title: Recognition, Simulation, and Refusal: A Contamination-Aware Study of Classic Psychological Effects in LLM Agents
summary: An LLM producing the response pattern associated with a human psychological effect is not the same claim as the LLM possessing that bias. We present PsyAgentBench, a benchmark that re-runs classic psychology experiments on LLM agents under a factorial design built to separate these: each paradigm is run with the paradigm explicitly labeled in the prompt (named) or framed as a routine task (blind), and on the literal textbook version of the task (canonical) or a structurally matched variant written to reduce lexical and scenario overlap with likely training data (counterfactual), crossed with a persona manipulation. Across five completed paradigms, evaluated on up to three open-weight model families with 41,904 trials released, apparently human-like effects arise through qualitatively different routes rather than one susceptibility: paradigm-label gating with explicit override (Asch conformity, 0 percent blind to 83.3 percent named on gpt-oss-120B), knowledge-dependent signal reliance (anchoring, exactly zero on grounded facts versus near total on invented quantities, a pattern equally consistent with rational use of the only available signal), amplification on novel content under labeling (framing), robust absence (sunk cost), and safety-mediated selection where refusal itself is the primary finding (minimal-group allocation). A one-sentence persona change (agreeableness, framed as an instruction rather than a verified trait manipulation) eliminates, dampens, or reverses these effects depending on which effect it is, arguing against any single response-bias account. We further formalize, and in two cases document empirically, three ways a psychology paradigm can fail to port to LLM agents: persona dominance, population collapse, and safety selection. We argue scalar bias-susceptibility scores obscure this structure and report replication profiles instead.

AI.tldr: 提出 PsyAgentBench 基准，以"命名/盲测 × 经典/反事实 × 人格操纵"的因子设计重跑经典心理学实验，证明 LLM 表现出的类人效应来自多种定性不同的路径，而非单一"偏见易感性"，并主张以复制剖面替代标量偏见分数。
AI.motivation: LLM 输出符合某种人类心理效应的反应模式，并不等同于 LLM 真正具有该偏见。既往研究常以单一"偏见易感性"标量概括此类现象，混淆了"复现行为模式"与"内在机制具备"两个不同命题，缺乏能区分二者的实验设计。
AI.method: 构建 PsyAgentBench：对每个范式采用因子设计——提示中显式标注范式（named）或将任务伪装为常规任务（blind），任务为教科书原版（canonical）或与训练数据在词汇与情境上重叠更少的结构匹配变体（counterfactual），并交叉一个人格操纵（如将宜人性表述为指令而非已验证特质）。在最多三个开源权重模型家族上评估五个已完成的范式，共发布 41,904 次试验。
AI.result: 各范式的类人效应来源各异：范式标签门控与显式覆盖（Asch 从众，gpt-oss-120B 上盲测 0% 比命名 83.3%）；依赖知识的信号使用（锚定效应在可靠事实上为零、在虚构数值上近乎完全，亦可解释为对唯一可用信号的理性利用）；标签化下对新内容的放大（框架效应）；稳健的缺失（沉没成本）；以及以拒绝本身为主要发现的安全中介选择（最小群体分配）。单句人格变更可使效应消失、减弱或反转，且因效应而异，否定了单一反应偏见解释。
AI.conclusion: 形式化并实证记录心理学范式向 LLM 智能体迁移失败的三种方式：人格主导、群体崩塌与安全选择。主张标量式偏见易感性得分会掩盖这种结构，应改为报告复制剖面（replication profiles）。

title: Memory That Looks Forward: A Zero-Inference Prospective Term for Personal Memory Retrieval
summary: Retrieval over a personal memory store is retrospective: it surfaces what resembles the query, and it is blind to what the user has committed to do. We describe a prospective term for memory retrieval that costs no inference at query time. Commitments are held in an explicit ledger as dated or trigger-conditioned entries; memory items linked to a firing entry receive a salience boost, blended multiplicatively into embedding-based retrieval so that relevance remains sovereign. On a synthetic prospective-memory task set modeled on TriggerBench's published structure (48 blind-authored dialogues, 175 tasks), the term raised recall@5 on the hard stratum from 0.000 to 0.955 at the default blend weight and to 1.000 under a floor variant, with zero false boosts across 53 resolved-commitment tasks. Blind authorship also produced a scope finding: only 17-29% of naturally phrased commitment-trigger pairs defeat embedding similarity, so the term matters on a real minority of cases and must do no harm on the rest, which it does not. We position precomputed commitment linkage as the always-on floor of a layered design whose expansion layer is query-time prospection. Results are preliminary: the evaluation set is author-constructed, and evaluation on TriggerBench proper is committed follow-up work once its data is released.

AI.tldr: 提出一种查询时零推理成本的"前瞻性"记忆检索机制：将用户承诺以显式台账（ledger）形式存储，命中条目关联的记忆项获得显著性加成，并以乘法方式融入嵌入检索，使相关性仍占主导。合成数据上难样本 recall@5 由 0.000 提升至 0.955（默认权重）/1.000（floor 变体），53 个已解决承诺任务零误加成。
AI.motivation: 现有个人记忆库检索是回溯式的：只召回与查询相似的记忆，而对用户已承诺要做的事（prospective memory）完全盲视。需要在查询时不增加推理开销的前提下，让检索能感知承诺。
AI.method: 将承诺保存在显式台账中，条目带日期或触发条件；当条目触发时，与之链接的记忆项获得显著性加成（salience boost），该加成以乘法方式与基于嵌入的检索分数混合，保证语义相关性仍占主导。评估采用仿 TriggerBench 结构构建的合成前瞻记忆任务集：48 段盲写对话、175 个任务。
AI.result: 难样本（hard stratum）recall@5 从 0.000 提升到默认混合权重下的 0.955，floor 变体下达 1.000；53 个已解决承诺任务上零误加成。范围发现：自然表述的承诺—触发配对中仅 17–29% 会击败嵌入相似度，说明该机制只在真实少数用例上起作用，且对其余用例无损害。
AI.conclusion: 将预计算的承诺链接定位为分层设计的"常开地板层"，其上层为查询时前瞻（prospection）的扩展层。结果为初步结论：评测集为作者自建，待 TriggerBench 数据发布后在正式基准上的评测是已承诺的后续工作。

title: Summarize, Judge, Refine: Decoupled Content Understanding and Policy Learning for Multimodal Content Moderation
summary: Content moderation systems traditionally entangle multimodal understanding with policy-specific classification, requiring full pipeline retraining for every policy change and suffering from label scarcity since multimedia cannot be meaningfully augmented. We propose Summarize-Judge-Refine (SJR), a two-model architecture that decouples these concerns via a natural language interface: a multimodal Content Model produces structured text summaries, and a text-only Policy Model classifies them against policy definitions. An iterative co-training loop refines the Content Model via GRPO to produce policy-relevant summaries, while text-space augmentation generates adversarial summary variants---an augmentation pathway impossible on raw multimedia---enabling few-shot policy bootstrap. Every decision is grounded in a human-readable summary, providing interpretability as a structural byproduct. On misleading advertisement detection, SJR achieves +23.6\% relative non-misleading F1 over a zero-shot chain-of-thought baseline, outperforming end-to-end SFT, STaR/RFT, and RLFT. Notably, a variant trained on zero real violating examples---with all positive-class data synthetically generated---matches the full-data model within 0.2\% relative on violating F1, demonstrating that new policies can launch without any real violation data.

AI.tldr: 提出 Summarize-Judge-Refine（SJR）双模型架构，通过自然语言接口解耦多模态理解与政策分类，配合 GRPO 协同训练与文本空间增强实现少样本政策冷启动与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统内容审核系统将多模态理解与特定政策分类耦合：政策变动需重训整条流水线，且多模态数据难以有效增强，导致标签稀缺。
AI.method: SJR 由两部分组成：多模态 Content Model 生成结构化文本摘要，纯文本 Policy Model 依据政策定义对摘要分类。通过迭代协同训练，用 GRPO 优化 Content Model 以产出政策相关摘要；并在文本空间生成对抗性摘要变体（多模态原始数据无法实现的增强路径），支持少样本政策引导。所有决策基于人类可读摘要，天然具备可解释性。
AI.result: 在误导性广告检测任务上，SJR 相比零样本思维链基线非误导类 F1 相对提升 +23.6%，优于端到端 SFT、STaR/RFT 与 RLFT。一个完全使用合成正类数据、零真实违规样本训练的变体，在违规类 F1 上与全量数据模型相差仅 0.2% 相对值。
AI.conclusion: 解耦式摘要—判别—精炼架构使新政策无需真实违规数据即可上线，同时兼顾性能与可解释性。

title: AI-inferred expressed well-being and collective-action discourse in climate-change campaigns on X
summary: Climate campaigns are often evaluated through attention and mobilization, but less is known about the well-being language that accompanies them. Whether campaign periods alter positive affect and hope, and whether happiness aligns with action language, remains unresolved. We analysed 364,118 public Twitter/X posts from Earth Day, Earth Hour, Global Climate Action Day and World Environment Day in 19 occurrence-years, using 30-day pre-event, event and post-event windows. A versioned weighted lexical model estimated happiness, future-oriented hope, collective capability, distress and action language. Event-period happiness prevalence was 9.02 percentage points higher than the pre-event baseline , whereas paired occurrence contrasts showed a 10.75-point decline in action language, indicating a happiness--action divergence. The happiness estimate remained positive across composition and text-deduplication checks, but was less precise under a 19-cluster wild bootstrap. Happier source posts had lower odds of an observed matched retweet cascade.

AI.tldr: 气候运动研究多关注注意力和动员，较少考察伴随的情感语言。本研究分析19个事件年度、四类气候纪念日的364,118条推文，采用加权词典模型测量幸福感、希望、集体能力、痛苦与行动语言，发现事件期幸福感上升9.02个百分点，行动语言下降10.75个百分点，呈"幸福—行动背离"。
AI.motivation: 气候运动的评估通常以关注度和动员规模为指标，但对其伴随的福祉/情感语言了解不足。尚不清楚运动周期是否改变积极情感与希望，也不清楚幸福感是否与行动语言相一致，这一空白需要实证检验。
AI.method: 采集地球日、地球一小时、全球气候行动日、世界环境日共19个事件年度的364,118条Twitter/X公开帖子，设置事件前30天、事件期、事件后30天窗口。构建带版本控制的加权词典模型，估计幸福感、面向未来的希望、集体能力、痛苦和行动语言五类指标。进行构成检验与文本去重稳健性检验，并采用19个聚类的wild bootstrap评估精度，同时检验源帖子幸福感与其被匹配转推级联出现几率的关系。
AI.result: 事件期幸福感流行度比事件前基线高9.02个百分点；配对事件对比显示行动语言下降10.75个百分点，构成"幸福—行动背离"。幸福感估计在构成与文本去重检验中保持为正，但在19聚类wild bootstrap下精度下降。幸福感更高的源帖子出现匹配转推级联的几率更低。
AI.conclusion: 气候纪念活动期间，公共话语中的积极情感上升并未同步转化为行动语言，二者出现分离。幸福感在多种稳健性检验中方向一致但统计精度有限，且高幸福感内容更不易形成转推级联，提示情感表达与传播动员之间可能存在张力。

title: Did You Steal My Shot? Pioneering Camera Motion Plagiarism Detection in Generative Videos
summary: Camera motion often reflects directorial intent and requires professional equipment, making it a high value form of intellectual property. However, generative video models can imitate such high value camera motions with simple prompts, while existing similarity detection methods mainly operate on visual content and fail to capture deeper motion similarity. This is mainly because their training data entangles camera motion with visual content. Moreover, traditional optical flow is insufficient to represent complex camera motions. We therefore build the first benchmark for camera motion analysis, including a motion dataset with \textbf{11} motion styles and evaluation protocols. Furthermore, we propose a motion representation that augments optical flow with vorticity cues from fluid dynamics, thereby better capturing motions. Experiments show that our detector achieves a \textbf{3.02*} improvement in plagiarism detection over the strongest baseline and remains effective on generative videos. We believe our work extends copyright protection beyond static content to dynamic camera motion.

AI.tldr: 本文针对生成式视频可轻易模仿高价值镜头运动、而现有相似性检测方法难以捕捉深层运动相似性的问题，构建了首个镜头运动分析基准，并提出融合流体力学涡量线索的运动表征，使抄袭检测性能较最强基线提升3.02倍，并能有效应对生成视频。
AI.motivation: 镜头运动体现导演意图，需专业设备拍摄，属于高价值知识产权。但生成式视频模型仅凭简单提示即可模仿此类运动；现有相似性检测方法主要基于视觉内容，无法捕捉更深层的运动相似性，原因是其训练数据将镜头运动与视觉内容纠缠在一起，且传统光流不足以表示复杂镜头运动。
AI.method: 1) 构建首个镜头运动分析基准，含11种运动风格的运动数据集及评测协议；2) 提出在光流基础上引入流体力学涡量（vorticity）线索的运动表征，以更好地刻画运动。
AI.result: 检测器在抄袭检测任务上较最强基线取得3.02*的提升，并在生成视频上仍保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将版权保护从静态内容扩展至动态镜头运动。

title: Didactic knowledge or Clinical Cases? How Data Types Shape Medical Large Language Models
comment: This paper is accepted by NLPCC 2026 oral
summary: Medical large language models are commonly trained on mixtures of didactic data (e.g., textbooks) and clinical data (e.g., patient records), yet how these data types differentially shape model capabilities remains unclear. We address this issue with token-matched experiments that vary the didactic-to-clinical ratio and analyze how data composition affects performance, capability profiles, and error patterns across knowledge-intensive and clinic-oriented tasks. We uncover an asymmetric transfer across task types: clinical data improves clinic-oriented tasks while remaining competitive on knowledge-intensive ones, whereas didactic data mainly improves knowledge-intensive tasks. Error analysis suggests a knowing-doing gap, where improvements in knowledge recall do not reliably generalize to clinical reasoning. We further observe that modest amounts of clinical data yield most of the gains on EHR-grounded tasks, while the optimal mixture ratio varies with the knowledge and clinical reasoning demands of downstream tasks. These findings suggest that medical LLM data curation should be application-driven, with higher proportions of clinical data preferred for reasoning-intensive use cases.

AI.tldr: 本文通过token匹配实验系统探究医学大语言模型训练数据中"教学数据"与"临床数据"配比对模型能力的影响，发现两类数据存在非对称迁移，并提出以应用为导向的数据配比策略。
AI.motivation: 医学大语言模型通常在教科书类教学数据与病历类临床数据的混合语料上训练，但这两类数据如何差异化地塑造模型能力尚不清晰，缺乏对数据配比与下游任务表现关系的系统理解，也缺少指导数据筛选的实证依据。
AI.method: 开展token匹配（等量token控制）的实验，系统性改变教学数据与临床数据的比例，在知识密集型任务与面向临床的任务上评估模型表现，并分析其能力画像与错误模式。
AI.result: 发现跨任务类型的非对称迁移：临床数据提升面向临床的任务，并在知识密集型任务上保持竞争力；教学数据则主要提升知识密集型任务。错误分析揭示存在"知行差距"（knowing-doing gap），即知识回忆能力的提升并不能可靠地泛化到临床推理。此外，少量临床数据即可在基于电子健康记录（EHR）的任务上取得大部分收益，而最优混合比例随下游任务对知识与临床推理的需求而变化。
AI.conclusion: 医学大语言模型的数据策划应当以应用为导向：对推理密集型用例，应优先采用更高比例的临床数据。

title: Token Signatures of Code: Comparing Coding Behaviors Across Large Language Models
summary: The evaluation of large language models (LLMs) on coding tasks has primarily focused on performance metrics such as pass@k. As LLMs continue to advance, many models now meet baseline performance requirements, reducing the discriminative power of performance-based evaluation alone. Yet a key question remains largely unexplored: how do LLMs differ in their coding behavior? We propose CLIC (Code Learning for Identification and Comparison), a visual analytics approach that characterizes LLM coding behavior through token-frequency analysis. CLIC represents each code sample as a feature vector of token frequencies and trains an interpretable decision tree to separate two LLMs' code sets. Beyond classification accuracy, we define two new metrics: robustness, which measures whether the two LLMs remain distinguishable as their most-discriminative tokens are progressively removed, and concentration, which measures whether the difference is driven by a few dominant tokens or spread across many. Interpreting numerous pairwise comparisons (across LLM pairs, tasks, and tokenization levels) and tracing the full analytical chain form an inherently multi-scale, hypothesis-driven exploration task. We therefore develop an interactive visual analytics system to navigate the comparison landscape, identify pairs of interest, and drill down into discriminative tokens and their code contexts. Case studies comparing 10 LLMs across 22 Kaggle ML tasks reveal actionable insights for LLM selection and prompt engineering.

AI.tldr: 提出CLIC视觉分析方法，通过token频率分析刻画LLM编码行为，并定义鲁棒性与集中度两个新指标，配合交互式系统揭示模型差异。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM编码评测主要依赖pass@k等性能指标，随着模型普遍达标，性能评估的区分度下降；而模型在编码行为上的差异这一关键问题尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: CLIC将每个代码样本表示为token频率特征向量，训练可解释决策树以区分两个LLM的代码集合；定义鲁棒性（逐步移除最具区分性token后是否仍可区分）与集中度（差异由少数主导token还是众多token驱动）两个新指标；并开发交互式可视分析系统以导航比较全貌、筛选感兴趣配对并下钻到区分性token及其代码语境。
AI.result: 在22个Kaggle机器学习任务上对比10个LLM的案例研究显示，该方法能为LLM选择与提示工程提供可操作的洞见。
AI.conclusion: CLIC通过token频率分析与可视分析，将LLM评测从单纯性能比较拓展到编码行为刻画，弥补了性能指标区分度不足的问题。

title: Enabling Vision and Cross-Modal Learning for Multimodal Stroke Recurrence Prediction: An Interpretable Two-Step Framework
comment: ML-CDS 2026: Multimodal Learning and Fusion Across Scales for Clinical Decision Support, MICCAI 2026, Strasbourg, France
summary: Multimodal stroke recurrence prediction requires effective integration of heterogeneous clinical and imaging data, yet modality imbalance often causes models to over-rely on dominant modalities and underutilize complementary information. While self-supervised pretraining and selective parameter freezing are commonly employed to improve representation learning and fine-tuning stability, their effect on modality contributions and cross-modal behavior in multimodal medical models remains largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate whether image pretraining on 3D CTA scans reduces modality imbalance and improves cross-modal integration for stroke recurrence prediction, a clinically critical task we recently addressed. To this end, two multimodal neural networks are pretrained in a self-supervised manner and subsequently fine-tuned using two distinct freezing strategies. Their performance and modality utilization are compared against both the baseline model from our previous work and models trained entirely from scratch in this study. Our results demonstrate that self-supervised pretraining enables more effective utilization of the multimodal image-tabular dataset, outperforming both the prior baseline and all non-pretrained models. Notably, the best-performing Vision Transformer based neural network successfully overcomes unimodal collapse. Synergy analysis reveals significant interactions between vision and both gender and CHD, suggesting clinically relevant patterns for stroke recurrence. Overall, our findings demonstrate that self-supervised pretraining and strategic fine-tuning support more balanced modality utilization and enable meaningful cross-modal interactions. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/ChristianGappGit/SSL_Pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自监督预训练与参数冻结策略对多模态卒中复发预测中模态失衡与跨模态融合的影响。结果表明，自监督预训练优于既往基线与所有从零训练模型，最佳ViT模型克服了单模态塌缩，并发现图像与性别、CHD存在显著交互。
AI.motivation: 多模态卒中复发预测需整合异质临床与影像数据，但模态失衡会使模型过度依赖主导模态、忽视互补信息。自监督预训练与选择性冻结虽常用于提升表征学习与微调稳定性，但其对多模态医学模型中模态贡献与跨模态行为的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建两个多模态神经网络，先对3D CTA影像进行自监督预训练，再采用两种不同的冻结策略进行微调；与既往工作的基线模型及本研究从零训练的模型进行性能与模态利用度对比，并开展协同（synergy）分析考察跨模态交互。
AI.result: 自监督预训练使模型能更有效地利用图像-表格多模态数据，性能优于既往基线与所有非预训练模型；表现最佳的Vision Transformer模型成功克服单模态塌缩；协同分析显示视觉与性别、CHD之间存在显著交互，提示具有临床意义的卒中复发模式。
AI.conclusion: 自监督预训练结合策略性微调有助于实现更均衡的模态利用并促成有意义的跨模态交互，为多模态医学预测中的模态失衡问题提供了有效思路。

title: An Affordable AI-Integrated Smart Cane for Multimodal Mobility Assistance of Visually Impaired Users
summary: Visual impairment affects over 2.2 billion people worldwide, yet conventional white canes cannot detect elevated hazards or provide semantic environmental context. Existing AI-assisted navigation systems typically rely on expensive hardware or cloud connectivity, limiting accessibility in resource-constrained settings. This paper presents an affordable (\$88 USD), fully offline AI-integrated smart cane designed for multimodal mobility assistance on an ultra-low-power Raspberry Pi Zero 2W. The system fuses RGB vision sensing with Time-of-Flight (ToF) distance estimation, pairing an INT8-quantized SSD MobileNet V1 model with distance-aware vibrotactile feedback and real-time audio alerts. To ensure operational robustness on constrained hardware, a multiprocessing architecture isolates sensor acquisition, neural inference, and haptic feedback into independent processes with fail-safe sensing support. Experimental evaluation across indoor mobility scenarios demonstrates a macro-averaged F1-score of 0.82 (precision: 0.85, recall: 0.81), a mean end-to-end latency of 330\,ms, and a peak power draw of 2.8\,W. A preliminary usability study with 12 participants (SUS: 78.5, NASA-TLX) demonstrated positive user perception and enhanced obstacle awareness. The proposed prototype validates the feasibility of deploying privacy-preserving, edge-native assistive intelligence for cost-sensitive mobility assistance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一款售价88美元、完全离线的AI智能盲杖，基于Raspberry Pi Zero 2W，融合RGB视觉与ToF测距，采用INT8量化SSD MobileNet V1与多进程架构，在室内场景实现F1 0.82、端到端延迟330 ms、峰值功耗2.8 W，并通过12人可用性研究验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 全球超过22亿人受视觉障碍影响，传统白杖无法检测高处障碍或提供语义环境信息；现有AI辅助导航系统多依赖昂贵硬件或云端连接，难以在资源受限场景中普及。因此需要一种低成本、可离线运行的边缘智能辅助方案。
AI.method: 构建88美元的低成本智能盲杖，硬件平台为超低功耗Raspberry Pi Zero 2W；融合RGB视觉感知与ToF距离估计，模型采用INT8量化的SSD MobileNet V1；输出端结合距离感知的振动触觉反馈与实时音频提示；软件上采用多进程架构，将传感器采集、神经网络推理与触觉反馈隔离为独立进程，并配备失效安全（fail-safe）传感支持以保障运行稳健性。
AI.result: 室内移动场景实验显示宏平均F1为0.82（精确率0.85、召回率0.81），平均端到端延迟330 ms，峰值功耗2.8 W；12名参与者的初步可用性研究（SUS 78.5、NASA-TLX）表明用户主观评价积极且障碍感知能力增强。
AI.conclusion: 该原型验证了在成本敏感型出行辅助场景中部署隐私保护、边缘原生辅助智能的可行性。

title: TreeSpark: Calibrated, Load-Adaptive Draft Trees for Semi-Autoregressive Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model inference by letting a cheap drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Recent block drafters make drafting nearly free: a single backbone pass emits an entire block of draft tokens. Draft trees promise a further gain -- several alternative continuations verified in one target forward -- but existing constructions rank candidates by per-position marginals that ignore which parent a candidate extends, so on semi-autoregressive drafters wider trees mostly add mis-ranked nodes; and a tree of fixed size ignores how much speculation each decoding round, and each serving load, can support. We introduce TreeSpark, which reads a parent-conditioned distribution from the drafter's existing Markov head at negligible cost, calibrates it into an edge-acceptance estimate, and lets path survival govern everything else: best-first expansion, per-round stopping, and a load-adaptive serving policy. Sampling siblings without replacement, with matching residuals in recursive rejection, keeps decoding lossless at any temperature. Adaptive trees improve on matched fixed budgets at every temperature; against a tuned chain on the same drafter, TreeSpark accepts 15-25% more draft tokens per round and decodes 8-14% faster in single-request wall-clock, and under rising load it gracefully shrinks the tree back to the chain. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/PopSoda2002/TreeSpark

AI.tldr: TreeSpark：利用草稿模型 Markov head 的父条件分布做边接受率校准，以路径存活概率驱动最优优先扩展、轮内停止与负载自适应服务，实现无损自适应推测树解码。
AI.motivation: 现有多块草稿器（block drafter）虽使起草近乎零成本，但推测树构造存在两个缺陷：(1) 候选排序依据位置边缘概率，忽略了候选所扩展的父节点，(2) 在半自回归草稿器上扩宽树只会引入错排节点；(3) 固定尺寸的树未考虑每轮解码与每个服务负载实际可支持的推测量。
AI.method: 从草稿器已有的 Markov head 中以极低成本读取父条件分布，将其校准为边接受率估计；以路径存活概率统一驱动最优优先（best-first）树扩展、逐轮停止准则与负载自适应服务策略；兄弟节点采用无放回采样，并在递归拒绝采样中使用匹配残差，保证任意温度下解码无损。
AI.result: 自适应树在各温度下均优于等预算固定树；在同一草稿器上与调优链式基线相比，每轮多接受 15–25% 草稿 token，单请求 wall-clock 提速 8–14%；负载升高时树能优雅收缩回链式结构。
AI.conclusion: 以父条件边接受率替代位置边缘概率、并以路径存活统一调度树构建与服务，可在保持无损的前提下显著提升推测解码的接受长度与吞吐，且自适应地适配解码轮与服务负载。

title: Moonworks Lunara: Modeling Artistic Intelligence
summary: We formulate \emph{Artistic Intelligence} as exploration driven world realization, leaving space for creative possibility while preserving the semantic, artistic, and compositional structure that must remain true. Moonworks Lunara, a text-to-image model, implements this framework with a novel Diffusion Mixture Transformer architecture. A new training algorithm iteratively evolves the data distribution through informative sample acquisition and targeted injection of human-created art. We benchmark Lunara against seven image-generation models, including FLUX.2-Klein-4B, Qwen-Image (20B), and GPT-Image-1-Mini. With GPT-5.6 Sol as evaluator, Lunara ranks first in \emph{Aesthetic Quality (8.473 vs. 8.457 GPT-Image-1-mini)}, second in \emph{Emotional Resonance}, and remains competitive in \emph{Content Integrity}. A blind human evaluation over the same evaluation set corroborates the automated metrics, ranking Lunara first. It also stays among the strongest models under conventional measures including CLIPScore and LAION Aesthetic Predictor. On GenEval, Lunara achieves competitive performance against a broader set of 16 models, including GPT Image 2 and Seedream 4.0. These results place Lunara at the frontier with Artistic Intelligence while maintaining a sub-10B active-parameter footprint and sub-10-second inference latency. Lunara advances the general visual intelligence frontier by shifting the question from whether models can get images right to how deeply they can interpret meaning and realize it as imaginative, expressive worlds.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"艺术智能"（Artistic Intelligence）框架，并据此开发文本到图像模型 Moonworks Lunara，在美学质量与人类盲评中登顶，同时保持十亿级参数与秒级推理。
AI.motivation: 现有图像生成模型主要关注"是否正确还原"（能否把图像画对），而缺乏在保留语义、艺术与构图结构不变的前提下，探索创造性可能性的能力。作者希望将评价问题从"模型能否把图像画对"转向"模型能多深地解读意义并将其实现为富有想象力与表现力的世界"。
AI.method: 1) 将"艺术智能"形式化为"探索驱动的世界实现"（exploration driven world realization）；2) Moonworks Lunara 采用新型 Diffusion Mixture Transformer 架构实现该框架；3) 提出新的训练算法，通过有信息量的样本获取（informative sample acquisition）与人类创作艺术的定向注入（targeted injection），迭代演化数据分布。
AI.result: 与 7 个图像生成模型（含 FLUX.2-Klein-4B、Qwen-Image 20B、GPT-Image-1-Mini）对比，以 GPT-5.6 Sol 为评估器：Lunara 在美学质量排名第一（8.473 vs. 8.457），情感共鸣排名第二，内容完整性保持竞争力；同评测集上的人类盲评与自动指标一致，Lunara 排名第一。在 CLIPScore 与 LAION Aesthetic Predictor 等常规指标上同样处于最强之列。在 GenEval 上，面对包括 GPT Image 2、Seedream 4.0 在内的 16 个更广模型集合，表现具竞争力。模型保持低于 10B 的活跃参数规模与低于 10 秒的推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: Lunara 以"艺术智能"定位处于该方向前沿，并在小参数、低延迟条件下达到领先的美学与人类偏好表现。其意义在于推动通用视觉智能前沿：关键问题从"模型能否把图像画对"转变为"模型能多深地解读意义并将其实现为富有想象力、表现力的世界"。

title: PAANI : On Device Visual Evidence Fusion and Explainable Guidance for River Robot Simulation
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables. Includes system and AI architecture diagrams, model-training results, qualitative evaluations, and Arduino UNO Q deployment measurements. Project code, trained models, ONNX artifacts, logs, and reproducibility documentation are available at https://github.com/immanuelihs/ASV_PAANI
summary: Mobile river monitoring robots must interpret obstacles and water boundaries that geographic waypoints alone cannot describe. On resource constrained platforms, converting imperfect visual predictions into timely and inspectable guidance is a distinct challenge. An object label or steering command does not explain which evidence supports a decision or when that evidence is unreliable. We present PAANI, an on-device perception to guidance architecture that combines a project trained YOLO11n detector and a custom MobileNetV3 Small semantic segmenter with timestamp aligned evidence fusion on Arduino UNO Q. Bounded tracking supplies object persistence, while an explicit corridor policy combines surface labels, accepted detections, urgency and mask uncertainty. Each final advisory exposes its contributing evidence and policy reasons. ROS 2 interfaces connect the local AI pipeline to a separate Gazebo vessel, localization and control testbed. Training uses 10,000 WaterScenes images for four-class detection and 1,127 MaSTr1325 images for segmentation, including 198 segmentation validation images. The selected FP32 ONNX models occupy 14.817 MB. Detector checkpoint test mAP at 0.5 IoU is 0.7388, while the separately evaluated rectangular ONNX export achieves validation mAP at 0.5 IoU of 0.7367. Segmentation ONNX validation mIoU is 0.9750. A five-minute UNO Q recording produced median and 95th percentile pipeline latencies of 467.8 ms and 580.3 ms at a configured 0.5 Hz cadence. The evaluation also identifies black input misclassification and a sampling rate mismatch that prevents the diagnostic apparent motion estimator from collecting sufficient evidence. These results support an inspectable and reusable edge robotics foundation while clearly distinguishing model accuracy and on-board execution from validated on-water collision avoidance.

AI.tldr: 提出PAANI——面向资源受限平台的端侧感知到引导架构，融合YOLO11n检测、MobileNetV3-Small分割与证据融合，在Arduino UNO Q上生成可解释的航行建议，并通过ROS 2对接Gazebo测试台。
AI.motivation: 河道监测机器人仅靠地理航点无法描述障碍与水域边界；在资源受限平台上，将不完美的视觉预测转化为及时、可审查的引导是独立难题。单一目标标签或转向指令无法说明决策依据，也无法指示证据何时不可靠。
AI.method: 在Arduino UNO Q上实现端侧感知到引导流水线：项目训练的YOLO11n检测器 + 定制MobileNetV3-Small语义分割器，采用时间戳对齐的证据融合；用有界跟踪维持目标持续性；显式走廊策略综合水面标签、接受检测、紧迫度与掩码不确定性；每条建议输出其证据来源与策略理由。ROS 2接口连接本地AI流水线与独立的Gazebo船舶、定位与控制测试台。训练数据：10,000张WaterScenes图像（四类检测）、1,127张MaSTr1325图像（分割，含198张验证）。
AI.result: FP32 ONNX模型共14.817 MB。检测器checkpoint在0.5 IoU下测试mAP为0.7388，矩形ONNX导出的验证mAP为0.7367；分割ONNX验证mIoU为0.9750。五分钟UNO Q录制在0.5 Hz配置频率下，流水线时延中位数467.8 ms，95分位580.3 ms。评估还发现黑色输入误分类，以及采样率不匹配导致诊断性表观运动估计器证据不足。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持一个可审查、可复用的边缘机器人基础，同时明确区分模型精度与板载执行性能，与经水面验证的避碰能力相区别。

title: A framework for recipe data structure with applications for culinary and nutritional insights
comment: Main Text (11 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables); Supplementary Information (6 pages, 5 figures, 1 table)
summary: Cooking is a complex process that transforms raw ingredients into delicious and nutritious dishes, yet the recipes that encode this process remain largely free text; readable by people but not directly computable. Existing recipe collections capture fragments of this information, but no shared representation links a recipe's structured ingredient composition, its geo-cultural provenance, and its nutritional profile within a single queryable schema. We address this representation gap by formalizing a framework for recipe data structure that decomposes each recipe into typed ingredient entities, grounds those entities in a reference nutritional database, and annotates them with geo-cultural and dietary context. We present RecipeDB2, a structured compilation of 128,942 recipes with 35,474 ingredients from 32 regions and 99 countries. Ingredient phrases are parsed into seven culinary attributes using a transformer-based named-entity model; ingredients are linked to the USDA reference tables through a BERT embedding strategy (F1 = 87.90 on a manually adjudicated set of the 200 most frequent ingredients), yielding 148 nutritional parameters per mapped ingredient; a Random Forest classifier propagates 34 ingredient categories across the full vocabulary; and a deterministic, conservative rule set assigns each recipe a dietary style. Through RecipeDB2 (https://cosylab.iiitd.edu.in/recipedb2/), we demonstrate a scalable framework for making recipes computable, turning culinary heritage (long treated as an artistic rather than a quantitative object) into a data-driven analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对食谱数据缺乏统一可计算表示的问题，构建了结构化食谱框架 RecipeDB2，整合 128,942 份食谱、35,474 种食材，涵盖食材解析、营养映射与地理文化标注，实现食谱的可查询与数据驱动分析。
AI.motivation: 食谱虽编码了将原料转化为菜肴的复杂过程，但多以自由文本形式存在，人类可读却难以直接计算。现有食谱数据集仅捕获零散信息，缺乏统一的可查询模式来同时关联结构化食材组成、地理文化来源与营养特征，因此存在表示层面的空白。
AI.method: 论文形式化了一个食谱数据结构框架：将每份食谱分解为带类型的食材实体，将其锚定到参考营养数据库，并标注地理文化与饮食背景。具体地，用基于 Transformer 的命名实体模型把食材短语解析为七类烹饪属性；用 BERT 嵌入策略将食材链接到 USDA 参考表；用随机森林分类器在全词表上传播 34 个食材类别；再用确定性、保守的规则集为每份食谱分配饮食风格。
AI.result: RecipeDB2 汇集了来自 32 个地区、99 个国家的 128,942 份食谱和 35,474 种食材。食材与 USDA 表的链接在 200 个最高频食材的人工裁定集上 F1 = 87.90，每个映射食材可获得 148 个营养参数。系统已上线于 https://cosylab.iiitd.edu.in/recipedb2/。
AI.conclusion: RecipeDB2 提供了一个可扩展的框架，使食谱变得可计算，将长期被视为艺术而非定量对象的烹饪遗产转化为数据驱动的分析对象。

title: Performance vs Consistency: Evaluating a Foundation Model in Lung-RADS Screening
summary: Foundation models have recently demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of medical imaging tasks. However, their performance in structured clinical interpretation settings remains insufficiently explored. In lung cancer screening, interpretative variability persists despite standardized frameworks such as Lung-RADS. In this study, we evaluate MedGemma, a medical general-purpose foundation model derived from Gemini and its fine-tuned version adapted for lung cancer detection and diagnosis, compared against radiologists performing Lung-RADS v2022 assessment on the NLST dataset. Twelve radiologists independently evaluated each case in a multi-reader design, enabling quantification of inter-reader variability. Radiologists achieved a mean AUC of 0.90, with substantial variability across readers (range: 0.80-0.94). The native foundation model achieved an AUC of 0.70, failing to reach clinically relevant performance. In contrast, fine-tuning significantly improved performance to an AUC of 0.83, placing the model within the lower range of individual radiologists performance. These findings highlight a trade-off between peak accuracy and prediction consistency. Unlike radiologists, under fixed conditions, the model produces deterministic outputs, removing inter-run variability under identical inputs, in contrast to inter-reader variability observed among radiologists. This supports the role of fine-tuned foundation models potential complementary tools for clinical decision support, particularly in settings with limited expertise. However, evaluation is performed on a case-enriched cohort from NLST and does not account for real-world prevalence or external validation, limiting direct clinical generalization.

AI.tldr: 该研究在NLST数据集上评估MedGemma（含微调版）与12名放射科医生在Lung-RADS v2022评估中的表现。放射科医生平均AUC为0.90（区间0.80–0.94），原始基础模型AUC仅0.70，微调后提升至0.83，落入放射科医生表现的较低区间。研究揭示了峰值准确性与预测一致性之间的权衡：模型在固定条件下输出确定，无运行间变异，而医生存在读者间变异。作者认为微调基础模型可作为临床决策支持的补充工具，但受限于病例富集队列、未考虑真实患病率及缺乏外部验证。
AI.motivation: 基础模型在多种医学影像任务中展现出强大能力，但其在结构化临床解读场景（如肺癌筛查中标准化的Lung-RADS框架）中的表现尚未被充分探索。尽管已有标准化框架，解读变异性仍然存在，因此需要量化基础模型与放射科医生之间的性能差距及一致性差异。
AI.method: 在NLST数据集上，采用多读者设计，让12名放射科医生独立对每个病例进行Lung-RADS v2022评估，以量化读者间变异性；同时评估MedGemma（源自Gemini的医学通用基础模型）及其针对肺癌检测与诊断微调的版本，比较三者的AUC表现。
AI.result: 放射科医生平均AUC为0.90，读者间差异显著（0.80–0.94）；原始基础模型AUC为0.70，未达到临床相关性能；微调后显著提升至AUC 0.83，处于个体放射科医生表现的较低区间。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了峰值准确性与预测一致性之间的权衡：模型在固定条件下输出确定，消除了相同输入下的运行间变异，与放射科医生间的读者间变异形成对比。这支持微调基础模型作为临床决策支持补充工具的潜力，尤其在专业知识有限的场景中。但评估基于NLST的病例富集队列，未考虑真实世界患病率且缺乏外部验证，限制了直接的临床推广。

title: Social Influence and the Allocation of Scientific Attention in AI Populations
summary: AI systems are becoming participants in the evaluation and use of scientific research. They encounter citation counts, download statistics and lists of popular articles developed around human readers, but the collective consequences of these signals for artificial readers remain uncertain. This paper adapts the Music Lab design to a market for academic attention. In the first experiment, 1,000 AI agents choose papers from the titles and abstracts of all 114 regular research articles published in the American Economic Review in 2025. The experiment has five independent-choice communities and five social-influence communities, each with 100 sequential agents. Only agents in the social-influence condition observe earlier selections within their community. Agents may select any number of papers. Social-information communities select 17.2 percent fewer papers per agent, concentrate their choices more heavily, and collectively cover 73 papers, compared with 90 independently. Between-community variation is greater under social information. In a second experiment with 200 agents across twenty social communities, randomly assigning papers five initial selections raises their subsequent selection rate by 45.55 percentage points (95% CI: 41.20 to 49.90). Choices have modest correspondence with external citations and little correspondence with download counts. The results show how a simple information rule shapes the volume, breadth and distribution of scientific attention in an artificial population.

AI.tldr: 本文将"音乐实验室"（Music Lab）范式迁移至学术注意力市场，用1,000个AI智能体从《美国经济评论》2025年114篇论文中选文，发现社会信息使个体选文量减少17.2%、选择更集中、集体覆盖从90篇降至73篇，且随机赋予初始选择可将后续选择率提高45.55个百分点，表明简单信息规则会显著塑造人工群体中科学注意力的规模、广度与分布。
AI.motivation: AI系统正成为科研评价与使用中的参与者，而它们所接触的引用量、下载量、热门文章榜单等信号均是围绕人类读者构建的；这些信号对"人工读者"群体的集体后果尚不明确。作者希望借助成熟的Music Lab实验设计，检验社会信息（他人选择）如何影响AI智能体的选文行为。
AI.method: 采用改编自Music Lab的在线实验设计。实验一：1,000个AI智能体从《美国经济评论》2025年114篇常规研究论文的标题与摘要中选文，分为5个独立选择社区和5个社会影响社区，每组100个顺序决策智能体，仅社会影响组可观察本社区先前选择；智能体可选任意数量论文。实验二：20个社会社区共200个智能体，随机为论文赋予5次初始选择，检验其对后续选择率的因果影响。另将选择结果与外部引用量、下载量做对应性比较。
AI.result: 社会信息社区每智能体选文数量比独立组少17.2%，选择更集中，集体覆盖73篇（独立组为90篇）；社会信息条件下社区间差异更大。实验二中，随机赋予5次初始选择使论文后续选择率提高45.55个百分点（95% CI: 41.20–49.90）。选择与外部引用量仅有微弱对应，与下载量几乎没有对应。
AI.conclusion: 一条简单的信息规则即可显著改变人工群体中科学注意力的总量、广度与分布，产生"马太效应"式的集中与路径依赖。这提示在AI参与科研评价的背景下，基于人类读者构建的流行度信号可能被AI放大并扭曲注意力分配，需要审慎设计面向人工读者的信息机制。

title: AdaMem: Adaptive Memory Token Allocation for Soft Compression in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves language models with retrieved evidence, but processing many long passages is costly and can introduce distracting information. Soft compression addresses this challenge by encoding passages as compact sequences of continuous memory embeddings before generation. However, existing methods typically assign each retained passage an identical number of memory embeddings, irrespective of its query-specific relevance. To address this, we propose AdaMem, a relevance-guided soft-compression framework that maps learned passage-relevance estimates to a query-dependent allocation of a fixed memory-token budget. A shared query-conditioned compressor produces both continuous passage memories and relevance scores in a single pass; a deterministic allocation rule assigns more memory tokens to higher-scoring passages and can omit low-scoring ones. Across six open-domain QA benchmarks, AdaMem consistently outperforms OSCAR (the closely matched soft-compression baseline that uses uniform allocation) as well as other soft-compression methods at matched memory budgets. Under standard 16$\times$ compression, AdaMem improves sub-string match by up to 3.2 points (5.5%) over uniform allocation baseline, with an average relative gain of 3.4%; under aggressive 64$\times$ compression the average relative gain grows to 14.6%, with a maximum of 9.8 points (19.7%) on PopQA. AdaMem matches the answer quality of the uncompressed at up to 4$\times$ lower inference latency than full context baseline. AdaMem retains an efficiency profile comparable to the uniform-compression baseline, while achieving up to $4\times$ lower inference latency than full-context inference. Thus, relevance-guided memory allocation is particularly effective when retrieval pools are large and the available memory budget is tight.

AI.tldr: AdaMem是一个基于相关性引导的软压缩框架，通过按查询相关度动态分配记忆token预算，在多个开放域QA基准上优于均匀分配方法，尤其在紧预算下增益显著。
AI.motivation: 现有软压缩方法对每个保留段落分配相同数量的记忆嵌入，忽略了段落相对查询的差异性相关性，导致在长段落、大检索池与紧记忆预算场景下效率与效果受限。
AI.method: 提出AdaMem：共享的查询条件压缩器单次前向同时产出连续段落记忆与相关性打分；再用确定性分配规则将固定记忆token预算按查询相关度分配给段落，高分段落获得更多token，低分段落可被省略。
AI.result: 在六个开放域QA基准上稳定超越均匀分配的OSCAR等软压缩方法。16×压缩下子串匹配最高提升3.2点（5.5%），平均相对增益3.4%；64×压缩下平均相对增益达14.6%，PopQA最高9.8点（19.7%）；推理延迟比全上下文基线低至多4×。
AI.conclusion: 相关性引导的记忆分配在检索池大且记忆预算紧时尤为有效，可在保持与均匀压缩相当效率的同时，以更低延迟逼近未压缩答案质量。

title: Brain-to-Image Generation: Reconstructing Visual Stimuli from EEG using Generative Adversarial Networks
summary: Reconstructing visual stimuli from electroencephalography (EEG) is difficult because scalp measurements have high temporal but limited spatial resolution, and paired EEG-image datasets remain small relative to modern generative-model training corpora. We present a reproducible single-subject baseline on THINGS-EEG2 that first tests the more defensible question of whether EEG can retrieve the viewed stimulus in a visual embedding space. A compact temporal-spatial convolutional encoder maps repetition-averaged EEG (63 by 250) to provided 512-dimensional ViT-B/32 image features. Model selection uses a concept-disjoint validation split, and final evaluation uses the official 200-image, 200-concept test gallery. Across three training seeds, the model obtains 12.83 +/- 0.58%, 39.17 +/- 1.76%, and 58.00 +/- 1.73% image recall at 1, 5, and 10 (mean +/- sample standard deviation), compared with analytical chance levels of 0.5%, 2.5%, and 5.0%. A session-balanced ablation shows that averaging more test repetitions generally improves ranking. Applying the Subject 01 model to the other nine subjects without adaptation causes a sharp performance drop, exposing subject specificity. We further report exploratory stress tests of direct conditional generators trained without external visual weights: single-subject and ten-subject variants produce noise-dominated outputs, with early validation improvements reversing after one to four epochs. Finally, we distinguish direct reconstruction from semantic rendering with a pretrained diffusion prior. The results support above-chance coarse semantic decoding under a closed-set, repetition-averaged protocol, but do not support faithful recovery of stimulus pixels.

AI.tldr: 在 THINGS-EEG2 上建立可复现的单被试基线：用紧凑时空卷积编码器把重复平均 EEG 映射到 ViT-B/32 图像特征，验证 EEG 能在视觉嵌入空间中检索所视刺激（Top-1/5/10 分别约 12.8%/39.2%/58.0%，远高于随机水平），但不支持像素级忠实重建。
AI.motivation: EEG 头皮测量时间分辨率高但空间分辨率有限，且配对的 EEG-图像数据集规模远小于现代生成模型的训练语料，因此"从 EEG 重建视觉刺激"这一目标本身较难界定。作者认为，与其直接追求像素重建，不如先回答更可辩护的问题：EEG 能否在视觉嵌入空间中检索到所视刺激。
AI.method: 采用单被试、可复现的基线流程。用紧凑的时空卷积编码器将重复平均后的 EEG（63 通道 × 250 时间点）映射到给定的 512 维 ViT-B/32 图像特征；模型选择基于概念不相交的验证划分，最终评估使用官方 200 图像、200 概念的测试库。此外进行会话平衡消融、跨被试迁移测试，以及无外部视觉权重的直接条件生成器压力测试（单被试与十被试变体），并区分直接重建与基于预训练扩散先验的语义渲染。
AI.result: 在三个训练随机种子下，图像检索 Recall@1/5/10 分别为 12.83±0.58%、39.17±1.76%、58.00±1.73%（均值±样本标准差），而解析随机水平分别为 0.5%、2.5%、5.0%。会话平衡消融显示，平均更多测试重复通常能提升排序性能。将 Subject 01 模型无适配地应用到其余九名被试时性能急剧下降，体现明显的被试特异性。直接条件生成器产生以噪声为主的输出，早期验证改善在 1–4 个 epoch 后反转。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在闭集、重复平均协议下 EEG 具有高于随机的粗略语义解码能力，但不支持对刺激像素的忠实恢复；同时揭示了被试特异性，并将直接重建与基于预训练扩散先验的语义渲染加以区分。

title: Learning 3D biophysical cell properties from 2D images and cell-population statistics
summary: Inferring 3D cellular properties from 2D microscopy is difficult when a reference instrument reports only population statistics rather than labels for individual cells. Here we develop a population-supervised framework that maps single 2D red-cell images to latent biophysical quantities and aggregates them to mean corpuscular volume, red-cell distribution width and mean corpuscular haemoglobin. The model combines shared local inference, a biophysically structured decoder for volume and haemoglobin, learned instance weighting and device-specific calibration. We formalise conditions under which aggregate observations identify restricted instance predictors, show why population agreement does not by itself identify single-cell properties or 3D geometry, and derive the dispersion penalty induced by subset mean matching. The development dataset comprises 390 specimens and 1,105 acquisitions across six devices, with reported Pearson correlations of 0.86--0.98 against a Sysmex analyser. The framework provides a testable route from 2D images and population supervision to 3D cellular biophysics without claiming explicit 3D reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出群体监督框架，将单细胞2D红细胞图像映射到潜在生物物理量并聚合为MCV、RDW、MCH，学理上澄清群体一致性不足以辨识单细胞性质。
AI.motivation: 从2D显微图像推断3D细胞性质困难，因为参考仪器仅提供群体统计量（如MCV、RDW、MCH），缺乏逐细胞标签，无法直接进行监督学习。
AI.method: 模型包含共享局部推断、针对体积与血红蛋白的生物物理结构化解码器、可学习的实例权重以及设备特异性校准；并形式化分析聚合观测量对受限实例预测器的可辨识条件。
AI.result: 理论证明群体一致性本身不能辨识单细胞性质或3D几何，并推导子集均值匹配引入的离散度惩罚。数据集含390份标本、6台设备的1,105次采集，与Sysmex分析仪相比Pearson相关系数为0.86–0.98。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为从2D图像与群体监督走向3D细胞生物物理提供了可检验路径，但不主张显式的3D重建。

title: Context Poisoning as Extreme-Value Attention Interference in Long-Context Language Models
summary: Large language models can process increasingly long prompts, yet their ability to locate and use decisive evidence may degrade as irrelevant or confusable context is added. We formulate this phenomenon, which we call context poisoning, as extreme-value interference in attention: the decisive-evidence score is upper-bounded, while the maximum score among effective distractors grows with their number. Under a softmax retrieval abstraction, we derive a finite-sample upper bound showing that maintaining a fixed accuracy target above base rate requires the evidence margin to scale as $Ω(\sqrt{\log N})$, where N denotes the effective distractor count rather than necessarily the raw context length. The analysis connects long-context degradation to score aliasing, positional aliasing, and softmax dilution. Controlled experiments show that retrieval accuracy decreases as total context grows in the presence of embedded hard negatives, that the same-format condition produces the largest observed accuracy drop among the tested distractor constructions at fixed context length, and that retrieval gating can improve evidence use while its net benefit depends on preserving evidence recall. These results motivate evidence bottlenecks, alias-resistant representations, retrieve-then-reason architectures, verifier-mediated memory, and contrastive anti-poison training.

AI.tldr: 本文将长上下文性能退化形式化为"上下文投毒"，即注意力的极值干扰现象，并给出证据边际需按Ω(√log N)缩放的有限样本上界。
AI.motivation: 大模型可处理越来越长的提示，但随着无关或易混淆上下文增加，其定位并使用决定性证据的能力会退化。作者希望为这一现象建立理论刻画，而非仅停留在经验观察。
AI.method: 将问题建模为softmax检索抽象下的极值干扰：决定性证据得分存在上界，而有效干扰项的最大得分随其数量增长。据此推导有限样本上界，并开展受控实验，操纵上下文长度、嵌入硬负样本及干扰项构造方式（含同格式条件），同时测试检索门控的作用。
AI.result: 在存在嵌入硬负样本时，检索准确率随总上下文增长而下降；在固定上下文长度下，同格式条件的准确率下降幅度在受测干扰项构造中最大；检索门控可改善证据使用，但其净收益取决于是否保持证据召回。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文退化可归因于分数混叠、位置混叠与softmax稀释。维持高于基线的固定准确率要求证据边际随有效干扰项数量N按Ω(√log N)增长，且N未必等于原始上下文长度。研究指向证据瓶颈、抗混叠表示、先检索后推理架构、验证器中介记忆与对比式抗投毒训练。

title: Rethinking Streaming Video Diffusion Model: Context, Execution, and Training
summary: Understanding the design space of streaming video diffusion is essential to exploring its potential for generation quality and computational efficiency. We develop a unified analytical framework that relates model and sampler choices, historical conditioning, execution scheduling, and training strategies. The framework accommodates a broad family of causal context-selection policies and makes their computational dependencies and training-inference alignment explicit. Within this design space, we study three representative policies: clean, same-level, and progressive history. On the full VBench prompt set, same-level and progressive history achieve aggregate scores of 85.24 and 85.60, respectively, compared with 84.45 for the clean-history reference. Long-video comparisons further show improved subject consistency and more coherent motion with progressive history. By allowing multiple denoising nodes to be processed together, progressive-history pipelining achieves $1.57$-$2.83\times$ steady-state DiT speedups under our evaluated conditions. We additionally find that LoRA adaptation of the DMD fake-score network improves generation quality using only 2.15% as many trainable fake-score parameters as full-parameter adaptation. Together, these findings show that fully denoised history is not a prerequisite for high-quality streaming generation and motivate the joint design of historical conditioning, execution, and training.

AI.tldr: 本文建立流式视频扩散设计的统一分析框架，研究三种因果上下文选择策略，发现完全去噪的历史并非高质量流式生成的必要条件，并提出历史条件、执行与训练的联合设计方向。
AI.motivation: 流式视频扩散的设计空间尚未被系统理解，需明确模型与采样器选择、历史条件、执行调度与训练策略之间的关系，以兼顾生成质量与计算效率。
AI.method: 提出统一分析框架，关联模型/采样器、历史条件、执行调度与训练策略；框架涵盖广泛的因果上下文选择策略并显式化其计算依赖与训练-推理对齐；在其中研究三种代表性策略：clean、same-level 与 progressive history；并采用 LoRA 对 DMD fake-score 网络进行适配。
AI.result: 在完整 VBench 提示集上，same-level 与 progressive history 聚合得分分别为 85.24 与 85.60，clean-history 基准为 84.45；长视频对比中 progressive history 呈现更好的主体一致性与更连贯的运动；通过并行处理多个去噪节点，progressive-history 流水线在评测条件下实现 1.57–2.83× 的稳态 DiT 加速；LoRA 适配 DMD fake-score 网络仅用全参数适配 2.15% 的可训练参数即提升生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 完全去噪的历史并非高质量流式生成的前提，应联合设计历史条件、执行调度与训练策略以释放流式视频扩散的质量与效率潜力。

title: Goal-driven Variant Categorization
summary: Process discovery rarely yields a single coherent process structure. For analysis, a common step is to cluster process variants based on structural similarity and then assign business meaning to the resulting groups. Since these partitions are not derived from the organization's goals, analysts must manually interpret and consolidate variants into business-meaningful categories. This judgment-intensive step becomes increasingly difficult as the number and complexity of variants grow. In this paper, we propose a goal-driven approach to variant categorization that reverses this workflow. We first author an organization's goal model that predefines the categorization axis. Each variant is transformed into a textual narrative describing its behavior, and a Large Language Model (LLM) interprets it in the context of the goal model and assigns the variant to the most appropriate category. LLM-based semantic reasoning connects low-level process behavior with analyst-defined business goals. We instantiate this approach end-to-end and evaluate it on three public logs differing substantially in scale and behavioral diversity. Goal-model guidance yields partitions that differ from those produced by unguided induction and respond to controlled edits to the declared alternatives, at the cost of authoring a goal model.

AI.tldr: 提出目标驱动的流程变体分类方法：先构建组织目标模型预定义分类轴，将每个变体转为行为文本叙事，由LLM结合目标模型语义推理归入最合适类别。在三个规模与行为多样性差异显著的公开日志上端到端验证。
AI.motivation: 流程发现很少产出单一连贯的流程结构。常规做法是先按结构相似度聚类流程变体，再人工为分组赋予业务含义；但这类划分并非源自组织目标，且随变体数量与复杂度增加，人工解释与归并的难度急剧上升。
AI.method: 目标驱动、反转既定工作流的方法：1）先编写组织目标模型，预定义分类轴；2）将每个流程变体转换为描述其行为的文本叙事；3）由大语言模型在目标模型语境下解读叙事，将变体分配到最合适的类别，以语义推理连接低层流程行为与分析者定义的业务目标。方法被端到端实例化。
AI.result: 在三个规模与行为多样性差异显著的公开日志上评估：目标模型引导产生的划分与无引导归纳所得划分不同，并能响应对所声明备选项的受控编辑，代价是需要编写目标模型。
AI.conclusion: 用目标模型引导LLM进行流程变体分类，可产生贴合业务目标、且对目标模型变更敏感的划分结果；其代价是额外的人工目标建模开销。

title: DeepInstructor: An Agentic AI Instructor for Experience-Driven Idea Evaluation
summary: As automated scientific discovery advances, Large Language Models (LLMs) can now generate research ideas at an unprecedented scale, shifting the bottleneck from idea generation to idea evaluation. Existing evaluators mainly rely on parametric LLM knowledge or unstructured retrieval, producing judgments that lack the experience-grounded reasoning used by human instructors. To address this, we propose DeepInstructor, an agentic framework that formulates idea evaluation as reasoning over structured scholarly experience. DeepInstructor constructs an Experience Graph from 58,607 peer reviews and employs a ReAct-based agent to retrieve dimension-specific evidence for traceable evaluation. We further introduce DeepInstruct, a dataset with controlled pairwise comparisons across novelty, significance, and feasibility. Experiments show that DeepInstructor substantially outperforms existing baselines, improving Hit@1 and Hit@2 alignment with human judgments by 24.4% and 29.7%, respectively. Our findings suggest that scientific idea evaluation can be grounded in explicit reasoning over structured scholarly experience

AI.tldr: 提出 DeepInstructor 智能体框架，将科研想法评估重构为对结构化学术经验的推理，并构建 DeepInstruct 数据集，在与人判断的对齐度上显著超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 随着大模型可大规模生成科研想法，瓶颈已从想法生成转向想法评估。现有评估器主要依赖参数化知识或无结构检索，缺乏人类导师那种基于经验的推理，判断可信度不足。
AI.method: 提出 DeepInstructor：从 58,607 条同行评审构建 Experience Graph（经验图），并采用基于 ReAct 的智能体检索维度特定证据，实现可追溯评估。同时构建 DeepInstruct 数据集，包含新颖性、重要性、可行性三个维度上的受控成对比较。
AI.result: DeepInstructor 显著优于现有基线，与人类判断对齐的 Hit@1 和 Hit@2 分别提升 24.4% 和 29.7%。
AI.conclusion: 科研想法评估可以建立在对结构化学术经验的显式推理之上。

title: Complementary rPPG-Derived and Lip-Region Frequency Cues for Talking-Face Deepfake Detection
summary: Talking-face (TF) deepfakes are detected unevenly by rPPG-based methods across generators. We study two lightweight visual-only cues, rPPG-derived waveforms extracted by RhythmFormer and lip-region discrete cosine transform (DCT) coefficients, on the seven TF methods of Celeb-DF++ under a subject-independent protocol. In-domain, lip-region DCT matches or exceeds the rPPG-derived 1D ResNet on every method except SadTalker, and Concat fusion reaches AUC 0.891 against 0.824 and 0.827 for the unimodal baselines. Under leave-one-generator-out evaluation the cues split: each transfers clearly better to three held-out methods, and IP-LAP is near chance for both. Concat averages 0.798 but falls below rPPG alone where DCT transfers poorly, so static fusion only partly exploits this complementarity. Lip-region DCT outperforms full-face DCT on six of seven methods. We treat the rPPG-derived signal as an empirical cue and do not claim it is cardiac in origin.

AI.tldr: 该文研究基于rPPG波形与唇部DCT系数两种轻量视觉线索在Celeb-DF++七种Talking-face生成方法上的检测表现，发现两线索互补，静态融合仅能部分利用其互补性。
AI.motivation: rPPG类方法对Talking-face深度伪造的检测在不同生成器间表现不均衡，需要探究轻量视觉线索的跨生成器检测能力与互补性。
AI.method: 在受试者独立协议下，提取两类视觉线索：RhythmFormer提取的rPPG派生波形（1D ResNet处理）与唇部区域DCT系数，在Celeb-DF++七种TF方法上进行域内评估及留一生成器（LOGO）跨域评估，并测试Concat静态融合。作为对照，还比较了全脸DCT与唇部DCT。
AI.result: 域内：唇部DCT在除SadTalker外所有方法上达到或超过rPPG-1D ResNet；Concat融合AUC达0.891，优于单模态的0.824和0.827。留一生成器评估中两线索出现分化：各自对三种留出方法迁移性明显更好，而IP-LAP两者均接近随机水平。Concat平均0.798，但在DCT迁移性差的情况下低于单独rPPG。唇部DCT在七种方法中的六种上优于全脸DCT。
AI.conclusion: 两种线索具有生成器依赖的互补性，但静态融合仅能部分利用该互补性；作者将rPPG派生信号视为经验线索，不主张其源自心脏活动。

title: Replication Without Persistence in Hosted LLMs: Measurement Sensitivity in Action-Time Belief Evaluation
summary: Behavioural evaluations of hosted language models can vary because the evaluated service, the measurement instrument, or both differ across runs. We separate three validation questions: whether a prior finding recurs on fresh data under its historical configuration (replication), whether the endpoint changes when the evaluation-and-inference configuration is rebuilt under the same identifier (measurement sensitivity), and whether the finding persists across subsequently tested identifiers under one common instrument (persistence). We study these questions in Regent Chess, a sequential environment in which a hidden, mutable state is recorded exactly, allowing stated beliefs to be scored against ground truth at action time; positive endpoint values mean worse performance than a matched-uniform comparator. The previously reported Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite deficit recurs on fresh games under its historical configuration (+0.0530, 95% CI [+0.0329,+0.0714]). In a back-to-back same-day H/R comparison under the same public identifier, the model-minus-uniform endpoint is 0.0429 lower under the rebuilt configuration (95% CI for the H-minus-R contrast [+0.0182,+0.0667]); all six configuration components vary jointly, so no component is isolated. Under rebuilt R, the prospectively frozen, interleaved same-window 4K comparison reverses sign between Gemini 3.1 and Gemini 3.7, identifiers that differ in release and product tier; additional descriptive and exploratory cells show the same directional pattern. Any additional serving-period contribution remains unresolved (-0.0166, [-0.0483,+0.0157]). Replication, measurement sensitivity, and persistence can therefore yield different conclusions within one evaluation, motivating explicit indexing of hosted-model behavioural claims by tested identifier, serving period, measurement instrument, and inference configuration.

AI.tldr: 托管语言模型的行为评估结论受服务端点、测量工具及推理配置影响，论文区分"复现、测量敏感性、持续性"三类验证问题，并主张对托管模型行为声明进行显式索引。
AI.motivation: 托管语言模型的行为评估结果在不同运行间会波动，原因可能来自被评估服务、测量工具或两者兼有。现有工作往往把"能否复现"当作单一问题，未区分是历史配置下的重新复现、同一标识符下重建配置导致的测量敏感性，还是跨后续模型标识符的持续性。
AI.method: 在 Regent Chess 环境中开展研究：该顺序环境精确记录隐藏的可变状态，可在动作时刻将模型陈述的信念与真值对照打分；端点正值表示性能差于匹配的均匀基线。设计三类验证：历史配置下新数据复现（replication）、同一公开标识符下重建评估与推理配置的 H/R 同日对照（measurement sensitivity，六个配置组件联合变动、无法分离单一组件）、以及在一次共同工具下对后续测试标识符的前瞻冻结、交错同窗口 4K 比较（persistence）。
AI.result: 先前报告的 Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 劣势在新对局的历史配置下复现（+0.0530，95% CI [+0.0329,+0.0714]）。同日背靠背 H/R 对照中，重建配置下的模型减均匀端点低 0.0429（H 减 R 对比的 95% CI [+0.0182,+0.0667]）。在重建 R 下，前瞻冻结的交错同窗口 4K 比较在 Gemini 3.1 与 3.7（发布版本与产品层级不同）之间出现方向反转，附加描述性与探索性单元呈相同方向模式。额外服务期贡献仍未定（-0.0166，[-0.0483,+0.0157]）。
AI.conclusion: 复现、测量敏感性与持续性可在同一次评估中给出不同结论，因此托管模型的行为性声明应显式按被测标识符、服务期、测量工具与推理配置进行索引。

title: Evaluating Fine-Tuned and Base Language Models in Maternal and Vaccination Healthcare for African Settings
summary: Background: Large language models (LLMs) can improve healthcare information delivery in low-resource settings but may produce inaccurate or culturally inappropriate advice. This study evaluated domain-specific fine-tuning for maternal health and vaccination in Nigeria. Objective: To compare HelpMum's MamaBot-Llama and Vax-Llama with Meta's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct for accuracy, safety, clarity, contextual appropriateness, and trustworthiness. Methods: We evaluated 200 healthcare questions, 100 each for maternal health and vaccination, across five subdomains per domain. MamaBot-Llama and Vax-Llama were fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation on over 36,000 maternal health and 9,000 vaccination question-answer pairs, respectively. Two Nigerian licensed physicians independently rated responses using a 5-point Likert scale. Paired comparisons used Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. Results: Performance varied by domain. MamaBot-Llama significantly outperformed the base model across all criteria, with a 4.9% overall improvement (p < .001), including gains in clinical trustworthiness (+7%) and medical accuracy (+5%). Critical issues decreased by 50%, and clinicians preferred it in 78% of cases. In contrast, Vax-Llama showed a 5.2% overall decline (p < .001), with critical issues increasing by 192% and safety concerns by 400%. Conclusions: Domain-specific fine-tuning can improve healthcare LLM performance when based on high-quality, clinician-curated data, but may also degrade performance when dataset quality is inadequate. Rigorous domain-specific validation is essential before clinical deployment. Physician evaluators provided informed consent, and chatbot logs were anonymized. Keywords: Large language models; Fine-tuning; Maternal health; Vaccination; Healthcare AI; Low-resource settings; Nigeria; Model evaluation; LoRA; Medical accuracy

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了尼日利亚母婴健康与疫苗接种领域的领域特定微调LLM（MamaBot-Llama、Vax-Llama）相较Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的表现：母婴健康模型显著提升，而疫苗接种模型显著退化，表明微调效果高度依赖数据质量。
AI.motivation: LLM可改善低资源环境下的医疗信息传递，但可能产生不准确或不符合文化背景的建议，因此需要验证领域特定微调在真实临床场景中的安全性与有效性。
AI.method: 采用LoRA分别对36,000+母婴健康与9,000疫苗接种问答对进行微调；由两名尼日利亚执业医师用5点Likert量表独立评分200道问题（每领域100题，各含5个子领域），并以Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行配对比较。
AI.result: 母婴健康模型MamaBot-Llama在所有指标上显著优于基座模型，整体提升4.9%（p<.001），临床可信度+7%、医学准确性+5%，严重问题减少50%，78%的病例中医师更偏好该模型；疫苗接种模型Vax-Llama整体下降5.2%（p<.001），严重问题增加192%，安全隐患增加400%。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定微调在高质量、临床专家策展数据基础上可提升医疗LLM表现，但数据质量不足时会损害性能，临床部署前必须进行严格的领域特定验证。

title: Beyond the Survey: A Systematic Empirical Study of Detection and Association in Visual MOT
comment: Accepted for publication in Artificial Intelligence Review
summary: This paper presents a comprehensive experimental evaluation and detailed analysis of state-of-the-art multi-object tracking algorithms, with an emphasis on quantifying the individual contributions of detection and association components to overall tracking performance. Unlike existing surveys that primarily offer theoretical categorizations or taxonomies of tracking methods, our work adopts a rigorous experimental perspective grounded in publicly available implementations, providing practical guidance for researchers and practitioners in method selection and system design. We introduce a unified pipeline diagram that consolidates the core components across the two main branches of visual multi-object tracking: tracking-by-detection and end-to-end deep learning paradigms, and systematically analyze the object detection, feature extraction, and data association modules. Through extensive empirical studies on standard benchmarks, including MOT16, MOT17, MOT20, SportsMOT, DanceTrack, and CrowdTrack datasets, we reveal critical insights: (1) detection quality dominates association strategy performance, with detector improvements yielding more than 10% gains compared to less than 5% from refined association strategies; (2) modern deep learning detectors paired with specialized re-identification models significantly outperform joint detection and embedding approaches; and (3) transformer-based end-to-end methods exhibit greater robustness to detection quality variations but at a substantial computational cost. Our findings from extensive experiments provide key insights into component-level effects in MOT, particularly the dominant influence of detection quality relative to association, while offering practical insights for designing and optimizing MOT systems under varying performance and robustness requirements. Code and experimental setups are available at github.com/linh-gist/VisualMOT.

AI.tldr: 本文通过统一实验框架系统评估多目标跟踪算法，量化检测与关联模块对整体性能的贡献，发现检测质量是性能主导因素。
AI.motivation: 现有综述多停留在理论分类与体系归纳，缺乏基于公开实现的可复现实验对比，难以为研究者与实践者在方法选择与系统设计上提供实证指导。
AI.method: 提出统一的流水线示意图，整合tracking-by-detection与端到端深度学习两大分支的核心组件，系统分析目标检测、特征提取与数据关联模块，并在MOT16、MOT17、MOT20、SportsMOT、DanceTrack、CrowdTrack等标准基准上开展广泛实验。
AI.result: 检测质量主导关联策略的性能表现，检测器改进带来超过10%的提升，而精化关联策略不足5%；现代深度学习检测器配合专用重识别模型显著优于联合检测与嵌入方法；基于Transformer的端到端方法对检测质量变化更具鲁棒性，但计算开销显著。
AI.conclusion: 实验揭示了MOT中组件级效应的关键结论，尤其强调检测质量相对于关联的主导影响，并为在不同性能与鲁棒性需求下设计与优化MOT系统提供实践指导；代码与实验设置已开源。

title: The Wisdom of Artificial Deliberative Crowds
summary: The aggregation of many lay estimates often outperforms individual expert judgment, a phenomenon known as the wisdom of crowds. While this is usually attributed to the independence of estimates, an even stronger effect arises through deliberation: averaging the consensus estimates of small deliberating groups outperforms the classical wisdom of crowds, with individual judgments themselves also becoming more accurate after deliberation. Whether these improvements transfer to large language models deliberating amongst themselves is unknown. Here we adapt a three-stage deliberation paradigm previously used with human participants for use with large language models from three different families, and test it across four domains of increasing real-world stakes: visual numerical estimation (Study 1), peer review of machine-learning papers (Study 2), detection of hidden malicious behavior by an artificial intelligence agent (Study 3), and sports forecasting against a real prediction market (Study 4). Across domains, deliberation reduced collective error beyond passive aggregation of independent responses, and post-deliberation individual judgments retained this collective gain. Notably, the advantage required model diversity: groups composed of clones of a single model did not benefit from deliberating. These results establish machine deliberation as a general-purpose aggregation mechanism, and point to diversity as an active ingredient.

AI.tldr: 该研究将人类的三阶段审议范式迁移至大语言模型，在四个不同领域验证模型间审议能超越独立估计的群体智慧，且该增益依赖模型多样性。
AI.motivation: 群体智慧通常归因于估计的独立性，但人类研究表明审议（deliberation）能带来更强增益：小型审议组的共识估计平均后优于经典群体智慧，个体判断在审议后也更准确。这一效应能否迁移到大语言模型之间的相互审议尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用三阶段审议范式（原用于人类被试），选取来自三个不同模型家族的大语言模型作为被试，在四个现实风险递增的领域测试：视觉数值估计（研究1）、机器学习论文同行评审（研究2）、AI智能体隐藏恶意行为检测（研究3）、对抗真实预测市场的体育预测（研究4）。同时设置单一模型克隆组作为对照，考察多样性作用。
AI.result: 在所有领域，审议相比独立反应的被动聚合都降低了集体误差；审议后的个体判断仍保留了这一集体增益（即个体判断本身也更准确）。关键的是，该优势需要模型多样性：由单一模型克隆组成的组在审议中未获益。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习模型间的审议是一种通用聚合机制，可跨领域稳健地超越传统群体智慧；多样性是产生该增益的积极要素。研究为将模型审议作为通用聚合手段提供了实证支持。

title: Beyond the Text: Verifying That Agent-Written Papers Are Backed by Their Artifacts
summary: Large language model agents are increasingly capable of conducting research autonomously, producing research documents alongside the code and experiments that ostensibly support them. Yet whether the reported findings are consistently supported by corresponding implementations and execution evidence remains largely unexplored: existing review practices primarily assess textual quality and cannot reliably identify inconsistencies such as hard-coded metrics, unimplemented methods, or unsupported experimental results. We present ReAgent, an automated auditing framework for assessing the consistency between agent-generated research documents and their associated repositories. ReAgent constructs structured representations of scientific claims from research documents and uses them to guide repository analysis and evidence collection. Static auditing examines whether claimed methodologies, implementations, and experimental configurations are consistently reflected in the repository, while dynamic auditing executes relevant experiments and collects execution evidence to assess empirical findings. By combining static analysis with dynamic evidence, ReAgent identifies inconsistencies that may remain hidden under either perspective alone, such as experiments that reproduce reported numbers while deviating from the claimed methodology. The collected evidence and audit decisions are organized into a structured repository-level audit report, enabling transparent evidence traceability. We evaluate ReAgent on a manually curated benchmark of agent-generated research document--repository pairs and compare it against representative static and reproduction-based baselines. Experimental results demonstrate that ReAgent effectively identifies inconsistencies between reported research findings and their supporting repository evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReAgent，一个用于审计大模型智能体生成的研究文档与其关联代码仓库之间一致性的自动化框架，通过结合静态分析与动态执行证据来识别硬编码指标、未实现方法、无支撑实验结果等不一致问题，并在人工构建的基准上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 大模型智能体已能自主开展研究并产出研究文档及配套代码与实验，但报告结论是否被实现和运行证据真正支撑尚不清楚。现有评审实践主要评估文本质量，无法可靠识别硬编码指标、未实现方法、无支撑实验结果等不一致性，因此需要一种能够对文档主张与仓库证据进行一致性审计的自动化方法。
AI.method: ReAgent 首先从研究文档中构建科学主张的结构化表示，并以此指导仓库分析与证据收集。静态审计检查所声称的方法、实现与实验配置是否在仓库中一致体现；动态审计则执行相关实验并收集执行证据以评估实证结论。框架将静态分析与动态证据相结合，从而发现单一视角下难以察觉的不一致（例如复现了报告数值但偏离所声称方法论的实验），并将证据与审计判定组织为结构化的仓库级审计报告，实现证据可追溯。
AI.result: 在人工构建的智能体生成研究文档—仓库配对基准上进行评估，并与代表性的静态基线和基于复现的基线进行比较，实验结果表明 ReAgent 能有效识别所报告研究发现与其支撑仓库证据之间的不一致。
AI.conclusion: 结合静态分析与动态执行证据的审计方式，可显著提升对智能体生成研究成果一致性的检测能力，并借助结构化的仓库级审计报告实现透明的证据溯源，为自主研究产出的可信评估提供了可行路径。

title: Validating, Not Sampling: Region-Level Robustness of Vision-Language and Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications. There, a small perturbation to the recorded camera image may change a decision significantly. However, existing benchmarks for these models only sample perturbations, which does not guarantee the absence of a failure in the untested region. We present the first robustness validation of six VLMs (drawn from the Gemma, InternVL, LLaVA, and Qwen families) and five VLAs (drawn from the GR00T, OpenVLA, and $π$ families) over entire continuous regions of photometric and geometric image perturbation: brightness shifts, camera rotations, and their composition. To this end, we build on the validation framework H$^2$V and introduce H$^2$V-M, a margin-aware convergence rule that makes validation affordable at the 32B parameter scale. We demonstrate that H$^2$V-M outperforms H$^2$V by an order of magnitude in model queries and that it finds counterexamples faster than random sampling while providing soundness guarantees. Our VLM and VLA robustness validation shows that robustness is mostly dependent on the perturbation type, rather than the model, and that VLMs are more robust to large camera rotations than VLAs. For VLAs, even perturbations as small as $\pm1^\circ$ can change the commanded action in many cases. We also show that robustness depends more on model family than on model size.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 H²V-M（一种 margin-aware 收敛规则），首次对 6 个 VLM 和 5 个 VLA 在整个连续的光度与几何图像扰动区域内做鲁棒性验证，证明其在查询效率和反例发现速度上均优于 H²V 与随机采样，并给出鲁棒性主要取决于扰动类型、VLM 相机旋转鲁棒性优于 VLA 等结论。
AI.motivation: VLM/VLA 已广泛部署于真实场景，但相机图像的微小扰动可能显著改变模型决策；现有基准仅对扰动进行采样，无法保证未测试区域中不存在失效情况（无可靠性保证），因此需要覆盖整个连续扰动区域的鲁棒性验证方法。
AI.method: 基于验证框架 H²V，提出 H²V-M——一种 margin-aware 收敛规则，使验证在 32B 参数量级下仍可行；在亮度偏移、相机旋转及其组合构成的连续光度与几何扰动区域上，对 6 个 VLM（Gemma、InternVL、LLaVA、Qwen 系列）与 5 个 VLA（GR00T、OpenVLA、π 系列）进行鲁棒性验证。
AI.result: H²V-M 在模型查询次数上比 H²V 高一个数量级（提升约 10 倍），且比随机采样更快找到反例，同时提供可靠性（soundness）保证；鲁棒性更多取决于扰动类型而非模型本身；VLM 对大角度相机旋转的鲁棒性强于 VLA；对 VLA 而言，小至 ±1° 的扰动在许多情况下即可改变所执行的动作；鲁棒性对模型家族的依赖强于对模型规模的依赖。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次实现了对 VLM 与 VLA 在整个连续扰动区域上的可负担鲁棒性验证，其 margin-aware 收敛规则在效率与保证上优于现有采样式基准，揭示了扰动类型、模型家族与模型类型（VLM/VLA）在鲁棒性中的主导作用，而非模型规模。

title: Agreement Overstates Evidence: Error Dependence in LLM Judge Consensus
summary: Consensus among LLM judges is often taken as strong evidence that a decision is correct. This assumes that judges make their errors independently. In practice, LLM judges are often trained and evaluated in similar ways, so they can make the same mistakes. We study how this dependency affects the reliability of consensus. We find substantial error correlation across both open-weight and frontier LLM judges. In our main bank of ten judges, the average pairwise correlation between judge errors is 0.21. As a result, the ten judges only provide roughly as much statistical information as 3.5 independent judges. The dependency is even stronger among the high-accuracy frontier judges we evaluate, including judges from different providers. In up to 28% of our comparisons, ignoring shared errors leads to the conclusion that one system is significantly better, while accounting for them does not. We also find that the pattern of errors matters. Errors shared by most judges and errors concentrated among a smaller group affect consensus differently and favor different voting methods. Measuring the overall amount of correlation alone is therefore insufficient. Our results suggest a simple approach: use a small set of trusted examples to estimate judge accuracy and identify shared mistakes. These shared errors should then be considered when analyzing the results, and the voting method should be chosen using trusted examples before it is applied to new data.

AI.tldr: LLM评审者之间的错误存在显著相关性，十个评审者的统计信息量仅相当于约3.5个独立评审者，忽略共享错误会导致错误的显著性结论。
AI.motivation: 共识常被视为决策正确的强证据，这一假设前提是评审者独立犯错。然而LLM评审者往往以相似方式训练和评估，可能犯相同错误，因此有必要研究这种依赖性如何影响共识可靠性。
AI.method: 作者测量了开放权重与前沿LLM评审者之间的错误相关性，以一个包含十名评审者的主评审组为对象，计算平均成对错误相关系数，并将其折算为等效独立评审者数量；通过有无考虑共享错误的对比，分析对系统显著性判断的影响；进一步区分普遍共享错误与小群体集中错误的模式，考察其对共识和投票方法的不同作用。
AI.result: 十名评审者的平均成对错误相关系数为0.21，统计信息量仅约等于3.5个独立评审者；在高准确率前沿评审者（含不同提供方）中依赖性更强；忽略共享错误时，最多28%的对比会得出某系统显著更优的结论，而考虑共享错误后该结论不成立；错误模式也影响共识，普遍共享错误与小群体集中错误偏好不同的投票方法。
AI.conclusion: 仅测量总体相关程度并不充分，需同时考虑错误模式。建议使用一小组可信示例估计评审者准确率并识别共享错误，在分析结果时纳入这些共享错误，并在应用于新数据前用可信示例选择投票方法。

title: Privacy Personalization Trade offs in LLMs: The Impact of Stylometric Signal Reduction on User-Specific Text Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated the ability to generate user-specific text with high stylistic fidelity. However, the personal data that enables such personalization frequently embeds demographic, cultural, and stylistic markers that raises concerns about stylometric re- identification. This paper investigates whether reducing identifiable stylistic signals affects personalization in text generation by LLMs. We introduce a controlled framework to isolate stylometric signals in LLM personalization using the LaMP-7 Twitter benchmark. Experiments on 250 sampled users compare two settings: paraphrasing conditioned on the original profile and paraphrasing conditioned on an anonymized converted profile in which demographic identifiers, cultural references, personal details, and informal linguistic cues have been systematically neutralized. Outputs are assessed by two independent LLM judges and a complementary human evaluation. Our pairwise evaluation shows that outputs conditioned on original profiles are nearly indistinguishable from human-authored ground truth, indicating that modern LLMs can closely reproduce an author's writing style with sufficient fidelity. In contrast, preference for model outputs with anonymized profiles drops to 13.0% on average, while semantic context preservation remains high at 94.8%. A study with human evaluators confirms the same pattern. These findings reveal a clear privacy-personalization trade-off and highlight the need for privacy-aware personalization methods that retain meaning while suppressing identifying stylistic signals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究降低可识别文体信号对LLM个性化文本生成的影响，通过LaMP-7 Twitter基准构建受控框架，对比原始画像与匿名化画像条件下的改写效果。结果显示原始画像输出与人类真迹几乎不可区分，而匿名化画像下模型输出偏好降至13.0%，但语义保持率仍达94.8%，揭示了隐私—个性化的权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM已能以高度风格保真度生成用户特定文本，但实现个性化所需的个人数据常嵌入人口统计、文化及文体标记，引发文体计量学重识别（stylometric re-identification）的隐私担忧。论文旨在探究减少可识别文体信号是否会损害LLM文本生成的个性化效果。
AI.method: 提出一个受控框架，基于LaMP-7 Twitter基准隔离LLM个性化中的文体计量信号。抽取250名用户，比较两种设定：以原始画像为条件的改写，以及以匿名化转换画像为条件的改写——后者系统性中性化了人口统计标识、文化引用、个人细节及非正式语言线索。输出由两个独立LLM评判器及一项补充性人工评估进行评价。
AI.result: 成对评估表明，以原始画像为条件的输出与人类撰写的真值几乎不可区分，说明现代LLM能以足够保真度复现作者写作风格。相比之下，匿名化画像下模型输出的偏好平均降至13.0%，而语义上下文保持率仍高居94.8%。人工评估研究证实了相同的模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果揭示了明确的隐私—个性化权衡，并强调需要开发隐私感知的个性化方法，在保留语义的同时抑制可识别的文体信号。

title: On The Robustness-Resolution Tradeoff In Temporal Quantization Of Event Streams
summary: Event pipelines often discretize asynchronous timestamps before learning. This step looks harmless, but its stability depends directly on temporal resolution. We study this dependence at the representation level. We first show that hard temporal binning is discontinuous: an arbitrarily small timestamp shift near a boundary can move unit event mass between bins. We then define a class of nonnegative, mass-preserving, resolution-faithful continuous encoders and prove that every encoder in this class has global L1 sensitivity at least 2/Delta, where Delta denotes bin width. Linear two-bin interpolation attains this limit. Local support and first-moment preservation also make it unique. Experiments on SHD, N-MNIST, and DVS128 Gesture support the analysis. Across uniform timestamp budgets, linear interpolation lowers mean representation drift by 47-72% while keeping clean accuracy nearly unchanged. On DVS Gesture, it produces zero prediction flips across all tested budgets and three seeds. On SHD, measured drift follows 1/Delta with R^2 = 0.992.

AI.tldr: 本文从表示层面研究事件流水线中硬时间分箱对时间分辨率的依赖，证明其不连续性，并提出并刻画了一类连续编码器，其中线性双箱插值达到L1灵敏度的理论下界，实验验证其能显著降低表示漂移且几乎不影响精度。
AI.motivation: 事件流水线通常在异步时间戳学习前进行离散化，这一步骤看似无害，但其稳定性直接依赖于时间分辨率。作者希望从表示层面研究这种依赖性，揭示硬时间分箱的稳定性缺陷并寻找更稳定的连续编码方式。
AI.method: 首先证明硬时间分箱是不连续的：边界附近任意小的时间戳偏移都会使单位事件质量在不同箱之间移动。随后定义一类非负、质量保持、分辨率忠实的连续编码器，并证明该类中每个编码器的全局L1灵敏度至少为2/Delta（Delta为箱宽）。进一步表明线性双箱插值可达到该下界，且局部支撑与一阶矩保持使其具有唯一性。最后在SHD、N-MNIST和DVS128 Gesture数据集上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验支持理论分析。在统一时间戳预算下，线性插值将平均表示漂移降低47-72%，同时干净准确率几乎不变。在DVS Gesture上，所有测试预算和三个随机种子下均产生零预测翻转。在SHD上，实测漂移遵循1/Delta规律，R^2=0.992。
AI.conclusion: 硬时间分箱对时间分辨率高度敏感且不稳定，而线性双箱插值作为满足特定性质的连续编码器，在理论上达到L1灵敏度下界并具有唯一性，在实践中能显著提升表示稳定性且几乎不损失精度，是事件流水线中更可靠的离散化替代方案。

title: IntLawNER: A Named Entity Recognition Dataset and Benchmark in International Law
summary: International law provides the normative framework through which states coordinate action, regulate armed conflict, and protect human rights, yet its texts remain without token-level named entity recognition (NER) resources. We introduce IntLawNER, a NER dataset and benchmark for codified sources of international law, covering 2,987 gold-annotated sentences and 8,094 entity spans from International Court of Justice (ICJ) decisions, UN Security Council resolutions, and European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) judgments, annotated with seven institution-specific entity types. We construct IntLawNER with a cost-effective hybrid algorithmic-agentic pipeline that reduces 468k source sentences to a compact annotation set through candidate retrieval, LLM-based vetting, and human review, with 89.6% of gold spans accepted unchanged from the silver layer. However, the silver-to-gold analysis reveals that human-machine aggregate agreement metrics can be misleading in domain-specific NER: Cohen's kappa=0.964 on boundary-matched spans masks a macro-F1 of 0.753 when missing entities, boundary errors, and label corrections are included. The benchmark shows that zero-shot span-based GLiNER collapses on entity types dependent on institutional function rather than surface form (0.243 micro-F1), while fine-tuned transformers struggle on rare labels. Carefully selected few-shot examples that demonstrate label contrasts improve every LLM over zero-shot prompting, with Claude Opus 4.6 reaching the best score of 0.873 micro-F1. We release IntLawNER as a benchmark and reusable resource for extracting references in international legal texts.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出IntLawNER，首个面向成文法源的国际法命名实体识别（NER）数据集与基准，含2,987句金标注、8,094个实体跨度，覆盖ICJ判决、联合国安理会决议与ECtHR判决，并揭示人机聚合一致性指标在领域NER中的误导性。
AI.motivation: 国际法通过规范框架协调国家行动、规制武装冲突与保护人权，但其文本缺乏词元级命名实体识别资源。既有NER资源多集中于通用领域或特定语料，缺少面向国际法成文法源的标注数据与系统评测，故需构建专门的数据集与基准。
AI.method: 采用经济高效的混合算法-智能体流水线：通过候选检索、基于LLM的筛选与人工复核，将468k源句压缩为紧凑标注集；标注七类机构特定实体类型。金标注层统计显示89.6%的金跨度从银层未修改接受。随后进行银-金差异分析与多模型基准评测，包括零样本GLiNER、微调Transformer及少样本提示的各类LLM。
AI.result: 银-金分析表明，边界匹配跨度上的Cohen's kappa=0.964会掩盖包含遗漏实体、边界错误与标签更正后的macro-F1=0.753，说明人机聚合一致性指标可能误导。基准结果显示：零样本span-based GLiNER在依赖机构职能而非表面形式的实体类型上崩溃（micro-F1=0.243）；微调Transformer在稀有标签上表现不佳；精心选择的少样本示例展示标签对比后，各LLM均优于零样本，其中Claude Opus 4.6达到最佳micro-F1=0.873。
AI.conclusion: IntLawNER作为可复用资源与基准发布，用于国际法文本中的引用抽取，并提示领域特定NER需谨慎对待人机一致性评估与少样本示例设计。

title: An Empirical Cost Attribution of Context-Compression Gateways in Multi-Turn Coding Agents
summary: Context compression is widely proposed as a way to cut the token bill of LLM coding agents, and public benchmarks report that aggressive compression preserves task-solving quality. These two facts do not imply the third one commonly assumed: that compressing file reads saves money in a real multi-turn agent. We instrument a production compression gateway (Paritok) between coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) and frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet, GPT-5), and decompose the token bill of real sessions into three independent levers: tool-schema filtering, content compression of file reads and tool output, and history summarization. Measured in isolation under controlled A/B runs, the three save at fundamentally different rates. Tool-schema filtering removes a fixed block every turn, roughly 21K-57K tokens on a typical turn; it is linear in the turn count N and the only unambiguously and reproducibly positive lever. Content compression saves only about 2% of the cache-priced prefix per turn, but compressed reads accumulate in history and are re-sent on every later turn, so its cumulative saving grows quadratically, about 3350*N^2 tokens (measured), overtaking the fixed tool-filter saving within roughly 6 turns until the context window caps it. A non-destructive gateway lets the agent pull original bytes back on demand; each recall re-sends exactly the one segment just compressed away, so its cost is fixed and bounded rather than a multiplicative blowup, and heavy recall spends the accumulated saving back one segment at a time. Finally, a strong single-shot compression benchmark - 86.5% of SWE-bench quality retained at a 25.7% compression rate, achieved by the model this gateway deploys (Paritok-4B, reported separately) - is orthogonal to multi-turn agent cost and must not be cited as a cost-saving argument. We distill the results into an actionable recipe for where token-saving effort pays off.

AI.tldr: 在真实多轮编码代理中测量三种token节流手段后，只有工具schema过滤是稳定正向收益；内容压缩的节省随轮数二次累积，约在6轮后超过前者，而单轮压缩benchmark的高分与多轮代理成本无关。
AI.motivation: 上下文压缩常被当作降低LLM编码代理token开销的手段，公开benchmark也报告激进压缩能保持任务质量；但作者指出这两点并不能推出业界默认的第三个结论——即在真实多轮代理中压缩文件读取确实省钱。因此需要在一个生产级压缩网关中，对真实会话的token账单做可分解的实证测量，厘清各手段的实际收益来源与量级。
AI.method: 作者在编码代理（Claude Code、Codex）与前沿模型（Claude Sonnet、GPT-5）之间部署了生产级压缩网关Paritok，把真实会话的token账单分解为三个相互独立的杠杆：工具schema过滤、文件读取与工具输出的内容压缩、历史摘要。三者在受控A/B条件下分别被隔离测量，并在同一网关中评估非破坏性召回（按需取回原始字节）对成本的影响。
AI.result: 工具schema过滤每轮移除固定的token块，典型一轮约21K–57K tokens，与轮数N线性相关，是唯一无歧义且可复现的正向杠杆。内容压缩每轮仅节省约2%的缓存计价前缀，但压缩后的读取会累积进历史并在后续每一轮重发，故其累计节省呈二次增长，实测约3350·N² tokens，约在6轮内超过固定的工具过滤节省，直至被上下文窗口封顶。非破坏性网关允许代理按需召回原始字节，每次召回只重发刚被压缩掉的那一个片段，成本固定且有界，而非乘性膨胀；高频召回会逐段花掉已经积累的节省。单轮强压缩benchmark（该网关部署的Paritok-4B在SWE-bench上以25.7%压缩率保留86.5%质量）与多轮代理成本正交，不能作为省钱的论据。
AI.conclusion: 多轮编码代理的token节省应分层看待：工具schema过滤提供线性且稳定的基础收益，内容压缩的价值来自跨轮累积的二次增长而非单轮压缩率，召回机制则把节省转化为可逐段支取的预算。单轮压缩benchmark成绩不能外推到多轮成本，作者据此给出可操作的省钱优先级方案。

title: Authority-Preserving Evaluation of Medical Vision-Language Assistants
comment: Accepted at 2nd Emerging LLM/LMM Applications in Medical Imaging (ELAMI) 2026, held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026. To appear in the Springer proceedings
summary: Medical vision-language models can propose how urgently a skin lesion should be reviewed, but the local service retains authority to accept or replace that proposal under referral policy, capacity, and locally held patient context. Proposal quality and selected-action quality are therefore distinct evaluation targets, and benchmark evidence transfers between them only when local review preserves the expected action score. We introduce AuthEval, a logging and evaluation framework that records both actions, scores the selected action under declared local criteria, and, where feasible, scores the declined proposal under the same rule. It reports the resulting authority gap only when the record supports it. Because the gap is the product of the proposal-change rate and the mean score change on changed cases, that rate alone determines neither its magnitude nor its sign. On ISIC 2019, with MedGemma and simulated local review, two constraint regimes with similar change rates produced an optimistic image-equal gap under capacity ($+0.744$ simulator units) but no detectable gap under safety. The declared evaluation unit also mattered: under mixed constraints the gap reversed from $+0.374$ to $-0.206$ when weighting shifted from image to lesion-aware cluster. AuthEval thus clarifies whether a study's records support claims about the model, the workflow, or both.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AuthEval，一个记录并评估"模型提议动作"与"本地最终执行动作"的日志与评估框架，用以量化二者之间的"权威差距"（authority gap），并明确基准证据在何种条件下可迁移。
AI.motivation: 医学视觉语言模型可提议皮肤病变的紧急程度，但本地服务依据转诊政策、资源容量和本地患者背景保留接受或替换该提议的权威。因此"提议质量"与"被选动作质量"是两个不同的评估目标，基准证据仅在本地复核保留预期动作得分时才能迁移；现有评估未区分二者，也未刻画本地权威对结论的影响。
AI.method: 提出AuthEval框架：同时记录提议动作与最终执行动作，在声明的本地准则下对所选动作评分，并在可行时以同一准则对未被采纳的提议评分；仅在记录支持时才报告权威差距。框架指出该差距等于"提议变更率"与"变更案例上平均分值变化"的乘积，故变更率本身不能决定差距的大小或符号；并考察评估单元（图像级 vs 病灶感知聚类）与约束机制（容量、安全、混合）的影响。实验在ISIC 2019上使用MedGemma并采用模拟本地复核。
