AI.result: 两种约束机制变更率相近，但在容量约束下产生偏乐观的图像级差距（+0.744模拟器单位），在安全约束下未检出可检测差距；在混合约束下，当权重从图像级转为病灶感知聚类级时，差距由+0.374反转为-0.206。
AI.conclusion: 权威差距不能由变更率单独推断，其量级与符号取决于本地评审准则、约束机制及声明的评估单元。AuthEval可澄清一项研究的记录究竟支持关于模型的结论、关于工作流的结论，还是二者兼有。

title: EvidenT: Building Trustworthy Enterprise Assistants through Evidence Groundedness and Traceability
summary: Enterprise AI assistants must produce responses that are verifiable and traceable to source evidence. However, retrieval augmented generation (RAG) over heterogeneous enterprise data can suffer from citation drift, unsupported content, and weak source traceability. We present EvidenT (T = Trust + Transparency + Traceability), a lightweight pipeline that verifies extracted evidence against retrieved documents before answer generation, without model retraining. EvidenT combines structured passage extraction with deterministic lexical alignment to filter unsupported content, correct citation drift, and preserve source-span traceability. On approximately 500 real enterprise queries, EvidenT improves gold-source hit rate by an average of 29% over prompting baselines, produces no citations to nonretrieved urls, and achieves near-saturated answer-to-source lexical coverage.

AI.tldr: EvidenT：一种轻量级证据验证流水线，通过在生成前对检索文档与抽取证据进行确定性词法对齐，解决企业级RAG中的引用漂移、无支撑内容与溯源薄弱问题，无需重训练即可提升金标来源命中率约29%。
AI.motivation: 企业AI助手要求回答可验证、可溯源至源证据，但面向异构企业数据的RAG存在引用漂移、内容缺乏证据支撑、来源可追溯性弱等问题。现有提示基线难以保证引用与检索文档一致，亟需在生成前对证据可靠性进行约束。
AI.method: 提出EvidenT（T=Trust+Transparency+Traceability）轻量级流水线：在答案生成之前，将抽取的证据与检索到的文档进行验证，且无需模型重训练。方法结合结构化段落抽取与确定性词法对齐，用以过滤无支撑内容、纠正引用漂移，并保留源文本片段的溯源信息。
AI.result: 在约500条真实企业查询上，EvidenT相较提示基线将金标来源命中率平均提升29%；未产生任何指向未检索URL的引用，并实现接近饱和的答案-来源词法覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: 生成前的证据验证与词法对齐可有效提升企业RAG的可验证性与可追溯性，在不重训练模型的前提下显著改善来源命中与引用准确性，为企业级可信问答提供轻量、可落地的方案。

title: Evaluation Awareness Shifts from Format to Context with Model Scale
summary: Evaluation awareness poses an unprecedented threat to model evaluation, but the mechanisms by which models detect it remain unknown. This study focuses on determining this and identifying contrasting mechanisms between smaller and larger models. While smaller models use the prompt's format sensitivity to detect evaluation, larger models often rely on higher-order reasoning to detect it. We evaluated Gemma 3 (1B, 4B, and 12B), Phi-3 (Mini and Medium), and Llama-3 8B using Chain-of-Thought analysis, representation probing, and Integrated Gradients attribution. Motivated by these findings, we propose a dual-pathway intervention that combines prompt sanitization with activation counter-steering to suppress both external evaluation triggers and their internal representations. Across 200 highly evaluation-aware prompts, our method achieves an average behavioral flip rate of 70.58\%, consistently outperforming either intervention alone. These results provide new insights into how evaluation awareness develops in compact language models and suggest that effective mitigation requires jointly addressing both prompt-level and representation-level signals.Datasets and codebase can be found in this \href{https://github.com/chahal-navi/Evaluation-Awareness-Compact-LLMs/tree/main}{Github Repository.}

AI.tldr: 本文研究紧凑型语言模型如何检测评估意图，揭示小模型依赖提示格式敏感性、大模型依赖高阶推理的机制差异，并提出双重路径干预方法实现70.58%的行为翻转率。
AI.motivation: 评估意识（evaluation awareness）对模型评估构成前所未有的威胁，但模型检测评估的机制尚不明确。且小型与大型模型之间是否存在不同的检测机制有待探究。
AI.method: 在Gemma 3（1B、4B、12B）、Phi-3（Mini、Medium）和Llama-3 8B上，采用思维链分析（Chain-of-Thought analysis）、表征探针（representation probing）和积分梯度归因（Integrated Gradients attribution）三种方法。基于发现提出双重路径干预，结合提示净化（prompt sanitization）与激活反向引导（activation counter-steering）。
AI.result: 小模型依据提示格式敏感性检测评估，大模型依赖高阶推理检测评估。在200个高评估意识提示上，平均行为翻转率达70.58%，持续优于单一干预。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了紧凑型语言模型中评估意识的发展机制，表明有效缓解需同时处理提示层面与表征层面的信号。数据集与代码已在GitHub开源。

title: GameReplica: A Benchmark for Black-Box Visual Game Replication by Vision-Language Agents
summary: Coding-agent benchmarks usually evaluate implementation after the target behavior has been specified in text, code, or demonstrations. Existing research has extensively evaluated the ability of coding agents to generate programs from textual specifications. However, under black-box conditions where neither source code nor documentation is available, it remains underexplored whether an agent can induce the rules solely through visual observation and active interaction and reproduce the target system as a verifiable executable system. To this end, we present GameReplica, a closed-loop evaluation framework for end-to-end black-box game replication that covers the full perception, exploration, induction, reproduction, and verification pipeline. GameReplica comprises 125 tasks spanning 25 games across 5 core mechanism families, with each game instantiated at five difficulty levels. The tasks require an agent to access the target game only through screenshots and an action interface, induce the key visual elements and gameplay rules from pixel feedback and interaction outcomes, and generate a self-contained, runnable game replica that can be automatically verified by an external program. Experiments show that current coding agents still face substantial challenges in end-to-end black-box replication: the best-performing model (Claude Opus 4.8) achieves an overall score of 71.6\%, while the remaining models score only 4.0\%--42.9\%. Further analysis reveals a consistent pattern across all models: visual-fidelity scores are substantially higher than implementation- and rule-consistency scores, indicating that agents replicate visual appearance more readily than game mechanics. The difficulty levels further amplify the performance gap: from L1 to L5, the overall score of weaker agents drops sharply, whereas that of the best-performing agent declines only slightly.

AI.tldr: 提出GameReplica闭环评测框架，考察智能体在纯黑盒条件下仅凭截图与动作接口，通过观察与交互归纳规则并复现可验证游戏，含25款游戏125任务；最佳模型71.6%，其余仅4.0%–42.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有coding-agent基准多在目标行为已被文本、代码或示范明确指定后评测实现能力，而"无源码、无文档"的黑盒条件下，智能体能否仅靠视觉观察与主动交互归纳规则并复现可执行系统尚缺乏系统评测。
AI.method: 构建GameReplica闭环评测框架，覆盖感知—探索—归纳—复现—验证全流程。任务集含125个任务、25款游戏、5类核心机制族，每款游戏设5个难度等级。智能体仅能通过截图与动作接口访问目标游戏，需从像素反馈与交互结果中归纳关键视觉元素与玩法规则，并生成可由外部程序自动验证的自包含可运行复刻版本。
AI.result: 当前coding agent在端到端黑盒复现上仍面临显著挑战：最佳模型（Claude Opus 4.8）总体得分71.6%，其余模型仅4.0%–42.9%。所有模型呈现一致模式——视觉保真度得分明显高于实现一致性与规则一致性得分。难度等级放大差距：L1至L5，较弱智能体总分急剧下降，最佳模型仅小幅下降。
AI.conclusion: 该框架揭示了端到端黑盒游戏复现这一未被充分探索的能力维度，表明智能体更易复刻视觉外观而难以还原游戏机制，规则归纳与机制级实现是主要瓶颈，随难度提升差距进一步放大。

title: AutoGym: Blueprint-First Generation of Verifiable Agent Gyms
comment: Submitted to NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents?
summary: Training agents with reinforcement learning requires a gym, comprising a task, an executable environment in which the task can be attempted, and a verifier that reliably distinguishes success from failure. Constructing such gyms remains manual, expensive, and static. Task sets saturate as models improve and are increasingly exposed to contamination. Synthetic generation offers scale, but single-pass synthesis produces tasks whose difficulty is largely cosmetic. Models comparable in capability solve them despite convoluted phrasing, and correctness must be adjudicated post-hoc by unreliable LLM judges. We present AutoGym, a framework that generates complete gyms (tasks, executable environments, and verifiers) from a minimal domain seed or prior model trajectories. AutoGym introduces three mechanisms. (1) Blueprint-first generation specifies the valid solution space, environment requirements, and verification criteria before the environment is materialized, making solvability a construction prerequisite rather than a property verified after the fact. (2) Explicit generation parameters control task topology, interaction depth, capability axes, question obfuscation, and distractor composition, enabling fine-grained difficulty steering. (3) Active curriculum synthesis uses performance-informed calibration to adjust the distribution over these parameters as model capabilities evolve. Across productivity and temporal-reasoning settings, AutoGym generates gyms spanning the capability spectrum, including instances that challenge frontier models.

AI.tldr: AutoGym 是一个从最小领域种子或模型历史轨迹自动生成完整 RL "gym"（任务+可执行环境+验证器）的框架，通过蓝图先行生成、显式生成参数与主动课程合成三大机制，实现难度可控且能挑战前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 强化学习训练智能体依赖 gym（任务、可执行环境、验证器），但传统构建方式依赖人工、成本高昂且静态。随着模型能力提升，固定任务集会被饱和并面临数据污染；而单次合成虽能扩展规模，但其难度大多是"表面上的"——能力相当的模型即便面对复杂措辞仍能解决，且正确性只能靠不可靠的 LLM 评判器事后裁定。因此需要一种可扩展、难度真实可控、验证可靠且可随模型能力演化的 gym 生成方法。
AI.method: 提出 AutoGym 框架，包含三个机制：(1) 蓝图先行生成：在环境实体化之前先指定有效解空间、环境需求与验证标准，使"可解性"成为构造前提而非事后验证的属性；(2) 显式生成参数：控制任务拓扑、交互深度、能力维度、问题混淆程度与干扰项构成，实现细粒度难度调节；(3) 主动课程合成：采用基于性能的校准，随模型能力演化调整上述参数的分布。
AI.result: 在生产力（productivity）与时间推理（temporal-reasoning）两类场景中，AutoGym 生成的 gym 覆盖了完整的能力谱系，其中包含能够挑战前沿模型的实例。
AI.conclusion: AutoGym 通过"先蓝图、后环境"的构造顺序和参数化难度控制与主动课程校准，将 gym 构建从人工、静态、易饱和转变为自动化、可扩展且难度真实可调的流程，为持续挑战并训练不断进化的智能体提供了可行路径。

title: Balancing Reasoning and Hardware Constraints in RAG Pipelines for Ukrainian Multi-Domain Document Understanding
comment: 5 pages, 2 tables. Technical report based on UNLP 2026 Shared Task submission
summary: This paper describes the system submitted to the UNLP 2026 Shared Task on Multi-Domain Document Understanding. The challenge required extracting precise answers, document IDs, and page numbers from a diverse corpus of Ukrainian PDF documents within a strict 9-hour offline Kaggle execution limit. During evaluation on the hidden private test set, optical character recognition (OCR) of scanned documents emerged as a severe bottleneck, consuming 5-7 hours of the total time budget due to sequential single-threaded execution. This overhead strictly limited the remaining time for Large Language Model (LLM) inference to approximately two hours for 500 questions. To guarantee pipeline completion without timeouts, we developed a resource-efficient Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline utilizing BM25, BGE-M3, and Cross-Encoder reranking. Rather than deploying parameter-heavy reasoning models (e.g., DeepSeek R1) which consistently timed out, we utilized a 4-bit quantized LapaLLM 12B model via llama.cpp on dual NVIDIA T4 GPUs. Prioritizing pipeline stability over multi-step reasoning, our system achieved a Private Score of 0.8095, placing 10th out of 15 active teams.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个参加UNLP 2026多领域文档理解共享任务的系统。面对9小时离线Kaggle时限及OCR耗时5-7小时的瓶颈，作者构建了基于BM25、BGE-M3和Cross-Encoder重排序的资源高效型混合RAG流水线，并采用4-bit量化的LapaLLM 12B模型在双NVIDIA T4 GPU上运行，最终以0.8095的私有分数在15支活跃队伍中排名第10。
AI.motivation: 该任务要求在严格的9小时离线Kaggle执行限制内，从多样化的乌克兰语PDF文档语料中提取精确答案、文档ID和页码。扫描文档的OCR需耗时5-7小时，严重挤压了留给LLM推理的时间（约2小时处理500个问题），因此需要在极端资源受限条件下保证流水线能完整跑完而不超时。
AI.method: 采用资源高效的混合RAG流水线，结合BM25、BGE-M3和Cross-Encoder重排序进行检索。放弃参数庞大的推理模型（如DeepSeek R1，因其持续超时），改用经4-bit量化的LapaLLM 12B模型，通过llama.cpp在双NVIDIA T4 GPU上推理。整体设计以流水线稳定性优先于多步推理。
AI.result: 系统在隐藏私有测试集上取得0.8095的私有分数，在15支活跃队伍中排名第10。
AI.conclusion: 在极端时间约束下，优先保证流水线稳定性、采用资源高效的量化和混合RAG方案，是完成多领域文档理解任务并取得一定成绩的有效策略，但该任务中OCR单线程串行执行成为主要瓶颈，制约了整体性能上限。

title: Yarn tracking of large-scale 3D textile reinforcements using topological material features
summary: Automated segmentation of CT images has become increasingly important to enhance the reliability of simulations through the generation of high fidelity numerical models. This study addresses the challenging task of semi-automatically tracking textile reinforcements in fan blade dry preforms using X-ray CT images captured at coarse resolutions (i.e., above 140 $μ$m). Our approach offers a scalable, slice-based analysis conducted on planes orthogonal to the main yarn directions, applied to a large-scale real industrial component. This enables accurate identification and tracking of yarn paths while requiring minimal training. The method models three key yarn properties statistically: their typical cross-section shape, their continuity and movement in the 3D space, and their spatial relative arrangement with respect to neighboring yarns. These statistical properties are integrated into a tracking framework via a variational formulation that optimizes all yarn center positions in successive cross-section planes. The method tracks more than 3,000 warp yarns across 1,500 slices and achieves a tracking success rate above 90%. Overall, this work demonstrates a promising approach toward large-scale, automated textile reinforcement annotation, paving the way for more efficient material characterization in complex composite structures.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种基于切片统计建模与变分优化的半自动方法，在粗分辨率（>140 μm）X射线CT图像中追踪扇叶干预制体的纺织增强体纱线路径，在1500张切片上追踪3000余根经纱，成功率超90%。
AI.motivation: CT图像自动分割对生成高保真数值模型、提升仿真可靠性日益重要。但扇叶干预制体中纺织增强体的追踪面临粗分辨率CT成像的挑战，且需在大型真实工业构件上规模化处理，同时尽量降低训练成本。
AI.method: 采用可扩展的切片式分析，在垂直于主要纱线方向的平面上进行。统计建模三类纱线特性：典型截面形状、在三维空间中的连续性与运动、以及与相邻纱线的空间相对排布。将这些统计特性通过变分形式整合进追踪框架，优化连续截面平面上所有纱线中心位置。方法为半自动，所需训练量极小。
AI.result: 在1500张切片上成功追踪超过3000根经纱，追踪成功率达到90%以上；方法应用于大型真实工业构件。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了一种面向大规模纺织增强体自动标注的有前景的方法，为复杂复合材料结构更高效的材料表征奠定基础。

title: MAWILE: Multi-Axis Workbench for Inspecting LLM Evaluators
summary: Large language model (LLM) judges provide a flexible and scalable method for evaluating model and agent outputs, but their verdicts can be sensitive to incidental changes in the evaluated response, judge instructions, and scoring rubric. Existing systems examine important subsets of these failure modes, but auditing a configured judge requires testing both the judge instrument and the items it evaluates. We introduce MAWILE, a developer-facing workbench for auditing judge sensitivity across four surfaces: the judge prompt, judge rubric, target-system input, and target-system output. Given a user-supplied judge and representative evaluation items, MAWILE constructs and validates controlled perturbations, re-executes the judge, and localizes the resulting sensitivity. Each perturbation declares whether the verdict should remain invariant or change in a specified direction, allowing the same system to measure both robustness to irrelevant variations and sensitivity to meaningful changes. MAWILE audits binary, ordinal, and pairwise judges without requiring gold labels. The code for this tool is available at: github.com/megagonlabs/mawile-judge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MAWILE，一个面向开发者的评审敏感性审计工作台，从评审提示、评分细则、目标系统输入与输出四个表面构建并验证受控扰动，在无需金标准标签的情况下支持二值、序数与成对评审器的鲁棒性与敏感性审计。
AI.motivation: LLM 评审器（LLM judge）虽灵活可扩展，但其判定容易受到被评回复、评审指令与评分细则中无关变化的影响。现有系统只覆盖这些失败模式的若干重要子集；而完整审计一个已配置的评审器，需要同时检验评审工具本身及其所评估的条目。
AI.method: 提出 MAWILE 工作台。给定用户提供的评审器与代表性评估条目，MAWILE 在四个表面（评审提示、评审细则、目标系统输入、目标系统输出）上构建并验证受控扰动，重新执行评审器，并定位由此产生的敏感性。每个扰动声明其判定应保持不变还是按指定方向变化，从而用同一系统同时度量对无关变化的鲁棒性与对有意义变化的敏感性。支持二值、序数和成对评审器，且无需金标准标签。代码已开源。
AI.result: 该工具能够对二值、序数与成对评审器进行审计，无需金标准标签；通过声明式扰动同时度量鲁棒性与敏感性，并可将敏感性定位到具体扰动表面。摘要未给出量化实验数据，主要贡献为工具与审计框架本身。
AI.conclusion: MAWILE 为开发者提供了一个覆盖评审提示、细则、目标输入与输出四个表面的评审敏感性审计工作台，兼顾鲁棒性与敏感性度量，且不依赖金标准标签，可作为配置评审器的实用审计工具。

title: Type-Driven Tokenization for Brahmic Scripts
summary: Standard tokenizers used in large language models produce malformed text when applied to Brahmic scripts. They are a family of abugidas, writing systems whose consonants carry an inherent vowel that dependent marks can modify. They include Devanagari, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and others. The underlying issue is that these tokenizers violate orthographic constraints that do not arise in alphabetic scripts like English. We observe that while English orthography forms a \emph{semigroup} (any two valid tokens can be freely concatenated), Brahmic orthography forms a \emph{partial semigroup}: not every concatenation yields a valid string. We formalise this distinction in Agda, model valid Brahmic tokens as chains in a transition system, and derive a provably correct \texttt{fixToken} function that extends any candidate token to respect orthographic boundaries. We then show how this formal derivation translates into a practical patch for SentencePiece as well as a standalone Rust-based pre-tokenizer library, eliminating the observed errors across Indic scripts.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出主流大语言模型分词器在处理婆罗米系文字时会产生不合法文本，原因在于分词违反了该类文字特有的正字法约束。作者以半群/偏半群的代数视角形式化这一区别，在Agda中建模合法token并推导出可证明正确的fixToken函数，进而实现SentencePiece补丁与独立Rust预分词库，消除了各印度文字中的相关错误。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型的标准分词器（如SentencePiece）针对英文等字母文字设计，直接应用于婆罗米系文字（如天城文、泰卢固文、泰米尔文、卡纳达文等元音附标文字）时会产生格式错误的文本。其根本原因是这些分词器违反了字母文字中不存在、而婆罗米系文字中特有的正字法约束：英文正字法构成半群（任意两个合法token可自由拼接），而婆罗米系正字法仅构成偏半群（并非所有拼接都产生合法字符串）。论文旨在从形式化角度刻画这一差异，并据此修复分词器。
AI.method: 1）以代数结构为视角，将英文正字法刻画为半群，将婆罗米系正字法刻画为偏半群，形式化两者的区别；2）在Agda证明助理中对这一区别进行形式化；3）将合法的婆罗米token建模为转移系统中的链（chain）；4）由此推导出一个可证明正确的fixToken函数，将任意候选token扩展至符合正字法边界；5）将该形式化推导转化为SentencePiece的实际补丁，以及一个独立的基于Rust的预分词库。
AI.result: 形式化推导出可证明正确的fixToken函数，并成功将其落地为SentencePiece补丁和独立的Rust预分词库，消除了所观察到跨印度文字（Indic scripts）的分词错误。
AI.conclusion: 婆罗米系文字正字法的偏半群性质是分词错误的根源，通过Agda形式化建模并将合法token表示为转移系统链，可推导出可证明正确的修复函数；该形式化方法能够有效转化为实用工具，从根本上解决印度文字的分词错误问题。

title: ALPINE: Adaptive Localization for Parameter- and Sample-Efficient Few-Shot Learning
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Code, checkpoints, and reproduction manifests available at https://github.com/NeerajYadav-coder/alpine-fewshot
summary: Few-shot learning research is predominantly evaluated on accuracy alone, with limited attention to the parameter and training-sample budgets required to reach that accuracy - a real constraint for practitioners without large-scale compute. We present an ultra-lightweight (22,249-34,917 parameter) spatial-relational architecture for few-shot image classification that combines fixed Gabor edge-energy guidance with a windowed, content-adaptive patch locator. Under a strictly matched, iso-episode-budget protocol (250 meta-training episodes, 5 canonical seeds, 600 evaluation episodes per seed), our architecture achieves 5-shot accuracy gains, consistent across all five seeds, over Prototypical Networks, Relation Networks, and MAML on both CIFAR-FS and MiniImageNet, while using 27-53% fewer parameters than any baseline. It also converges in fewer training episodes, generalizes better to an unseen fine-grained domain (CUB-200-2011 birds, zero retraining), and is more robust to 50% occlusion and 25% spatial translation than all three baselines. A series of falsification ablations - zeroing relational tokens at inference and retraining without them entirely - shows that the architecture's pairwise relational computation, while present, is not the primary driver of its performance; the content-adaptive patch locator is. We report this honestly, together with a capacity sweep showing a genuine accuracy plateau near 22-35k parameters, and release full seed-level results and checkpoint hashes for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 提出一种22,249–34,917参数的超轻量空间关系架构，结合固定Gabor边缘能量引导与窗口化内容自适应图像块定位器，用于少样本图像分类；在严格等回合预算协议下，以比所有基线少27–53%的参数在5-shot精度上稳定超越ProtoNet、RelationNet与MAML，并更早收敛、跨域泛化更好、对遮挡与平移更鲁棒；消融表明性能主因是自适应定位器而非关系计算。
AI.motivation: 现有少样本学习研究主要仅以精度评价，忽视了达到该精度所需的参数与训练样本预算，这对缺乏大规模算力的研究者与实践者构成实际约束。论文希望在极小参数预算下重新审视少样本分类的性能与效率权衡，并提供可复现的严格对比。
AI.method: 设计超轻量（22,249–34,917参数）空间关系架构：由固定Gabor边缘能量引导模块与窗口化、内容自适应的图像块定位器组成，辅以成对关系计算模块。采用严格匹配的等回合预算协议：250个元训练回合、5个规范随机种子、每种子600个评估回合，在CIFAR-FS与MiniImageNet上与Prototypical Networks、Relation Networks、MAML对比。并开展证伪式消融（推理时置零关系token、完全不使用关系token重训练）以及参数容量扫描。
AI.result: 5-shot精度增益在全部5个种子中一致，优于三个基线；参数量比任一基线少27–53%；收敛所需训练回合更少；零重训练下对未见细粒度域CUB-200-2011泛化更好；对50%遮挡与25%空间平移更鲁棒。消融显示：推理时置零关系token及去掉关系token重训练后，性能主因仍为内容自适应图像块定位器，而非成对关系计算。容量扫描显示在约22–35k参数附近存在真实的精度平台。
AI.conclusion: 少样本学习评价应纳入参数与训练预算维度；在极小容量区间（约22–35k参数）可达到稳定且具竞争力的少样本分类精度，其收益主要来自内容自适应定位而非关系建模。作者如实报告关系计算并非主要驱动因素，并公开全部种子级结果与检查点哈希以保证可复现性。

title: GaitVista: Reliability-Aware AI Measurement toward Accessible Longitudinal Gait Assessment
summary: Tracking recovery of walking function requires detecting meaningful gait change across rehabilitation sessions, yet objective 3D measurement remains confined to specialized motion-capture laboratories. Small camera sets and body-worn inertial sensors broaden access, but reliability varies across joints and time, allowing sensing failures to masquerade as patient change. We present \textsc{GaitVista}, a reliability-aware measurement layer whose lightweight gate assigns joint- and frame-specific visual contributions using camera coverage, local visual quality, cross-modal disagreement, and root-motion continuity, and exposes them for inspection. Across seven clean and degraded sensing conditions on TotalCapture, \textsc{GaitVista} reduces average full-body and lower-body error by \textbf{27.7\%} and \textbf{27.8\%}, attains the lowest worst-condition error among fusion methods, and reduces the gap to a joint-frame oracle from $2.76$--$5.33$~cm for condition-blind baselines to $1.11$~cm. On MoVi with image-derived keypoints, it is the only deployable fusion method to improve over both unimodal streams, reducing marker-supported error by \textbf{6.4\%} relative to the strongest learned fusion baseline. On TotalCapture, it improves bilateral knee-flexion waveform accuracy by \textbf{18.9\%}. Raw inertial measurements from five TotalCapture participants show location- and time-varying magnetic disturbance, supporting the design's reliability premise. Both benchmarks contain neurologically healthy participants in controlled settings and retain participant-specific IMU calibration; we therefore report progress toward accessible gait assessment, not validated clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出可靠性感知的步态测量融合层GaitVista，用轻量门控按关节与帧分配视觉贡献，在多个退化传感条件下显著降低全身上/下肢误差并优于现有融合方法。
AI.motivation: 步态功能恢复评估需要检测有意义的步态变化，但客观3D测量局限于专业运动捕捉实验室；小型相机集与穿戴式惯性传感器虽降低门槛，但其可靠性随关节和时间变化，传感失效容易被误判为患者真实变化。
AI.method: GaitVista是一个可靠性感知的测量层，其轻量门控基于相机覆盖范围、局部视觉质量、跨模态不一致性和根运动连续性，为每个关节、每一帧分配特定的视觉贡献权重，并支持对这些贡献进行可视化检查。
AI.result: 在TotalCapture的7种干净与退化传感条件下，平均全身和下肢误差分别降低27.7%和27.8%，在所有融合方法中取得最低的最差条件误差，并将与关节-帧oracle的差距从条件无关基线的2.76–5.33 cm缩小到1.11 cm；在MoVi的图像关键点上，是唯一同时优于两个单模态流的可部署融合方法，较最强学习型融合基线降低6.4%的marker支持误差；在TotalCapture上双边膝屈曲波形精度提升18.9%。此外，五名参与者原始IMU数据显示磁场干扰随位置和时间变化，验证了可靠性设计前提。
AI.conclusion: 两个基准均使用神经健康参与者且在受控环境中采集，并保留了个体化IMU标定，因此该工作应被视为迈向可及步态评估的进展，而非已验证的临床部署。

title: Beyond Accuracy and Surface Fluency: Risk-Sensitive Evaluation of LLMs for Legal Clause Generation
comment: Accepted to the AI for Law Workshop @ ICML 2026. https://openreview.net/forum?id=qWtjzD2Udj
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to draft contractual language, yet conventional accuracy or preference-based evaluations are poorly matched to legal drafting. A clause may be fluent and stylistically polished while still omitting an essential carve-out, allocating risk in an unenforceable way, assuming an inapplicable jurisdiction, or exposing a party to regulatory liability. This paper presents a empirical study design and framework for evaluating LLM-generated contract clauses. The study evaluates four models - Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, GPT 5.4 Nano, and Qwen 3.5 Flash, across 22 contract clause categories and 34 legally-motivated failure modes. We combine two evaluation frameworks: CLAUSE, which classifies prompts by legal function and failure target, and LENS-CRAFT, which scores outputs across nine legal-quality dimensions. Instead of averaging dimension scores, the study applies a Max Severity Principle so that a single legally decisive defect remains visible. The paper provides the evaluation protocol, taxonomy, analysis plan, and a results structure for reporting empirical findings. We argue that legal AI evaluation should move beyond aggregate accuracy toward clause-specific, failure-mode-driven, and risk-sensitive assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套针对LLM生成合同条款的实证研究设计与评估框架，结合CLAUSE（按法律功能与失败目标分类提示）与LENS-CRAFT（九个法律质量维度打分）两套体系，覆盖4个模型、22类条款、34种法律失败模式，并采用"最大严重度原则"避免平均分掩盖致命缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有基于准确率或人类偏好的评估与法律起草任务严重不匹配：条款可能语言流畅、风格精良，却遗漏关键除外条款、以不可执行方式分配风险、假定不适用法域或使当事方面临监管责任。因此需要更贴合法律实践的评估范式。
AI.method: 提出实证研究设计与框架：评估Claude Haiku 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite、GPT 5.4 Nano、Qwen 3.5 Flash四个模型；覆盖22类合同条款与34种法律动机的失败模式；融合CLAUSE（按法律功能与失败目标对提示分类）与LENS-CRAFT（对输出从九个法律质量维度评分）两套框架；不采用维度分数平均，而引入Max Severity Principle（最大严重度原则）。论文并给出评估协议、分类体系、分析计划与结果报告结构。
AI.result: 论文属于研究设计类工作，尚未报告实验数据；其"结果"为可复用的评估协议、分类法、分析计划及面向实证发现的结果报告结构。
AI.conclusion: 法律AI评估应从聚合准确率转向条款特定、失败模式驱动且风险敏感的评估方式。

title: Dimensionality reduction for AI based hyperspectral image classification based on XAI
comment: The paper has been presented at the Annual Workshop of the Austrian Association for Pattern Recognition (OAGM) 2023 - Patterns in One Health - Oct 24-25, 2023, Vienna, Austria
summary: This research addresses the challenge of limited material recycling in wood recycling processes by leveraging artificial intelligence (AI)-based dimensionality reduction. Our study explores the application of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in multi-channel hyperspectral imaging (HSI), extending beyond RGB channels to over 200 spectral channels. Dimensionality reduction within this context involves streamlining the feature space for AI system training and inference. Focusing on explainable AI (XAI) methods, this paper contributes to a broader research initiative, presenting a solution framework that enhances the sustainability and efficiency of wood recycling processes.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对木材回收中材料再利用率低的问题，探索利用AI降维技术，将多通道高光谱成像（>200个光谱通道）与CNN结合用于木材分选，并聚焦可解释AI（XAI）方法，提出一个提升木材回收可持续性与效率的解决方案框架。
AI.motivation: 木材回收过程中材料循环利用率有限，传统基于RGB通道的识别手段难以满足精细分选需求，因此需要借助高光谱信息与AI方法提升识别与回收效率。
AI.method: 采用基于AI的降维方法，将卷积神经网络（CNN）应用于多通道高光谱成像（HSI），特征空间从RGB的3个通道扩展至200余个光谱通道，以精简用于AI训练与推理的特征空间；同时聚焦可解释AI（XAI）方法。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体的定量实验结果，仅说明该工作为更广泛研究计划的一部分，提出了一个可提升木材回收流程可持续性与效率的解决方案框架。
AI.conclusion: 基于AI降维与多通道高光谱成像结合CNN，并引入XAI，有助于改善木材回收的材料循环利用，具有提升可持续性与效率的潜力。

title: Splitting Documents at Lower Cost: Multi-Split Boundary Decisions for LLM-Based Page Stream Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the DocInsights Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Scanned mail, uploaded PDFs, and consolidated attachments often arrive as page streams that must be split into individual documents before downstream classification, extraction, or routing. Zero-shot large language models can detect document boundaries without task-specific training, but standard Page Classification (PC) and Boundary Decision (BD) formulations resolve only one boundary per model call. We introduce Multi-Split Boundary Decision (MSBD), which predicts multiple boundaries within a page window in a single call, reducing the number of inference requests. We evaluate MSBD across multiple language models, document collections, input modalities, and window sizes. The results reveal a model- and corpus-dependent operating range in which MSBD preserves strong segmentation accuracy while substantially improving inference efficiency, followed by a sharp decline at larger windows. MSBD provided the strongest overall accuracy--efficiency trade-off, while large windows expose distinct over- and under-segmentation behavior across models. These findings show that multi-boundary prediction can make zero-shot page stream segmentation more efficient when the window size is selected for the target corpus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多分界判定（MSBD），在单次模型调用中预测窗口内多个文档边界，实现零样本页流分割的效率与精度更优权衡。
AI.motivation: 扫描邮件、上传PDF及合并附件常以页流形式到达，需先切分为独立文档以便下游分类、抽取与路由。零样本大语言模型无需任务特定训练即可检测文档边界，但标准的页分类（PC）与边界判定（BD）每次调用仅能解决一个边界，导致推理请求数量大、效率低。
AI.method: 提出多分界判定（MSBD），在单个页窗口内一次调用预测多个边界，以减少推理请求次数。在多种语言模型、文档集合、输入模态与窗口尺寸上对MSBD进行评估。
AI.result: 结果揭示出依赖模型与语料的操作区间：在该区间内MSBD保持较强分割精度并显著提升推理效率，窗口进一步增大后性能急剧下降。MSBD提供最佳的整体精度—效率权衡，而大窗口则暴露出不同模型间明显的过分割与欠分割行为差异。
AI.conclusion: 多边界预测在针对目标语料选择合适窗口尺寸时，可使零样本页流分割更高效。

title: Correlation-Aware Structured Pruning for Large Language Models
summary: Structured pruning is a promising approach for reducing the substantial inference costs of Large Language Models (LLMs) while maintaining hardware efficiency. Many existing methods assess the importance of prunable units (e.g., channels or heads) in isolation, implicitly assuming that pruning errors are additive. This independence assumption is often invalidated by the non-orthogonality of model weights and strong correlations between unit activations, potentially leading to performance degradation. To address this, we propose a Correlation-Aware Structured Pruning method. We formulate the pruning objective as a cardinality-constrained binary quadratic program that explicitly models cross-unit dependencies in the reconstruction error. Since this binary quadratic program is NP-hard and difficult to solve exactly, we develop a greedy interaction algorithm based on dependency-aware marginal costs to optimize unit selection. Furthermore, we incorporate a gradient-based strategy to achieve adaptive layer-wise sparsity allocation across the entire model. Extensive experiments on mainstream LLMs demonstrate that incorporating correlation information yields competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs compared to representative structured pruning baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出相关性感知结构化剪枝方法，将剪枝建模为基数约束二元二次规划，用依赖感知边际成本的贪心算法求解，并做自适应逐层稀疏分配。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化剪枝方法孤立地评估剪枝单元（如通道、注意力头）的重要性，隐含假设剪枝误差可加。但模型权重非正交、单元激活强相关，使该独立性假设失效，导致性能下降。
AI.method: 将剪枝目标形式化为基数约束的二元二次规划，显式建模重构误差中的跨单元依赖关系；由于该问题是NP-hard难以精确求解，提出基于依赖感知边际成本的贪心交互算法来选择单元；并引入基于梯度的策略实现全模型自适应逐层稀疏率分配。
AI.result: 在主流大语言模型上的大量实验表明，相比代表性结构化剪枝基线，引入相关性信息能取得更具竞争力的精度—效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模单元间相关性，可缓解独立性假设带来的性能退化，实现更优的结构化剪枝效果，为LLM推理成本降低提供有效方案。

title: Hierarchical Aggregation of Semantic Uncertainty in 3D Scene Graphs
summary: Open-vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs (3DSGs) ground each object node in a vision-language embedding, yet they record every entry as equally certain, so a robot querying the map cannot tell which of its entries are unreliable. Estimators of semantic uncertainty could supply that distinction, but they require repeated sampling of a model, training, or held-out labels, none of which are available to a deployed system at query time. We present a framework that exploits the detector confidence and the embeddings a 3DSG already stores, converts them into a probability that an entry is correct, and propagates that probability through the containment hierarchy into a belief that a room contains a queried class. Four signals, each paired with the object-level error it indicates, are converted to probabilities at the logit scale learned by the vision-language model and combined in closed form with no additional perception or training. Objects sharing a detector and a vocabulary fail together, so the framework aggregates them in the fully correlated limit, where an aggregation under independence would treat one repeated error as repeated evidence. Evaluated on HM3DSem against a state-of-the-art 3DSG system, the framework improves object retrieval and lowers the error of the room-level assertions of the graph it reads.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需重复采样或训练的开放式词汇3D场景图不确定性估计框架，将检测置信度与嵌入转化为条目正确概率并沿包含层次传播为房间级信念。
AI.motivation: 现有开放式词汇3D场景图将每个物体节点锚定在视觉-语言嵌入中，却把所有条目记录为同等确定，机器人在查询地图时无法判断哪些条目不可靠。语义不确定性估计器虽可提供这种区分，但需要模型重复采样、训练或留出标注，这些在部署系统的查询时刻都不可得。
AI.method: 利用3DSG已存储的检测器置信度与嵌入，将四类信号（各自对应一种物体级错误）在视觉-语言模型学得的logit尺度上转换为概率，并以闭式形式组合，无需额外感知或训练；由于共享检测器与词汇表的物体倾向于共同出错，框架在完全相关极限下聚合，而非独立性假设下（后者会把一次重复错误当作重复证据）。随后该概率沿包含层次传播，形成房间包含被查询类别的信念。
AI.result: 在HM3DSem上对标最先进3DSG系统，该框架提升了物体检索性能，并降低了其读取的场景图在房间级断言上的误差。
AI.conclusion: 通过复用已有嵌入与检测置信度并采用完全相关聚合，可在查询时零开销地为3DSG提供标定后的不确定性，并改善下游物体与房间级查询的可靠性。

title: Text, Pixels, or Both? Evaluating Input Representations for Multimodal Document QA
comment: Accepted as a poster at the Context Beyond the Window (CBW) Workshop at COLM 2026 and the DocInsights Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Every document QA system begins with a choice that is rarely studied on its own: whether to feed the model page images, extracted text, or both. We isolate this choice, holding the prompt, judge, and scoring pipeline fixed, across four commercial model endpoints, two corpora, and two context regimes (gold evidence pages and the full document). On documents that fit the image budget, page images lead on accuracy at every document length on both corpora, but this advantage carries a growing latency and cost premium: text latency stays roughly flat as documents lengthen while image latency rises steadily. Text and images also fail on different questions, with exactly one representation correct on 19--25% of items across the reported cells, so neither subsumes the other. Exploiting this complementarity, a lightweight TF-IDF router that reads only the question text gains 2.6 points over always-text while cutting median latency 30% relative to always-vision, on a document-disjoint held-out split.

AI.tldr: 论文隔离"输入表示"这一被忽视的设计选择：在固定提示、评判器与打分流程的条件下，比较页面图像、提取文本及两者混合对文档问答的影响。
AI.motivation: 文档QA系统通常默认选择输入形式（图像/文本），但该选择本身缺乏独立研究。作者希望厘清：图像与文本表示各自的准确率、延迟与成本特性，以及两者是否可相互替代。
AI.method: 固定prompt、judge与评分流程，跨4个商用模型端点、2个语料库、2种上下文设置（金标证据页与整篇文档）进行对照实验；分析图像与文本的错误重叠；提出仅读问题文本的轻量TF-IDF路由器，在文档不相交的留出划分上评估。
AI.result: 在图像预算内的文档上，页面图像在各文档长度与两个语料库上均取得更高准确率，但延迟与成本随文档变长持续上升，而文本延迟基本持平；在19–25%的条目上仅有一种表示正确，说明两者不可相互涵盖。TF-IDF路由器较always-text提升2.6个点，且相较always-vision降低30%中位延迟。
AI.conclusion: 输入表示是一个独立且影响显著的设计维度：图像准确率更高但代价递增，文本与图像错误互补；基于问题的轻量路由可在准确率与延迟之间取得优于任一固定表示策略的折中。

title: Observational Equivalence of LLM and Human Annotation
summary: In this paper, we show that LLM and human coding are observationally equivalent in terms of annotation quality: recent LLMs agree with expert coders at rates comparable to those observed among experts themselves. We demonstrate this through replications of text-classification tasks from 14 peer-reviewed political science studies, in which ten LLMs, three human experts, and 165 crowdsourced workers independently classify the same texts using identical codebooks. We find that this equivalence is driven by ambiguity in the texts and coding rules. When LLMs disagree with experts, experts are also more likely to disagree with one another, and clarifying coding rules reduces disagreement among both experts and sufficiently capable LLMs. Thus, there is little empirical basis for preferring human coding on the basis of annotation quality alone, while LLMs offer substantial advantages in speed and cost. We therefore argue that the central challenge of text annotation is no longer choosing between human and machine coders, but developing coding rules that minimize ambiguity and accounting for the ambiguity that remains. To this end, we propose using disagreement across LLMs to identify difficult cases and refine codebooks, and we develop ambiguity-aware bounds for downstream inference when a unique annotation cannot be defined for every text.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明LLM与人类在文本标注质量上具有观测等价性，分歧主要源于文本与编码规则的歧义而非编码者类型，并据此提出以LLM间分歧识别困难样本、修订码本及构建歧义感知的下游推断边界。
AI.motivation: 学界普遍默认人类专家标注在质量上优于LLM，因而在文本标注任务中偏好人工编码。但这一偏好缺乏系统的实证检验：尚不清楚LLM与专家的一致率是否真的低于专家之间的一致率，也不清楚分歧的真正来源是编码者能力还是任务本身的歧义。作者旨在检验"人工编码质量更优"这一假设的经验基础。
AI.method: 复现14项同行评审政治学研究中的文本分类任务，统一码本下由10个LLM、3名人类专家与165名众包工作者独立标注同一批文本，比较LLM—专家一致率与专家间一致率；通过分析分歧文本的特征、检验澄清编码规则前后分歧的变化，识别歧义的作用；并提出利用LLM间分歧定位困难案例、迭代精炼码本的方法，以及当文本无法定义唯一标注时的歧义感知推断边界（ambiguity-aware bounds）。
AI.result: LLM与专家的一致率与专家彼此间的一致率相当，即二者在观测上等价；分歧由文本与编码规则中的歧义驱动——当LLM与专家不一致时，专家之间也更易互相不一致；澄清编码规则后，专家与能力足够的LLM的分歧均下降。这表明仅以标注质量为由偏好人工编码缺乏实证依据，而LLM在速度与成本上具有显著优势。
AI.conclusion: 文本标注的核心挑战已从"选择人工还是机器编码者"转变为"制定歧义最小化的编码规则并处理残余歧义"。作者据此建议：用LLM间分歧识别困难案例以精炼码本，并在无法为每段文本定义唯一标注时，采用歧义感知边界进行下游推断。

title: MarsRecon: Self-Supervised and Multimodal Surface Representations for Mars
summary: High-resolution orbital imagery offers a rich record of the Martian surface, but sparse geological labels limit supervised representation learning. We present MarsRecon, a geospatially aware pipeline for learning visual and multimodal representations from HiRISE observations of Olympus Mons. The pipeline calibrates NASA Planetary Data System products, extracts valid georeferenced patches, and trains a masked autoencoder on unlabeled imagery. Increasing input resolution and filtering invalid tokens reduced held-out reconstruction loss from 0.1751 to 0.1342 in the principal Stage A model series. We then freeze the visual encoder and align its features with observation text, coordinates, and local--global image context. The strongest current local-primary model achieves image-to-text recall@10 of 0.3787, text-to-image recall@10 of 0.9161, and local-to-global recall@10 of 0.4350 on the held-out test split. These results establish a working Mars-specific pretraining and retrieval pipeline; further crop-overlap controls and downstream geological evaluations are needed to assess the broader utility of its embeddings.

AI.tldr: 提出MarsRecon——一个面向火星HiRISE影像的地理空间感知自监督/多模态表征学习流程，在奥林帕斯山区域训练掩码自编码器并与文本、坐标及局部-全局图像上下文对齐，建立可用的火星专用预训练与检索管线。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率轨道影像提供了丰富的火星地表记录，但地质标注稀疏，限制了监督式表征学习；因此需要利用无标注影像进行自监督预训练，并构建多模态对齐以支撑检索等下游任务。
AI.method: 构建地理空间感知流程MarsRecon：对NASA行星数据系统（PDS）产品进行校准，提取有效的带地理参考影像块（patches）；在无标注影像上训练掩码自编码器（MAE）；随后冻结视觉编码器，将其特征与观测文本、坐标以及局部-全局图像上下文进行对齐。
AI.result: Stage A主模型系列中，提高输入分辨率并过滤无效token使留出集重建损失从0.1751降至0.1342；在留出测试集上，当前最优的local-primary模型取得image-to-text recall@10为0.3787、text-to-image recall@10为0.9161、local-to-global recall@10为0.4350。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了可行的火星专用预训练与检索流程；仍需补充裁剪重叠控制实验和下游地质任务评估，以验证其嵌入表征的更广泛适用性。

title: Self-Organizing Agent Teams Learn to Reason Together
summary: Collective intelligence depends not only on what team members know, but also on how they organize their work. When the structure of a solution is unknown, useful roles and divisions of labor cannot be specified in advance; teams must learn from experience how to organize reasoning as it unfolds. Human teams routinely adapt this way, while existing AI agent teams rely on fixed protocols, explicit task decomposition, or routing. We introduce Self-Organizing Agent Teams (SAT), fixed teams of AI agents that learn reusable strategies from prior collaborations to organize roles, conversational phases, participation, and information flow. These strategies enable what we call collaborative computation: agents exchange, challenge, repair, and synthesize partial reasoning into solutions no member produced independently. In two independent settings, we learn teamwork strategies that transfer unchanged to unseen benchmarks, using only 15 mathematics and 25 graduate-level knowledge problems. Across five mathematics and physics benchmarks, self-organizing teams average 66.7% accuracy, versus 48.8% for their strongest member, 58.7% for compute-matched inference by that agent, and 59.0% for a perfect router over members' independent answers; on AIME 2026, they exceed this router by 13.4 points. Because gains vary across benchmarks, we ask when self-organizing collaboration helps. Across eight benchmarks, demonstrability (the organizational-psychology construct of whether a team can distinguish correct from incorrect reasoning) strongly tracks improvement over the strongest member (Spearman $ρ=0.90$, $p=0.005$): teams benefit most when correct reasoning can be recognized once it appears. More broadly, these results suggest that organization itself can become an agent capability: agent teams can learn how to reason together and produce solutions their members could not reach independently.

AI.tldr: 提出自组织智能体团队（SAT），让固定AI智能体团队从既往协作中学习可复用的团队策略（角色、会话阶段、参与度与信息流），实现"协作计算"；在数学与物理基准上显著超越最强成员、同等算力推理与最优路由器，并发现"可论证性"是协作增益的关键预测因子。
AI.motivation: 集体智能不仅取决于成员知识，还取决于团队如何组织工作。当解决方案结构未知时，有用角色与分工无法预先指定，需从经验中学习组织推理方式。人类团队常如此自适应，而现有AI智能体团队依赖固定协议、显式任务分解或路由，缺乏这种可学习、可迁移的组织能力。
AI.method: 提出Self-Organizing Agent Teams (SAT)：由固定AI智能体组成的团队，从既往协作中学习可复用策略，用于组织角色分配、对话阶段、参与度与信息流。这些策略促成"协作计算"——智能体交换、质疑、修复并综合部分推理，形成任何单个成员无法独立得出的解。用仅15道数学题与25道研究生水平知识题学习团队策略，并在两个独立设置中验证其可原样迁移到未见基准。随后在8个基准上考察"可论证性"（团队能否区分正确与错误推理）与相对最强成员提升的关系。
AI.result: 在5个数学与物理基准上，自组织团队平均准确率66.7%，对比最强成员48.8%、该智能体同等算力推理58.7%、成员独立答案的完美路由器59.0%；在AIME 2026上超越该路由器13.4个百分点。跨8个基准，可论证性与相对最强成员的提升高度相关（Spearman ρ=0.90, p=0.005）。
AI.conclusion: 团队增益随基准而异，当正确推理一旦出现便能被识别时协作获益最大。更广泛地，结果表明组织本身可以成为智能体的一种能力：智能体团队能够学会如何共同推理，并产生成员独立无法达到的解。

title: Read-Best Is Not Steer-Best: A Probing--Steering Layer Dissociation in Omni-Modal Large Language Models
summary: Omni-modal large language models integrate text, audio, and image signals into a shared residual stream, where concepts such as emotion can be linearly decoded and causally modified by activation steering. A common but rarely tested assumption is that the layer with the highest probing accuracy is also the best layer for steering, so injection layers are often selected by probe performance. We provide the first causal test of this assumption across three independently developed omni-modal models and find that it fails. Reading and intervention rely on different layers, a phenomenon we call the probing-steering layer dissociation. Using emotion as a controlled testbed, we measure layer-wise readability and steerability across text, audio, and image inputs. Probe-best layers vary widely across architectures, while steering-effective layers consistently fall within a narrow mid-to-late range of normalized depth. Paired random-direction controls show an approximately 26-fold causal gap, ruling out random perturbation and direction quality as explanations. Logit-lens analysis reveals a staged forward process: causal handle, probing saturation, and vocabulary commitment, and motivates a two-factor account in which steering effectiveness depends on both representational readability and downstream plasticity. These results show that probing accuracy is a poor heuristic for selecting intervention layers and suggest a cross-architecture mid-to-late selection criterion. We also identify a cross-modal emotion subspace organized by valence and arousal, with joy acting as a stable anchor across models. Code and data: https://github.com/YiboWang2002/Read-Best-Is-Not-Steer-Best.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对"探针准确率最高的层也是最佳干预层"这一假设进行因果检验，发现该假设在三个独立的全模态大模型中均不成立，并提出跨架构的中后期层选择准则。
AI.motivation: 全模态大模型将文本、音频、图像信号整合到共享残差流中，可通过激活引导（activation steering）对情绪等概念进行线性解码与因果修改。然而，注入层的选择常依赖探针性能，即默认"探针最准的层即最佳引导层"，这一假设虽普遍却少有验证。本文旨在对该假设进行首次因果检验。
AI.method: 以情绪为受控测试床，在三个独立开发的全模态模型上测量各层在不同模态（文本、音频、图像）下的可读性（readability）与可引导性（steerability）；采用配对随机方向对照排除随机扰动与方向质量的影响，并通过 logit-lens 分析前向过程。
AI.result: 探针最优层在不同架构间差异很大，而引导有效层始终落在归一化深度的中后期窄区间；配对随机方向对照显示约 26 倍的因果差距；logit-lens 揭示出"因果把手—探针饱和—词汇固化"的分阶段前向过程；此外发现一个按效价与唤醒度组织的跨模态情绪子空间，其中"喜悦"在各模型中作为稳定锚点。
AI.conclusion: 探针准确率是选择干预层的糟糕启发式，读取与干预依赖不同层（探针-引导层解离）；引导效果取决于表征可读性与下游可塑性两个因素，据此提出跨架构的中后期层选择准则。

title: Style as Cover: Deep Image Steganography via Stylized Transmission
summary: Image steganography hides secret message within normal images, with most existing works relying on cover-preserving transmission. However, such a paradigm becomes vulnerable once the original cover is exposed or can be reliably approximated. In this paper, we propose StyleStegaNet, a stylized image hiding framework that replaces cover matching with style-concealment transmission. Instead of transmitting a cover-like stego image, StyleStegaNet generates stylized stego images conditioned on publicly available style references, redefining steganography invisibility from cover-preserving concealment to behavior-level camouflage based on style transformation. Such a setting poses a substantial challenge to reliable secret recovery, since neural stylization can significantly alter the feature statistics exploited by deep hiding methods. To address this challenge, StyleStegaNet decouples the overall task into four coordinated stages: stego generation, stylized transmission, structure-preserving reconstruction, and secret recovery. Moreover, StyleStegaNet is optimized with a progressive three-stage training strategy, in which wavelet-domain constraints and perceptual supervision guide the recoverable information toward structural representations. We further provide an analysis showing that secret recoverability is largely restricted to the normalized structural subspace, offering a mechanistic explanation for why directly stylized baselines fail and why a reconstruction-guided recovery path is necessary. Extensive experiments on DIV2K and MS-COCO datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of StyleStegaNet. And few-shot image steganalysis with two deep detectors further shows detection accuracy near random guessing, approximately 51\%.

AI.tldr: StyleStegaNet提出一种风格化图像隐写框架，用"风格隐藏式传输"替代传统的载体匹配式传输，通过公开风格参考生成风格化含密图像，实现行为级伪装，并保证了秘密信息的可靠恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有图像隐写多依赖载体保持式传输，一旦原始载体被公开或被可靠逼近，隐写安全性即被破坏。因此需要一种不再依赖载体匹配、而基于风格变换实现行为级伪装的新隐写范式。
AI.method: StyleStegaNet以公开风格参考为条件生成风格化含密图像，将整体任务解耦为四个协同阶段：含密生成、风格化传输、结构保持重建与秘密恢复；并采用渐进式三阶段训练策略，结合小波域约束与感知监督，将可恢复信息引导至结构表示中。理论上分析了秘密可恢复性主要限制在归一化结构子空间。
AI.result: 在DIV2K和MS-COCO数据集上的大量实验验证了StyleStegaNet的有效性；两种深度检测器的少样本图像隐写分析检测准确率接近随机猜测，约为51%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将隐写不可见性从载体保持式隐藏重新定义为基于风格变换的行为级伪装，并借助重建引导的恢复路径，StyleStegaNet在强风格化干扰下仍能可靠恢复秘密，同时具备较强的抗检测能力。

title: Generative Embodied Multiple Behavior Control Systems for Human-like Agents
summary: An enduring and richly elaborated dichotomy in cognitive neuroscience is that of human behavior control mechanisms, divided into habitual versus goal-directed. While existing human-like agent frameworks primarily focus on modeling goal- directed behavior, habitual behavior has been largely overlooked, though it plays a crucial role in human daily life. In this paper, we address this gap by studying multiple behavior control systems that jointly model goal-directed and habitual behaviors. We propose a human behavior control mechanism-inspired framework which the Habitual Controller retrieves cue-triggered behaviors from personal- ized habit memory, while the Goal-directed Controller employs a context-aware world model to predict action consequences and estimate their values. The Arbiter dynamically balances the influence of both systems according to individual differ- ences and momentary internal states. To reconstruct diverse human-level behavior instructions in 3D environments, we further develop a keyframe-guided 3D mo- tion generation module. Through extensive evaluation methods, human studies, and ablations studies, experimental results demonstrate that human-likeness per- formance is significantly improved by our approach. The efficacy of our approach indicates the benefits of leveraging habitual behavior and multiple behavior con- trol system coordination for believable embodied human-like agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个受人类行为控制机制启发的框架，联合建模习惯性与目标导向行为，并配合关键帧引导的3D动作生成模块，显著提升了具身智能体的类人表现。
AI.motivation: 认知神经科学将人类行为控制分为习惯性与目标导向两类，但现有的类人智能体框架主要只建模目标导向行为，忽视了在人类日常生活中至关重要的习惯行为，导致行为建模不完整、类人性不足。
AI.method: 提出多行为控制系统框架：习惯控制器从个性化习惯记忆中检索线索触发的行为；目标导向控制器利用情境感知世界模型预测动作后果并估计其价值；仲裁器根据个体差异与瞬时内部状态动态平衡两系统的影响。此外，开发关键帧引导的3D动作生成模块，以在3D环境中重建多样化的人类级行为指令。
AI.result: 通过多种评估方法、人类主观研究与消融实验，结果表明所提方法在类人性表现上有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了利用习惯行为与多行为控制系统协同，对构建可信的具身类人智能体具有明显益处，弥补了以往仅关注目标导向行为的不足。

title: DiFA: Dual Evidence Fusion and Aggregation for Token-Level Text Anomaly Detection
comment: Accepted by ICDM 2026. 10 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables
summary: Text anomaly detection, the task of identifying text instances that deviate from normal language patterns, is crucial for language-driven applications. However, most existing methods can only perform document-level anomaly detection, making it hard to locate harmful phrases or support targeted prevention. Recently, there has been an emerging trend toward token-level text anomaly detection, which aims to address the above limitation by identifying anomalous words or fragments within a document. Nevertheless, one representative method mainly relies on representation-space distance measurement, neglecting the complementary roles of different anomaly cues in capturing diverse abnormal patterns. To bridge the gaps, we propose a Dual-evidence framework with adaptive Fusion and Aggregation (DiFA) for token-level anomaly detection. DiFA derives anomaly scores from form-structural and semantic views to capture visible structural abnormality and contextual inconsistency, respectively, thereby providing complementary evidence for identifying diverse anomalies. To combine these two scores with varying numerical scales, DiFA incorporates a calibration and fusion mechanism to adaptively balance the two views. Moreover, to obtain a discriminative document-level score, a multivariate aggregation method is designed to summarize token-level anomaly scores from multiple perspectives, preventing rare anomalous tokens from being diluted. Extensive experiments across various text anomaly detection benchmarks demonstrate that DiFA consistently achieves top performance while maintaining strong efficiency, robustness, and interpretability. The code and scripts are available at: https://github.com/qyy11-com/DiFA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DiFA（Dual-evidence framework with adaptive Fusion and Aggregation），用于 token 级文本异常检测，通过形式结构与语义双视角互补证据、自适应校准融合机制及多变量聚合，显著提升检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有文本异常检测方法大多只能进行文档级检测，难以定位有害短语或支持针对性预防。新兴的 token 级检测方法虽能识别文档内的异常词或片段，但代表性方法主要依赖表示空间距离度量，忽略了不同异常线索在捕捉多样异常模式中的互补作用。
AI.method: DiFA 从形式结构视角和语义视角分别推导异常分数，用以捕捉可见的结构异常与上下文不一致，形成互补证据；针对两种分数数值尺度不同的问题，引入校准与融合机制自适应平衡两个视角；并设计多变量聚合方法，从多角度汇总 token 级异常分数，以获得具判别性的文档级分数，防止稀有异常 token 被稀释。
AI.result: 在多个文本异常检测基准上的大量实验表明，DiFA 持续取得最优性能，同时保持较强的效率、鲁棒性与可解释性。
AI.conclusion: DiFA 通过双证据融合与聚合有效解决了 token 级文本异常检测中线索单一与尺度不平衡的问题，是当前性能领先且兼具效率、鲁棒性和可解释性的方案。

title: Spatiotemporal Flux Probing for Single-Photon Videography
summary: We address the problem of recovering high-speed videos from dynamic scenes under extreme photon sparsity. Existing methods rely on aggregating photon detections in local spatiotemporal windows to improve signal-to-noise ratio; however, this local grouping discards global structure and fails in low-light regimes where photon detections are sparse in space and time. In this work, we show that the information needed to recover both motion and illumination is encoded in correlations over the full space-time pattern of photon arrivals. Building on this insight, we develop a spatiotemporal flux probing theory and an algorithm that estimates the Fourier coefficients of the underlying intensity directly from the photon stream. We demonstrate that our approach (1) recovers fast motion and temporal illumination dynamics with substantially fewer photons than prior methods, (2) enables velocity-selective videography that automatically refocuses video onto specific detected motions, and (3) generalizes across sensing modalities including single-photon, event, and spike cameras.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"时空通量探测"理论与算法，直接从光子到达的时空相关性中估计强度场的傅里叶系数，从而在极端光子稀疏条件下恢复高速视频，并支持速度选择性视频成像。
AI.motivation: 在极端低光、光子稀疏的动态场景中恢复高速视频十分困难。现有方法通过在局部时空窗口内聚合光子探测来提高信噪比，但这种局部聚合丢弃了全局结构，在光子在空间和时间上都稀疏的低光条件下失效。作者认为运动与光照恢复所需的信息实际上编码在光子到达的完整时空模式的相关性中。
AI.method: 作者建立"时空通量探测"（spatiotemporal flux probing）理论，并设计算法，直接从光子流中估计底层强度分布的傅里叶系数，而非依赖局部窗口聚合。
AI.result: 实验表明：(1) 相比已有方法，能用显著更少的光子恢复快速运动与时间光照动态；(2) 可实现速度选择性视频成像，自动将视频重聚焦到特定检测到的运动上；(3) 能跨传感模态泛化，包括单光子相机、事件相机和脉冲（spike）相机。
AI.conclusion: 利用光子到达的全局时空相关性可突破光子稀疏限制，实现高效的高速视频重建与速度选择性成像，并具备跨模态通用性。

title: Toward Auditable and Calibrated AI for Dementia-Related Crash Severity Prediction: A Selective Deferral Framework to Support Human Review
comment: This is the author's preprint version of a paper accepted for presentation at HICSS 60 (Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences), 2027, Hawaii, USA. The final published version will appear in the official conference proceedings. Conference site: https://hicss.hawaii.edu/
summary: Public crash databases increasingly support automated safety analysis, but crash severity prediction remains difficult to translate into public-sector decision workflows when models are evaluated primarily as ordinary classifiers. This study reframes dementia-related crash severity modeling as a decision-aware triage problem in which a system must classify crashes into no-injury/property-damage-only (O), minor or moderate injury (BC), and fatal or severe injury (KA), while also controlling outcome leakage, reporting severe under-triage, calibrating confidence, and preserving every raw prediction for audit. Using 4,781 Texas crash records with structured fields and police narratives, we evaluate structured, narrative, fusion, calibrated fusion, BERT-family, and local large-language-model baselines under a stratified 70/15/15 split. In the reported split, leakage-controlled Gemma obtains the highest observed macro-F1 (0.545; 95% bootstrap CI [0.507, 0.583]). The best calibrated fusion model obtains macro-F1 of 0.522 and expected calibration error of 0.033. Selective deferral improves performance among cases retained for automatic classification. At 70% coverage, macro-F1 rises to 0.573 and severity cost falls to 0.577, while deferred cases are treated as candidates for a proposed human-review process and are not further evaluated in the present experiment. The study contributes a reproducible, leakage-controlled, and uncertainty-aware evaluation framework for crash AI systems, emphasizing auditability and selective deferral rather than accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 将痴呆相关车祸严重程度建模重构为决策感知的分诊问题，在控制数据泄漏、报告严重漏诊、校准置信度并保留全部原始预测的前提下，构建可复现、不确定性感知的评估框架。在4,781条德州车祸记录上，Gemma取得最高宏F1（0.545），最佳校准融合模型宏F1为0.522、ECE为0.033；选择性延迟使70%覆盖率下宏F1升至0.573，严重程度代价降至0.577。
AI.motivation: 公共车祸数据库日益支持自动化安全分析，但现有研究多将严重程度预测当作普通分类任务评估，难以转化为公共部门的决策流程。作者希望将模型评估从单纯追求准确率转向面向决策的分诊视角，同时解决结果泄漏、严重漏诊报告缺失、置信度未校准、预测不可审计等实际问题。
AI.method: 将车祸严重程度分为O（无伤/仅财产损失）、BC（轻中度伤）、KA（死亡或重伤）三类，作为决策感知的分诊任务。使用4,781条德州车祸记录（结构化字段+警方叙述文本），在分层70/15/15划分下评估结构化模型、叙述文本模型、融合模型、校准融合模型、BERT系列模型和本地大语言模型基线，并进行泄漏控制、置信度校准与选择性延迟评估。
AI.result: 在报告的数据划分下，经泄漏控制的Gemma取得最高观测宏F1（0.545，95% bootstrap CI [0.507, 0.583]）；最佳校准融合模型宏F1为0.522，期望校准误差（ECE）为0.033。选择性延迟提升了保留自动分类样本的性能：在70%覆盖率下，宏F1升至0.573，严重程度代价降至0.577；被延迟的样本被视为拟议人工复核流程的候选，本研究未对其进一步评估。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为车祸AI系统贡献了一个可复现、控制泄漏、感知不确定性的评估框架，强调可审计性与选择性延迟，而非仅关注准确率，从而更契合公共部门的实际决策工作流。

title: Does the Truthfulness Signal Survive Code-Mixing? Probing Hidden States for Hallucination Detection in Hinglish
summary: Hidden-state hallucination probing - training a linear classifier on an LLM's internal activations to detect whether a generated answer is faithful to the input - is an active area of 2026 research, with recent work reporting 0.90-1.00 AUROC across several benchmarks and languages. However, none of this work has tested probes on code-mixed input, despite the fact that a huge population of chatbot users write in Hindi-English code-mixed text ("Hinglish"). We address this gap directly: does a hallucination probe trained on clean-language hidden states transfer to Hinglish, or does the signal degrade under code-mixing? We construct a 5,674-item Hindi/English/Hinglish QA benchmark, generate and label 17,022 model responses across three open-weight 7-8B LLMs (Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B, Llama-3.1-8B), extract per-layer hidden states at two token positions, and train linear and MLP probes for in-distribution detection and cross-lingual transfer. We find that the hallucination signal survives code-mixing well: transfer AUROC ranges from 0.88 to 0.99, with gaps of mostly under 0.05 AUROC relative to in-distribution performance, and that Hindi-trained probes transfer to Hinglish more reliably than English-trained probes. As an independent, practically motivated finding, all three models hallucinate substantially more on Hindi and Hinglish than on English for matched facts. We release our code and synthetic Hinglish QA dataset to support further work on code-mixed hallucination detection.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了包含5,674条印地语/英语/Hinglish问答数据的基准，对三个7-8B开源模型生成并标注17,022条回答，提取逐层隐藏状态训练线性与MLP探针，发现幻觉信号在语码混合下依然稳健（跨语言迁移AUROC 0.88-0.99），且印地语训练的探针迁移到Hinglish更为可靠。
AI.motivation: 隐藏状态幻觉探针（在LLM内部激活上训练线性分类器以判断生成答案是否忠实于输入）在2026年已成为活跃研究方向，在多个基准和语言上报告了0.90-1.00的AUROC。然而，现有工作均未在语码混合输入上测试探针，而大量聊天机器人用户使用印地语-英语混合文本（Hinglish）。因此本文直接针对这一空白提问：在纯语言隐藏状态上训练的幻觉探针能否迁移到Hinglish，还是信号会在语码混合下退化？
AI.method: 构建5,674条印地语/英语/Hinglish问答基准；使用三个开放权重7-8B模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Llama-3.1-8B）生成并标注17,022条模型回答；在两个token位置提取逐层隐藏状态；训练线性与MLP探针，用于分布内检测与跨语言迁移评估。
AI.result: 幻觉信号在语码混合下保持良好：迁移AUROC范围为0.88-0.99，与分布内性能的差距大多低于0.05 AUROC；印地语训练的探针比英语训练的探针更可靠地迁移到Hinglish。作为一个独立的、具有实际意义的发现，在匹配事实上，三个模型在印地语和Hinglish上的幻觉都显著多于英语。
AI.conclusion: 幻觉探针可有效跨语言迁移至Hinglish语码混合场景，其中印地语训练探针的迁移性更优；同时多语言模型在印地语与Hinglish上幻觉更严重，凸显了非英语场景下幻觉检测的必要性。作者公开代码与合成Hinglish问答数据集，以支持语码混合幻觉检测的后续研究。

title: Event-Frame Fusion for Inter-Frame Segmentation via Event-Guided Motion
summary: Autonomous navigation requires precise and efficient semantic segmentation, yet existing frame-based approaches remain limited by motion blur, glare, latency, and the low temporal resolution (20-30 FPS) of conventional cameras, which leads to information loss between frames. Event cameras have emerged as an alternative sensing modality, capturing intensity changes asynchronously with high temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and sparse outputs. However, event-based algorithms still fall short of frame-based ones in accuracy, as most segmentation methods are designed for dense frame data. To overcome these limitations, we propose a hybrid vision architecture that combines conventional frame-based and event-based cameras. The system integrates two complementary components: (1) a compact Spiking Neural Network (SNN) with 42k parameters for motion estimation, and (2) a lightweight event-driven SNN with 0.84M parameters for frame-based semantic segmentation, which interpolates motion between frames to refine segmentation results. By predicting inter-frame segmentations, the framework achieves segmentation rates of up to 500 Hz with an energy consumption below 1.87 mJ per inference, while maintaining real-time GPU execution at frequencies up to 200 Hz. Additionally, our approach compensates for information loss in frames affected by blur or overexposure, enabling more robust perception in challenging conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出帧-事件混合视觉架构，用两个轻量SNN分别做运动估计与语义分割插值，实现最高500 Hz分割、单次推理<1.87 mJ，并缓解模糊/过曝下的信息丢失。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需要精确高效的语义分割，但传统帧式相机受运动模糊、眩光、延迟及20-30 FPS低时间分辨率限制，帧间信息丢失；事件相机虽具高时间分辨率、高动态范围和稀疏输出优势，但现有事件分割算法精度仍不及帧式方法，因其多面向稠密帧数据设计。
AI.method: 提出融合帧式与事件相机的混合视觉架构，包含两个互补组件：(1) 42k参数的紧凑脉冲神经网络（SNN）用于运动估计；(2) 0.84M参数的轻量事件驱动SNN用于帧式语义分割，通过插值帧间运动来细化分割结果。
AI.result: 通过预测帧间分割，框架达到最高500 Hz的分割速率，单次推理能耗低于1.87 mJ，同时保持最高200 Hz的实时GPU执行频率；并能在模糊或过曝帧中补偿信息丢失。
AI.conclusion: 帧-事件混合架构结合轻量SNN，可在挑战性条件下实现高频率、低能耗且更鲁棒的语义分割，弥补帧式与事件式方法各自的不足。

title: A Survey on the Linear Representation Hypothesis
summary: The term "linear representation hypothesis" (LRH) has appeared across diverse subfields of artificial intelligence, neuroscience, and cognitive science. But previous works have not consistently treated the LRH as a falsifiable scientific hypothesis; we analyze these inconsistencies and examine their implications for how prior theoretical and methodological results should be interpreted. Based on this analysis, we argue that claims regarding linear representations become well-defined only through careful examination of the model, representation location, feature definition, and evaluation dataset. We therefore propose a more rigorous formalization of the LRH that makes these dependencies explicit and allows the hypothesis to be evaluated as a falsifiable scientific claim. Finally, we identify some non-trivial open problems that warrant further attention from the research community.

AI.tldr: 论文指出"线性表示假设"（LRH）此前未被一致地当作可证伪的科学假设，通过分析其不一致性，提出一个显式化模型、表示位置、特征定义与评估数据集依赖关系的严格形式化框架，并列出若干开放问题。
AI.motivation: LRH 已在人工智能、神经科学与认知科学等多个子领域出现，但既有工作未一致地将其视为可证伪的科学假设，导致理论与方法学结果在解释上存在歧义，因此有必要澄清这些不一致性并给出严格界定。
AI.method: 对现有文献中 LRH 的表述进行概念性分析与批判性梳理，指出其不一致之处及其对既有结果解释的影响；在此基础上提出一个更为严格的形式化定义，使模型、表示位置、特征定义与评估数据集这四个依赖要素显式化。
AI.result: 论证了关于线性表示的论断只有在明确模型、表示位置、特征定义和评估数据集之后才有确切含义；所提出的形式化使 LRH 可作为可证伪的科学主张被评估，并识别出若干非平凡的开放问题。
AI.conclusion: LRH 需从模糊的直觉性表述转变为依赖明确的、可证伪的科学假设；作者呼吁研究社区关注其所列举的开放问题，以推动该假设的系统性检验。

title: Using Composition Operators to Linearize LLM Semantic Transformations
summary: Machine learning learns functions: prompt to response, image to caption. What these functions are mathematically remains hard to say. We present a method to approximate these kinds of transformations using techniques from dynamical systems that fall under the umbrella of Koopmanism. We introduce the use of composition operators, which generalize the Koopman operator and, crucially, can map between distinct spaces, motivating the perspective that LLM transformations are rectangular infinite-dimensional operators. This formalism reveals useful structure: under natural assumptions on the prompt and response distributions, the LLM operator is an isometry, and misalignment between learned representations manifests as spectral pollution of its finite sections. We then outline a method of constructing finite-dimensional approximations of an LLM operator, and demonstrate how the singular value spectrum can be used to compare tasks and models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用Koopmanism中的复合算子来近似机器学习中的函数变换，证明LLM变换是矩形无穷维算子且为等距同构，并将表示不对齐表征为有限截断的谱污染。
AI.motivation: 机器学习本质是学习函数（如提示到回复、图像到描述），但这些函数在数学上难以刻画，缺乏统一的理论形式化工具。
AI.method: 引入动力系统Koopmanism框架下的复合算子，推广Koopman算子使其能在不同空间之间映射；将LLM变换建模为矩形无穷维算子，并在提示与响应分布的假设下分析其算子性质；构建LLM算子的有限维近似。
AI.result: 在自然假设下LLM算子为等距算子；学习表示间的不对齐表现为有限截断的谱污染；提出有限维近似构造方法，并展示可用奇异值谱来比较任务与模型。
AI.conclusion: 复合算子（矩形无穷维算子）为LLM变换提供了统一的数学形式化，等距性与谱污染揭示了有用结构，奇异值谱可作为任务与模型比较的分析工具。

title: Rethinking Vision Architectures with Gated Linear Attention and KAN
summary: Vision Transformers allocate most parameters to multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) for channel mixing, while token interactions usually rely on quadratic multi-head self-attention (MHSA). Linear attention reduces sequence complexity to O(N), but remains coupled with the same fixed-activation MLP as softmax Transformers. Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) instead place learnable univariate maps on edges, yet prior vision KANs keep MHSA or omit attention entirely. We introduce LKAT (Linear Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer), an isotropic ViT encoder that couples chunkwise Gated Linear Attention (GLA) with a two-layer KAN feed-forward, and we provide an I/O-aware fused RBF-KAN kernel for the radial-basis grid maps. Under a shared DeiT-style recipe we compare LKAT with ViT, ViT-5, and MLP-Mixer. LKAT-B exceeds ViT-B/16, ViT-5-B, and Mixer-B/16 on ImageNet-100. Tiny/Small/Base LKAT variants scale consistently on CIFAR-10/100, and ImageNet-100 pretraining transfers to CIFAR fine-tuning. The results support gated linear attention and KAN-based radial-basis functions as complementary inductive biases for mid-scale visual representation learning.

AI.tldr: LKAT是一种各向同性ViT编码器，将分块门控线性注意力（GLA）与两层KAN前馈网络耦合，并配有I/O感知融合RBF-KAN核，在中尺度视觉表征学习上优于ViT、ViT-5和MLP-Mixer。
AI.motivation: ViT将多数参数分配给用于通道混合的MLP，而token交互依赖二次复杂度的MHSA。线性注意力虽将复杂度降至O(N)，但仍沿用与softmax Transformer相同的固定激活MLP；KAN将可学习一元映射置于边上，但既有视觉KAN仍保留MHSA或完全省略注意力。因此需要一种兼具线性注意力与KAN前馈的互补归纳偏置架构。
AI.method: 提出LKAT（Linear Kolmogorov-Arnold Transformer），一种各向同性ViT编码器，将分块门控线性注意力（GLA）与两层KAN前馈网络耦合；并为径向基网格映射提供I/O感知的融合RBF-KAN核。
AI.result: 在共享DeiT风格训练配方下，LKAT-B在ImageNet-100上超过ViT-B/16、ViT-5-B和Mixer-B/16；Tiny/Small/Base变体在CIFAR-10/100上持续可扩展，且ImageNet-100预训练可迁移至CIFAR微调。
AI.conclusion: 门控线性注意力与基于KAN的径向基函数可作为互补归纳偏置，适用于中尺度视觉表征学习。

title: Building Trustworthy Mental Health Benchmarks on Bluesky: A Validation-Aware Weak-Supervision Framework
comment: This is the author's preprint version of a paper accepted for presentation at HICSS 60 (Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences), 2027, Hawaii, USA. The final published version will appear in the official conference proceedings. Conference site: https://hicss.hawaii.edu/
summary: Decentralized social media platforms create new opportunities and challenges for computational mental health research because data access, moderation, labeling, and deployment responsibilities are distributed across multiple technical and governance layers. This paper presents a validation-aware weak-supervision system for constructing and evaluating suicidal ideation (SI) and broader mental health (MH) disclosure benchmarks on Bluesky, a decentralized social media platform built on the AT Protocol. The system integrates public firehose collection, task-specific lexicon filtering, Llama-3-8B-assisted binary annotation, human-adjudicated validation subsets, and transformer-based model benchmarking. Using this pipeline, we construct two task-specific corpora containing 8,346 SI-labeled posts and 9,988 MH-labeled posts. The evaluation shows that model performance depends strongly on both task definition and validation protocol. BERT+LSTM achieves the highest SI stratified cross-validation F1-score, RoBERTa achieves the strongest SI holdout F1-score, and DistilRoBERTa achieves the best MH cross-validation F1-score. Human validation reveals different weak-label failure modes across tasks, with SI labels dominated by false negatives and MH labels dominated by false positives. These findings show that decentralized social media can support reproducible mental health benchmarking, but only when system design, label provenance, validation strategy, and deployment constraints are evaluated together.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个验证感知的弱监督系统，用于在去中心化社交平台Bluesky上构建并评估自杀意念（SI）与心理健康（MH）披露基准，强调标签来源、验证策略与部署约束需联合评估。
AI.motivation: 去中心化社交媒体的数据访问、审核、标注与部署责任分散于多个技术与治理层级，为计算心理健康研究带来新机遇与挑战，现有基准构建方法难以直接适用。
AI.method: 系统整合四部分：公共firehose数据采集、任务特定词典过滤、Llama-3-8B辅助二分类标注、人工裁决的验证子集，以及基于Transformer的模型基准测试。
AI.result: 构建了两个任务语料库，分别含8,346条SI标注帖与9,988条MH标注帖。模型表现强烈依赖任务定义与验证协议：BERT+LSTM取得最高SI分层交叉验证F1，RoBERTa取得最强SI留出F1，DistilRoBERTa取得最佳MH交叉验证F1。人工验证显示不同任务的弱标签失效模式不同：SI以假阴性为主，MH以假阳性为主。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化社交媒体可支持可复现的心理健康基准测试，但前提是系统设计、标签来源、验证策略与部署约束必须被共同评估。

title: Multilingual Safety Signals Are Multi-Layered: Filtering Safety-Degrading Data for Safer LLMs
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 16 pages, 11 figures
summary: Preserving safety alignment during large language models fine-tuning is critical, however, recent studies have demonstrated that even benign fine-tuning data may contain safety-degrading samples that silently undermine safety alignment. Existing approaches typically identify such samples using representations from a single safety-sensitive layer. While this assumption has shown effectiveness in monolingual settings, its validity for multilingual models remains unclear due to potential cross-lingual differences in representation patterns. Through a cross-lingual analysis, we show that sensitive layers are only partially shared across languages, with safety-relevant signals often distributed across multiple layers. Motivated by these observations, we propose MMSAFE, a multi-layer framework for multilingual safety-degrading data identification that captures both shared and language-specific safety signals. Extensive experiments across multiple models, languages, and safety benchmarks demonstrate that MMSAFE reduces the average harmful-response ratio by 60% compared with random filtering and achieves stronger average performance than the strongest single-layer baseline, demonstrating the effectiveness of multi-layer modeling for robust multilingual safety alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MMSAFE，一种面向多语言场景的多层安全退化数据识别框架，通过捕捉跨语言共享与语言特有的安全信号，有效缓解微调导致的安全对齐退化问题。
AI.motivation: 即使良性微调数据也可能包含隐性削弱安全对齐的样本。现有方法通常仅依赖单一"安全敏感层"的表征来识别此类样本，该假设在单语场景有效，但在多语言模型中因跨语言表征模式差异而有效性存疑。作者通过跨语言分析发现，敏感层仅部分共享，安全相关信号往往分布于多个层中。
AI.method: 先进行跨语言表征分析，验证敏感层跨语言仅部分共享、安全信号呈多层分布；据此提出MMSAFE多层框架，同时建模跨语言共享的安全信号与各语言特有的安全信号，用于识别多语言安全退化数据。
AI.result: 在多个模型、多种语言与多个安全基准上的大量实验表明，MMSAFE相比随机过滤将平均有害回复率降低60%，且平均性能优于最强的单层基线。
AI.conclusion: 多层建模对稳健的多语言安全对齐是有效的，跨语言共享与语言特有多层信号的联合建模优于单层假设。

title: AdaMerge: Tuning-Free Patch Compression for Multi-Vector Visual Document Retrieval
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as a short paper at ACM CIKM 2026
summary: Multi-vector visual document retrieval (VDR) models such as ColPali and ColNomic achieve strong accuracy by representing each document with hundreds to thousands of patch-level embeddings, at substantial storage and latency cost. Existing compression methods either prune unimportant patches or merge similar ones into clusters; the recent state-of-the-art merging method Prune-then-Merge (PtM) consistently outperforms pruning-only baselines at high compression, but requires a per-dataset cluster budget m to be tuned by grid search. We observe that the merge-cosine sequence produced by hierarchical clustering exhibits a sharp cliff separating mergeable redundancy from salient signal, and that the location of this cliff is concentrated in a narrow band across more than 11,000 documents from 14 datasets. This suggests the merge boundary can be detected per document rather than tuned per dataset. Building on this observation, we propose AdaMerge, a plug-and-play compression method that (i) detects each document's own cliff via gap analysis on the merge-cosine trajectory, and (ii) builds attention-weighted cluster centroids to preserve salient signal. On the long-document benchmark ViDoRe-V2 (4 datasets, two backbones), AdaMerge significantly outperforms tuned PtM across the operating range (p < 10^-4); on the short-document benchmark ViDoRe-V1 (10 datasets, two backbones), where all merging methods are already near-lossless, AdaMerge matches tuned PtM without any per-dataset tuning. AdaMerge adds only about 10 ms per document and exposes a single global hyperparameter shared across all datasets and backbones.

AI.tldr: AdaMerge是一种即插即用的多向量视觉文档检索压缩方法，通过逐文档检测层次聚类合并余弦序列中的"断崖"来自适应确定聚类数，替代按数据集网格搜索调参，在ViDoRe-V2上显著超越调优的PtM，在ViDoRe-V1上无调参即可匹配。
AI.motivation: 多向量VDR模型（如ColPali、ColNomic）用成百上千个patch级嵌入表示文档，存储与延迟开销大。现有压缩方法中，剪枝丢失信息，合并类方法中的SOTA——Prune-then-Merge（PtM）在高压缩率下优于纯剪枝基线，但需按数据集通过网格搜索调优聚类预算m，缺乏通用性且成本高。
AI.method: 作者观察到层次聚类产生的merge-cosine序列存在明显"断崖"，区分可合并冗余与显著信号，且在14个数据集、超过11,000篇文档中该断崖位置集中于窄带内，说明合并边界可按文档检测而非按数据集调参。据此提出AdaMerge：(i) 通过merge-cosine轨迹的gap分析检测每篇文档自身的断崖以确定聚类边界；(ii) 构建注意力加权的聚类质心以保留显著信号。方法即插即用，仅暴露一个跨数据集与骨干网络共享的全局超参数。
AI.result: 在长文档基准ViDoRe-V2（4个数据集、两种骨干网络）上，AdaMerge在整个工作区间显著优于调优的PtM（p < 10^-4）；在短文档基准ViDoRe-V1（10个数据集、两种骨干网络）上，所有合并方法已接近无损，AdaMerge在无任何按数据集调参的情况下匹配调优的PtM。每篇文档额外开销仅约10 ms。
AI.conclusion: merge-cosine断崖的跨数据集稳定性使合并边界可由文档自适应确定，AdaMerge据此实现了免按数据集调参、即插即用的压缩，在多数场景匹配或超越网格搜索调优的PtM，并保持极低的额外延迟。

title: Hapi: A Multivariable Land-Surface Transformer for Medium-Range Hydrological Forecasting at Continental Scale
summary: Accurate flood forecasts several days in advance are essential for flood control, water-resource management, and emergency response. Producing them at high resolution over a continental domain calls for local hydrological detail together with spatial context extending from river basins to synoptic weather systems. We developed Hapi, a U-Net Swin Transformer that uses fine three-dimensional patches and hierarchical shifted-window attention to forecast discharge, surface runoff, snow water equivalent, and soil wetness across the contiguous United States. The model produces 24--72-hour forecasts at $0.05^{\circ}$ resolution, with learned Laplacian task weights adjusting each variable's contribution to training. On 2024 test data using reconstructed weather and land-surface inputs from ERA5-Land, Hapi outperformed an operational physics-based model and a state-of-the-art AI model in flood detection. Independent validation against 3,881 U.S. Geological Survey gauges and a Hurricane Helene case study supported its advantage over the physics-based model in reproducing daily discharge. Controlled experiments showed that learned task weighting strengthens rare-flood detection, which is particularly sensitive to changes in precipitation inputs. Hapi produced a four-variable, 72-hour forecast across the contiguous United States with an average inference time of 0.11 seconds on a single A100 GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hapi模型，一种U-Net Swin Transformer，可在美国本土以0.05°分辨率、0.11秒推理速度实现72小时洪水预报，性能优于物理模型和现有AI模型。
AI.motivation: 提前数天的准确洪水预报对防洪、水资源管理和应急响应至关重要。大陆尺度高分辨率预报既需要局部水文细节，又需要从流域到天气系统的空间背景，传统方法难以兼顾。
AI.method: Hapi采用U-Net Swin Transformer架构，使用精细三维patch和层级移位窗口注意力，预测流量、地表径流、雪水当量和土壤湿度四个变量；采用可学习的Laplacian任务权重调节各变量对训练的贡献；输入基于ERA5-Land重建的气象与陆面数据。
AI.result: 在2024年测试数据上，Hapi在洪水检测方面优于业务物理模型和先进AI模型；经3881个USGS水文站独立验证及飓风案例研究，其在再现日流量方面优于物理模型；受控实验表明任务权重学习增强了稀有洪水检测能力；单张A100 GPU上实现全美四变量72小时预报，平均推理时间0.11秒。
AI.conclusion: Hapi通过结合局部细节与空间上下文的多任务Transformer架构，实现了高效、高分辨率的大陆尺度洪水预报，并在洪水检测与径流再现上超越现有方法。

title: Beyond the Stitching Assumption: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Synthetic Data Evaluation via Semantic Quantization
comment: 10 Pages, 2 figures, 4 tables, accepted to PST 2026
summary: Multimodal synthetic datasets combine structured attributes with free text, but are often evaluated separately. Such metrics can remain high after tabular--text pairings are disrupted. We present a projection-based evaluator for tabular--text synthetic data. A fixed sentence encoder maps text to embeddings, \(k\)-means converts them to cluster states, and tabular variables are represented as categorical or quantile-binned states. Real and synthetic contingency tables are compared using Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD), normalized mutual information (NMI), conditional JSD (cJSD), and joint-state entropy. We also report text-to-attribute (T2A) utility and a holdout-calibrated proximity flag rate (PFR) as a representation-level diagnostic. A text-permutation control preserves both marginal distributions while disrupting their pairing. Experiments on Amazon Reviews, Kiva Loans, and the Employment Scam Aegean Dataset show that modality-specific scores remain high under this control. The projection diagnostics detect disruption when real projected dependence exceeds a permutation baseline, but are less informative for weak or sparse projections. Some conditioned LLM baselines also exhibit stronger measured dependence than the corresponding real-data projections. These results support explicit cross-modal evaluation with permutation baselines and coverage reporting.

AI.tldr: 提出基于投影的表格-文本合成数据评估器：用固定句编码器+k-means将文本转为簇状态，表格变量离散化为类别/分位状态，通过JSD、NMI、条件JSD和联合熵比较真实与合成的列联表，并引入置换基线揭示单模态高分假象。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态合成数据评估通常对结构化属性与自由文本分别打分，导致表格-文本配对被破坏后指标仍保持高位，无法反映跨模态依赖是否真实保留。需要显式的跨模态评估方法。
AI.method: 1）固定句编码器将文本映射为嵌入，k-means离散化为簇状态；表格变量表示为类别状态或分位分箱状态，形成统一投影空间。2）在真实与合成的列联表上计算JSD、NMI、条件JSD（cJSD）与联合状态熵。3）报告文本到属性（T2A）效用及基于留出集校准的近邻标记率（PFR）作为表示层诊断。4）设计文本置换对照：保持两个边缘分布不变、仅破坏配对关系，作为置换基线。
AI.result: 在Amazon Reviews、Kiva Loans和Employment Scam Aegean数据集上，置换对照下各单模态分数依然很高；当真实投影依赖超过置换基线时，投影诊断能检测出配对破坏，但对弱投影或稀疏投影信息量有限。部分条件化LLM基线测得的相关性甚至强于对应的真实数据投影。
AI.conclusion: 应进行显式的跨模态评估，并配合置换基线与覆盖度报告；单模态指标不足以验证表格-文本对齐质量。

title: Beyond the Leaderboard: Counterfactual Diagnosis of End-to-End and VLA Driving Policies Under Domain Shift
summary: End-to-end and vision-language-action (VLA) driving policies are compared by leaderboard rank, but a rank reports an outcome, not the behaviour behind it, so it predicts poorly how a policy will behave at a new site. On six released policies, rank on nuScenes open-loop error or on NAVSIM's leaderboard does not carry over to scenes with a pedestrian near the ego corridor at a new site. We propose a counterfactual check-up: a few hundred real frames, each edited two ways (pedestrian removed, or re-lit by a night-style perturbation), every edit verified by an independent detector, and the change in the planned trajectory read as a diagnosis rather than a score. From these edits two causal axes are read, and five exams built on them separate what a score merges: how far the policy plans to drive, whether seeing the pedestrian buys safety, whether that response scales with danger, whether the plan moves when nothing requires it, and how much an irrelevant lighting change moves it. On 246 NAVSIM near-pedestrian scenes, in the cells where the pedestrian lies on the planned path only 1.9% of responses are genuine avoidance, and under our open-loop protocol the median clearance change is at most 0.03 m and the median change in planned distance at most 0.08 m for every policy. In a pre-registered test from left- to right-hand drive, the exposure and specificity orderings, the lighting verdict and the collision outcome transfer, while point values and the hazard-sensitivity verdict do not. Read as a selection report, the profiles say which policy is safe because it plans short, which covers a human-like distance without yielding, and which is unsteady under a change that requires no reaction, and they price each verdict: most settle within a few dozen frames, hazard sensitivity needs hundreds. Code and edited frames will be released.

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有端到端/VLA驾驶策略仅以排行榜排名比较，排名只反映结果而非行为，难以预测新场景表现；提出"反事实检查"诊断法，通过对真实帧做行人移除与夜间光照扰动并验证编辑，读取两条因果轴并构建五项考试，在NAVSIM近行人场景揭示多数策略缺乏真实避让，并在跨驾驶侧预注册测试中验证部分结论可迁移。
AI.motivation: 排行榜排名只报告结果，不揭示策略背后的行为机制，因此无法预测策略在换到新地点后的表现。在六个已发布策略上，nuScenes开环误差或NAVSIM排行榜的名次并不能迁移到新地点中有行人靠近自车走廊的场景。
AI.method: 提出反事实检查：选取数百帧真实画面，每帧做两种编辑（移除行人、夜间风格重光照），每次编辑由独立检测器验证；把规划轨迹的变化当作诊断而非评分。由此读取两条因果轴，并基于它们设计五项考试：计划行驶距离、看到行人是否换来安全、该响应是否随危险程度缩放、在无需反应时计划是否移动、无关光照变化的扰动幅度。
AI.result: 在246个NAVSIM近行人场景中，行人位于计划路径上的单元里仅1.9%的响应为真实避让；在开环协议下，各策略的间隙变化中位数至多0.03 m，计划距离变化中位数至多0.08 m。在左舵到右舵的预注册测试中，暴露度与特异性排序、光照结论与碰撞结果可迁移，而具体数值与危险敏感性结论不可迁移。
AI.conclusion: 以选择报告的方式阅读，这些画像能说明哪个策略因计划短而安全、哪个覆盖了类人距离却不让行、哪个在无需反应的变化下不稳，并为每个结论标价：多数在几十帧内稳定，危险敏感性需数百帧。代码与编辑帧将公开。

title: Trustworthy Agentic AI: Failure Modes, Mitigation Strategies, and a Lifecycle Framework for Autonomous LLM Systems
summary: Agentic AI systems built on large language models can plan over multiple steps, use external tools, retain information in memory, and coordinate with other agents. These capabilities make them more useful than static language models, but they also introduce new security and operational risks. Untrusted content from websites, emails, documents, and databases can enter the same context as system instructions; persistent memory can carry compromised information across sessions; and access to external tools can turn an incorrect model response into a consequential real-world action. This article reviews the trustworthiness of agentic AI across five interconnected dimensions: safety and robustness, alignment and human oversight, transparency and auditability, privacy and data governance, and regulatory compliance. It organizes key failure modes, including indirect prompt injection, backdoor triggers, goal misgeneralization, memory contamination, and cross-session data leakage, into a unified taxonomy. It also examines major mitigation approaches, such as instruction hierarchies, context isolation, spotlighting, process-based supervision, constrained tool use, and privacy-preserving memory, while distinguishing techniques supported by empirical evidence from those that remain largely conceptual. Building on this analysis, we introduce the Trustworthy Agent Development Lifecycle (TADL), a six-phase framework covering specification, design, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring. For each phase, TADL identifies relevant trust activities, expected evidence, and risk-based decision gates. Although TADL has not yet been empirically validated, it provides a structured foundation for developing and evaluating more secure and accountable agentic systems. The article concludes by identifying gaps in current benchmarks and outlining priorities for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了基于大语言模型的智能体AI（Agentic AI）的可信性问题，围绕安全鲁棒性、对齐与人类监督、透明度与可审计性、隐私与数据治理、合规五个维度建立失效模式统一分类，梳理缓解技术并区分实证与概念性方法，提出六阶段可信智能体开发生命周期（TADL）框架，并指出基准缺口与未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI具备多步规划、调用外部工具、持久记忆与多智能体协作能力，比静态语言模型更实用，但引入了新的安全与运维风险：不可信内容（网页、邮件、文档、数据库）可与系统指令进入同一上下文，持久记忆可跨会话携带被污染信息，外部工具访问可将错误响应转化为有实际后果的现实行动。现有研究缺乏对智能体AI可信性的统一梳理，需建立统一分类与开发生命周期框架。
AI.method: 采用综述方法，从五个相互关联维度（安全与鲁棒性、对齐与人类监督、透明度与可审计性、隐私与数据治理、监管合规）审视智能体AI可信性；将间接提示注入、后门触发、目标错误泛化、记忆污染、跨会话数据泄露等关键失效模式组织为统一分类法；考察指令层级、上下文隔离、spotlighting、基于过程的监督、受限工具使用、隐私保护记忆等缓解方法，并区分有实证支持的与仍属概念性的技术；在此基础上提出六阶段可信智能体开发生命周期（TADL）框架，涵盖规范、设计、训练、评估、部署、监控，每阶段给出可信活动、预期证据与基于风险的决策门。
AI.result: 建立了涵盖五维度可信性与主要失效模式的统一分类法；区分了缓解技术中具实证支持与仍属概念性的部分；提出TADL六阶段框架，为各阶段定义可信活动、预期证据与风险决策门；识别出当前基准的缺口并列出未来研究优先事项。TADL尚未经实证验证。
AI.conclusion: 智能体AI的可信性需从多维度、全生命周期系统治理，统一分类法与TADL为开发更安全、更可问责的智能体系统提供结构化基础，但其有效性仍有待实证检验；未来研究应聚焦基准建设与关键缺口填补。

title: Do Language Models Know Their Own Constraints?
summary: We ask whether behavioral constraints acquired through post training remain explicitly reportable. Using constrained recipe generation as a testbed, five banned ingredients enforced via LoRA fine tuning of Llama 3.1 8B Instruct we compare supervised fine tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) against an untrained baseline on a four tier Constraint Awareness Benchmark.
