Guided by observed optimization behavior, the LLM then refines, recombines, and explores coupled PINN design components, forming a continual cycle of generation, execution, feedback, and evolution. Unlike one-shot search or evaluation-only feedback, PINNsForge progressively converts training experience into improved design decisions for the target PDE. Across 25 PDE benchmarks, PINNsForge achieves the lowest mean MSE on 24 tasks compared with RoPINN, PINNsFormer, and PINNsAgent. Ablation studies further confirm the importance of the PDE knowledge base, execution feedback, and evolutionary search: removing these components increases the mean MSE to 3.74$\times$, 12.10$\times$, and 10.10$\times$ that of the full PINNsForge, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出PINNsForge，一种基于LLM驱动进化、利用执行反馈的自动化PINN设计框架，在25个PDE基准上24项取得最低MSE。
AI.motivation: PINN需在网络表示、采样、损失构造与优化上协同选择，且有效配置在不同PDE间差异大。现有自动化设计方法虽能搜索候选配置，但训练中产生的信息主要用于评估而非指导后续设计，导致重复试错、训练预算利用低效。
AI.method: PINNsForge从PDE相关先验知识生成多样化候选配置，通过实际训练评估，并将高性能设计与累积的执行证据回馈给LLM；LLM依据观察到的优化行为，对耦合的PINN设计组件进行精炼、重组与探索，形成"生成—执行—反馈—进化"的持续循环。
AI.result: 在25个PDE基准上，PINNsForge在24个任务上取得最低平均MSE，优于RoPINN、PINNsFormer和PINNsAgent。消融研究显示，移除PDE知识库、执行反馈和进化搜索后，平均MSE分别增至完整PINNsForge的3.74倍、12.10倍和10.10倍。
AI.conclusion: 不同于一次性搜索或仅用于评估的反馈，PINNsForge将训练经验逐步转化为面向目标PDE的改进设计决策；消融结果证实PDE知识库、执行反馈与进化搜索三者均是关键组成部分。

title: Evaluating Personal Information Output from Conversational Interactions in Generative AI Systems
comment: Accepted at the 19th IIAI International Congress on Advanced Applied Informatics (IIAI-AAI 2026)
summary: This exploratory pilot study evaluates the scope and perceived accuracy of personal information output from ongoing conversational interactions in generative AI systems using GPT-5.2 Instant and GPT-5.2 Thinking, categorized into three output types: Fact, Inference, and Confidence. Based on the evaluation results obtained from 15 Japanese participants, differences in model design have limited impact on personal information output tendencies. Compared with the Inference type, the Fact type shows a more conservative output pattern. Regarding attribute categories, the findings indicate that Core Personal attributes associated with identification are treated relatively conservatively, whereas Behavioral and Linguistic attributes show higher accuracy across both Fact and Inference outputs. Furthermore, Holistic Profile, Psychological and Cognitive, and Residual attributes are more readily inferred, even when not supported by explicit factual outputs. Notably, the lack of null outputs for these attributes in the Inference type suggests that such inferred profiles may be constructed from indirectly available contextual information. The findings may contribute to future discussions regarding privacy awareness and personal information inference in generative AI systems.

AI.tldr: 该探索性试点研究评估了GPT-5.2 Instant与GPT-5.2 Thinking在持续对话中输出个人信息的范围与感知准确性，将输出分为事实、推断与置信三类；基于15名日本参与者的结果发现，模型设计差异影响有限，事实类输出更保守，核心身份属性较保守，行为与语言属性准确性较高，而整体画像、心理认知与残余属性更易被推断，即使缺乏显式事实支持。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI系统在持续对话中会积累并输出用户个人信息，涉及隐私风险，但学界对模型设计差异、输出类型及属性类别如何影响个人信息输出的范围与准确性尚缺乏系统评估，因此作者开展此探索性试点研究以厘清输出倾向并为隐私意识讨论提供依据。
AI.method: 采用探索性试点设计，使用GPT-5.2 Instant与GPT-5.2 Thinking两个模型进行持续对话交互，将个人信息输出划分为事实（Fact）、推断（Inference）、置信（Confidence）三类；招募15名日本参与者进行评价，并区分核心个人属性与行为、语言、整体画像、心理认知及残余等属性类别，比较输出范围与感知准确性。
AI.result: 模型设计差异对个人信息输出倾向影响有限；与推断类相比，事实类呈现更保守的输出模式；核心个人属性（与身份识别相关）处理相对保守，而行为与语言属性在事实和推断输出中均准确性较高；整体画像、心理认知与残余属性更易被推断，即便缺乏显式事实输出支持；推断类中这些属性未出现空输出，表明其可能基于间接可得的上下文信息构建。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果可为生成式AI系统中隐私意识与个人信息推断的未来讨论提供参考，提示模型设计并非决定性因素，且某些属性存在基于上下文的隐性推断风险。

title: C$^{2}$-INR: Customized Convolutional Implicit Neural Representation
summary: Implicit Neural Representation (INR) leverages neural networks to represent discrete signals such as images as continuous ones, where the network weights serve as a compact form of the signal itself. Most existing INR methods adopt Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) as their backbone. Since these models render each pixel independently, they inherently fail to exploit the spatial correlations that exist between neighboring pixels. In contrast,convolutional INRs can process pixels in parallel while inherently accounting for inter-pixel dependencies, making them a more natural fit for representing images. Nevertheless, convolutional INRs remain relatively underexplored, and the majority of them rely on fixed architectural settings, leaving little room for image-specific adaptation. In this paper, we investigate network customization for convolutional INRs. We replace conventional filters with irregular directional kernels, whose allocation is guided by the directional energy in the image spectrum, i.e., directions exhibiting stronger energy are assigned a larger number of kernels, enabling content-tailored convolution settings. These kernels are further reformulated via an orthogonal basis to achieve a superior sparse representation. Moreover, we introduce an annealed Gumbel-Softmax-based mechanism for kernel-level activation function selection, which gives the most suitable activation function for each convolution kernel. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method, namely C$^{2}$-INR, achieves superior performance against state-of-the-art approaches under comparable parameter budgets across a wide range of image processing tasks, including representation, inpainting, and super-resolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 C$^{2}$-INR，一种面向卷积式隐式神经表示的网络定制方法：用图像频谱方向能量引导的不规则方向核替代常规卷积核，并以正交基重构实现稀疏表示，同时引入退火 Gumbel-Softmax 进行核级激活函数选择。在表示、修复、超分等任务上于相近参数量下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 INR 多采用 MLP，逐像素独立渲染，无法利用相邻像素间的空间相关性；卷积式 INR 虽可并行处理并建模像素间依赖，但研究较少，且多使用固定架构设定，缺乏针对具体图像的自适应能力。
AI.method: 1) 以不规则方向核替换传统卷积核，核的分配由图像频谱中的方向能量引导：能量更强的方向分配更多核，实现内容定制化卷积配置；2) 将这些核用正交基重构，获得更优的稀疏表示；3) 引入基于退火 Gumbel-Softmax 的核级激活函数选择机制，为每个卷积核匹配最合适的激活函数。
AI.result: 在表示、图像修复（inpainting）和超分辨率等广泛图像处理任务上、在可比的参数预算下，C$^{2}$-INR 均取得优于当前最先进方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过方向核定制、正交基稀疏重构与核级激活函数自适应选择，卷积式 INR 的架构可针对图像内容进行有效定制，从而在多种图像处理任务中以相近参数量获得更优表现。

title: Spatial-Interactor: Learning Spatial Reasoning through Interaction with the Observable Physical World
summary: Spatial reasoning is essential for vision-language models (VLMs) to understand and act in the physical world. Reasoning in dynamic environments requires VLMs to perceive local state transitions caused by object motion and viewpoint changes and integrate them over long trajectories to maintain an updated spatial state, yet existing VLMs remain limited in both capabilities. Current spatial training primarily focuses on static questions about object attributes and spatial relations, providing limited direct supervision for state transitions; in contrast, interaction trajectories naturally connect a preceding observation, an action, and a subsequent observation, offering direct supervision for local state transitions, while complete trajectories reveal dependencies among consecutive transitions. We therefore introduce Spatial-Interactor, a framework that trains VLMs to model physical-world state transitions through interaction, organizing this learning process into a three-level curriculum covering L1 passive world-state transitions, L2 active self-state transitions, and L3 long-horizon interaction trajectories. Accordingly, we construct the Learning from Spatial Interaction dataset (LSI-108K) from simulated and real interaction trajectories, with tasks aligned with the objective of each level. Our two-stage training strategy applies Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to L1 and L2 for local transition modeling, and On-Policy Distillation (OPD) then uses privileged self-distillation: a teacher branch given segment-level transition descriptions supervises the student's on-policy CoT, helping the student learn to integrate consecutive transitions over L3 long trajectories. Experiments across multiple VLMs and spatial benchmarks show consistent gains in local transition modeling and long-horizon integration.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Spatial-Interactor 框架，通过交互轨迹训练视觉语言模型建模物理世界状态转移，构建三级课程与 LSI-108K 数据集，采用 SFT + 在线策略蒸馏的两阶段训练，在多个空间基准上取得一致的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 空间推理是 VLM 理解并作用于物理世界的关键能力。动态环境中的推理要求模型感知由物体运动与视角变化引起的局部状态转移，并在长轨迹上整合以维持更新的空间状态，但现有 VLM 在这两方面均受限。当前空间训练主要聚焦于关于物体属性和空间关系的静态问题，对状态转移缺乏直接监督；而交互轨迹天然连接"前一观测—动作—后一观测"，为局部状态转移提供直接监督，完整轨迹还能揭示连续转移间的依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出 Spatial-Interactor 框架，将学习过程组织为三级课程：L1 被动世界状态转移、L2 主动自身状态转移、L3 长时程交互轨迹。基于仿真与真实交互轨迹构建 LSI-108K 数据集，任务与各层级目标对齐。训练采用两阶段策略：先用 SFT 对 L1、L2 进行局部转移建模；再用在线策略蒸馏（OPD）进行特权自蒸馏——教师分支获得片段级转移描述，监督学生的在线策略思维链，从而帮助学生学会在 L3 长轨迹上整合连续转移。
AI.result: 在多种 VLM 与多个空间基准上的实验表明，模型在局部状态转移建模和长时程整合两方面均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过交互轨迹驱动的三级课程与 SFT+OPD 两阶段训练，能够有效提升 VLM 对物理世界状态转移的建模能力及其长时程空间状态整合能力。

title: Dissecting Training-Free Uncertainty Estimation in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of multimodal tasks, yet understanding and quantifying their predictive uncertainty remains underexplored despite being central for safety critical applications. In this work, we present a systematic study of training-free uncertainty quantification strategies for MLLMs, categorizing existing approaches into three conceptual families: token-level methods, which operate directly in the text output space; verbalized methods, which elicit uncertainty estimates or abstention signals via natural language prompts; and semantic methods, which measure uncertainty in a semantic meaning space. We benchmark these strategies across multiple datasets, model families, generations, and scales, and find that no single family dominates: token-level entropy (at sampling temperature 1.0) wins on short answers, verbalized abstention on sentence-length responses, and semantic methods on long-form generation.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究MLLM的免训练不确定性量化，将其分为token级、语言化、语义三类方法，并在多数据集、多模型上基准测试，发现无单一方法占优：token级熵适合短答案、语言化弃答适合句子级、语义方法适合长文本生成。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLM）在各类多模态任务上表现优异，但其预测不确定性尚未被充分理解和量化，而这对于安全关键应用至关重要。
AI.method: 提出对MLLM免训练不确定性量化策略的系统性研究，将现有方法划分为三个概念家族：token级方法（直接在文本输出空间操作）、语言化方法（通过自然语言提示引出不确定性估计或弃答信号）、语义方法（在语义意义空间度量不确定性）；并在多个数据集、模型家族、不同代际与规模上进行基准测试。
AI.result: 没有单一的家族占据主导地位：在采样温度1.0下的token级熵在短答案上表现最佳；语言化弃答在句子长度响应上最优；语义方法在长文本生成上表现最好。
AI.conclusion: 不同不确定性量化策略各有所长，其有效性取决于任务输出形态与长度，实际应用中需根据具体生成场景选择相应方法。

title: SatOV: Restoring Spatial Priors for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation in Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVS) of remote sensing imagery is a challenging pixel-level task requiring strong generalization and adaptation to the spatial characteristics of remote sensing data. Although existing vision-language foundation models perform well in general domains, their image-level classification design weakens the spatial priors needed for high-resolution remote sensing segmentation: structural spatial relations are degraded during deep feature transformation, and fine-grained spatial details are lost during downsampling. To address these complementary deficiencies, we propose SatOV, a training-free framework for open-vocabulary remote sensing segmentation that restores spatial priors at two stages of the representation pipeline. Specifically, Residual QQ Attention (ResQQ) extracts Query-Key self-attention from an intermediate CLIP layer and fuses it with final-layer Query-Query attention via a residual combination, restoring structural spatial priors suppressed by the final-layer representation. Spatially Modulated Upsampling (SatUp) uses the original high-resolution RGB image as spatial guidance, combining spatial feature modulation with guided cross-attention to reconstruct pixel-level textures and boundaries. Extensive experiments on DOTA, UDD, LoveDA, and Vaihingen show that SatOV consistently improves training-free OVS and achieves competitive quantitative and qualitative results against state-of-the-art methods. These results validate the effectiveness of restoring spatial priors at both the representation and spatial-resolution stages for remote sensing open-vocabulary segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架SatOV，通过恢复空间先验提升遥感图像开放词汇语义分割性能。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像的开放词汇语义分割（OVS）是像素级任务，需要强泛化能力并适应遥感数据的空间特性。现有视觉-语言基础模型在通用领域表现良好，但其图像级分类设计削弱了高分辨率遥感分割所需的空间先验：深层特征变换中结构空间关系被退化，下采样过程中细粒度空间细节丢失。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架SatOV，在表示流程的两个阶段恢复空间先验。其一，Residual QQ Attention（ResQQ）从CLIP中间层提取Query-Key自注意力，与最终层Query-Query注意力以残差方式融合，恢复被最终层表示抑制的结构性空间先验。其二，Spatially Modulated Upsampling（SatUp）以原始高分辨率RGB图像作为空间引导，结合空间特征调制与引导式交叉注意力，重建像素级纹理与边界。
AI.result: 在DOTA、UDD、LoveDA和Vaihingen数据集上开展大量实验，SatOV持续改进免训练OVS，并在定量与定性结果上与当前最优方法具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了在表示阶段与空间分辨率阶段同时恢复空间先验，对遥感开放词汇分割的有效性。

title: Enforcing Narrative Reliability and Epistemic Pacing in LLM-Driven Detective Games via Structured Knowledge Trees
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) enable open-ended dialogue in interactive games, but their non-deterministic outputs make it difficult to preserve authorial control, factual consistency, and the intended sequence of information disclosure. These challenges are particularly significant in detective games, where premature revelation or fabricated details can undermine the logic of player progression. We present a Structured Knowledge Tree architecture coupled with a tri-agent LLM pipeline for controlling dialogue in an open-ended interrogation game. The system separates knowledge retrieval, dialogue generation, and response verification to ensure that the virtual suspect reveals only information permitted by the current narrative state. We evaluate the approach through The Interrogation of Adrian Gale, a playable detective-game testbed, and a formal user study examining hallucination reduction, adherence to authored disclosure sequences, and perceived logical progression. Our results demonstrate that the structured architecture reduces critical hallucinations by 64.78% and entirely prevents premature narrative disclosure. While the strict mechanical constraints introduced usability trade-offs regarding forced conversational reveals, the system successfully enforces rigorous epistemic pacing and provides players with a clear, subjective sense of progression toward solving the case.

AI.tldr: 提出结构化知识树架构与三智能体LLM管线，用于开放审讯游戏中的对话控制，实现仅按叙事状态授权披露信息，减少幻觉并防止提前泄密。
AI.motivation: LLM支持交互游戏开放式对话，但其非确定性输出难以保持作者控制权、事实一致性与既定的信息披露顺序；在侦探游戏中，过早揭示或虚构细节会破坏玩家推进的逻辑。
AI.method: 采用结构化知识树架构，并配合三智能体LLM管线，将知识检索、对话生成与回复验证分离，确保虚拟嫌疑人只披露当前叙事状态允许的信息。以可玩侦探游戏测试平台《The Interrogation of Adrian Gale》进行验证，并开展正式用户研究，考察幻觉削减、对作者设定披露顺序的遵循度及感知逻辑推进。
AI.result: 结构化架构将关键幻觉减少64.78%，并完全防止叙事内容的提前披露；严格的机械约束在强制对话揭示方面带来了可用性权衡，但系统成功实现了严格的认知节奏控制，并让玩家对破案进程产生清晰的主观推进感。
AI.conclusion: 该结构化知识树与三智能体验证管线能够有效约束LLM在侦探审讯类游戏中的信息披露，兼顾事实一致性、作者控制与玩家推进体验，但需权衡机械约束带来的可用性问题。

title: Replicating the Geometry of Emotion Representations in a Base Open-Weights Model
summary: Sofroniew et al. (2026) report that emotion concepts in Claude Sonnet 4.5 are represented as vectors whose geometry mirrors human affect psychology. We replicate the representational core of that study on the base pretrained model google/gemma-2-27b, inheriting every disclosed parameter, resolving unspecified steps by disclosed rules, and changing only the subject model. From 205,200 newly generated Claude Sonnet 4.5 stories matching the original corpus design, we extract 171 emotion vectors and recover the core results. The leading principal components form an affective circumplex (PC1 carries 26.7% of variance against the original study's ~27%, PC2 13.4% against ~14%), emotions cluster into similar intuitive families, and the geometry holds across a broad late-middle band. The valence axis aligns with human norms (r = 0.72, against 0.81) and is stable across scales and depth. Arousal aligns at r = 0.67 (against 0.66) but only at the full 171-emotion scale and late depth, so we do not classify it as replicated. Extending the original analysis, a 46-layer sweep locates a sharp seam at L22-26, where the geometry consolidates and the vocabulary readout becomes legible. An embedding-layer baseline finds much of the geometry already present in the static token embeddings, with arousal as the exception. On top-activating held-out text, the geometry predicts token-level co-activation at r = 0.907. At least 52% of vectors peak on structurally non-conceptual tokens, a measured floor for max-activation confounds. Even when a document contains the vector's emotion word, the peak lands on that word only 6.1% of the time. Because the subject is a base model and the stimuli are Claude-generated fiction, the recovered structure is a property of the pretrained representation of Claude-rendered emotion. The original's causal and assistant-facing analyses are out of scope. Code and data are released.

AI.tldr: 在基座模型 google/gemma-2-27b 上复现 Sofroniew et al. (2026) 关于 Claude Sonnet 4.5 情绪概念表征的核心结果，仅更换被试模型，成功复现情感环状几何结构，但唤醒度轴未达复现标准。
AI.motivation: 检验原研究中情绪概念向量几何是否稳健、是否依赖于特定模型，通过对基座模型 gemma-2-27b 进行可复现的独立复制来验证其表征核心的普适性。
AI.method: 沿用原文所有已披露参数与规则，仅将被试模型替换为 gemma-2-27b；用 205,200 篇符合原语料设计的新生成故事提取 171 个情绪向量；做主成分分析、跨规模与深度稳定性检验；扩展进行 46 层扫描、嵌入层基线、top-activating 文本共激活预测及峰值 token 混淆分析。
AI.result: 前两个主成分构成情感环状结构（PC1 26.7% vs 原文约 27%，PC2 13.4% vs 约 14%），情绪聚类为直观家族，几何在晚中段广泛深度带成立；效价轴对齐人类常模 r=0.72（原文 0.81），唤醒度 r=0.67（原文 0.66）但仅在完整 171 情绪规模与较晚深度成立，故不判定为复现；L22-26 处存在几何固化的明显断层；静态词嵌入已含大部分几何；top-activating 文本上几何预测 token 级共激活 r=0.907；至少 52% 向量峰值落在结构性非概念 token，峰值命中情绪词仅 6.1%。
AI.conclusion: 基座模型可复现原研究表征核心，所恢复结构是预训练表征对 Claude 渲染情绪的性质，而非助手微调产物；原文因果与面向助手部分不在复现范围，代码与数据已公开。

title: LINGO: Latent Initialization and Gradient Optimization for Sparse-view X-ray Novel View Synthesis and CT Reconstruction with 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: In novel view synthesis and Computed Tomography (CT) reconstruction with sparse-view X-ray imaging, insufficient angular coverage leads to structural ambiguity and accumulated noise. Integrating 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with X-ray absorption physics can achieve promising results, but it suffers from noisy initialization, positional insensitivity, and weak gradients in low-density regions. In this paper, we propose a unified Latent Initialization and Gradient Optimization (LINGO) framework to address these issues. LINGO combines latent mask-space initialization with dynamic gradient optimization to improve point cloud structural completeness while accelerating training. It constructs voxel-level 3D filters from X-ray masks to robustly suppress background noise and provide reliable geometric priors. By employing an adaptive voxel scaling strategy and dynamically scaling loss, LINGO can adjust spatial resolution and explicitly amplify gradients in low-density structures. To evaluate the quality of initialization, we introduce the Initialization Point Cloud Structural Deviation (IPSD) metric. Experiments on the X3D dataset indicate that for the novel view synthesis task, LINGO improves the Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) and Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) by an average of 0.72 and 0.0039, respectively, over baselines under identical sparse-view settings, achieving comparable reconstruction quality within 5k steps to state-of-the-art models typically trained with 30k iterations. For the CT reconstruction task, LINGO also demonstrates consistent improvements, with average PSNR and SSIM gains of 0.36 and 0.0134. These results highlight LINGO's effectiveness in both accelerating training and enhancing reconstruction quality across different sparse-view imaging scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的潜在初始化与梯度优化框架LINGO，解决3DGS结合X射线吸收物理在稀疏视角成像中的初始化噪声、位置不敏感和低密度区梯度弱问题，在新视角合成与CT重建任务上提升质量并加速训练。
AI.motivation: 在新视角合成与稀疏视角X射线CT重建中，角度覆盖不足导致结构歧义和噪声累积；将3DGS与X射线吸收物理结合虽有效，但存在初始化噪声大、位置不敏感、低密度区域梯度弱的问题。
AI.method: LINGO结合潜在掩膜空间初始化与动态梯度优化；从X射线掩膜构建体素级3D滤波器以抑制背景噪声并提供几何先验；采用自适应体素缩放策略和动态缩放损失，调整空间分辨率并放大低密度结构梯度；提出初始化点云结构偏差(IPSD)指标评估初始化质量。
AI.result: 在X3D数据集上，新视角合成任务中PSNR和SSIM平均提升0.72和0.0039，5k步达到SOTA模型30k迭代的可比质量；CT重建任务中PSNR和SSIM平均提升0.36和0.0134。
AI.conclusion: LINGO在稀疏视角成像场景中既能加速训练又能提升重建质量，具有跨任务有效性。

title: LazyAgent: Demand-Driven Materialization and Physical Optimization of Agentic Programs
summary: Current agent runtimes that plan before acting generally execute a step once it becomes ready. We present LazyAgent, a unified execution framework for agent-authored programs organized around a live, goal-derived demanded set. LazyAgent refreshes a backward closure from requested outputs as execution state changes and materializes a ready node only when the active goal requires it. This replaces repeated local judgments with one linear-time graph analysis followed by constant-time membership tests, allowing programs to remain broad while execution stays request-specific. On programs that describe more than the current request needs, LazyAgent consistently outperforms the strongest goal-stopping eager baseline by refusing unrelated work before it starts. Adding one unrelated product raises the eager bill by 22.5% and LazyAgent's by 0.0%. LazyAgent saves 42.0% of measured CPU on production scientific workflows and 51.7% of container time on a live release gate spanning four repositories. We also prove and verify exact equivalence when the request reaches the whole graph, leaving no unrelated work to avoid. Beyond permission, goal-relative output projection saves up to approximately 90% of a shared step on two third-party test suites while the identical eager control saves 0.0%; the advantage disappears when the omitted output has no other consumer or the request needs it. Ordering, reuse, and pruning can also save cost, but do not replace permission. Finally, we show that current public benchmarks are eager-shaped and contain almost no unrequested work. A pre-registered planning intervention did not broaden them. These findings motivate benchmarks built from standing programs and sequences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LazyAgent——一种围绕"活跃目标导出的需求集"组织的智能体程序统一执行框架：通过一次线性时间图分析加常数时间成员测试，在节点真正被当前请求需要时才物化，从而在源头拒绝无关工作，避免"先规划后执行"运行时的一步就绪即执行。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体运行时先规划后执行，节点一旦就绪便执行，导致程序描述范围广于当前请求时产生大量无关工作；同时作者怀疑现有公开基准本身是"急切型"的、几乎不含未请求工作，故需一种按请求裁剪执行的机制与相应基准。
AI.method: LazyAgent 维护由目标推导出的"需求集"，随执行状态变化刷新从被请求输出出发的后向闭包，仅当活跃目标需要时才物化就绪节点。该机制用一次线性时间的整图分析替代反复的局部判断，之后以常数时间做成员测试，使程序保持宽泛而执行保持请求特定。
AI.result: 在描述超出当前请求所需的程序上，LazyAgent 稳定优于最强的"目标停止"急切基线：增加一个无关产物使急切基线开销上升 22.5%，而 LazyAgent 变化为 0.0%；在生产科学工作流上节省 42.0% 实测 CPU，在跨四个仓库的发布门禁上节省 51.7% 容器时间。在第三方测试套件上，目标相对输出投影最多节省约 90% 的共享步骤，而相同急切对照为 0.0%；当被省略输出无其他消费者或请求本身需要它时，该优势消失。此外，排序、复用与剪枝也能省成本，但不能替代"许可"机制；作者证明并验证了当请求覆盖整图时两者精确等价。作者还发现现有公开基准呈急切形态、几乎不含未请求工作，且一项预注册的规划干预未能使其变得更宽泛。
AI.conclusion: 按请求（目标相对）裁剪执行能显著降低无关工作与成本，但其收益以"程序描述多于请求所需"为前提；排序、复用、剪枝等手段无法替代权限式的按需物化。由于现有公开基准为急切形态且难以通过规划干预拓宽，作者呼吁构建基于常备程序与序列的新基准。

title: Schematize: An Agentic System for Generating and Refining Information-Extraction Schemas for Legal Research
summary: Empirical legal research often relies on turning research questions into structured data extracted from large collections of rulings and judgments. Designing the extraction schema and then extracting the data remain a manual, expertise-heavy bottleneck. We present schematize, an open-source multi-agent system that interactively turns a researcher's problem statement into a validated extraction schema that can later be used for autonomous extraction. Schematize couples (i) a clarification dialogue that elicits implicit expert intent, (ii) iterative schema generation, (iii) data-grounded refinement that tests the schema against documents, and (iv) chat-based post-editing. We evaluated the system with human legal professional, introducing our novel methodology, and schematize achieves top performance in most of tested configurations. While the system is designed to be domain-agnostic and applicable to any document collection, we tailor and evaluate it on legal research problems. We release schematize as a pip-installable Python package with full documentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 schematize——一个开源多智能体系统，可将法律研究者的"问题陈述"交互式转化为经过验证的抽取模式（schema），用于后续自主信息抽取。系统结合澄清对话、迭代式模式生成、数据驱动的模式精炼与基于聊天的后编辑四种机制。以法律专业人士为对象评估，在多数测试配置下取得最佳表现。系统可作为 pip 安装的 Python 包发布。
AI.motivation: 实证法律研究常需将研究问题转化为从大量裁判文书中抽取的结构化数据。其中"设计抽取模式"与"执行抽取"两个环节仍是依赖人工、高度专业密集的瓶颈。作者希望将这一过程自动化、交互化，以降低对专家经验的依赖。
AI.method: 提出 schematize，一个域无关的开源多智能体系统，包含四个耦合组件：(i) 澄清对话，用于引出研究者未明说的专家意图；(ii) 迭代式模式生成；(iii) 数据驱动的精炼，通过将模式与真实文书对照测试来修正；(iv) 基于聊天的后编辑。评估在法律研究场景下进行，并引入了新的评估方法。
AI.result: 在人类法律专业人士参与的评估中，schematize 在多数测试配置下取得最佳表现（top performance）。
AI.conclusion: 系统设计为域无关，可适用于任意文档集合，但本文在法律研究问题上做了定制与评估。系统以 pip 可安装的 Python 包形式开源发布，并附完整文档，便于研究者复现和使用。

title: Image Frame Dynamic Object Segmentation and Ego Motion Estimation using Radar Image Fusion
comment: Accepted for presentation at IEEE IROS 2026 Workshop LTP
summary: Dynamic object segmentation and ego-motion estimation are closely coupled problems in autonomous driving, as accurate ego-motion estimation typically requires static scene observations, while identifying static observations requires knowledge of the ego motion. We present Radar-Dot, a radar--RGB framework that exploits radar Doppler measurements to address this coupling. Radar returns are first used to estimate ego velocity through a linear Doppler constraint, with residual-based static/dynamic segmentation and robust estimation used to reduce the influence of moving objects. The estimated motion is then combined with metric depth and dense optical flow to identify image regions whose observed motion is inconsistent with the rigid scene motion. Experiments on 10 nuScenes scenes (part of nuscenes-mini) demonstrate that the resulting geometric pipeline achieves 20.24% dynamic IoU and 33.67% F1-score over 394 frame pairs, while radar-based static-point filtering improves ego-velocity estimation compared with using all radar returns. These results demonstrate the potential of radar as a modality for jointly improving ego-motion estimation and dynamic object segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Radar-Dot，一个利用雷达多普勒测量来解决动态物体分割与自运动估计耦合问题的雷达-视觉框架。
AI.motivation: 在自动驾驶中，动态物体分割与自运动估计高度耦合：准确的自运动估计通常依赖静态场景观测，而识别静态观测又需要已知自运动。二者相互依赖形成难点。
AI.method: 首先利用雷达回波通过线性多普勒约束估计自车速度，并借助基于残差的静态/动态分割与鲁棒估计降低运动物体的影响；随后将估计的运动与度量深度及稠密光流结合，识别图像中观测运动与刚性场景运动不一致的区域。
AI.result: 在10个nuScenes场景（nuscenes-mini的一部分）上，394对帧上几何流程达到20.24%动态IoU和33.67% F1-score；与使用全部雷达回波相比，基于雷达的静态点滤波提升了自车速度估计。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明雷达作为联合提升自运动估计与动态物体分割的一种模态具有潜力。

title: FireWorldBench: Benchmarking Complex Physical World Intelligence through Coupled-Field Fire Dynamics
summary: Understanding the physical world requires more than object recognition, scene description, and short-term visual prediction, as real-world physical systems involve multiple continuous fields, latent causal mechanisms, partial observations, and intervention-sensitive dynamics. We propose FireWorldBench, a benchmark for evaluating complex physical world intelligence in multimodal large language models and agents through coupled-field fire dynamics. Fire provides a canonical stress-test environment, where multiple interacting physical fields jointly shape observable states and temporal dynamics. FireWorldBench is organized along two complementary axes, a physical capability axis and a fire scenario task axis, jointly covering physical-state understanding, temporal dynamics, causal mechanisms, and intervention reasoning. The benchmark comprises 520 fire-world entries, including 494 controlled simulation worlds and 26 real-world-aligned event groups, spanning 47 scene archetypes across 7 environment families. These entries combine structured textual observations, multiple 2D physical-field visualizations, and 3D event-level scene modeling, yielding 9,074 text-image interleaved question-answer pairs across choice-based and open-ended report-generation formats. FireWorldBench evaluates whether models can infer latent physical states, explain underlying mechanisms, forecast coupled-field evolution, and assess intervention consequences from multimodal partial observations, providing a challenging testbed for complex physical world intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出 FireWorldBench，一个基于耦合场火灾动力学的多模态大模型/智能体复杂物理世界智能评测基准，含520个火灾世界条目、9074个图文交错问答对。
AI.motivation: 现有物理世界理解任务多停留在物体识别、场景描述与短期视觉预测，难以覆盖真实物理系统涉及的多连续场、潜在因果机制、部分观测与干预敏感动力学等复杂特性，缺乏相应评测手段。
AI.method: 以火灾动力学作为典型压力测试环境，构建 FireWorldBench：沿"物理能力轴"与"火灾场景任务轴"两条互补维度组织，覆盖物理状态理解、时间动力学、因果机制与干预推理；共520个条目（494个受控仿真世界、26个真实世界对齐事件组），跨7个环境族、47类场景原型；融合结构化文本观测、多幅2D物理场可视化与3D事件级场景建模，生成9074个图文交错问答对，含选择题与开放式报告生成两种形式。
AI.result: 构建出覆盖多场耦合、多观测模态、多任务形式的火灾世界基准，可用于评测模型从多模态部分观测中推断潜在物理状态、解释机理、预测耦合场演化及评估干预后果的能力。
AI.conclusion: FireWorldBench 为复杂物理世界智能提供了具有挑战性的测试平台，推动多模态大模型与智能体超越表层感知、走向潜在因果与干预层面的物理理解。

title: SALSA: Semi-Autonomous Literature Summarization Assistant
summary: SALSA (Semi-Autonomous Literature Summarization Assistant) is an open- source, human-in-the-loop platform for extracting structured scientific datasets from multimodal literature sources. The software combines document parsing, large language models, optical character recognition, computer vision, figure digitization, and user-guided correction tools to recover structured information from text, tables, figures, and captions. Users can configure extraction stages, define dataset schemas, perform interventions on digitized figures, and export verified data for downstream analysis and machine learning. SALSA is designed to automate repetitive literature curation tasks while preserving oversight where expert judgment is required. By supporting customizable extraction workflows across diverse input types, the software provides a flexible framework for scalable, reliable data curation for materials research, and potentially across several disciplines. Users are responsible for ensuring that all inputs, extraction workflows, and downstream uses comply with applicable publisher agreements, copyright and licensing terms, institutional policies, and data-use requirements.

AI.tldr: SALSA 是一个开源、人在回路（human-in-the-loop）平台，用于从多模态科学文献中抽取结构化数据集。
AI.motivation: 科学文献（文本、表格、图像、图注）中的信息抽取与整理是重复且耗时的工作，同时又需要专家判断，因此需要既能自动化又能保留人工监督的工具。
AI.method: 集成文档解析、大语言模型（LLM）、光学字符识别（OCR）、计算机视觉、图像数据数字化（figure digitization）以及用户引导的纠错工具；支持用户配置抽取阶段、定义数据集 schema、对数字化图像进行人工干预，并导出经核验的数据。
AI.result: 实现了一个可配置、跨多种输入类型的抽取工作流框架，能够自动完成重复性文献整理任务，并在需要专家判断的环节保留人工监督。
AI.conclusion: SALSA 为材料研究乃至其他学科提供了可扩展、可靠的数据整理灵活框架；但用户需自行确保输入、抽取流程及下游使用符合出版商协议、版权与许可条款、机构政策及数据使用要求。

title: Planning-Aligned Pretraining of BEV Representations with Sparse Action-Conditioned Targets for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end driving requires planning-relevant bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations, but existing pretraining approaches often rely on task annotations or dense scene reconstruction. We introduce PAVER, Planning-Aligned BEV Encoder Pretraining. From a single LiDAR sweep, PAVER constructs sparse risk and unknown targets describing occupied and unobserved evidence along rule-based ego motions. A 10K-parameter head predicts these targets from masked BEV features conditioned on the action state, directing supervision toward geometric constraints on candidate motions. Pretraining requires no driving-task annotations or dense reconstruction. Only the BEV encoder is transferred, preserving the downstream architecture and camera-only inference. On nuScenes, PAVER reduces VAD-Tiny's average collision rate from 0.51% to 0.19%, while improving planning L2, motion prediction, detection, and mapping. The selected VAD-Tiny and VAD-Base schedules use about 36% less estimated total training time than scratch training, including pretraining. On Bench2Drive Town05 Long, PAVER improves UniAD-Tiny's closed-loop Driving Score from 48.45 to 58.79. The project page is available at https://archiiive99.github.io/PAVER.

AI.tldr: PAVER 提出一种规划对齐的 BEV 编码器预训练方法，无需驾驶任务标注或稠密重建，仅用单帧 LiDAR 构建稀疏风险与未知目标，通过动作状态条件化的掩码 BEV 特征预测进行监督，预训练后仅迁移 BEV 编码器，在 nuScenes 与 Bench2Drive 上显著提升碰撞率、规划与其他下游任务表现。
AI.motivation: 端到端驾驶需要与规划相关的鸟瞰图（BEV）表示，但现有预训练方法通常依赖任务标注或稠密场景重建，成本高且不一定与规划对齐。因此作者希望设计一种无需驾驶任务标注、无需稠密重建、且直接面向规划几何约束的 BEV 编码器预训练方案。
AI.method: PAVER（Planning-Aligned BEV Encoder Pretraining）：从单次 LiDAR 扫描出发，沿基于规则的自车运动构建稀疏“风险”与“未知”目标，用于描述被占据与未被观测的证据。使用一个约 10K 参数的预测头，在动作状态条件下从掩码 BEV 特征预测这些目标，从而将监督引导至候选运动上的几何约束。预训练过程不需要驾驶任务标注或稠密重建。迁移时仅转移 BEV 编码器，保持下游架构与纯相机推理不变。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes 上，PAVER 将 VAD-Tiny 的平均碰撞率从 0.51% 降至 0.19%，同时改善规划 L2、运动预测、检测与建图性能。所选的 VAD-Tiny 与 VAD-Base 训练计划相比从零训练（含预训练）估计总训练时间减少约 36%。在 Bench2Drive Town05 Long 上，PAVER 将 UniAD-Tiny 的闭环驾驶得分从 48.45 提升至 58.79。
AI.conclusion: PAVER 表明，基于稀疏风险/未知目标的规划对齐 BEV 编码器预训练可在无任务标注与无稠密重建条件下有效提升端到端驾驶性能，并兼容纯相机下游推理、降低总训练时间，具有较强的实用性与可迁移性。

title: Tutoring Large Language Models to be Domain-adaptive, Precise and Safe
comment: This is a preprint of a PhD thesis submitted to IIT KGP. The final, official version of record is available through the university's institutional repository
summary: This thesis proposes a framework for "responsible intelligence" to address AI's critical challenges in safety, ethics, and cultural sensitivity. It advances three core areas: First, it improves domain adaptation in specialized fields using active learning and graph-based knowledge to reduce hallucinations. Second, it enhances ethical rigor via a novel decoding-time alignment mechanism that proactively blocks harmful text generation in real-time. Finally, it ensures cultural and multilingual safety through language-specific steering that respects diverse linguistic and social norms. Ultimately, this work provides a blueprint for building next-generation AI that is contextually knowledgeable, ethically sound, and culturally adaptable.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"负责任智能"框架，从领域适应、伦理对齐、文化多语言安全三个层面提升AI的安全性、伦理性与文化敏感性。
AI.motivation: 应对AI在安全、伦理和文化敏感性方面面临的严峻挑战，需要构建兼顾知识性、伦理合规与文化适应性的下一代AI。
AI.method: 包含三项核心技术：1）利用主动学习与基于图的知识改进专业领域适应，降低幻觉；2）提出新颖的解码阶段对齐机制，实时主动阻断有害文本生成；3）通过语言特定的引导实现文化与多语言安全，尊重多元语言与社会规范。
AI.result: 在三个方向分别实现了：专业领域适应能力提升与幻觉减少、实时阻断有害生成、以及跨语言文化的安全对齐。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为构建兼具领域知识、伦理健全与文化适应性的下一代AI提供了蓝图。

title: A Channel-Boosted Multi-Agent System with Iterative Consultation for Document Sensitivity Classification
summary: Organizations in critical national infrastructure sectors must assess heterogeneous documents for sensitivity before routing or storage. Manual assessment is slow, inconsistent, and unscalable. Extending our prior leakage-controlled benchmark, BERT established the top single-encoder baseline (89.14% accuracy, 89.33% F1-score under 5-fold cross-validation on the Strategic 16K corpus). However, transformer baselines suffer from a structural limitation: fixed input length truncation discards evidence beyond the retained window-precisely where sensitive cables tend to be longest. We present Channel-Boosted MAS (CB-MAS) and instantiate it as IC-MAS (Iterative Consultation Multi-Agent System) to solve this without long-context computational costs. A Channel Critic Agent learns document-adaptive trust weights governing Gated Channel Boosting between two first-window encoders, while paired Consultation Agents iteratively exchange belief states to reconcile evidence from the beginning and end of long documents. IC-MAS holds computation constant regardless of document length by reconciling fixed windows in a compact representation space. Ablation studies show critic-controlled Channel Boosting provides the bulk of accuracy gains, while consultation recovers recall without precision collapse. Critic-Controlled Gated Channel Boosting with Max-Pool fusion and Blackboard Adaptive Consultation achieves 90.72% accuracy, 91.23% F1-score, 92.01% sensitive recall, and 90.46% sensitive precision, using about 54% less average computation than a fixed-round baseline. Gains over the single-encoder baseline are statistically significant (McNemar's test, p less than 0.000001; paired t-test). We include LIME/SHAP explainability, multi-agent evaluation, and an honest accounting of limitations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CB-MAS及其实现IC-MAS，一种通道增强多智能体系统，用于长文档敏感度评估，在避免长上下文计算开销的前提下显著超越单编码器BERT基线。
AI.motivation: 关键国家基础设施领域的组织需在路由或存储前对异构文档进行敏感度评估，但人工评估缓慢、不一致且不可扩展；此前的BERT单编码器基线虽表现良好，却存在固定输入长度截断丢弃窗口外证据的结构性缺陷，而敏感长文件恰恰最长。
AI.method: 提出Channel-Boosted MAS（CB-MAS），并具体实例化为IC-MAS（Iterative Consultation Multi-Agent System）。其中Channel Critic Agent学习文档自适应信任权重，在两个首窗口编码器之间进行门控通道增强；成对的Consultation Agents迭代交换信念状态，以调和长文档首尾证据。系统通过在紧凑表示空间中调和固定窗口，使计算量与文档长度无关。
AI.result: 消融实验显示，批评者控制的通道增强贡献了大部分准确率提升，而咨询机制在不导致精确率崩溃的情况下恢复了召回率。最终方法（批评者控制门控通道增强+Max-Pool融合+黑板自适应咨询）达到90.72%准确率、91.23% F1、92.01%敏感召回率和90.46%敏感精确率，平均计算量比固定轮次基线减少约54%。相对单编码器基线的提升具统计显著性（McNemar检验 p<0.000001；配对t检验）。
AI.conclusion: IC-MAS在不引入长上下文计算成本的情况下缓解了固定长度截断的证据丢失问题，以更高效率实现性能提升，并提供LIME/SHAP可解释性、多智能体评估及对局限性的诚实说明。

title: Combining Foundation Model Confidence and Monocular Depth for Training-Free Out-of-Distribution Segmentation
summary: Autonomous vehicles operating in open-world scenarios are inevitably confronted with previously unknown objects, such as exotic animals or loose cargo. The reliable detection and segmentation of these out-of-distribution (OOD) objects is therefore crucial for a safe understanding of the environment and decision-making. Most existing approaches require access to OOD training samples, retraining of the segmentation backbone, or dedicated auxiliary architectures, limiting their practical applicability. We propose a training-free method that derives dense OOD scores directly from the confidence predictions of a foundation segmentation model, without any task-specific fine-tuning or access to anomalous data. To improve the robustness of our OOD segmentation, geometric information from monocular depth estimation is incorporated into the decision process, providing complementary cues to uncertainty-based predictions. We evaluate the proposed method on the SegmentMeIfYouCan benchmark and additionally assess its performance on OOD tracking in video sequences, reflecting the temporal nature of real-world perception systems. The method performs strongly on road-centered benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的方法，直接从基础分割模型的置信度预测中导出密集OOD分数，并融合单目深度几何信息以增强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶在开放场景中会遇到未知物体（如异域动物、散落货物），可靠检测与分割这些分布外（OOD）物体对安全感知与决策至关重要。现有方法多需OOD训练样本、重训分割骨干或专用辅助架构，实用性受限。
AI.method: 无需训练的方法：直接从基础分割模型的置信度预测中导出密集OOD分数，不做任务特定微调，也不需要异常数据；并将单目深度估计的几何信息引入决策过程，与不确定性预测形成互补线索。
AI.result: 在SegmentMeIfYouCan基准上评估，并额外考察视频序列中的OOD跟踪性能；该方法在以道路为中心的基准上表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: 该免训练、融合几何信息的OOD分割思路在道路中心场景下有效，并可扩展至视频OOD跟踪，具备较高实用潜力。

title: Event Signature Transfer: Model-Agnostic Forecast Scenario Construction from Historical Events
summary: Forecasters often know an event is imminent but not the shape, size, or timing of its effect. We introduce Event Signature Transfer (EST), a training-free, model-agnostic operator that turns a completed past event into an explicit forecast scenario. EST removes a source event's own trend and seasonality, then scales and retimes the remaining event signature onto a native forecast, preserving the forecast's linked structure and reducing to it exactly at zero strength. Because it reads only output quantiles, EST applies to any quantile forecaster, with no training, no model internals, at transfer time. Across twelve real episodes and ten synthetic scenarios on Chronos-2, TimesFM-2.5 and Toto-2.0, manually configured EST reduces real-episode WQL by 21.7-90\% in-sample. On Chronos-2, it leads eleven of twelve matched comparisons against covariate conditioning, activation editing and raw replay. The operator builds a scenario; it does not estimate its likelihood.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练、模型无关的 EST 算子，将已完成事件的"事件签名"迁移到原生预测上，构造显式预测情景，显著降低 WQL。
AI.motivation: 预测者常预知事件即将发生，却不知其影响的形状、幅度与时机，缺乏将历史事件转化为显式预测情景的手段。
AI.method: EST 先剥离源事件自身的趋势与季节性，再将剩余的事件签名按比例缩放并重新定时，叠加到原生预测上，保持预测的关联结构，且在强度为零时精确退化为原预测；仅读取输出分位数，是免训练、模型无关的算子。
AI.result: 在 Chronos-2、TimesFM-2.5、Toto-2.0 上，针对 12 个真实事件与 10 个合成情景测试：手工配置的 EST 使真实情景样本内 WQL 降低 21.7%–90%；在 Chronos-2 上，于 12 组匹配对比中 11 组优于协变量条件化、激活编辑与原始重放。
AI.conclusion: EST 能有效构造预测情景，但仅构建情景本身，不估计该情景发生的似然。

title: SCoP: Structured Constraint Parsing for Evidence-Space Control in Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering
summary: Temporal Knowledge Graph Question Answering (TKGQA) requires answer inference from evidence that is both structurally valid and temporally admissible. Existing methods often leave anchor-event binding, temporal admissibility, and ordinal selection implicit in model reasoning, task-specific training, or similarity-driven retrieval, allowing locally relevant but invalid facts to enter the answer context. We formulate complex TKGQA as evidence-space control and propose SCoP (Structured Constraint Parsing), a constraint-centric framework that externalizes temporal decisions before answer inference. Instead of treating retrieved facts as admissible evidence by default, SCoP separates answer-seeking event patterns from temporal anchor events, conservatively grounds them to canonical TKG entities and relations, and translates temporal intent into executable constraints with optional ranking requirements. These constraints operate over normalized point and interval ranges, enabling deterministic filtering of structurally compatible candidates and producing a compact evidence space for generation. Experiments on MultiTQ and TimelineCronQ-R assess SCoP across timestamped point-fact and interval-oriented settings with richer temporal relations and ordering dependencies. Without task-specific parameter updates, SCoP achieves 0.825 Hits@1 on MultiTQ and 0.761 Hits@1 on TimelineCronQ-R, with gains on constraint-intensive question types. These results support explicit evidence-space control over unconstrained retrieval or implicit temporal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SCoP框架，将复杂时序知识图谱问答建模为证据空间控制问题，通过显式约束解析实现确定性的时序过滤，无需任务特定训练即在MultiTQ和TimelineCronQ-R上取得领先效果。
AI.motivation: 现有TKGQA方法将锚事件绑定、时序可采纳性和序数选择隐含在模型推理、任务特定训练或相似度检索中，导致局部相关但时序无效的事实混入答案上下文。作者希望将时序决策显式外化，避免无效事实进入证据空间。
AI.method: 提出SCoP（结构化约束解析）框架：将答案寻求的事件模式与时序锚事件分离，保守地将它们锚定到规范化的TKG实体和关系上，把时序意图翻译为带可选排序要求的可执行约束；这些约束作用于归一化的时间点与区间范围，从而确定性地过滤结构兼容的候选，生成紧凑证据空间供生成模块使用。
AI.result: 在MultiTQ和TimelineCronQ-R上评估，覆盖时间戳点事实与区间导向两种设定，包含更丰富的时序关系和排序依赖。无需任务特定参数更新，MultiTQ上Hits@1达0.825，TimelineCronQ-R上Hits@1达0.761，在约束密集型问题类型上提升明显。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持显式证据空间控制优于无约束检索或隐式时序推理，说明将时序约束外化为可执行、确定性的解析过程能有效提升复杂TKGQA的答案准确性与证据可靠性。

title: Scout: Open-World Species Recognition on the Edge
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) enable recognition beyond a fixed class set, but their computational demands prevent them from running on many edge devices. Cloud offload makes this capability accessible, but sending every image consumes scarce bandwidth and communication energy. We ask how to bring the open-world recognition capability of VLMs to the edge while operating within tight compute, energy, and bandwidth budgets. Wildlife monitoring provides a natural setting for exploring this question because camera traps encounter species not known at deployment. We present Scout, an autonomous open-world recognition system that invokes a cloud VLM intermittently to teach new classes to a compact edge model. Given only the deployment location and empty site frames, Scout autonomously turns each species identified by the VLM into persistent, site-conditioned recognition capability in a resource-efficient edge model, without a predefined species list, human labeling, or manual tuning. Across 30 camera-trap deployments in three regions on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, the accuracy of Scout remains within 0.1-2.5% of a model given a predefined species list. On species outside its initial class set, Scout achieves 53.7-59.1% accuracy, compared with 56.5-65.1% for full cloud offload, while using 59-71% less deployment energy.

AI.tldr: Scout是一个面向边缘设备的自主开放世界识别系统，通过间歇调用云端VLM来"教会"紧凑边缘模型识别新物种，在无需预定义物种列表、人工标注或手动调参的情况下，实现接近预定义列表模型的精度，同时显著降低能耗。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（VLM）具备开放世界识别能力，但计算需求高，难以在边缘设备运行；云端卸载虽可访问该能力，却因传输每张图像而消耗稀缺带宽与通信能量。因此需要一种在严格计算、能量和带宽预算内，将VLM的开放世界识别能力带到边缘的方案。野生动物监测是理想场景，因为相机陷阱会遇到部署时未知的物种。
AI.method: 提出Scout——一个自主开放世界识别系统，间歇性调用云端VLM向紧凑边缘模型传授新类别。仅需部署地点和空场景帧，Scout即可自主将VLM识别出的每个物种转化为边缘模型中持久、以站点为条件的识别能力，无需预定义物种列表、人工标注或手动调参。
AI.result: 在三个区域、30个相机陷阱部署于NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上的测试中：Scout精度与给定预定义物种列表的模型相差0.1–2.5%以内；对其初始类别集之外的物种，Scout达到53.7–59.1%的准确率，而完全云端卸载为56.5–65.1%，同时部署能耗降低59–71%。
AI.conclusion: Scout证明了在边缘设备上以低能耗实现接近云端VLM的开放世界识别能力是可行的，为资源受限场景下的开放世界识别提供了实用路径。

title: From Inference Engine to Inference Control Plane: Connecting vLLM, llm-d, and the Evolution of Efficient Distributed LLM Serving
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Systems synthesis and research agenda on vLLM, llm-d, distributed inference control, KV-state management, routing, disaggregation, heterogeneous accelerators, reliability, and agentic/multimodal serving. No new experimental measurements are claimed; empirical and organization-reported results are attributed to the cited sources
summary: Large language model (LLM) inference is evolving from an engine-local optimization problem into a distributed control problem involving reusable state, phase placement, heterogeneous accelerators, networking, autoscaling, reliability, and service-level objectives. This paper connects that transition across peer-reviewed systems research, open-source implementations, and documented production studies. It treats vLLM and llm-d as complementary layers: model-serving engines optimize execution through mechanisms such as PagedAttention, continuous batching, kernels, quantization, and parallelism, while an inference control plane can optimize where, when, and under what policy execution occurs across a fleet. The contribution is synthesis rather than a new benchmark; all reported performance and deployment results remain attributed to their original sources. The combined evidence suggests that the scarce resource in modern inference is shifting from raw FLOPs alone toward managed state, placement, network movement, reliability, and decision quality. We propose an Inference Execution Planner that selects feasible execution plans rather than only endpoints, including aggregated versus disaggregated topology, KV source and transfer action, hardware variant, routing/admission policy, and slower scaling decisions. We also provide a source-local benchmark atlas, a bottleneck-migration taxonomy, practical deployment guidance, an evaluation framework based on SLO-goodput, and research questions for agentic, multimodal, heterogeneous, and resilient inference.

AI.tldr: 本文综述LLM推理从引擎内优化向分布式控制问题的演进，以vLLM与llm-d为互补层次，提出"推理执行规划器"（Inference Execution Planner）及配套工具，强调稀缺资源正从FLOPs转向状态管理、放置、网络、可靠性与决策质量。
AI.motivation: LLM推理已从单一引擎的局部优化，演变为涉及可复用状态、阶段放置、异构加速器、网络、自动扩缩容、可靠性与SLO的分布式控制问题；现有研究分散在系统研究、开源实现与生产实践中，缺乏跨来源的系统性连接与统一视角。
AI.method: 采用综述/综合（synthesis）方法，而非提出新基准。将vLLM（模型服务引擎层：PagedAttention、连续批处理、算子、量化、并行）与llm-d（推理控制平面层：执行的地点、时机与策略）视为互补层次，整合同行评审系统研究、开源实现与有记录的生产研究。提出推理执行规划器，选择可行执行方案（聚合 vs 分离拓扑、KV来源与传输动作、硬件变体、路由/准入策略、较慢的扩缩容决策）。
AI.result: 所有性能与部署数据均归属原始来源，本文不做新测量。综合证据表明：现代推理的稀缺资源正从单纯的原始FLOPs，转向受管状态、放置、网络传输、可靠性与决策质量。产出包括：来源本地化基准图谱、瓶颈迁移分类法、部署实践指南、基于SLO-goodput的评估框架，以及面向智能体、多模态、异构与韧性推理的研究问题。
AI.conclusion: LLM推理的核心挑战已由算力密集转向"状态与决策"密集的系统控制问题；通过引擎层与控制平面层的互补分工及执行规划器的引入，可为大规模推理部署提供统一的分析、评估与研究框架。

title: The Bairong System for MLC-SLM 2026: Dynamic Question-Aware Evidence Routing for Multilingual Conversational Speech Understanding
comment: Accepted at the 2nd MLC-SLM Challenge and Workshop, INTERSPEECH 2026
summary: Long multilingual conversational spoken question answering requires systems to balance long-range transcript semantics with sparse acoustic and speaker-sensitive cues. We present the Bairong system for the MLC-SLM 2026 Challenge, where a diarization-ASR front-end produces speaker-attributed transcripts and a dynamic evidence router constructs question-specific inputs for answer prediction. Instead of applying a fixed transcript-only or audio-only policy, the router infers the required evidence type and context scope from the question and answer options, and selects among full transcript context, local audio-text fusion, speaker-linked evidence, and compact global acoustic samples. This transcript-backbone design keeps discourse context available while activating audio only when it provides complementary evidence. Our Task 1 system achieves 25.70% and 18.44% tcpMER on the development and evaluation sets. For Task 2, the final system obtains 94.84% devel?opment accuracy, outperforming the full-transcript baseline by 1.68 points and the best audio-centric diagnostic system by 2.77 points. These results support dynamic question-aware routing as an effective evidence allocation strategy for conversational spoken QA.

AI.tldr: 提出 Bairong 系统，用动态证据路由器为长时多语言对话语音问答按问题自适应分配证据，Task 1 达 25.70%/18.44% tcpMER，Task 2 达 94.84% 准确率。
AI.motivation: 长时多语言对话式语音问答需同时兼顾长程转写语义与稀疏的声学及说话人线索。固定采用纯文本或纯音频策略难以适配不同问题的证据需求，因此需要一种按问题动态分配证据的机制。
AI.method: 系统由两部分构成：① 说话人分离-ASR 前端，生成带说话人属性的转写；② 动态证据路由器，根据问题与选项推断所需证据类型与上下文范围，在全文转写上下文、局部音文融合、说话人关联证据、紧凑全局声学采样四类输入间进行选择。以转写为主干保留篇章上下文，仅在音频能提供互补证据时激活音频。
AI.result: Task 1 系统在开发集与评估集上分别取得 25.70% 和 18.44% 的 tcpMER。Task 2 最终系统取得 94.84% 的开发集准确率，分别比全文转写基线高 1.68 个百分点、比最佳音频中心诊断系统高 2.77 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，动态的、问题感知的证据路由是一种有效的证据分配策略，适用于对话式语音问答。

title: AVTR-1: Open Stack for Real-Time Interactive Avatars
summary: Talking-head and dyadic models now achieve real-time inference, yet fast motion generation alone does not produce an interactive conversation. A live system must synchronize the model's output with speech from an external voice agent, schedule video frames for playback, and handle interruptions. We introduce AVTR-1, an open stack for real-time interactive avatar conversations, built around a compact 153M-parameter autoregressive flow-matching motion generator conditioned on both participants' audio. We adapt its audio encoder for streaming through self-distillation. The stack turns the model's chunk-based generation into a continuous, synchronized audio-video stream driven by an external voice agent, and we analytically derive its contribution to the user-facing latencies and validate the resulting bounds with two commercial voice agents. Further experiments demonstrate that AVTR-1 leads the compared dyadic systems on all reported visual-quality metrics and most conventional listening-motion metrics while remaining competitive in lip synchronization. Its inference runtime operates in real time on data-center and consumer GPUs. However, conventional listening metrics do not establish whether the paired speaker's speech contributes to generated motion. We therefore introduce the Reference-Based Directed Granger Gain (R-DGG), which measures the additional predictive information carried by speaker speech after accounting for listener history and speaker motion. R-DGG finds statistically supported predictive dependence for recorded listeners and all evaluated dyadic systems, but not for talking-head generators without paired audio or mismatched speaker-listener pairs. We release the model weights, renderer, and serving backend under component-specific licenses.

AI.tldr: 提出开源实时交互式数字人对话系统 AVTR-1，含 153M 参数的流匹配动作生成器，配合流式音频编码器自蒸馏与调度后端，实现与外置语音智能体的音视频同步，并提出 R-DGG 指标验证听者对说话者语音的预测依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有 talking-head 与双人（dyadic）模型虽已实现实时推理，但仅靠快速动作生成无法构成真正的交互式对话：系统还需与外部语音智能体输出的语音同步、调度视频帧播放并处理中断。此外，常规的倾听动作（listening-motion）指标无法判断生成动作是否真的受到对话方语音的影响。
AI.method: 1) 构建由 153M 参数自回归流匹配（flow-matching）动作生成器组成的紧凑模型，条件输入为双方音频；2) 通过自蒸馏（self-distillation）改造音频编码器以支持流式处理；3) 将分块生成转为由外部语音智能体驱动的连续同步音视频流，并解析推导其在用户侧延迟中的贡献；4) 提出基于参考的有向格兰杰增益（R-DGG），在扣除听者历史与说话者动作后度量说话者语音携带的额外预测信息。
AI.result: 在报告的视觉质量指标上全面领先所比较的双人系统，在多数常规倾听动作指标上领先，唇同步保持竞争力；推理在数据中心与消费级 GPU 上均达到实时；延迟上界由两个商用语音智能体验证。R-DGG 对真实录音听者与所有评测双人系统均发现具统计显著性的预测依赖，而在无配对音频的 talking-head 生成器及说话者-听者错配组合上未发现该依赖。
AI.conclusion: 实时交互式数字人对话不仅取决于动作生成速度，更依赖音频驱动同步、播放调度与打断处理的整体系统设计；模型权重、渲染器与服务后端按组件分别授权开源，为该方向提供了可复现的开源基础设施。

title: CraftBench-UE: Deterministic Evaluation for Coding Agents in Unreal Engine
summary: Building gameplay features in a game engine requires more than code, as code that compiles and runs does not necessarily implement the requested gameplay. We introduce CraftBenchUE, an evaluation harness that runs agents in an isolated Unreal Engine environment, reconstructs their saved submissions in fresh projects, and applies deterministic build, asset, and runtime checks without an LLM judge. Based on the harness, we built a benchmark consisting of 70 tasks spanning C++ source, Blueprint assets, and editor scripting. We evaluate seven models under two editor-tool configurations, with a file-and-shell baseline on C++ tasks. We further pair tasks that specify the same gameplay and use the same runtime tests, but require C++ and Blueprint as the deliverables. Across the 10 paired tasks, C++ completion rates exceed Blueprint by 30.0 and 42.9 percentage points in the two tool configurations. Among on-time Blueprint submissions in this paired set that pass asset checks, 42.2% and 50.0% fail explicit runtime assertions. These submissions satisfy asset requirements but fail the required gameplay tests. We will release the harness, task benchmark, and our trajectory findings with the report.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CraftBenchUE 评测框架，在隔离的 Unreal Engine 环境中运行智能体，重建其保存的提交并在新项目中施加确定性的构建、资产与运行时检查（无需 LLM 评判）。基于该框架构建了覆盖 C++ 源码、蓝图资产与编辑器脚本的 70 项任务基准，评测七种模型在两种编辑器工具配置下的表现，并设置 C++/蓝图配对任务。
AI.motivation: 在游戏引擎中实现玩法功能不仅依赖代码，代码能编译运行并不意味着实现了所要求的玩法，因此需要一种不依赖 LLM 主观评判、可确定性验证提交是否真正满足玩法要求的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 CraftBenchUE 评测框架：在隔离的 Unreal Engine 环境中运行智能体，将其保存的提交在全新项目中重建，并施加确定性的构建、资产与运行时检查，不使用 LLM 作为评判者。据此构建含 70 项任务的基准，涵盖 C++ 源码、蓝图资产与编辑器脚本；对七种模型在两种编辑器工具配置下进行评测，并在 C++ 任务上设置了基于文件与 shell 的基线。此外设计配对任务：玩法规格相同、运行时测试相同，但交付物分别为 C++ 与蓝图。
AI.result: 在 10 组配对任务中，C++ 的完成率在两种工具配置下分别高出蓝图 30.0 和 42.9 个百分点。在该配对集合中通过资产检查的按时蓝图提交里，分别有 42.2% 和 50.0% 未通过显式运行时断言——即满足资产要求但未通过所需玩法测试。
AI.conclusion: 编译运行通过并不等于玩法实现正确；基于确定性检查的评测能揭示蓝图提交中“资产合规但玩法失败”的显著问题。作者将随报告发布评测框架、任务基准及轨迹发现。

title: On Mitigation of Subliminal Learning in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 17 pages, 9 figures, 12 tables
summary: Knowledge distillation can transmit unintended behavioral traits from a teacher model to a student through training data that appear semantically unrelated to those traits, a phenomenon known as subliminal learning. Although recent work has established this effect, its training dynamics and mitigation remain underexplored. We study subliminal learning in open-weight language models ranging from 1.5B to 8B parameters, covering the Qwen, Gemma, and Llama families in number-sequence and chain-of-thought settings. Rather than evaluating only final models, we track trait-related probabilities throughout fine-tuning and find that subliminal acquisition can be highly non-monotonic, with transient spikes, reversals, and trait-specific failures of transfer. We then introduce liminal training, an annealed KL-regularized fine-tuning method that constrains early drift from the base model. Across our experiments, liminal training substantially reduces subliminal trait acquisition while largely preserving task gains, outperforming paraphrasing and layer freezing as mitigation strategies. The effect also extends beyond animal preferences: in a French-language response-style experiment, liminal training suppresses language transfer while retaining much of the GSM8K improvement. Finally, we show that KL timing matters: early regularization is more effective than late regularization, and sweeping the regularization strength reveals an empirical trade-off between task learning and trait suppression.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究开放权重语言模型中的"潜意识学习"现象，追踪微调过程中特质的动态获取，并提出"liminal training"（退火KL正则化微调）来抑制潜意识特质迁移，同时保留任务性能。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏可能通过语义上无关的训练数据，将教师的非预期行为特质传递给学生（潜意识学习）。已有工作证实了该现象的存在，但其训练动态和缓解方法仍缺乏深入研究。
AI.method: 在1.5B至8B参数的开放权重模型（Qwen、Gemma、Llama系列）中，于数字序列和思维链设定下研究潜意识学习；不仅评估最终模型，还全程追踪微调过程中特质相关概率的变化。提出liminal training——一种退火KL正则化微调方法，在训练早期约束模型偏离基座模型，并与改写（paraphrasing）和层冻结（layer freezing）进行对比；另在法语回答风格实验中验证，并考察KL正则化时机（早期vs晚期）与正则化强度的权衡。
AI.result: 潜意识特质的获取高度非单调，存在瞬时峰值、反转以及特质特异性的迁移失败。liminal training在显著减少潜意识特质获取的同时基本保留任务增益，优于改写和层冻结。在法语回答风格实验中，该方法抑制了语言迁移，同时保留了大部分GSM8K提升。此外，早期正则化比晚期正则化更有效，正则化强度扫描揭示了任务学习与特质抑制之间的经验性权衡。
AI.conclusion: 潜意识学习具有复杂的非单调训练动态，liminal training通过早期的退火KL正则化可有效缓解特质迁移并维持任务收益，KL正则化的时机是关键因素。

title: Planning and Rendering in Concert: DeepFusion of Autoregressive Layouts and Diffusion for Visual Text Generation
summary: Generating text-rich images from prompts requires both textual fidelity and the coherent integration of text into the surrounding image. An explicit layout can provide structured guidance about what text should appear and where, but a well-formed plan alone does not guarantee that the renderer will realize it faithfully. Existing layout-based AR-diffusion systems typically optimize planning and rendering separately, preventing the planner's representations from being adapted jointly with image synthesis. We introduce DuetGen, an autonomous visual text generator built on DeepFusion, which jointly learns autoregressive planning and continuous diffusion rendering. DeepFusion conditions a diffusion transformer on the planner's prompt and bbox-content hidden states, allowing rendering supervision to shape the representations connecting textual plans with visual outputs. Its joint objective combines autoregressive plan supervision, text-region-weighted diffusion learning, and auxiliary coordinate supervision to maintain structured planning, emphasize text-bearing regions, and improve the spatial precision of planner representations. During inference, Phase-Aware Attention Modulation strengthens the correspondence between image regions and their matched coordinate and content states, facilitating region-specific execution of the generated plan. With a 2B planner and a 4B single-stream DiT, DuetGen achieves 0.8293 word accuracy on CVTG-2K and 0.938 accuracy on LongText-Bench, closely matching the substantially larger Qwen-Image on both benchmarks. These results demonstrate the value of jointly learned planning representations and region-specific rendering for autonomous visual text generation.

AI.tldr: DuetGen：基于DeepFusion的自主视觉文本生成框架，联合学习自回归规划与扩散渲染，在CVTG-2K上达0.8293词准确率，LongText-Bench达0.938。
AI.motivation: 从提示生成富含文本的图像需同时满足文本保真度与文本在图像中的连贯融合。显式布局可提供"应出现何种文本、位于何处"的结构化引导，但仅凭良好规划无法保证渲染器忠实实现。现有基于布局的自回归-扩散系统通常将规划与渲染分开优化，导致规划器表示无法与图像合成共同适配。
AI.method: 提出DuetGen，构建于DeepFusion之上，联合学习自回归规划与连续扩散渲染。DeepFusion以规划器的提示与bbox-content隐状态对扩散Transformer进行条件化，使渲染监督能塑造连接文本规划与视觉输出的表示。联合目标包含三项：自回归规划监督、文本区域加权扩散学习、辅助坐标监督，分别用于维持结构化规划、强调含文本区域、提升规划器表示的空间精度。推理阶段采用Phase-Aware Attention Modulation增强图像区域与其对应坐标、内容状态间的对应关系。
AI.result: 采用2B规划器与4B单流DiT，DuetGen在CVTG-2K上取得0.8293的词准确率，在LongText-Bench上取得0.938的准确率，两项基准上均接近规模显著更大的Qwen-Image。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明联合学习的规划表示与区域特定渲染对自主视觉文本生成具有重要价值。

title: Do Not Trust the Benchmark: Limitations of General LLM Rankings and a Case for Task-Specific Evaluation
summary: Benchmark scores increasingly influence the development, marketing, and selection of large language models (LLMs). Yet an overall score is interpretable only in relation to the system tested, the questions included, and the conditions of evaluation. This perspective examines five connected limitations of general LLM rankings: differences between evaluated and publicly available systems; commercial incentives and dependencies in external evaluation; benchmark saturation, defective tests, and data contamination; models exploiting scoring procedures; and the limited relevance of general scores to users' tasks. Documented cases illustrate why these problems require different responses. I argue for evaluation procedures that disclose the tested configuration, validate questions and successful task completion, report performance alongside cost and execution time, and make the scope of generalization explicit. I then discuss \textbf{Isotanta}, a crowdsourced benchmarking platform, as a practical example of contributed questions and repeated evaluation. A larger question pool may improve task coverage, while repeated sampling can improve the stability of estimates on that pool; neither guarantees validity or personalization. The paper distinguishes the platform's current shared ranking from proposed task-specific and user-provided evaluations. Its central argument is that model selection requires evidence about performance on the intended work, not simply a high position on a general leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文反思通用大模型排行榜的五类结构性缺陷，主张评测应披露测试配置、验证题目与任务完成、并列报告成本与耗时、明确泛化边界，并以众包平台 Isotanta 为例探讨改进路径。
AI.motivation: 基准分数日益影响大模型的研发、营销与选型，但总分只有在明确被测系统、题目集合与评测条件时才可解释；单一排名易被误读为普适能力指标。
AI.method: 观点性/立场论文。系统梳理并分类五项相互关联的局限：被测系统与公开可用系统不一致；外部评测中的商业动机与依赖关系；基准饱和、缺陷题目与数据污染；模型针对评分流程的取巧；通用分数与用户实际任务的关联有限。结合已有记录案例说明各类问题需不同应对，并提出改进的评测规范。随后以众包基准平台 Isotanta 作为实践案例，讨论贡献题目与重复评测的设计。
AI.result: 案例分析指出：更大的题目池可提升任务覆盖度，重复采样可提升该题目池上估计的稳定性；但二者均不保证效度，也不保证个性化。论文区分了平台当前的共享排名与所提出的任务特定评测、用户自提供评测。
AI.conclusion: 核心论点：模型选择需要关于目标工作实际表现的证据，而非通用排行榜上的高名次。评测程序应披露测试配置、验证题目与成功完成任务、报告性能同时给出成本与执行时间，并明确泛化范围。

title: Knowing, and Saying It Only When Asked: LLM Endognostics and the Schizognosis of Minerva-7B
comment: 32 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. Appendices A-E and full human evaluation datasets included
summary: Evaluating an aligned language model by reading its answers assumes the answers carry the distinction the evaluator cares about. We introduce LLM endognostics, a white-box internal auditing framework designed to extract and causally manipulate latent knowledge within the residual stream. Applied to Minerva-7B-Instruct-v1.0 on 124 minimal prompt pairs over 12 categories of professional risk, behavioral evaluation fails on most of the set: the model acts identically on 63.7% of the pairs (95% CI [55.0%, 71.6%]), complying with or refusing both members. Yet, projecting the residual stream onto the vocabulary by a Jacobian lens reveals a statistically significant Contrastive Endognostic Margin, proving the model maintains robust risk differentiation internally. In a second protocol crossing 25 facts with five linguistic framings, we show that the model conforms to presupposed falsehoods in 72% of cases, despite representing the true entity in its latent layers. Surgically ablating the direction of the planted falsehood restores the correct answer in 11 of 25 suppressed cases (McNemar p = 0.0010), validated by blind human annotation (binary agreement kappa = 0.68). In contrast, an out-of-sample linear probe achieves 77% accuracy at layer 10, but its orthogonal ablation yields a 0% recovery rate. This establishes a fundamental theoretical dissociation: abstract linear representation does not imply causal control over verbalization. Our main contribution is the formalization of endognostics to prove that behavioral evaluation and internal reading systematically disagree in the common case, and that linear decodability is decoupled from causal control.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LLM endognostics 白盒内部审计框架，通过 Jacobian lens 提取并因果操控残差流中的潜在知识，证明行为评估与内部表征系统性不一致，且线性可解码性与因果控制解耦。
AI.motivation: 通过阅读模型答案来评估对齐模型，预设答案携带了评估者关心的区分信息；但作者质疑这一前提，认为行为层面的输出可能无法反映模型内部的潜在知识与风险区分能力。
AI.method: 提出 LLM endognostics 框架，从残差流中提取并因果操控潜在知识。实验一：在 Minerva-7B-Instruct-v1.0 上使用 124 个最小提示对（覆盖 12 类职业风险），以 Jacobian lens 将残差流投影到词表，度量 Contrastive Endognostic Margin。实验二：25 个事实 × 5 种语言框架的交叉协议，检验模型对预设虚假信息的顺从，并消融植入虚假方向；同时对比样本外线性探针（第 10 层 77% 准确率）及其正交消融。
AI.result: 行为评估在 63.7% 的提示对上失效（95% CI [55.0%, 71.6%]），模型对两个成员均顺从或拒绝，但 Jacobian lens 显示存在统计显著的 Contrastive Endognostic Margin，内部保持稳健的风险区分。在事实-框架协议中，模型 72% 情况下顺从预设虚假信息，尽管潜在层表征了真实实体；消融植入虚假方向在 25 个被抑制案例中恢复 11 个正确答案（McNemar p = 0.0010），经盲法人工标注验证（二分类一致 kappa = 0.68）。相反，样本外线性探针虽在第 10 层达 77% 准确率，其正交消融恢复率为 0%。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了一个基本理论分离：抽象线性表征并不意味着对言语化的因果控制。主要贡献是形式化 endognostics，证明行为评估与内部读取在常见情形下系统性不一致，且线性可解码性与因果控制相互解耦。

title: D3GS: Depth, DINO, and RGB Diffusion Co-Guided 3D Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Reconstruction
summary: Novel view synthesis from sparse inputs remains challenging for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) due to ambiguous geometry, cross-view inconsistency, and missing details in under-constrained regions, resulting in degraded reconstruction and unstable rendering. To tackle these issues, we propose D$^{3}$GS, a Depth-DINO-Diffusion guided sparse-view Gaussian reconstruction framework that jointly enhances geometry and appearance. D$^{3}$GS first recovers a high-resolution, metric depth map via diffusion-based completion and DPT (Dense Prediction Transformer) refinement, providing robust Gaussian initialization and geometric constraints. Then, a DINO-guided view-consistent learning is introduced to augment Gaussian attributes with structural features, improving multi-view consistency. Finally, a diffusion-based Gaussian refinement module injects generative priors into an iterative optimization strategy, enhancing high-frequency geometric and appearance details within the Gaussian representation. Experiments on DTU, LLFF, and Mip-NeRF 360 show that D$^{3}$GS achieves consistent and substantial improvements over strong baselines, with ablation studies validating the effectiveness and complementary roles of each component.

AI.tldr: 提出D3GS框架，通过深度扩散补全、DINO引导的视图一致性学习和扩散式高斯精修，联合增强稀疏视角下3DGS的几何与外观重建质量。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯溅射（3DGS）在稀疏输入下的新视角合成面临几何模糊、跨视图不一致以及欠约束区域细节缺失等问题，导致重建质量下降与渲染不稳定。
AI.method: D3GS包含三个模块：（1）基于扩散补全与DPT细化恢复高分辨率度量深度图，为高斯提供稳健初始化与几何约束；（2）DINO引导的视图一致性学习，用结构特征增强高斯属性以提升多视图一致性；（3）基于扩散的高斯精修模块，将生成先验注入迭代优化，增强高频几何与外观细节。
AI.result: 在DTU、LLFF和Mip-NeRF 360数据集上，D3GS相较强基线取得一致且显著的性能提升；消融实验验证了各模块的有效性及其互补作用。
AI.conclusion: D3GS通过深度、DINO结构与扩散生成先验的协同引导，有效缓解稀疏视角3DGS的几何与外观退化问题，实现稳定且高质量的新视角合成。

title: Expansion Counts under Standard A* Tie-Breaking Strategies on the Final Plateau
summary: In the A* search algorithm, the tie-breaking strategies for nodes with the same $f$-value determines which states A* expands on the final $f$-layer. For nine standard tie-breaking strategies, we show that under a consistent heuristic, every pair has positive-cost instances favoring each strategy over the other by an arbitrarily large additive expansion gap. A parameterized unit-cost grid example also gives unbounded expansion-count ratios between low-$h$ with FIFO and LIFO. In unit-cost search with $h > 0$ at non-goals, exact heuristic values near the goal lead to complementary extremal results: low-$h$ minimizes the number of remaining expansions from a common configuration within the perfect region, while high-$h$ maximizes the total number of expansions when every final-plateau state with $h=1$ is a goal predecessor. Finally, with the evaluation function $f_α = g + αh$, when $h>0$ at non-goals, every heuristic weight $0 \leq α<1$ eliminates tie-breaking sensitivity, and all tie-breaking strategies expand the same set of states.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了A*中9种标准平局打破策略的展开行为差异：一致性启发式下任意两策略间均存在正代价实例产生任意大的展开差距；单位代价下low-h与high-h呈现互补极值；权重0≤α<1可消除平局敏感性。
AI.motivation: A*中相同f值节点的平局打破策略决定最终f层上展开哪些状态，但不同策略之间的展开量差异缺乏系统性刻画，本文旨在量化这些差异及其产生条件。
AI.method: 针对9种标准平局打破策略，构造正代价实例进行成对比较分析；设计参数化的单位代价网格实例考察low-h与LIFO/FIFO的展开比；在单位代价搜索中分析精确启发式值在目标附近的极值行为；并研究评价函数f_α=g+αh在权重0≤α<1下的表现。
AI.result: 一致性启发式下，任意两种平局打破策略都存在正代价实例，使一方以任意大的加性展开差距优于另一方；参数化单位代价网格实例显示low-h配合FIFO与LIFO之间展开数比无界。单位代价搜索（非目标点h>0）中，目标附近精确启发式值导致互补的极值结果：low-h在完美区域内从同一配置起最小化剩余展开数，而high-h在最终平台上每个h=1状态均为目标前驱时最大化总展开数。当f_α=g+αh且非目标点h>0时，任何0≤α<1的权重都消除平局敏感性，所有平局策略展开相同状态集。
AI.conclusion: 平局打破策略在A*中具有显著且可任意放大的影响，但在单位代价精确启发式与加权评价函数（0≤α<1）条件下，这种敏感性可被结构性消除，为策略选择提供了理论依据。

title: Team DArgk at the 2026 ELOQUENT lab for evaluating generative language model quality: Residuals of Humanity: AI Detection Evasion via GRPO Fine-Tuning
comment: Accepted for Working Notes of the Conference and Labs of the Evaluation Forum (CLEF 2026)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent and coherent text that is increasingly difficult to distinguish from human writing, motivating the development of automatic AI-generated text detectors. However, the robustness of such detectors under adversarial generation remains uncertain. This paper presents SHADE (Stochastic Human-like generation via Adversarial Detector Evasion), a reinforcement learning framework that formulates detector evasion as a policy optimization problem. Instead of applying post-hoc perturbations or prompting-based rewriting, SHADE fine-tunes an instruction-tuned LLaMA model with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), using feedback from a surrogate detector based on the PAN 2025 mdok system. Our experiments show that full fine-tuning with a small KL regularization penalty achieves $98.5\%$ surrogate evasion, compared to $1.5\%$ for the base model, while LoRA-based adaptation is substantially less effective under regularization. Linguistic analysis reveals that successful evasion is associated with shorter, simpler, and less lexically diverse outputs, suggesting that high detector evasion does not necessarily correspond to more human-like writing. In the official Voight-Kampff competition setting, our submissions ranked sixth and seventh, indicating that optimization against a single surrogate detector only partially transfers to unseen evaluation classifiers. These results highlight both the potential and limitations of reinforcement learning for adversarial AI-text generation and motivate more robust, multi-detector evaluation protocols for AI-generated text detection.

AI.tldr: SHADE：用GRPO强化学习微调LLaMA以逃避AI文本检测器，全量微调达98.5%替代检测器规避率，但官方竞赛仅排第六、七名，迁移性有限。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的文本越来越难以与人类写作区分，推动了自动AI文本检测器的发展；但检测器在对抗性生成下的鲁棒性仍不明确，需要研究检测器规避的可行性与边界。
AI.method: 提出SHADE框架，将检测器规避建模为策略优化问题。不采用事后扰动或提示改写，而是用GRPO对指令微调后的LLaMA进行微调，奖励信号来自基于PAN 2025 mdok系统构建的替代检测器。对比全量微调与LoRA适配，并设置KL正则化。
AI.result: 全量微调配合小KL惩罚实现98.5%的替代检测器规避率，基线模型仅1.5%；LoRA在正则化下效果明显较差。语言分析显示成功规避的文本更短、更简单、词汇多样性更低。在Voight-Kampff官方竞赛中提交结果排名第六和第七。
AI.conclusion: 针对单一替代检测器的优化只能部分迁移到未见过的评估分类器；高规避率不等于更像人类写作。结果既展示了强化学习用于对抗性AI文本生成的潜力，也暴露其局限，呼吁采用更鲁棒的多检测器评估协议。

title: An Evolutionary Agentic Approach for Open-ended Image Quality Perception
summary: Generative models are rapidly expanding image quality assessment (IQA) beyond traditional fidelity factors to emerging dimensions such as physical plausibility and text-rendering correctness. However, existing IQA models rely on fixed definitions and heavy supervision, making them difficult to extend to open-ended perceptual dimensions. We identify holistic bias as an important limitation: when scoring an unseen dimension, models reuse generic quality priors, leading to scoring errors and rank inversion. To address this, we propose PACE (Perceptual Agentic Collaborative Evolution), a training-free multi-agent framework that formulates open-ended IQA as explicit protocol construction. Given a target dimension, PACE uses collaborative agents to construct an evaluation protocol composed of verifiable Visual Question Answering (VQA) probes, grounding evaluation in concrete visual evidence rather than holistic impressions. The resulting protocol is calibrated using only four human-annotated images per dimension, while a dual-track scoring mechanism aligns model perception with human scoring scales. Across traditional IQA, structural fidelity, context-aware aesthetics, and newly defined open-ended dimensions, PACE consistently improves its MLLM backbone, achieving competitive performance across diverse IQA settings, and reduces the Holistic Override Rate (HOR) from 44.4\% to 8.6\%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACE，一个免训练的多智能体协作演化框架，将开放式图像质量评估（IQA）转化为显式协议构建，通过可验证的VQA探针缓解整体性偏差，显著降低HOR并提升多维度IQA性能。
AI.motivation: 生成模型的兴起使IQA从传统保真度扩展到物理合理性、文本渲染正确性等开放式感知维度。现有IQA模型依赖固定定义与重监督，难以扩展；且存在"整体性偏差"——评分未见维度时复用通用质量先验，导致评分错误与排序反转。
AI.method: 提出PACE（Perceptual Agentic Collaborative Evolution），一个免训练的多智能体框架，将开放式IQA形式化为显式协议构建：针对目标维度，协作智能体构建由可验证VQA探针组成的评测协议，将评估扎根于具体视觉证据；协议仅需每维度4张人工标注图像进行校准，并采用双轨评分机制对齐模型感知与人类评分尺度。
AI.result: 在传统IQA、结构保真度、上下文感知美学及新定义的开放式维度上，PACE持续提升其MLLM主干性能，在多样IQA设定中达到有竞争力表现，并将整体性覆盖率（HOR）从44.4%降至8.6%。
AI.conclusion: 将开放式IQA表述为可验证协议构建、以具体视觉证据替代整体印象，是缓解整体性偏差、实现免训练可扩展IQA的有效途径。

title: TicTacBench: Benchmarking Timing Closure Capabilities of Coding Agents
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have led to the emergence of coding agents capable of performing complex engineering tasks, including register-transfer level (RTL) design and optimization. Existing RTL benchmarks mainly evaluate functional correctness and performance, power, and area (PPA) of the generated RTL designs, leaving agents' ability for \emph{timing closure} under-evaluated. We propose TicTacBench, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate coding agents' capabilities for RTL-level timing closure under post-place-and-route (post-PnR) evaluation. TicTacBench contains 30 diverse tasks, each provided with a suboptimal RTL design, realistic timing constraints, functional equivalence verification, and timing reports. With over 300 runs of coding agents driven by 8 frontier LLMs, we find that even the best agent can only close 53.3\% of tasks with 7.18\% area-delay product (ADP) degradation and 8.83\% energy-delay-squared product (EDDP) improvement on average. We identify common failure categories that explain why agents fail to close timing. Then we propose TicTacSkill, a new method that guides agents to follow standard timing-closure procedures and improves the Timing Closure Rate by 9\%. These results suggest that while coding agents have made significant progress in RTL design, their timing-closure capability still has substantial room for improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出TicTacBench基准，在post-PnR评估下衡量编码智能体的RTL时序收敛能力，并给出改进方法TicTacSkill。
AI.motivation: 现有RTL基准主要评估生成设计的功能正确性与PPA，忽视了智能体在时序收敛方面的能力，缺乏针对性评测。
AI.method: 构建TicTacBench，含30个多样化任务，每个提供次优RTL设计、真实时序约束、功能等价性验证与时序报告；用8个前沿LLM驱动的编码智能体进行300余次实验；并提出TicTacSkill，引导智能体遵循标准时序收敛流程。
AI.result: 最佳智能体仅收敛53.3%任务，平均ADP恶化7.18%、EDDP改善8.83%；归纳出常见失败类别；TicTacSkill将时序收敛率提升9%。
AI.conclusion: 编码智能体在RTL设计上进展显著，但时序收敛能力仍有很大提升空间。

title: EAVer: Long-Form Factuality Verification as an End-to-End Agentic Policy
summary: Long-form factuality verification is commonly implemented as a static decompose-search-verify pipeline, with separately prompted modules processing claims and invoking external search. Treating claims independently makes LLM and search calls scale with claim count and causes repeated searches for overlapping evidence about related claims. We introduce EAVer, an End-to-end Agentic Verifier that learns to control the complete response-level verification workflow as a unified policy. EAVer groups semantically related claims, routes each group to direct verification or targeted search based on confidence, and keeps evidence returned by search in compact in-context memos for cross-claim reuse. To train this policy, we develop a privileged-teacher synthesis pipeline that converts gold claim annotations into executable multi-turn tool-interaction trajectories with live search rather than post-hoc rationales. Structural, label-alignment, tool-use, search-budget, and leakage checks yield 1,447 quality-controlled trajectories. We further construct 794 bidirectional same-trajectory preference pairs that keep claim grouping, search, and evidence fixed, enabling decision-focused Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) over factuality-decision tokens. The results with Qwen3-8B show that EAVer outperforms the strongest search-based baseline on each benchmark by 2.88 Macro-F1 points on VeriFastScore and 4.73 points on the out-of-distribution FaStFact-Bench, while using about 80% fewer searches than the most search-efficient baseline. Moreover, EAVer consistently improves performance across models ranging from 4B to 32B parameters, demonstrating its strong generalizability.

AI.tldr: EAVer是一个端到端智能体式长文事实性验证器，将整个响应级验证流程（主张分组、路由、搜索、证据复用）统一为单一策略，并借助特权教师合成的多轮工具交互轨迹与DPO训练，在提升Macro-F1的同时将搜索次数减少约80%。
AI.motivation: 现有长文事实性验证普遍采用静态的"分解-检索-验证"流水线，各模块独立提示、分别处理主张并调用外部搜索。独立处理主张导致LLM与搜索调用量随主张数量线性增长，且对相互关联的主张反复检索重叠证据，效率低下且缺乏全局协同。
AI.method: 提出EAVer，把完整验证工作流建模为统一策略：将语义相关主张分组，依据置信度将每组路由至直接验证或定向搜索，并以紧凑的上下文备忘（memo）保存检索证据供跨主张复用。训练上构建特权教师合成流水线，将金标主张标注转化为带实时搜索的可执行多轮工具交互轨迹（而非事后理由），经结构、标签对齐、工具使用、搜索预算与泄漏等检查得到1,447条质控轨迹；并构造794条双向同轨迹偏好对（固定分组、搜索与证据），在事实性决策token上进行聚焦决策的DPO。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B上，EAVer在各基准上均优于最强的基于搜索的基线：VeriFastScore上Macro-F1高出2.88分，分布外FaStFact-Bench上高出4.73分，同时搜索次数比最省搜索的基线减少约80%。此外，EAVer在4B至32B参数范围的模型上均带来稳定提升，展现出良好的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 将长文事实性验证从静态模块化流水线重构为端到端可学习的智能体策略，可在显著降低搜索开销的同时提升验证准确度，且该范式对不同规模模型具有可移植性与泛化能力。

title: RewardVerse: Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization for Video Reward Modeling
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is vital for optimizing video generation models, with a robust reward model (RM) serving as the cornerstone. However, existing video reward models often produce unstable scalar scores because they directly map complex, subjective video quality into a single score without explicit evaluation criteria. This leads to scalar drift, where the scoring scale collapses or shifts across different prompts, making the reward unreliable for RL. Drawing inspiration from professional human annotation engineering, we address this problem with RewardVerse, a rubric-based video reward framework that introduces a dynamic rubric as an intermediate representation between the evaluation query and the scorer. Instead of unconstrained direct scoring, RewardVerse first generates explicit evaluation criteria and then performs rubric-guided scoring, providing a stable semantic anchor that mitigates scalar drift. To efficiently optimize this collaborative pipeline, we propose Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization (RGPO), a two-stage training algorithm. RGPO first warms up the scorer using self-evolving seed rubrics and then jointly optimizes the rubric generator to produce query-adaptive evaluation criteria while continuously aligning the scorer with human ratings. Extensive experiments on the 16-dimensional EvalVerse benchmark and external datasets demonstrate that RewardVerse mitigates scalar drift, achieves state-of-the-art performance on both pointwise and pairwise evaluation, and provides a robust and interpretable reward signal for RL in video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于评分细则（rubric）的视频奖励模型框架 RewardVerse 及两阶段训练算法 RGPO，通过引入动态 rubric 作为中间表示缓解标量漂移，在视频生成强化学习中提供稳定、可解释的奖励信号。
AI.motivation: 强化学习对视频生成模型的优化至关重要，其核心是稳健的奖励模型。但现有视频奖励模型缺乏显式评价标准，直接将复杂、主观的视频质量映射为单一分数，导致标量漂移：评分尺度在不同提示下崩溃或偏移，使奖励对强化学习不可靠。受专业人工标注工程启发，需要引入显式评价标准来稳定评分。
AI.method: 提出 RewardVerse，一种基于评分细则的视频奖励框架，在评估查询与评分器之间引入动态 rubric 作为中间表示：先生成显式评价标准，再进行 rubric 引导的评分，从而提供稳定的语义锚点。为高效优化该协同流程，提出 Rubric-Guided Policy Optimization（RGPO）两阶段训练算法：第一阶段用自演化的种子 rubric 预热评分器；第二阶段联合优化 rubric 生成器以产生查询自适应的评价标准，同时持续将评分器与人类评分对齐。
AI.result: 在 16 维 EvalVerse 基准及外部数据集上的大量实验表明，RewardVerse 缓解了标量漂移，在逐点（pointwise）和成对（pairwise）评估上均达到最优性能，并为视频生成的强化学习提供了稳健且可解释的奖励信号。
AI.conclusion: RewardVerse 通过 rubric 中间表示与 RGPO 训练算法，有效解决了视频奖励模型的标量漂移问题，实现了 SOTA 的评估性能，并为视频生成强化学习提供了稳定、可解释的奖励信号。

title: Leaky-integrator reconstruction: taming error accumulation in recursive differenced time-series forecasting
summary: We introduce leaky-integrator reconstruction, a training-free method that cures the error accumulation of recursive differenced forecasting. Our first contribution is diagnostic: predicting one-step changes and integrating them by cumulative summation, the standard remedy for non-stationarity, is a discrete integrator with a pole on the unit circle, and we show this makes recursive rollout of a nonlinear model diverge, its 336-step error reaching several times that of a well-behaved forecaster (normalised MAE 1.6-3.8 versus about 0.8) across every neural architecture tested. Our second, central contribution is the fix: move the pole inside the unit circle with a leaky integrator H(z) = 1/(1 - gamma z^-1), gamma < 1, which provably bounds the accumulated error variance. Applied at reconstruction time with a single fixed gamma=0.9 (no retraining, a two-line change to any deployed one-step or foundation-model forecaster), it shrinks error at every horizon, the mean gain over seven diverging architectures and twenty datasets growing from ~3% at H=24 to 23% at H=96, 37% at H=192 and 51% (43-74% across those architectures) at H=336 (78% with an oracle pole). Crucially, it is provably inert where no pathology exists (stable or joint predictors already at the irreducible rate), making it a safe, general default.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 leaky-integrator reconstruction，一种无需训练的递归差分预测修正方法：用泄漏积分器将累积求和带来的单位圆极点移入圆内，从而证明性地抑制误差累积，在长时域上大幅降低误差，且对无病态模型保持惰性。
AI.motivation: 递归差分预测（先预测一阶差分再累积求和）是应对非平稳性的标准做法，但其递归展开会导致误差累积乃至发散。作者希望从信号系统角度诊断该问题根源，并给出无需重训、可普遍适用的修复方案，同时避免在不存在病态的情形下损害性能。
