AI.method: 首先做诊断：将累积求和视为单位圆上有极点的离散积分器，证明它使非线性模型的递归展开发散。随后提出修复：用泄漏积分器 H(z)=1/(1-γz^{-1})（γ<1）将极点移入单位圆内，并证明其可界定累积误差方差。在重建阶段应用单一固定 γ=0.9，无需重训，对任意已部署的一步预测器或基础模型预测器仅需两行改动（另报告 oracle pole 变体）。
AI.result: 在所有测试的神经网络架构上，累积求和式递归展开的 336 步归一化 MAE 达 1.6-3.8，而表现良好的预测器约为 0.8。γ=0.9 的泄漏积分器在每个预测时域都降低误差：七个发散架构与二十个数据集上的平均增益从 H=24 的约 3% 增至 H=96 的 23%、H=192 的 37%、H=336 的 51%（各架构 43-74%），使用 oracle pole 时达 78%。
AI.conclusion: 误差累积可归因于单位圆极点导致的发散。泄漏积分器以极简、免训练的方式修复该问题，长时域增益显著；且在没有病态（已稳定或联合预测器已达不可约误差率）时被证明为惰性，因此可作为安全、通用的默认重建方式。

title: From Trait Vectors to Circuits: Tracing Refusal and Sycophancy Through Language Models
summary: A direction in activation space that changes safety-relevant behavior when steered is not necessarily one the model uses to produce that behavior on its own. We therefore ask whether steering acts through the computation of the unmodified model or through a different set of components, studying two traits whose directions have been extracted and validated in prior work: refusal and sycophancy in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. For each, we use the trait vector to split the computation into a reconstruction circuit before the vector and a transmission circuit after it. We then test whether restoring the coordinate returns behavior removed by ablation. For refusal, both circuits are compact and faithful, restoring the coordinate alone recovers almost all of the refusal signal lost to ablation, and a circuit built around the vector matches the faithfulness of a direct input-to-output circuit at roughly half the edges. For sycophancy, transmission is compact, but reconstruction is broader and only partially faithful. Circuits that transmit a steering intervention are therefore not automatically the circuits that produce the behavior, and we report the counterfactual, target, and behavioral test for every circuit accordingly.

AI.tldr: 该论文区分"激活空间中的可操控方向"与"模型自然产生该行为所用的计算路径"，通过将计算拆分为方向向量前的重构电路与后的传输电路，检验该向量是否真正参与模型自身的计算。
AI.motivation: 先前工作提取并验证了与安全相关行为（如拒答、谄媚）对应的激活方向向量，但一个方向在被干预时能改变行为，并不意味着模型在自然产生该行为时就使用了该方向，二者可能被混淆。作者希望通过电路层面的分析澄清这一区别。
AI.method: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上针对拒答与谄媚两种特质，利用特质向量将计算划分为向量之前的重构电路与向量之后的传输电路；随后通过消融移除行为，检验仅恢复该向量坐标能否复原行为，并比较围绕该向量构建的电路与直接输入到输出的电路在忠实度上的差异及边数开销。
AI.result: 对拒答而言，两个电路都紧凑且忠实，仅恢复坐标即可找回几乎全部因消融损失的拒答信号，且围绕向量构建的电路以约一半的边数达到与直接输入—输出电路相当的忠实度。对谄媚而言，传输电路紧凑，但重构电路更宽泛且仅部分忠实。
AI.conclusion: 传输操控干预的电路并不自动等同于产生该行为的电路，因此对每个电路都分别报告反事实、目标与行为三类测试，以区分操控有效性与模型自然计算所用路径。

title: CLEAR: Complex Learned Explicit Analytical Regularization for Ultra-Accelerated 4D Flow CMR Reconstruction
summary: While compressed-sensing regularizers enable interpretable reconstruction of 4D Flow CMR through transparent variational objectives, their hand-crafted nature is too restrictive under high acceleration. State-of-the-art learning-based approaches mitigate this, but typically encode regularization implicitly through unrolled network modules, which limits their interpretability. To address this limitation, we propose CLEAR, designed to combine the interpretability of compressed sensing with the flexibility of learned models. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first learned regularizer for a 4D reconstruction task. In the ultra-accelerated \(10\times\)--\(50\times\) regime of the CMRx4DFlow2026 challenge, CLEAR outperforms compressed sensing locally low-rank (LLR) and the popular variational network FlowVN, while using less than 10k parameters and preserving an interpretable regularization structure.

AI.tldr: 提出CLEAR：首个面向4D重建任务的可学习正则化器，兼顾压缩感知的可解释性与学习模型的灵活性，在10×–50×超加速4D Flow CMR重建中优于LLR压缩感知与FlowVN。
AI.motivation: 压缩感知正则化器能通过透明的变分目标实现可解释的4D Flow CMR重建，但手工设计的正则项在高加速倍率下约束过强；现有学习类方法虽能缓解该问题，却通常借助展开网络模块隐式编码正则化，损失了可解释性。因此需要兼具二者优势的方案。
AI.method: 提出CLEAR，将压缩感知的可解释性与学习模型的灵活性结合，构建面向4D重建任务的可学习正则化器（据作者所知为该类任务首例）。该方法参数量少于10k，并保留了可解释的正则化结构。
AI.result: 在CMRx4DFlow2026挑战赛的10×–50×超加速场景下，CLEAR优于压缩感知局部低秩（LLR）方法以及流行的变分网络FlowVN，且参数量不足10k，同时保持可解释的正则化结构。
AI.conclusion: CLEAR以极小的参数开销在超加速4D Flow CMR重建中取得优于LLR与FlowVN的表现，并保持正则化结构的可解释性，验证了可学习正则化器在4D重建任务中的可行性与优势。

title: AgentBetta: Verification-Driven Adaptive Configuration of an AI Nano-Agent through Selective Expansion and Verified Contraction
summary: Large language model agents are typically deployed with predefined configurations, although the required model capability, context, tools, permissions, memory, and computational resources can vary substantially across tasks. This study develops and evaluates AgentBetta, an adaptive AI Nano-Agent framework that represents these factors as an executable configuration and updates them through verification-driven diagnosis, selective expansion, and verification-based counterfactual contraction. The evaluation distinguishes controlled mechanism validation from external agent comparisons. On the AB-ConfigBench benchmark, AgentBetta achieved 91.38% verified success while reducing median context allocation from 64,000 to 8,000 context characters and median tool exposure from five tools to zero compared with the fully provisioned configuration. The configuration-deficiency diagnosis achieved a macro-F1 score of 0.819 with precision of 1.000 across the evaluated dimensions, and selective expansion avoided unnecessary changes to unrelated configuration dimensions. Post-success contraction preserved verification outcomes in 56.41% of evaluated one-dimension contraction probes, indicating that some successful configurations contained removable capability under the tested conditions. External evaluations indicate that adaptive configuration can improve the balance between verified task completion and capability exposure; however, the results vary across benchmarks and agent families. In particular, the cross-family replication did not reproduce the primary-backbone accuracy ordering, and specialized systems remained advantageous for certain task domains. These results support interpreting AgentBetta as a configuration-adaptation mechanism that regulates capability allocation and inference expenditure rather than as a universal replacement for specialized agent architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出并评估自适应 AI Nano-Agent 框架 AgentBetta，将模型能力、上下文、工具、权限、记忆与算力等表示为可执行配置，并通过验证驱动的诊断、选择性扩展与反事实收缩进行更新；在 AB-ConfigBench 上取得 91.38% 验证成功率，同时大幅降低上下文与工具暴露。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型智能体通常以预定义配置部署，但不同任务对模型能力、上下文、工具、权限、记忆和计算资源的需求差异显著，固定配置易导致能力过度暴露或不足，因此需要一种自适应配置机制来平衡验证任务完成与能力分配。
AI.method: 提出 AgentBetta 自适应 AI Nano-Agent 框架，将相关因素建模为可执行配置，并通过三类机制更新：验证驱动的配置缺陷诊断、选择性扩展（仅修改必要维度）以及基于验证的反事实收缩。评估区分受控机制验证与外部智能体对比，在 AB-ConfigBench 上进行测试并开展跨家族复现。
AI.result: 在 AB-ConfigBench 上，AgentBetta 达到 91.38% 验证成功率，中位上下文字符分配由 64,000 降至 8,000，中位工具暴露由 5 个降至 0（相较于全量供给配置）。配置缺陷诊断在各评估维度上宏平均 F1 为 0.819，精确率为 1.000；选择性扩展避免了对无关配置维度的不必要改动。成功后收缩在一维收缩探测中 56.41% 保持验证结果，表明部分成功配置含可移除能力。外部评估显示自适应配置可改善验证任务完成与能力暴露的平衡，但结果随基准与智能体家族变化；跨家族复现未复现主干模型准确率排序，专用系统在特定任务域仍具优势。
AI.conclusion: AgentBetta 应被理解为一种调节能力分配与推理开销的配置自适应机制，而非专用智能体架构的通用替代方案；其有效性依赖于基准与智能体家族，专用系统在部分任务域依然具有优势。

title: Do LLMs Choose Like Humans? Using Cognitive Theory to Evaluate LLM Decision-Making
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit a range of human-like decision-making behaviors, but whether these reflect similar underlying mechanisms or surface-level mimicry remains unclear. We evaluate whether LLM context sensitivity aligns with a cognitive economic theory that explains human behavior through problem categorization and attention allocation. Across 12 open-source and commercial LLMs on a novel 140,000-trial product choice benchmark, context induces human-like shifts in choice and problem categorization, but does not reliably reweight attention between features like price and quality. Neither scale nor chain-of-thought reasoning reliably attenuates context sensitivity or generates human-like behavior. These results suggest that LLM decision mechanisms are distinct from human ones.

AI.tldr: 该研究用14万试次的产品选择基准测试12个开源与商业LLM，发现LLM虽表现出类人的情境敏感性与问题分类转变，但未可靠地重新分配对价格、质量等特征的注意力，且规模与思维链均无法稳定产生类人行为，说明其决策机制与人类不同。
AI.motivation: LLM表现出类人的决策行为，但这种行为究竟反映与人类相似的底层机制，还是仅停留在表层模仿，尚不明确。作者希望借助认知经济学理论（通过问题分类与注意力分配解释人类行为）来检验LLM的情境敏感性是否与该理论对齐，从而判断其决策机制的本质。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含140,000个试次的新型产品选择基准，对12个开源与商业LLM进行评测，考察其在情境变化下是否符合认知经济学理论所预测的问题分类转变与注意力权重重分配；同时检验模型规模与思维链（chain-of-thought）推理是否能减弱情境敏感性或生成类人行为。
AI.result: 情境确实引发了类人的选择转变与问题分类变化，但未能可靠地重新分配价格与质量等特征之间的注意力权重。模型规模和思维链推理均无法稳定地削弱情境敏感性，也无法产生类人行为。
AI.conclusion: LLM的决策机制与人类的决策机制存在本质区别，其类人行为更可能是表层模仿而非共享相同的认知过程。

title: General Collaborative Intelligence: Architecting Cognition for Resilient Multi-Agent Ecosystems
summary: Multi-agent unmanned systems are moving from isolated, ego-centric sensing toward collaborative intelligence, in which distributed agents exchange compact features to overcome a local observation trap that no single agent can escape: occlusions, finite sensor range, and environmental degradation. The field has matured across architectural, communication, embodied, resilience, and trust dimensions, yet existing surveys examine these dimensions in isolation and rarely expose their dependencies. This review offers a unified synthesis through two complementary lenses. The first is a five-dimensional taxonomy spanning collaboration stage, communication paradigm, fusion architecture, learning strategy, and application domain. The second is three cognitive synergy conditions, Semantic Disambiguation, Pragmatic Information Exchange, and Proactive Informational Foraging, that turn cognitive synergy into operational criteria. Across these lenses we survey collaboration architectures and topologies, neural-communication co-design that treats the channel as a differentiable pipeline component, embodied action-perception loops via multi-agent reinforcement learning, and resilience mechanisms for synchronization, uncertainty quantification, and label-efficient learning. We then map these advances onto four operational domains, V2X, unmanned aerial, industrial logistics, and smart cities, and onto the safety-privacy-utility triad. To counter benchmark saturation and evaluation fragmentation, we propose GCI-Bench, a five-pillar scoring protocol with a maturity model that makes the trade-offs of collaborative methods comparable across studies. A critical reflection on reproducibility, the sim-to-real gulf, and conditions under which collaboration degrades performance identifies open challenges and charts directions toward general collaborative intelligence under real-world uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文是多智能体无人系统协作智能的综述，以五维分类法与三项认知协同条件统一架构、通信、具身、韧性与信任等分散视角，映射至V2X、无人机、工业物流与智慧城市四大领域及安全-隐私-效用三角，并提出GCI-Bench五支柱评分协议与成熟度模型以缓解评测饱和与碎片化，同时反思可复现性、仿真到现实鸿沟及协作负效应并指出开放挑战。
AI.motivation: 多智能体无人系统正从孤立、以自我为中心的感知转向协作智能，通过交换紧凑特征克服单智能体无法摆脱的局部观测陷阱（遮挡、有限感知范围、环境退化）。该领域已在架构、通信、具身、韧性与信任等维度成熟，但既有综述将这些维度孤立考察，很少揭示其相互依赖关系，因此需要统一综合。
AI.method: 采用两个互补视角进行统一综述。其一为五维分类法，涵盖协作阶段、通信范式、融合架构、学习策略与应用领域；其二为三项认知协同条件——语义消歧、语用信息交换与主动信息觅食——将认知协同转化为可操作判据。在此基础上综述协作架构与拓扑、将信道视为可微管线组件的神经通信协同设计、基于多智能体强化学习的具身动作-感知回路，以及面向同步、不确定性量化与标签高效学习的韧性机制；并将进展映射到V2X、无人机、工业物流与智慧城市四大运行领域及安全-隐私-效用三角。此外提出GCI-Bench五支柱评分协议与成熟度模型。
AI.result: 形成跨维度依赖的统一图景，并通过GCI-Bench五支柱评分协议与成熟度模型，使协作方法的权衡在不同研究之间可比，从而应对基准饱和与评测碎片化问题。
AI.conclusion: 对可复现性、仿真到现实鸿沟以及协作导致性能退化等条件进行批判性反思，识别开放挑战，并勾勒出面向真实世界不确定性下通用协作智能的发展方向。

title: Are Human-Aligned Models Models of Humans? A Turing-Test Gap in Preference Alignment
summary: Human-feedback alignment has made language models useful assistants and is commonly described as aligning them with humans. However, the responses people prefer from an AI need not be the responses they themselves would give. We distinguish alignment with human preferences from alignment with human behavior, and show that alignment with human preferences can make model behavior less human-like even when both preferences and responses come entirely from humans. We call this the Turing-test gap. We show that preference alignment preserves the human response distribution only under a restrictive condition, and find no consistent evidence that real human preferences satisfy it. Empirically, the loss of human-response likelihood increases with the strength of preference weighting, regardless of its direction, and the gap also appears under standard DPO. These results establish human-likeness as an explicit dimension of alignment rather than something assumed to follow from preference alignment.

AI.tldr: 论文区分了"对齐人类偏好"与"对齐人类行为"，指出即使偏好和回答都来自人类，偏好对齐也会使模型行为偏离人类行为分布，称之为"图灵测试差距"。理论分析表明偏好对齐仅在严苛条件下才能保持人类回答分布，且实证发现真实人类偏好并不满足该条件，DPO下同样存在此差距。
AI.motivation: 当前领域普遍将基于人类反馈的对齐等同于"使模型与人类对齐"，但人们偏好的回答未必就是他们自己会给出的回答。作者认为这一混淆掩盖了一个关键问题：偏好对齐可能降低模型行为的人类相似度，因此需要明确区分并量化这一差距。
AI.method: 理论上刻画偏好对齐保持人类回答分布的充要（受限）条件，并检验真实人类偏好是否满足；实证上分析人类回答似然损失随偏好加权强度的变化规律，并在标准DPO训练下验证该差距的存在。
AI.result: 未有一致证据表明真实人类偏好满足保持人类回答分布的条件；人类回答似然损失随偏好加权强度增加而增大，且与偏好方向无关；标准DPO下同样出现该差距。
AI.conclusion: 人类相似度应被视为对齐的一个显式独立维度，而不能预设它会从偏好对齐中自动获得。

title: Swiss-Knife: A Framework for Reconfigurable Externalised Multi-Objective Alignment at Decode Time
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures, includes technical appendix and proofs
summary: Decode-time alignment methods steer a frozen language model by scoring candidate continuations with an external reward and selecting the maximiser. We argue that this shared design is a single degenerate point in a much larger space. We introduce Swiss-Knife, a framework for externalised multi-objective alignment in which the alignment specification is a first-class runtime object: hot-swappable scoring blades, a batch normaliser, a pairwise aggregation operator, and a selection rule. Six axioms characterise the admissible aggregation operators, and we prove a representation theorem: every operator satisfying them has the form $R_i = \sum_{j \neq i} g((μ_i - μ_j)/s(σ_i,σ_j))$, a two-parameter family containing probit and logistic comparison rules and pointwise argmax as named coordinates. Within it, pairwise aggregation is Lipschitz-stable under adversarial reward contamination while argmax is not, and Candidate-Batch Normalization (CBN) makes the weight simplex invariant to the rescalings under which reward models are only ever identified. Our reference instantiation pairs DPO-LoRA blades with an uncertainty-aware pairwise tournament. Sweeping the helpfulness/honesty/harmlessness simplex, it attains the best balanced frontier of six decode-time methods (harmonic $F_1$ 0.797 vs. 0.750 for the strongest baseline, $p < 10^{-14}$) with the lowest refusal rate and highest helpfulness of any arm, and reconfigures its objectives in 0.05 ms with no gradient computation. Ablating CBN costs 0.217 $F_1$, and the metadata confirms the predicted mechanism: the lowest-variance blade retains 9% of its nominal 33% influence, and the collapse follows the predicted ordering.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Swiss-Knife 框架，将解码时对齐形式化为可热插拔的多目标聚合对象，证明聚合算子的表示定理，并实验验证成对聚合的稳定性与最优平衡前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有解码时对齐方法共享同一退化设计：用外部奖励对候选续写打分并取最大值。作者认为这只是更大设计空间中的单一退化点，缺乏对多目标外部化对齐的系统刻画。
AI.method: 将对齐规范作为一等运行时对象，包含可热插拔评分 blade、批归一化器、成对聚合算子与选择规则。用六条公理刻画可允许的聚合算子，并证明表示定理：满足公理的算子均具 $R_i = \sum_{j \neq i} g((μ_i - μ_j)/s(σ_i,σ_j))$ 形式，含 probit、logistic 与逐点 argmax 为命名坐标。提出 Candidate-Batch Normalization (CBN) 使权重单纯形对奖励模型的重缩放不变；参考实例将 DPO-LoRA blade 与不确定性感知成对锦标赛配对。
AI.result: 在 helpfulness/honesty/harmlessness 单纯形上扫描，取得六种解码时方法中最优平衡前沿（调和 $F_1$ 0.797，最强基线 0.750，$p < 10^{-14}$），且拒绝率最低、有用性最高；可在 0.05 ms 内重配置目标且无需梯度计算。消融 CBN 损失 0.217 $F_1$，元数据证实预测机制：最低方差 blade 仅保留名义 33% 影响力的 9%，崩溃顺序符合理论预测。
AI.conclusion: 解码时对齐不应局限于 argmax 这一退化点；成对聚合在对抗性奖励污染下 Lipschitz 稳定而 argmax 不稳定，CBN 是保持权重单纯形不变性的关键组件，Swiss-Knife 为多目标外部化对齐提供了兼具理论保证与高效重配置的通用框架。

title: M3GA-Wild: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Multi-Modal Multi-session Ground-to-Aerial Place Recognition in Forests
summary: We present M3GA-Wild, the first benchmark for multi-modal, multi-session ground-to-aerial place recognition in forests. M3GA-Wild unifies and extends existing forest localisation datasets, providing a holistic benchmark with synchronised RGB imagery and LiDAR from ground traversals spanning 36 km, aligned high-resolution aerial imagery and multi-altitude LiDAR covering 370 hectares, and accurate geo-referenced 6-DoF poses for precise evaluation. M3GA-Wild captures diverse forest scenes with varying viewpoints, occlusion, and environmental conditions, enabling systematic evaluation of visual, LiDAR, cross-modal, and multi-modal methods. Baseline experiments show that LiDAR-based approaches significantly outperform vision-only methods under severe viewpoint differences, while current multi-modal fusion strategies yield limited gains due to poor cross-modal alignment. By pairing aerial RGB imagery with geo-referenced aerial LiDAR, M3GA-Wild also enables evaluation of foundation models for monocular depth estimation as a cheap source of 3D geometry from forest imagery, with initial experiments revealing shortfalls of current methods. These results highlight key challenges in cross-platform localisation, including modality misalignment and severe domain gaps. M3GA-Wild establishes a new benchmark to support research in robust multi-modal localisation and long-term autonomy in unstructured natural environments. The dataset and code will be available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: M3GA-Wild 是首个面向森林多模态、多会话地空地点识别基准，融合地面 RGB/LiDAR 与航空 RGB/多高度 LiDAR，含 36 km 地面轨迹、370 公顷航空覆盖及 6-DoF 位姿标注，用于系统评估视觉、LiDAR、跨模态与多模态定位方法。
AI.motivation: 现有森林定位数据集在模态、平台、会话覆盖上分散且有限，难以支撑跨平台、长期自主性研究；需要统一的地空多模态基准以系统揭示跨模态对齐与域差异问题。
AI.method: 整合并扩展既有森林定位数据集，构建同步的地面 RGB 与 LiDAR、对齐的高分辨率航空影像与多高度 LiDAR，提供精确地理参考 6-DoF 位姿；设计涵盖视觉、LiDAR、跨模态和多模态方法的基线实验，并利用航空 RGB 与地理参考航空 LiDAR 评估单目深度基础模型作为低成本 3D 几何来源。
AI.result: 在显著视角差异下，LiDAR 方法显著优于纯视觉方法；现有多模态融合因跨模态对齐差而增益有限；单目深度基础模型在森林影像上的 3D 几何估计表现不足。数据涵盖多视角、遮挡与环境变化场景。
AI.conclusion: 跨平台定位的关键挑战在于模态错位与严重域间隙；M3GA-Wild 为新基准，支撑非结构化自然环境中鲁棒多模态定位与长期自主性研究，数据集与代码将在录用后公开。

title: PhysAI-Bench: A Benchmark for LLM-Based Agentic Decision-Making in Autonomous UAV-Centric Physical AI
summary: Recent advances in Physical AI have accelerated the use of foundation models in autonomous systems such as unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), which must perceive, reason, plan, and act in dynamic environments. Existing benchmarks assess physical perception, intuitive physics, embodied navigation, and collaborative reasoning, but rarely evaluate the agentic decision-making required for reliable autonomy. We introduce \textit{PhysAI-Bench}, a benchmark for evaluating this capability. It contains 10,178 standardized decision instances automatically extracted from conversational traces of autonomous UAV missions. Each instance preserves mission context, temporal dependencies, physical constraints, Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool calls, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) interactions, sensor observations, and AI-native 6G network conditions, including latency, packet loss, throughput, edge load, and network slicing. We expose only information preceding each decision, preventing future-event leakage and approximating online decision-making. We evaluate 29 foundation models using a two-stage protocol. We select model-specific configurations from 12 combinations of zero-, three-, and five-shot prompting and four temperatures, tested in three runs on a 35-instance, human-verified development set. We then freeze each selected configuration and evaluate it in three runs on a fixed, episode-disjoint set of 500 instances. GPT-5.3 achieves the highest accuracy (52.00%), followed by GPT-5.2 (49.40%) and Grok~4.5 (49.07%). Few-shot prompting generally improves performance, while temperature has limited influence. The results demonstrate that reliable agentic decision-making in Physical AI remains an open challenge. The dataset is available at https://github.com/maferrag/physai-bench

AI.tldr: 提出PhysAI-Bench基准，用于评估无人机自主任务中的智能体决策能力，包含10178个决策实例，29个基础模型最高准确率仅52%。
AI.motivation: 物理AI基础模型在无人机等自主系统中需完成感知、推理、规划与行动，但现有基准多评估物理感知、直觉物理、具身导航与协作推理，很少评估可靠自主性所需的智能体决策能力。
AI.method: 从自主无人机任务的对话轨迹中自动抽取10178个标准化决策实例，每个实例保留任务上下文、时间依赖、物理约束、MCP工具调用、A2A交互、传感器观测及AI原生6G网络条件（时延、丢包、吞吐、边缘负载、网络切片）。仅暴露决策前的信息以避免未来事件泄漏，逼近在线决策。评估29个基础模型，采用两阶段协议：先在35个经人工验证的开发集上，从零样本、三样本、五样本提示与4种温度共12种组合中选出模型特定配置并运行3次；随后冻结配置，在500个固定、情节不相交实例集上运行3次。
AI.result: GPT-5.3准确率最高（52.00%），其次为GPT-5.2（49.40%）和Grok 4.5（49.07%）。少样本提示总体提升性能，温度影响有限。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明物理AI中可靠的智能体决策仍是未解决的开放挑战。数据集已公开。

title: Assessing Adversarial Robustness of Latent Reasoning Models
summary: Large language models increasingly rely on long chain-of-thought (CoT) trajectories for complex reasoning, but autoregressive generation brings substantial memory and inference costs. Latent reasoning models (LRMs) offer a more efficient alternative by compressing intermediate reasoning into a small number of continuous latent vectors. Despite their efficiency, however, the adversarial robustness of LRMs remains largely underexplored. In this work, we systematically evaluate the robustness of latent reasoning across textual and multimodal settings, covering eight models and six benchmarks. We find that, across our evaluated settings, LRMs are generally less robust than explicit CoT baselines under adversarial perturbations, with particularly severe degradation under white-box attacks. Further analysis reveals distinct failure modes across modalities: textual latent states exhibit brittle dynamics and high sensitivity to specific input patterns, while latent states in multimodal models can remain largely invariant to input perturbations and have limited influence on final predictions. These findings expose robustness limitations of current latent reasoning approaches and highlight the need to jointly consider efficiency and robustness when designing implicit reasoning systems. We have open-sourced our code to facilitate reproduction of our research https://github.com/PKU-ML/latent-reasoning-model-assessment.

AI.tldr: 该文系统评估了潜在推理模型（LRMs）的对抗鲁棒性，发现其整体弱于显式CoT基线，且文本与多模态场景存在不同的失效模式。
AI.motivation: 长链思维（CoT）轨迹虽提升复杂推理能力，但自回归生成带来显著的内存与推理成本；潜在推理模型（LRMs）通过将中间推理压缩为少量连续潜在向量以提升效率，然而其对抗鲁棒性尚未被充分探索。作者因此希望系统评估LRMs的鲁棒性，以揭示效率提升是否以牺牲鲁棒性为代价。
AI.method: 在文本与多模态两种设置下系统评估潜在推理的鲁棒性，覆盖8个模型、6个基准，并在对抗扰动下将LRMs与显式CoT基线进行对比，包含白盒攻击场景，并对不同模态的潜在状态动态与失效模式进行分析。
AI.result: 在所评估的设置中，LRMs通常比显式CoT基线鲁棒性更差，白盒攻击下性能退化尤为严重。进一步分析发现不同模态存在不同失效模式：文本潜在状态动态脆弱、对特定输入模式高度敏感；多模态模型的潜在状态可能对输入扰动基本不变，且对最终预测影响有限。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前潜在推理方法的鲁棒性局限，表明在设计隐式推理系统时需同时兼顾效率与鲁棒性，并开源代码以促进复现。

title: Compressing 3D Gaussian Splatting via Cross-Representation Priors
comment: 14 pages, 8 figures. Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality novel view synthesis but incurs high storage and transmission costs due to dense Gaussian primitives. Recent anchor-based compression reduces per-primitive redundancy, yet redundancy across anchors remains largely unexploited. We propose CRP-GS (Cross-Representation Priors for Gaussian Splatting), a rate-distortion optimized compression framework that leverages cross-representation priors to improve anchor-level entropy modeling. First, a Correspondence-Oriented Hierarchical Structure (COHS) organizes anchors by feature correspondence rather than spatial proximity, constructing root-leaf dependencies so that selected anchors can act as informative priors to conditionally encode others, yielding more accurate likelihood prediction and lower conditional entropy. Second, Shared Feature Aggregation (SFA) extracts globally shared features from a contextual hash grid and injects them into anchor representations, factoring out scene-consistent low-frequency information that would otherwise be redundantly embedded in individual anchors. Both modules are trained under a unified rate-distortion objective to balance bitrate reduction and rendering fidelity. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that CRP-GS achieves a favorable overall rate-distortion trade-off, yielding around 30% average bitrate reduction compared to anchor-based baselines while maintaining comparable rendering quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CRP-GS，一种率失真优化的 3D 高斯泼溅压缩框架，通过跨表征先验改善锚点级熵建模，在保持渲染质量的同时实现约 30% 的平均码率降低。
AI.motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting 虽能实现高质量新视角合成，但稠密高斯基元带来高昂存储与传输开销。现有基于锚点的压缩方法虽降低了单基元冗余，却未充分利用锚点之间的冗余，因此存在进一步压缩的空间。
AI.method: 提出 CRP-GS 框架，包含两个模块：1）对应关系导向层次结构（COHS），按特征对应而非空间邻近组织锚点，构建根-叶依赖关系，使部分锚点作为信息先验对其他锚点进行条件编码，从而获得更准确的似然预测与更低的条件熵；2）共享特征聚合（SFA），从上下文哈希网格中提取全局共享特征并注入锚点表征，分离出场景一致的低频信息，避免其在各锚点中重复嵌入。两模块在统一的率失真目标下联合训练。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，CRP-GS 取得了更优的整体率失真权衡，相比基于锚点的基线方法平均码率降低约 30%，同时保持可比的渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用跨表征先验并显式建模锚点间冗余与场景共享低频信息，可显著提升锚点式 3DGS 压缩效率，实现码率与渲染质量的良好平衡。

title: ScholarStack: Layered Research Asset Orchestration and Cross-Task Reuse for Scientific Agents
summary: Scientific agents support a range of literature-based research tasks, such as retrieval, question answering, evidence-grounded generation, and claim assessment. Most existing systems, however, are organized around individual tasks: the same papers are repeatedly retrieved, segmented, and interpreted, and the understanding built in one task is difficult to reuse in the next. We present ScholarStack, a layered research asset framework that compiles a paper collection into reusable, versioned, and provenance-preserving assets at three complementary levels: source-grounded paper-level statements, domain-level organization, and evidence-grounded cross-paper syntheses. A common access interface returns task-specific views at the evidence granularity each task requires, preserving study conditions, source traceability, and verification status. We instantiate the framework on four task families spanning ten task settings, comparing agents that use the compiled assets with task-specific baselines under matched base models. Quality gains concentrate on tasks that require cross-paper evidence, such as multi-paper question answering and literature review generation, and query-time token cost falls on every task where it is measured, with assets compiled once and reused across tasks. These results suggest that layered research assets can serve as shared infrastructure for scientific agents, shifting literature-based assistance from isolated document processing toward cumulative, evidence-grounded workflows.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ScholarStack，一个将文献集合编译为可复用、版本化、可溯源资产的分层框架（论文级陈述、领域级组织、跨论文证据综合），并验证其在跨论文证据任务上的质量与成本优势。
AI.motivation: 现有科学智能体多围绕单任务组织，同一批论文被反复检索、切分和解读，前序任务积累的理解难以在后续任务中复用，导致效率与知识累积性不足。
AI.method: 提出 ScholarStack 分层研究资产框架，将论文集合编译为三个互补层级的资产：来源支撑的论文级陈述、领域级组织、证据支撑的跨论文综合；提供统一访问接口，按任务所需证据粒度返回任务特定视图，并保留研究条件、来源可追溯性与验证状态。在覆盖十种任务设置的四个任务族上实例化，在匹配基座模型下与任务特定基线对比。
AI.result: 质量提升集中在需要跨论文证据的任务上，如多论文问答与文献综述生成；在可测量的所有任务上，查询阶段 token 成本均下降，因为资产一次编译、跨任务复用。
AI.conclusion: 分层研究资产可作为科学智能体的共享基础设施，推动基于文献的辅助从孤立的文档处理转向累积式、证据支撑的工作流。

title: EvalMem: An Operation-Level Diagnostic Framework for Long-Term Memory Systems
summary: Long-horizon interactions with LLM-based assistants require memory systems that preserve and update user states, preferences, and interaction histories. Existing evaluations report end-to-end QA accuracy and cannot determine whether errors arise from encoding, retrieval, or generation. We introduce EvalMem, an operation-level diagnostic framework with three parallel Examiners. For each query, the Encoding Examiner checks whether the target fact is stored, the Retrieval Examiner assesses whether the native retriever returns usable evidence, and the Generation Examiner tests whether the model can answer from oracle evidence. Their outputs form fine-grained multi-label defect codes. To improve store-level diagnosis, we adapt agentic RAG with a recall-first strategy that searches using both the query and source evidence, increasing recall of present evidence on LoCoMo from 70.2% to 95.6%. Evaluations of seven memory systems on LoCoMo, LongMemEval-S, and dynamic DynaMem-Bench identify retrieval as the most frequently attributed failure layer; in default LoCoMo, retrieval defects reach 22.1%, compared with 7.7% for encoding and 6.5% for generation. Guided by this diagnosis, MemWiki, a search-friendly auxiliary structure built from each system's memory export, improves mean accuracy by 2.5 and 2.3 percentage points on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出操作级诊断框架 EvalMem,通过编码/检索/生成三路 Examiner 定位记忆系统故障层,发现检索为主要失效层,并据此构建 MemWiki 辅助结构提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 长时程 LLM 助手交互依赖能保存并更新用户状态、偏好与交互历史的记忆系统。现有评测仅报告端到端问答准确率,无法判定错误源自编码、检索还是生成,诊断粒度不足。
AI.method: EvalMem 操作级诊断框架,含三类并行 Examiner：Encoding Examiner 检查目标事实是否被存储;Retrieval Examiner 评估原生检索器是否返回可用证据;Generation Examiner 测试模型能否基于 oracle 证据作答。其输出构成细粒度多标签缺陷码。为改进存储层诊断,采用 agentic RAG 的 recall-first 策略,同时用查询与源证据做检索。
AI.result: recall-first 策略将 LoCoMo 上已存在证据的召回率从 70.2% 提升至 95.6%。在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S 与动态 DynaMem-Bench 上评测七个记忆系统,检索被识别为最常归因的失效层;默认 LoCoMo 上检索缺陷占 22.1%,编码 7.7%,生成 6.5%。据此诊断构建的 MemWiki 在 LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval-S 上分别提升平均准确率 2.5 与 2.3 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 操作级、分层归因的评测能揭示端到端指标所掩盖的故障来源,检索是记忆系统的主要瓶颈;该诊断可指导针对性改进结构(如 MemWiki),显著提升系统性能。

title: MixiMotion: One-Step Text-to-Motion Generation via Asymmetric Set Distillation
summary: Iterative text-to-motion generation delivers high-quality and semantically aligned motions but requires multiple network evaluations, resulting in substantial inference latency. We present \textbf{MixiMotion}, a strict one-step text-to-motion generation framework based on offline set distillation. Instead of distilling a single teacher trajectory for each text prompt, MixiMotion constructs an offline bank of multiple teacher motions and aligns teacher and student sample sets through \textbf{asymmetric bidirectional matching}. The teacher-to-student direction promotes coverage of diverse teacher-supported motions, while the student-to-teacher direction suppresses unsupported generations. We further introduce differentiable decoded-space kinematic supervision to complement normalized representation matching with constraints in the decoded motion space. At inference, MixiMotion generates a complete motion sequence with a single network evaluation, without teacher queries, iterative sampling, or candidate ranking. On ViMoGen, MixiMotion achieves a semantic alignment score of $0.835$, outperforming the evaluated one-step baselines and approaching the $0.858$ score of its 50-step HY-Motion-1.0-Lite teacher. In blinded human evaluation, MixiMotion obtains an overall rating of $4.33$, compared with $4.50$ for the teacher, while outperforming the evaluated one-/few-step baselines. Meanwhile, generation latency is reduced from $829.58$\,ms to $9.30$\,ms, corresponding to an $89.2\times$ speedup. These results demonstrate an effective quality--efficiency trade-off for strict one-step text-to-motion generation.

AI.tldr: MixiMotion：基于离线集合蒸馏的严格单步文本到动作生成框架，通过非对称双向匹配与解码空间运动学监督，实现约89.2倍加速并接近教师质量。
AI.motivation: 迭代式文本到动作生成质量高且语义对齐好，但需多次网络前向，推理延迟大。目标是在保持质量的同时实现严格单步生成。
AI.method: 采用离线集合蒸馏：为每个文本提示构建多教师动作库，通过非对称双向匹配对齐教师与学生样本集（教师→学生方向提升对多样教师支持动作的覆盖，学生→教师方向抑制不受支持的生成）；并引入可微解码空间运动学监督，在归一化表示匹配之外增加解码动作空间约束。推理时单次网络评估即生成完整动作序列，无需教师查询、迭代采样或候选排序。
AI.result: 在ViMoGen上语义对齐得分0.835，优于所评估的单步基线，接近50步教师HY-Motion-1.0-Lite的0.858；盲测人工评价总分4.33，教师为4.50，优于所评估的一步/少步基线；生成延迟从829.58 ms降至9.30 ms，加速89.2倍。
AI.conclusion: MixiMotion在严格单步文本到动作生成中实现了有效的质量—效率权衡。

title: On Probabilistic Inference Through Parametric Tensor Decomposition in Base Tensor Networks
comment: Accepted at: The 17th International Conference on Scalable Uncertainty Management (SUM 2026)
summary: Probabilistic inference is generally only tractable in low-treewidth graphical models, limiting its effective applicability in high-treewidth settings. Many existing methods improve efficiency by exploiting specific parametric structure, such as symmetries. However, they typically require such structure to be explicitly present, limiting their applicability to a broader range of graphical models. To address this limitation, we propose a framework where tractable inference is controlled by latent parametric structure exploitation, rather than requiring it to be explicitly present a priori. Our approach first reparameterises a graphical model as a specific tensor network representation, which we call a base tensor network. This representation yields two key properties that allow inference tractability to be controlled by parametric structure: 1) First, the complexity of inference is mainly determined by the parametric structure of a single tensor, called the base tensor. We characterise several tractable classes of base tensors for which the entire base tensor network can be contracted efficiently. 2) Second, decomposing the base tensor yields again a collection of base tensor networks. This allows inference to be naturally reduced to decomposing the base tensor into tractable components with sufficient parametric structure. We call this procedure parametric tensor decomposition. By exploiting parametric structure within the base tensor, our framework enables a novel view on inference beyond settings where such structure is explicitly present.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出参数张量分解框架：将图模型重参数化为基张量网络，使推理复杂性由单个基张量的参数结构决定，从而在缺乏显式参数结构的高树宽图模型中实现可处理推理。
AI.motivation: 概率推理通常只在低树宽图模型中可处理，高树宽场景受限。现有方法多依赖对称性等显式存在的参数结构来提升效率，适用范围狭窄。作者希望摆脱"结构必须先验显式存在"的限制，让可处理推理由潜在的参数结构利用来驱动。
AI.method: 首先将图模型重参数化为特定张量网络表示，称为基张量网络（base tensor network）。该表示具备两点性质：（1）推理复杂度主要由单个"基张量"的参数结构决定，作者刻画了若干可高效收缩整个基张量网络的基张量可处理类；（2）分解基张量会重新得到一组基张量网络，由此将推理归约为把基张量分解为具有充分参数结构的可处理分量，该过程称为参数张量分解（parametric tensor decomposition）。
AI.result: 刻画了多种可处理基张量类，使得对应基张量网络可被高效收缩；并证明基张量分解后可自然表示为基张量网络集合，从而将推理问题转化为对基张量的分解问题。由此利用基张量内部的参数结构，为超越"结构显式存在"情形的推理提供了新视角。
AI.conclusion: 通过基张量网络重参数化与参数张量分解，作者将高树宽图模型的可处理推理控制权从"显式参数结构"转移到"潜在参数结构利用"，拓展了概率推理的可适用范围。

title: Seeing Through Conflicts: Improving Instruction Hierarchy Alignment in Vision-Language Models
summary: Instruction hierarchy (IH) alignment teaches language models to prioritize higher-level instructions when inputs conflict. While studied primarily in text-only settings, vision-language models (VLMs) introduce new challenges for IH: instructions may be embedded in images, split across modalities, visually transformed, or encountered during agentic tasks. Positing multimodal IH alignment as a reasoning problem, we train VLMs using reinforcement learning with rule-based rewards, comparing text-only, image-only, and mixed-modality supervision. We find that text-only IH training partially transfers to multimodal attacks, failing when models must decode, reconstruct, or reason over instructions across modalities. Image-based training improves robustness beyond text-only supervision, while mixed-modality training performs best overall. Importantly, the benefits generalize beyond the synthetic typographic training setting to real-image and web-agent safety tasks, while largely preserving general multimodal capability, showing that lightweight, verifiable supervision can meaningfully improve VLM robustness under adversarial, cross-modal, and interactive instruction conflicts.

AI.tldr: 该论文将多模态指令层级（IH）对齐视为推理问题，使用带规则奖励的强化学习训练视觉语言模型（VLM），并比较纯文本、纯图像与混合模态监督的效果，发现混合模态训练整体最佳且能泛化至真实图像与网页智能体安全任务。
AI.motivation: 指令层级（IH）对齐旨在让语言模型在输入冲突时优先执行高层指令，但以往研究主要局限于纯文本场景。视觉语言模型（VLM）引入了新挑战：指令可能嵌入图像、跨模态拆分、经过视觉变换，或出现在智能体任务中。因此需要探究多模态场景下的IH对齐机制。
AI.method: 作者将多模态IH对齐视为推理问题，采用带规则奖励（rule-based rewards）的强化学习训练VLM，系统对比三种监督方式：纯文本监督、纯图像监督与混合模态监督。同时将合成的排版式（typographic）训练设置迁移到真实图像与网页智能体安全任务进行验证。
AI.result: 纯文本IH训练只能部分迁移到多模态攻击，当模型需要跨模态解码、重构或推理指令时即失效；基于图像的训练在鲁棒性上优于纯文本监督；混合模态训练整体表现最佳。该增益可泛化至真实图像与网页智能体安全任务，同时基本保持通用多模态能力。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级、可验证的监督（rule-based RL）能有效提升VLM在对抗性、跨模态及交互式指令冲突下的鲁棒性；混合模态监督是应对多模态IH对齐的最优策略，且不损害通用多模态能力。

title: CrowdCue: Specialist-Cue Conditioning for Vision-Language Crowd Counting
summary: Generative vision-language models (VLMs) offer a counting paradigm in which one model produces both a count and a natural-language account of the scene, yet their raw counting accuracy sits in the range of sub-million-parameter specialist regressors. The open question is whether auxiliary guidance from a pretrained specialist can lift them into useful territory, and through which channel that guidance is best routed. We evaluate Qwen2.5-VL-7B on four widely used crowd counting benchmarks (ShanghaiTech A and B, UCF-QNRF, NWPU-Crowd). Zero-shot prompting rarely produces a parseable count, so LoRA supervised fine-tuning establishes the baseline at overall MAE 81.64. Conditioning on a P2PNet-derived density heatmap as an auxiliary visual signal fails in every encoding we tested, and an adversarial-swap protocol shows the model reads the heatmap but applies it counterproductively. We propose CrowdCue, a family that supplies the same specialist's already-integrated integer count to the VLM as a discrete symbol. The text-channel variant reaches MAE 72.04. The visual-channel variant, which renders the integer as printed digits and supplies it as a second image, reaches MAE 62.65, the strongest result in this paper and well ahead of the cue-supplying specialist alone (84.45 on the same split). In the late-fusion VLM we study, the binding constraint is not the channel but the abstraction level at which the specialist signal is delivered.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何用专家模型辅助生成式VLM进行人群计数，发现将专家的整型计数值作为离散符号输入（CrowdCue）效果最佳，视觉通道渲染数字达MAE 62.65。
AI.motivation: 生成式VLM能同时给出计数和自然语言描述，但其原始计数精度仅相当于亚百万参数的专用回归器。核心问题是：预训练专家的辅助引导能否将其提升到实用水平，以及引导信号应通过何种通道传递最佳。
AI.method: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B与四个基准（ShanghaiTech A/B、UCF-QNRF、NWPU-Crowd）上评测。先用LoRA有监督微调建立基线；再测试将P2PNet密度热图作为辅助视觉信号；最后提出CrowdCue，把专家已集成的整型计数以离散符号提供给VLM，分文本通道与视觉通道（将整数渲染为印刷数字作为第二张图像）两种变体，并用对抗交换协议诊断模型行为。
AI.result: 零样本提示几乎无法产生可解析计数。LoRA微调基线总体MAE为81.64。密度热图条件化在所有编码下均失败，对抗交换协议显示模型能读取热图但反向应用。CrowdCue文本通道MAE达72.04，视觉通道达62.65（本文最佳），显著优于单独提供线索的专家（同一划分上为84.45）。
AI.conclusion: 在所研究的晚期融合VLM中，决定性能的瓶颈不是通道选择，而是专家信号被传递时所处的抽象层级——提供离散整数符号比提供连续密度热图更有效。

title: Total Cost of Agency: Exact Attribution of Memory Injection Cost in Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code, data, and evaluation harness in github: https://github.com/vsingh45/tca-compiler
summary: Every node in a multi-agent large language model (LLM) workflow retrieves context from memory and injects it into its prompt, where those injected tokens are billed as input tokens at the same per-token price as the system prompt and the user query. Production observability tools report total token cost but do not separate the tokens a node generates from the tokens it is handed, so this component of the bill is invisible to the teams paying it. We introduce the Total Cost of Agency (TCA), a decomposition of multi-agent workflow cost into base prompt, inference, memory injection, miss penalty and context-accumulation components, and an exact attribution method: a two-pass, non-billable token count that measures injected tokens directly rather than estimating them from word-count proxies. On a 200-task enterprise benchmark executed against real model APIs, memory injection accounts for 13.6 percent of the variable cost a compile-time optimizer can act on, about 12 percent of the full billed cost, and its share rises from a structural zero at workflow depth one to 27.6 percent at depth six. Injected tokens grow linearly with depth over the measured range (R^2 = 0.9974, depths two through six); a quadratic fit yields a negative leading coefficient, so the data do not exhibit convex growth at these depths. We show the component is controllable at fixed model tier: reducing the retrieval window capacity from 32 to 2 entries lowers injected tokens by 28.7 percent with an accuracy change within seed-level variation. We report in full that our graph-rewriting transforms are approximately cost-neutral in isolation, that two of the five decomposition terms are zero by construction in this harness, and that total workflow cost is dominated by model tier assignment, which we hold fixed and treat as prior work. Prompt caching is not evaluated; all figures are for the uncached case.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"代理总成本"(TCA)框架,将多智能体LLM工作流成本分解为基础提示、推理、记忆注入、未命中惩罚和上下文累积五个组成部分,并给出一种两遍、非计费的精确归因方法直接测量注入token。在200任务的企业基准上,记忆注入占可变成本的13.6%、完整账单成本约12%,且随工作流深度从零升至27.6%。
AI.motivation: 生产环境可观测性工具仅报告总token成本,不区分节点生成的token与输入的token,因此记忆注入这一成本项对付费团队完全不可见。作者希望揭示并量化多智能体工作流中被隐藏的成本结构。
AI.method: 提出TCA成本分解(基础提示、推理、记忆注入、未命中惩罚、上下文累积),并设计一种两遍、非计费的精确归因方法,直接计数注入token而非通过词数代理估计。在200任务企业基准上针对真实模型API执行,并进行检索窗口容量消融与深度分析。
AI.result: 记忆注入占编译期优化器可作用的可变成本13.6%,约占完整计费成本12%;其占比从深度1的结构性零升至深度6的27.6%。注入token随深度线性增长(R^2=0.9974,深度2至6),二次拟合首项系数为负,说明该深度范围无凸性增长。检索窗口从32降至2使注入token减少28.7%,准确率变化在种子级波动内。图重写变换单独使用近乎成本中性,五个分解项中两项在此框架下按构造为零,总成本主要由模型层级分配主导。未评估提示缓存。
AI.conclusion: 记忆注入是多智能体LLM工作流中被忽视但可观的成本组成部分,且在该模型层级下可通过缩减检索窗口进行控制而不损害准确率。作者同时坦承分解项的局限性与未评估范围(如提示缓存)。

title: BizSage: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework for Business Research with Efficient Knowledge Retrieval
summary: While multi-agent systems based on large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating the progressive workflow of academic research, extending them to economics and business research, where specialized domain knowledge spans neighboring disciplines yet remains difficult to access in a structured way, presents two challenges. First, existing methods mostly retrieve at the paper level, yet the evidence needed for research tasks is often distributed across different sections, creating a granularity mismatch that hinders retrieval coverage and precision. Second, these fields demand strict empirical rigor, yet current systems provide limited mechanisms for learning from evaluation feedback. We present \textbf{BizSage}, a multi-agent framework combining corpus-level fine-grained retrieval with quality-driven self-evolution. We build a Lateral Knowledge Graph (LKG) by merging section-level knowledge graphs and apply Personalized PageRank (PPR) to surface semantically relevant and structurally important sections. Seven specialized agents collaborate under a Meta-Review self-evolution mechanism that distills failure modes from evaluation traces into reusable strategies. On a benchmark spanning four domains and three tasks, BizSage ranks first on the majority of metrics, achieves pairwise win-rates above 60\% against six baselines, and produces zero hallucinated citations. We hope BizSage paves the way for reliable research assistance in economics, business, and the broader social sciences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BizSage——一个面向经济学与商业研究的LLM多智能体框架，通过章节级细粒度检索与质量驱动的自进化机制，解决检索粒度不匹配与经验学习不足的问题，在四领域三任务基准上多数指标第一，对六个基线胜率超60%，且零幻觉引用。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统虽在学术研究流程自动化上初见成效，但扩展到经济学与商业研究时存在两大挑战：一是这些领域所需的专业证据常分散于论文不同章节，而现有方法多以论文级检索，造成粒度错配，影响检索覆盖率与精确度；二是这些领域对实证严谨性要求高，而当前系统缺乏从评估反馈中学习的机制。
AI.method: BizSage采用语料库级细粒度检索与质量驱动自进化相结合的多智能体框架。构建横向知识图谱（LKG），通过合并章节级知识图谱实现，并应用个性化PageRank（PPR）以挖掘语义相关且结构重要的章节。七个专门化智能体在Meta-Review自进化机制下协作，该机制从评估轨迹中提炼失败模式并转化为可复用策略。
AI.result: 在覆盖四个领域、三类任务的基准上，BizSage在多数指标上排名第一，相对六个基线取得超过60%的成对胜率，并实现零幻觉引用。
AI.conclusion: BizSage有望为经济学、商业及更广泛社会科学领域的可靠研究辅助奠定基础。

title: Reconstructed holograms and explanation-aware evaluation for low-cost computational pollen analysis in veterinary cytology
comment: 25 pages, 17 figures, 20 tables. Supplementary material included. Submitted to a journal for peer review
summary: Automated pollen analysis supports veterinary cytology, but brightfield microscopy is costlier and more complex than lens-less digital in-line holographic microscopy. We evaluate whether reconstructed holograms can narrow this gap and whether model explanations remain reliable under modality change. Six pollen species were imaged by brightfield and holographic microscopy. Raw, single back-propagation and iterative phase retrieval holograms were evaluated with YOLOv26s detection and MobileNetV4 classification after anchor-based annotation transfer. Six attribution methods were assessed for spatial grounding and faithfulness with the Attribution Health Inspection and Repair (AHIR) protocol, which tests model brittleness under weak noise and corrects attribution-map granularity when needed. Brightfield achieved 0.6890 mAP50-95 (0.8865 mAP50) for detection and 0.9687 macro-F1 (0.9705 accuracy) for classification. Reconstructed holograms narrowed the gap with a task-dependent split: p-type was strongest for detection at 0.5324 mAP50-95 (0.8229 mAP50), while r-type was strongest for classification at 0.7695 macro-F1 (0.7866 accuracy), both far above raw-hologram baselines. Activation-based explanations localized strongly on grains, and region-based methods retained ~60 to ~80% of faithfulness under holography. The holographic detector was highly brittle to weak perturbations, saturating deletion-based evaluation while insertion remained informative. Pixel-level gradient explanations approached random floor, yet spatial smoothing restored p-type gradient faithfulness from 0.05 to 0.51. For holographic classification, perturbation-based explanations remained faithful while gradient-based methods fell below random floor. Reconstruction improves low-cost holographic pollen analysis, while AHIR distinguishes genuine attribution failure from artifacts caused by model brittleness and map granularity.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较明场与无透镜数字全息显微镜在花粉自动分析中的表现，并检验模态改变下模型解释的可靠性。全息重建缩小了与明场的差距，检测以p-type最强、分类以r-type最强；AHIR协议可区分归因方法的真实失败与模型脆弱性/归因图粒度造成的假象。
AI.motivation: 自动花粉分析可支持兽医细胞学，但明场显微镜成本更高、系统更复杂，而无透镜数字全息显微镜更具低成本潜力。作者希望评估重建全息图能否缩小两者差距，并检验在模态改变时模型解释是否仍然可靠。
AI.method: 对六种花粉分别用明场与全息显微镜成像；在基于锚框的标注迁移后，用YOLOv26s做检测、MobileNetV4做分类，比较原始全息图、单次反向传播重建和迭代相位恢复重建。采用六种归因方法评估空间定位与忠实性，并使用AHIR协议检验弱噪声下模型脆弱性，并在需要时修正归因图粒度。
AI.result: 明场检测达0.6890 mAP50-95（0.8865 mAP50），分类达0.9687 macro-F1（0.9705 accuracy）。重建全息图缩小差距且呈任务依赖：检测以p-type最佳，为0.5324 mAP50-95（0.8229 mAP50）；分类以r-type最佳，为0.7695 macro-F1（0.7866 accuracy），均远高于原始全息图基线。基于激活的解释在花粉粒上定位强，区域类方法在全息条件下保留约60%至80%忠实性。全息检测器对弱扰动高度脆弱，使删除式评估饱和而插入式仍有信息；像素级梯度解释接近随机下限，但空间平滑将p-type梯度忠实性从0.05提升至0.51。全息分类中扰动类解释保持忠实，梯度类方法低于随机下限。
AI.conclusion: 重建可提升低成本全息花粉分析性能，且AHIR协议能区分真实归因失败与模型脆弱性及归因图粒度导致的伪影。

title: WorkWorlds: An Infrastructure for Evaluating AI Agents on Workplace Tasks
summary: Many knowledge-work benchmarks are constructed around individual tasks, with the context needed for each task selected together with or after the task has been specified. This design measures performance on workplace-like tasks in an environment assembled for the task. When task specification guides which context is selected, the evaluation can encode task information into the environment and pre-complete part of the information-localization work that workplace performance normally requires. We introduce WorkWorlds, an evaluation infrastructure that separates organizational state from task specification. A world first fixes a revision, date, and employee seat and materializes the organizational state that employee can access; tasks are introduced only afterward. We implement WorkWorlds in a primary synthetic pharmaceutical company with 8 measured tasks across 6 employee seats, and construct additional organizational worlds. Across 192 matched evaluations, moving from task-curated context to the full role-visible workplace reduced evidence access from 90.4% to 74.5% and criterion pass from 79.4% to 68.2%, while pass conditional on evidence access remained nearly unchanged; most of the measured difference occurred before the agent reached sufficient evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 WorkWorlds 评测基础设施，将组织状态与任务规格分离，先固化世界状态再引入任务。在合成制药公司场景的 192 次匹配评测中，从任务定制上下文转为完整角色可见工作环境后，证据获取率由 90.4% 降至 74.5%，标准通过率由 79.4% 降至 68.2%。
AI.motivation: 现有知识工作基准多围绕单项任务构建，任务所需上下文在任务指定时或之后被一并选定，导致任务信息被编码进环境，预先完成了一部分本应由工作场景承担的信息定位工作，从而高估了模型能力，无法真实衡量职场表现。
AI.method: 提出 WorkWorlds 评测基础设施，将组织状态与任务规格解耦：世界先确定修订版本、日期与员工席位，物化该员工可访问的组织状态，随后才引入任务。在主实验中实现了一个合成制药公司，包含 6 个员工席位与 8 项测量任务，并额外构建其他组织世界，共进行 192 次匹配评测。
AI.result: 由任务定制上下文切换为完整角色可见工作环境后，证据获取率从 90.4% 下降至 74.5%，标准通过率从 79.4% 下降至 68.2%；而在已获取证据条件下的通过率基本不变，表明大部分性能差异发生在智能体获得充分证据之前。
AI.conclusion: 任务定制化上下文会系统性高估智能体的知识工作任务表现；信息定位（证据获取）而非证据使用是主要瓶颈，WorkWorlds 为该类评测提供了更贴近真实职场的方案。

title: Knowledge Graph-Augmented Ambient AI for Clinical Note Generation
summary: Ambient AI is increasingly adopted in healthcare to automatically generate clinical notes from patient-clinician conversations, with the potential to substantially reduce clinician documentation burden. However, generated notes may omit clinically relevant information discussed during the encounter, creating information gaps that can affect downstream care. Knowledge graphs (KGs) constructed from encounter transcripts can provide a structured representation of what was discussed and enable systematic identification of missing information from generated notes that are critical for patient care. In this study, we introduce Coverage-Directed Revision (CDR), a model-agnostic framework that constructs a KG from the encounter transcript, identifies medical concepts absent from an initially generated note, and directs large language models (LLMs) to restore the missing information without modifying the underlying note-generation system. We evaluate CDR on two datasets: 1) Pitt-Bench, a local dataset comprising rehabilitation sessions, and 2) ACI-Bench, a public dataset for benchmarking clinical note generation. We tested four underlying LLMs widely used in ambient AI systems. The results show that CDR consistently improves content recall across all evaluated conditions. Our study provides a practical approach for improving the completeness of ambient AI-generated clinical documentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Coverage-Directed Revision (CDR)框架，通过从医患对话转录构建知识图谱识别初始生成病历中缺失的医学概念，并引导大语言模型补全缺失信息，在Pitt-Bench和ACI-Bench两个数据集上均提升了内容召回率。
AI.motivation: 环境AI（Ambient AI）越来越多地用于从医患对话自动生成临床病历，以减轻临床医生的文书负担。但生成的病历可能遗漏对话中讨论的临床相关信息，形成信息缺口，影响后续诊疗。因此需要一种方法来系统性地识别并补全这些关键缺失信息。
AI.method: 提出Coverage-Directed Revision (CDR)——一种模型无关的框架：首先从对话转录构建知识图谱(KG)，然后识别初始生成病历中缺失的医学概念，最后引导大语言模型(LLM)补全缺失信息，且不修改底层病历生成系统。在Pitt-Bench（本地康复会话数据集）和ACI-Bench（公开临床病历生成基准数据集）上评测，测试了四种广泛用于环境AI系统的LLM。
AI.result: 在全部评测条件下，CDR均一致地提升了内容召回率（content recall）。
AI.conclusion: CDR为提升环境AI生成的临床文书的完整性提供了一种实用方法。

title: BrainIAC: Interactive 3D Brain Lesion Segmentation across Heterogeneous MRI Modalities with Online Adaptation
summary: Brain lesion segmentation is a fundamental task in medical image analysis, playing a critical role in diagnosis, treatment planning, and longitudinal disease monitoring. Yet existing models still struggle to meet the demands of real clinical use, where deployments contain data distribution shifts, arising from differences in scanner hardware, imaging protocol (varying MRI modality sets), and new pathologies. We present BrainIAC (Brain lesion Interactive Adaptive Continuously learning segmentation), a unified framework that integrates (i) a multi-modal backbone network trained to segment multiple types of brain lesions and handle heterogeneous sets of modalities via zero-filling and random modality dropping; (ii) 3D interactive segmentation with bounding-box and click prompts that preserves fully automatic prediction when no prompt is given; and (iii) an online adaptation mechanism combining Mid-Interaction adaptation and Post-Interaction adaptation, supervised by the network's own predictions as pseudo labels and guided by an extra Click-Centered Gaussian loss. To our knowledge, this is one of the first 3D online adaptation methods for interactive segmentation, and the first to combine handling of heterogeneous modality sets with online adaptation. Experiments across seven brain MRI datasets demonstrate that the proposed components provide complementary and synergistic benefits. The method consistently outperforms existing approaches and generalizes well across heterogeneous imaging modalities, including those unseen during training, as well as previously unseen brain pathology types. The code and a 3D Slicer plug-in will be released at https://github.com/WenTXuL/BrainIAC upon publication.

AI.tldr: BrainIAC 是一个统一框架，集成多模态骨干网络、3D 交互式分割与在线自适应机制，可在模态集合异构及新病理场景下实现稳健的脑病灶分割，并在七个 MRI 数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 临床实际部署中普遍存在数据分布偏移，来源包括扫描仪硬件差异、成像协议（MRI 模态组合不同）以及新出现的病理类型，而现有脑病灶分割模型难以应对这些挑战。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：(i) 多模态骨干网络，通过零填充与随机模态丢弃处理异构模态集合并分割多类脑病灶；(ii) 基于边界框与点击提示的 3D 交互式分割，无提示时保留全自动预测；(iii) 在线自适应机制，结合交互中期适配与交互后期适配，以网络自身预测作为伪标签监督，并由额外的 Click-Centered Gaussian 损失引导。
AI.result: 在七个脑 MRI 数据集上的实验表明，各组件具有互补且协同的增益；方法持续优于现有方法，并在训练中未见的异构成像模态及未见脑病理类型上具有良好泛化能力；代码与 3D Slicer 插件将于发表后开源。
AI.conclusion: 该工作据称是首批面向交互式分割的 3D 在线自适应方法之一，也是首个将异构模态集合处理与在线自适应相结合的方法，为真实临床部署提供了统一且可泛化的脑病灶分割方案。

title: Pretraining of Medical Visual Encoders Toward Multi-modal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) commonly reuse visual encoders pretrained with CLIP, although the features of these ViTs are ultimately consumed by autoregressive LLMs. We refer to this mismatch as the semantic-interface gap and introduce MedMLIP, a framework that pretrains the visual encoder through report generation with a frozen LLM, while employing Local Relational Distillation (LRD) to preserve relationships among visual patches to avoid visual collapse. We pretrain MedMLIP on IU-Xray and Open-PMC-300K and evaluate the resulting encoders on VQA-RAD and SLAKE. Only the ViT is transferred, while the guiding LLM and projector are replaced, allowing us to assess cross-LLM transferability. Our cross-LLM transfer experiments demonstrate the value of pretraining visual encoders for their autoregressive LLM interface while trying to preserve more fine-grained visual information. Code and the pretrained model are available at https://github.com/SkyCol/MedMLIP

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MedMLIP框架，通过冻结LLM的医学报告生成预训练视觉编码器，并用局部关系蒸馏（LRD）保留视觉patch间关系以避免视觉塌缩，实验验证了面向自回归LLM接口预训练视觉编码器的价值。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）普遍复用CLIP预训练的视觉编码器，但这些ViT特征最终由自回归LLM消费，二者之间存在语义接口不匹配（semantic-interface gap）。现有做法未针对这一不匹配进行优化，可能导致视觉信息在下游LLM中利用不充分。
AI.method: 提出MedMLIP框架：在冻结LLM的条件下，通过医学报告生成任务预训练视觉编码器；同时引入局部关系蒸馏（LRD），保留视觉patch之间的关系以避免视觉塌缩。在IU-Xray和Open-PMC-300K上预训练，评测时仅迁移ViT，替换引导LLM和投影器，以评估跨LLM迁移性。
AI.result: 在VQA-RAD和SLAKE上进行评测，跨LLM迁移实验表明，面向自回归LLM接口预训练视觉编码器具有价值，同时能够保留更细粒度的视觉信息。代码与预训练模型已开源。
AI.conclusion: 针对视觉编码器与自回归LLM之间的语义接口不匹配进行预训练是有效的，LRD有助于在适配LLM接口的同时保留细粒度视觉信息，且迁移的ViT具备跨LLM泛化能力。

title: H2LooP Telecom Model v1: From Telecom Comprehension to Autonomous Issue and PR Resolution
summary: We present H2LooP Telecom Model v1, a domain-specialized large language models fine-tuned for the telecommunications industry. We release two domain-adapted model variants serving complementary use cases: a comprehension-focused variant for telecom domain question answering and reasoning, and an agentic variant for autonomous telecom code generation, pull request resolution, and code commits on production repositories. H2LooP Telecom achieves strong results on the GSMA Open Telecom Lite (OT-Lite) benchmark and a proprietary telecom code generation benchmark, outperforming frontier closed-source models such as GPT-5 and Claude Opus on independent leaderboard evaluation, while preserving general-purpose capabilities. The Comprehension variant achieves 81.8% weighted average on OT-Lite Pass@3, and, independently, ranks 5th overall on the official community-run Open Telco AI Leaderboard* at only 31B parameters-ahead of frontier closed-source systems including Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5, Gemini 3 Flash, Grok-4-fast, and Kimi K2.5. Our agentic variant obtains a relative improvement of +8.8% in AST Similarity and +20.0% in Location IoU over the base model on telecom code generation, while maintaining identical MMLU (74.0%) and BFCL v3 multi-turn function calling (79.0%) performance, indicating zero catastrophic forgetting. Domain specialization on curated telecom corpora, spanning 3GPP standards, O-RAN specifications, network telemetry, and real repository commits, yields substantial improvements over general-purpose models of equivalent scale, approaches frontier closed-source models on domain-specific evaluation, and is independently corroborated by our official leaderboard standing.

AI.tldr: 提出H2LooP Telecom Model v1，两个面向电信领域的专用大模型变体（理解型与智能体型），在OT-Lite基准及私有代码基准上超越GPT-5、Claude Opus等前沿闭源模型，且无灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 通用大模型在电信领域（如3GPP标准、O-RAN规范、网络遥测、真实代码提交）缺乏领域专业知识，需要领域专精化模型以提升问答推理与代码生成能力，同时保持通用能力不退化。
AI.method: 基于电信领域精选语料（3GPP标准、O-RAN规范、网络遥测数据、真实仓库提交）进行领域微调，发布两个变体：面向电信问答与推理的理解型模型，以及面向前沿仓库自动化代码生成、PR解决与代码提交的智能体型模型。
AI.result: 理解型在OT-Lite Pass@3达81.8%加权平均，仅310亿参数即在官方Open Telco AI Leaderboard排名第5，领先Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5、Gemini 3 Flash、Grok-4-fast、Kimi K2.5等闭源模型；智能体型在电信代码生成上AST Similarity相对提升+8.8%、Location IoU提升+20.0%，同时MMLU保持74.0%、BFCL v3多轮函数调用保持79.0%。
AI.conclusion: 电信领域专精化显著优于同规模通用模型，接近前沿闭源模型水平，且未出现灾难性遗忘；官方榜单排名独立佐证了方法有效性。

title: VDGS: Visibility-Driven Large-Scale 3D Gaussian Splatting for Aerial Scene Reconstruction
summary: Large-scale scene reconstruction is a critical foundational technology in robotic autonomous systems such as 3D mapping and autonomous driving. In recent years, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated remarkable advantages in both visual quality and computational efficiency, making it a promising representation for large-scale scene reconstruction. However, it still faces challenges in large-scale scenes, including excessive memory consumption and uneven viewpoint coverage caused by UAV acquisition, limiting its real-world applications. To address this, we propose VDGS, a novel 3DGS framework that incorporates camera distribution into scene modeling. VDGS introduces visibility-driven statistics for scene anchors to quantify supervision strength. These statistics are further leveraged for scene partitioning and for gradient compensation in under-optimized regions, thereby promoting balanced optimization across different regions. Extensive experiments on multiple large-scale aerial scene datasets demonstrate that, under imbalanced viewpoint distributions, VDGS consistently outperforms existing methods, while maintaining competitive performance in scenarios with more uniform view distributions.

AI.tldr: 提出VDGS框架，将相机分布引入3DGS场景建模，通过可见性驱动统计实现场景分区与梯度补偿，缓解大规模航空场景的内存与视角不平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 大规模场景重建是机器人自主系统（如三维建图、自动驾驶）的关键基础技术。3DGS在视觉质量与计算效率上优势明显，适合作为大规模场景表示，但仍面临内存消耗过大、以及无人机采集导致的视角覆盖不均等挑战，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 提出VDGS——一种将相机分布纳入场景建模的新型3DGS框架。核心是为场景锚点引入可见性驱动统计量，用以量化监督强度；并基于该统计量进行场景分区，同时对优化不足区域实施梯度补偿，从而促进不同区域间的均衡优化。
AI.result: 在多个大规模航空场景数据集上进行大量实验，在视角分布不平衡条件下，VDGS持续优于现有方法；在视角分布较均匀的场景中，性能也保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: VDGS通过显式建模相机可见性分布，有效改善了大规模航空场景下3DGS的优化不均衡问题，兼顾了不平衡与均匀视角两种情形下的重建表现。

title: Explainable Recommendations at Scale: LLM Rationales for YouTube Music Artist Discovery
summary: Modern music streaming platforms face a persistent tradeoff: exploiting familiar content versus driving the exploration of novel items. While users frequently desire discovery, they hesitate to select unknown artists over proven favorites. Providing transparent, natural language rationales that explain why an unexplored item is recommended lowers this barrier. However, while Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at this nuanced explainability, their real-time deployment is severely bottlenecked by prohibitive inference costs and computational overhead. In this paper, we present an industry case study of a decoupled recommendation architecture that successfully scales exploration without compromising latency. Our system isolates LLM inference asynchronously offline, pre-computing personalized candidate pools of undiscovered artists alongside tailored rationales. Large-scale online A/B experiments validate our design. We demonstrate that combining LLM-backed recommendations with these explanatory rationales significantly reduces the trust barrier for new content, yielding statistically significant improvements in both user exploration and overall engagement on the discovery surfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种解耦式推荐架构，将LLM推理异步置于离线，预计算未发现艺术家的个性化候选池及自然语言推荐理由，在保证低延迟的同时提升探索与参与度。
AI.motivation: 音乐流媒体平台面临"利用熟悉内容"与"推动探索新颖内容"的权衡：用户虽有发现意愿，却因不熟悉而迟疑。透明、自然语言的理由可降低该信任门槛，但LLM实时部署受制于高昂的推理成本与计算开销。
AI.method: 工业案例研究：构建解耦推荐架构，将LLM推理完全隔离至离线异步执行，预计算"未发现艺术家"的个性化候选池及配套的定制化推荐理由，在线服务仅做轻量检索与排序。
AI.result: 大规模在线A/B实验验证：LLM驱动的推荐结合解释性理由显著降低了新内容的信任门槛，在发现场景的用户探索量与整体参与度上均取得统计显著的提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过离在线解耦，可在不牺牲延迟的前提下规模化引入LLM可解释推荐，兼顾探索效率与系统性能，为工业级推荐系统落地LLM提供了可行范式。

title: Replay-Gated Neural Execution: Decoupling Persistent Behavioral Specifications from Neural Realizations in Frozen Language Models
summary: Input-conditioned neural interventions raise a runtime question: what persists when one behavioral specification admits multiple actions whose validity depends on execution state? We introduce replay-gated neural execution, separating five objects: a persistent behavioral predicate, its state-indexed certified realization set, a transient action witness, a budget-limited finder, and execution authorization. Candidates undergo isolated FP32/BF16 replay of the frozen model; commitment additionally requires a valid run audit. Experiments on Qwen3-0.6B and SmolLM2-360M-Instruct establish distinct failure modes for these objects. Independent initializations yield distinct certified actions in all 24 tested fixed-state cells. Unchanged SmolLM2 witnesses remain certified in all 128 native states but only 66 of 384 off-diagonal transfers. All 767 archived Qwen witnesses replay successfully, yet a budget-limited finder misses one known-realizable cell in all three prespecified runs. Of 1,141 replay-submitted candidates, 174 fail item certification. A frozen three-tier cascade uses these boundaries to reject uncertified proposals and escalate audit-valid search misses. On 256 previously sealed Qwen Fresh requests, 221 first certify at the lowest-cost tier and all 256 receive audited authorization, with no observed bypass. Relative to frozen full search, the median singleton search-and-certification cost ratio is 0.1055 and P95 is 1.3485, including failed tiers. Within the studied behavioral family on two small models, these results support state-indexed, set-valued execution semantics: specifications persist, search proposes witnesses, and replay certification plus run audit grants execution authority.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"replay-gated neural execution"框架，将执行语义拆分为持久行为谓词、状态索引的认证实现集、瞬态动作见证、预算受限查找器与执行授权五个对象，并通过FP32/BF16重放认证区分其失效模式。
AI.motivation: 输入条件神经干预面临运行时问题：当同一行为规范允许多个依赖执行状态才有效的动作时，究竟什么应当持久化？需要一种能够区分"持久规范"与"瞬态见证"的执行语义框架。
AI.method: 将执行拆分为五类对象：持久行为谓词、状态索引认证实现集、瞬态动作见证、预算受限查找器、执行授权。候选动作在冻结模型上做隔离FP32/BF16重放，承诺执行还须通过有效运行审计。在Qwen3-0.6B与SmolLM2-360M-Instruct上实验，并构建冻结三级级联用于拒绝未认证提案、升级审计有效的搜索遗漏。
AI.result: 独立初始化在全部24个固定状态单元中产生不同的认证动作；SmolLM2见证在全部128个原生状态保持认证但仅384个非对角迁移中的66个通过；767个Qwen见证全部重放成功，但预算受限查找器在三次预设运行中均遗漏一个已知可实现单元；1,141个重放提交候选中有174个未通过条目认证；256个密封Qwen Fresh请求中221个在最低成本层首次认证且全部256个获审计授权，无绕过；相对冻结全搜索，单例搜索与认证成本比中位数为0.1055，P95为1.3485。
AI.conclusion: 在两个小模型的研究行为族内，结果支持状态索引、集合值执行语义：规范持久、搜索提出见证、重放认证加运行审计授予执行权。

title: HDMamba-YOLO: Efficient State-Space Perception and Local Spatial Reconstruction for UAV Small Object
summary: Small-object detection in UAV imagery is challenged by weak visual evidence, ambiguous boundaries, dense object distributions, and complex backgrounds. Effective detection therefore requires long-range contextual information for target-background discrimination while preserving explicit local two-dimensional structures for accurate localization. These requirements arise at different stages of the detection pipeline and are not naturally addressed by a uniform feature-processing strategy. We propose Hybrid Dual-domain Mamba-YOLO (HDMamba-YOLO), a stage-wise heterogeneous SSM-CNN detector organized according to a perception-reconstruction-alignment-interaction rationale. EfficientVMamba-based EVSS establishes long-range contextual perception in the backbone, while PhasePatchMerging2D provides phase-aware hierarchical transitions. DST-Wrapper and Native C3k2-ASSAF then perform perception-to-reconstruction transition and repeated local two-dimensional reconstruction during FPN/PAN aggregation. DySample provides content-adaptive cross-scale resampling, while OS-CVTIA introduces macro-micro interaction and task-specific modulation for localization and classification. On VisDrone2019, HDMamba-YOLO-B achieves 42.737% mAP50 and 25.713% mAP50:95 with 10.042M parameters and 29.879 corrected GFLOPs. HDMamba-YOLO-Lite achieves 41.140% mAP50 and 24.741% mAP50:95 with 5.344M parameters. Under the unified AI-TOD evaluation protocol, HDMamba-YOLO-B obtains 21.621% AP and 47.881% AP50. Controlled ablations further support the stage-wise allocation of state-space perception, convolutional reconstruction, dynamic alignment, and task interaction for UAV small-object detection.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出HDMamba-YOLO，一种按"感知-重建-对齐-交互"分阶段设计的SSM-CNN异构检测器，用于无人机小目标检测，在VisDrone2019和AI-TOD上取得领先精度与参数效率。
AI.motivation: 无人机图像中小目标检测面临视觉证据微弱、边界模糊、目标分布密集及背景复杂等挑战。有效检测既需要长程上下文信息以区分目标与背景，又需保留显式的局部二维结构以实现精确定位。这两类需求出现在检测流程的不同阶段，统一的特征处理策略难以同时满足，因此需要阶段化的异构设计。
AI.method: 提出HDMamba-YOLO，按感知-重建-对齐-交互的阶段性异构SSM-CNN架构：骨干网络采用基于EfficientVMamba的EVSS建立长程上下文感知；PhasePatchMerging2D实现相位感知的层级下采样过渡；DST-Wrapper与Native C3k2-ASSAF在FPN/PAN聚合中完成感知到重建的转换及重复的局部二维重建；DySample提供内容自适应的跨尺度重采样；OS-CVTIA引入宏-微观交互与任务特定调制，分别服务于定位与分类。
AI.result: 在VisDrone2019上，HDMamba-YOLO-B达到42.737% mAP50、25.713% mAP50:95，参数量10.042M、校正GFLOPs为29.879；HDMamba-YOLO-Lite以5.344M参数达到41.140% mAP50、24.741% mAP50:95。在统一AI-TOD评测协议下，HDMamba-YOLO-B获得21.621% AP与47.881% AP50。受控消融实验进一步验证了状态空间感知、卷积重建、动态对齐与任务交互的阶段化分配的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将状态空间感知、卷积重建、动态对齐与任务交互按检测阶段异构分配，HDMamba-YOLO有效兼顾长程上下文与局部二维结构，在无人机小目标检测中实现了精度与参数效率的良好平衡，消融结果支持该阶段化设计思路的合理性。

title: Increasing Skill Level Recruits Deeper Attention Layers in a Frozen Chess Transformer
comment: 19 pages, 12 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/David-31415/maia-depth-migration. Built with chessformer-lens library: https://github.com/chessformer-lens/chessformer_lens
summary: Chess involves complex reasoning in a deterministic environment, which makes it a useful setting for studying the mechanisms of computation inside transformers. The Maia-3 chess transformer takes Elo, a measure of competitive chess skill, as an input to the pre-trained network, so we can vary the skill the network is conditioned on with no change to its weights. Here we investigate how turning this skill dial affects self-attention. Ablating every attention head at every Elo from 700 to 2500, we find 1) increasing skill pushes the causal center of mass of the computation deeper, monotonically, for every chess piece and move type we measured; 2) the depth migration is much greater for specific tactics, especially knight forks, than for other move types; 3) the migration consists of deeper heads getting recruited for more specialized computations while one shared shallow head keeps a roughly constant contribution. These results may shed light on how conditioning inputs redistribute computation in larger transformers.

AI.tldr: 通过消融Maia-3国际象棋Transformer在Elo 700–2500范围内的每个注意力头，发现技能条件输入会单调地把计算的因果重心推向更深层，且这种深度迁移对特定战术（如马叉）更显著，由深层头承担更专门化计算、浅层共享头贡献基本恒定。
AI.motivation: 研究动机：国际象棋是确定性环境下的复杂推理任务，适合探究Transformer内部计算机制；Maia-3模型以Elo（棋力）作为条件输入且不改变权重，为研究“条件输入如何重新分配计算”提供了一个可控的“技能旋钮”。
AI.method: 方法：在Elo 700至2500的每个技能水平上，对Maia-3国际象棋Transformer的每一个注意力头逐一进行消融（ablation），并测量每个棋子与走子类型对应的计算因果重心（causal center of mass）随Elo的变化。
AI.result: 结果：1）技能提升使所有被测量棋子与走子类型的因果重心单调向更深层移动；2）深度迁移在特定战术上远大于其他走子类型，尤其是马叉（knight forks）；3）迁移机制表现为更深层的头被招募承担更专门化的计算，而一个共享的浅层头贡献大致保持恒定。
AI.conclusion: 结论：条件输入（技能水平）会在Transformer中重新分配计算深度，且这种重分配具有任务/战术特异性。该发现有助于理解更大规模Transformer中条件输入如何重新组织内部计算。

title: Do Chess Explanations Reflect Model Decisions? Behavioral and Token-Level Tests of LLM Reasoning Faithfulness
summary: Large language models can produce fluent explanations for chess moves, but plausible language does not necessarily reflect the reasoning behind a decision. We study this question in chess, where the board state is fully observable, legal actions can be enumerated, and move quality can be evaluated independently. Across 200 Lichess endgame puzzles, we test explanations using move recoverability, decoder-side controls, and token-level scoring of legal candidate moves. Unmasked explanations make generated moves easy to recover, but this advantage drops sharply after explicit move hints are removed. Under strict masking, explanations provide only small and decoder-dependent gains over the board state alone. Token-level scoring shows that explanations can nevertheless alter move preferences: random but plausible explanations from other puzzles reduce the probability of the correct move, indicating that irrelevant reasoning text is not simply ignored. We also find that recognizable endgame motifs can make generated moves easier to recover without reliably improving move correctness. Together, these results show that linguistic plausibility, consistency with a generated action, and solution correctness are distinct properties. Fluent chess explanations can influence action preferences and support a coherent move narrative while providing only limited evidence of faithful reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该研究以国际象棋为可控测试平台，考察大语言模型给出的棋步解释是否反映其真实推理过程，发现语言流畅性、与生成动作的一致性以及解题正确性是三种相互独立的属性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型能够为棋步生成流畅解释，但语言上的合理性并不必然反映决策背后的真实推理，因此需要在一个状态完全可观测、合法动作可枚举、棋步质量可独立评估的环境中，检验"解释是否忠实反映模型推理"这一问题。
AI.method: 在200个Lichess残局谜题上，采用三类方法检验解释的作用：(1) 棋步可恢复性（move recoverability），即能否由解释反推生成的动作；(2) 解码端控制（decoder-side controls），即通过显式掩码移除动作提示；(3) 对合法候选棋步进行token级打分。同时测试了来自其他谜题的随机但貌似合理的解释对正确棋步概率的影响，以及可识别的残局模式所起的作用。
AI.result: 未加掩码时解释使生成棋步易于被恢复，但移除显式棋步提示后该优势急剧下降；在严格掩码下，解释相对于仅使用棋盘状态只带来微小且依赖解码器的增益。Token级打分显示解释仍能改变棋步偏好：来自其他谜题的随机但貌似合理的解释会降低正确棋步的概率，说明不相关的推理文本并非被简单忽略。此外，可识别的残局模式能让生成棋步更易被恢复，却不必然提升棋步正确性。
AI.conclusion: 语言的合理性、与所生成动作的一致性、以及解答的正确性是彼此不同的属性。流畅的棋局解释能够影响动作偏好并支撑连贯的棋步叙述，但只能为忠实推理提供有限证据。

title: LD-RSVIS: A Large-Scale and Diverse Benchmark for Referring Surgical Video Instrument Segmentation
summary: Referring surgical video instrument segmentation (RSVIS) aims at segmenting the instrument in a surgical video, given a textual description. Despite recent progress, current models are trained and assessed on relatively small-scale benchmarks, hindering the development of more general RSVIS. In addition, existing benchmarks support only the single-target expression that refers to one instrument in the video, while overlooking multi-target and no-target referring expressions, restricting the applicability of RSVIS in practical scenarios. Addressing these issues, we propose LD-RSVIS, a new benchmark aiming to facilitate more robust and general RSVIS. Specifically, LD-RSVIS consists of 3,536 surgical videos with 1.09 million frames and covers a broad set of 30 instrument classes from 25 various procedures. By including abundant videos and classes, LD-RSVIS could benefit large-scale training and evaluation of more general RSVIS methods. Besides, unlike existing datasets, LD-RSVIS offers diverse referring settings, including no-target, single-target, and multi-target expressions, which enables the development of more practical RSVIS models in real applications. In order to ensure high-quality annotations, all videos in LD-RSVIS are manually labeled with multiple rounds of inspection and refinement. To our knowledge, LD-RSVIS is the largest and most diverse benchmark for RSVIS. To analyze LD-RSVIS and to provide comparison for future research, we evaluate 12 representative methods, and the results reveal that more efforts are required for improvements. To encourage future research, we present a simple yet effective RSVIS method, dubbed Cascade-RSVIS, that first mines target-specific cues using the complementary multi-cue text information and then employs such cues and textual information for segmentation, achieving promising performance. Our benchmark and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LD-RSVIS，一个面向指代手术视频器械分割的大规模、多样化基准，并给出高效方法Cascade-RSVIS。
AI.motivation: 现有RSVIS方法训练与评测基准规模小，且仅支持单目标指代表达式，忽略多目标与无目标情形，限制了泛化性与实际适用性。
AI.method: 构建LD-RSVIS：包含3,536个手术视频、109万帧、30类器械、25种术式，并经多轮人工标注与复核；提供无目标、单目标、多目标指代设置；评测12种代表性方法；提出Cascade-RSVIS，先用互补多线索文本信息挖掘目标特定线索，再结合线索与文本进行分割。
AI.result: LD-RSVIS为目前最大且最多样的RSVIS基准；12种代表性方法评测结果显示仍存在较大改进空间；Cascade-RSVIS取得有前景的性能。
AI.conclusion: LD-RSVIS可支持大规模训练与评测，推动更通用、实用的RSVIS研究；基准与代码将公开。

title: Echo State Network (ESN) for Signal Recovery in RF-Impaired IBFD MIMO Systems
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. This work has been accepted by IEEE Milcom 2026
summary: In-band full-duplex (IBFD) multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems enable simultaneous transmission and reception on the same frequency band, improving spectral efficiency for next-generation wireless networks. However, IBFD-MIMO systems are susceptible to self-interference (SI), which may overpower signals of interest (SOI). In this scenario, blind source separation (BSS) algorithms can be adopted to remove SI and perform joint sensing and communication (JSAC), but BSS algorithms mostly assume an idealized linear and quasi-stationary signal model, which does not hold under realistic radio frequency (RF) impairments, such as I/Q imbalance, carrier frequency offset (CFO), phase noise, and power amplifier nonlinearity. This paper proposes a two-stage echo state network (ESN)-based scheme that is superior to BSS under these realistic conditions. A frozen ESN is trained offline to characterize the static SI path, while an adaptive ESN, updated online via recursive least squares, tracks the time-varying SOI path using sparse pilot symbols. We evaluate the proposed scheme's SOI recovery performance and acquisition speed with different block sizes, comparing it against other recurrent neural networks (RNN), such as long short-term memory (LSTM) and gated recurrent unit (GRU). Simulation results show that the proposed approach outperforms BSS, LSTM, and GRU in both efficiency and SOI recovery, demonstrating the viability of ESNs for real-time, nonlinear self-interference cancellation in realistic IBFD MIMO systems.

AI.tldr: 提出一种两级回声状态网络（ESN）方案，用于现实射频损伤下的IBFD-MIMO自干扰消除，性能优于BSS、LSTM和GRU。
AI.motivation: 带内全双工（IBFD）MIMO系统可在同一频段同时收发以提升频谱效率，但易受自干扰（SI）影响，SI可能淹没有用信号（SOI）。盲源分离（BSS）算法可用于去除SI并实现联合感知与通信（JSAC），但BSS多假设理想化的线性准平稳信号模型，在I/Q不平衡、载波频率偏移（CFO）、相位噪声、功放非线性等现实射频损伤下不成立。
AI.method: 提出两级ESN方案：一个冻结ESN离线训练以刻画静态SI路径；一个自适应ESN通过递归最小二乘（RLS）在线更新，利用稀疏导频符号跟踪时变SOI路径。以不同块大小评估SOI恢复性能与捕获速度，并与LSTM、GRU等RNN对比。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，该方案在效率与SOI恢复方面均优于BSS、LSTM和GRU。
AI.conclusion: 验证了ESN在现实IBFD-MIMO系统中用于实时、非线性自干扰消除的可行性。

title: The Corroboration Illusion: When More News Makes LLM Forecasts Less True
comment: Key words: LLM forecasting, retrieval-augmented generation, data poisoning, misinformation, calibration
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast real-world events by retrieving and reasoning over news. We show that this dependence on an open, crawlable news corpus creates a new attack surface: an adversary who can merely publish articles--without access to the retriever, the model, or the user's queries--can systematically move the forecaster's output probabilities. We formalize news-corpus poisoning of probabilistic forecasters, a threat model distinct from prior RAG poisoning, which targets factual answers or opinion polarity rather than calibrated probabilities. We evaluate the attack on 500 resolved ForecastBench questions against a 17.4M-article Common Crawl News corpus with a strict crawl-date cutoff, using three retrieval-augmented forecasters built on open 7-8B models. A single LLM-written article per question flips 56% of forecasts across the 0.5 boundary; five articles flip 69-73% and shift probabilities by +0.13 to +0.22 net of a neutral-article placebo, degrading the Brier score from 0.18 to 0.37. The effect is monotone in the number, retrieval rank, query similarity, and context share of injected articles, transfers across model families, and is unaffected by the claimed publisher. We then evaluate three natural defenses--source allow-lists, isolate-then-aggregate forecasting, and perplexity filtering--and show that each has a cheap bypass: spoofed publishers, majority poisoning, and higher-temperature generation, respectively. Our results indicate that probabilistic LLM judgments inherit the full fragility of the information supply chain they consume.

AI.tldr: 论文形式化了面向概率预测器的"新闻语料投毒"攻击：仅凭发布文章即可系统性地操纵LLM预测概率，实验证明单篇文章翻转56%预测、五篇翻转69-73%，并使Brier分数由0.18恶化至0.37；现有三类防御均存在廉价绕过手段。
AI.motivation: LLM日益依赖检索新闻来预测现实事件，这种对开放可爬取新闻语料的依赖构成了新的攻击面。作者希望揭示：与以往针对事实答案或观点极性的RAG投毒不同，概率预测器的校准概率同样脆弱，且攻击者无需接触检索器、模型或用户查询即可实施攻击。
AI.method: 1) 形式化新闻语料投毒威胁模型；2) 在500个已解决的ForecastBench问题与1740万篇Common Crawl News语料（严格爬取日期截断）上评估；3) 使用三个基于开源7-8B模型的检索增强预测器；4) 每问题注入LLM撰写的单篇或多篇文章，并设置中性文章安慰剂对照；5) 从文章数量、检索排名、查询相似度、上下文占比等维度分析效应，并测试跨模型族迁移性与发布者身份影响；6) 评估来源白名单、先隔离后聚合预测、困惑度过滤三种防御及其绕过方式。
AI.result: 单篇LLM撰写文章使56%的预测跨越0.5边界；五篇文章翻转69-73%预测，扣除中性安慰剂后净概率偏移+0.13至+0.22，Brier分数从0.18退化至0.37。攻击效应在文章数量、检索排名、查询相似度与上下文占比上呈单调性，可跨模型族迁移，且不受声称发布者影响。三种防御均存在廉价绕过：伪造发布者、多数投毒、更高温度生成。
AI.conclusion: 概率型LLM判断继承了其信息供给链的全部脆弱性；仅靠发布内容即可系统操纵预测输出，且现有常见防御难以有效抵御，提示需重新审视检索增强预测系统的安全边界。

title: MM-ContextFold: Context Folding for Multimodal Agentic Retrieval
summary: Multimodal Agentic Retrieval (MAR) requires agents to solve complex information-seeking tasks by iteratively invoking external tools. Typical frameworks such as ReAct maintain raw multimodal inputs and the accumulating interaction history in a single, ever-growing context, leading to the context explosion problem. While existing methods alleviate this issue by compressing redundant text, effective strategies for managing token-intensive visual content remain largely underexplored. To address this gap, we first conduct a systematic empirical study of approximately 10,000 trajectories. The results show that as visual cues are progressively extracted through external tools and textualized into the context, raw images become increasingly redundant. Continued image retention is associated with higher output entropy and can even degrade task accuracy. Motivated by these findings, we propose MM-ContextFold, a training-free framework that loads raw images only when needed. It maintains a persistent, text-only main context for high-level planning and spawns ephemeral branch contexts for image-dependent subtasks. Within each branch, the agent loads the relevant images, completes the subtask, and folds the result back into the main context as a concise textual summary; the images and branch trace are then discarded. Experiments on seven MAR benchmarks across five backbone models show that MM-ContextFold improves average accuracy by 6.3 percentage points over ReAct while reducing the working context length by 27.5\%.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 MM-ContextFold，通过按需加载图像、分支化子任务并回收图像，解决多模态智能体检索中的上下文爆炸问题。
AI.motivation: ReAct 等框架将原始多模态输入与不断增长的交互历史保留在单一上下文中，导致上下文爆炸；已有方法主要压缩冗余文本，对 token 密集的视觉内容管理策略研究不足。
AI.method: 先对约 10,000 条轨迹进行系统实证研究，发现视觉线索被工具提取并文本化后，原始图像愈发冗余，继续保留会提高输出熵甚至降低准确率；据此提出免训练框架 MM-ContextFold：维护仅文本的持久主上下文用于高层规划，为依赖图像的子任务生成临时分支上下文，在分支内加载相关图像完成子任务，并将结果以简洁文本摘要折叠回主上下文，随后丢弃图像与分支轨迹。
AI.result: 在五个骨干模型、七个 MAR 基准上，平均准确率较 ReAct 提升 6.3 个百分点，同时工作上下文长度减少 27.5%。
AI.conclusion: 原始图像在多模态智能体检索中具有冗余性，按需加载与分支折叠的上下文管理策略可在不训练的情况下显著提升准确率并压缩上下文。

title: Agents That Edit Documents: Measuring Agentic PDF Forgery Against a Non-Agentic Control
summary: AI agents that carry a multi-step computer task through on their own became ordinary tools in the past year, and the same autonomy is available to anyone whose task is harmful. We ask what that means for a relying party -- an insurer, a lender, an auditor -- whose evidence is a filed PDF. AgentForge-Bench measures how reliably an off-the-shelf coding agent, driving one of seven open-weight models with a shell and the stock Python PDF stack, alters one dollar amount, date or address in a real filed financial document from a single sentence of intent, graded by rules rather than by a model. Across 1,750 cells, 1,419 (81.1%) satisfy the verifier, and 808 (46.2%) also survive every stricter filter: visible, localized, typeface-matched, original value gone document-wide. A deterministic script with no model in it solves 98 of the 125 documents; the agents solve 124, and none the script solves alone. Agents misreport 41% of their wrong edits as done, no model refused, and the cheapest verified forgery costs 2.4 cents. The raw rate overstates the threat by about a factor of two; the strict rate is still large.

AI.tldr: AgentForge-Bench量化了现成编码智能体在真实已提交财务PDF中篡改单个金额/日期/地址的可靠性：1,750个测试单元中81.1%通过验证器，46.2%通过更严格的全部过滤条件；智能体可解124份文档而确定性脚本仅98份，且智能体将41%的错误编辑误报为已完成，无一模型拒绝，最低验证成本2.4美分。
AI.motivation: 自主型AI智能体已成为普及工具，但其自主性同样可被用于有害任务。依赖方（保险公司、贷款机构、审计方）的证据常为已提交的PDF文件，因此需要量化：现成编码智能体能否仅凭一句意图指令，可靠地篡改真实已提交财务文件中的单个关键信息（金额、日期或地址），以评估该威胁的真实规模。
