AI.method: 构建AgentForge-Bench基准：让现成编码智能体在shell环境中驱动七种开放权重模型之一，使用标准Python PDF处理栈，仅根据一句意图描述修改真实已提交财务文件中的单个金额、日期或地址。采用规则化（而非模型）验证器进行评分，并设置更严格的过滤条件——修改可见、局部化、字体匹配、原始数值在全文范围内消失。共测试1,750个单元，并设置无模型的确定性脚本作为对照基线。
AI.result: 在1,750个测试单元中，1,419个（81.1%）通过验证器；808个（46.2%）同时通过全部更严格过滤条件。无模型的确定性脚本可解决125份文档中的98份，智能体可解决124份，且脚本单独能解的文档智能体全部能解。智能体将41%的错误编辑误报为已完成，没有任何模型拒绝执行，最便宜的验证型伪造成本为2.4美分。
AI.conclusion: 原始成功率约将威胁高估了一倍（81.1% vs 46.2%的严格率），但严格成功率仍然很高，表明现成智能体对依赖PDF证据的机构构成实质性风险。同时，智能体存在严重的误报完成倾向，且缺乏任何拒绝机制，最低成本极低，说明威胁真实且易得。

title: Checkpoints Are Not Enough: Trust Calibration in CoSLR, a Human-AI System for Systematic Literature Reviews
summary: Systematic Literature Reviews (SLRs) are essential for evidence-based research but remain time-consuming, requiring researchers to manage large volumes of publications across planning, screening, analysis, and reporting. Large language models (LLMs) can now produce fluent, well-structured review text, which makes it difficult to distinguish synthesis that was verified by a researcher from synthesis that merely appears authoritative. This raises the risk that unverified AI-generated synthesis enters the scholarly record carrying the credibility of a systematic review. We present CoSLR, a Human-AI collaborative multi-agent system that supports the SLR workflow through a modular three-phase pipeline using large language models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and that places explicit, mandatory human checkpoints on the path between generated output and its acceptance. In a survey-based study with 63 participants, the system was received positively: 27 of 63 participants (42.9 percent) rated its usability highly, indicating that the mandatory checkpoints did not come at the cost of a workable interface. However, a checkpoint safeguards the review only if researchers use it to verify: 22 of 63 participants (34.9 percent) reported that they would trust AI-generated summaries and reports without additional human checking after only a short interaction with the system. These findings indicate that Human-AI collaboration can support literature review work, but that the effectiveness of human oversight depends on whether users are willing to exercise it. This is a calibration problem that interface design must address directly, not assume.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoSLR——一个基于LLM与RAG、带强制性人工检查点的三阶段多智能体人机协作系统，用于支持系统性文献综述（SLR）全流程；63人调研显示可用性评价良好，但约三分之一用户表示会在缺乏人工核验的情况下信任AI生成的综述内容，表明人机协作的有效性取决于用户是否愿意行使人工作监督。
AI.motivation: 系统性文献综述是循证研究的基础，但耗时巨大，需在规划、筛选、分析和报告各阶段处理大量文献。LLM能生成流畅且结构良好的综述文本，使得"经研究者核验的综合"与"仅看似权威的综合"难以区分，存在未经核验的AI生成内容以系统综述的可信度进入学术记录的风险。因此需要一套在生成输出与采纳之间设置显式、强制性人工检查点的协作系统。
AI.method: 提出CoSLR：一种人机协作多智能体系统，采用模块化三阶段流水线，基于LLM与检索增强生成（RAG）支撑SLR工作流，并在生成输出到被采纳的路径上设置显式且强制性的人工检查点。随后开展63名参与者参与的问卷调研以评估系统可用性与用户核验意愿。
AI.result: 系统整体获得积极反馈：63名参与者中有27人（42.9%）对其可用性给出高评价，说明强制性检查点并未以牺牲界面可用性为代价。但检查点只有在研究者真正用于核验时才能起到保障作用：63人中有22人（34.9%）表示，在仅与系统进行短暂交互后，他们会在没有额外人工核验的情况下信任AI生成的摘要和报告。
AI.conclusion: 人机协作能够支持文献综述工作，但人工作监督的有效性取决于用户是否愿意主动行使核验行为。这是一个"校准"问题，界面设计必须直接应对，而不能默认用户会自动履行核验职责。

title: QwenVLConnector: A Fast, Unified Medical VLM Chatbot for Fine-Grained Clinical Perception and Text Generation
summary: Most medical vision-language models (VLMs) excel at open-ended report generation and VQA but provide limited support for structured, fine-grained clinical perception within a unified interface. We present QwenVLConnector, a Qwen2.5-VL-based medical chatbot that unifies classification, multi-label classification, textualized detection, counting, regression, and free-form report generation under a single next-token objective. Our key component is a lightweight dense multi-layer Connector that aggregates low- and high-level visual features, aligns them through the pretrained vision Merger, and fuses them with the final visual representation without increasing sequence length. This design enriches visual tokens with complementary spatial and semantic cues while preserving efficiency. On FLARE-2D, QwenVLConnector improves detection F1 from 0.55 to 0.85, raises single-label classification from 0.37 to 0.51, and boosts report-generation GREEN by up to 18.3 points over the Qwen2.5-VL baseline. We further explore multimodal in-context learning for report generation, showing additional improvements without updating model parameters. Overall, QwenVLConnector offers a unified and efficient framework for combining structured medical perception with open-ended clinical text generation. Our code can be found at https://github.com/plnguyen2908/QwenConnector.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QwenVLConnector，一个基于Qwen2.5-VL的医学聊天机器人，通过轻量级密集多层Connector统一分类、多标签分类、文本化检测、计数、回归和报告生成任务，在FLARE-2D上显著提升各项指标。
AI.motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型擅长开放式报告生成和VQA，但在统一接口下对结构化、细粒度临床感知任务的支持有限。
AI.method: 核心是轻量级密集多层Connector：聚合低层与高层视觉特征，通过预训练vision Merger对齐，并与最终视觉表示融合而不增加序列长度，从而为视觉token补充空间与语义线索并保持效率；所有任务统一在单一next-token目标下。
AI.result: 在FLARE-2D上，检测F1从0.55提升至0.85，单标签分类从0.37提升至0.51，报告生成GREEN较Qwen2.5-VL基线最高提升18.3分；进一步探索多模态上下文学习可在不更新参数的情况下进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: QwenVLConnector为结构化医学感知与开放式临床文本生成的统一结合提供了一个高效框架。

title: Divergent strategies and convergent outcomes in autonomous materials discovery
summary: Scientific agents are mostly evaluated on whether they complete tasks or recover known results; we instead study variation across repeated open-ended campaigns. Sixteen separately initialized sessions of one model-harness configuration received a frozen database of 12,499 metal-organic frameworks, a methane-storage objective, a pinned protocol and a one-week budget. Strategies diverged into four approaches spanning 100--5,000 screened structures, and eight built 2,253 hypothetical structures. Yet the agents recovered the same materials frontier near 200 cm^3/cm^3, and an independent calculation of the database's porous region found its nine best structures all among their reports. Enforced checks on half the agents raised fresh-run reproduction from one of eight to eight of eight but could not detectably improve conclusion validity, because fifteen of sixteen agents selected the same audit-excluded entry, an incomplete structure whose missing anions created artificial pore volume. Replicated agents thus reveal both robust conclusions and common-mode errors from shared inputs.

AI.tldr: 该研究以16个独立初始化的同模型-框架智能体重复开展开放式甲烷存储材料筛选campaign，发现策略多样但结论高度一致，同时暴露出由共享输入导致的共性错误。
AI.motivation: 现有科学智能体评价多关注任务是否完成或能否复现已知结果，缺乏对重复开放式探索中变异性的研究，作者希望考察智能体在开放式科研campaign中的重复稳定性与结论稳健性。
AI.method: 给16个独立初始化的相同模型-框架配置会话提供冻结的12,499个金属有机框架数据库、甲烷存储目标、固定协议与一周预算；对其中一半智能体施加强制性检查；并与数据库多孔区域的独立计算结果进行对比。
AI.result: 策略分化为四类方法，筛选规模从100至5,000个结构不等，其中八个构建了2,253个假设结构；但智能体均恢复了约200 cm^3/cm^3附近的相同材料前沿，独立计算发现数据库多孔区域最优的九个结构均在其报告中。强制检查将新运行复现率从八分之一提升至八分之八，却未能显著改善结论有效性，因为16个智能体中有15个选中了同一被审计排除的条目——一个缺失阴离子、产生人工孔体积的不完整结构。
AI.conclusion: 重复运行的智能体既呈现稳健结论，也因共享输入而产生共性错误；说明仅靠复现性检查不足以保障结论有效性。

title: A Tutorial on Prompt Engineering: From Messy Thoughts to AI Workflows
summary: This paper treats prompt engineering as a discipline for turning informal human intent into structured AI work specifications. It develops the practice as a sequence of reusable design moves: define the work, construct only the context the answer depends on, choose a role, or a moderated panel of roles, as an attention lens, and state affirmative quality targets, reserving prohibitions for hard boundaries. To keep prompts lean, it adapts two classical principles, Occam's razor and Chekhov's gun, so that every instruction earns its place. For consequential tasks, it adds structured critique through steelmanning and premortems, followed by verification and, where tools or multi-step actions are involved, agentic operating loops with explicit boundaries and escalation. Aimed at a general readership, this tutorial is not a benchmarking study; it offers a practical, technically grounded path from casual prompting to disciplined AI workflow design, illustrated by a worked example that carries one task from a weak prompt to a strong specification. The framework is presented as principles and checklists that remain useful as models and tools change. The strongest prompt is rarely the longest prompt; it is the one that makes desired behaviour, required sources and checks, and success criteria unmistakable.

AI.tldr: 本文将提示工程视为一门把非正式人类意图转化为结构化AI工作规范的学科，提出一套可复用的设计动作序列（定义工作、构建必要上下文、角色或角色面板作为注意力透镜、正向质量目标优先），并借用奥卡姆剃刀与契诃夫之枪原则使指令精简。对重要任务引入钢人化与事前验尸的结构化批判、验证以及带明确边界与升级机制的智能体操作循环，通过一个从弱提示到强规范的实例展示实用路径，强调最强提示不在于长而在于清晰。
AI.motivation: 将提示工程从随意尝试提升为有纪律的工作规范设计，使非正式的人类意图能可靠地转化为AI可执行的结构化任务。目标是面向普通读者，提供一种不依赖具体模型与工具、可长期适用的原则与清单式方法。
AI.method: 以设计动作序列组织实践：定义工作；仅构造答案所依赖的上下文；选择角色或经过约束的角色面板作为注意力透镜；陈述正向质量目标，仅在硬性边界处使用禁止性表述。借用奥卡姆剃刀（去除不必要指令）与契诃夫之枪（每条指令都须发挥作用）保持提示精简。对高风险任务加入钢人化与事前验尸式结构化批判，随后进行验证；涉及工具或多步动作时采用带明确边界与升级路径的智能体操作循环。以单一任务的实例从弱提示演进到强规范加以说明。
AI.result: 本文为教程性质，而非基准测试研究，不提供量化性能对比；其成果是一套以原则和检查清单形式呈现的框架，并附有一个从弱提示到强规范的完整示例，展示方法在实践中的可操作性。
AI.conclusion: 提示工程应被视为面向AI工作规范的设计学科。最强的提示通常不是最长的提示，而是让期望行为、所需来源与检查项、成功标准都清晰无歧义的那一个。所提原则与清单具有跨模型、跨工具的稳健性，可支持从随意提示走向有纪律的AI工作流设计。

title: SparkDiffusion: Mitigating the High-Sparsity Trap --- A Unified Framework for up to $265\times$ Single-GPU Acceleration of Visual Generation
summary: Video diffusion transformers are expensive because attention dominates long spatiotemporal token sequences. We identify the \emph{high-sparsity trap}: at extreme attention sparsity, step-local training losses keep decreasing while terminal generation quality stagnates or degrades. The trap is one of supervision: the dominant terminal errors originate in the high-noise structure-generation stage, and terminal-aligned training corrects terminal errors that substantially extended step-local training cannot. This yields a simple staging principle: \emph{first adapt the sparse architecture into a coarse prior, then correct the terminal distribution}. We instantiate the principle as \method, a unified acceleration framework for visual generation that combines a short sparse warm-up, few-step trajectory-mixed distillation, and FP8 quantization with fused kernels. \method sustains $97\%$ attention sparsity with strong visual quality on long-sequence 720P generation across Wan2.1/Wan2.2 backbones and T2V/I2V tasks, and $90\%$ sparsity on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-480P. With 3-step CFG-free inference, \method achieves a $265\times$ end-to-end speedup over the 50-step CFG dense baseline for Wan2.1-T2V-14B-720P on a single RTX~5090 ($220\times$ on H100), and denoises a Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-480P video in $1.3$s.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"高稀疏陷阱"现象，指出极端注意力稀疏下步局部训练损失下降但终端生成质量停滞；据此提出先粗后细的分阶段原则及统一加速框架，实现97%稀疏度与265倍端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer因注意力机制在长时空token序列上开销巨大而代价高昂。作者希望在极端注意力稀疏下加速生成，但发现此时步局部训练损失持续下降，终端生成质量却停滞甚至退化，这一矛盾亟待解释与解决。
AI.method: 将问题归因于监督方式：主导性终端误差源自高噪声结构生成阶段，终端对齐训练能纠正步局部训练无法纠正的终端误差。据此提出分阶段原则——先将稀疏架构适配为粗糙先验，再校正终端分布。并以统一加速框架实例化：短稀疏预热、少步轨迹混合蒸馏、FP8量化与融合内核。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1/Wan2.2骨干与T2V/I2V任务的长序列720P生成上，维持97%注意力稀疏度且视觉质量强；Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-480P达90%稀疏度。3步无CFG推理下，Wan2.1-T2V-14B-720P在单张RTX 5090上相对50步CFG稠密基线实现265倍端到端加速（H100上220倍），1.3B-480P视频去噪仅需1.3秒。
AI.conclusion: 终端对齐的分阶段训练可有效解决高稀疏陷阱，稀疏注意力、少步蒸馏与FP8量化的结合能在极高稀疏度下保持生成质量并带来数量级加速，为视频扩散Transformer的高效推理提供了可行方案。

title: UniK: Universal Knowledge Perception for Digital and Physical AI
summary: Two transformative classes of AI systems are reshaping how organizations operate: \textit{digital AI}, which reasons over enterprise knowledge to power chatbots and agent workflows; and \textit{physical AI}, which learns to control robots and autonomous systems from video, gameplay, and sensor telemetry. Both face the same foundational bottleneck: raw knowledge at scale, spanning heterogeneous modalities, locked in private corpora that existing AI infrastructure cannot access reliably or efficiently. We propose \textit{Universal Knowledge Perception (UniK)} as a common platform for both classes, covering the full knowledge lifecycle (ingestion, enrichment, indexing, retrieval, and continuous evaluation) across modalities from rich text and video to molecular data and sensor telemetry. We present UniK, built on Polymath Retrieval (multi-index fusion over automatically enriched indices) with no task-specific fine-tuning. Across five digital AI domains (medical literature, open-domain QA, chemistry, legal video proceedings, and government open data) UniK combined with an open-source 70-billion-parameter model consistently matches or outperforms frontier proprietary LLMs that are orders of magnitude larger: 76\% RAG accuracy on government data versus 47\% for GPT-5; 77.9\% on medical QA without fine-tuning; topping all open-source chemistry pipelines. We show that the same infrastructure directly addresses the data curation, indexing, and retrieval challenges facing physical AI world model training, where the knowledge problem is harder but structurally identical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通用知识感知平台UniK，以Polymath Retrieval（多索引融合）实现跨模态知识全生命周期管理，无需任务微调即可在多个数字AI领域媲美或超越超大闭源LLM，并可迁移至物理AI的数据策管与检索。
AI.motivation: 数字AI（企业知识问答、智能体工作流）与物理AI（机器人、自主系统控制）面临共同的基础瓶颈：大规模、多模态原始知识散落于私有语料库，现有AI基础设施无法可靠高效地访问。需要统一平台解决知识的摄取、增强、索引、检索与持续评估问题。
AI.method: 构建UniK平台，覆盖知识全生命周期（ingestion、enrichment、indexing、retrieval、continuous evaluation），支持从富文本、视频到分子数据与传感器遥测的多模态；核心为Polymath Retrieval，即对自动增强后的索引进行多索引融合，且不做任何任务特定微调。
AI.result: 在五个数字AI领域（医学文献、开放域QA、化学、法律视频庭审、政府开放数据）中，UniK结合开源700亿参数模型一致地匹配或超越大数个数量级的前沿闭源LLM：政府数据RAG准确率76%（GPT-5为47%）；医学QA 77.9%（无微调）；在开源化学流水线中排名居首。
AI.conclusion: 同一套基础设施可直接应对物理AI世界模型训练所面临的数据策管、索引与检索挑战，其知识问题虽更难但结构上同构，说明UniK可作为两类AI系统的通用知识底座。

title: Deep Persona: A Psychologically Grounded Architecture and Evaluation Framework for Role-Playing Agents and Simulations
summary: Existing approaches to persona simulation with Large Language Models (LLMs) mostly rely on shallow character descriptions that fail to sustain coherent character behavior across extended interactions. We introduce Deep Persona, a psychologically grounded, three-layered architecture that organizes personas into hierarchical levels of observable expression, latent beliefs, and core motivational drives, for constructing highly convincing role-playing agents. Governed by the principles of scripted determinism and bounded agency, the architecture restricts the model to a reactive engine guided by a structured internal script. We further propose a reference-free evaluation framework that benchmarks dialogue naturalness against empirical human distributions using established psychological clinical instruments and adversarial stress-tests. Empirical evaluation reveals that while LLMs achieve high pragmatic fluency, they exhibit systematic limitations in emotional expression and joint attention. In addition, we present a case study of two Deep Personas and evaluate them using the proposed framework, demonstrating that structured personas can produce interactions that more closely align with human conversational behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出三层心理架构 Deep Persona 及无参考评估框架，提升 LLM 角色扮演的一致性与拟人度。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 人格模拟多依赖浅层角色描述，难以在长程交互中维持连贯的角色行为。
AI.method: 构建心理学取向的三层架构：可观察表达、潜在信念、核心动机驱动力；以"脚本化确定性"与"有限能动性"为原则，将模型约束为受结构化内部脚本引导的反应式引擎；并提出无参考评估框架，借助心理学临床量表与对抗性压力测试，将对话自然度对照真实人类分布进行基准比较。
AI.result: LLM 在语用流畅度上表现良好，但在情绪表达与共同注意方面存在系统性局限；两个 Deep Persona 案例研究表明，结构化人格可产生更贴近人类对话行为的交互。
AI.conclusion: 结构化、心理学驱动的人格设计能有效缓解长程角色一致性不足的问题；无参考评估可揭示 LLM 拟人化的系统性短板。

title: An Eternal Irradiance Camera
summary: A conventional camera uses millions of pixels to measure radiance from all directions within its field of view. We present an omnidirectional irradiance camera that measures the irradiance function---the illumination incident upon every point on a sphere. The irradiance function varies smoothly over the sphere and hence is bandlimited. We have analyzed this function in the frequency domain and have shown that it is well approximated by a weighted sum of the first seven degrees of spherical harmonics. As a result, the irradiance function can be accurately reconstructed from a small number of samples. This implies that an irradiance camera does not need millions of detectors (pixels)---just a handful of measurements suffice. This brings two major benefits. First, the camera consumes such little energy that it can be completely powered by the light falling on its detectors. Second, it does not capture the visual details needed to identify an individual, and hence privacy is preserved. We have built a prototype irradiance camera, called FluxCam, using 49 detectors arranged on the surface of a sphere. In a well-lit indoor environment, FluxCam can read out and wirelessly transmit its measurements at 30 frames per second using energy harvested from the light falling on it (i.e., without a battery, cable, or external power supply). We show how FluxCam can be used as an optical gyroscope for computing rotation, to monitor a workspace, as an untethered light probe for diffuse relighting, and as an omnidirectional pyranometer for estimating sky conditions and determining the best orientation of a solar panel.

AI.tldr: 提出全向辐照度相机FluxCam，利用球面辐照度函数的带限特性，仅需少量探测器即可重建，实现光能自供电与隐私保护。
AI.motivation: 传统相机用数百万像素测量视场内各方向辐射，能耗高且会捕捉可识别个人身份的视觉细节，带来隐私问题。作者希望以极少量测量获取光照信息，从而实现低功耗自供电并保护隐私。
AI.method: 将入射到球面各点的辐照度函数在频域分析，证明其平滑且带限，可用前七阶球谐函数的加权和良好近似，因而少量采样即可精确重建。据此设计并制作原型FluxCam：在球面表面布置49个探测器，读取并通过无线方式传输测量值。
AI.result: 在光照良好的室内环境中，FluxCam依靠落在探测器上的光收集的能量（无需电池、线缆或外部电源）以30帧每秒读出并无线传输数据。展示了其作为光学陀螺仪计算旋转、监测工作空间、作为无拘束光探针用于漫反射重光照，以及作为全向总辐射表估计天空状况并确定太阳能板最佳朝向的应用。
AI.conclusion: 辐照度函数带限意味着辐照度相机无需数百万像素，少量测量即可，从而带来极低能耗（可由光自供电）与隐私保护两大优势，并通过FluxCam原型验证了多种实际应用。

title: LEAP-NBV: Lightweight Edge Active-Perception for Foundation-Model Next-Best-View Planning
summary: Foundation models are endowing autonomous systems with greater intelligence, enabling a more comprehensive understanding of the environment through visual perception. A representative example is Human Mesh Recovery (HMR), which provides useful estimates of a target's 3D pose and shape that can benefit tactical missions. However, the size and power demands of such models make them difficult to run on edge platforms and limit their real-time performance, undermining the requirements of tactical edge deployment - especially for active perception, where a mobile robot must plan its next-best view on-board and cannot offload computation under contested communications. We present LEAP-NBV, a lightweight active-perception framework that runs foundation-model-driven Next-Best-View (NBV) planning on-board an edge device. To this end, we distill a family of large HMR teachers, each into a compact 32M student, with an offline mesh objective, then quantize the vision encoder to FP16 and characterize its on-device accuracy and latency. Within an occlusion-aware active perception loop, we evaluate all configurations on the same held-out benchmark and deploy the end-to-end pipeline on an NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX, reporting measured on-device latency and energy. Distillation recovers 6-7 mm of Procrustes-aligned mean per-vertex position error (PA-MPVPE) over the undistilled student on the test set. Selecting the edge-optimal compression model brings the HMR engine to ~12 ms at a small accuracy cost and runs the full closed loop at 3.6 FPS and 2.6 J per frame, achieving a 2.0x speedup and 3.0x lower energy than the uncompressed model while nearly matching downstream task quality.

AI.tldr: LEAP-NBV：在边缘设备上运行的轻量级主动感知框架，通过蒸馏+FP16量化压缩HMR基座模型，实现板载NBV规划，端到端3.6 FPS、2.6 J/帧，较未压缩模型加速2.0倍、能耗降低3.0倍。
AI.motivation: 基座模型（如人体网格恢复HMR）虽能提升自主系统的环境理解能力，但其参数量与算力/功耗需求过大，难以在边缘平台实时运行。在战术边缘的主动感知场景中，移动机器人需板载规划次优视角且无法在通信受限时卸载计算，因此亟需轻量化且能效高的板载方案。
AI.method: 提出LEAP-NBV轻量级主动感知框架：将多个大型HMR教师模型分别蒸馏为32M的紧凑学生模型，采用离线网格（mesh）目标；对视觉编码器做FP16量化并刻画其在设备上的精度与延迟；在遮挡感知的主动感知闭环中，于同一留出基准上评估全部配置，并将端到端流水线部署到NVIDIA Jetson Xavier NX上，实测板载延迟与能耗。
AI.result: 蒸馏在学生模型上相比未蒸馏版本于测试集上恢复了6-7 mm的PA-MPVPE误差；选用边缘最优压缩模型使HMR引擎约12 ms（精度代价很小），完整闭环达3.6 FPS、2.6 J/帧，相比未压缩模型实现2.0倍加速与3.0倍能耗降低，且下游任务质量基本持平。
AI.conclusion: 通过蒸馏与量化相结合的压缩策略，可以在边缘设备上实现基座模型驱动的板载NBV主动感知，在显著降低延迟与能耗的同时几乎不损失下游任务性能，验证了战术边缘实时主动感知部署的可行性。

title: DIPLOMAT: Dialogue-Span-Aware Direct Preference Optimization for Polite Persuasive Workplace Negotiation Dialogues
summary: Effective workplace negotiation requires balancing multiple objectives, including achieving task goals, preserving professional relationships, and resolving conflicts constructively. However, misunderstandings, misaligned preferences, and interpersonal friction often impede successful outcomes. Politeness mitigates these challenges by fostering trust, reducing tension, and preventing escalation, and persuasive communication helps overcome resistance, align preferences, and guide participants toward mutually beneficial agreements. Motivated by these insights, we present DIPLOMAT, a dialogue system for polite and persuasive workplace negotiation. To support its development, we introduce PROWESS, a dataset of multi-turn workplace negotiation dialogues generated via a multi-agent framework and enriched withnegotiation strategies, politeness levels, persuasive strategies. DIPLOMAT is trained using Dialogue-Span-Aware Direct Preference Optimization (DSA-DPO), a novel preference learning objective that identifies key dialogue spans for preference alignment. This enables DIPLOMAT to generate contextually coherent responses that employ intended negotiation strategies, maintain politeness, and incorporate effective persuasion strategies throughout interactions. Automatic and human evaluation on PROWESS confirm that DIPLOMAT consistently outperforms baselines in generating coherent, polite, and persuasive negotiation responses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DIPLOMAT对话系统及PROWESS数据集，通过DSA-DPO偏好学习实现礼貌且具说服力的职场谈判对话生成。
AI.motivation: 职场谈判需平衡任务目标、维护职业关系并建设性解决冲突，但误解、偏好错位和人际摩擦常阻碍成功结果。礼貌可增进信任、缓解紧张，说服性沟通有助于克服阻力、对齐偏好并促成互利协议，故需构建兼顾礼貌与说服的谈判对话系统。
AI.method: 提出DIPLOMAT谈判对话系统；构建PROWESS多轮职场谈判对话数据集，由多智能体框架生成，并标注谈判策略、礼貌程度与说服策略；采用对话片段感知的直接偏好优化（DSA-DPO）进行训练，识别关键对话片段以对齐偏好。
AI.result: 自动与人工评估表明，DIPLOMAT在生成连贯、礼貌且具说服力的谈判回复方面持续优于各基线模型。
AI.conclusion: DIPLOMAT结合PROWESS数据集与DSA-DPO方法，能够按预期策略生成连贯、礼貌且有说服力的谈判回复，验证了策略与礼貌、说服整合在职场谈判对话中的有效性。

title: UltraTex: Unleashing 2K Multi-View Diffusion for 3D Texturing
summary: High-quality texture generation is essential for creating realistic and production-ready 3D assets. Recent multi-view diffusion methods have shown promising results for image-guided 3D texturing, but they are typically constrained to low operating resolutions such as 512 or 768, making it difficult to preserve high-frequency details from high-resolution reference images. Scaling this paradigm to 2048 resolution is computationally prohibitive, as the unified multi-view sequence exceeds 212K tokens and incurs excessive memory and latency. In this paper, we present UltraTex, an efficient end-to-end framework for high-resolution multi-view diffusion-based 3D texturing. Our key observation is that object-centric multi-view renderings contain two major sources of redundancy: background-induced sequence redundancy and sparse token interactions within the foreground. To address them, we introduce Background Token Dropping, which removes background tokens before the DiT backbone, and Block-Sparse Attention, which reduces attention computation over the retained foreground sequence. To enable efficient foreground-only inference while avoiding reconstruction artifacts, we further design Foreground-Aware VAE Decoding to ensure the quality of the final high-resolution views. To satisfy the demanding data requirements of 2K-resolution multi-view diffusion training, we construct G-buffer TexVerse, a large-scale, ultra-high-resolution multi-view rendering dataset covering over 268,000 3D assets. Extensive experiments show that UltraTex generates visually faithful textures with rich fine-grained details, while substantially improving efficiency, achieving $20.6\times$--$91.1\times$ training speedup and $22.3\times$--$74.6\times$ end-to-end inference speedup over the baseline on common samples in our dataset. Code and data is at https://yiboz2001.github.io/UltraTex.

AI.tldr: UltraTex 是一个高效端到端的 3D 纹理生成框架，通过背景 token 丢弃、块稀疏注意力与前景感知 VAE 解码，将多视图扩散纹理生成扩展到 2048 分辨率，并构建了大规模超高清数据集 G-buffer TexVerse。
AI.motivation: 高质量纹理生成对生产级 3D 资产至关重要。现有多视图扩散方法受限于 512 或 768 等低分辨率，难以保留高分辨率参考图中的高频细节；直接扩展到 2048 分辨率时，统一多视图序列超过 212K token，导致内存和延迟开销过大，计算上不可行。
AI.method: 核心观察：以物体为中心的多视图渲染存在两类冗余——背景引起的序列冗余，以及前景内稀疏的 token 交互。为此提出：(1) Background Token Dropping，在 DiT 主干前移除背景 token；(2) Block-Sparse Attention，在保留的前景序列上减少注意力计算；(3) Foreground-Aware VAE Decoding，实现高效的前景-only 推理并避免重建伪影。此外构建 G-buffer TexVerse 数据集，覆盖 26.8 万余个 3D 资产。
AI.result: UltraTex 能生成视觉逼真、细节丰富的纹理，同时显著提升效率：相比基线在数据集常见样本上实现 20.6×–91.1× 训练加速和 22.3×–74.6× 端到端推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除多视图渲染中的背景冗余与前景稀疏注意力冗余，并结合前景感知解码和大规模超高清数据集，UltraTex 可在 2048 分辨率下高效生成高质量 3D 纹理，兼顾质量与效率。代码与数据已开源。

title: Jev-Mem: System-One-Controlled Agentic Memory for Efficient AI Agents
summary: Agentic memory is becoming essential for long-horizon AI agents, yet many existing systems rely on autoregressive LLMs to control how memories are organized, retrieved, and used, placing expensive generation on the critical path of memory operations. We introduce \textbf{\method}, a new agentic memory architecture inspired by System-One/System-Two cognition. System One captures fast, lightweight decision-making, whereas System Two performs slower, deliberative reasoning. Jev-Mem brings this division of labor to agentic memory through a dedicated System-One control plane, a structured multi-relational memory plane, and a System-Two reasoning plane. The System-One controller governs memory typing and relational organization during construction, and dynamically performs query routing, retrieval-budget allocation, graph traversal, candidate scoring, and adaptive stopping during retrieval. System Two is invoked only for complex reasoning and answer synthesis. This design improves both memory effectiveness and system efficiency: on LoCoMo Jev-Mem achieves an overall LLM-as-a-Judge score of 0.777, an 11.0\% relative improvement over the strongest baseline, while reducing memory construction time to 158\,s, a 6.6$\times$ speedup over the fastest competing memory system, and lowering average query latency to 0.93\,s, a 36.7\% reduction.

AI.tldr: Jev-Mem是一种受双系统认知启发的智能体记忆架构，通过System-One控制平面承担记忆构建与检索的轻量决策，仅在复杂推理时调用System-Two，从而在效果与效率上同时提升。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统多依赖自回归LLM控制记忆的组织、检索与使用，将昂贵的生成过程置于记忆操作的关键路径上，导致效率低下。
AI.method: 借鉴System-One/System-Two认知理论，设计三平面架构：System-One控制平面负责构建阶段的记忆类型划分与关系组织，以及检索阶段的查询路由、检索预算分配、图遍历、候选打分与自适应停止；结构化多关系记忆平面用于存储组织记忆；System-Two推理平面仅在复杂推理与答案合成时被调用。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准上取得0.777的LLM-as-a-Judge总体得分，较最强基线相对提升11.0%；记忆构建时间降至158秒，较最快竞争系统加速6.6倍；平均查询延迟降至0.93秒，降低36.7%。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆控制从昂贵的生成式LLM中解耦，交由专门的System-One控制平面处理，可同时提升记忆有效性与系统效率，验证了双系统认知分工在智能体记忆中的可行性。

title: Which Part of the Context Layer Does the Work? Separating Semantic Content from Retrieval Scaffolding in Text-to-SQL Agents
summary: Context layers, curated documentation that an analytics agent fetches at query time, produce large accuracy gains on text-to-SQL benchmarks. A with/without comparison cannot say which part of the layer does the work: the semantic content, the retrieval scaffolding that delivers it, or the pre-computed views that usually accompany it. We report a four-arm ablation on DABStep on four models that separates the three. The instrument is a data contract: a YAML artifact that carries a domain's semantics and the rules an agent's tools enforce. One arm empties every field of prose in the frozen contract while holding the tool surface, retrieval instruction, table allow-list and operation rules byte-for-byte fixed. Compiling the contract's own SQL expressions into views gives the ceiling a pre-computed layer would reach: gold on all 176 tasks it covers. Content dominates. It raises hard-task accuracy from 13.9% to 55.1%, 22.6% to 56.6%, 22.9% to 68.4% and 37.0% to 77.4%, beating the same knowledge pasted into the prompt on every model. Scaffolding without content is worth 0 to 5 points on two flash models and 14 to 15 on two frontier models. Against the compiled ceiling the contract arm's shortfall is a failure to derive, and it falls from 39 points to 5 with model capability. The contract beats the prompt because the rule it needs is one lookup away rather than buried in a long prompt: its SQL carries the fee semantics up to 98% of the time against the prompt arm's 4%, and at the lowest cost per correct answer on three of four models. For practitioners: semantics first, scaffolding second, pre-computed macros only where an agent demonstrably fails to derive. Ungoverned arms submitted 166 mutating statements; governed arms none. The gain is confined to the contract's domain. On one model the benchmark's own withheld golds grade the contract arm at 51.9% against 18.8% for the prompt baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文通过四臂消融实验，在 DABStep 基准和四个模型上，将上下文层的作用拆解为语义内容、检索脚手架与预计算视图三部分，发现语义内容贡献最大，脚手架作用次要，预计算宏应仅在智能体无法推导时使用。
AI.motivation: 上下文层（查询时获取的整理文档）在 text-to-SQL 基准上带来大幅精度提升，但简单的"有/无"对比无法区分是语义内容、交付内容的检索脚手架，还是通常伴随出现的预计算视图在起作用，因此需要受控消融来分离这三者。
AI.method: 采用四臂消融设计，工具为"数据契约"——一种 YAML 工件，承载领域语义及智能体工具执行的规则。其中一个实验臂清空冻结契约中的所有散文内容，同时逐字节固定工具接口、检索指令、表白名单与操作规则。将契约自身的 SQL 表达式编译为视图，以给出预计算层所能达到的上限。同时与"将相同知识粘贴进提示词"的基线对比，并在四个模型上测量硬任务准确率、知识使用率、成本与治理行为。
AI.result: 语义内容占主导：硬任务准确率从 13.9% 提升到 55.1%、22.6% 到 56.6%、22.9% 到 68.4%、37.0% 到 77.4%，在每个模型上都优于把相同知识粘贴进提示词的方案。仅脚手架而无内容时，两个 flash 模型仅提升 0-5 分，两个前沿模型提升 14-15 分。相对编译上限，契约臂的差距是"推导失败"，且随模型能力从 39 分降至 5 分。契约的 SQL 在最多 98% 的情况下携带费用语义（提示词臂仅 4%），并在四个模型中的三个上实现最低的每正确回答成本。未治理臂提交了 166 条变更语句，治理臂为零。收益局限于契约领域内；某模型上基准自身保留的 gold 评分显示契约臂为 51.9%，提示词基线为 18.8%。
AI.conclusion: 对实践者的建议是：语义优先，脚手架其次，预计算宏仅在智能体确实无法推导时使用。契约优于提示词的原因在于所需规则"只需一次查找"而非埋没于长提示词中。收益具有领域局限性，且治理机制有效阻止了变更性语句的提交。

title: GrapeSplat: Geometry-Grounded Reconstruction via Amalgamated Pose-Free Encoding for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting now reconstructs renderable scenes from unposed, uncalibrated images. Yet, most models supervise only photometric consistency and predict Gaussians pixel by pixel, which leaves global structure fragile and ties primitive count to image resolution and view count. To this end, GrapeSplat amalgamates multi-view cues into a voxel-aligned scene representation and decodes Gaussians directly from the learned grid, requiring no per-scene optimization or post-processing. An Atlas Encoder lifts all views into pixel-wise geometry-and-appearance features anchored at predicted 3D points. PEACH-Vox compands the unbounded scene into a bounded sparse grid through a smooth per-axis map with an exact closed-form inverse. The Sparse Decoder then consolidates the grid with sparse convolutions and decodes the full scene as multiple Gaussians per occupied cell. This amalgamated representation exploits sparse voxel occupancy, where the Gaussian count follows the occupied cells and saturates as views cover the scene, while grid resolution sets its ceiling. GrapeSplat turns unposed images into a renderable Gaussian scene in a single forward pass. Trained with 2D and 3D supervision on 8-view sequences, it generalizes zero-shot from 4 to 64 views across indoor and unbounded scenes. Code and trained weights are available at https://github.com/VAISR/GrapeSplat

AI.tldr: GrapeSplat 提出一种前馈式 3D 高斯泼溅框架：将多视图线索融合为体素对齐的场景表示，并直接从学习到的稀疏网格中解码高斯，无需逐场景优化或后处理，即可将无位姿、未标定图像单次前向传播生成可渲染场景，且在高斯数量与视图覆盖解耦方面具有优势。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈式 3D 高斯泼溅虽能从未标定、无位姿图像重建可渲染场景，但多数方法仅以光度一致性为监督，并逐像素预测高斯，导致全局结构脆弱，且高斯基元数量与图像分辨率及视图数量绑定。为此，作者希望构建一种不依赖逐场景优化、具有全局结构约束且基元数量可控的场景表示。
AI.method: 方法核心为将多视图线索融合进体素对齐的场景表示，并直接从学习到的网格解码高斯。具体包含三个组件：1) Atlas Encoder 将所有视图提升为以预测 3D 点为锚点的逐像素几何与外观特征；2) PEACH-Vox 通过平滑的逐轴映射将无界场景压缩为有界稀疏网格，并具备精确闭式逆映射；3) Sparse Decoder 使用稀疏卷积对网格进行聚合，并在每个被占据单元解码多个高斯。该表示利用稀疏体素占据性：高斯数量随被占据单元变化，在视图覆盖场景后趋于饱和，其上限由网格分辨率决定。
AI.result: GrapeSplat 能在单次前向传播中将无位姿图像转换为可渲染的高斯场景。模型在 8 视图序列上结合 2D 与 3D 监督训练，并在室内及无界场景中实现从 4 到 64 视图的零样本泛化。代码与训练权重已开源。
AI.conclusion: GrapeSplat 通过将多视图融合为体素对齐表示并直接从稀疏网格解码高斯，实现了无需逐场景优化或后处理的前馈式可渲染场景重建，缓解了全局结构脆弱及基元数量与分辨率/视图数耦合的问题，并展示出良好的跨视图零样本泛化能力。

title: ACLArena: Agent Continue Learning in Multi-stage Post-training
summary: Building general-purpose agents for industrial deployment requires integrating multiple capabilities, each typically acquired at a distinct stage of training. Yet there is currently no well-established recipe for Agent Continual Learning (ACL), with little understanding of the trade-offs among existing integration paradigms. To address this gap, we introduce ACLArena, a framework for comprehensively studying, analyzing, and evaluating ACL. We first build a sequential training pipeline and conduct an in-depth analysis that explains the mechanisms of forgetting and generalization from two complementary perspectives, the model level and the token level. Guided by these analyses, we systematically compare multi-teacher on-policy distillation, self-distilled fine-tuning, and model merging to assess their ability to recover previously learned capabilities while preserving newly acquired ones. Through extensive experiments, we develop a detailed understanding of how capabilities transfer across stages. Finally, we propose a new ACL recipe that combines offline replay over high-quality trajectories with a routed network of multiple LoRA experts each specialized via RL, substantially improving the agent's ability to learn across multiple domains. Comprehensive experiments on four reasoning and agentic tasks, evaluated under both in-domain and out-of-domain settings, demonstrate the value of our analysis and the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACLArena框架，系统研究智能体持续学习（ACL）中的遗忘与泛化机制，比较多种能力集成范式，并提出结合离线高质量轨迹回放与多LoRA专家路由网络的新配方。
AI.motivation: 工业部署的通用智能体需整合在训练不同阶段获得的多项能力，但ACL缺乏成熟方案，且对现有集成范式的权衡理解不足。
AI.method: 构建序列化训练流水线，从模型级与token级两个视角分析遗忘与泛化机制；系统比较多教师同策略蒸馏、自蒸馏微调与模型融合在恢复旧能力同时保持新能力方面的表现；提出结合离线高质量轨迹回放与经RL专门化的多LoRA专家路由网络的新ACL配方。
AI.result: 通过大量实验深入理解能力跨阶段迁移规律；在四项推理与智能体任务（域内与域外设置）上验证了分析与方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: ACLArena为ACL提供了系统分析框架，揭示集成范式权衡，所提配方显著提升智能体跨多域学习能力。

title: Used, Mentioned, or Condemned? A Controlled Contrast-Set Diagnostic for the Use-Mention Distinction in Code-Mixed Hinglish Misogyny Detection
comment: Preprint. 8 pages main text + appendix, 6 figures, 7 tables. Code, data, and generator to be released with camera-ready version
summary:
Lexicon-driven misogyny detectors cannot, by construction, distinguish a slur used against a woman from the same slur mentioned in counter-speech ("don't call her that") -- yet exactly this distinction governs whether moderation protects or silences the people discussing abuse. We study this problem in code-mixed Hinglish and make three contributions.
  First, we diagnose two evaluation artifacts on a publicly available redacted corpus: category-encoding anonymization placeholders leak the label (a no-learning rule scores 1.000), and even after they are neutralized misogynistic and benign comments occupy lexically disjoint registers, so bag-of-words reaches macro-F1 approximately 1.00 under random cross-validation but collapses under template-disjoint evaluation.
  Second, we release Hinglish-MGY-Diag, a deterministic generator and a 416-item / 163-minimal-pair contrast-set diagnostic across five linguistically motivated categories in which slur presence and gendered register are decorrelated from the label by construction.
  Third, we introduce a strict pair-consistency metric that credits a model only when both members of a minimal pair are correctly labelled. Five from-scratch classical baselines evaluated under construction-disjoint five-fold cross-validation reveal that the strongest model reaches 0.93 accuracy on the cleanest use-mention subset but only 0.82 consistency -- it still mislabels roughly one counter-speech pair in five. A frontier LLM used as an author-model ceiling attains 1.000 on all metrics, doubling as independent label validation and confirming the benchmark is a capability gradient rather than an adversarial wall. We release all code, data, the generator, and an arms-length LLM harness for reproducing every number.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了 Hinglish 语码混合场景下的"辱骂性用语 vs. 反话语提及"诊断基准，揭示词汇驱动检测器的评测伪影，并提出最小对一致性指标衡量模型的"使用-提及"区分能力。
AI.motivation: 词汇驱动的厌女检测器无法在构造上区分"针对女性的侮辱语使用"与"反话语中对该侮辱语的提及"，而这一区分恰恰决定审核是保护还是噤声受虐讨论者。现有公开语料在这一问题上存在评测缺陷，需要新的诊断手段。
AI.method: 1) 诊断公开脱敏语料的两类评测伪影：类别编码匿名占位符泄漏标签（无学习规则即得 1.000）；中和后仍存在词汇域不交，bag-of-words 在随机交叉验证下 macro-F1 近 1.00，但在模板不相交评测下崩塌。2) 发布 Hinglish-MGY-Diag：确定性生成器与 416 项 / 163 最小对对比集，覆盖五个语言学动机类别，构造上使侮辱语出现与性别化语域同标签解耦。3) 提出严格最小对一致性指标，仅当一对中两个成员均正确标注时才计分；在构造不相交五折交叉验证下评测五个从零训练的经典基线。
AI.result: 最强模型在最干净的使用-提及子集上准确率 0.93，但一致性仅 0.82，仍误标约五分之一的反馈话术对。前沿 LLM 作为作者模型上限在所有指标上达 1.000，兼具独立标签验证作用。
AI.conclusion: 该基准是可扩展的能力梯度而非对抗性壁垒；词汇驱动方法在真正需要区分使用与提及时存在系统性失效，需以最小对一致性等严格指标评估。代码、数据、生成器与 LLM 测试框架全部开源以复现全部数值。

title: CausalWM: Causal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Embodied World Model
summary: Embodied world models learn to predict future physical dynamics from visual observations and control signals, where physical knowledge is implicitly entangled within latent representations. We introduce CausalWM, a 16B embodied world model that performs explicit causal chain-of-thought reasoning before future video prediction. CausalWM organizes useful variables into a reasoning trajectory, allowing the model to progressively capture causal dependencies underlying physical evolution. To train CausalWM, we collect 31K hours embodied data and develop a three-stage paradigm consisting of large-scale video pre-training, causal CoT mid-training, and multi-objective RL post-training. Despite using only a limited set of supervised CoT variables, CausalWM exhibits emergent in-context learning capabilities, enabling contextual visual feature guidance and efficient few-step generation. CausalWM achieves state-of-the-art performance across language-conditioned, action-conditioned, single-view and multi-view benchmarks, including Top-1 performance on TriWorldBench leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 提出 CausalWM（16B 具身世界模型），在未来视频预测前进行显式因果链式推理，通过三阶段训练（视频预训练、因果 CoT 中训、多目标 RL 后训），在多类基准上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有具身世界模型将物理知识隐式纠缠在潜在表示中，缺乏显式的因果推理，难以渐进捕捉物理演化背后的因果依赖关系。
AI.method: CausalWM 将有用变量组织为推理轨迹，先做显式因果链式推理（causal CoT），再进行未来视频预测；训练采用三阶段范式：大规模视频预训练、因果 CoT 中训、多目标 RL 后训，并收集了 31K 小时具身数据。
AI.result: 在仅使用有限监督 CoT 变量的情况下，模型涌现出上下文学习能力，支持上下文视觉特征引导与高效少步生成；在语言条件、动作条件、单视图与多视图基准上均达 SOTA，包括 TriWorldBench 榜单 Top-1。
AI.conclusion: 显式因果链式推理可作为具身世界模型的有效建模方式，在有限监督下带来涌现能力与跨基准的领先性能。

title: FinInteract: Benchmarking Clarification and Intent Integration in Ambiguous Financial Question Answering
summary: Large language model agents increasingly answer financial questions by searching regulatory filings. Such questions are often deceptively under-specified: Meta Platforms' "operating income" is $46.75B consolidated but $62.87B for the Family of Apps segment, and each reading is exactly verifiable against the filing. A capable agent should recognize the ambiguity and ask, rather than commit to a plausible but unintended reading. Existing financial benchmarks cannot measure this, because one gold answer per question cannot separate agents that resolve the ambiguity from those that guess the common reading, a blind spot we call the single-gold illusion. We release FinInteract, a bilingual (English/Chinese) benchmark of 173 instances that pairs each question with a default and an intended interpretation across a five-category ambiguity taxonomy, and grades whether an agent elicits the right clarification and then integrates it. Re-grading identical outputs against the default rather than the intended reading inflates GPT-4o's accuracy by 3.1 times, confirming the illusion. Beyond it, we find that models answer above 90% once the interpretation is supplied but at most 28.9% when they must elicit it themselves, that targeting is uneven across a taxonomy well powered for entity scope and metric definition and exploratory elsewhere, and that conditioning on the ambiguity category improves resolution at both inference and training time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FinInteract 双语基准（173 个实例），揭示金融问答中"单一金标准错觉"，并测量智能体主动澄清歧义并整合澄清信息的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有金融基准每道题仅设一个金标准答案，无法区分"真正解决歧义"的智能体与"猜测常见读法"的智能体，形成 single-gold illusion 盲点。金融问题常被表面完整地"欠指定"，如 Meta 的 operating income 合并口径为 46.75B、Family of Apps 分部为 62.87B，两种读法均可验证。
AI.method: 发布 FinInteract：英/中双语基准，173 个实例，每题配默认解读与目标解读，覆盖五类歧义分类法；评分考察智能体是否引出正确澄清并整合之。通过将同一输出分别按默认读法与目标读法重新评分来验证错觉。
AI.result: 按默认而非目标读法重评，GPT-4o 准确率虚高 3.1 倍，证实错觉存在。给定解读时模型准确率超 90%，但需自行澄清时最高仅 28.9%。定位能力在分类法上不均衡：实体范围与指标定义类统计功效充足，其余为探索性。以歧义类别为条件可在推理与训练阶段提升消解效果。
AI.conclusion: 单金标准评估掩盖了智能体的歧义消解能力缺陷；FinInteract 提供了可量化的评测框架，并表明歧义类别条件化是有前景的改进方向。

title: Functional Emotion Without Character: Large Language Models, Aristotelian Disposition, and the Limits of Behavioral Alignment
summary: Debates about whether artificial systems can feel are often forced between two unsatisfactory positions: behavioral equivalence is treated as sufficient for emotion, or phenomenal consciousness is treated as a prerequisite that makes the question empirically inaccessible. This article develops a structural alternative. It models emotions as context-sensitive regions, trajectories and attractor dynamics in high-dimensional representational state spaces. Recent mechanistic interpretability findings support the existence of causally active emotion-concept representations in large language models, but they do not establish subjective feeling or full emotional agency. Assessed against published adequacy standards for representation in language models, intervention provides strong evidence of causal use, while full affective role integration, uniformity across subject domains and coherence remain only partially established; there is no direct analogue of accuracy. These mismatches expose the need for a standard of affective appropriateness, which an account of character must supply. Such an account requires three further conditions: regulatory embodiment that gives valence endogenous stakes, temporal continuity that allows affective episodes to accumulate into a history, and an integrated self-model that binds that history to persistent values. Aristotle's concepts of pathē, hexis, mesotēs and phronēsis are translated into a state-space sketch in which practical wisdom includes competence in estimating normatively salient context, not merely acting on a context description already given. The framework reframes alignment as a problem of durable disposition rather than output conformity, and yields interventional tests with explicit control conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以“结构化”路径替代“行为等价”与“现象意识门槛”二选一的争论：将情绪建模为高维表征状态空间中的情境敏感区域、轨迹与吸引子动力学，并借助机制可解释性证据说明大模型中存在因果有效的情感概念表征，但不足以证明主观感受；进而主张用“情感恰当性”标准补足，并引入亚里士多德德性概念构建状态空间方案。
AI.motivation: 现有关于人工系统能否感受的讨论被逼入两个不尽人意的立场：要么把行为等价当作情绪的充分条件，要么把现象意识当作先决条件，从而使问题在经验上无法检验。作者希望提供第三条路径。
AI.method: 以高维表征状态空间刻画情绪为情境敏感的区域、轨迹与吸引子动力学；对照已发表的“大模型表征适当性”标准，评估机制可解释性研究所揭示的因果使用证据及其不足；并提出“情感恰当性”标准，要求由“性格”理论提供，包含三条附加条件：调节性具身、时间连续性、整合自我模型；最后将亚里士多德的pathē、hexis、mesotēs与phronēsis转译为状态空间草图。
AI.result: 机制可解释性发现支持大语言模型中存在因果有效的情感概念表征，但未确立主观感受或完整情感能动性；按表征适当性标准，干预提供了较强的因果使用证据，而完整情感角色整合、跨主体域的一致性与连贯性仅部分成立，且“准确性”无直接对应物。这些错配凸显了引入情感恰当性标准的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架把对齐重新定义为“持久倾向”问题而非输出一致性，并给出带有明确控制条件的干预性测试；实践智慧被理解为包含对规范性显著情境的估计能力，而不仅是依据已给定的情境描述行动。

title: SPACE: Semantic Projection and Alignment of CLIP Embeddings for Domain Adaptation
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP), Tampere, Finland. 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
summary: A fundamental challenge in deploying vision models is domain shift, which arises when training and test data follow different distributions, leading to degraded performance. This challenge is amplified when the same semantic concept appears under distinct visual forms, such as photographs and sketches, where visual similarity is weak despite semantic correspondence. Existing unsupervised domain-adaptation methods aim to align distributions across domains but often ignore semantic relationships among samples of the same class. To address this issue, this paper introduces SPACE, a method that exploits the semantic structure of CLIP's vision-language space for domain adaptation. The key idea is to use text descriptions as semantic anchors by applying Singular Value Decomposition to CLIP embeddings of class descriptions, yielding an orthogonal basis that captures semantic relationships among categories. Visual features from both domains are projected into this semantic subspace, aligning images based on meaning rather than appearance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPACE方法，利用CLIP视觉-语言空间的语义结构实现无监督域适应，通过对类描述嵌入做奇异值分解构建语义锚点，将两域视觉特征投影到语义子空间，按语义而非外观对齐图像。
AI.motivation: 视觉模型部署面临域偏移问题，当同一语义概念呈现不同视觉形式（如照片与素描）时，视觉相似性弱但语义对应，性能下降更严重。现有无监督域适应方法只对齐域间分布，忽略了同类样本间的语义关系。
AI.method: SPACE方法：利用CLIP视觉-语言空间的语义结构。以文本描述作为语义锚点，对各类描述的CLIP嵌入应用奇异值分解（SVD），得到捕获类别间语义关系的正交基；将来自源域和目标域的视觉特征投影到该语义子空间，从而基于语义而非外观对齐图像。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果（如数据集、精度提升等数值指标），仅从原理上说明该方法可缓解跨域视觉形式差异下的对齐问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过借助CLIP语义空间构建语义子空间并在此空间内对齐特征，SPACE弥补了传统域适应忽略类内语义关系的不足，为跨视觉形式的域适应提供了语义驱动的解决思路。

title: Testing, not presuming, adequacy: calibrating generative social simulators against emergent network structure
comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Artificial Societies and Social Simulation (JASSS). 43 pages (34 main text, 9 supplementary information), 4 figures
summary: Validation of generative social simulators often stops at face validity: emergent network structure is compared descriptively, without quantified parameter uncertainty or an adequacy check. We present an adequacy-aware calibration protocol that couples amortized posterior estimation with a synthetic identifiability assessment, a matched-sample-size adequacy check (prior-predictive reachability plus per-statistic posterior-predictive localization), a diagnosis-guided repair, and a statistic-held-out audit. We demonstrate it on a real second-hand luxury resale market with four channel-by-residency cells, each a bipartite buyer-brand network, using a forward model built from persona profiles elicited once, offline, by a language model. The behavioural parameters are recoverable in all four cells, though calibration is approximate and overconfident for one parameter. The observed summary falls outside the simulator's reachability reference in every cell, with the mean purchased tier as the pervasive discrepancy. The repair meets the value-block criterion in two of four cells but does not restore adequacy, and the held-out audit surfaces a buyer-breadth-dispersion miss no earlier diagnostic detected. A profile-source ablation finds the language-model profiles beat a flat rule baseline in all four cells, yet within-category brand relabelling causes no consistent degradation, so the profiles are a partially validated input whose value rests on structure, not brand identity. Making no causal claim, we conclude that an independent-aggregation account, without agent interaction or a buyer-breadth mechanism, cannot jointly reproduce the market's purchased-tier level, head-brand concentration, community structure and buyer-breadth heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套"充分性感知"的生成式社会模拟器校准协议（摊销后验估计＋合成可识别性评估＋匹配样本量的充分性检验＋诊断引导修复＋统计量留出审计），并在真实二手奢侈品转售市场（四个渠道×居住地单元格、买卖双方-品牌二部网络）上验证：行为参数四格均可恢复但校准近似且对一参数过度自信；观测摘要值全部落在模拟器可达范围之外，主要偏差为平均购买层级；修复仅两格达标且未恢复充分性；留出审计发现买方广度离散度缺失；LLM人物画像优于平铺规则基线，但品牌重标记无一致退化，故画像仅部分有效。
AI.motivation: 生成式社会模拟器的验证通常止步于表面效度：仅对涌现网络结构做描述性比较，缺乏量化的参数不确定性与充分性检验。本文旨在建立一套可量化、可诊断、可修复的校准与充分性评估协议，以判断模拟器能否真正再现真实市场数据。
AI.method: 协议包含五个环节：(1) 摊销后验估计（amortized posterior estimation）完成贝叶斯校准；(2) 合成可识别性评估；(3) 匹配样本量的充分性检验，含先验预测可达性（prior-predictive reachability）与逐统计量后验预测定位；(4) 诊断引导的修复；(5) 统计量留出审计。应用场景为真实二手奢侈品转售市场，含四个渠道×居住地单元格，每格为买方-品牌二部网络；前向模型由语言模型一次性线下引出的人物画像（persona profiles）构建；并附画像来源消融（对比平铺规则基线、类内品牌重标记）。
AI.result: (1) 四个单元格的行为参数均可恢复，但校准为近似且对某一参数过度自信；(2) 观测摘要值在所有单元格均落在模拟器可达性参考之外，平均购买层级（mean purchased tier）为普遍性差异；(3) 修复使两格满足价值块准则，但未恢复充分性；(4) 留出审计暴露出此前所有诊断均未检出的"买方广度离散度"缺失；(5) 画像来源消融显示 LLM 画像在四格均优于平铺规则基线，但类内品牌重标记未造成一致退化，表明画像为部分验证的输入，其价值来源于结构而非品牌身份。
AI.conclusion: 在不作因果主张的前提下，本文结论是：一个不含智能体交互、也不含买方广度机制的独立聚合（independent-aggregation）模型，无法同时再现该市场的购买层级水平、头部品牌集中度、社区结构与买方广度异质性。

title: Contextual Causality with Large Language Models: A Survey
comment: Accepted to the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
summary: Understanding contextual causality is critical for large language models (LLMs), as it enables them to accurately identify causal relations in specific situations and support more reliable decision-making. Despite its significance, a systematic exploration of contextual causality with LLMs is still lacking. To fill this gap, we present a comprehensive survey on this topic. In this survey, we first propose a taxonomy of contextual causality, consisting of semantic, intervention, and counterfactual causality, and characterize each category by its core causal question, required model capabilities, representative tasks, and practical uses in causality analysis. We then analyze existing studies and discuss their key limitations. Finally, we examine the gaps between current benchmarks and real-world needs and outline promising directions for future research. Our goal is to clarify the research landscape of contextual causality with LLMs, emphasize its importance, and highlight promising future directions.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了大语言模型中的情境因果性，提出语义、干预与反事实三类因果的分类体系，分析现有研究局限并指出未来方向。
AI.motivation: 理解情境因果性对LLM至关重要，能使其准确识别特定情境下的因果关系并支持更可靠的决策，但目前缺乏对LLM情境因果性的系统性梳理。
AI.method: 开展综合性综述：首先提出由语义、干预与反事实因果性构成的分类体系，并刻画每类因果的核心问题、所需模型能力、代表性任务及在因果分析中的实际用途；随后分析现有研究并讨论关键局限。
AI.result: 建立了情境因果性的分类框架，识别了现有研究的关键局限，并考察了当前基准与真实需求之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 梳理了LLM情境因果性的研究图景，强调其重要性，并指出未来有前景的研究方向。

title: Exact Quotients of Fresnel-Kummer Surfaces and Certified Biaxial Refraction
summary: The Fresnel wave surface governs the propagation of light in a transparent biaxial crystal. It is a special Kummer quartic, and we identify it exactly. Over the complex numbers the wave surface of a crystal is the Kummer surface of the Jacobian of an explicit genus-two curve branched at the signed square roots of the three principal permittivities. This Jacobian is isogenous, by an isogeny with kernel of order four, to a product of two elliptic curves. One elliptic curve carries the three permittivities, and the other carries the optic-axis angle. The physical family is Zariski dense in the locus of genus-two curves with an extra involution, and its automorphism strata are explicit. The identification instantiates a task-aware quotient, which identifies parameters that differ by a nuisance transformation and carries invariant coordinates and explicit strata. For biaxial crystals, two ratios of the permittivities form a complete invariant of the wave surface up to rotation and rescaling, and the four real nodes are given in closed form. At an interface the candidate transmitted waves are the roots of a quartic of exact degree four. Its real-root count, root order, and repeated-root events are decided by exact algebraic predicates, and along the generic single-node encounters of the paper its discriminant vanishes to second order. Floating-point solvers drop forward transmitted modes near the optic axes, and the certified solver does not. On exact equivalence classes, learned models on quotient coordinates are invariant and more accurate than models on raw tensors, while learned root-count predicates fail near the optic axes.

AI.tldr: 本文精确识别了双轴晶体中Fresnel波面：复域上它是某显式亏格2曲线Jacobian的Kummer曲面，该Jacobian与两椭圆曲线乘积四阶同源；并给出任务感知商、不变坐标、闭式节点、界面四次方程精确判定及数值/学习实验。
AI.motivation: Fresnel波面是透明双轴晶体中光传播的基本对象，属特殊Kummer四次曲面，但其精确代数几何身份、与主介电常数及光轴角的关系尚需明确刻画。同时，界面透射波判定常依赖浮点求解，在光轴附近可能丢失前向透射模式，需要精确代数判据与不变表示。
AI.method: 将晶体波面识别为显式亏格2曲线（分支点为三个主介电常数的带符号平方根）Jacobian的Kummer曲面；证明该Jacobian与两条椭圆曲线之积存在核为四阶的同源，其中一椭圆承载三个介电常数，另一承载光轴角。构造任务感知商，以消去nuisance变换，给出不变坐标与显式分层。界面候选透射波为精确四次方程根，使用精确代数谓词判定实根数、根序及重根事件。
AI.result: 物理族在带额外对合的亏格2曲线轨迹中Zariski稠密，自同构分层显式；双轴晶体中两个介电常数比值构成波面在旋转与缩放下的完全不变量，四个实节点有闭式表达。界面四次方程判别式在一般单节点相遇处二阶消失；浮点求解器在光轴附近会丢失前向透射模式，而认证求解器不会。在精确等价类上，学习模型若使用商坐标则具有不变性且比原始张量模型更准确，但学习得到的根数谓词在光轴附近失效。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将双轴晶体Fresnel波面精确等同于特定Kummer曲面，并给出同源结构、不变量、闭式节点与界面精确判定，体现任务感知商的有效性。精确代数方法在光轴附近优于浮点求解，不变坐标提升学习模型精度，但直接学习根数谓词仍不可靠。

title: Context-Aware Pre-Deployment Evaluation of AI Systems: A Regulatory Framework for Nigerian Fintech
summary: Commercial large language models are increasingly deployed across African fintech infrastructure for fraud detection and customer communication, yet no Nigerian or African continental regulatory instrument specifies what pre-deployment evaluation such systems must undergo before procurement. This paper reviews African fintech AI governance across global, continental, and Nigerian instruments, and shows that safety is affirmed as a principle while pre-deployment evaluation is operationally unspecified. Generic safety benchmarks cannot surface the failure modes most relevant to this domain, since none contain Nigerian institutional content or test for false positive misclassification of legitimate financial communications. These claims are demonstrated using SafeAlert, a purpose-built evaluation kit applied to six commercial models across three system prompt conditions. Results show that models resisting generic harmful content requests still produce complete fraud scripts under specific framing, and that several models misclassify most legitimate Nigerian bank communications as suspicious or fraudulent, a failure invisible to standard safety evaluation. The paper concludes with a regulatory framework proposing pre-deployment evaluation requirements for the CBN, NITDA, SEC, and the AU, arguing that the identified gap reflects an absence of regulatory specification, not a shortage of technical or financial resources.

AI.tldr: 该论文审查了全球、非洲大陆及尼日利亚层面的AI治理文件，指出"安全"虽被确认为原则，但"部署前评估"在操作层面完全未作规定；作者用自建的SafeAlert评估套件测试六个商用大模型，发现它们会在特定话术下生成完整诈骗脚本，且会把大量合法的尼日利亚银行通讯误判为可疑或欺诈，从而论证这一缺口源于监管规范的缺失而非技术或资金不足，并提出面向CBN、NITDA、SEC及非盟的部署前评估监管框架。
AI.motivation: 商用大模型正被越来越多地部署在非洲金融科技基础设施中，用于欺诈检测和客户沟通，但尼日利亚及整个非洲大陆尚无任何监管文件规定此类系统在采购前必须通过何种部署前评估。作者希望填补这一治理与评估之间的空白，并说明现有通用安全基准无法暴露该领域特有的失效模式。
AI.method: 首先对全球、非洲大陆和尼日利亚三个层级的金融科技AI治理文件进行审查，识别"安全原则"与"评估操作规范"之间的落差。随后构建专用评估套件SafeAlert，针对六个商用模型在三种系统提示条件下进行测试，重点检验两类场景：特定话术下的欺诈脚本生成，以及对合法尼日利亚银行通讯的误分类。
AI.result: 在通用有害内容请求上表现合规、拒绝配合的模型，在特定框架（framing）下仍能生成完整的诈骗脚本；同时多个模型将大部分合法的尼日利亚银行通讯误判为可疑或欺诈。后一类失效在标准安全评估中完全不可见，因为现有基准中不包含尼日利亚机构相关内容，也不测试对合法金融通讯的假阳性误分类。
AI.conclusion: 该缺口反映的是监管规范的缺失，而非技术能力或财政资源的不足。论文据此提出一套监管框架，为尼日利亚中央银行（CBN）、国家信息技术发展局（NITDA）、证券交易委员会（SEC）以及非盟（AU）设定金融科技大模型部署前评估要求。

title: Vox-Infinity: Benchmarking the Limits of Long-Context Spoken Language Models
summary: Long-context understanding remains a fundamental challenge for large language models, as excessively long inputs often lead models to forget salient information. This issue is even more pronounced in the speech domain, where audio, as a low-compression modality, requires substantially more embeddings than text to preserve both semantic content and acoustic cues. To address this challenge, we introduce \textbf{Vox-Infinity}, the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate long-context understanding in spoken language models. Vox-Infinity systematically extends audio history along two dimensions: turn count and turn duration. It covers a diverse range of representative scenarios with varying interaction structures and semantic complexity. Crucially, Vox-Infinity provides explicit answer-provenance annotations and organizes samples according to the amount of historical context required to resolve each query, enabling precise and length-aware evaluation. Extensive evaluations of seven representative spoken language models reveal a clear overall recency effect: models generally achieve higher accuracy when answer-supporting evidence is closer to the query, but struggle to retrieve and use evidence located farther back in the dialogue history. Cases and datasets are available at https://vox-infinity.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出 Vox-Infinity，首个面向口语语言模型长上下文理解能力的评测基准。
AI.motivation: 长上下文理解是LLM的核心挑战，长输入易导致显著信息遗忘；语音因音频低压缩、需更多嵌入而问题更突出，且缺乏专门评测基准。
AI.method: Vox-Infinity 沿轮次数与轮次时长两个维度扩展音频历史，覆盖交互结构语义复杂度各异的场景，并提供显式答案溯源标注，按解析查询所需历史上下文量组织样本，实现精确且长度感知的评测。
AI.result: 对七个代表性口语语言模型的评测显示明显近因效应：证据距查询越近准确率越高，越靠前的历史证据越难检索与利用。
AI.conclusion: 口语语言模型在长对话历史中检索与利用远端证据能力不足，存在系统性近因偏差；Vox-Infinity 为长上下文语音理解提供可量化评测手段。

title: Blind Deconvolution of Binary and Pattern Images with Pixel Intensity Constraints and Sparse Gradient Prior
summary: Blind image deconvolution (BID) is a prominent research topic in the field of imaging sciences, given its significant practical applications. Most existing model-based BID methods focus on natural images, incorporating appropriate prior knowledge about both the underlying image and the blur kernel. However, for certain classes of images, such as barcodes, text, and patterns, pixels can only take very limited values, a specific prior that is often overlooked in the literature. In this article, we introduce a novel pixel intensity constraint to leverage this important information, improving recovery performance for these specialized image classes. Specifically, we propose a unified framework for blind binary and pattern image deconvolution that incorporates both the pixel intensity constraint and a gradient sparsity regularizer. Numerical experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms many existing BID techniques, achieving superior results in terms of both visual quality and quantitative metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种引入像素强度约束的盲图像去卷积统一框架，针对二值与图案图像，结合梯度稀疏正则化，实验证明在视觉质量与定量指标上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于模型的盲图像去卷积方法主要针对自然图像，依赖图像与模糊核的先验知识，但忽略了某些图像类别（如条形码、文字、图案）像素取值极为有限这一特定先验，导致这类图像的恢复性能受限。
AI.method: 引入一种新的像素强度约束以利用上述有限取值信息，提出统一的盲二值与图案图像去卷积框架，该框架同时结合像素强度约束与梯度稀疏正则化项。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该方法优于多种现有盲图像去卷积技术，在视觉质量和定量指标两方面均取得更优结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模像素有限取值这一被忽视的先验，所提统一框架能有效提升二值与图案等特殊类别图像的盲去卷积恢复性能。

title: Synthesizing Reactive Character Behaviors for Continuous Games via Programmatic Policy Search
comment: To be presented at SIGGRAPH Asia 2026
summary: We present a method for synthesizing reactive character behaviors for continuous games as compact, human-readable programs. Game AI practice still relies heavily on manually authored behavior trees, state machines, and scripts, while academic reinforcement learning typically produces opaque neural controllers that are expensive to train and difficult to edit. Our approach bridges this gap by searching directly over a domain-specific language for continuous-space game policies. The language is designed around reactive geometric decisions and includes higher-order constructs such as direction maximization. These constructs help discretize a continuous behavior space into enumerable program structures. To make program search practical, we introduce a large set of synthesis antipatterns that remove redundant program forms while preserving behavioral coverage. We further combine bottom-up symbolic enumeration with top-down guidance from a coding agent. Our resulting method, agentic sketching, has the agent propose high-level policy structure and call an enumerator to complete local program slots. We evaluate the method on a benchmark of 14 continuous games, ranging from classic control tasks to multi-agent football. We find that pure enumeration is often more efficient than using a coding agent alone, while the combined method substantially outperforms both. Our results suggest that programmatic policy search can be a practical authoring tool for game AI: designers specify reward functions, and the system discovers editable behaviors that are effective, portable, and often surprising.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"agentic sketching"方法，通过在连续空间游戏策略的领域特定语言上直接搜索，合成紧凑、人类可读的反应式角色行为程序，结合自底向上符号枚举与编码智能体的自顶向下引导，在14款连续游戏中显著优于纯枚举或纯智能体方法。
AI.motivation: 游戏AI实践仍依赖手工编写的行为树、状态机与脚本，而学术强化学习通常产生不透明、训练成本高且难以编辑的神经控制器。作者希望弥合这一差距，为连续游戏提供既有效又可编辑的程序化策略。
AI.method: 设计围绕反应式几何决策的领域特定语言，包含方向最大化等高阶构造，将连续行为空间离散为可枚举的程序结构；引入大量合成反模式以剔除冗余程序形式并保持行为覆盖；将自底向上的符号枚举与编码智能体的自顶向下引导结合，由智能体提出高层策略结构并调用枚举器填充局部程序槽位（即agentic sketching）。
AI.result: 在涵盖经典控制任务到多智能体足球的14款连续游戏基准上评估：纯枚举往往比单独使用编码智能体更高效，而两者结合的方法大幅优于二者。
AI.conclusion: 程序化策略搜索可作为游戏AI的实用创作工具：设计者只需指定奖励函数，系统即可发现有效、可移植且常常出人意料的可编辑行为。

title: Apollo Restore: A Foundation LLM for Historical Greek Optimized for Fill-in-the-Middle Restoration of Ancient Greek Texts
summary: We present Apollo Restore, a 24-billion-parameter large language model for restoring lacunae---physical gaps---in fragmentary Ancient Greek texts. Fine-tuned from Mistral Small with a fill-in-the-middle objective, Apollo Restore reconstructs missing spans without requiring oracle knowledge of their length. To our knowledge, it is the first large-scale decoder model for historical Greek, and the first for any ancient Mediterranean language. Evaluated as in prior work, on short gaps of up to ten characters, Apollo Restore places the correct restoration among its top twenty candidates for 80.6%/54.6%/61.0% of documentary-papyrus, literary-papyrus, and stone-inscription lacunae, exceeding the strongest published models by $1.6\times$/$2.6\times$/$1.4\times$. Prior evaluation protocols, however, inflate scores through a bias toward trivially short gaps; under a length-balanced metric Apollo Restore's advantage over the strongest published models grows to $2.3\times$/$3.5\times$/$1.6\times$ and degrades gracefully, even given incorrect length hints. In a blind study, 20 expert papyrologists, epigraphists, and philologists strongly preferred Apollo Restore to the strongest baseline and judged its performance at least as good as human restorations in 77% of cases. Apollo Restore also improves the published reading of P.Herc. 1667---a papyrus roll carbonised in the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 CE and digitally unrolled and edited after Apollo Restore's training data was compiled. Apollo Restore is an output of the Decoding Antiquity initiative to build specialized LLMs for historical languages and manuscripts, led by the Austrian Academy of Sciences.

AI.tldr: Apollo Restore，一个240亿参数的大语言模型，专用于恢复古希腊残篇中的物理缺损（lacunae）。基于Mistral Small以填空（fill-in-the-middle）目标微调，可在未知缺损长度的情况下重建缺失文本。在短缺口（≤10字符）评测中，其top-20候选准确率达80.6%/54.6%/61.0%（文献纸草/文学纸草/石刻铭文），超越最强已发表模型1.6×/2.6×/1.4×；在长度均衡指标下优势扩大至2.3×/3.5×/1.6×。盲测中20位专家在77%的案例中认为其表现不逊于人类复原，并成功改进P.Herc. 1667的已发表释读。
AI.motivation: 古希腊残篇普遍存在物理缺损，传统复原依赖专家知识且难以规模化；同时既有评测协议偏向极短缺口，导致分数虚高。作者旨在构建首个面向历史希腊语（乃至古代地中海语言）的大规模解码器模型，并建立更公平的评测标准。
AI.method: 以Mistral Small为基础，采用fill-in-the-middle目标微调，得到240亿参数的Apollo Restore；模型无需预知缺损长度即可重建缺失片段，支持给出长度提示（即使提示错误亦能稳健退化）。在文献纸草、文学纸草与石刻铭文三类数据上，按前人协议及新提出的长度均衡指标进行评测，并开展20位纸草学家、铭文学家与语文学家的盲测，另对维苏威火山碳化纸卷P.Herc. 1667进行案例验证。
AI.result: 短缺口（≤10字符）top-20准确率为80.6%/54.6%/61.0%，分别超出最强已发表模型1.6×/2.6×/1.4×；长度均衡指标下优势增至2.3×/3.5×/1.6×，且对错误长度提示具有稳健性。盲测中专家显著偏好Apollo Restore，77%案例中其表现不逊于人类复原。模型还改进了P.Herc. 1667的已发表释读结果。
AI.conclusion: Apollo Restore是首个面向古代地中海语言的大规模解码器复原模型，在客观指标与专家主观评价上均超越现有最强基线，并能产生学术价值的新释读。该工作同时揭示了既有评测协议的偏差，并提出长度均衡评价范式；作为奥地利科学院主导的Decoding Antiquity计划成果，为历史语言与手稿专用LLM的构建提供了范例。

title: RegVGGT: Sustainable Visual Geometry Grounding for Streaming via Regulated Memory
comment: ECCV 2026. Corresponding author is Junjun Jiang
summary: 3D reconstruction from a lengthy video stream input poses a dilemma for feed-forward reconstruction models (FFRMs), that a whole-stream inference context cannot be retained under limited GPU memory.Recent studies seek to resolve this problem via a trade-off between the integrity of inference context and GPU memory usage, which either suffer from a rapid memory inflation or degraded context integrity due to artificially capping memory usage.Driven by our key observation that the initial saliency of a token reliably dictates its long-term importance across the stream, we propose RegVGGT, a training-free token regulation method which aggressively regulates the tokens of incoming frames.By admitting at most 1% of tokens per frame to update the context memory, our method dramatically suppresses memory inflation as the stream progresses.Equipped with a FlashAttention-compatible token saliency estimation scheme, RegVGGT is capable of processing thousands of frames on a consumer-grade GPU with negligible compromise to reconstruction quality.Extensive experiments demonstrate that RegVGGT achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-horizon benchmarks across diverse FFRM prediction tasks, surpassing prior FFRM-based stream reconstruction baselines by a large margin.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RegVGGT，一种免训练的前馈重建模型（FFRM）token 调节方法，通过每帧仅保留约 1% 的 token 更新上下文记忆，在消费级 GPU 上实现数千帧流式 3D 重建，并取得长时序基准上的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 长时间视频流输入的 3D 重建对前馈重建模型（FFRM）构成两难：受限 GPU 显存无法保留整个流的推理上下文。现有方法在上下文完整性与显存占用之间折中，但要么导致显存快速膨胀，要么因人为限制显存而损失上下文完整性。作者的核心观察是：token 的初始显著性可可靠地预示其在整条流中的长期重要性，因此可据此进行激进的 token 调节。
AI.method: 提出 RegVGGT——一种免训练的 token 调节方法，对输入帧的 token 进行激进的筛选与调节；每帧最多接纳 1% 的 token 用于更新上下文记忆，从而随流推进显著抑制显存膨胀。同时设计了与 FlashAttention 兼容的 token 显著性估计方案。
AI.result: 在消费级 GPU 上可处理数千帧，且对重建质量的损失可忽略；在多种 FFRM 预测任务的长时序基准上取得 SOTA 性能，大幅超越先前基于 FFRM 的流式重建基线。
AI.conclusion: 利用 token 初始显著性预测长期重要性，可有效解决长视频流 3D 重建中的显存与上下文完整性矛盾；RegVGGT 无需训练即可在有限显存下实现高质量、长时程的流式重建。

title: Structured Decomposition for Reliable LLM-Generated Access Control Policies
summary:
This paper presents an LLM-based system that translates natural-language access control policies (NLACPs) into executable Rego code for Open Policy Agent (OPA). It provides a modular, end-to-end pipeline for policy detection, component extraction, schema validation, linting, compilation, and automated test generation and execution. The system is designed to bridge the gap between human-readable access requirements and machine-enforceable policy-as-code (PaC), with a focus on deployment reliability and security correctness.
  We evaluate the system on 372 ACRE-complete access control statements with non-null subject, action, and resource annotations against a direct single-prompt LLM baseline to isolate the contribution of structured decomposition and schema-aware validation. The system achieves a 50.3% end-to-end policy correctness rate, compared with 15.3% for the baseline, representing a 3.3x improvement. A policy is counted as correct only if it satisfies compilation, linting, and both positive and negative tests, making this a strict measure of deployable correctness.
  On security-critical patterns, the system generates correct deny semantics for 87.5% of deny policies (baseline: 37.5%), ownership conditions for 100% of ownership-qualified policies (baseline: 40%), and status-qualified conditions for 100% of status-qualified policies (baseline: 55.6%). These results indicate that structured decomposition and schema-aware validation play a critical role in improving the reliability of LLM-generated authorization policies.

AI.tldr: 提出基于LLM的端到端流水线，将自然语言访问控制策略转化为可执行的Rego代码，正确率较单提示基线提升3.3倍。
AI.motivation: 弥合人类可读的访问需求与机器可执行的策略即代码（PaC）之间的鸿沟，提升LLM生成授权策略的部署可靠性与安全正确性。
AI.method: 构建模块化流水线，涵盖策略检测、组件抽取、模式校验、lint、编译及自动化测试生成与执行；在372条ACRE完整访问控制语句上，与直接单提示LLM基线对比，以隔离结构化分解与模式感知校验的贡献。
AI.result: 端到端策略正确率50.3%（基线15.3%），提升3.3倍；正确性需同时满足编译、lint及正负测试。安全关键模式上，拒绝语义正确率87.5%（基线37.5%），所有权条件100%（基线40%），状态限定条件100%（基线55.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化分解与模式感知校验对提升LLM生成授权策略的可靠性具有关键作用。

title: Toward Personalized Sleep Guidance from Wearable Data Using Language Models
summary: Sleep monitoring using wearable data has shown promise for personal health, yet large language model (LLM)-based summarization and question answering remain insufficient for personalized sleep guidance. Training specialized models, however, often requires costly expert annotation. Moreover, privacy and accessibility concerns motivate lightweight, local deployment for end users. We present a two-stage framework to address these challenges. Specifically, in Stage~1, a multi-agent LLM pipeline reasons structured sleep guidance from unannotated wearable records, enabling scalable dataset construction. Stage~2 distills guidance reasoning trajectories into small language models (SLMs) through supervised fine-tuning and integrates a training-free Best-of-$N$ selection strategy to enhance inference. Experimental results demonstrate our method outperforms commercial general and medical LLMs and open-source models. Human evaluation further supports the quality of the generated guidance and the feasibility of personalized sleep guidance with SLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个两阶段框架，利用多智能体LLM从无标注可穿戴数据生成睡眠指导并蒸馏到小语言模型，实现本地化个性化睡眠指导。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴数据睡眠监测有健康价值，但基于LLM的总结与问答不足以提供个性化睡眠指导；训练专用模型需昂贵专家标注，且隐私与可及性要求轻量本地部署。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：Stage 1用多智能体LLM流水线从无标注可穿戴记录推理结构化睡眠指导，实现可扩展数据集构建；Stage 2通过监督微调将指导推理轨迹蒸馏到小语言模型，并集成免训练的Best-of-N选择策略增强推理。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法优于商用通用与医疗LLM以及开源模型；人工评估进一步支持生成指导的质量及用SLM实现个性化睡眠指导的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体LLM蒸馏结合Best-of-N可在无需专家标注下构建数据，并使小模型具备高质量个性化睡眠指导能力，利于本地部署。

title: MinCU: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Grounded Minimal-Change Understanding in Image Pairs
summary: Localizing and describing fine-grained differences between near-identical images is a critical yet underexplored capability for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing benchmarks largely assess semantic comparison or single-image grounding in isolation, without jointly requiring faithful description and physical localization. To bridge this gap, we introduce MinCU, a benchmark for grounded minimal-change understanding, where each sample consists of an image pair differing by a single atomic variation in object category, attribute, count, or spatial position, and models are evaluated on their ability to describe the change, localize the changed regions, and identify the changed entity. We further propose Semantic-Guided Implicit Spatial Anchors (SG-ISA), a structured autoregressive method that decomposes prediction into a Think-Locate-Describe sequence. SG-ISA first predicts a semantic cue for the changed concept, then uses discrete spatial anchors as an implicit localization scaffold, and finally generates the change description together with the grounding box. Experiments reveal that even the strongest closed-source MLLMs and recent R1-style reasoning models struggle on MinCU, with most failing to jointly produce accurate descriptions and grounding boxes. Compared to the previous chain-of-thought method, fine-tuning with SG-ISA yields substantial joint improvements in grounding accuracy and description quality while reducing reasoning-token overhead by approximately 26%. These results suggest that an implicit intermediate spatial interface can be more effective than relying solely on model scale for grounded dual-image understanding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基准 MinCU（图像对间单一原子差异，需同时描述变化、定位区域、识别实体）与方法 SG-ISA（Think-Locate-Describe 结构化自回归，用语义线索+离散空间锚点隐式定位），实验表明现有最强闭源 MLLM 与 R1 式推理模型均难以同时给出准确描述与定位框，SG-ISA 微调在联合指标上大幅提升并将推理 token 开销降低约 26%。
AI.motivation: 细粒度比较近似图像是 MLLM 的关键但研究不足的能力；现有基准要么只做语义比较，要么只做单图定位，缺少同时要求"忠实描述"与"物理定位"的联合评测，因此无法真实衡量 grounded dual-image understanding。
AI.method: 构建 MinCU 基准：每个样本为一对仅在物体类别、属性、数量或空间位置上有单一原子变化的图像，评测描述变化、定位变化区域、识别变化实体三项能力。提出 SG-ISA：将预测分解为 Think-Locate-Describe 的结构化自回归流程，先预测变化概念的语义线索，再以离散空间锚点作为隐式定位支架，最后联合生成变化描述与 grounding box。
AI.result: 最强的闭源 MLLM 与近期 R1 式推理模型在 MinCU 上均表现吃力，多数无法同时产出准确描述与定位框。相较此前的 chain-of-thought 方法，SG-ISA 微调在定位准确率与描述质量的联合指标上显著提升，同时推理 token 开销减少约 26%。
AI.conclusion: 对于基于双图的 grounded 理解任务，引入隐式中间空间接口（implicit intermediate spatial interface）比单纯依赖模型规模扩展更有效。

title: Representation-guided in-context learning for medical image interpretation with multimodal large language models
summary: Medical image interpretation is central to diagnosis and care, yet adapting general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often requires resource-intensive domain-specific fine-tuning. Here we introduce representation-guided in-context learning (RG-ICL), a training-free inference framework that retrieves query-aligned demonstrations using frozen encoders, without task-specific parameter updates. Across eight datasets spanning histopathology, radiology and retinal fundoscopy, RG-ICL improved classification (mean gain 20 percentage points) and visual question answering (VQA) (mean gain 13 percentage points) over no-context and conventional ICL, approaching or exceeding training-based comparators. Which cases were retrieved mattered more than how many: 6 query-aligned cases outperformed up to 32 randomly selected ones, whereas fixed or random cases often reduced accuracy below baseline. For VQA, aligning reference cases with both image content and question intent produced further gains. These findings indicate that for medical image interpretation, curating which reference cases an MLLM sees is a practical alternative to retraining it.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的表征引导上下文学习框架RG-ICL，通过冻结编码器检索与查询对齐的示例，在八项医学影像数据集上显著提升分类与VQA性能，且检索质量比数量更关键。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态大模型（MLLMs）适配医学影像解读常依赖资源密集的领域微调，成本高。作者希望寻找一种无需任务特定参数更新的替代方案。
AI.method: RG-ICL：一种免训练的推理框架。使用冻结编码器检索与查询对齐的演示示例（query-aligned demonstrations），进行上下文学习，不进行任务特定参数更新。覆盖组织病理、放射和视网膜眼底等八项数据集。对VQA进一步对齐参考示例的图像内容与问题意图。
AI.result: 分类平均提升20个百分点，VQA平均提升13个百分点，优于无上下文与常规ICL，接近或超过基于训练的比较方法。检索"哪些"案例比"多少"更关键：6个查询对齐案例优于多达32个随机案例；固定或随机案例常使准确率低于基线。
AI.conclusion: 对医学影像解读而言，精心挑选MLLM所见的参考案例（curating which reference cases）是替代模型重训练的实用方案。

title: CultureMINE: Datasets and Methods for Improving the Cultural Capabilities of NLP Systems
summary: In recent years, there has been a surge of interest in Cultural NLP, with substantial efforts to create globally inclusive NLP systems. The rapid growth of literature in this field makes it difficult to track trends in methods and data resources. To address this, we analyze over 375 papers to answer three complementary questions: (1) What Cultural Capabilities (CCs) are being targeted in NLP systems? (2) How are cultural data resources being created? and (3) What methods are being used to improve the CCs of those systems? We discuss trends observed across the three questions, and identify relevant research gaps. To facilitate further research in this field, we release our full list of analyzed papers in the form of an interactive web interface, which includes a feature to allow researchers to add their work; we hope this facilitates future research and proves to be a valuable resource for the Cultural NLP community.

AI.tldr: 本文对文化自然语言处理（Cultural NLP）领域逾375篇论文进行系统性文献分析，回答三个核心问题：目标文化能力、文化数据资源构建方式、提升文化能力的方法，并总结趋势、识别研究空白，同时发布交互式网页界面以促进后续研究。
AI.motivation: 近年来Cultural NLP研究激增，领域文献快速增长导致方法与数据资源的趋势难以追踪，亟需系统性梳理以厘清研究现状与空白。
AI.method: 对超过375篇Cultural NLP相关论文进行文献计量与内容分析，围绕三个互补问题展开：（1）NLP系统所针对的文化能力（CCs）；（2）文化数据资源的构建方式；（3）用于提升系统文化能力的方法；并构建交互式Web界面以发布论文清单并支持研究者自主补充。
AI.result: 归纳出三个问题上的研究趋势，识别出若干研究空白，并发布了包含全部分析论文的可交互网页资源，具备研究者自行添加工作的功能。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为Cultural NLP领域提供了系统性的文献地图与资源平台，有助于研究者把握趋势、发现空白，并推动全球包容性NLP系统的进一步发展。

title: AniPrO: Interpretable Anime Image Provenance Detection via Multi-Dimensional Semantic Reasoning
comment: Accepted at the Computer Graphics International (CGI) 2026, 2 figures, 6 tables
summary: As generative AI becomes increasingly used in anime-style image creation, distinguishing human-drawn, AI-inpainted, and text-to-image images is important for copyright attribution, visual provenance, and content governance. Existing AI-generated image detectors mainly target real-world photographs and often overlook anime-specific cues such as flat coloring, exaggerated structures, and artistic line control. To address this gap, we propose AniPrO, a multi-dimensional description-enhanced framework for interpretable anime image provenance. Built upon AnimeDL-2M, AniPrO contains 15,000 balanced samples from a 35,000-image candidate pool, covering Real, Inpainting, and Text2Image categories with structured five-dimensional descriptions. We further introduce AniPrO-SFD-Bench and AniPrO-MFR-Bench to evaluate provenance detection from statistical feature discrimination and multimodal fusion reasoning perspectives. Experiments show that structured semantic guidance reveals systematic AI-generation biases, such as the gap between global visual plausibility and local detail coherence, and improves the detection of challenging inpainting samples. The dataset and code will be released at: https://github.com/YAN-LIU05/AniPrO.

AI.tldr: 提出AniPrO多维度描述增强框架，用于动漫图像来源鉴别的可解释分析，构建1.5万样本数据集与两个评测基准，揭示AI生成系统性偏差并提升Inpainting检测。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在动漫风格图像创作中日益普及，区分手绘、AI修复（Inpainting）与文生图（Text2Image）图像对版权归属、视觉溯源和内容治理具有重要价值；但现有AI生成图像检测器主要面向真实照片，忽略了动漫特有的扁平上色、夸张结构与艺术线条控制等线索。
AI.method: 基于AnimeDL-2M构建AniPrO：从3.5万张候选池中筛选1.5万张均衡样本，涵盖Real、Inpainting、Text2Image三类，并配以结构化五维描述；提出AniPrO-SFD-Bench（统计特征判别）与AniPrO-MFR-Bench（多模态融合推理）两个评测基准。
AI.result: 实验表明，结构化语义引导能够揭示系统性的AI生成偏差，例如全局视觉合理性与局部细节一致性之间的差距，并提升对高难度Inpainting样本的检测效果。
AI.conclusion: AniPrO以多维度描述增强实现了可解释的动漫图像来源鉴别，弥补了动漫领域检测线索缺失的空白，数据集与代码将在GitHub开源。

title: Incremental Consistency Execution for Autonomous Intelligent Systems
summary: Long-horizon autonomous intelligent systems rely on heterogeneous components such as large language models, databases, external APIs, and rule engines, while their external states continuously change during execution. Re-executing the entire workflow after every change introduces substantial redundant computation. This paper proposes an incremental consistency execution method based on task fact contracts, field-level dependency masks, and state perturbation result invariant domains. After an initial verified execution, the system constructs conservative invariant domains for critical inputs and uses them to determine whether downstream results can be safely renewed without re-invoking expensive components. When re-execution is required, only the smallest affected output fields are recomputed, and an equivalence barrier prevents unnecessary downstream propagation. A submission-time version consistency gate further ensures the safety of side-effecting actions. Experiments on industrial fault diagnosis, enterprise analytics, and LLM-based multi-tool assistants show that the proposed method significantly reduces expensive component calls and end-to-end latency while maintaining high consistency and low incorrect-reuse rates.

AI.tldr: 提出基于任务事实契约、字段级依赖掩码与状态扰动结果不变域的增量一致性执行方法，在保证结果一致性的前提下，显著减少昂贵组件的重复调用与端到端时延。
AI.motivation: 长周期自主智能系统由大语言模型、数据库、外部API、规则引擎等异构组件构成，其外部状态在执行中持续变化。每当状态变化就重跑整个工作流会带来大量冗余计算，因此需要在保证一致性的前提下仅重算受影响的部分。
AI.method: 方法包含四个要点：1）任务事实契约与字段级依赖掩码，刻画输出字段对输入的细粒度依赖；2）状态扰动结果不变域，在首次验证执行后为关键输入构造保守不变域，用于判断下游结果能否安全续用；3）最小重算与等价屏障，当必须重执行时只重算最小受影响输出字段，并阻断不必要的下游传播；4）提交时版本一致性门，确保具有副作用的动作安全提交。
AI.result: 在工业故障诊断、企业数据分析和基于LLM的多工具助手三类场景中，该方法显著减少了昂贵组件的调用次数与端到端时延，同时保持高一致性并维持较低的误复用率。
AI.conclusion: 通过不变域判定与字段级最小重算，可在异构组件、外部状态动态变化的长周期系统中实现安全高效的增量执行，一致性、效率与误复用率之间取得良好平衡。

title: When Cosine Similarity Fails to Reflect Linearly Accessible Structure in Dialogue Models
summary: Cosine similarity is widely used to analyze transformer representations, implicitly assuming that similarity reflects task-relevant structure. We study when this assumption fails in dialogue-conditioned large language models. Across three 7-8B chat-tuned models, ambient cosine similarity substantially underestimates linearly decodable persona structure on the same hidden states; numerically, linear probe AUC is in the 0.73-0.97 range while cosine kNN is in the 0.56-0.77 range on a 30-class task. A low-dimensional supervised subspace recovers much of this gap, whereas a matched-rank PCA subspace does not and in some cases degrades performance. This mismatch is regime-dependent: it is absent in single-sentence sentiment classification (SST-5), and a matched-cardinality control rules out attribute cardinality as a confound. The gap does not systematically increase across dialogue turns, and the task-aligned subspace remains stable over time. However, two of three models violate a pre-registered within-subspace separability invariance criterion (|Delta AUC| <= 0.03), and one model violates a pre-registered turn-invariance criterion (|Delta L| <= 0.05). These results show that cosine similarity can fail to reflect task-aligned structure in dialogue representations even when that structure is linearly accessible.

AI.tldr: 余弦相似度在对话大模型表示中会显著低估线性可解码的任务结构，该失配具有情境依赖性且部分模型违反预注册不变性准则。
AI.motivation: 余弦相似度被广泛用于分析Transformer表示，隐含假设相似度能反映任务相关结构。作者旨在检验该假设在对话条件下的LLM中何时失效。
AI.method: 在三个70-80亿参数的对话微调模型上，比较环境余弦相似度与线性探针在同一隐藏状态上的表现（30类人格任务，30类）；引入低维监督子空间与匹配秩的PCA子空间对照；在SST-5单句情感分类上做情境对照，并用匹配基数控制排除属性基数混淆；检验跨对话轮次的差距变化与子空间时间稳定性，并设置预注册的组内可分性不变性准则和轮次不变性准则。
