AI.result: 余弦相似度大幅低估线性可解码结构：线性探针AUC为0.73-0.97，而余弦kNN仅为0.56-0.77。低维监督子空间可恢复大部分差距，匹配秩PCA不能甚至有时降低性能。该失配在SST-5中不存在；匹配基数控制排除属性基数混淆。差距不随对话轮次系统性增大，任务对齐子空间随时间稳定。但三个模型中两个违反预注册组内可分性不变性（|ΔAUC|≤0.03），一个违反轮次不变性（|ΔL|≤0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 即使任务对齐结构在对话表示中线性可及，余弦相似度也可能无法反映该结构，说明将余弦相似度作为任务结构代理需谨慎。

title: BiView-Touch: Learning Bimanual Tactile Representations by Cross-Hand Completion
summary: Bimanual interaction produces complementary tactile views of the same physical process, yet existing tactile representation learning largely models the two hands independently or combines them only for downstream prediction, leaving their cross-hand relationship unexplored. To exploit this overlooked structure, we introduce BiView-Touch, a tactile-only framework that completes masked target-hand latents from the remaining visible target-hand regions and the synchronized full contralateral hand. A student encoder with a geometry-conditioned directional decoder predicts full-view EMA latent targets, while temporal and layout counterfactuals encourage sensitivity to synchronized and anatomically organized source information. Controlled ablations and source-context interventions show that BiView-Touch learns structured cross-hand dependence on temporally aligned and anatomically organized contralateral tactile context, rather than benefiting from bilateral input alone. On the public HumanTouch dataset, its frozen representations consistently outperform representative self-supervised baselines across low-label settings. With only 5\% downstream labels, BiView-Touch achieves relative balanced-accuracy gains of 7.1\% on bilateral wrist-motion recognition and 14.1\% on force-derived interaction-phase recognition. We further introduce BVT-20, a 20-task bilateral tactile dataset, and demonstrate transfer across recording sessions and pretraining corpora, including transfer to a held-out bimanual task. Our code and dataset details are available on the anonymous project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/biview-touch-review-site-050C/.

AI.tldr: BiView-Touch 是一个仅用触觉的双视图自监督框架，通过用对侧手完整信息补全遮蔽的目标手潜在表示，学习跨手依赖关系，在低标签场景下优于自监督基线。
AI.motivation: 双手交互可提供同一物理过程的互补触觉视图，但现有触觉表示学习大多独立建模双手，或仅在预测阶段组合双手，未挖掘跨手关系这一被忽视的结构。
AI.method: 提出仅触觉框架 BiView-Touch：利用剩余可见的目标手区域与同步的对侧手完整信息，补全被遮蔽的目标手潜在表示。采用学生编码器加几何条件的方向性解码器预测全视图 EMA 潜在目标；并设计时间与布局反事实，促使模型对同步且符合解剖组织的源信息保持敏感。
AI.result: 在公开 HumanTouch 数据集上，冻结表示在低标签设置下持续优于代表性自监督基线；仅用 5% 下游标签时，双侧腕部运动识别平衡准确率相对提升 7.1%，力导出的交互阶段识别相对提升 14.1%。发布了 20 任务的 BVT-20 双侧触觉数据集，并验证了跨会话、跨预训练语料的迁移，以及向留出双手任务的迁移。
AI.conclusion: 受控消融与源上下文干预表明，BiView-Touch 学到的是对时间对齐、解剖组织的对侧触觉上下文的结构化跨手依赖，而非仅受益于双侧输入本身。

title: DocMIDE: Learning Multi-Hop Implicit Derivation in Visually Rich Documents
summary: Real-world document processing systems rely on rigid, predefined schemas, yet critical target fields often lack direct visual counterparts on the page. Extracting these implicit values requires multi-hop derivation, such as aggregating sub-categories or reasoning over visual marks. While existing methods handle explicit text spans or simple implicit queries, they fail at multi-hop visual reasoning even after standard fine-tuning: models retrieve incorrect visual evidence, or retrieve it correctly and then skip the intermediate steps of the derivation. To address this, we introduce DocMIDE, a fine-tuning framework that trains compact vision-language models to retrieve visual evidence explicitly before deriving an answer. DocMIDE constrains generation to a plan-retrieve-derive structure and optimizes it with Group Relative Policy Optimization under a four-component, rule-based reward that scores output format, the retrieved evidence block, every intermediate derivation step, and the final value against a verified reference trace. On a 4,151-pair implicit extraction benchmark, DocMIDE raises accuracy from 70.8% to 95.9% on Qwen3.5-4B from only a small set of annotated examples, and transfers to a second backbone architecture. Supervised demonstrations alone do not close this gap at any budget we tested; rewarding the intermediate steps is what does.

AI.tldr: DocMIDE 通过“先检索视觉证据、再分步推导”的强化微调框架，显著提升小模型在隐式字段抽取中的多跳视觉推理能力，准确率从 70.8% 提升至 95.9%。
AI.motivation: 现实文档处理依赖预定义 schema，但许多关键目标字段在页面上没有直接视觉对应物，需要多跳推导（如聚合子类别、对视觉标记进行推理）。现有方法仅能处理显式文本片段或简单隐式查询，即便经过标准微调，在多跳视觉推理上仍会失败：要么检索到错误的视觉证据，要么虽正确检索却跳过中间推导步骤。
AI.method: 提出 DocMIDE 微调框架，训练紧凑的视觉语言模型在给出答案前显式检索视觉证据。该方法将生成约束为 plan-retrieve-derive 结构，并采用 Group Relative Policy Optimization 优化；奖励为四分量规则式设计，分别评估输出格式、检索到的证据块、每一个中间推导步骤以及最终值（与经核验的参考轨迹比对）。
AI.result: 在包含 4,151 对样本的隐式抽取基准上，借助少量标注示例，DocMIDE 将 Qwen3.5-4B 的准确率从 70.8% 提升至 95.9%，并可迁移到第二种主干架构。仅靠监督示范在任何测试预算下都无法弥合这一差距。
AI.conclusion: 奖励中间推导步骤是性能提升的关键，而非单纯的监督示范；DocMIDE 有效解决了多跳视觉推理中的证据检索与步骤跳跃问题。

title: Cross-Dialect NER for Bangla Regional Dialects Using Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation and Explainable AI
comment: Accepted for Publication in IEEE 3rd INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON COMPUTING, APPLICATIONS AND SYSTEMS (COMPAS 2026)
summary: Bangla, the seventh most spoken language in the world, exhibits significant regional dialectal diversity, with dialects such as Barishal, Chattogram, Sylhet, Noakhali, and Mymensingh differing in lexical, morphological, and syntactic characteristics. These variations pose substantial challenges for Named Entity Recognition (NER), limiting the generalization of models trained on Standard Bangla or a single regional dialect. This paper presents a cross-dialect Bangla NER framework using the publicly available ANCHOLIK-NER dataset, comprising 17,405 annotated sentences and 101,817 tokens across five major Bangla regional dialects. A Leave-One-Dialect-Out Cross-Validation (LODOCV) strategy is adopted, training models on four dialects and evaluating on the remaining unseen dialect. Eight pretrained transformer-based models, including BanglaBERT, MuRIL, XLM-RoBERTa, and Multilingual-E5, are evaluated under identical experimental settings. Multilingual-E5 Large achieves the highest F1-score in every fold, peaking at 97.26% on Mymensingh and reaching its lowest, 82.38%, on Chattogram, the most challenging target dialect. To improve interpretability, Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) are applied to word-level predictions, revealing that the model's decisions are driven primarily by the surface form of the target entity word itself rather than by surrounding sentence context. These findings establish a benchmark for cross-dialect Bangla NER and demonstrate the effectiveness of transformer-based transfer learning for low-resource regional dialects, while highlighting the surface-form dependence of current models as a direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 提出跨方言孟加拉语NER框架，基于ANCHOLIK-NER数据集采用LODOCV策略评估八个预训练Transformer模型，Multilingual-E5 Large最优，并用LIME揭示模型主要依赖实体词表层面形式。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语方言（Barishal、Chattogram、Sylhet、Noakhali、Mymensingh）在词汇、形态和句法上差异显著，导致在标准孟加拉语或单一方言上训练的NER模型泛化能力受限，亟需跨方言NER基准与方法。
AI.method: 使用公开的ANCHOLIK-NER数据集（17,405条标注句子、101,817个token，覆盖五种主要孟加拉语地区方言）；采用留一方言交叉验证（LODOCV）策略，以四方言训练、另一方言测试；在相同实验设置下评估八种预训练Transformer模型（含BanglaBERT、MuRIL、XLM-RoBERTa、Multilingual-E5）；并应用LIME对词级预测进行可解释性分析。
AI.result: Multilingual-E5 Large在每一折中均取得最高F1，最高为Mymensingh上的97.26%，最低为最具挑战性的目标方言Chattogram上的82.38%；LIME分析显示模型决策主要受目标实体词的表层形式驱动，而非周围句子语境。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为跨方言孟加拉语NER建立了基准，验证了Transformer迁移学习在低资源地区方言上的有效性，并指出当前模型对表层形式的依赖是未来改进方向。

title: The Right Future for Action: Learning Action-Relevant Predictive States in World Action Models
summary: Generation-free world action models (WAMs) retain future-video prediction during training but act from internal video features at inference, leaving unclear what these features should preserve for control. Our representation diagnostics show that representations with more predictable future changes need not make linear action decoding easier. Observed future changes provide additional action information beyond the present, and linearly readable action information is spatially concentrated. These findings motivate Action-Relevant Predictive States (ARPS), a compact predictive interface between the video and action experts. ARPS uses a horizon-conditioned state predictor to aggregate intermediate video features into a compact state that supplies all visual context to the action expert. Future-representation supervision trains different parts of this state to predict visual representations at different future times, together with their changes relative to the present. At inference, the supervision branch is removed, and the action expert only uses the learned predictive state computed from current observations. Controlled ablations show that future supervision substantially improves generalization under distribution shift. ARPS achieves 99.2% success on LIBERO and transfers to LIBERO-Plus without adaptation, reaching 87.3% and exceeding Fast-WAM by 39.2 percentage points.

AI.tldr: ARPS是一种紧凑的预测接口，通过horizon条件状态预测器聚合视频特征并为动作专家提供全部视觉上下文，配合未来表征监督显著提升分布偏移下的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有generation-free world action models在推理时基于内部视频特征执行动作，但这些特征应为控制保留何种信息尚不明确。诊断实验显示，未来变化预测性更强的表征未必更利于线性动作解码，且可线性读取的动作信息在空间上高度集中，因此需要重新设计视频与动作专家之间的接口。
AI.method: 提出Action-Relevant Predictive States（ARPS）：使用horizon条件状态预测器将中间视频特征聚合为紧凑状态，为动作专家提供全部视觉上下文；通过未来表征监督训练该状态的不同部分预测不同未来时刻的视觉表征及其相对当前的变化；推理时移除监督分支，动作专家仅使用由当前观测计算得到的预测状态。
AI.result: 控制消融实验表明未来监督显著提升分布偏移下的泛化能力。ARPS在LIBERO上达到99.2%成功率，并在无自适应情况下迁移至LIBERO-Plus，取得87.3%，超过Fast-WAM 39.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 未来表征监督所学习的紧凑预测状态能够作为视频与动作专家之间的有效接口，在保持推理高效的同时大幅提升泛化性和跨任务迁移能力。

title: When More Evidence Hurts: Publication-Bias Drift and Principled Stopping for Biomedical Causal Search
summary: Automated biomedical evidence synthesis depends on retrieving published studies, but the biomedical literature is systematically skewed toward positive findings. Deeper retrieval can therefore make a system \emph{more} likely to falsely infer benefit when the true effect is null. We formalise this phenomenon as \emph{evidence drift} and prove that, under a standard publication-bias model, the false-positive probability on null-effect queries follows a strictly increasing large-sample envelope in retrieval depth, approaching one. Empirically, on a held-out test set of 140 Cochrane-derived queries, drift rises monotonically from 7.9\% to 15.7\% as the retrieval budget grows from 3 to 20 steps, and concentrates in the null-effect class. We present DACG-agent, a drift-aware causal-graph agent that incrementally builds a causal knowledge graph from PubMed abstracts and applies a two-layer stopping policy with complementary roles: a KL-divergence monitor that detects posterior convergence (the accuracy layer), and a Bradley--Terry process reward model (PRM) whose online decline detection halts retrieval once evidence quality peaks (the efficiency layer). Against full-budget retrieval, DACG-agent reduces evidence drift from 15.7\% to 6.4\% and improves null-effect accuracy by 21 percentage points (40.0\%$\to$61.4\%) while using 67\% fewer retrieval steps; overall accuracy rises from 61.4\% to 69.3\% (95\% CI 61--77). A simulation confirms the drift result transfers from the analysed vote-counting aggregator to the deployed noisy-OR one.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并形式化"证据漂移"现象：检索越深，系统越易在真实效应为零时错误推断出获益。作者提出漂移感知的因果图智能体DACG-agent，通过两层停止策略将假阳性率从15.7%降至6.4%，并提升零效应准确率21个百分点。
AI.motivation: 自动化生物医学证据合成依赖文献检索，但文献发表存在系统性的正向偏倚（positive findings倾斜）。检索越深，纳入的偏倚证据越多，反而使系统在真实效应为零（null effect）时更易错误推断出获益。论文将这一反直觉现象形式化为"证据漂移"（evidence drift），并证明其在检索深度增加时单调恶化，从而揭示当前"检索越多越好"范式的根本缺陷。
AI.method: 1）理论建模：在标准发表偏倚模型下，证明零效应查询的假阳性概率随检索深度呈严格递增的大样本包络，趋于1。2）定义两类聚合器：用于分析的投票计数（vote-counting）聚合器与部署用的噪声或（noisy-OR）聚合器。3）提出DACG-agent：增量式地从PubMed摘要构建因果知识图谱；采用双层停止策略——KL散度监控器检测后验收敛（准确层），Bradley–Terry过程奖励模型（PRM）通过在线下降检测在证据质量达峰时停止检索（效率层）。4）在140个Cochrane来源查询的留出测试集上验证，并用模拟验证漂移结论在两类聚合器间的可迁移性。
AI.result: 检索预算从3步增至20步时，证据漂移由7.9%单调升至15.7%，且集中于零效应类别。相比全预算检索，DACG-agent将证据漂移从15.7%降至6.4%，零效应准确率提升21个百分点（40.0%→61.4%），同时检索步数减少67%；总体准确率由61.4%升至69.3%（95% CI 61–77）。模拟结果确认漂移现象可从分析的投票计数聚合器迁移至部署的noisy-OR聚合器。
AI.conclusion: 证据漂移是生物医学自动化证据合成中由发表偏倚与深检索共同导致的系统性风险，且随检索深度单调加剧。该风险可通过漂移感知的动态停止策略有效缓解：DACG-agent在显著削减检索成本的同时，降低了假阳性并提升零效应与总体准确率，表明"该何时停止检索"比"检索多少"更关键。

title: Correct Diagnosis, Better Feedback: A Symbolic-Verifier for Faithful LLM Tutoring Feedback in Logic Proofs
summary: Effective LLM tutoring depends on correctly identifying the specific error in a student's reasoning before generating feedback. We study this problem in propositional-logic proof tutoring, where student actions can be checked against formal inference rules. We introduce a verifier-grounded architecture that separates diagnosis from language generation. Using 600 balanced student actions, we compare a zero-shot LLM detector, a fine-tuned detector, and a symbolic verifier. Each diagnosis is processed by shared rationale and feedback agents, isolating the effect of the initial diagnosis. The zero-shot detector achieves a macro-F1 of 0.191; fine-tuning raises this to 0.709 but retains systematic errors between structurally related classes. Rationales generally preserve the diagnosis supplied to them, showing that an incorrect diagnosis can be faithfully propagated through the pipeline. Feedback can likewise remain faithful to its rationale, non-revealing, and pedagogically appropriate while addressing the wrong error. Verifier-grounded feedback achieves the highest diagnostic correctness, and expert ratings largely uneven with the automatic feedback evaluations. These findings show that apparent feedback quality can conceal upstream diagnostic errors and that faithfulness must be evaluated separately from correctness. Our code is publicly available

AI.tldr: 该论文研究命题逻辑证明辅导中的学生错误诊断问题，提出将诊断与语言生成分离的"验证器锚定"架构。基于600条平衡学生行为数据，比较零样本LLM检测器、微调检测器与符号验证器，发现诊断错误会被忠实传播至解释与反馈环节，表面高质量的反馈可能掩盖上游诊断错误，因此忠实性必须与正确性分开评估。
AI.motivation: 有效的LLM辅导需在生成反馈前正确识别学生推理中的具体错误。然而现有方法往往将诊断与反馈生成耦合，难以判断反馈质量反映的是真实诊断正确性还是仅对错误诊断的忠实转述。
AI.method: 在命题逻辑证明辅导场景中构建验证器锚定架构，将诊断与语言生成解耦。采用600条平衡的学生行为数据，对比零样本LLM检测器、微调检测器和符号验证器；每个诊断结果交由共享的解释（rationale）与反馈智能体处理，以隔离初始诊断的影响。
AI.result: 零样本检测器macro-F1为0.191；微调提升至0.709，但在结构相关类别间仍存在系统性混淆。解释通常保留所接收的诊断，说明错误诊断可被忠实传播；反馈同样可忠实于其解释、不泄露答案且教学上得当，却针对了错误的错误。验证器锚定的反馈取得最高的诊断正确率，且专家评分与自动反馈评估结果大多不一致。
AI.conclusion: 表面上的反馈质量可能掩盖上游的诊断错误，因此忠实性（faithfulness）必须与正确性（correctness）分开评估。验证器锚定的架构在诊断正确性上表现最佳，提示诊断环节应以形式化验证为根基，而非依赖LLM的隐式判断。

title: Vision-Wireless Fusion for Multi-User Localization: A Cross-Modal Transformer Approach
summary: Accurate multi-user localization is challenging in complex urban environments, where wireless measurements can become ambiguous under noise, blockage, and multipath, while visual observations provide complementary spatial context. This paper presents a vision-wireless fusion framework for multi-user localization using pilot-indexed channel state information (CSI). Orthogonal pilot indices preserve the identities of the communicating UEs in the CSI token sequence and localization outputs. The model encodes each pilot-indexed CSI observation as a query token and uses cross-attention to retrieve user-specific information from spatial visual memory. Self-attention among CSI tokens further captures inter-user interactions, while the resulting multimodal representations are used for user-wise localization. Experiments on different datasets show consistent improvements over model-based, CSI-only, and multimodal-fusion baselines. Further experiments evaluate the model under different wireless and visual conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于导频索引CSI的视觉-无线融合多用户定位框架，通过跨注意力从视觉空间记忆中检索用户特定信息，并在多数据集上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 复杂城市环境中，无线测量在噪声、遮挡与多径下会产生歧义，而视觉观测可提供互补的空间上下文，因此需要融合视觉与无线信息以实现准确的多用户定位。
AI.method: 采用正交导频索引保留CSI标记序列中通信UE的身份；将每个导频索引CSI观测编码为查询token，通过跨注意力从空间视觉记忆中检索用户特定信息；利用CSI token间的自注意力捕捉用户间交互；最终将多模态表示用于逐用户定位。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验相较基于模型、仅CSI以及多模态融合基线均取得一致提升；进一步实验评估了模型在不同无线与视觉条件下的表现。
AI.conclusion: 导频索引CSI与视觉记忆的跨模态注意力机制可有效解决多用户身份关联与复杂环境下的定位歧义问题，验证了视觉-无线融合框架的鲁棒性与有效性。

title: EDGEGEN: Improving Tool-Calling Agents Beyond Happy Paths with Synthetic Edge Case Generation
summary: Tool-calling LLM agents are increasingly deployed in enterprise applications. However, effective evaluation and optimization require high-quality, diverse task datasets that are often difficult to obtain due to privacy and other constraints. Existing synthetic task generation methods often produce generic tasks that ignore an agent's underlying state or database and fail to reflect real-world usage diversity. We propose EdgeGen, a synthetic task generation framework that extracts compliance rules from an agent's specification and uses them to generate database-grounded edge-case tasks designed to violate these rules. When combined with existing synthetic data generation techniques, EdgeGen enables agent improvement through finetuning and harness optimization. The resulting pipeline forms a fully automated closed-loop system that requires no human annotation. Finetuning on data generated by EdgeGen yields a consistent mean progress improvement of 2 percent to 42 percent on tau2bench airline domain, while other baseline methods show degradation for some models. On the other hand, for harness optimization, our method shows a mean progress improvement of 10 percent and 30 percent over the human-curated and base harnesses, respectively, for the Gemma-4-e4b model.

AI.tldr: 提出 EdgeGen 合成任务生成框架，通过从智能体规范中抽取合规规则生成"违规型"边缘任务，实现全自动闭环的智能体微调与 harness 优化。
AI.motivation: 工具调用型 LLM 智能体在企业场景中应用日益广泛，但高质量、多样化的评测与优化数据集因隐私等约束难以获取；现有合成任务生成方法产出的任务过于通用，既忽略了智能体底层状态或数据库，也难以反映真实使用中的多样性。
AI.method: EdgeGen 从智能体的 specification 中提取 compliance rules，并据此生成以数据库为 grounding、旨在违反这些规则的 edge-case 任务；再与现有合成数据生成技术结合，构成无需人工标注的全自动闭环流水线，用于微调与 harness 优化。
AI.result: 微调方面，在 tau2bench 航空领域上使用 EdgeGen 生成数据带来平均 progress 提升 2%~42%，且表现一致；相比之下其他基线方法在部分模型上出现性能退化。harness 优化方面，在 Gemma-4-e4b 模型上，该方法相较人工构建 harness 与基础 harness 分别取得约 10% 与 30% 的平均 progress 提升。
AI.conclusion: EdgeGen 通过规则驱动的边缘任务合成，弥补了通用合成任务缺乏数据库 grounding 与真实多样性的缺陷，验证了其在微调与 harness 优化两条路径上的有效性，并提供了一种无需人工标注的全自动智能体改进方案。

title: Do Student LLMs Inherit OOD Robustness? Invariance-Weighted Distillation for Reliable Knowledge Transfer
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) aims to compress high-performance teacher LLMs into lightweight students. However, distilled students often exhibit substantial performance degradation in out-of-distribution (OOD) settings, a critical gap that remains underexplored. We identify two compounding mechanisms causing OOD performance degradation: (1) data spuriousness: students can learn spurious correlations in the distillation dataset over genuine causal relationships; and (2) teacher capability: standard KD treats all samples uniformly, ignoring whether the teacher is guided by causal features or misled by spurious shortcuts on a given sample. To address these challenges, we propose Invariance-Weighted Distillation (IWD), a theoretically grounded framework that dynamically reweights training samples using an estimate of the teacher's causal reliance derived from prediction invariance across multiple synthetic environments. IWD perturbs spurious cues while preserving core semantics, assigning higher distillation weights to samples whose teacher predictions remain invariant, indicating greater reliance on causal rather than spurious features. We theoretically show that IWD reduces the student's Spurious-to-Causal (S2C) gradient ratio compared to standard uniformly weighted KD, driving the student toward more invariant representations. Experiments on four NLP benchmarks (MNLI, SQuAD-v2, CoNLL-2003 NER, and SST-2) across two model families (DeBERTa-v3 and Qwen-2.5) demonstrate that IWD consistently outperforms strong KD baselines on OOD evaluations while maintaining competitive in-distribution (ID) performance. Specifically, IWD achieves the highest accuracy in 15 out of 16 OOD benchmarks and improves average OOD performance over standard KD by 4.34 percentage points on NLI and 14.94 percentage points on QA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Invariance-Weighted Distillation (IWD)，通过基于教师预测不变性动态加权训练样本，缓解知识蒸馏学生在分布外（OOD）场景下的性能退化，并在多个 NLP 基准上取得优于标准 KD 的 OOD 表现。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏（KD）旨在将高性能教师大模型压缩为轻量学生模型，但蒸馏学生在分布外（OOD）设置下常出现显著性能退化，这一问题尚未被充分探索。作者识别出两个导致 OOD 退化的复合机制：（1）数据虚假性：学生会学习蒸馏数据中的虚假相关而非真实因果关系；（2）教师能力：标准 KD 对所有样本统一处理，忽视了教师在特定样本上是否依赖因果特征还是被虚假捷径误导。
AI.method: 作者提出 Invariance-Weighted Distillation (IWD)，一个理论支撑的框架。IWD 通过多个合成环境中的预测不变性估计教师对因果特征的依赖程度，并据此动态重加权训练样本。具体而言，IWD 扰动虚假线索同时保留核心语义，对教师预测保持不变的样本赋予更高蒸馏权重，表明教师更依赖因果而非虚假特征。理论上证明 IWD 相比标准均匀加权 KD 能降低学生的 Spurious-to-Causal (S2C) 梯度比率，推动学生朝更不变的表征学习。
AI.result: 在四个 NLP 基准（MNLI、SQuAD-v2、CoNLL-2003 NER、SST-2）和两个模型家族（DeBERTa-v3 与 Qwen-2.5）上的实验表明，IWD 在 OOD 评估中持续优于强 KD 基线，同时保持有竞争力的 ID 性能。具体地，IWD 在 16 个 OOD 基准中的 15 个取得最高准确率，并在平均 OOD 性能上较标准 KD 在 NLI 上提升 4.34 个百分点，在 QA 上提升 14.94 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: IWD 通过估计教师因果依赖并动态重加权样本，有效缓解知识蒸馏学生在 OOD 场景下的性能退化，理论分析与实验结果均验证其能引导学生学习更不变的表征，是一种提升蒸馏鲁棒性的有效框架。

title: LiteTex-GS: Fast and Lightweight Texturing for Gaussian Splatting
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to Pacific Graphics 2026 (Journal Track)
summary: Gaussian Splatting has enabled real-time novel view synthesis, but its tightly coupled geometry and appearance representation often require a large number of primitives to reproduce high-frequency texture details, leading to substantial memory and optimization costs. Recent textured 2D Gaussian methods alleviate this limitation by attaching texture maps to Gaussian primitives. However, bridging the fundamental structural gap between discrete Gaussians and continuous 2D grids requires complex parameterizations that introduce severe computational overhead. This overhead fundamentally compromises the original efficiency of Gaussian Splatting, making the balance between detailed texturing and computational agility an unresolved challenge. To address these challenges, we propose LiteTex-GS, a fast and lightweight texturing framework for Gaussian Splatting. Our method initializes an extremely compact representation, assigning minimal local texture to each Gaussian and progressively allocates higher resolution only to primitives with significant reconstruction errors. To maintain a streamlined geometric scaffold, we introduce a contribution- and area-aware pruning strategy that eliminates low-utility Gaussians. Furthermore, to mitigate the gradient dilution caused by texture upsampling, we design a resolution-aware update rule that preserves rapid and stable convergence. Extensive experiments on standard novel view synthesis benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves competitive or superior rendering quality while using substantially fewer parameters and less training time than existing textured Gaussian baselines.

AI.tldr: LiteTex-GS：一种快速轻量的高斯泼溅纹理框架，通过渐进式纹理分配与剪枝策略，在减少参数和训练时间的同时保持竞争性渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 3D高斯泼溅中几何与外观表示紧耦合，需大量图元才能复现高频纹理，导致内存与优化成本高；现有纹理化2D高斯方法虽缓解该问题，但离散高斯与连续2D网格的结构差异需要复杂参数化，带来严重计算开销，破坏了高斯泼溅的效率优势，细节纹理与计算敏捷性的平衡仍未解决。
AI.method: 提出LiteTex-GS框架：1）初始化极紧凑表示，为每个高斯分配最小局部纹理，仅对重建误差显著的图元渐进分配更高分辨率；2）引入贡献与面积感知的剪枝策略，剔除低效高斯以保持精简几何骨架；3）设计分辨率感知的更新规则，缓解纹理上采样引起的梯度稀释，保持快速稳定收敛。
AI.result: 在标准新视角合成基准上，相比现有纹理化高斯基线，使用显著更少的参数和更短的训练时间，达到竞争性或更优的渲染质量。
AI.conclusion: LiteTex-GS有效解决了纹理化高斯泼溅中细节与效率的平衡难题，实现了轻量、快速且高质量的渲染。

title: Self-Healing Harness for Runtime Oversight of Agent Self-Modification
summary: LLM agents can change their own future behavior, raising a basic control question of which self-generated changes should be allowed to persist. We formulate this as admission control for self-modification. The agent may propose changes to its operating instructions, while an external runtime gate controls persistence. We implement this principle as a model-agnostic self-healing harness that runs a Detect, Notice, Heal, Validate loop around an otherwise unmodified agent. The agent authors candidate behavioral rules in an external workspace, where they receive provisional execution authority during evaluation and acquire persistent cross-episode authority only after measured improvement on the triggering failure without regression beyond a fixed margin on protected cases. Replay provides matched evidence when available, forward trials provide a weaker fallback, and a corpus-level guard re-tests the accumulated active rule set. Across 16 matched Baseline and Harness runs spanning AppWorld, Terminal-Bench, and $τ^2$-Bench, the gate rejected 383 replay-decided proposals. Of these, 211 (55%) improved their triggering failure while degrading a case that previously worked. This shows that locally beneficial self-modifications can introduce collateral regressions often enough to materially affect gate decisions, providing direct empirical motivation for external admission control. Task-completion score is higher under the Harness in all 16 pairs, with two paired bootstrap intervals excluding zero, while repeated-trial reliability is higher in 12 pairs, tied in 4, and lower in none. Because adaptation modifies the policy-inducing context while leaving model weights fixed, admitted changes remain inspectable, reversible, and compatible with closed-weight models.

AI.tldr: 本文将LLM智能体的自我修改问题形式化为"准入控制"问题，提出模型无关的自愈框架，通过外部运行时门控决定自我生成的行为规则能否持久化，实验证明本地有益的自我修改常带来附带回归，且外部门控能提升任务完成度与可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体能够改变自身未来行为，由此引发一个基本控制问题：哪些自我生成的改变应被允许持久保留。若不加外部约束，智能体的自我修改可能带来不可控的副作用，因此需要研究如何在允许有益自适应与防止有害改变之间进行权衡。
AI.method: 作者将问题形式化为"自我修改的准入控制"（admission control for self-modification）：智能体可提出对自身运行指令的修改，但由外部运行时门控控制其是否持久化。实现为一个模型无关的自愈框架（self-healing harness），在未修改的智能体外围运行"检测—告知—修复—验证"（Detect, Notice, Heal, Validate）循环。候选行为规则写在外部工作区，评估期间获得临时执行权限，只有在触发失败上测得改进且受保护用例回归不超过固定裕度后，才获得跨轮次的持久权限。有重放证据时用重放匹配，否则用前向试验作为较弱回退，并以语料级守卫重新测试累积的活跃规则集。
AI.result: 在AppWorld、Terminal-Bench和τ²-Bench的16对匹配的基线/框架运行中，门控拒绝了383个由重放裁决的提案，其中211个（55%）改善了触发失败但同时损害了原本可用的用例。框架在全部16对中任务完成分更高，其中两个配对bootstrap区间不含零；重复试验可靠性在12对中更高、4对持平、无一对更低。
AI.conclusion: 本地有益的自我修改会足够频繁地引入附带回归，从而实质影响门控决策，这为外部准入控制提供了直接的经验支持。由于自适应只修改诱发策略的上下文而固定模型权重，被接纳的改变保持可审查、可逆，并兼容闭权重模型。

title: Preserving What Matters: Semantic Scaffolds Beyond Saturation in Summarization Evaluation
comment: Accepted at the AIMS Workshop at COLM 2026
summary: Summarization ships in countless production systems, making model selection a routine decision that depends on measuring summary quality. Existing metrics struggle to support this: ROUGE captures only surface overlap, while LLM-as-judge scores saturate to near-identical values that fail to rank models effectively. We observe this saturation across three public datasets, two proprietary datasets, and multilingual settings. Motivated by this, we introduce Semantic Scaffold, an evaluation framework that extracts a hierarchical representation of facts, questions, and entity attributes from a source text, labeling each as a main point or supporting detail, and reusing this structure as a fixed reference for scoring summaries. From this representation, we derive three diagnostic metrics: Fact Preservation Score (FPS), Question Preservation Score (QPS), and Entity Preservation Score (EPS), designed to reward the preservation of essential information while penalizing detail overload, and position them as interpretable diagnostics that remain informative where holistic axes collapse. Finally, we analyze four recurring failure modes of ROUGE and LLM-as-judge scores, demonstrating that scaffold-based evaluation remains informative where conventional metrics collapse.

AI.tldr: 针对摘要质量评估中ROUGE仅测表层重叠、LLM-as-judge评分饱和失效的问题，提出Semantic Scaffold评估框架，从源文本抽取事实、问题、实体属性的层次化表示并区分主次，导出FPS/QPS/EPS三项诊断指标，在多种数据集上验证其能保持区分度。
AI.motivation: 摘要系统广泛部署，模型选择依赖质量评估，但现有指标存在缺陷：ROUGE只捕捉表层词汇重叠，而LLM-as-judge在不同模型上评分趋近饱和、无法有效排序。作者在三个公开数据集、两个专有数据集及多语言场景中均观察到这一饱和现象，因此需要一种更细粒度、可解释的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出Semantic Scaffold评估框架：先从源文本中抽取事实、问题与实体属性的层次化表示，并将每个要素标注为主要观点或支撑细节，再将该结构复用为固定的评分参考。基于此表示导出三项诊断指标——事实保留分数（FPS）、问题保留分数（QPS）和实体保留分数（EPS），设计目标是在奖励关键信息保留的同时惩罚细节过载。
AI.result: 所提指标被定位为可解释的诊断工具，在整体性指标（holistic axes）失效的场景下仍具信息量；并在多个数据集与多语言设置中验证其有效性。论文进一步分析出ROUGE与LLM-as-judge评分的四种反复出现的失效模式，证明基于scaffold的评估在传统指标崩塌处仍能保持区分力。
AI.conclusion: Semantic Scaffold通过结构化、可解释的诊断指标弥补了ROUGE与LLM-as-judge的不足，为摘要模型选择提供更可靠的评估手段，并揭示了传统指标的典型失效模式，表明其在实际系统评估中具有应用价值。

title: ProxyBuild: Text-Guided Structured 3D Building Generation with Mesh-Anchored Procedural Proxies
summary: Text-guided 3D building generation holds tremendous application potential, yet existing generative models typically output inseparable single meshes or non-interactive rendered representations. While procedural modeling can generate editable buildings with hierarchical structures, rule authoring is laborious, and even with the aid of large language models (LLMs), it remains challenging to effectively solve procedural rules under geometric constraints. In this paper, we propose ProxyBuild, a novel hybrid framework for structured building generation. We introduce the Mesh-Anchored Procedural Proxy (MAPP) as a novel intermediate representation, which tightly anchors building components onto geometric shells, thereby decoupling the generation task into two phases: proxy prediction and proxy-to-asset instantiation. First, we construct a building dataset with MAPP annotations to train our designed face-edge bigraph encoder. By explicitly modeling the feature interactions of topological elements on heterogeneous mesh graphs, this encoder accurately infers the semantic roles of faces and edges. Subsequently, conditioned on textual styles and attribute parameters parsed by LLMs, we accomplish high-precision asset retrieval and assembly by integrating a spatial placement logic with hard constraints. Extensive experiments show that ProxyBuild not only significantly mitigates common issues in building generation such as over-smoothing, component collisions, and structural corruptions, but also accurately parses semantic-free shells from diverse sources. Outperforming prior baselines across various metrics, our method can robustly generate structurally clear, detail-rich, and post-editable 3D buildings from text, thereby providing a reliable and interactive content foundation for downstream applications such as virtual reality and digital twins.

AI.tldr: ProxyBuild：一种基于"网格锚定过程代理(MAPP)"的混合式结构化建筑生成框架，将生成解耦为代理预测与代理到资产实例化两阶段，可从文本鲁棒生成结构清晰、细节丰富且可后期编辑的三维建筑。
AI.motivation: 现有文本引导三维建筑生成模型通常输出不可分离的单一网格或不可交互的渲染表示；过程式建模虽可生成可编辑的层级建筑，但规则编写繁琐，即便借助大语言模型也难以在几何约束下有效求解过程式规则。因此需要兼顾可编辑性与生成质量的新方法。
AI.method: 提出混合框架ProxyBuild及新型中间表示MAPP（网格锚定过程代理），将建筑构件紧贴锚定到几何外壳上，把生成解耦为两阶段：(1) 代理预测——构建带MAPP标注的建筑数据集，训练面-边二部图编码器，通过在异质网格图上显式建模拓扑元素特征交互，推断面与边的语义角色；(2) 代理到资产实例化——以LLM解析的文本风格与属性参数为条件，结合硬约束的空间布局逻辑实现高精度资产检索与装配。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，ProxyBuild显著缓解了建筑生成中常见的过平滑、构件碰撞与结构损坏等问题，并能准确解析来自多种来源的无语义外壳；在多项指标上优于先前基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够从文本稳健生成结构清晰、细节丰富且可后期编辑的三维建筑，为虚拟现实、数字孪生等下游应用提供可靠且可交互的内容基础。

title: APEXA: Execution-Integrity Enforcement for Multi-Agent LLM Automation of Synchrotron Data Reduction
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 4th TPC Workshop @ SC'26 (Building Open AI Infrastructure, Models, and Agentic Systems for Science). Code and benchmark: https://github.com/AdvancedPhotonSource/APEXA-APS-Beamline-Assistant ; data: https://doi.org/10.18126/tgg4-1m26
summary: Synchrotron data reduction, detector calibration followed by azimuthal integration of terabyte-scale diffraction series, is a multi-step, expert-bound bottleneck that increasingly limits the science rate of user facilities. LLM agents promise to collapse it, but driving a real pipeline with a stochastic model creates a failure mode chat benchmarks cannot see: an agent can report a calibration that was never computed. Correctness here is a property of what executed, not of the transcript. We present APEXA, a deployed multi-agent framework (61 tools over heterogeneous compute, run as a single reasoning loop) automating calibration and integration from natural language at a major light source. We make three contributions. First, execution-integrity enforcement: a deterministic tool-layer guard that refuses to surface any result not backed by an executed tool call, with a parser tolerant of cross-model tool-call format drift: in deployment, a frontier model fabricated a complete calibration-comparison report for commands that never ran, which the guard converts to an explicit non-result; the same code gates an optional motor-control surface at 0/200 adversarial violations against a simulated IOC, versus 15/200 for an equivalent safety prompt. Second, we release APEXA-Bench, an evaluation harness of 58 facility tasks (50 base plus an 8-task cross-detector slice) organized by a four-class physical-consequence taxonomy, the first benchmark axis we know of separating a wasted compute cycle from a damaged instrument; its cross-detector grading against NIST-traceable lattice constants surfaced two latent pipeline bugs. Large-scale agent scoring is left to a full-length study. Third, we validate APEXA on real beamline data: from one natural-language prompt it recovers detector geometry and integrates a full attenuation/exposure sweep. We release the framework, harness and traces.

AI.tldr: 提出并部署了多智能体框架APEXA，用确定性执行完整性守卫防止LLM谎报未执行结果，并发布APEXA-Bench基准，在真实光束线数据上验证。
AI.motivation: 同步辐射数据处理（校准+方位积分）是TB级、多步骤、依赖专家的瓶颈，限制设施科研产出。LLM智能体有潜力自动化，但随机模型驱动真实管线的失败模式（谎报从未计算的校准）无法被对话基准检测，因为正确性是"实际执行"的属性而非"对话记录"的属性。
AI.method: 1）执行完整性强制：确定性工具层守卫，拒绝呈现无工具调用支撑的结果，解析器容忍跨模型工具调用格式漂移；同一代码保护可选电机控制面。2）发布APEXA-Bench：58项设施任务（50基础+8跨探测器切片），按四类物理后果分类法组织，区分"浪费算力"与"损坏仪器"。3）在真实光束线数据上验证：单条自然语言提示恢复探测器几何并完成衰减/曝光扫描积分。
AI.result: 部署中前沿模型为未运行命令编造了完整校准对比报告，守卫将其转为显式非结果；模拟IOC对抗测试0/200违规（对比安全提示词15/200）。跨探测器评分对照NIST可溯源晶格常数暴露两个潜在管线bug。真实数据上单提示完成几何恢复与全扫描积分。
AI.conclusion: 执行完整性守卫能有效防止LLM智能体的虚假结果报告并提升安全性；APEXA-Bench首次引入物理后果分类轴；框架、基准与轨迹已开源，大规模智能体评分留待完整研究。

title: Pretrained Persona Mixture Models and Tandem Models for Human Simulation
comment: 11 pages in body, 36 with appendices. 7 figures. 8 tables
summary: We argue here that the current dominant practice in LLM human simulation: prompting instruction-tuned assistant language models to role-play personas, is inaccurate and produces stereotyped predictions (lacking natural diversity). It has previously been shown that LLMs can be bound to personas using naturalistic, freetext dialog avoiding stereotyping. Here we show that binding can also be achieved using short, individual samples of dialog from specific people. Demographics can be added later without negative effects by simply querying the model. We use the term Persona Mixture Models (PMMs) for well-calibrated human models, currently realized as pretrained base models. We show that PMMs produce more accurate predictions than instruction-tuned models and retain more of the lexical, semantic, and pragmatic diversity found in human dialog. We measure realism and diversity of LLMs simulating human interlocutors across a diverse set of corpora spanning open-domain text, human-AI chat, and task-oriented dialogue between human speakers. However, base pretrained models can produce out-of-domain dialog and may lose some of the human's internal state over long contexts. We propose and explore tandem models which combine a pre-trained model with an instruction-tuned supervisor. Tandem models achieve the best overall accuracy and diversity in our experiments.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用短对话样本绑定预训练基座模型构建"Persona Mixture Models (PMMs)"来模拟特定人类，比指令微调模型的角色扮演更准确、更具多样性；并进一步提出并联模型（预训练模型+指令微调监督器）以兼顾准确性与多样性。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM人类模拟的主流做法是让指令微调的助手模型进行角色扮演（role-play personas），作者认为这种做法不准确，且会产生刻板化预测、缺乏自然多样性。已有研究显示LLM可通过自然、自由文本的对话绑定人格从而避免刻板化，本文希望进一步验证更轻量的绑定方式并改进模拟质量。
AI.method: 1）用特定个体的短对话样本将LLM绑定到该人格，实现PMMs（当前以预训练基座模型实现）；2）后续通过直接查询模型加入人口统计信息，且无负面影响；3）在涵盖开放域文本、人机聊天、人类间任务型对话的多个语料上，测量LLM模拟人类对话者的真实性与多样性；4）提出tandem模型，将预训练模型与指令微调监督器结合。
AI.result: PMMs比指令微调模型预测更准确，并保留了更多人类对话中的词汇、语义和语用多样性。但基座预训练模型可能产生域外对话，且在长上下文中可能丢失部分人类内部状态。Tandem模型在实验中取得最佳的整体准确性与多样性。
AI.conclusion: 以短对话样本绑定的PMMs是比指令微调角色扮演更优的人类模拟方式；结合预训练模型与指令微调监督器的tandem模型能同时改善准确性与多样性，是当前实验中表现最佳的方案。

title: Enhancing Shrimp Disease Detection via Deep Learning and Data Refinement for Resilient Aquaculture
comment: This paper has been accepted at the International Conference on Multidisciplinary Research (ICMR 2025)
summary: Shrimp diseases continue to cause devastating losses in the aquaculture industry, driving a critical need for robust, automated detection. This work contributes the first application of Vision Transformers (ViT) and Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) to the shrimp farming domain, addressing both performance bottlenecks and data labeling challenges. We propose two deep learning pipelines to classify four key diseases: Healthy, Black Gill (BG), White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV), and a co-infection of both using a dataset of 4,348 images. First, our supervised transfer-learning approach leverages ImageNet-pretrained ViT-Small/16 and EfficientNet backbones. Second, we introduce a contrastive learning framework (SimCLR) with a ViT-Small encoder to extract robust representations from unlabeled images prior to fine-tuning. Our results establish strong new baselines for sustainable aquaculture monitoring. The supervised approach achieves an outstanding 96% accuracy with fast convergence, outperforming traditional generic models, while the label-efficient SSL approach reaches a highly competitive 85% validation accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该文首次将ViT与自监督学习引入对虾病害识别，构建两套深度学习管线区分健康、黑鳃、WSSV及双重感染，监督迁移学习达96%精度，SimCLR自监督在少标注下达85%验证精度。
AI.motivation: 对虾病害给水产养殖业造成严重损失，亟需鲁棒、自动化的检测手段；现有方法存在性能瓶颈与数据标注困难两大问题，且ViT与SSL尚未被应用于对虾养殖领域。
AI.method: 基于4,348张图像的四分类任务（Healthy、黑鳃BG、白斑综合征WSSV及二者共感染），提出两套管线：(1) 监督迁移学习，采用ImageNet预训练的ViT-Small/16与EfficientNet骨干网络；(2) 以ViT-Small为编码器的SimCLR对比学习框架，先从未标注图像中提取鲁棒表征再微调。
AI.result: 监督迁移学习方案取得96%准确率，收敛速度快，优于传统通用模型；标签高效的自监督方案达到85%的验证准确率，具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为可持续水产养殖监测建立了新的强基线，证明ViT与SSL在对虾病害分类中有效，且自监督可在有限标注条件下保持较高性能。

title: CREDO: Variance-Guided Rubric Evolution for Replay-Corrected Credit Assignment
summary: Long-horizon language agents receive sparse terminal feedback, while intermediate rubrics provide structured but potentially misspecified assessments of progress. In resettable training environments, counterfactual continuation rollouts can measure local credit, but exhaustive replay is costly. We propose Credo, a framework that couples evolving semantic rubrics with selective, execution-based credit correction. A frozen judge maps visible transitions to rubric features, and a credit head predicts the change in expected terminal reward associated with the realized transition. Independently sampled two-sided replays correct prediction residuals using their recorded inclusion probabilities. We derive conditional unbiasedness and a variance decomposition that connects two design choices: which rubric features to retain, and where to allocate a fixed expected replay budget. The resulting criterion weights prediction errors by policy-score sensitivity and missing replay coverage; its allocation rule additionally accounts for continuation cost. We also describe a practical mixture with terminal leave-one-out advantages and distinguish its clipped, token-normalized PPO implementation from the ideal policy-gradient estimator. This preliminary report provides the method, proofs, an exact finite-model audit, and a controlled evaluation protocol. It makes no claim of empirical superiority on language-agent benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Credo框架，将演化式语义评分标准与选择性、基于执行的反事实信用校正相结合，用于长时程语言智能体的稀疏奖励信用分配。
AI.motivation: 长时程语言智能体仅获得稀疏的终局反馈，而中间评分标准虽能提供结构化进展评价却可能存在错误指定；在可重置训练环境中，反事实续跑可度量局部信用，但穷举回放代价高昂。
AI.method: 冻结评判器将可见状态转移映射为评分特征，信用头预测实际转移带来的期望终局奖励变化；独立采样的双边回放按其记录的选择概率校正预测残差；推导条件无偏性与方差分解，据此设计特征保留准则与固定期望回放预算的分配规则，并给出与终局留一优势混合的实际实现及其裁剪、token归一化PPO形式。
AI.result: 给出条件无偏性证明、方差分解、精确有限模型审计以及受控评估协议；未声称在语言智能体基准上具有实证优越性。
AI.conclusion: 这是一份初步报告，提供方法、证明、审计与评估协议，为后续实证研究奠定理论与实验基础。

title: Beetle: A Bilingual Model Suite for Modelling Second-Language Processing
summary: Bilingual language models (LMs) offer a controlled setting for studying how training conditions shape second-language (L2) behaviour, but prior work typically varies exposure structure, scale, and architecture at once, making it difficult to attribute effects to any single factor. We introduce Beetle, a controlled language model pretraining framework in which tokeniser, target language, training budget, and exposure structure are each independently manipulable, enabling systematic and comparable experimentation of training conditions. Using Beetle, we train and release 285 bilingual and 45 monolingual open-source LMs with rich checkpoints across a range of exposure schedules, data scales and first languages (L1s) to study multilingual pretraining and computational modelling of bilingualism and second language learning. Evaluating models on human bilingual and second language reading-time prediction and grammaticality judgement tasks, we find that staged and temporally structured curricula consistently improve alignment with language learner reading time compared to balanced bilingual training, with the largest gains at smaller data scales and for typologically closer language pairs. The Beetle models are well suited tools to help move computational psycholinguistics beyond its prevailing monolingual, English-centric focus toward models of human bilingual processing, to study cross-lingual learning dynamics, while supporting community-based development of controlled model families.

AI.tldr: 提出 Beetle 双语语言模型预训练框架，独立操控分词器、目标语言、训练预算与语言暴露结构，训练并开源 285 个双语与 45 个单语模型，发现分阶段、时间结构化的课程能提升模型与人类二语阅读时间数据的对齐度。
AI.motivation: 既有双语 LM 研究常同时改变暴露结构、规模与架构，难以将效应归因于单一因素；且计算心理语言学以单语、英语为中心，缺乏可控的双语/二语学习建模工具。
AI.method: 构建 Beetle 受控预训练框架，使分词器、目标语言、训练预算、暴露结构可各自独立操控；据此训练并发布 285 个双语与 45 个单语开源 LM，覆盖多种暴露日程、数据规模与母语（L1），并在人类双语与二语阅读时间预测、语法性判断任务上进行评估。
AI.result: 与均衡双语训练相比，分阶段（staged）与时间结构化的课程在语言学习者阅读时间预测上一致性更好；增益在数据规模较小时最大，且在类型学上更接近的语言对中更明显。
AI.conclusion: Beetle 模型可推动计算心理语言学超越单语、英语中心范式，转向人类双语加工与跨语言学习动态研究，并支持社区化开发受控模型族。

title: ScaleBlind: Point Cloud Completion under Unknown Scale
summary: Point cloud completion aims to infer a complete 3D shape from a partial point cloud and serves as a fundamental building block for downstream tasks such as reconstruction, editing, and simulation. Despite the recent progress, existing learning-based methods often implicitly rely on access to the ground-truth shape scale (GT-scale) during both training- and testing-time normalization, assuming privileged information that is unavailable in real-world inference. This hidden assumption limits practical deployment and can lead to severe completion artifacts, e.g., over- or under-completion and nested shells, once the oracle GT-scale cue is removed. We observe that the recent foundation image generation models exhibit a strong capability of understanding objects and geometries, and producing multi-view consistent renderings, making them promising priors for GT-scale-free 3D completion. Motivated by this insight, we propose ScaleBlind, a novel framework that leverages foundation-model-based image completion to recover global scale directly from partial inputs and then faithfully produces the 3D completion. Specifically, ScaleBlind dreams out complete multi-view appearances from rendered partial views, lifts the inferred missing regions back into 3D to obtain a geometry-aware coarse completion, and further refines it via a powerful cross-modal fusion network with the original partial point cloud. By harnessing 2D foundation priors, our method eliminates the need for accessing GT-scale information at inference. Moreover, it provides a principled bridge between 2D generative priors and 3D point cloud completion. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our framework, making ScaleBlind the new state-of-the-art for the point cloud completion task.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ScaleBlind，一个无需真值尺度（GT-scale）的点云补全框架：利用图像生成基础模型从部分点云渲染视图推断完整多视角并恢复全局尺度，再通过跨模态融合网络精修3D补全，成为点云补全任务的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有点云补全方法在训练和测试归一化时隐含依赖真值形状尺度（GT-scale）这一特权信息，而真实推理场景中无法获得，导致部署受限并在移除该线索后出现过度/不足补全、嵌套壳等严重伪影。作者观察到图像生成基础模型具备理解物体几何与生成多视角一致渲染的能力，可作为无GT-scale的3D补全先验。
AI.method: 提出ScaleBlind框架：从渲染的部分视图出发，借助基础模型"想象"出完整的多视角外观，从而直接从部分输入恢复全局尺度；将推断出的缺失区域提升（lift）回3D，得到几何感知的粗糙补全；随后通过强力的跨模态融合网络与原始部分点云进行精修。方法在推理时无需GT-scale信息，并在2D生成先验与3D点云补全之间建立桥接。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该框架性能优越，使ScaleBlind在点云补全任务上达到新的state-of-the-art。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用2D图像基础模型的先验，ScaleBlind消除了推理时对GT-scale的依赖，为无尺度先验的点云补全提供了有效方案，并搭建了2D生成先验与3D补全之间的原则性桥梁。

title: LIMIT: Less Is More for Instruction Tuning in Text-to-SQL
summary: Large language models have achieved remarkable progress on Text-to-SQL through reasoning-enhanced fine-tuning, yet existing approaches predominantly rely on massive instruction corpora under the assumption that scale drives performance. We challenge this paradigm by investigating a fundamental question: what is the minimal data requirement for effective Text-to-SQL instruction tuning? We propose LIMIT(Less Is More for Instruction Tuning in Text-to-SQL), a data-centric framework that demonstrates strong database reasoning can emerge from an extremely compact training set when examples are strategically selected. LIMIT operates through four stages: difficulty-aware filtering that identifies samples within the model's learning frontier, chain-of-thought synthesis with consistency-based selection, multi-dimensional quality scoring via LLM-as-judge, and genetic algorithm optimization that jointly maximizes schema coverage and sample quality. On the BIRD and Spider benchmark, LIMIT selects only 796 and 863 samples while achieving 100% table coverage, enabling Qwen3-8B to reach 69.1% and 88.9% execution accuracy.This result surpasses methods trained on 20 times more data and establishes a new state-of-the-art among open-source approaches. Our findings suggest that careful data curation, rather than scale, is the key to efficient Text-to-SQL learning.

AI.tldr: LIMIT：面向Text-to-SQL指令微调的数据中心框架，通过四阶段精选极少量样本（796/863条）实现100%表覆盖，Qwen3-8B达BIRD 69.1%、Spider 88.9%，超越20倍数据训练方法。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL微调依赖海量指令语料，默认"规模驱动性能"。论文质疑该范式，探究有效指令微调的最小数据需求。
AI.method: LIMIT四阶段流程：①难度感知过滤，筛选处于模型学习前沿的样本；②思维链合成结合一致性选择；③基于LLM-as-judge的多维质量评分；④遗传算法优化，联合最大化模式覆盖与样本质量。
AI.result: 在BIRD与Spider基准上分别仅选796、863条样本即达100%表覆盖；Qwen3-8B执行准确率69.1%（BIRD）与88.9%（Spider），超越训练数据量20倍的方法，创开源方案新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 数据精心策展而非规模，是高效Text-to-SQL学习的关键。

title: COT-TTS: Audio Context-Aware Text-to-Speech with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Recently, text-to-speech systems have made significant progress in speech expressiveness and controllability. However, the speaking style of generated speech typically relies on clear user-specified instructions. In natural conversations, speaking style should be naturally inferred from the preceding conversational context. Therefore, we propose COT-TTS, a context-aware, reasoning-based text-to-speech task. Given historical conversation audio, target text, and a reference speech, the system should comprehend the conversational context, infer an explicit intermediate reasoning, and finally synthesize the target speech with the specified timbre. To support this task, we constructed a large-scale bilingual conversational speech dataset comprising 9 million training samples, including a high-quality subset of 1 million samples. We further constructed a source-disjoint benchmark with 800 human-verified samples and established strong task-specific baselines. Additionally, we developed end-to-end autoregressive models with parameter sizes of 0.6B and 1.7B, generating emotion-labeled transcripts, editable speech style inferences, and speech tokens. Experimental results show that the proposed model achieves performance comparable to large-scale baseline systems with significantly fewer parameters. At the same time, the model performs well in terms of duration consistency and emotional consistency, and can generate appropriate emotional, stress, and rhythmic variations based on the conversational context. To facilitate future research, we will publicly release the data construction pipeline, dataset, trained models, and related resources. The demo page and additional resources are available at https://luckybian.github.io/COT-TTS

AI.tldr: 提出上下文感知、基于推理的 TTS 任务 COT-TTS，构建大规模双语对话语音数据集与基准，并开发 0.6B/1.7B 自回归模型，实现从对话上下文推断说话风格并合成语音。
AI.motivation: 现有 TTS 在表现力与可控性上进步显著，但说话风格通常依赖用户明确指定指令；自然对话中风格应从对话上下文自然推断。为此需要定义上下文感知、基于推理的 TTS 新任务。
AI.method: 给定历史对话音频、目标文本与参考语音，系统理解对话上下文、推断显式中间推理，并以指定音色合成目标语音。构建 900 万训练样本的双语对话语音数据集（含 100 万高质量子集）；构建源分离、800 条人工校验样本的基准与强基线；开发 0.6B 和 1.7B 端到端自回归模型，生成情感标注转写、可编辑语音风格推理与语音 token。
AI.result: 所提模型以显著更少参数达到与大规模基线系统相当的性能；在时长一致性与情感一致性方面表现良好，并能依据对话上下文生成合适的情感、重音与韵律变化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作定义了上下文推理驱动的 TTS 新任务并提供数据、基准与模型，验证了基于对话上下文推断说话风格的有效性；将公开数据构建流程、数据集、训练模型及相关资源。

title: Accurate Motion Estimation with Bézier Control Point for Efficient Frame Interpolation
comment: Accepted by IEEE TIP. Code: https://github.com/SHH-Han/ABC-Inter
summary: In frame interpolation tasks, motion ambiguity in the training set causes models to generate blurry intermediate frames. Moreover, the assumption of uniform motion between frames during inference further leads to inaccuracies in the generated intermediate frames. To tackle these challenges, we propose an Accurate motion estimation algorithm with Bézier Control point, ABC-Inter, for efficient frame Interpolation. Specifically, ABC-Inter designs an Accurate Flow estimation Module (AFM) by decoupling two-frame features and mapping to corresponding coordinates to better estimate the optical flow between the two frames. Furthermore, ABC-Inter eliminates motion ambiguity in the training set by introducing Bézier control points that are computed using the input frames and the intermediate ground-truth (gt) frames. This allows the model to estimate accurate optical flow between two frames during the training process, thereby solving the blurriness problem in the generated intermediate frames during inference. Benefiting from the more accurate flow estimation between two frames, we can introduce additional frames and directly use multiple flows to calculate Bézier control points for modeling non-uniform motion without retraining the model. Simultaneously, to realize the estimation of non-linear motion using only two frames, we also introduce a new Bézier control point estimation module which achieves better motion estimation between the two frames by performing fine-tuning on the model in the second stage. Experimental results demonstrate that our ABC-Inter achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmark datasets and exhibits excellent visual perception.

AI.tldr: 提出ABC-Inter，通过精确光流估计模块与Bézier控制点建模，解决帧插值中运动模糊与非均匀运动问题，在多个基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 训练集中的运动模糊导致模型生成模糊的中间帧；同时推理阶段假设帧间匀速运动，进一步造成中间帧生成不准确。因此需要更精确的运动估计并支持非均匀运动的建模。
AI.method: 核心为精确运动估计与Bézier控制点相结合的帧插值算法ABC-Inter。1）设计精确光流估计模块AFM，通过解耦两帧特征并映射到对应坐标，更准确地估计两帧间光流；2）引入由输入帧与中间真值帧计算的Bézier控制点，消除训练集中的运动模糊，使训练时能估计准确光流；3）借助更准确的两帧光流，引入额外帧并直接使用多条光流计算Bézier控制点，无需重训练即可建模非均匀运动；4）提出新的Bézier控制点估计模块，通过第二阶段微调实现仅用两帧进行非线性运动估计。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上取得SOTA性能，并展现出优秀的视觉感知效果。
AI.conclusion: ABC-Inter通过精确光流估计与Bézier控制点建模，有效缓解了训练集运动模糊与推理期匀速假设带来的问题，兼顾非均匀运动建模与仅用两帧的非线性运动估计，具有优异的插值精度与视觉效果。

title: SKstars at SHROOM: Visions Agreement-Guided Ensembling of Zero-Shot and LoRA-Adapted Vision--Language Models
comment: This paper has been accepted at the SHROOM-Visions 2026 Shared Task, co-located with EMNLP2026
summary: This paper describes the SKstars submission to SHROOM-Visions 2026, a shared task on fine-grained hallucination detection in large vision-language model outputs. The task requires systems to identify hallucinated character spans, assign hallucination categories, and provide confidence estimates for their predictions. Our approach combines zero-shot predictions from Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct with those of a LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct model. The outputs of the two models are integrated through a lightweight ensemble procedure, followed by span refinement and confidence adjustment. We evaluate the main system components on a small internal development subset and report the performance of the submitted system on the official English test set. SKstars achieved a Cor+Lbl score of 0.2902, ranking 15th among 29 teams, and obtained Cor and IoU scores of 0.3642 and 0.3151, respectively, ranking 18th on both metrics. The results show that combining a large zero-shot model with a smaller adapted model provides a practical framework for multilingual and fine-grained hallucination localization, while also highlighting the difficulty of transferring development-set improvements to hidden test data. Code and predictions: https://github.com/aliathar1401/SK-Stars-shroom-visions-2026

AI.tldr: SKstars 团队参加 SHROOM-Visions 2026 细粒度幻觉检测任务的系统方案：融合大模型零样本预测与小模型 LoRA 微调预测，经集成、片段细化与置信度调整后提交，官方英文测试集上 Cor+Lbl 得分 0.2902（29 队中第 15）。
AI.motivation: 任务要求系统在大型视觉-语言模型输出中定位幻觉字符片段、赋予幻觉类别并给出置信度估计，属于细粒度且多语言的幻觉检测问题，需要兼顾定位精度与类别判定。
AI.method: 将 Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct 的零样本预测与经 LoRA 适配的 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 预测相结合；通过轻量级集成流程整合两模型输出，随后进行片段细化（span refinement）与置信度调整。在小型内部开发子集上评估各主要组件。
AI.result: 在官方英文测试集上，Cor+Lbl 得分为 0.2902，在 29 支队伍中排名第 15；Cor 得分为 0.3642，IoU 得分为 0.3151，两项指标均排名第 18。开发集上的改进难以迁移至隐藏测试数据。
AI.conclusion: 将大型零样本模型与较小的适配模型相结合，为多语言、细粒度幻觉定位提供了一个实用框架；但开发集性能提升向隐藏测试集的泛化仍存在困难。代码与预测已开源。

title: LLaDA-PRM: A Bidirectional Step-Level Reasoning Evaluator
summary: Step-level reasoning evaluators are commonly based on autoregressive language models, whose causal attention restricts each step representation to the problem, previous steps, and the current step. Yet, when the complete solution is available, the validity of an earlier step may become clearer only through its downstream consequences. We validate this hypothesis through a controlled 54-run comparison of causal and bidirectional LLaDA evaluators at 1B--3B scale, changing only the self-attention mask, and find bidirectional attention yields consistent improvements. Building on this finding, we introduce \prm{}, an 8B bidirectional evaluator that reaches 88.8 step-level F1 on MR-MATH-invalid and 83.8 on the out-of-distribution MR-GSM8K original-question subset, outperforming ReasonEval-Llemma-34B by 11.3 and 10.3 F1 points, respectively. \prm{} also remains effective when evaluating incomplete reasoning traces in online settings, outperforming the strongest baselines on both benchmarks by a large margin. We further show that \prm{} provides an effective training-data selection signal, improving Mistral-7B performance on MATH-500.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出双向注意力步骤级评估器 \prm{}，验证双向注意力优于因果注意力，并在多个基准上大幅超越现有强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有步骤级推理评估器多基于自回归语言模型，其因果注意力使每一步表示仅能利用问题、先前步骤和当前步骤，无法借助后续步骤的后果来判断早期步骤的有效性。作者假设当完整解答可得时，下游后果能帮助更清晰地判断早期步骤的有效性。
AI.method: 作者通过54次受控实验，在1B--3B规模上比较因果与双向 LLaDA 评估器，仅改变自注意力掩码。基于该发现，提出 8B 双向评估器 \prm{}。
AI.result: \prm{} 在 MR-MATH-invalid 上达到88.8的步骤级 F1，在分布外 MR-GSM8K 原始问题子集上达到83.8，分别比 ReasonEval-Llemma-34B 高出11.3和10.3个 F1 点；在在线设置下评估不完整推理轨迹时也大幅优于最强基线；并可作为有效的训练数据选择信号，提升 Mistral-7B 在 MATH-500 上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 双向注意力能一致地提升步骤级评估性能，\prm{} 在离线与在线评估及训练数据选择中均表现优异，验证了利用下游后果判断早期步骤有效性的假设。

title: Retrieval Geometry Shapes Cache-Based Clip Adaptation
summary: Cache-based test-time adaptation improves CLIP predictions by storing and retrieving examples from the target stream while keeping the model frozen. However, existing methods largely treat the feature space used for image-image retrieval as fixed, leaving open how much adaptation depends on the retrieval space itself. We study this question by fixing the memory and changing only the retrieval encoder, finding that the same memory can yield very different gains: across sixteen retrieval spaces, ImageNet-A cache gain ranges from at most +0.44 points for CLIP and MAE to +19.7 +/- 0.4 for DINOv2-L, while label-free retrieval-space selection retains 98% of oracle gain on ImageNet-V2. These results show that memory quality depends not only on which examples are stored, but also on how they are retrieved. Motivated by this finding, we propose MARC (Memory Augmented Retrieval for CLIP), a training-free system that uses frozen CLIP for prediction and DINOv2-B for retrieval with a single fusion weight. A single-view cache repairs 1074 +/- 21 baseline errors, compared with 878 +/- 4 for a 64-view ensemble, at roughly one seventh of the cost. Across four ImageNet distribution shifts, MARC reaches a 67.91% OOD average and, at matched DINOv2-B scale and eight views, achieves 64.17 +/- 0.31% versus 62.75 +/- 0.15% for a graph-based cache system while running 2.6 times faster. Overall, our results establish retrieval space as a first-order design choice for robust cache-based adaptation in remote sensing, scientific imaging, and changing visual environments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究缓存式测试时适应中检索空间的影响，提出免训练的MARC系统，用冻结CLIP预测、DINOv2-B检索，显著优于多视图集成和图缓存方法。
AI.motivation: 现有缓存式测试时适应方法多将图像-图像检索所用的特征空间视为固定，忽视了检索空间本身对适应增益的影响，作者希望探究检索编码器选择的重要性。
AI.method: 通过固定记忆库、仅更换检索编码器进行对照实验，考察十六种检索空间的缓存增益差异；并提出MARC（Memory Augmented Retrieval for CLIP），使用冻结CLIP做预测、DINOv2-B做检索，仅用单一融合权重，无需训练。
AI.result: ImageNet-A缓存增益随检索空间从CLIP和MAE的最多+0.44点，到DINOv2-L的+19.7±0.4；无标签检索空间选择在ImageNet-V2上保留98%的oracle增益。MARC单视图缓存修复1074±21个基线错误，64视图集成仅878±4，成本约为其七分之一。四种ImageNet分布偏移下MARC达67.91% OOD均值；在匹配DINOv2-B规模和八视图时达64.17±0.31%，优于图缓存系统的62.75±0.15%，且速度快2.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 检索空间是稳健缓存式适应的首要设计选择，对遥感、科学成像及视觉环境变化场景具有指导意义。

title: Recovering Lost Details: Multi-Scale Frequency Compensation for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
comment: 11 pages. Accepted at the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
summary: Long-term time series forecasting has made significant progress by leveraging multi-scale information to capture hierarchical temporal patterns and model long-range dependencies. However, temporal downsampling in existing multi-scale methods inevitably smooths detailed temporal fluctuations, and this information loss is further aggravated by their emphasis on dominant trends across scales, resulting in insufficiently expressive representations. To address this, we propose a Multi-Scale Wavelet Mixing (MWMixer) model, which incorporates a Bidirectional Frequency-Bands Mixing strategy to recover lost temporal details across scales, enabling complementary cross-scale information interactions. Then, a Dynamic Scale-Adaptive Fusion module learns time-varying weights for each scale to fuse multi-scale forecasts into the final prediction, enhancing the flexibility of multi-scale aggregation. In addition, a cross-scale consistency loss aligns each coarse-scale prediction with the interval-averaged fine-scale outputs, while a multi-scale supervision loss enforces prediction accuracy at each scale, promoting consistent learning across scales. Extensive experiments on seven real-world datasets demonstrate that MWMixer achieves competitive performance in long-term forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出MWMixer模型，通过双向频带混合、动态尺度自适应融合及跨尺度一致性/多尺度监督损失，缓解多尺度时序下采样导致的信息损失，在七个真实数据集上取得有竞争力的长期预测性能。
AI.motivation: 长期时间序列预测已借助多尺度信息捕获层次化时序模式与长程依赖。但现有多尺度方法中的时序下采样会平滑细节波动，加之各尺度偏重主导趋势，进一步加剧信息损失，导致表示表达能力不足。
AI.method: MWMixer包含：1）双向频带混合（Bidirectional Frequency-Bands Mixing）策略，跨尺度恢复丢失的时序细节，实现互补的跨尺度信息交互；2）动态尺度自适应融合模块，学习各尺度随时间变化的权重，将多尺度预测融合为最终结果，提升聚合灵活性；3）跨尺度一致性损失，将粗尺度预测与细尺度输出的区间均值对齐；4）多尺度监督损失，约束各尺度预测精度，促进跨尺度一致学习。
AI.result: 在七个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，MWMixer在长期预测任务中取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过频带混合恢复细节、动态加权融合多尺度预测并配合跨尺度一致性与多尺度监督损失，可有效缓解多尺度下采样的信息损失，提升长期时间序列预测的表示能力与准确性。

title: Analyzing Public Discourse on Urbanism: Topic Clustering, Sentiment Analysis and Retrieval-Augmented Generation using YouTube Comments
summary: Online discourse about urban issues - walkability, cycling infrastructure, public transit, housing density, and street safety - is voluminous but unstructured, and existing city-evaluation tools capture none of it. We present a pipeline and conversational system that combines geographic entity resolution, topic modeling, sentiment analysis, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over 22,788 chunks of YouTube transcripts and comments spanning 309 North American cities. Beyond the system itself, our contribution is a set of measurements about what happens when standard NLP components meet short, informal, geographically ambiguous text. A Twitter-tuned RoBERTa classifier outperforms a VADER lexicon baseline by 12.6 macro-F1 points (0.589 vs. 0.464; McNemar p = 0.0001), but both models collapse on the neutral class, which dominates urbanist comment traffic; annotators disagree on the same class (Cohen's kappa = 0.53). Dense retrieval beats a TF-IDF baseline at every cutoff (P@5 0.790 vs. 0.560), and video-level relevance proxies understate chunk-level precision by a wide margin (0.660 vs. 0.94 under human rating). For groundedness evaluation, we find BERTScore unusable when a multi-sentence generated summary is compared against a single short comment - scores are nearly flat regardless of relevance - and show that ROUGE-1-based groundedness is a paraphrase-driven lower bound rather than a hallucination rate. These findings generalize beyond the urbanist domain to any RAG system built over short user-generated documents.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个面向北美城市议题在线讨论的RAG对话系统，并系统测量了标准NLP组件在短文本、非正式、地理歧义场景下的失效模式。
AI.motivation: 城市议题（步行性、自行车基础设施、公共交通、住房密度、街道安全）的在线讨论量巨大但结构松散，现有城市评价工具完全未能捕捉这类数据，因此需要一套可挖掘并对话式检索该类语料的系统。
AI.method: 构建融合地理实体解析、主题建模、情感分析与RAG的流水线及对话系统，语料为309个北美城市、22,788个YouTube转写与评论文本块；对比Twitter微调RoBERTa与VADER词典基线，比较稠密检索与TF-IDF，并评估BERTScore与基于ROUGE-1的groundedness指标。
AI.result: RoBERTa较VADER高出12.6个宏F1（0.589 vs 0.464，McNemar p=0.0001），但两者在中性类上均崩溃（该类别主导城市议题评论，标注者一致性Cohen's kappa=0.53）；稠密检索在各截断点均优于TF-IDF（P@5 0.790 vs 0.560）；视频级相关性代理严重低估块级精度（0.660 vs 人工评分的0.94）；BERTScore在多句摘要与单条短评论对比时几乎无区分度，ROUGE-1 groundedness仅为复述驱动的下界而非幻觉率。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现不仅适用于城市议题领域，也推广到任何基于短篇用户生成文档构建的RAG系统。

title: Semi-automated reconstruction of indoor geometry from 360-degree video for CFD-based airflow analysis in classrooms
summary: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) is widely used to evaluate ventilation and contaminant transport in occupied buildings, but deployment at scale is limited by three bottlenecks: acquiring room geometry without costly scanning hardware or manual CAD modeling, decomposing the scene into individually manipulable objects, and reconfiguring those objects for alternative layouts without re-capturing the room. We present a semi-automated workflow that converts a single 360-degree video of a room into individually editable, simulation-ready geometry assets. A dense point cloud is reconstructed using Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), and 2D instance masks from text-prompted SAM 3 segmentation are lifted to 3D using multi-view consensus and depth-band filtering. Points are separated into object instances with an octree, and occlusion gaps are healed with a connectivity graph. Chair templates are fitted by Iterative Closest Point (ICP) alignment, and table geometry is generated procedurally. A browser-based editor supports quality assurance and rapid construction of alternative layout configurations. A steady Reynolds-averaged OpenFOAM solution then drives transient passive-scalar transport; the setup is verified using a mesh-sensitivity study and validated against an IEA Annex 20 benchmark. We apply the workflow to two university classrooms and a tiered lecture-hall auditorium. The capture-to-geometry pass takes two to five hours per room on a consumer workstation. In a controlled obstruction sequence in one classroom, the modeled half-clearance time varies non-monotonically as furniture is added, and a cross-room comparison indicates that clearance behavior cannot be reliably extrapolated between rooms, motivating per-room geometry acquisition. By making that acquisition low-cost, the workflow makes geometry-resolved comparative ventilation studies practical for spaces such as classrooms.

AI.tldr: 提出半自动化工作流，将单段360°视频转为可编辑、可仿真的室内几何资产，实现低成本几何分辨的通风比较研究。
AI.motivation: CFD广泛用于评估有人居住建筑的通风与污染物输运，但规模化部署受三个瓶颈限制：获取房间几何需昂贵扫描硬件或手工CAD建模；难以将场景分解为可独立操作的物体；替代布局重配置需重新采集房间。
AI.method: 用NeRF重建稠密点云，将文本提示SAM 3分割得到的2D实例掩码经多视角一致性与深度带滤波提升到3D；用八叉树分离物体实例，连通图修复遮挡空洞；ICP拟合椅子模板，程序化生成桌子几何；浏览器编辑器支持质量保证与替代布局快速构建；稳态RANS OpenFOAM求解驱动瞬态被动标量输运，网格敏感性研究验证、IEA Annex 20基准校验。
AI.result: 应用于两间大学教室与一个阶梯报告厅；每房间采集到几何流程在消费级工作站耗时2–5小时；一间教室受控障碍序列中，模拟半清除时间随家具增加呈非单调变化；跨房间比较表明清除行为无法在房间间可靠外推。
AI.conclusion: 房间特异性的清除行为需逐房间几何采集；该工作流通过降低采集成本，使课堂等空间的几何分辨比较通风研究变得可行。

title: Taming CoT Obfuscation in VLMs: From Mechanistic Evidence to Activation Enforcement
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) but can induce chain-of-thought (CoT) obfuscation: an operational, non-intentional outcome where task reward or accuracy rises while traces become less grounded and monitorable. Prior work largely documents this decay behaviorally, leaving its representation-level correlates and actionable controls unclear. We find that template- and ground-associated activations become less separable during RL; matched interventions support the contribution of selected features to monitorability degradation. Guided by this evidence, we propose Targeted Anti-obfuscation with Mechanistic Enforcement (TAME), which uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to combine behavioral feedback with targeted suppression of template-associated activations during RL. Its asymmetric constraint penalizes template activations only above their pre-RL baseline, anchoring the localized features while behavioral feedback promotes grounded refinements. Across VIRL-39k, SPA-VL, and two model families, TAME improves CoT monitorability by up to 30.9 and 16.7 percentage points over Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), respectively. Blinded human evaluation finds higher human monitorability on both datasets, and two held-out monitor families reproduce the monitorability gains. Task accuracy changes are small and mixed, and general-capability benchmarks show task-specific trade-offs. These results provide a path from behavioral monitoring to representation-level oversight for more auditable RL-trained multimodal systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现强化学习（RL）会引发视觉语言模型（VLM）的思维链（CoT）混淆现象，并提出基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的TAME方法抑制模板相关激活，从而显著提升CoT的可监控性。
AI.motivation: RL能提升VLM推理能力，但会导致CoT混淆：任务奖励或准确率上升，而推理轨迹的可监控性与接地性下降。已有工作多停留于行为层面的现象记录，缺乏对表征层面关联机制及可操作控制手段的探究。
AI.method: 作者首先分析发现，RL训练过程中模板相关激活与接地相关激活的可分离性降低，并通过匹配干预验证所选特征对可监控性退化的贡献。据此提出TAME（Targeted Anti-obfuscation with Mechanistic Enforcement），利用SAE将行为反馈与对模板相关激活的定向抑制相结合；其非对称约束仅在模板激活高于RL前基线时施加惩罚，从而锚定局部特征，同时由行为反馈促进接地性细化。
AI.result: 在VIRL-39k、SPA-VL及两个模型家族上，TAME相较GRPO分别将CoT可监控性提升最多30.9和16.7个百分点。盲法人工评估在两个数据集上均显示更高的人类可监控性，两个留出监控器家族也复现了可监控性增益。任务准确率变化较小且方向不一，通用能力基准显示存在任务特定权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一条从行为监控走向表征层面监督的路径，有助于构建更可审计的RL训练多模态系统。

title: Clinical Domain Classification from Medical Transcriptions
summary: Clinical domain classification plays an important role in organizing and analyzing large volumes of unstructured medical text. However, medical transcription datasets are often highly imbalanced, which can substantially degrade classification performance, particularly for underrepresented clinical specialties. In this work, we present a comparative study of machine learning and transformer-based approaches for clinical domain classification from medical transcriptions. We evaluate six traditional machine learning classifiers---Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and XGBoost---along with two pretrained transformer models, BERT and XLNet, and a few-shot large language model prompting approach. Experiments are conducted on medical transcription data collected from MTSamples, comprising 5,013 samples across 40 clinical specialties. To address severe class imbalance, we investigate two balancing strategies: text augmentation using NLP-based synonym replacement and Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE). Experimental results demonstrate that data balancing substantially improves classification performance across the evaluated models. In particular, BERT achieves the highest F1-score of 0.996 on the SMOTE-balanced dataset while requiring lower training time than XLNet. The results highlight the effectiveness of transformer-based representations combined with appropriate data balancing strategies for clinical domain classification and provide a systematic comparison of classical machine learning, transformer models, and few-shot prompting for medical transcription analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了传统机器学习、Transformer模型及少样本提示方法在医学转录文本临床专科分类中的表现，并评估了文本增强与SMOTE两种数据平衡策略。结果表明数据平衡显著提升性能，BERT在SMOTE平衡数据集上取得最高F1值0.996。
AI.motivation: 临床专科分类对组织和分析海量非结构化医学文本具有重要意义，但医学转录数据集常存在严重类别不平衡问题，会显著降低分类性能，尤其对样本不足的临床专科影响更大。
AI.method: 在MTSamples医学转录数据集（5,013个样本、40个临床专科）上，评估六种传统机器学习分类器（朴素贝叶斯、SVM、决策树、随机森林、KNN、XGBoost）、两种预训练Transformer模型（BERT、XLNet）以及少样本大语言模型提示方法；并采用基于NLP同义词替换的文本增强与SMOTE两种平衡策略缓解类别不平衡。
AI.result: 数据平衡显著提升了所有评估模型的分类性能；其中BERT在SMOTE平衡数据集上取得最高F1值0.996，且训练时间低于XLNet。
AI.conclusion: Transformer表示结合适当的数据平衡策略对临床专科分类效果显著，本文为医学转录分析提供了传统机器学习、Transformer模型与少样本提示的系统性对比。

title: RSPDBench: Benchmarking Vision Foundation Models on Earth Observation Tasks Under Physically Grounded Remote-Sensing Product Degradations
summary: Vision foundation models targeting Earth observation (EO) tasks are commonly evaluated on clean downstream benchmarks, but operational EO products can already contain spatial, radiometric, alignment, noise, and harmonization defects before reaching the model. Existing robustness evaluations often use generic image corruptions or broad domain shifts, which do not isolate these product-level failure modes. We introduce \textbf{RSPDBench}, a physically grounded \textbf{r}emote-\textbf{s}ensing-\textbf{p}roduct \textbf{d}egradation \textbf{b}enchmark for vision foundation models. RSPDBench evaluates five EO datasets, seven foundation-model entries, and two supervised baselines under audited primitive degradations and compound product chains. Each model is evaluated under its clean-selected native protocol, with robustness measured as the drop from its own clean baseline. Our analysis reveals that degradation sensitivity is strongly structured: resolution-conditioned and channel-grouped encoders protect different failure axes, and the same physical defect can hurt one model while helping another. Compound chains expose failures that isolated degradations do not predict, with model-dependent amplification, saturation, or component dominance, and excess drops up to $38$ percentage points beyond the strongest component. These results show that EO robustness cannot be characterized by clean accuracy or generic perturbation tests alone; it must also be measured against the structured defects that remote-sensing products carry into deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RSPDBench，一个面向遥感产品级退化的视觉基础模型鲁棒性基准，用物理可信的基本退化与复合退化链评估EO模型。
AI.motivation: 现有EO视觉基础模型多只在干净下游基准上评测，但实际运行中的遥感产品在进入模型前已包含空间、辐射、配准、噪声、协调化等缺陷。既有鲁棒性评测依赖通用图像损坏或宽泛域偏移，无法隔离这些产品级失效模式。
AI.method: 构建RSPDBench：覆盖5个EO数据集、7个基础模型条目与2个监督基线；在经审计的基本退化与复合产品退化链下评测；每个模型按其干净数据选定的原生协议运行，鲁棒性以其相对自身干净基线的性能下降来度量。
AI.result: 退化敏感性呈强结构性：分辨率条件化编码器与通道分组编码器保护不同失效轴；同一物理缺陷可能损害某模型却增益另一模型。复合退化链暴露出孤立退化无法预测的失效，表现为模型相关的放大、饱和或成分主导，额外下降幅度最高可达38个百分点。
AI.conclusion: EO鲁棒性不能仅靠干净准确率或通用扰动测试刻画，还必须针对遥感产品带入部署的结构化缺陷进行测量。

title: Unsupervised Brain Anomaly Detection as a Bayesian Inverse Problem with Diffusion Prior
summary: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) aims to localize abnormal regions in medical scans without pixel-level annotations. A typical strategy seeks to reconstruct a pseudo-healthy image that preserves subject-specific anatomy. Recently, diffusion models have been proposed to perform UAD. However, these methods rely on heuristic noise schedules or synthetic corruptions to balance subject-specificity and anomaly removal. In this work, we propose an alternative formulation of UAD as a Bayesian inverse problem under a diffusion prior. First, we introduce a latent spatial anomaly mask that models pixel-wise consistency between a test image and its latent corresponding pseudo-healthy image. Then, we propose an approximation of the unknown generation process that links healthy anatomy, anomalies, and the observed image, enabling a well-defined likelihood within the Bayesian framework. Building on recent advances in diffusion-based inverse problem methods, we jointly infer the pseudo-healthy image and the anomaly mask via annealed posterior sampling. We evaluate our approach on FDG PET (ADNI) and FLAIR MRI (BraTS 2021), demonstrating improved anomaly localization performance compared to other diffusion-based approaches and validating the contribution of our introduced model. Our code is available at https://github.com/HuguesRoy/UAD_DAPS.

AI.tldr: 提出将无监督医学异常检测(UAD)建模为扩散先验下的贝叶斯逆问题，通过退火后验采样联合推断伪健康图像与潜在异常掩码。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的UAD方法依赖启发式噪声调度或合成腐蚀来平衡受试者特异性保持与异常去除，缺乏原则性框架。作者希望以贝叶斯逆问题的严格形式替代这些启发式设计。
AI.method: 引入潜在空间异常掩码，建模测试图像与其潜在对应伪健康图像的逐像素一致性；提出对未知生成过程的近似，将健康解剖、异常与观测图像联系起来，从而在贝叶斯框架内定义明确的似然；借助扩散逆问题方法，通过退火后验采样联合推断伪健康图像和异常掩码。
AI.result: 在FDG PET (ADNI) 与 FLAIR MRI (BraTS 2021) 上评估，异常定位性能优于其他基于扩散的方法，并验证了所提出模型各组成部分的贡献。
AI.conclusion: UAD可作为扩散先验下的贝叶斯逆问题来求解，退火后验采样能有效联合估计伪健康图像与异常掩码，为医学无监督异常检测提供了原则性且有效的替代方案。

title: Beyond Final-Token Classification: Heterogeneous Readouts for Evidence-Grounded Suicide Risk Detection
comment: Competition paper for the IEEE Big Data Cup 2026. Ranked 2nd among 31 participating teams and invited for submission to IEEE Big Data 2026
summary: The IEEE BigData Cup benchmark combines three prediction problems with different output structures: ordinal suicide-risk classification, multi-label psychosocial factor detection, and extraction of supporting phrases. We introduce heterogeneous readout decomposition (HRD), which separates semantic verification from output realization. A locally deployed Qwen3.8-27B model, adapted with task-specific QLoRA adapters, produces both answer-token margins and layer-63 answer states for card-conditioned queries. HRD compares four latent scores for ordinal risk, retains token margins for most factors while routing seven labels through one shared latent probe, and constructs evidence sets from verbatim span candidates with calibrated, risk-conditional constraints. On two held-out user-grouped confirmation folds, the latent risk readout improves weighted F1 from 0.8237 to 0.8372 and macro F1 from 0.7965 to 0.8185. Selective factor routing improves macro F1 by 0.0105 and tail-label macro F1 by 0.0189; in contrast, global latent replacement and independent label-specific probes fail. The constrained evidence decoder raises pooled phrase F1 from 0.7488 to 0.7609 in row-level out-of-fold evaluation. Lenormand's best public result is 0.8052 on Subtask 1 and 0.6636 on Subtask 2, giving a composite score of 0.7627. These results identify the answer-token boundary, rather than semantic representation alone, as a measurable source of error in this benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出异构读出分解（HRD），将语义验证与输出实现分离，在IEEE BigData Cup基准的三个预测子任务上（序数自杀风险分类、多标签心理社会因素检测、支持性短语抽取）均取得性能提升。
AI.motivation: 基准包含三个输出结构不同的预测任务，单一统一读出方式难以兼顾语义验证与各任务特有的输出形式；作者希望识别并分离误差来源，尤其是答案标记边界带来的误差。
AI.method: 采用本地部署的Qwen3.8-27B，配任务专用QLoRA适配器，对卡片条件查询生成答案标记边际与第63层答案状态。HRD对序数风险比较四个潜分数；多数因素保留标记边际，其中七个标签经共享潜探针路由；用逐字片段候选并施加校准的、风险条件约束构建证据集。
AI.result: 在两个保留的用户分组确认折上，潜风险读出将加权F1从0.8237提升至0.8372，宏F1从0.7965提升至0.8185；选择性因素路由使宏F1提升0.0105，尾标签宏F1提升0.0189；全局潜替换与独立标签专用探针均失败。约束证据解码器在行级折外评估中将短语F1从0.7488提升至0.7609。Lenormand公开最佳结果为子任务1的0.8052与子任务2的0.6636，综合分0.7627。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明答案标记边界而非仅语义表示本身是该基准中一个可测量的误差来源；HRD通过针对性分解读出结构，在风险分类、因素检测与证据抽取上均优于基线。

title: HOIBlender: Blending Lightweight Detection with Vision-Language Priors for Efficient Human-Object Interaction Detection
summary: Human-object interaction (HOI) detection requires grounding an interacting human-object pair and recognizing the verb that links them, often under severe long-tail supervision. Recent methods improve accuracy with stronger detectors and vision-language priors, but many still stack heavy transformer encoders, intricate denoising schedules, or post-hoc semantic calibration on top of the detector. We present \textbf{HOIBlender}, an efficient HOI detector named after its core design principle: blending detector-grounded visual tokens, spatial subject-object reasoning, and BLIP-2 semantic priors inside one lightweight decoding pipeline. HOIBlender builds on an RF-DETR/LW-DETR-style foundation with a DINOv2 backbone and selects top-$K$ image-conditioned tokens directly from the multi-scale projector as subject and object candidates, removing the dedicated encoder stage retained by prior HOI methods. A dual-stage decoder first stabilizes human-object geometry and then performs verb and HOI classification through progressive BLIP-2 prior fusion, with classifier weights initialized from BLIP-2 text embeddings for long-tail categories. Grouped-query training further enriches optimization without increasing inference cost. Across three model scales (Nano, Small, 2XL), HOIBlender consistently outperforms SOV-STG-VLA and Hybrid-SOV-VLA on HICO-DET, reaching $44.49$ Default Full mAP in only $9$ training epochs while maintaining competitive latency and parameter budgets. These results show that lightweight detection, structured spatial-semantic decoding, and deeply integrated vision-language priors can be blended into a single efficient HOI pipeline.

AI.tldr: 提出HOIBlender，一种高效HOI检测器，将检测器视觉token、主客体空间推理与BLIP-2语义先验融合进单一轻量解码流程，在HICO-DET上以9个epoch达到44.49 mAP（Default Full），优于SOV-STG-VLA与Hybrid-SOV-VLA。
AI.motivation: HOI检测需在严重长尾监督下定位交互的主客体对并识别连接动词。现有方法虽借助更强检测器与视觉语言先验提升精度，但往往堆叠重型Transformer编码器、复杂去噪调度或检测器之上的后处理语义校准，导致结构冗余、效率受限。本文旨在探索将轻量检测、结构化空间语义解码与深度集成视觉语言先验融合为单一高效流程。
AI.method: HOIBlender基于RF-DETR/LW-DETR风格框架与DINOv2骨干，直接从多尺度投影器选取top-K图像条件token作为主客体候选，省去先前HOI方法保留的专用编码器阶段；采用双阶段解码器，先稳定人物-物体几何关系，再通过渐进式BLIP-2先验融合完成动词与HOI分类；分类器权重由BLIP-2文本嵌入初始化以应对长尾类别；分组查询训练在不增加推理成本的前提下丰富优化。
AI.result: 在Nano、Small、2XL三种模型规模下，HOIBlender在HICO-DET上一致优于SOV-STG-VLA与Hybrid-SOV-VLA，仅用9个训练epoch即达到44.49 Default Full mAP，同时保持有竞争力的延迟与参数量。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明轻量检测、结构化空间语义解码与深度集成的视觉语言先验可融合为单一高效HOI流程，在精度、训练效率与推理成本间取得良好平衡。

title: How Many Pixels Is a Digit Worth? Place-Aware Coordinate Entropy for GUI Agent Confidence Estimation
summary: GUI agents predict click coordinates as digit-token sequences, but standard text-LLM confidence estimation methods rank correct clicks from wrong ones only weakly. GUI-specific alternatives use K samples or new supervision, but still leave room for improvement. We trace part of this to place-value asymmetry: bounding-box correctness often makes higher-place digits more important than lower-place digits, so uniform aggregation weakens the signal that determines correctness. The fix is to weight each digit's Shannon entropy by its place value. We call this Place-Aware Coordinate Entropy (PACE). Across fixed-scale agents on ScreenSpot-Pro and ScreenSpot-v2, PACE wins both AUROC and selective accuracy on all primary comparisons in a single forward pass, matching or outperforming K-sample baselines at a fraction of the cost. PACE provides a per-click confidence estimate that turns coordinate-token internals into a practical confidence signal for GUI agent deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PACE（Place-Aware Coordinate Entropy），通过按位值加权坐标各位数字的Shannon熵，为GUI agent的点击坐标提供单次前向传播的置信度估计，在ScreenSpot-Pro和ScreenSpot-v2上优于K采样基线。
AI.motivation: GUI agent以数字token序列形式预测点击坐标，但标准文本LLM的置信度估计方法难以有效区分正确与错误点击；GUI专用替代方案需K次采样或额外监督，仍有改进空间。作者将部分问题归因于位值不对称：边界框正确性通常使高位数字比低位数字更重要，而均匀聚合削弱了决定正确性的信号。
AI.method: 提出Place-Aware Coordinate Entropy（PACE），对每个数字的Shannon熵按其位值进行加权，从而在单次前向传播中生成逐点击的置信度估计。
AI.result: 在ScreenSpot-Pro和ScreenSpot-v2上，对固定规模agent，PACE在所有主要比较中均赢得AUROC和选择性准确率（selective accuracy），且以更低成本匹配或超越K采样基线。
AI.conclusion: PACE将坐标token内部信息转化为实用的逐点击置信度信号，为GUI agent部署提供了高效可靠的置信度估计方案。

title: NLPCC 2026 Task 10: Citation-Level Faithfulness Verification with DeBERTa Ensembles and Class-Wise Calibration
comment: Accepted to the NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 10 system paper track. Ranked 2nd in Track 2 on the final leaderboard
summary: This paper presents our system for Track 2 of the NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 10 on citation-level faithfulness in AI-assisted scientific reporting. Given an atomic scientific claim and the structured full text of its cited paper, the task requires both a four-way relation label and up to three evidence paragraph identifiers.
