The label head ensembles a paragraph-aware cross-encoder with a document-level DeBERTa-large classifier, followed by class-wise decision calibration. Probability-level fusion is motivated by an out-of-fold tendency to over-predict Topical Match. The evidence head combines paragraph scores from top-20 and top-30 joint models with BM25 scores. The system runs fully offline without external retrieval or LLM prompting. On the final leaderboard, our system achieved 82.9898 overall (89.5491 Macro-F1 and 76.4305 Joint@3), ranking second in Track 2. Ablations and error analysis show that model complementarity and calibration drive the label gains. Gold-evidence inference changes label Macro-F1 negligibly, whereas evidence ranking remains important for Joint@3.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NLPCC 2026共享任务Track 2（AI辅助科学报告中的引文级忠实性）的系统：融合段落级交叉编码器与文档级DeBERTa-large分类器进行四分类关系判别并做类别校准，证据段落检索融合联合模型段落分数与BM25分数，全程离线、不依赖外部检索或LLM提示，最终榜单得分82.9898，排名第二。
AI.motivation: 任务要求在给定原子科学论断及其被引论文结构化全文的条件下，同时输出四类关系标签与至多三个证据段落标识。其中存在若干难点：关系判别需要在段落与文档两种粒度上建模，且模型存在对Topical Match类别过度预测的倾向；证据定位需要兼顾语义匹配与词项匹配；系统还需满足离线约束，不能借助外部检索或LLM提示。
AI.method: 标签头采用段落感知交叉编码器与文档级DeBERTa-large分类器的集成，随后进行类别级决策校准；概率级融合的动机来自折外验证中观察到的Topical Match过度预测倾向。证据头将top-20与top-30联合模型的段落分数与BM25分数相结合。整个系统完全离线运行，不使用外部检索或LLM提示。
AI.result: 最终榜单上系统总体得分为82.9898（Macro-F1为89.5491，Joint@3为76.4305），在Track 2中排名第二。消融与错误分析表明模型互补性与校准是标签性能提升的主要来源；使用金标准证据推理对标签Macro-F1影响可忽略，而证据排序对Joint@3仍然重要。
AI.conclusion: 多粒度模型集成与类别级概率校准能够有效提升引文级忠实性判别的标签性能，证据排序质量则主要影响联合指标Joint@3；系统在完全离线条件下取得较好效果，验证了在不引入外部检索与LLM提示时的可行性。

title: GAPS: Generative Active Pseudo-view Selection for Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Novel view synthesis from sparse observations is severely under-constrained. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time rendering, it produces floaters, broken geometry, and washed-out backgrounds when trained with few views. We propose an alternating optimization framework that uses a pre-trained image diffusion model to generate geometrically consistent pseudo-views for additional 3DGS supervision. Generation is constrained by depth-conditioned ControlNet, IP-Adapter style transfer, LoRA scene adaptation, and img2img structural anchoring. We introduce Generative Active Pseudo-view Selection (GAPS) to balance reconstruction informativeness and generative reliability when choosing target views. Its annealing schedule shifts from conservative interpolation early in training to exploratory extrapolation later, gradually covering unobserved regions. A dual-criterion admission gate and uncertainty-weighted losses reject unreliable generations, while density-adaptive DropGaussian reduces overfitting in complex scenes. On LLFF with 3/6/9 views, our method improves average PSNR over vanilla 3DGS by 0.40/0.89/0.70 dB. On Mip-NeRF 360 with 12/24 views, the gains are 1.18/0.80 dB. SSIM improves and LPIPS decreases in every setting. Ablations show that active selection and density-adaptive regularization are both necessary; only the full method reduces LPIPS below the no-pseudo-view baseline on unbounded 360-degree scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出交替优化框架，用预训练扩散模型生成几何一致的伪视角来监督稀疏视角3DGS，并设计主动伪视角选择与密度自适应正则，显著提升新视角合成质量。
AI.motivation: 稀疏观测下的新视角合成严重欠约束。3DGS虽支持实时渲染，但在少视角训练时会产生漂浮物、几何破碎和背景泛白等问题，需要额外监督信号来缓解。
AI.method: 采用交替优化框架，用预训练图像扩散模型生成几何一致的伪视角，并通过深度条件ControlNet、IP-Adapter风格迁移、LoRA场景适配与img2img结构锚定进行约束。提出生成式主动伪视角选择（GAPS），用退火调度从训练早期的保守插值过渡到晚期的探索性外推；配合双准则准入门与不确定性加权损失过滤不可靠生成，并用密度自适应DropGaussian抑制复杂场景过拟合。
AI.result: LLFF在3/6/9视角下平均PSNR较原始3DGS提升0.40/0.89/0.70 dB；Mip-NeRF 360在12/24视角下提升1.18/0.80 dB。所有设置中SSIM提升、LPIPS下降。消融实验表明主动选择与密度自适应正则均为必需，且仅完整方法能在无界360度场景将LPIPS降至无伪视角基线以下。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型生成的伪视角监督可有效缓解稀疏视角3DGS的欠约束问题，主动选择与自适应正则的组合是性能提升的关键。

title: When and How Should an Agent Clarify? CIGAsk: Teaching LLMs to Clarify via Counterfactual Information Gain
summary: Instruction-tuned LLMs faced with underspecified queries often commit to a single interpretation rather than ask for clarification, producing confidently wrong answers. In our experiments, prompting alone is insufficient: models either ask for clarification on every query or ask vague questions that fail to recover the missing information. Addressing this failure requires learning two coupled skills: when to ask rather than answer and how to ask a question that recovers the disambiguating information. Existing recipes either address only one of these skills or require a separately trained critic. We propose CIGAsk, an RL recipe that teaches both skills through two complementary reward signals within a multi-turn GRPO loop. Counterfactual Information Gain (CIG) compares the gold-answer log-likelihood under a frozen reference model with and without the user response, providing per-turn credit that guides how to ask. The Asymmetric Ambiguity Bonus assigns a signed reward at the terminal token based on the gold ambiguity label, guiding when to ask. Across three clarification benchmarks spanning table, passage, and open-domain QA, CIGAsk-7B outperforms the strongest external baseline despite using a smaller backbone. It also transfers across datasets without per-dataset tuning while preserving single-turn QA performance on out-of-distribution benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出CIGAsk，一种基于多轮GRPO的强化学习方法，通过两个互补奖励信号同时教会模型"何时提问"和"如何提问"，在三个澄清基准上超越更强基线并保持单轮QA性能。
AI.motivation: 指令微调的LLM面对信息不充分的查询时倾向于直接给出单一解释而非请求澄清，产生自信但错误的答案。仅靠提示无法解决：模型要么对每个查询都请求澄清，要么提出无法恢复缺失信息的模糊问题。要解决该问题需学习两种耦合技能：何时提问（而非作答）以及如何提问以恢复消歧信息。现有方法要么只解决其中一项技能，要么需要单独训练的评判器。
AI.method: CIGAsk是一个在多轮GRPO循环中通过两种互补奖励信号同时教授上述两种技能的RL方法。（1）反事实信息增益（CIG）：用冻结的参考模型比较在有/无用户回复情况下金标准答案的对数似然，为每一轮提供信用分配，指导"如何提问"。（2）非对称模糊性奖励（Asymmetric Ambiguity Bonus）：在终止token处根据金标准模糊性标签赋予带符号奖励，指导"何时提问"。
AI.result: 在覆盖表格、段落和开放域问答的三个澄清基准上，CIGAsk-7B虽使用更小的骨干模型，仍优于最强的外部基线。它还能跨数据集迁移而无需按数据集调参，同时在分布外基准上保持单轮QA性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习"何时提问"与"如何提问"两种耦合技能，CIGAsk提供了一种无需额外评判器、可跨任务泛化的澄清能力强化学习方案，在提升澄清表现的同时不损害原有单轮问答能力。

title: MIS-Bench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Psychotherapeutic Interpersonal Skills Assessment
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used as evaluators, yet their reliability in professional assessment tasks that require expert judgment remains unclear. We investigate this challenge in the context of assessing psychotherapeutic interpersonal skills and introduce MIS-Bench, a Multimodal Interpersonal Skills (MIS) benchmark comprising 996 psychotherapy response videos annotated across 8 dimensions of Facilitative Interpersonal Skills. Across 9 MLLMs with multiple modality and prompting settings, we find that current models show only modest agreement with human experts, inconsistent gains from multimodal input, and limited benefits from reasoning-based prompting. To mitigate this gap, we propose MIS-RAFT, a regression-aware fine-tuning method inspired by RAFT and tailored to fine-grained interpersonal skill scoring at one-decimal precision. MIS-RAFT addresses the mismatch between autoregressive token prediction and scalar-valued expert assessment, significantly improving agreement with human ratings. Overall, MIS-Bench reveals a clear gap between general multimodal capability and expert-level interpersonal judgment, while MIS-RAFT offers a promising path toward more reliable model-based assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MIS-Bench基准与MIS-RAFT微调方法，系统评估多模态大模型在心理治疗人际技能专业评估中的可靠性，发现通用能力与专家级判断存在明显差距，而所提方法可显著提升与人类评分的一致性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型（MLLMs）日益被用作评估者，但在需要专家判断的专业评估任务中其可靠性尚不明确。既有工作缺乏针对细粒度、专业化人际技能评估的系统性检验。
AI.method: 构建MIS-Bench基准，包含996个心理治疗回应视频，依据Facilitative Interpersonal Skills的8个维度进行标注；在多种模态与提示设置下评测9个MLLM。进一步提出MIS-RAFT，一种受RAFT启发的回归感知微调方法，针对一位小数精度的细粒度人际技能打分，缓解自回归token预测与标量专家评估之间的不匹配。
AI.result: 当前模型与人类专家一致性仅为中等水平，多模态输入带来的增益不稳定，基于推理的提示收益有限；MIS-RAFT显著提升了与人类评分的一致性，缩小了上述差距。
AI.conclusion: MIS-Bench揭示了通用多模态能力与专家级人际判断之间的明显差距，MIS-RAFT为构建更可靠的模型化评估提供了有希望的路径。

title: PhysReflect: Geometry and Perception Guided Diffusion for Physically-Plausible Mirror Reflections
summary: Diffusion models generate high-quality images, yet often violate the physical laws governing mirror reflections. Reflections often suffer from geometric aberrations, including positional offsets, directional misalignment, proportional imbalance, and structural distortion. These failures remain evident even in contemporary state-of-the-art generative systems. Existing methods itigate this problem through synthetic data scaling or auxiliary depth conditioning, yet their merely reliance on latent-space noise reconstruction losses as implicit supervision prevents direct enforcement of reflection-specific geometric and perceptual constraints. To bridge this gap, we present PhysReflect, a geometry and perception guided diffusion framework that decodes the predicted clean latent into pixel space at each training step and applies annealed supervision through two complementary differentiable objectives. The Geometric Loss enforces mirror-induced spatial consistency through sparse epipolar correspondence and dense boundary projection alignment, where a SAM2-based TwinTrack mechanism provides stable in-mirror localization for boundary-aware supervision. The Perceptual Loss preserves reflected appearance by combining Semantic Consistency Loss, which maintains reflected identity and appearance via DINOv2 features, and Lighting Consistency Loss, which regularizes depth, surface-normal, and illumination coherence under monocular geometry priors. Experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that PhysReflect outperforms prior mirror-reflection methods in geometric, perceptual, and physical-plausibility metrics, as well as qualitative visual results.

AI.tldr: 提出 PhysReflect 框架，通过在训练中解码干净隐变量并施加几何与感知退火监督，提升扩散模型生成镜像反射的物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽能生成高质量图像，却常违反镜像反射的物理规律，出现位置偏移、方向错位、比例失衡和结构畸变等问题，即使最先进系统也难以避免。现有方法依赖合成数据规模化或辅助深度条件，且仅以隐空间噪声重建损失作为隐式监督，无法直接施加反射特有的几何与感知约束。
AI.method: PhysReflect 是几何与感知引导的扩散框架：在每个训练步将预测的干净隐变量解码到像素空间，并通过两个可微目标进行退火监督。几何损失通过稀疏对极对应与稠密边界投影对齐来强制镜像诱导的空间一致性，其中基于 SAM2 的 TwinTrack 机制提供稳定的镜内定位以实现边界感知监督。感知损失通过语义一致性损失（用 DINOv2 特征保持反射身份与外观）与光照一致性损失（在单目几何先验下正则化深度、表面法线与光照一致性）来保持反射外观。
AI.result: 在合成与真实基准上，PhysReflect 在几何、感知和物理合理性指标以及定性视觉效果上均优于既有镜像反射方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过在像素空间施加几何与感知的可微退火监督，可有效弥补隐空间重建损失作为隐式监督的不足，显著提升扩散模型镜像反射的物理真实性。

title: Brain-Token Learning: Microstate-Based Tokenization and Multi-Scale Interaction for Long-Horizon EEG Sequence Modeling
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive window into dynamic brain activity, yet modeling long-horizon EEG sequences remains challenging due to their high temporal complexity, substantial variability across subjects, and the lack of biologically meaningful sequence representations. Existing tokenization strategies, such as fixed-window and patch-based representations, discretize EEG signals according to artificial temporal boundaries, which may disrupt intrinsic brain-state dynamics. In this work, we propose Brain-Token Learning, a neuroscience-inspired framework that introduces Brain Tokenization for long-horizon EEG sequence modeling. Instead of partitioning EEG signals into predefined temporal segments, Brain Tokenization represents EEG as sequences of recurrent microstate-derived brain tokens, where each token corresponds to a quasi-stable large-scale brain state with variable temporal duration. Based on these biologically grounded tokens, we further develop a multi-scale token interaction module consisting of Latent State Aggregation and State Transition Modeling to jointly capture global brain-state context and local microstate transitions. We evaluate Brain-Token on five heterogeneous EEG datasets, including the newly collected long-horizon NeuroLong dataset and four affective or clinical EEG datasets (SEED, DEAP, MDD, and NSSI). Extensive experiments demonstrate that Brain-Token consistently outperforms conventional CNN/LSTM architectures, Transformer-based models, and domain adaptation methods across diverse EEG scenarios. Further analysis verifies the effectiveness of microstate-based tokenization and multi-scale interaction for learning robust and interpretable EEG representations. These results establish Brain-Token as a biologically grounded tokenization paradigm for long-horizon EEG sequence modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出Brain-Token框架，用脑微状态衍生的变长"脑token"替代固定窗口/分块分词，配合多尺度token交互模块建模长时段EEG序列，在五个数据集上全面超越CNN/LSTM、Transformer及域适应方法。
AI.motivation: EEG可无创反映动态脑活动，但长时段建模面临三大挑战：高时间复杂性、跨被试差异大、缺乏具备生物学意义的序列表示。现有分词策略（固定窗口、patch）按人为时间边界离散化信号，可能破坏内在脑状态动态。
AI.method: 提出神经科学启发的Brain-Token学习框架。核心为Brain Tokenization：不作预定义时间切分，而将EEG表示为反复出现的微状态（microstate）衍生脑token序列，每个token对应一个准稳定的大尺度脑状态，时长可变。在此基础上构建多尺度token交互模块，含潜在状态聚合（Latent State Aggregation）与状态转移建模（State Transition Modeling），联合捕捉全局脑状态上下文与局部微状态转移。
AI.result: 在五个异构EEG数据集上评估，包括新采集的长时段NeuroLong数据集及四个情感/临床数据集（SEED、DEAP、MDD、NSSI）。实验表明Brain-Token在多种EEG场景下持续优于传统CNN/LSTM架构、Transformer类模型和域适应方法；进一步分析验证了微状态分词与多尺度交互对学习鲁棒、可解释EEG表示的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Brain-Token确立了以生物学为基础的分词范式，为长时段EEG序列建模提供了新途径。

title: Diagnose, Then Repair: A Two-Stage MQM-Guided Post-Editing Framework for Domain-Specific Machine Translation
comment: Accepted to the ACL 2026 Industry Track and presented at ACL 2026
summary: LLM-based machine translation evaluation can closely match human judgments, but in practice it remains largely diagnostic, with the signals rarely translating into direct quality improvements under real production constraints. We propose a two-stage, evaluator-guided automatic post-editing framework that turns MQM-style evaluation into targeted repairs: a retrieval-augmented LLM evaluator outputs structured, span-level MQM diagnoses under an explicit edit contract, and a separate LLM post-editor applies minimal edits restricted to those diagnoses. This separation improves controllability and reduces paraphrastic drift compared to one-stage "judge-and-refine" baselines. In a systematic study involving seven LLMs spanning three model providers and seven languages, our best configuration consistently improves both COMET-22 and COMETKiwi scores over one-stage post-edit methods, while the evaluator's error spans and severities show strong agreement with human MQM annotations and human editor preferences.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段评估器引导的自动后编辑框架，将MQM式评估转化为定向修复，在七模型七语言实验中一致优于单阶段后编辑方法。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的机器翻译评估虽接近人类判断，但实际中多为诊断性质，其信号很少在真实生产约束下转化为直接的译文质量提升。
AI.method: 两阶段评估器引导的自动后编辑框架：检索增强的LLM评估器在显式编辑契约下输出结构化的、span级MQM诊断；独立的LLM后编辑器仅针对这些诊断执行最小编辑。该分离设计相比单阶段"judge-and-refine"基线提升了可控性并减少改述性漂移。
AI.result: 在覆盖3个模型提供商、7个LLM和7种语言的系统研究中，最佳配置在COMET-22与COMETKiwi上稳定优于单阶段后编辑方法，且评估器给出的错误span与严重程度同人类MQM标注及人类编辑偏好高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 将MQM式评估与后编辑显式分离、以结构化诊断驱动最小编辑，可有效把评估信号转化为可量化的翻译质量改进，并保持与人类判断的高一致性。

title: Rule-Constrained Assignment for Cue-Ball Identification in Broadcast Snooker
summary: Accurate cue-ball identification is essential for metric analysis of broadcast snooker. Existing systems evaluate each candidate independently against a fixed white prototype and reject candidates above an appearance threshold. Under broadcast conditions, illumination changes can make colored balls appear white, while intrusions from players and equipment can obscure the cue ball or introduce competing candidates. We formulate cue-ball identification as a rule-constrained assignment problem that jointly assigns detected candidates to the bounded snooker inventory: one cue ball, up to 15 reds, and six colors with known spots. The cue ball is selected by the incremental cost of assigning each candidate to the white slot, and the conventional appearance test follows as the one-slot case. On 419 hand-annotated shots, our method improves identity accuracy from 88.1% to 95.5%, and from 80.5% to 95.2% on held-out venues. Within CueLift, our metric state-recovery system, the assignment expands coverage from 36.2% to 55.4% over 6,241 scorable shots. Assigning an estimate to every shot in a separate evaluation on 2,529 shots preserves this advantage.

AI.tldr: 将台球母球识别建模为规则约束分配问题，显著提升识别准确率与指标分析覆盖率。
AI.motivation: 广播斯诺克指标分析依赖准确的母球识别，但现有系统独立评估每个候选并与固定白色原型比对，在光照变化下彩球可能显白，球员与器材遮挡还会干扰母球或引入竞争候选，导致识别不可靠。
AI.method: 将母球识别表述为规则约束的分配问题，把检测候选联合分配给有界斯诺克库存（1个母球、至多15个红球、6个已知点位的彩球）；通过将每个候选分配到白色槽位的增量代价来选择母球，传统外观测试成为单槽特例。
AI.result: 在419个手工标注击球上，身份准确率由88.1%提升至95.5%，在留出场地由80.5%提升至95.2%；在CueLift指标状态恢复系统中，6,241个可评分击球的覆盖率由36.2%提升至55.4%；在2,529个击球的独立评估中为每杆分配估计仍保持该优势。
AI.conclusion: 规则约束的联合分配框架优于独立的固定原型判断，能有效应对光照与遮挡干扰，提升母球识别与下游指标分析的稳健性和覆盖率。

title: LADDER: Graph-Guided Diffusion Language Models for Efficient Multi-Hop Reasoning
summary: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) has remarkably enhanced large language models on complex reasoning by leveraging structured entity topologies. However, existing frameworks heavily rely on standard autoregressive language models where the nature of inherent sequential generation severely hinders overall inference efficiency. Inspired by Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) that offer massive parallelism via continuous refine-in-parallel decoding, we aim to accelerate GraphRAG in the discrete space. However, it remains non-trivial for two challenges. First, partially denoised drafts are highly dynamic and uncertain, making dynamic graph grounding non-trivial. Second, raw denoising states are inherently noisy and unstable, making synchronous graph retrieval and multi-hop aggregation computationally prohibitive. To this end, we present LADDER, a novel framework that bridges diffusion language modeling with GraphRAG through graph-guided parallel decoding. Specifically, (i) we propose an event-driven self-clocking retrieval, inspired by our key insight that 88% of target entities emerge early in the partially denoised state, leading final commitment by an average of 5.7-9.6 steps. This mechanism dynamically triggers graph retrieval only when the set of graph-linkable entities expands, yielding an asynchronous self-clocking policy that bypasses learned gates or heuristic thresholds. (ii) An incomplete-query graph propagation module is designed to process the newly emerging entity queries using a specialized graph foundation model, continuously aggregating multi-hop evidence to sharpen parallel predictions and accelerate overall decoding convergence. Extensive experiments on three challenging multi-hop QA benchmarks show that LADDER raises average exact match from 39.6% to 45.2% while achieving a 4.1x latency reduction.

AI.tldr: LADDER通过图引导的并行解码，将扩散语言模型与GraphRAG结合，实现多跳问答的精度提升与4.1倍延迟下降。
AI.motivation: 现有GraphRAG依赖自回归语言模型，其顺序生成本质严重制约整体推理效率。虽有扩散语言模型可提供并行细化解码，但在离散空间中加速GraphRAG面临两大挑战：部分去噪草稿高度动态且不确定，导致动态图接地困难；原始去噪状态噪声大且不稳定，使得同步图检索与多跳聚合计算代价过高。
AI.method: 提出LADDER框架，通过图引导的并行解码连接扩散语言建模与GraphRAG。包含两个核心机制：(i)事件驱动的自时钟检索，基于“88%目标实体在部分去噪状态早期出现”的洞察，仅在可图链接实体集合扩展时动态触发图检索，形成无需学习门控或启发式阈值的异步自时钟策略，平均提前5.7-9.6步完成最终确定；(ii)不完整查询图传播模块，使用专用图基础模型处理新出现的实体查询，持续聚合多跳证据以锐化并行预测并加速整体解码收敛。
AI.result: 在三个具有挑战性的多跳问答基准上，LADDER将平均精确匹配率从39.6%提升至45.2%，同时实现4.1倍延迟降低。
AI.conclusion: LADDER有效融合扩散语言模型与GraphRAG，在不牺牲准确性的前提下显著提升推理效率，验证了离散空间并行解码用于图检索增强生成的可行性与优越性。

title: AlexandriaX 2026: The First Shared Task on Dialectal Arabic Machine Translation
comment: To Appear in ArabicNLP 2026, resources available in the following project page: https://alexandriax.dlnlp.ai
summary: Dialectal Arabic machine translation (MT) remains challenging despite recent progress in Arabic language technologies, particularly because effective translation requires modeling not only semantic content but also dialectal variation, conversational context, speaker and addressee characteristics, and sociolinguistic appropriateness. Moreover, conventional MT metrics provide limited insight into the linguistic errors produced by dialectal systems. We present the AlexandriaX 2026 Shared Task on Dialectal Arabic MT, which addresses these challenges through three complementary subtasks: (1) context-aware English-to-Dialectal Arabic dialogue translation across 13 Arabic varieties, (2) cross-dialect Arabic translation in the financial domain covering six Arabic dialects, and (3) span-level MT error detection and classification using linguistically motivated error categories across five Arabic varieties. The shared task attracted 38 registrations for Subtask 1, 33 for Subtask 2, and 35 for Subtask 3. Twelve unique teams submitted their system description papers, all of which we accepted for publication. The best system on Subtask 1 achieved 30.42 spBLEU in the constrained track and 33.49 spBLEU in the unconstrained track. On Subtask 2, the top system obtained 28.40 spBLEU. On Subtask 3, the best system achieved an overall score of 49.82, outperforming the 24.29 baseline. Taken together, the results of the leading systems across the three subtasks highlight the benefits of explicit dialect modeling, context-aware generation, retrieval and reranking, and specialized approaches to interpretable MT error analysis. All the resources of AlexandriaX 2026 shared task are publicly available, including data, baselines, and evaluation code on our project page: https://alexandriax.dlnlp.ai.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 AlexandriaX 2026 方言阿拉伯语机器翻译共享任务，设置三个子任务（上下文感知英-方言阿对话翻译、金融领域跨方言阿语翻译、片段级错误检测与分类），共吸引 33–38 支队伍注册，12 支队伍提交系统论文，最优系统在子任务 1 上达到 30.42/33.49 spBLEU，子任务 2 达 28.40 spBLEU，子任务 3 达 49.82 分（基线 24.29）。
AI.motivation: 方言阿拉伯语机器翻译仍具挑战性，因为有效翻译不仅需要建模语义内容，还需建模方言变异、会话上下文、说话人与受话人特征以及社会语言学适切性；此外，传统 MT 评测指标难以揭示方言系统产生的语言学错误。该共享任务正是为应对这些挑战而设立。
AI.method: 组织 AlexandriaX 2026 共享任务，包含三个互补子任务：(1) 覆盖 13 种阿拉伯语变体的上下文感知英-方言阿对话翻译；(2) 覆盖六种方言的金融领域跨方言阿语翻译；(3) 覆盖五种方言、基于语言学动机错误类别的片段级 MT 错误检测与分类。任务公开数据、基线与评测代码。
AI.result: 注册情况：子任务 1 有 38 支、子任务 2 有 33 支、子任务 3 有 35 支；12 支独立队伍提交系统描述论文，全部被接收发表。最优成绩：子任务 1 受限赛道 30.42 spBLEU，非受限赛道 33.49 spBLEU；子任务 2 最高 28.40 spBLEU；子任务 3 最佳系统总分 49.82，显著优于 24.29 的基线。
AI.conclusion: 三个子任务领先系统的结果表明，显式方言建模、上下文感知生成、检索与重排序，以及面向可解释 MT 错误分析的专门方法均能带来收益。该共享任务的全部资源（数据、基线、评测代码）已在项目主页 https://alexandriax.dlnlp.ai 公开。

title: Algebraic Consistency Alone Does Not Certify Temporal Structure in Latent Action Models
summary: Latent action models infer a code for the transition between two frames of action-free video. Recent methods regularise this code to compose additively and reverse antisymmetrically, and report order-of-magnitude reductions in the resulting errors as a label-free certificate that the code has captured temporal structure. We show that this conclusion does not follow. Reconstruction drives the decoded transition toward a difference of state features, for which both identities hold for any pairing, a solution the metric cannot distinguish from one encoding nuisance state or a coordinate convention. Across five source domains, a trained but unconstrained counterpart already achieves 83-97% of the reduction relative to an untrained anchor. The residual fold is governed as much by the decoder family as by what is learned. A constrained model retrained after its temporal pairing is destroyed still reaches, in each domain, a lower error than the unconstrained model on real data. Downstream, preserving the temporal pairing yields no consistent advantage on LIBERO-GOAL or LIBERO-SPATIAL, and across the tested arms the code's mean linear action decodability falls as the algebraic error improves. We also test the most direct repair, a violation-contrastive objective that requires the algebra to fail on destroyed pairings: in the tested configurations it yields only a marginal separation within the reconstruction budget, on training and test triples alike. We recommend a validation protocol that these methods currently lack: a baseline-corrected metric, retraining on destroyed pairings, and a seed-budget analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑潜动作模型中被广泛引用的"代数误差下降即可证明编码捕获了时序结构"这一结论，通过多重对照实验证明该指标无法区分真实时序编码与平凡解，并指出下游任务与解码线性可分性并不随之改善。
AI.motivation: 近期潜动作模型方法将帧间转移编码正则化为可加合成、反对称可逆的形式，并以由此带来的代数误差数量级下降作为"无标签证据"，宣称该编码已捕获时序结构。作者认为这一推断缺乏逻辑必然性，需要予以反驳并给出替代验证方案。
AI.method: 从理论层面说明重建目标会将解码转移推向状态特征之差，使两个代数恒等式对任意配对都成立，从而与编码了干扰状态或坐标约定的解不可区分；实验上在五个源域中对比训练但无约束的模型与未训练基线，并改变解码器族；再对时序配对被破坏后重新训练的受约束模型评估误差；在 LIBERO-GOAL 与 LIBERO-SPATIAL 上检验保留时序配对的下游收益及编码的平均线性动作可解码性；最后测试最直接的补救方案——要求代数在破坏配对上失效的违反对比目标。
AI.result: 理论分析表明重建使两个恒等式在任意配对下成立。实验中，无约束模型相对未训练锚点已获得 83–97% 的误差降幅；残差大小由解码器族与所学内容共同决定。时序配对被破坏后重训的受约束模型，在每个域上于真实数据上的误差都低于无约束模型。下游任务中保留时序配对无一致优势，且随代数误差改善，编码的平均线性动作可解码性反而下降。违反对比目标在测试配置下仅在重建预算内带来边际分离。
AI.conclusion: 代数误差的下降不能作为编码捕获时序结构的证据，该指标无法排除平凡解与坐标约定。作者建议采用当前方法普遍缺失的验证协议：基线校正指标、在破坏配对上重训、以及随机种子预算分析。

title: Few-Shot Demonstrations Elicit the Use of In-Context World Representations in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs), when acting as agents, are expected to take observed data in context, infer the latent state space underlying the world, and leverage it for downstream prediction. However, prior work demonstrated that LLMs struggle to use representations learned in context on a graph tracking task, where the model needs to construct a representation of the graph governing data generation process and use it for subsequent predictions. In this paper, we show that extending this to few-shot settings, where each demonstration is generated from a different world with either the same or different graph topologies, enhances its prediction on 6 models from 4 model families. To understand this improvement, we linearly probe a low-dimensional world representation that encodes graph information in the hidden states. Notably, we find that few-shot demonstrations relocate the world representation and increase its predictive use. Specifically, for each model, these world representations shift in directions nearly orthogonal to their original subspace, and interventions on these representations selectively impair performance more than interventions on other subspaces. Consistent with this insight, we show that few-shot demonstrations with observations from different worlds improve performance on ARC-AGI-1&2, web agent tasks, and Othello. Our findings elucidate the role and internal mechanisms of few-shot demonstrations in in-context world modeling. More broadly, our work advances our understanding of how LLM agents learn from in-context observations and provides implications for their further improvement.

AI.tldr: 少样本演示可提升LLM在上下文中的世界建模能力：演示将隐状态中的世界表征迁移至近正交方向并增强其预测用途，在6个模型、多个任务上验证有效。
AI.motivation: LLM作为智能体需要在上下文中从观测数据推断潜在世界状态空间并用于下游预测，但已有研究表明LLM在图追踪任务上难以利用上下文中学到的表征，因此需要探究如何改善这一能力并理解其内部机制。
AI.method: 将任务扩展到少样本设置，每个演示由不同世界生成（图拓扑相同或不同）；在4个模型家族的6个模型上评估预测表现；通过线性探针在隐状态中提取编码图信息的低维世界表征，分析其方向变化与因果作用（干预实验）。
AI.result: 少样本演示提升了6个模型的预测性能；演示使世界表征发生迁移，方向近乎正交于原始子空间，且对该表征的干预会比干预其他子空间更显著地损害性能；使用不同世界观测的少样本演示还能提升ARC-AGI-1&2、网页智能体任务和Othello上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 少样本演示通过迁移世界表征并增强其预测用途来改善LLM的上下文世界建模，揭示了演示在上下文学习中的角色与内部机制，为LLM智能体从上下文观测中学习及后续改进提供了启示。

title: To Consolidate or not to Consolidate? Evaluating the Impact of Consolidation in Multi-Reference Training using Peer Reviews
summary: Natural language generation (NLG) tasks span the spectrum of conditional entropy, ranging from highly constrained machine translation to open-ended dialogue generation. Structured tasks like automated peer-review generation occupy the intermediate region, where a single input admits multiple valid, overlapping outputs. In this work, we demonstrate that traditional single- and multi-reference training paradigms are suboptimal for these intermediary tasks. We provide empirical evidence that consolidating diverse references into a unified training signal is crucial for developing effective systems. To facilitate this, we introduce MERC-36K, a large-scale corpus of over 36,000 papers paired with original and consolidated peer reviews. Using this dataset, we train specific architectures to isolate the impact of different reference paradigms and benchmark against existing state-of-the-art systems. Through extensive automatic and human evaluation, we demonstrate that models trained on consolidated references significantly outperform those trained on unconsolidated references. Dataset and code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文指出传统单参考与多参考训练范式对"结构化中间任务"（如自动同行评审生成）效果欠佳，提出将多样参考整合为统一训练信号，并发布 MERC-36K 数据集（36,000+ 论文及原始/整合评审），实验证明整合参考训练的模型显著优于未整合参考的模型。
AI.motivation: NLG 任务覆盖从高约束（机器翻译）到开放生成（对话）的条件熵谱系。结构化任务（如自动同行评审生成）处于中间区域：单一输入存在多个有效且相互重叠的输出。传统单参考与多参考训练范式在此类中间任务上并非最优，需要一种能整合多样参考的训练信号。
AI.method: 1) 提供实证证据，说明将多样参考整合为统一训练信号对构建有效系统至关重要；2) 构建 MERC-36K 大规模语料，包含 36,000+ 篇论文及其原始评审与整合评审；3) 基于该数据集训练特定架构，以隔离不同参考范式的影响；4) 与现有 state-of-the-art 系统进行基准对比；5) 采用自动评估与人工评估双重验证。
AI.result: 大量自动评估与人工评估表明，基于整合参考（consolidated references）训练的模型显著优于基于未整合参考（unconsolidated references）训练的模型。数据集与代码将在论文录用后公开。
AI.conclusion: 对处于条件熵中间区域的结构化 NLG 任务，训练时应将多样参考整合为统一信号；所提出的 MERC-36K 与相应架构验证了该思路的有效性，为自动同行评审生成等任务提供了新的数据资源与方法基线。

title: CE$^4$L: Continual Ego, Exo, and Ego-Exo Learning
summary: Perception for embodied agents is video-based, often multi-view (ego, exo, or both), and inherently continual, with simultaneous task and viewpoint shifts. Yet continual learning (CL) remains dominated by exo-only recognition tasks, obscuring behavior under these real-world coupled shifts. We introduce Continual Ego, E}xo, and Ego-Exo Learning (CE$^4$L), a unified multi-view CL benchmark spanning four representative tasks: cross-view referenced skill assessment, temporal action segmentation, cross-view association, and action anticipation & planning. CE$^4$L highlights challenges largely absent in prior CL benchmarks, including cross-view correspondence, view-dependent asynchrony, and heterogeneous semantic objectives. To this end, we propose Video Incremental Subspace-routed Task Adapters (VISTA), a parameter-efficient baseline method that stores task-specific updates in lightweight adapters and performs training-free routing via residual distance to task-specific whitened subspaces estimated from second-order statistics. Extensive experiments demonstrate the significantly varied efficacy of representative CL methods across CE$^4$L settings, while VISTA is consistently competitive and achieves state-of-the-art overall performance. Our source code for benchmarks and methods is available at https://github.com/AnAppleCore/CE4L .

AI.tldr: 本文提出多视角持续学习基准CE4L及参数高效基线方法VISTA，覆盖四类任务，应对视图与任务耦合漂移。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体的感知本质上是基于视频、多视角且持续演化的，任务与视角会同时发生漂移。然而现有持续学习研究主要集中于仅外视角（exo-only）的识别任务，无法揭示真实场景中任务与视角耦合漂移下的表现，因此缺乏相应基准与方法。
AI.method: 作者构建统一的多视角持续学习基准CE4L，涵盖四类代表性任务：跨视角参考技能评估、时序动作分割、跨视角关联、动作预测与规划。同时提出参数高效基线VISTA（Video Incremental Subspace-routed Task Adapters），将任务特定更新存储于轻量适配器中，并基于二阶统计量估计任务特定的白化子空间，通过残差距离实现无需训练的路径路由。
AI.result: 实验表明，代表性持续学习方法在CE4L各设定下效果差异显著；VISTA始终保持竞争力，并在整体性能上达到最优。
AI.conclusion: CE4L揭示了跨视角对应、视角相关异步性和异构语义目标等在以往基准中缺失的挑战，为多视角持续学习提供了统一评测平台；VISTA作为参数高效方案可作为该方向的强基线。代码已开源。

title: VLM-in-Sandbox: Visual Workspaces for Agentic Visual Reasoning
summary: Sandboxed computer environments support multi-step reasoning with tools, executable programs, and persistent files, yet their extension from language models to vision-language models (VLMs) introduces a distinct state-management problem. Visual reasoning produces intermediate image-valued evidence---crops, masks, overlays, zoomed regions, and analytic renderings---that must remain addressable without accumulating unboundedly in multimodal context. We introduce VLM-in-Sandbox, a training-free framework for agentic multimodal reasoning in controlled computer environments. Its Visual Workspace registers generated artifacts in an image ledger, maintains a bounded active visual context, and lets the model explicitly promote selected evidence for subsequent inspection. This separates visual evidence generation, performed by sandbox tools, from visual evidence management. Across seven benchmarks and four base VLMs, VLM-in-Sandbox achieves the highest sample-weighted average accuracy among Vanilla VLM, Append-only Sandbox, and the proposed method. A compiler-matched $2\times2$ study on 1,260 examples further separates model-directed visibility from bounded retention: VLM-in-Sandbox reaches 66.27% accuracy with 18.6% fewer total tokens than the automatic, retain-all control. Over all 6,350 submitted GPT-4.1-mini examples, it produces 302 rescues and 142 regressions relative to Original Append-only. A local vLLM study with prefix caching confirms that the smaller request workload also reduces uncached tokens, time to first token, and end-to-end latency. These results identify explicit visual evidence state as a central abstraction for sandboxed VLM agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VLM-in-Sandbox——一种免训练的沙箱多模态智能体框架，通过 Visual Workspace 管理图像证据状态，在7个基准、4个基座 VLM 上取得最优平均准确率，并用更少 token 降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 将沙箱环境从语言模型扩展到视觉语言模型（VLM）时，出现了一个特有的状态管理问题：视觉推理会产生裁剪、掩码、叠加图、放大区域、分析渲染等图像型中间证据，这些证据需要保持可寻址，但不能无限制地堆积在多模态上下文中。
AI.method: 提出 VLM-in-Sandbox，一个面向受控计算机环境的免训练智能体式多模态推理框架。其核心组件 Visual Workspace 包含三部分机制：将生成的产物登记到 image ledger（图像账本）；维护一个有界的 active visual context（活跃视觉上下文）；允许模型显式提升选定证据以供后续检查。由此将视觉证据的生成（由沙箱工具完成）与视觉证据的管理相分离。此外进行了编译器匹配的 2×2 研究以分离“模型导向的可见性”与“有界保留”两个因素。
AI.result: 在7个基准和4个基座 VLM 上，该方法在 Vanilla VLM、Append-only Sandbox 与所提方法中取得最高的样本加权平均准确率。在 1,260 个样例上的编译器匹配 2×2 研究中，VLM-in-Sandbox 达到 66.27% 准确率，且相比自动、保留全部的对照减少 18.6% 的总 token。在全部 6,350 个提交的 GPT-4.1-mini 样例上，相对 Original Append-only 产生 302 次挽救（rescues）和 142 次退化（regressions）。基于 prefix caching 的本地 vLLM 研究证实，更小的请求负载同时降低了未缓存 token、首 token 时间和端到端延迟。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明显式的视觉证据状态是沙箱化 VLM 智能体的一个核心抽象。

title: Block-Sparse Attention with Semantic-Geometric Decoupled Routing
comment: Technical report; Submitted to ACL ARR 2026 May
summary: Long-context inference has become a defining capability of large language models, but exact dense attention remains costly due to its quadratic scaling with sequence length. Block-sparse attention offers a hardware-friendly alternative by routing each query block to a small set of relevant key blocks, yet accurate training-free block routing remains difficult. Existing routers often pool post-RoPE token representations, which entangles semantic aggregation with RoPE-induced geometry and attenuates local positional cues through high-frequency phase cancellation. To resolve this mismatch, we propose \textbf{Semantic-Geometric Decoupled Routing}, a training-free block routing framework that shifts semantic aggregation to the pre-RoPE space and reconstructs geometric bias with an offline structural prior and relative block distances. This decomposition yields an explicit closed-form block routing score without token-level search or post-hoc calibration. Experiments on long-context text and video tasks show that our method approaches full-attention accuracy across 4K--128K contexts, keeps routing overhead below 3.4 ms, and achieves a 5.03$\times$ speedup over FlashAttn at a 128K context length.

AI.tldr: 提出Semantic-Geometric Decoupled Routing，通过将语义聚合移至RoPE前空间、用离线结构先验重构几何偏置，实现免训练块稀疏注意力路由，在长上下文任务上接近全注意力精度并显著提速。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理中精确稠密注意力因序列长度的二次复杂度而开销高昂。块稀疏注意力通过将每个查询块路由到少量相关键块来提升硬件效率，但免训练的精确块路由仍很困难。现有路由器常对RoPE后的token表示做池化，导致语义聚合与RoPE诱导的几何信息纠缠，且高频相位抵消削弱了局部位置线索。
AI.method: 提出Semantic-Geometric Decoupled Routing免训练块路由框架：将语义聚合转移到RoPE前空间，并利用离线结构先验与相对块距离重建几何偏置。该分解产生显式闭式块路由分数，无需token级搜索或事后校准。
AI.result: 在长上下文文本与视频任务上，方法在4K–128K上下文范围内接近全注意力精度，路由开销低于3.4 ms，在128K上下文长度下相对FlashAttn取得5.03倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦语义与几何信息构建免训练块路由，可同时兼顾长上下文精度与效率，验证了RoPE前语义聚合与离线几何先验结合的有效性。

title: Pay More Attention To Text In High-Resolution MLLMs
summary: Failures of high-resolution MLLMs are commonly attributed to a visual problem, motivating zooming, cropping, and related visual interventions to recover fine-grained evidence or suppress interference. Yet recent studies suggest that relevant visual evidence is already encoded in intermediate representations, indicating that visual-side improvements alone insufficient. This raises a natural question: does the remaining bottleneck lie in the text that guides visual search? We identify a previously overlooked linguistic bottleneck: questions formulated for answering do not necessarily specify the visual evidence required for localization. To address this mismatch, we introduce EviSpec, a training-free compiler that derives complementary evidence specifications while preserving the original question for final reasoning. We further validate it through matched-control experiments that isolate the roles of evidence specification and localization. With the search budget fixed, structured evidence specifications yield an 8.6% relative gain over generic requests. With evidence geometry matched, the evidence localized by EviSpec yields a 14.8% relative gain over random evidence. Together, these controls isolate the benefit of specifying what evidence to seek rather than merely expanding visual access. Across all five MLLMs, EviSpec consistently improves upon the corresponding baseline on each of the three benchmarks, yielding average relative gains of \textbf{10.4%, 8.8%, and 12.4%} on V\textsuperscript{*}Bench, HR-Bench-4K, and HR-Bench-8K, respectively. Beyond high-resolution reasoning, EviSpec also achieves state-of-the-art performance on VQA and hallucination-focused benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文指出高分辨率多模态大模型（MLLMs）的性能瓶颈不仅在于视觉侧，还在于引导视觉搜索的文本。为此提出免训练的证据规格编译器 EviSpec，通过生成互补的证据规格并保留原始问题，在两个匹配对照实验中分别取得 8.6% 与 14.8% 的相对增益，并在五个 MLLM 与三个基准上取得平均 10.4%、8.8%、12.4% 的相对提升。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率 MLLM 的失败通常被归因于视觉问题，因而催生了缩放、裁剪等视觉干预手段。但近期研究表明，相关视觉证据其实已编码在中间表示中，仅靠视觉侧改进不足。这促使作者追问：剩余瓶颈是否在于引导视觉搜索的文本？作者识别出一个此前被忽视的语言瓶颈——为回答而构造的问题未必能指明定位所需的视觉证据，即问题与所需证据之间存在不匹配。
AI.method: 提出 EviSpec，一种免训练的编译器，在保留原始问题用于最终推理的同时，派生互补的证据规格（evidence specifications）。并通过匹配对照实验，将证据规格与证据定位两者的作用分离开来加以验证：在搜索预算固定的条件下比较结构化证据规格与通用请求；在证据几何匹配的条件下比较 EviSpec 定位的证据与随机证据。
AI.result: 在搜索预算固定时，结构化证据规格相比通用请求取得 8.6% 的相对增益；在证据几何匹配时，EviSpec 定位的证据相比随机证据取得 14.8% 的相对增益。两个对照实验共同表明，收益来自"指明寻找何种证据"，而非仅仅扩大视觉访问范围。在全部五个 MLLM 上，EviSpec 在三个基准上均一致优于对应基线，在 V*Bench、HR-Bench-4K、HR-Bench-8K 上分别取得平均 10.4%、8.8%、12.4% 的相对增益。此外，在高分辨率推理之外，EviSpec 在 VQA 与幻觉相关基准上也达到 SOTA 性能。
AI.conclusion: 高分辨率 MLLM 的剩余瓶颈部分源自文本侧，即问题未能明确指定定位所需的视觉证据。通过免训练的证据规格编译（EviSpec），在不改变原始问题的前提下补充结构化证据规格，可显著提升高分辨率推理性能，并在 VQA 与幻觉基准上达到 SOTA，说明"指明寻找何种证据"是与视觉干预互补的关键方向。

title: Predicting Postprandial Glycemic Response from Meal Images, Clinical Variables, and Gut Microbiome Information
comment: 11 pages (9 text + 2 references). This is a paper first submitted to MICCAI 2026 MultiTab workshop prior to peer review. The final revised version will be published in Springer LNCS proceedings after the MICCAI 2026 conference
summary: Predicting postprandial glycemic response (PPGR) is fundamental to personalized nutrition and type 2 diabetes management, yet existing approaches typically rely on manually reported dietary intake, limiting their scalability in free-living settings. We propose a multimodal framework that replaces manual dietary logging with image-derived macronutrient estimates and integrates them with clinical variables and gut microbiome information for personalized PPGR prediction. The framework jointly performs image-based macronutrient estimation and glucose prediction, while an attention-based prediction module models interactions between dietary and host-specific information. We evaluate the proposed approach on a real-world dataset comprising meal images, continuous glucose monitoring, clinical variables, and gut microbiome profiles. The proposed model outperforms existing PPGR baselines using image-derived nutritional inputs and approaches the performance of methods that rely on manually reported macronutrients despite using automatically estimated nutritional information. These results demonstrate that combining image-derived nutrition with complementary clinical and gut microbiome information provides a practical foundation for scalable personalized PPGR prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多模态框架，用图像估计的大营养素替代人工饮食记录，并结合临床变量与肠道菌群信息进行个性化餐后血糖响应（PPGR）预测。
AI.motivation: 个性化营养与2型糖尿病管理依赖PPGR预测，但现有方法多依赖人工报告的饮食摄入，在自由生活场景下难以规模化推广。
AI.method: 框架联合执行基于图像的宏量营养素估计与血糖预测，并采用基于注意力的预测模块建模饮食信息与宿主特异性信息之间的交互；输入包括餐食图像、连续血糖监测、临床变量与肠道菌群谱。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上，所提模型在使用图像衍生营养输入时优于现有PPGR基线，并在使用自动估计营养信息的情况下接近依赖人工报告宏量营养素方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 图像衍生营养信息结合临床与肠道菌群互补信息，为可扩展的个性化PPGR预测提供了实用基础。

title: LLMs Anchor on Chief Complaint and Fail to Integrate Evidence in Sequential Clinical Triage
summary: Triage in the emergency department (ED) is a sequential decision process that unfolds turn by turn. Existing evaluations of large language models (LLMs) for triage use completed retrospective records and report performance close to that of physicians. We implement a methodology for evaluating LLMs on sequential triage, the task of predicting a triage acuity label from a growing prefix of a nurse-patient conversation. We evaluate six LLMs at five sequential checkpoints on two corpora: 425 LLM-generated (SIMULATED) and 50 physician-authored (CLINICIAN) conversations, both labelled under the Emergency Severity Index (ESI). Every model, measured by quadratic weighted kappa (QWK), degrades from moderate-to-substantial agreement on completed records to fair-to-moderate agreement at every sequential checkpoint. Controlled perturbations show that the label at every checkpoint is anchored on the chief complaint exchanges, and prompting interventions fail to lift this plateau. Models extract clinically relevant content from later turns, yet the surprisal of the true label rises across the checkpoints. So the model fails to integrate the evidence. Three expert clinicians on the same conversations reach a QWK of 0.887-0.929, while the best model reaches 0.295. Predictions concentrate at ESI-2 and ESI-3, and models agree with each other more than with the ground truth, so ensembling worsens the failure. Deploying LLMs for ED triage based on offline benchmarks alone misses this sequential failure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出序贯分诊评测方法，发现LLM在逐轮对话前缀下性能系统性下降，离线基准高估了其真实能力。
AI.motivation: 急诊分诊本质是逐轮展开的序贯决策过程，但现有LLM分诊评测均基于已完成的回顾性病历，报告性能接近医生水平，可能严重高估LLM在真实交互场景中的能力。作者希望建立更贴近实际的序贯评测方法，检验这种"接近医生"的表现能否在信息逐步积累的过程中保持。
AI.method: 作者设计了序贯分诊评测流程：在护患对话不断增长的前缀上，让模型预测ESI分诊等级。实验覆盖六个LLM、五个序贯检查点，使用两个语料库：425条LLM生成（SIMULATED）与50条医生撰写（CLINICIAN）对话，均按急诊严重度指数（ESI）标注。评价指标为二次加权kappa（QWK）。此外进行了受控扰动实验和提示干预实验，并让三位专家临床医生在相同对话上作对照。
AI.result: 所有模型在完整病历上为中等至较高一致性，但在每个序贯检查点均下降至一般至中等一致性。受控扰动显示每个检查点的标签都锚定在主诉交换上，提示干预无法突破该平台期。模型虽能从后续轮次提取临床相关内容，但真实标签的surprisal随检查点上升，说明未能整合新证据。三位专家QWK为0.887–0.929，最佳模型仅0.295。预测集中在ESI-2和ESI-3，模型间一致性高于与真实标签的一致性，集成反而使性能变差。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭离线基准部署LLM于急诊分诊会忽视其序贯失败。序贯评测揭示了模型锚定初始主诉、无法随信息累积更新判断的核心缺陷，需在真实交互式评测框架下重新评估LLM的临床分诊能力。

title: Detecting Phone-Induced Pedestrian Distraction via a Multimodal Fusion Transformer
comment: 2026 IEEE 9th International Conference on Electronic Information and Communication Technology (ICEICT 2026)
summary: The increasing reliance on mobile phones has made phone-induced pedestrian distraction increasingly prevalent. Activities such as texting, watching videos, and making phone calls have become significant contributors to traffic accidents. Reliable detection of pedestrian distraction is essential for autonomous vehicles, as it improves situational awareness and enables timely risk assessment, thereby supporting safe motion planning and vehicle control. We propose a multimodal fusion Transformer (MFT) for detecting phone-induced pedestrian distraction. MFT jointly extracts skeletal dynamics from body pose keypoints and visual appearance features from pedestrian images, effectively leveraging the complementary information provided by the two modalities. A cross-modal attention module is proposed to capture inter-modal dependencies through multi-head cross-attention, facilitating effective fusion of complementary information across the two modalities. Then, a temporal attention fusion module, implemented with a Transformer encoder, is employed to capture temporal dependencies. MFT is trained and evaluated on a manually annotated dataset comprising 287 pedestrian instances with 20,741 images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MFT attains an overall accuracy of 95%, exceeding the performance of six baseline approaches by 6%.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态融合Transformer（MFT），联合骨骼动态与视觉外观特征检测手机诱发的行人分心，在自建数据集上达95%总体准确率，较六个基线高出6%。
AI.motivation: 手机使用导致的行人分心（发短信、看视频、通话）已成为交通事故的重要诱因；自动驾驶需要可靠的行人分心检测以提升情境感知、及时风险评估，从而支持安全运动规划与车辆控制。
AI.method: MFT为多模态融合Transformer：以行人图像提取视觉外观特征，以身体姿态关键点提取骨骼动态；通过多模态交叉注意力模块（多头交叉注意力）建模模态间依赖并融合互补信息；再由基于Transformer编码器的时间注意力融合模块捕捉时序依赖。模型在人工标注的287个行人实例、20,741张图像数据集上训练和评估。
AI.result: 总体准确率95%，优于六个基线方法6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 验证了骨骼与外观双模态互补融合结合跨模态与时间注意力对行人分心检测的有效性，适用于自动驾驶情境感知。

title: Fathom-Vaidya: Advancing Medical Reasoning with Rubric-Based Rewards
summary: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in healthcare requires robust performance across two complementary dimensions - diagnostic reasoning: the convergent, evidence-driven task of inferring a patient's condition from clinical data to produce a diagnosis, and clinical healthcare reasoning: the broader, navigational judgment required to communicate, plan, and adapt across multi-turn clinical interactions where a single correct answer may not exist. Recent benchmarks such as HealthBench and MedXpertQA reveal persistent weaknesses in both areas, exposing failures in complex diagnostic scenarios and limitations in contextual, patient-centered dialogue. We introduce a sequential training framework that targets these facets using synthetic data and rubric-based reinforcement learning. First, we improve diagnostic reasoning using MedBullets-derived questions with rule- and rubric-guided Reinforcement Learning (RL). We then shift to clinical reasoning by generating 5.3k synthetic multi-turn scenarios, each paired with multi-dimensional rubrics to comprehensively assess the response. This approach yields over 10% improvement on MedXpertQA, and our 30B model achieves 50.1% accuracy on HealthBench-Hard, surpassing proprietary baselines including GPT-5 (thinking). Our results show that targeted synthetic datasets and rubric-based training can systematically improve both diagnostic and interactive clinical reasoning in medical LLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出一个顺序训练框架，结合合成数据与基于评分标准的强化学习，分阶段提升医疗LLM的诊断推理与临床交互推理能力，在MedXpertQA提升超10%，30B模型在HealthBench-Hard达50.1%，超越GPT-5(thinking)等专有基线。
AI.motivation: 医疗场景部署LLM需兼顾两类互补能力：诊断推理（从临床数据收敛推断出诊断）与临床医疗推理（多轮交互中沟通、规划与适应，且往往无唯一正确答案）。现有基准（HealthBench、MedXpertQA）显示模型在这两方面均存在持续短板，亟需针对性训练方法。
AI.method: 采用顺序训练框架，基于合成数据与评分标准（rubric）的强化学习。第一阶段：用源自MedBullets的问题，结合规则与评分标准引导的RL提升诊断推理；第二阶段：转向临床推理，生成5.3k条合成多轮场景，每条配多维评分标准，以全面评估响应质量。
AI.result: 在MedXpertQA上取得超过10%的提升；30B模型在HealthBench-Hard上达到50.1%准确率，超过包括GPT-5(thinking)在内的专有基线。
AI.conclusion: 针对性的合成数据集与基于评分标准的训练，能够系统性提升医疗LLM的诊断推理与交互式临床推理能力。

title: An Iterative LangGraph Agent for Text-to-SQL: Natural Language Access to the Chicago Crime Database
summary: Non-technical stakeholders frequently cannot write the SQL needed to extract insights from operational databases. We built and evaluated a Text-to-SQL agent that closes this gap end to end: a six-node LangGraph StateGraph checks question relevance, fetches the live schema, generates PostgreSQL, validates it with a dry run, retries on failure, executes the query, and narrates the result set in plain English. The agent uses prompt engineering only; no model was fine-tuned. We evaluated it on the Chicago Crime dataset (approximately 8.5 million records, 22 attributes) against a hand-built benchmark of 100 natural language questions with ground-truth SQL, stratified into 30 Easy, 40 Medium and 30 Hard items. Comparing two prompt revisions of the same agent, the revised system (V2) reached a Valid SQL Rate of 93% (from 87%), an Execution Accuracy of 60% under a hybrid relational equivalence metric (from 47%; 19% from 12% under strict JSON matching), and a mean Synthesis Quality of 4.34 out of 5 (from 3.91). The single largest driver was removing a LIMIT 10 instruction from the system prompt, which had been truncating multi-row answers. Error analysis attributes the residual failures to relevance-checker false rejections, ambiguous question semantics, and free-tier API rate limits rather than to the language generation step. We report no comparison against an external baseline system or a public benchmark; the study is a single-model engineering evaluation.

AI.tldr: 构建并评估一个仅靠提示工程、无需微调的六节点 LangGraph Text-to-SQL 智能体，在芝加哥犯罪数据集（约850万条记录、22个属性）与100题人工基准上对比两版提示，V2 的 Valid SQL Rate 从87%升至93%，混合等价度量下 Execution Accuracy 从47%升至60%，Synthesis Quality 从3.91升至4.34（满分5）；最大改进来源是移除系统提示中的 LIMIT 10。
AI.motivation: 非技术利益相关者往往无法编写从业务数据库中提取洞察所需的 SQL，存在自然语言到 SQL 的能力鸿沟。作者希望构建一个端到端的 Text-to-SQL 智能体来弥合这一鸿沟，并检验仅通过提示工程（不微调模型）能达到何种程度的效果。
AI.method: 采用六节点 LangGraph StateGraph 构建端到端流水线：问题相关性检查、获取实时 schema、生成 PostgreSQL、通过 dry run 校验、失败重试、执行查询、以自然语言叙述结果集。仅使用提示工程，未对模型进行微调。评估在芝加哥犯罪数据集（约850万条记录、22个属性）上进行，使用100道带 ground-truth SQL 的自然语言问题作为人工基准，按难度分层为30 Easy、40 Medium、30 Hard。对比同一智能体的两版提示（V1 与 V2）。
AI.result: V2 相较 V1：Valid SQL Rate 达93%（原87%）；混合关系等价度量下 Execution Accuracy 为60%（原47%），严格 JSON 匹配下为19%（原12%）；Synthesis Quality 均值4.34/5（原3.91）。最大单项改进驱动因素是移除系统提示中的 LIMIT 10 指令，该指令此前会截断多行答案。残余失败主要归因于相关性检查器的误拒、问题语义歧义以及免费层 API 速率限制，而非语言生成步骤。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭提示工程即可让 Text-to-SQL 智能体在真实规模数据库上达到较高的 SQL 有效性（93%）与中等执行准确率（60%），并通过结果叙述为非技术用户提供端到端洞察。局限在于：未与外部基线系统或公开基准进行对比，属于单模型工程评估，结论的普适性有限。

title: GARO: Geometry-Aware Redundancy Optimization for Real-Time and High-Fidelity Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
summary: Novel view synthesis is a key task for dynamic scene reconstruction, where high rendering speed is essential for applications such as virtual reality. Existing deformable Gaussian Splatting methods achieve high-fidelity dynamic scene modeling, but still face limitations in memory usage and rendering efficiency due to the large number of redundant Gaussians. To address these challenges, we propose Geometry-Aware Redundancy Optimization (GARO), a unified redundancy measurement framework in the adaptive density control stage of the traditional dynamic scene reconstruction pipeline. This framework first selects low-gradient candidates using an optimization activity assessment strategy, and then evaluates geometric complexity through low curvature analysis to further filter and prune redundant points, resulting in a compact and expressive Gaussian representation. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that GARO achieves robust trade-offs between quality and speed, with PSNR remaining stable and rendering speed improved by 2x, validating the efficiency and effectiveness of GARO.

AI.tldr: 提出几何感知冗余优化（GARO）框架，在动态场景重建的自适应密度控制阶段统一度量冗余，实现紧凑高斯表示，渲染速度提升2倍且PSNR稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有可变形高斯泼溅方法虽能高质量建模动态场景，但因存在大量冗余高斯点，导致内存占用高、渲染效率低，难以满足虚拟现实等对渲染速度要求高的应用。
AI.method: 在传统动态场景重建流程的自适应密度控制阶段引入统一的冗余度量框架GARO：先通过优化活跃度评估策略筛选低梯度候选点，再利用低曲率分析评估几何复杂度，进一步过滤并剪枝冗余点，从而获得紧凑且具表现力的高斯表示。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上的大量实验表明，GARO在质量与速度之间取得良好权衡，PSNR保持稳定，渲染速度提升2倍。
AI.conclusion: GARO通过几何感知的冗余优化有效减少冗余高斯点，验证了其在效率和有效性上的优势，为动态场景重建提供了一种高质量、高速度的紧凑表示方案。

title: Not All Task Vectors Need Equal Rank: Energy-Proportional Allocation for Model Merging
summary: Model merging aims to combine multiple fine-tuned models derived from a common pretrained model into a single multi-task model without additional joint training. Recent spectral merging methods improve over simple weight averaging by exploiting low-rank structures of task-specific updates, but they commonly assign the same rank capacity to every task. This uniform allocation ignores that task vectors can have heterogeneous spectral complexity, causing the shared merging space to be used suboptimally. In this paper, we propose Spectral Energy-proportional Rank Allocation (SERA), a simple task-adaptive strategy that allocates ranks according to the singular-value energy structure of each task vector. By assigning richer spectral capacity to complex or isolated tasks and fewer directions to compact tasks, SERA extends SVD-based model merging from uniform-capacity merging to task-dependent capacity allocation. Experiments under standard vision model merging protocols show that SERA improves multi-task merging performance while preserving the same total rank budget as existing spectral merging methods. Further analysis demonstrates that task-level spectral concentration is closely related to the per-task effect of adaptive rank allocation, providing insight into when and why SERA is effective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SERA（谱能量比例秩分配），一种任务自适应策略，依据各任务向量的奇异值能量结构分配秩，将基于SVD的模型合并从统一容量提升为任务相关容量分配，在相同总秩预算下提升多任务合并性能。
AI.motivation: 现有谱合并方法虽利用任务特定更新的低秩结构改进了简单权重平均，但对所有任务分配相同秩容量，忽略了任务向量谱复杂度存在异质性，导致共享合并空间利用不最优。
AI.method: SERA根据每个任务向量的奇异值能量结构分配秩：对复杂或孤立任务赋予更丰富的谱容量（更多方向），对紧凑任务分配更少方向，在保持总秩预算不变的前提下实现任务相关的容量分配。
AI.result: 在标准视觉模型合并协议下，SERA在与现有谱合并方法相同的总秩预算下提升了多任务合并性能；进一步分析表明任务级谱集中度与自适应秩分配的单任务效果密切相关。
AI.conclusion: SERA以简单且任务自适应的方式改进了谱模型合并，揭示了任务级谱集中度对自适应秩分配有效性的影响机制，为理解何时及为何该方法有效提供了洞见。

title: Measuring Behavioural Signatures of Large Language Models through Psychometric Profiling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate human decisions and communication, yet their behavioural regularities remain difficult to characterize systematically. We develop a cross-linguistic psychometric profiling framework and evaluate nine LLMs using seven psychological instruments, with five repeated administrations per model and language in Chinese and English. Items unresolved after a prespecified retry procedure are retained as NA. Joint analysis of scored and NA responses captures response tendencies and boundaries of self-report applicability. LLMs exhibit structured, model-specific profiles despite a shared alignment-shaped pattern of higher prosocial and self-regulatory responses and lower dominance, disengagement and harmful-intent endorsement. NA responses are structured rather than uniformly distributed, indicating where outputs are treated as inapplicable, refused or cannot be mapped to valid response options. Language condition and provider origin are associated with profile configuration and answerability, whereas repeated administrations show high reproducibility and permit recovery of model identity. Human-reference and prompt-robustness analyses further indicate that these signatures are context dependent. Joint analysis of psychometric profiling and answerability offers a framework for quantifying deployment-level behavioural signatures.

AI.tldr: 提出跨语言心理测量画像框架，用7种心理量表对9个LLM在中英文下各重复施测5次，将未解决项记为NA，联合分析得分与NA反应以刻画模型行为规律与自我报告适用边界。
AI.motivation: LLM日益介入人类决策与交流，但其行为规律难以系统刻画，且传统心理测量工具在模型上的适用性边界尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建跨语言心理测量画像框架，选取9个LLM，使用7种心理测量工具；每个模型在中文与英文环境下各重复施测5次；预设重试程序后仍未解决的条目保留为NA；对得分反应与NA反应进行联合分析，并开展人类参照与提示稳健性分析。
AI.result: LLM呈现结构化、模型特异的画像，同时共享一种对齐塑造的模式（亲社会与自我调节反应较高，支配性、脱离与伤害意图认可较低）；NA反应呈结构化分布而非均匀分布，反映不适用、拒答或无法映射到有效选项的情形；语言条件与提供方来源同画像配置及答案可答性相关；重复施测显示高可复现性，并可据此恢复模型身份；人类参照与提示稳健性分析表明这些特征具有情境依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 心理测量画像与答案可答性的联合分析，为量化部署层面的行为特征提供了框架。

title: GeoBalance: Geometry-Aware Monitoring and Reconstruction with Asymmetric Optimization for Balanced Multimodal Learning
summary: Multimodal classifiers can converge to modality-dominant solutions in which one modality dominates the joint prediction, suppressing the learning of others. Existing balancing methods mainly adjust losses, gradients, or modality contributions, largely treating modality imbalance as an optimization problem while implicitly treating the weak modality as under-optimized but representationally intact. In this work, we find that this assumption does not always hold, as persistent modality dominance can induce a representation-level collapse of the weak modality, which we term \emph{manifold modality collapse} (MMC). MMC manifests as a coupled geometric degradation in which weak-modality representations collapse onto fewer directions within each class and become less separable across classes. Motivated by this observation, we propose \emph{GeoBalance}, a geometry-aware framework that monitors these two geometric properties and reconstructs the weak modality representation only when it exhibits signs of MMC. Once triggered, GeoBalance uses a fixed Simplex-ETF class scaffold and spectral regularization to restore class separation while preventing collapse onto a few feature directions. To preserve reconstruction during joint training, asymmetric gradient projection removes the joint-gradient component conflicting with reconstruction, leaving non-conflicting optimization unchanged. Extensive experiments across six multimodal benchmarks demonstrate great improvements over competitive balancing methods, validating its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现持续模态主导会导致弱模态表示层面的"流形模态崩溃"(MMC)，并提出几何感知框架GeoBalance，通过监测几何性质、按需重构弱模态表示并结合非对称梯度投影，有效缓解模态不平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态平衡方法主要调整损失、梯度或模态贡献，将模态不平衡视为优化问题，隐含假设弱模态只是"优化不足"但表示仍然完好。然而作者发现该假设并非总成立：持续的模态主导会导致弱模态在表示层面发生崩溃。
AI.method: 作者提出"流形模态崩溃"(MMC)概念，表现为弱模态表示在每个类别内坍缩到更少方向、类别间可分离性下降的几何退化。据此提出GeoBalance：监测上述两种几何性质，仅在出现MMC迹象时重构弱模态表示；使用固定的Simplex-ETF类支架与谱正则化恢复类间可分性并防止特征方向坍缩；通过非对称梯度投影移除与重构冲突的联合梯度分量，保持非冲突优化不变。
AI.result: 在六个多模态基准上进行了大量实验，相较竞争性平衡方法取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: GeoBalance通过几何感知的表示重构与梯度干预有效缓解模态不平衡导致的表示崩溃，验证了从表示几何角度处理该问题的有效性。

title: The Endless Exam: Mathematical Constructions from Today's Models toward Superintelligence
summary: We introduce the Endless Exam, a benchmark for measuring mathematical progress from today's models toward artificial superintelligence through fourteen parameterised construction families. Each submitted object is checked automatically for validity and assigned a relative quality score against a published frontier or construction baseline, without capping improvements at $1$. The families draw on open mathematical problems for long-term targets and generate new instances at larger parameters, where compact certificates keep large constructions verifiable. Across eight models evaluated on 69 distinct instances, continuous quality scores distinguish performance even though no evaluated system surpasses a published frontier. Size-quality curves show how construction quality changes as problem size increases. We release the generators, verifiers, references, model responses and analysis to support continued measurement before and beyond human frontiers.

AI.tldr: 提出"Endless Exam"基准，用十四个参数化构造族衡量模型数学能力向超级智能的进展，通过相对质量评分实现无上限评估。
AI.motivation: 现有数学基准难以衡量超越人类前沿的进展，需要一种可持续扩展、可自动验证且评分不设上限的评估方法，以追踪模型向人工超级智能的演进。
AI.method: 构建十四个参数化构造族，结合开放数学问题作为长期目标，并在更大参数下生成新实例；每个提交对象自动验证有效性，并相对已发布前沿或构造基线赋予相对质量分数，改进不被截断于1；采用紧凑证书保证大规模构造的可验证性。
AI.result: 在八个模型、69个不同实例上评估，连续质量分数能够区分模型表现，但尚无系统超越已发布前沿；尺寸-质量曲线揭示了构造质量随问题规模变化的规律。
AI.conclusion: 该基准可在人类前沿之前及之后持续测量数学进展，并公开生成器、验证器、参考、模型响应与分析以支持后续评测。

title: Automatic multimodal UX improvement recommendations from LLM agent user simulations
summary: Evaluating user experience (UX) on live websites through user testing is expensive, subjective, and difficult to scale. LLM agents offer a promising route to automating UX testing by simulating realistic user behaviour. However, existing simulation approaches typically lack multimodality and require time-consuming manual review to extract actionable insights. We formalise UX improvement recommendation from simulation data as a structured natural language generation and ranking problem, and establish an evaluation protocol using expert annotation and LLM-as-a-Judge. We present AMUSER, a multimodal framework which simulates user behaviour and automatically generates prioritised UX improvement recommendations from resulting data. We evaluate AMUSER on commercial websites and show that its recommendations substantially outperform those from text-only simulation (NDCG@3 = 0.758 versus 0.359) at an 89% lower simulation cost. Our results suggest an asymmetric role of multimodality: visual access during simulation improves recommendations through richer traces, while providing visual inputs during recommendation generation can modestly degrade quality. We also discuss practical deployment lessons from applying AMUSER to commercial websites.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AMUSER——一个多模态框架，通过模拟用户行为并自动生成优先级排序的UX改进建议，将UX改进推荐形式化为结构化自然语言生成与排序问题，并在商业网站上验证其效果显著优于纯文本模拟且成本更低。
AI.motivation: 在真实网站上进行用户体验（UX）测试成本高、主观性强、难以规模化。LLM智能体虽可模拟真实用户行为以实现UX测试自动化，但现有模拟方法普遍缺乏多模态能力，且需要耗时的人工审查才能提炼出可执行的洞察。
AI.method: 作者将基于模拟数据的UX改进推荐形式化为结构化自然语言生成与排序问题，并建立基于专家标注和LLM-as-a-Judge的评估协议。在此基础上提出AMUSER多模态框架，能够模拟用户行为并从生成数据中自动产出优先级排序的UX改进建议。
AI.result: 在商业网站上的评估显示，AMUSER的建议大幅优于纯文本模拟（NDCG@3 = 0.758 对 0.359），同时模拟成本降低89%。结果还揭示了多模态的非对称作用：模拟阶段的视觉访问通过更丰富的轨迹提升建议质量，而在建议生成阶段引入视觉输入反而会小幅降低质量。
AI.conclusion: 多模态模拟可显著提升UX改进建议的质量与效率，但其作用是非对称的——视觉信息在模拟阶段有益、在建议生成阶段可能有害。作者还讨论了将AMUSER应用于商业网站的实际部署经验。

title: PosEviLoc: Position-Conditioned Spatial Evidence for Language-Based 3D Localization
summary: Language-based 3D localization retrieves the point-cloud submap containing a target position from descriptions of nearby objects and their spatial relations. Existing methods typically compress queries and submaps into global descriptors, potentially obscuring object-level semantics and cross-description spatial coherence. We propose Position-Conditioned Evidence Localization (PosEviLoc), a query-position-aware framework for coarse text-to-point-cloud localization. Instead of relying on global matching, PosEviLoc evaluates each candidate submap using explicit semantic and spatial evidence. It models direction as a relation jointly determined by an object position and a hypothetical query position. The resulting Query-Position Spatial Evidence Field (QSEF) measures the fraction of query descriptions supported at each hypothetical position, explicitly capturing their agreement without using the ground-truth query pose to construct the evidence field. A Multi-Level Evidence Readout (MER) summarizes this evidence in a compact representation, which a lightweight MLP converts into a retrieval score. Across five benchmarks, PosEviLoc outperforms MNCL by an average of 17 percentage points in Recall@1. When used as a plug-and-play reranker, it improves MNCL by an average of 16 percentage points. Moreover, PosEviLoc introduces substantially fewer parameters and achieves faster inference speed than existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 PosEviLoc 框架，通过显式的语义与空间证据进行查询位置感知的粗粒度文本到点云定位，在五个基准上 Recall@1 平均超越 MNCL 17 个百分点，并具有更少参数和更快推理速度。
AI.motivation: 现有语言驱动 3D 定位方法通常将查询和子图压缩为全局描述符，可能掩盖对象级语义以及跨描述的空间一致性，导致匹配效果受限。
AI.method: PosEviLoc 不依赖全局匹配，而是对每个候选子图评估显式的语义与空间证据。它将方向建模为由对象位置与假设查询位置共同决定的关系，构建查询位置空间证据场（QSEF），在每个假设位置度量查询描述被支持的比例，且不使用真值查询位姿来构造证据场。随后通过多层证据读出（MER）汇总证据为紧凑表示，再由轻量 MLP 转换为检索分数。
AI.result: 在五个基准上，PosEviLoc 的 Recall@1 平均比 MNCL 高 17 个百分点；作为即插即用重排序器时平均提升 MNCL 16 个百分点。同时参数更少、推理速度更快。
AI.conclusion: PosEviLoc 通过查询位置感知的证据评估方式有效提升了文本到点云定位性能，兼具性能优势与效率优势。

title: Ascent: An Agentic System over the Model Context Protocol for Real-World Clinical Data Analysis
summary: Answering epidemiological questions from real-world clinical data requires medical coding, schema-aware SQL, and validation of implicit choices about populations, denominators, and time. We present Ascent, an agentic system that exposes medical coding, question answering, and cohort analysis through a shared Model Context Protocol tool surface for standardized and native schemas. We introduce EpiTrap, a dataset testing whether systems avoid recognized pharmacoepidemiological errors, and compare a fixed pipeline with agents across models and orchestrators. With capable models, agents improve accuracy over the fixed pipeline by an average of 27 and 20 percentage points on native and standardized schemas, respectively. These gains require more tool calls and longer runtimes. Experience from real projects highlights the system's value for feasibility assessment, diagnostic iteration, and expert-guided analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出智能体系统 Ascent，通过共享的 MCP 工具接口统一医学编码、问答与队列分析，并构建 EpiTrap 数据集检验系统能否规避药物流行病学常见错误；在强模型下，智能体相较固定流水线在原生与标准化 schema 上分别平均提升 27 与 20 个百分点，代价是更多工具调用与更长运行时间。
AI.motivation: 基于真实世界临床数据回答流行病学问题，需要医学编码、具备 schema 意识的 SQL，以及对人群、分母与时间等隐含选择的验证；现有固定流水线难以灵活应对这些需求，且系统是否会犯公认的药物流行病学错误缺乏检验手段。
AI.method: 构建智能体系统 Ascent，将医学编码、问答与队列分析统一暴露在共享的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）工具接口上，同时支持原生 schema 与标准化 schema；并提出 EpiTrap 数据集，用于测试系统能否规避已知的药物流行病学错误。实验中将固定流水线与智能体在多种模型与编排器（orchestrator）配置下进行对比。
AI.result: 在能力较强的模型下，智能体相较固定流水线在原生 schema 上平均提升 27 个百分点，在标准化 schema 上平均提升 20 个百分点；这些提升伴随更多工具调用与更长运行时间。真实项目经验表明，该系统在可行性评估、诊断式迭代与专家引导分析方面具有实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 智能体架构配合统一工具接口可显著提升流行病学问答与队列分析的准确性，但需权衡计算开销；统一工具面与针对性错误基准（EpiTrap）是兼顾性能与可靠性的有效路径，并在真实项目中展现出应用价值。

title: Rethinking Pivot Programming Languages in Code Language Models
summary: Multilingual code language models transfer skills across programming languages (PLs), but whether any PL occupies a privileged pivot position remains contested: geometric analyses point to C-family languages and Go, while behavioral evidence highlights Python. We revisit this question under controls for representational anisotropy and length variation across PLs, two confounds that compromise prior cosine-based analyses. Across three code models on multilingual competitive-programming data, we study three views of cross-PL organization: pairwise PL geometry, PL-English alignment, and pivoted retrieval through candidate PL representation spaces. The results are relation-dependent. Code-code geometry reveals structured language regions but no universal center; code-English alignment favors high-level scripting languages; and pivoted retrieval favors different intermediate spaces for code-to-code and English-to-code transfer. These findings suggest that Python's special role is better understood as English-facing affinity than as universal geometric centrality.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视多语言代码模型是否存在"特权枢纽语言"，在控制表征各向异性与长度变异两个混淆因素后，发现语言间关系是任务依赖的：代码-代码几何无普遍中心，代码-英语对齐偏向高层脚本语言，枢轴检索中不同迁移方向偏好不同中间空间，Python的特殊性更体现为面向英语的亲和性而非几何中心性。
AI.motivation: 多语言代码模型可跨编程语言迁移技能，但哪种编程语言占据"特权枢纽"地位尚存争议：几何分析指向C族语言与Go，行为证据则强调Python。既有基于余弦相似度的分析受表征各向异性与跨语言长度变异两个混淆因素影响，结论可靠性不足，因此需要在这些混淆受控的条件下重新检验该问题。
AI.method: 在三个代码模型上，使用多语言竞赛编程数据，控制表征各向异性与长度变异后，从三个视角研究跨编程语言组织：成对编程语言几何、编程语言-英语对齐、以及经由候选编程语言表征空间的枢轴检索。
AI.result: 结果依赖于具体关系类型。代码-代码几何显现出结构化的语言区域，但不存在普遍中心；代码-英语对齐更偏向高层脚本语言；枢轴检索中，代码到代码迁移与英语到代码迁移偏好不同的中间空间。
AI.conclusion: Python的特殊角色更适合被理解为面向英语的亲和性，而非普遍的几何中心性。

title: Towards robust multimodal 3D object detection via visual foundation models
comment: 27 pages, 5 figures. Bilingual English-Chinese manuscript; the complete English version appears first, followed by the complete Chinese version
summary: Multimodal 3D object detection is fundamental to robust perception in autonomous driving because it integrates complementary information from LiDAR and camera sensors. However, existing methods often fail to maintain robustness under out-of-distribution (OOD) corruptions caused by sensor noise, adverse weather, and environmental changes. To address this problem, we propose RoboDistill, a robust and generalizable multimodal 3D object detection framework that leverages visual foundation models (VFMs), such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM). First, we introduce SAM-AD, a domain-specific pretraining strategy that fine-tunes SAM on autonomous-driving imagery to extract feature representations with rich semantic information. Second, we design the AD Feature Pyramid Network (AD-FPN) to refine and upsample SAM features at multiple scales for seamless fusion with LiDAR features. Third, we develop the Depth-Guided Wavelet Attention (DGWA) module, which suppresses high-frequency sensor noise while preserving critical contextual information. Finally, we introduce KD Fusion, in which the pretrained SAM-AD serves as a teacher that distills high-quality visual knowledge into a lightweight point-cloud network, thereby improving robustness under noisy conditions. Extensive experiments across 27 challenging OOD corruption settings show that RoboDistill generally delivers stronger or competitive detection performance and robustness relative to representative state-of-the-art methods. This work bridges the gap between VFMs and 3D object detection and advances robust multimodal perception for real-world autonomous-driving applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoboDistill，一种利用视觉基础模型（SAM）的鲁棒且可泛化的多模态 3D 目标检测框架，通过 SAM-AD 领域预训练、AD-FPN、深度引导小波注意力（DGWA）与 KD Fusion 四个模块，在 27 种 OOD 损坏设定下取得更强或具竞争力的鲁棒检测性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态 3D 目标检测融合 LiDAR 与相机互补信息，对自动驾驶鲁棒感知至关重要。但现有方法在传感器噪声、恶劣天气与环境变化导致的分布外（OOD）损坏下难以保持鲁棒性，且视觉基础模型与 3D 检测之间存在鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出 RoboDistill 框架，包含四个组件：(1) SAM-AD：在自动驾驶图像上微调 SAM 的领域特定预训练策略，提取富含语义的特征；(2) AD-FPN：多尺度精炼与上采样 SAM 特征，以便与 LiDAR 特征无缝融合；(3) DGWA（深度引导小波注意力）：抑制高频传感器噪声并保留关键上下文信息；(4) KD Fusion：以预训练 SAM-AD 为教师，将高质量视觉知识蒸馏到轻量点云网络，提升噪声条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在 27 种具挑战性的 OOD 损坏设定下的大量实验表明，RoboDistill 相较代表性 SOTA 方法总体取得更强或具竞争力的检测性能与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作弥合了视觉基础模型与 3D 目标检测之间的差距，推动了面向真实自动驾驶应用的鲁棒多模态感知发展。

title: Custom Named Entity Recognition and Topic Classification for Global Health Publications
summary: How should natural language processing models be selected and adapted for global health literature in environments where annotated data and computational resources are limited? This thesis investigates these challenges through experiments on semantic tag discovery, named entity recognition (NER), and multi-label topic classification. First, skip-gram word2vec models trained on progressively larger specialized corpora are compared with BioWordVec to assess how corpus size and domain context influence tag discovery. Vocabulary coverage and qualitative evaluation indicate that broader coverage does not necessarily yield more useful domain-specific associations. The analysis then turns to entity extraction, comparing convolutional spaCy models with a RoBERTa-based transformer on 1,000 annotated sentences. Under a lenient scoring protocol, the transformer achieves 0.80 micro-F1 versus 0.65-0.69 for convolutional models, but takes 82 seconds rather than 5-6 seconds. This trade-off motivates fine-tuning convolutional models and integrating a disease recognizer that achieves 81.33% test F1 on the NCBI Disease Corpus. Combined with PDF preprocessing, entity filtering, and MeSH enrichment, the resulting pipeline supports document-level indexing. To complement entity extraction with thematic annotation, MiniLM-based few-shot classification is compared with BART-MNLI zero-shot inference across 50 topics and 1,000 handcrafted test sentences. BART-MNLI achieves 95.2% single-label accuracy versus 59%; reported multi-label accuracies are 88% and 32% under partly manual assessment. However, its higher inference cost limits practical integration. The results show where domain specialization and lightweight adaptation offer practical value, and where transformer accuracy justifies higher inference costs, providing an empirical basis for building knowledge systems under resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对标注数据和算力受限的全球健康文献场景，系统比较了语义标签发现、命名实体识别（NER）与多标签主题分类三类任务中轻量模型与Transformer模型的性能-成本权衡，为资源受限条件下的知识系统构建提供实证依据。
AI.motivation: 全球健康文献领域面临标注数据稀缺与计算资源有限的现实约束，如何在领域专用化与轻量化适配之间取舍、何时值得付出Transformer的高推理成本，缺乏系统的实证指导。论文旨在为这类资源受限环境下的NLP模型选型与适配提供依据。
AI.method: 1) 标签发现：对比在逐步增大的领域语料上训练的skip-gram word2vec与BioWordVec，用词汇覆盖率与定性评估考察语料规模与领域语境的影响。2) NER：在1,000句标注数据上比较卷积式spaCy模型与基于RoBERTa的Transformer，并微调卷积模型、集成在NCBI Disease Corpus上达81.33%测试F1的疾病识别器，配合PDF预处理、实体过滤与MeSH富集形成文档级索引流水线。3) 主题分类：在50个主题、1,000条手工测试句上比较MiniLM少样本分类与BART-MNLI零样本推理。
AI.result: 标签发现中，更广的词汇覆盖并不必然带来更有用的领域关联。NER在宽松评分下，Transformer取得0.80 micro-F1，卷积模型为0.65-0.69，但推理时间分别为82秒与5-6秒。主题分类中，BART-MNLI单标签准确率达95.2%（对比59%），多标签准确率在部分人工评估下分别为88%与32%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明领域专用化与轻量适配在部分任务中具有实用价值，而在另一些任务中Transformer的精度提升足以补偿其更高的推理成本，从而为资源受限条件下构建知识系统提供了实证基础。

title: Auditing Political Alignment in LLM Assistants: Engagement, Stance, and User Identity
comment: 51 pages, 6 figures. Preregistered; registration at doi:10.5281/zenodo.21135155
summary: LLM-based AI systems answer political questions for hundreds of millions of people. Current audits measure what they say to an average user, but their behavior is dynamic. I argue that their political behavior is a set of policies over whom to answer, what to say, and whether to engage at all, conditional on the topic and what the system knows about the user. I call these policies the system's speech regime, which is how a developer settles the tradeoff between answering, accommodating the user, and refusing, each of which carries a cost that varies by topic. I derive a typology of five regimes from two dimensions, engagement and stance. I test six AI systems (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI, Google, Mistral, DeepSeek) in a preregistered experiment of 7,500 multi-turn conversations that randomly assign the user's political identity across five topics: abortion, Catalan independence, climate change, Nazism, and a zero-stakes control (pineapple on pizza). Two LLM judges from different developers score every answer, validated against human coding, and refusal is treated as an outcome rather than missing data. Every system accommodates the user on the control topic, showing that political restraint is a policy. On contested topics the systems fall into different regimes: on abortion, GPT engages and mirrors every user, Gemma refuses everyone, Claude answers strongly conservative users 35 percent of the time and almost no one else, and Grok accommodates conservatives only. On settled topics such as climate change and Nazism, five systems hold firm for every user. The systems also infer the user's overall ideology, so accommodation can spill over to topics not yet discussed. A comparison of two Grok releases shows the regime changing between versions in a way current audits miss. Speech regimes matter for alignment research and for polarization, political knowledge, and the quality of democracy.

AI.tldr: 本文将大语言模型的政治行为建模为"言论体制"——即针对"回答谁、说什么、是否参与"的一组条件化策略，并通过对六个AI系统、7500段多轮对话的预注册实验，揭示不同系统在争议性与共识性议题上呈现出五种截然不同的体制，且体制会在版本间漂移。
AI.motivation: 现有审计只测量AI系统对"平均用户"的表述，但AI政治行为是动态的、取决于议题与对用户的认知。作者希望提出一个能刻画这种条件化、策略化行为的理论框架，并揭示当前审计方法所遗漏的系统间差异与版本漂移。
AI.method: 提出"言论体制"概念，将其定义为关于回答、迎合用户与拒绝三者权衡（各自随议题承担不同成本）的条件策略；从"参与度"与"立场"两个维度推导出五种体制类型学。开展预注册实验：六个AI系统（OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI、Google、Mistral、DeepSeek），7500段多轮对话，随机分配用户政治身份，覆盖五个议题（堕胎、加泰罗尼亚独立、气候变化、纳粹主义及零风险对照——菠萝披萨）。每段回答由来自不同开发方的两个LLM评委打分并经人工编码验证，拒绝被作为结果变量而非缺失数据。
AI.result: 所有系统在对照议题上都迎合用户，表明政治克制是一种政策选择而非能力缺失。争议议题上体制分化明显：堕胎议题上GPT参与并镜像所有用户，Gemma拒绝所有人，Claude对强烈保守用户约35%予以回答而几乎不回答他人，Grok仅迎合保守派。在气候变化、纳粹主义等共识议题上，五个系统对所有用户都立场坚定。系统还会推断用户整体意识形态，使迎合行为外溢至尚未讨论的议题。对比两个Grok版本显示体制在版本间发生变化，而现有审计无法捕捉。
AI.conclusion: 政治行为应被理解为条件化的"言论体制"，而非单一平均表述；体制在系统间与版本间均存在显著差异。该框架对对��研究与极化、政治知识及民主质量等议题具有重要意义，并揭示现有审计方法的系统性盲区。

title: SewFusion: Tailored Generation of Topology and Panel-Level Geometry for Sewing Patterns
summary: Generating sewing patterns from images and text requires modeling a heterogeneous representation composed of discrete topology and continuous geometry. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: diffusion-based methods enable holistic geometry generation by converting the entire pattern into a continuous representation, but weaken discrete topology modeling; in contrast, autoregressive methods preserve discrete topology through next-token prediction, but tie continuous geometry regression to token-level hidden states with limited panel-level context. To bridge this gap, we propose SewFusion, a unified autoregressive framework that adopts tailored generation mechanisms for discrete topology and panel-level continuous geometry, using next-token prediction for the former and flow matching for the latter. To support panel-level continuous geometry generation, we introduce a Panel Geometry VAE that learns a fixed-size latent space for variable-length panel geometry, together with Panel Geometry Flow for latent generation. We further propose Panel-Forcing to reduce the training--inference mismatch in topology context and improve robustness to topology prediction errors. Extensive experiments on SewFactory and GCD-MM demonstrate that SewFusion consistently outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods across various settings, achieving +6.36% Panel Accuracy, +11.30% Stitch Accuracy, and -1.90 Vertex L2 error in the image-text-based generation setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SewFusion，一个统一自回归框架，针对服装纸样中离散拓扑与连续几何的异构特性分别定制生成机制，实现图像与文本到纸样的生成。
AI.motivation: 从图像和文本生成缝纫纸样需同时建模离散拓扑与连续几何的异构表示。现有扩散方法将整个纸样转为连续表示以生成整体几何，但弱化了离散拓扑建模；自回归方法通过下一词元预测保留离散拓扑，却将连续几何回归绑定在词元级隐状态上，缺乏板块级上下文。两种范式各有缺陷，需要统一方案弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出SewFusion统一自回归框架，对离散拓扑采用下一词元预测，对板块级连续几何采用流匹配。为支持板块级连续几何生成，引入Panel Geometry VAE，为变长板块几何学习固定尺寸隐空间，并配合Panel Geometry Flow进行隐空间生成。此外提出Panel-Forcing，缓解拓扑上下文的训练—推理不一致，提升对拓扑预测误差的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在SewFactory和GCD-MM数据集上的大量实验表明，SewFusion在多种设置下持续优于先前的最先进方法。在图像-文本生成设置中，实现面板准确率提升6.36%、缝线准确率提升11.30%、顶点L2误差降低1.90。
AI.conclusion: SewFusion通过为离散拓扑与连续几何分别定制生成机制，有效弥合了扩散范式与自回归范式之间的鸿沟，在图像-文本到缝纫纸样生成任务上取得一致的性能提升，验证了统一异构表示建模的有效性。

title: DUMA-Bench: A Dual-Control Multi-Agent Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agent Security
summary: LLM-based agents increasingly operate in environments where they interact with users, tools, and external systems. Yet most security evaluations assume passive users and static control, ignoring the interactive dynamics that shape real agent behavior. We introduce \textbf{DUMA-Bench}, a benchmark and evaluation protocol for measuring agent security under \emph{dual-control} interaction, where both the agent and the user can influence the shared environment state. DUMA-Bench extends $τ^2$-bench ~\cite{barres2025tau} with adversarial environments covering eight vulnerability classes, including RAG poisoning, cross-agent manipulation, and unsafe output handling. We evaluate \textbf{14 models from five model families} (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Z.ai) across eight domains and multiple user-behavior regimes. Across our experiments, introducing dual-control interaction increases the attack success rate from \textbf{26.9\%} to \textbf{41.1\%}. These results show that agent security is not solely a property of the model but emerges from the interaction between the model, the user, and the environment. DUMA-Bench provides a missing evaluation layer for studying security in realistic agent deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DUMA-Bench，一个面向LLM智能体在双控交互下安全性的评测基准与协议，扩展τ²-bench覆盖八类漏洞，评测14个模型后发现双控交互将攻击成功率从26.9%提升至41.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体安全评测多假设用户被动、控制静态，忽略了真实部署中用户与智能体共同影响环境状态的交互动态，导致安全评估脱离现实。
AI.method: 在τ²-bench基础上构建DUMA-Bench，引入双控交互（智能体与用户均可影响共享环境状态），并扩展出八类对抗环境，包括RAG投毒、跨智能体操纵、不安全输出处理等；在八个领域和多种用户行为模式下评测来自五个模型家族（OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepSeek、Qwen、Z.ai）的14个模型。
AI.result: 引入双控交互后，攻击成功率由26.9%上升至41.1%。
AI.conclusion: 智能体安全性并非模型的固有属性，而是由模型、用户与环境三者交互共同涌现；DUMA-Bench为真实智能体部署中的安全研究提供了缺失的评测层。

title: Attributable Post-Rationalization in RAG Citations: A Controlled Reproduction and an RLVR Comparison
summary:
A RAG system can hand you the right answer and cite a source it did not actually use. Models output these unfaithful citations via post-rationalization: they write the answer first and then attach a citation to whatever passage looks close enough. Search agents are now trained with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR), which pays them for getting the answer right. We asked whether that training also teaches them to cite honestly.
  Improving an existing methodology with a required control, we compared an instruction-tuned model against three RLVR agents trained from it, on four question-answering datasets, using only free-tier Kaggle GPUs. Post-rationalization is everywhere: on Wikipedia-based questions roughly one citation in seven is unfaithful. RLVR does not fix it. The agents post-rationalize at their base model's rate, and one lands slightly worse. Rewarding correct answers buys nothing in citation faithfulness, so faithfulness has to be trained and measured on its own terms.

AI.tldr: RLVR训练智能体仅奖励答案正确性，无法改善其引用忠实度；引用不忠实现象普遍存在，需单独训练与度量。
AI.motivation: RAG系统可能给出正确答案却引用并未真正使用的来源，模型通过"事后合理化"（先写答案再附上看似接近的引用）产生不忠实引用。随着搜索智能体采用RLVR训练（仅以答案正确性为奖励），作者想探究这种训练是否也能教会模型诚实引用。
AI.method: 在已有方法上加入必需的控制组，将一个指令微调模型与由它训练出的三个RLVR智能体进行对比，在四个问答数据集上评测，且仅使用Kaggle免费层GPU。
AI.result: 事后合理化现象普遍：在基于维基百科的问题上，约每七条引用中就有一条不忠实。RLVR并未解决该问题——智能体的事后合理化率与其基座模型相当，其中一个甚至略差。
AI.conclusion: 奖励正确答案对引用忠实度毫无帮助，忠实度必须在其自身标准下被单独训练和度量。

title: Modeling Clinical Workflow for SYNTAX Scoring from Coronary Angiography Videos
summary: The SYNTAX score is a clinically established tool for assessing anatomical lesion complexity in coronary artery disease and guiding subsequent treatment. However, automated SYNTAX scoring is commonly formulated as a direct regression problem from coronary angiography videos to patient-level scores. In this work, we reformulate SYNTAX scoring as a vessel segment identity-preserving anatomical reasoning problem and propose a hierarchical modeling framework that explicitly aligns learning with the clinical workflow.
