Our approach maintains vessel segment identity across frames and views, estimates stenosis severity at the segment level, and aggregates evidence hierarchically according to coronary anatomy. Simultaneously, to address the scarcity of domain-specific data, we integrate and complete multiple public coronary angiography datasets, constructing a large-scale resource featuring completed vessel segmentation and derived structural annotations. Experiments demonstrate that vessel segment-level stenosis embedding enhances explanatory power and reduces prediction variability compared to baseline models, with the R^2 score improving by 0.201 and dev STD decreasing by 18.4%. These results highlight the necessity of structure-aligned modeling for reliable and stable automated SYNTAX scoring from multi-view coronary angiography videos. The GitHub link is https://github.com/VersaceSu7/SYNTAX_score_777.

AI.tldr: 本文将SYNTAX评分从"冠脉造影视频→患者级分数的直接回归"重构为"血管节段身份保持的解剖推理问题",提出分层建模框架并整合多个公开数据集构建大规模资源。实验显示节段级狭窄嵌入使R²提升0.201、预测标准差降低18.4%。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化SYNTAX评分普遍被建模为从冠脉造影视频到患者级评分的直接回归,忽略了血管节段身份与冠脉解剖结构,导致预测可解释性差、稳定性不足;此外领域专用数据稀缺。
AI.method: 将SYNTAX评分重构为血管节段身份保持的解剖推理问题,提出与临床流程显式对齐的分层建模框架:跨帧与跨视图保持血管节段身份,在节段级估计狭窄严重程度,并按冠脉解剖结构分层聚合证据。同时整合并补全多个公开冠脉造影数据集,构建含完整血管分割与派生结构标注的大规模资源。
AI.result: 与基线模型相比,血管节段级狭窄嵌入提升了可解释性并降低了预测波动:R²提升0.201,预测标准差下降18.4%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明,面向多视图冠脉造影视频的可靠且稳定的自动化SYNTAX评分,必须采用结构对齐的建模方式。

title: Beyond Endpoint Performance: Process-Level Evaluation of Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Self-evolving agents convert interaction feedback into persistent artifacts, such as memories or skills, which in turn guide subsequent decisions. As these artifacts are iteratively updated throughout an experience stream, the capabilities they support may evolve. Consequently, endpoint performance alone offers an incomplete view of self-evolution. Process-level evaluation is therefore essential to identify when a target capability emerges and whether later updates strengthen, preserve, or weaken it. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{EvoPathBench}, a benchmark that tracks individual capabilities during artifact-level self-evolution. EvoPathBench fixes the base model, tools, freezes evolving artifacts at successive checkpoints, and evaluates the target capability on held-out episodes. This benchmark evaluates agent self-evolution using public trading data and calibrated trajectories. It tests three capabilities: generalization to unseen tasks, retention after unrelated learning, and rule adaptation to new evidence. Experimental results show that gains on similar unseen tasks often weaken under distribution shift, retention losses are concentrated in a minority of evolution paths, and no method achieves reliable rule adaptation. Moreover, while self-evolution enables agents to generate candidate artifacts with substantial held-out gains, the selected updates consistently fall short of realizing this potential. Together, these findings establish capability-level process evaluation as a foundation for analyzing self-evolution, identifying candidate evaluation and selection as key targets for improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoPathBench 基准，在产物级自进化过程中追踪单个能力，通过冻结演进产物、在留出数据上评估，揭示终点性能之外的演化过程。
AI.motivation: 自进化智能体将交互反馈转化为记忆、技能等持久产物并迭代更新，其支持的能力随之演化。仅看终点性能无法判断目标能力何时出现，以及后续更新是强化、保持还是削弱该能力，因此需要过程级评估。
AI.method: EvoPathBench 固定基础模型与工具，在连续检查点冻结演进产物，并在留出回合上评估目标能力；使用公开交易数据与校准轨迹，考察三种能力：对未见任务的泛化、无关学习后的保持、对新证据的规则适应。
AI.result: 相似未见任务上的增益在分布偏移下常被削弱；保持性损失集中在少数进化路径；无方法能实现可靠的规则适应。自进化能生成具有显著留出增益的候选产物，但所选更新始终未能实现该潜力。
AI.conclusion: 确立了能力级过程评估作为分析自进化的基础，并将候选评估与选择识别为关键改进目标。

title: Bridging Static and Agentic RAG for Taiwanese Historical Question Answering
summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enables language models to adapt retrieval based on previously retrieved evidence, but it remains unclear whether such adaptive orchestration consistently outperforms well-designed static pipelines. We conduct a controlled comparison of agentic and static RAG for Taiwanese historical question answering, sharing the same generator and hybrid retrieval backend. Despite similar aggregate performance, the two pipelines differ on 70.83% of questions, with their advantages largely canceling out when averaged. An oracle that selects the better response per question improves the composite score by 0.2417 over the better individual pipeline, revealing substantial headroom for question-level selection. We therefore introduce a post-hoc selector that compares the two responses and their cited evidence, significantly outperforming either individual pipeline and recovering 60.34% of the oracle headroom. These results show that aggregate comparisons can obscure meaningful question-level differences between retrieval strategies, suggesting that exploiting their complementarity may be more fruitful than seeking a universally superior pipeline.

AI.tldr: 在共享生成器和混合检索后端的受控设置下，智能体式RAG与静态RAG在台湾历史问答的总体表现相近，但在70.83%的问题上给出不同答案；作者提出事后选择器比较两种回答及其引用证据，显著优于任一单独流程，并恢复了60.34%的oracle增益。
AI.motivation: 智能体式RAG能够依据先前检索到的证据自适应调整检索，但其是否稳定优于设计良好的静态流程尚不明确；同时，总体聚合指标可能掩盖不同检索策略在具体问题层面的差异与互补性。
AI.method: 在同一个生成器与混合检索后端下，对台湾历史问答进行智能体式RAG与静态RAG的受控对比；构建逐题选择更优回答的oracle以衡量理论上限；提出事后选择器，通过比较两种回答及其引用证据进行问题级选择。
AI.result: 两种流程总体表现相似，但在70.83%的问题上存在差异，平均后优势基本相互抵消；oracle较更好的单一流程在综合得分上提升0.2417；事后选择器显著优于任一单独流程，并恢复60.34%的oracle增益。
AI.conclusion: 聚合层面的比较会掩盖检索策略之间有意义的逐题差异；与其追求普遍更优的单一流程，不如利用不同检索策略之间的互补性，通过问题级选择获得更优性能。

title: Transferring Visual Explanations: How Cross-Architecture Knowledge Distillation Affects Model Interpretability
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to AJOSR
summary: Deploying efficient neural networks is essential in resource-constrained environments, yet compact models often sacrifice interpretability - a critical in safety-critical domains such as autonomous driving and medicine. This study investigates whether Knowledge Distillation transfers the spatial feature attribution of a large teacher network to a compact student. To assess the influence of the KD scheme on interpretability, we distill a ResNet-152 teacher into a ResNet-34 student on ImageNet-1K across five configurations by systematically varying the distillation temperature and soft-label loss weight. Models are evaluated on top-1 accuracy, along with two interpretability metrics: Relevance Mass Accuracy and Relevance Rank Accuracy. These metrics are computed via Grad-CAM heatmaps benchmarked against ground-truth object masks. Our results show that top-1 accuracy ranges from 71.6% to 74.0%. For Grad-CAM, RMA ranges from 7.7% to 9.7% and RRA from 7.3% to 10.1%; for Guided Grad-CAM, RMA ranges from 16.1% to 18.6% and RRA from 15.9% to 21.5%. Interpretability proves far more sensitive to the soft-label weight than to the temperature: keeping the student anchored to hard labels preserves both accuracy and coarse localization, whereas weighting the teacher heavily degrades both. Fine-grained attribution, however, fell below the undistilled baseline in every configuration tested, indicating that logit distillation transmits where a model attends more readily than the pixel-level structure of that attention. We evaluate 12 cross-architecture combinations of convolutional and transformer-based models, revealing that the inheritance of fine-grained spatial reasoning is fundamentally bottlenecked by the student's intrinsic structural biases. To our knowledge, this is the first application of this interpretability-aware evaluation framework - previously used for neural network pruning - to KD.

AI.tldr: 本文将用于剪枝的可解释性评估框架首次应用于知识蒸馏，通过Grad-CAM热图量化ResNet-152→ResNet-34学生在ImageNet-1K上的空间特征归因迁移，发现可解释性对软标签权重远比对温度敏感，粗粒度定位可保留但细粒度归因普遍低于未蒸馏基线。
AI.motivation: 紧凑模型在自动驾驶、医疗等安全关键领域部署时常常牺牲可解释性。作者试图探究知识蒸馏（KD）能否将大教师网络的空间特征归因迁移给紧凑学生，并考察不同KD配置（温度、软标签损失权重）对可解释性的影响。
AI.method: 在ImageNet-1K上将ResNet-152教师蒸馏至ResNet-34学生，系统变化蒸馏温度与软标签损失权重，得到5种配置；评估top-1准确率及两项可解释性指标——Relevance Mass Accuracy (RMA)与Relevance Rank Accuracy (RRA)，指标基于Grad-CAM/Guided Grad-CAM热图并以真值目标掩码为基准；另评估12种卷积与Transformer模型的跨架构组合。
AI.result: top-1准确率为71.6%–74.0%。Grad-CAM的RMA为7.7%–9.7%、RRA为7.3%–10.1%；Guided Grad-CAM的RMA为16.1%–18.6%、RRA为15.9%–21.5%。可解释性对软标签权重远比对温度敏感：保持学生锚定硬标签可同时保存准确率与粗粒度定位，而过度加权教师会同时损害二者。所有配置下细粒度归因均低于未蒸馏基线。跨架构实验中，细粒度空间推理的继承从根本上受学生固有结构偏置的瓶颈限制。
AI.conclusion: KD的logit蒸馏更易传递“模型关注何处”，而难以传递该关注的像素级结构；粗粒度注意力可迁移，细粒度归因迁移受学生结构偏置根本制约。这是该可解释性感知评估框架（此前用于剪枝）在KD上的首次应用。

title: TimeLitmus: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Cross-Modal Understanding and Explanation Faithfulness in Event-Conditioned Time-Series Prediction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to make predictions from numerical time-series histories and textual events. Yet accuracy alone cannot reveal whether correct answers reflect effective integration of the two inputs or instead arise from event polarity, unimodal priors, or superficial cues. Likewise, plausible explanations may rationalize predictions without faithfully reflecting the evidence that drives model behavior. We introduce TimeLitmus, a diagnostic benchmark for cross-modal understanding and explanation faithfulness in event-conditioned time-series prediction. TimeLitmus contains 4,856 evaluation records across Finance and Traffic, combining natural prediction with controlled counterfactual and contrastive interventions, explanation-targeted faithfulness tests, and systematic shortcut controls. Across ten representative LLMs, standard prediction accuracy substantially overstates reliable cross-modal understanding: Hard Paired Contrast (HPC) pair correctness peaks at only 19.2% in Finance and 11.7% in Traffic, and all ten models show lower-than-expected consistency on Finance series-side controls. Models often recognize scenario relations explicitly yet fail to apply them during independent prediction. Explanation faithfulness shows a similar gap: in Traffic, most models cite the manipulated temporal factor in over 90% of cases, while behavioral support remains below 22%. Human annotators outperform LLMs on matched controlled and hard-pair diagnostics, confirming that these distinctions are recoverable from the inputs. Natural-only adaptation yields selective gains in evidence selection and input sensitivity, but not consistent gains in controlled or hard-pair behavior. The benchmark, evaluation suite, and supervised adaptation data will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 提出诊断基准TimeLitmus，揭示LLM在事件条件下的时间序列预测中，预测准确率严重高估了其跨模态理解与解释忠实度。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地用于基于数值时间序列历史与文本事件进行预测，但准确率本身无法说明正确答案是源于两类输入的有效融合，还是来自事件极性、单模态先验或表面线索；同时看似合理的解释可能只是为预测做合理化，并未忠实反映驱动行为的证据。因此需要一个能同时诊断跨模态理解与解释忠实度的基准。
AI.method: 提出TimeLitmus诊断基准，覆盖Finance与Traffic两个领域，共4,856条评估记录；结合自然预测、受控反事实与对比干预（含Hard Paired Contrast成对对照）、面向解释的忠实度测试以及系统性的捷径控制；对十个代表性LLM进行评测，并与人类标注者对比，同时评估自然-only适配的效果。
AI.result: 标准预测准确率显著高估了可靠的跨模态理解：Hard Paired Contrast成对正确率在Finance最高仅19.2%、Traffic仅11.7%；十个模型在Finance序列侧控制上的一致性均低于预期；模型常能显式识别场景关系却在独立预测时无法应用。解释忠实度存在类似差距：Traffic中多数模型在超过90%的情况下引用被操纵的时间因素，但行为支持率低于22%。人类标注者在匹配的受控与hard-pair诊断上优于LLM，说明这些区分可从输入中恢复。自然-only适配在证据选择与输入敏感性上有选择性提升，但在受控或hard-pair行为上未获一致增益。
AI.conclusion: LLM的预测准确率不能代表真实的跨模态理解与解释忠实度，二者均存在显著差距；TimeLitmus为系统诊断该问题提供了基准与评估套件，基准、评估套件及监督适配数据将公开释放。

title: From Concept Alignment to Causal Grounding: An Intervention Test of Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) can sound plausible yet be unfaithful to the model's underlying reasoning. Most prior work probes CoT faithfulness through input--output behavior or input attributions, leaving internal computation largely underexplored. We instead cast faithfulness as internal concept grounding: Does a large language model's (LLM) CoT reasoning engage the same internal concepts that support the LLM's direct prediction, and do the shared concepts causally drive its answer? Encoding a prediction pass and a CoT pass with a single shared sparse autoencoder (SAE), a reliable approximator of the latent concepts LLMs use, makes their internal concepts directly comparable. We introduce three correlational metrics of concept-level alignment and a causal metric, $Δp$, which ablates the shared concepts and measures the drop in answer probability. Across five LLMs and four datasets, concept alignment is generally high, as indicated by the correlational metrics; yet these only identify which concepts are shared, not how much they causally contribute. $Δp$ fills this gap: causal faithfulness varies substantially with model depth, peaking at mid-to-late layers rather than the final ones, and model scale reshapes the layer-wise profile. Moreover, causally important shared concepts are not always verbalized in the CoT. These dissociations suggest that faithfulness cannot be reliably assessed from surface-level or representational correspondence alone; assessing it requires causal tests of whether the internal concepts underlying a CoT actually drive the model's prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将CoT忠实性重新定义为"内部概念接地"，通过共享稀疏自编码器（SAE）对齐预测通路与CoT通路的内部概念，并设计相关性对齐指标与因果指标Δp，发现概念对齐普遍较高但因果忠实性随层深变化（中后层达峰），且因果关键概念未必在CoT中显式表达，说明仅凭表面或表征对应无法可靠评估忠实性。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT忠实性研究多基于输入—输出行为或输入归因，未充分探索模型内部计算；作者希望从内部概念层面检验CoT推理是否真正驱动模型预测。
AI.method: 用单一共享稀疏自编码器（SAE）分别编码预测通路与CoT通路，使两者内部潜在概念可直接比较；提出三个概念级对齐的相关性指标，以及因果指标Δp——通过消融共享概念并测量答案概率的下降幅度来量化因果贡献。
AI.result: 在5个LLM与4个数据集上，相关性指标显示概念对齐总体较高；但Δp表明因果忠实性随模型深度显著变化，在中后层达峰而非最后层，且模型规模会改变逐层分布。此外，因果重要的共享概念并不总在CoT中被显式表述。
AI.conclusion: 概念共享与因果驱动存在解耦，仅靠表面文本或表征对应无法可靠评估CoT忠实性，必须借助因果测试来检验CoT背后的内部概念是否真正驱动模型预测。

title: MaskVLA: Visual Masking Against Trajectory Overfitting of Vision-Language-Action Model
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate vision-language understanding with executable robot actions, enabling end-to-end learning for robot control. However, our empirical analysis reveals that existing models exhibit severe trajectory overfitting when finetuned on limited datasets. To guide the model in effectively utilizing wrist camera information, we propose MaskVLA, a masking-based fine-tuning strategy. By randomly masking a small portion of the main camera's visual information, the model is guided to autonomously learn more fine-grained, task-relevant, and effective visual features. This process leads to the emergence of robust policies, thereby enhancing the model's capability to tackle complex manipulation tasks and improving its generalization performance. Our method has been comprehensively evaluated on RoboTwin 2.0, achieving an average success rate improvement of 23.2% and 16.8% compared to $π_0$ and OpenVLA-OFT, respectively. Furthermore, experiments on real-world ALOHA robots also demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

AI.tldr: 提出MaskVLA，一种基于掩码的微调策略，通过随机遮挡主相机部分视觉信息，引导VLA模型自主利用腕部相机信息，学习更细粒度、任务相关的视觉特征，从而缓解轨迹过拟合并提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在有限数据集上微调时表现出严重的轨迹过拟合问题，无法有效利用腕部相机信息，导致策略鲁棒性不足、复杂操作任务表现与泛化能力受限。
AI.method: MaskVLA采用掩码式微调策略：在主相机视觉输入上随机掩蔽一小部分信息，迫使模型主动依赖并学习腕部相机所提供的细粒度、任务相关视觉特征，进而涌现出更鲁棒的策略。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0基准上，相较π₀与OpenVLA-OFT，平均成功率分别提升23.2%和16.8%；在真实ALOHA机器人上的实验也验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过掩码主相机视觉信息引导模型利用腕部相机特征，可有效缓解轨迹过拟合、增强复杂操作任务能力与泛化性能，兼具仿真与真机有效性。

title: World State Generator
summary: Language agents solve complex tasks through plans and actions. A single step the world refuses puts the goal out of reach, and what the agent does next decides the task. Prompted planners fail at exactly this point, rewriting the refused step in new words, meeting the same refusal, and burning the attempt budget without moving. They fail because the plan was never tied to the world, so a refusal has nothing in the plan to attach to. A world is where a task runs, and it has its own rules, its own admissible actions, and its own constraints. We build synthetic worlds across 7 domains and extract training data from them. A program enforces each world's rules and grades its goal, and every world is admitted only if its goal is reachable from its initial state. Agents run inside and leave verified failures paired with repairs that carried the run to a state the world certified, a record of about 226K trajectories. On this record we train the World State Generator, a model that writes a plan as checkable states of the world and keeps that plan aligned with the world it runs in. That alignment is what a plan written in language lacks, since the world it runs in has physical limits, logical dependencies, and required orders the language never states, and the plan encounters these rules only when a state fails. WSG takes that failure as the rule the world has stated and rewrites the remaining states to obey it, so the plan bends to the world as the run goes on. Across 7 public benchmarks, WSG raises end-to-end success for two open models near 30B parameters over prompting and brings to the level of proprietary model.

AI.tldr: 提出世界状态生成器（WSG），将计划写成可校验的世界状态，使计划在执行中被拒绝时能依世界规则重写，在7个公开基准上将约30B开源模型的端到端成功率提升至接近专有模型水平。
AI.motivation: 提示式规划器在步骤被世界拒绝时会用新措辞重写同一步骤、遭遇同样拒绝，徒耗尝试预算而无进展。根本原因在于计划从未与世界绑定，拒绝无处附着。
AI.method: 构建覆盖7个领域的合成世界并用程序强制规则、评测目标，仅接受目标从初始状态可达的世界；在其中运行智能体，收集约226K条经校验的失败—修复轨迹；据此训练世界状态生成器，把计划写成可校验的世界状态，并在状态失败时视其为世界给出的规则，重写剩余状态以持续对齐世界。
AI.result: 在7个公开基准上，对两个约30B参数的开源模型，相较提示方法将端到端成功率提升至接近30%，并达到专有模型水平。
AI.conclusion: 以可校验世界状态而非自然语言表达计划，并让计划随执行依规则动态调整，是弥合语言计划与世界约束之间鸿沟的有效途径。

title: Directing large language models to follow the letter or spirit of the law
summary: The distinction between the spirit and letter of the law is a central issue across research and everyday life, and a growing concern for building safe, intelligent machines. What is this distinction based on, and how can we develop machines that follow the intention behind a rule? We used targeted adaptation that made large language models prioritize the spirit or letter of the law. With minimal modifications, our method significantly changed LLM behavior across diverse measures, novel vignettes, real-world scenarios, and influential legal cases. An analysis of model internals revealed a low-dimensional space with three interpretable dimensions matching a formal pre-specified framework for the geometry of legal concepts. These findings show how legal thought in LLMs may be organized and directed.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定向适配使大语言模型分别优先遵循法律的精神或字面含义，发现该方法能以极小改动显著改变模型行为，并在模型内部揭示了与形式化法律概念几何框架吻合的三维低维空间。
AI.motivation: 法律的精神与字面（spirit vs. letter）之别是法学研究与日常生活中的核心问题，也日益成为构建安全、智能机器的关切。论文追问这一区分的基础是什么，以及如何让机器遵循规则背后的意图。
AI.method: 采用定向适配（targeted adaptation），使大型语言模型在"法律精神"与"法律字面"之间产生偏好；同时对模型内部表征进行分析（model internals），检验其是否呈现与预设定形式化框架一致的低维几何结构。
AI.result: 以极小的修改，方法在多种评测指标、新颖情境短文（novel vignettes）、真实世界场景及有影响力的法律案例上显著改变了LLM行为；内部表征分析揭示出一个低维空间，其三个可解释维度与预设定的法律概念几何形式框架相匹配。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现表明LLM中的法律思维可能是可组织、可引导的，为理解并调控机器对规则意图的遵循提供了依据。

title: G6D: Geometric Learning-Free RGB-D 6D Pose Solver for Robotic Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Corresponding author: Chuxiong Hu. Project page: https://ai4control.github.io/G6D-Project-Page
summary: 6D object pose estimation is fundamental to robotic manipulation and automation. Recent zero-shot methods have significantly improved generalization to unseen objects, but most still rely on large-scale pretrained models with substantial GPU computation and memory demands. These requirements complicate deployment on robotic platforms where perception, planning, and control share limited computational resources, while learned intermediate representations offer limited geometric interpretability for task-specific adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose G6D, a learning-free, geometry-driven RGB-D 6D pose solver. Given an RGB-D observation, an object instance mask, camera intrinsics, and a CAD model, G6D generates pose hypotheses through template-based geometric matching and refines them using silhouette and depth consistency, forming a purely geometry-driven pose estimation paradigm. This paradigm requires neither pretrained visual models nor target-specific training and preserves interpretable geometric representations throughout pose estimation. Moreover, adjustable hypothesis counts provide flexible accuracy-computation trade-offs, while a CPU-only configuration supports deployment without GPU resources. Experiments on LineMOD and five BOP19 datasets demonstrate advanced performance. Real-world pick-and-place experiments further demonstrate G6D's applicability to robotic manipulation. The complete project is publicly available at https://ai4control.github.io/G6D-Project-Page .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 G6D，一种无需学习、纯几何驱动的 RGB-D 6D 物体位姿求解器，通过模板几何匹配生成假设并利用轮廓与深度一致性精化，在 LineMOD 与五个 BOP19 数据集上取得先进性能，并支持 CPU 部署与真实机器人抓取任务。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本 6D 位姿估计方法虽提升了对未见物体的泛化能力，但多依赖大规模预训练模型，带来高昂的 GPU 算力与显存需求，难以部署在感知、规划、控制共享有限计算资源的机器人平台上；同时其学习到的中间表征几何可解释性不足，不利于任务特定适配。
AI.method: G6D 是一种无需学习、几何驱动的 RGB-D 6D 位姿求解器。输入包括 RGB-D 观测、物体实例掩码、相机内参和 CAD 模型。方法首先通过基于模板的几何匹配生成位姿假设，再利用轮廓一致性与深度一致性对其进行精化，形成纯几何驱动的位姿估计范式。该范式无需预训练视觉模型或目标特定训练，并在整个估计过程中保持可解释的几何表征；假设数量可调以权衡精度与计算量，且支持纯 CPU 配置部署。
AI.result: 在 LineMOD 与五个 BOP19 数据集上的实验展示了先进性能；真实世界抓取放置实验进一步验证了 G6D 在机器人操作中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: G6D 以纯几何、无学习的方式实现高泛化、可解释且低资源需求的 6D 位姿估计，兼顾精度与计算灵活性，适用于资源受限的机器人平台与真实操作任务。项目已公开。

title: Epi-Logic: A Conceptual Framework for Epistemic Runtime Control, Schema Validity Checking, and Controlled Accommodation in Autonomous AI Agents
summary:
Autonomous AI agents are increasingly deployed in areas where wrong decisions are hard to reverse. This paper examines schema mismatch: the condition in which an agent operates within an interpretive frame that no longer applies to the current context. Outputs produced under such a mismatch can appear internally consistent, linguistically plausible, and largely factually correct; output-quality metrics alone therefore capture the underlying loss of validity only partially.
  The paper introduces Epi-Logic, a conceptual framework for epistemic runtime control. It couples the detection of schema dissonance, a graduated reduction of autonomy, and the auditable switch to a validated schema. A schema is formalised as a tuple of variable space, expectation model, validity conditions, axioms, and metadata. The Epi-Score aggregates seven graded dimensions of epistemic dissonance; the temporal validity dimension D8, violations of the validity conditions G, and axiom violations are carried as separate categorical paths that are not offset against the aggregate.
  The architecture rests on a checking asymmetry: formalised validity conditions can be checked at runtime, whereas the correctness of many actions is established only ex post. The paper separates two architectural properties, a conditional result from sequential changepoint detection, and an empirical remainder. Eight falsifiable propositions with named baselines describe the transition to empirical validation. All propositions are empirically testable hypotheses, not established results.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Epi-Logic 概念框架，用于自主 AI 智能体的运行时认知控制：通过检测"图式错配"（schema mismatch），触发分级自主权削减并切换到经校验的图式，并以 Epi-Score 聚合七个维度的认知失调，其中时间有效性、有效性条件违反与公理违反作为独立分类路径不参与聚合抵消。
AI.motivation: 自主 AI 智能体日益部署于错误决策难以逆转的领域。当智能体所依赖的解释框架不再适用于当前情境时，即发生"图式错配"（schema mismatch）。此类错配下产生的输出往往内部自洽、语言上合理、且大体事实正确，因此仅凭输出质量指标只能部分捕捉其背后有效性的丧失。论文动机在于为这一被现有质量度量遮蔽的风险提供运行时控制手段。
AI.method: 提出 Epi-Logic 概念框架，将认知运行时控制分解为三个耦合环节：图式失调检测、自主权分级削减、以及可审计地切换至经校验图式。将图式形式化为五元组（变量空间、期望模型、有效性条件、公理、元数据）。用 Epi-Score 聚合七个分级维度衡量认知失调，其中时间有效性维度 D8、有效性条件 G 的违反、公理违反作为独立分类路径，不与聚合分数相互抵消。架构基于"检查不对称性"：形式化的有效性条件可在运行时检查，而许多动作的正确性只能事后确立。论文区分了两类架构性质——一个来自序贯变点检测的条件性结果，以及一个经验性剩余部分，并用八个带命名基线的可证伪命题描述向实证验证的过渡。
AI.result: 论文给出的并非已确立的实证结果，而是一套可检验的假设体系：八个可证伪命题及其命名基线，用于描述框架向实证验证的过渡。已形式化陈述的结果包括 Epi-Score 的七维聚合结构、三类独立分类路径的设计，以及基于检查不对称性的两类架构性质划分（序贯变点检测的条件性结果与经验性剩余）。
AI.conclusion: Epi-Logic 为自主智能体的认知运行时控制提供了概念框架，强调输出质量指标不足以捕获图式错配导致的效度丧失。框架通过可运行时检查的有效性条件、分级自主权削减和可审计的图式切换来应对检查不对称性。作者明确指出所有命题均为可实证检验的假设而非既定结果，后续工作需以八个可证伪命题和命名基线开展经验验证。

title: OmniEdu: Open Foundation Models for Learning and Teaching
summary: Educational foundation models must solve problems, understand curriculum structure, diagnose learner difficulties, and provide appropriate instructional support. Existing educational language models often focus on either problem solving or tutoring, with training mixtures organized by source or task rather than capability. We present OmniEdu, an open family of foundation models for K-12 learning and teaching. Its instruction-tuning corpus combines over 100 educational resources and general instruction sources, organized around four capabilities: subject competence, curriculum grounding, diagnostic reasoning, and pedagogical action and scaffolding. Our pipeline integrates deterministic cleaning, semantic auditing and rewriting, task-specific quality scoring, token-budgeted diversity selection, and pedagogical instruction assignment. It yields 69,999 examples and 15.96M supervised response tokens, including 60,951 education-specific examples. We fine-tune 4B, 9B, and 27B models and evaluate curriculum grounding, K-12 problem solving, and pedagogical tutoring, alongside general capability. Education-oriented tuning consistently improves all three educational benchmark groups across model scales. OmniEdu-27B achieves 63.12% EM and 76.69% F1 on K12-Bench, 85.89% on MathFish, 86.95% on EDUMATH, and 78.74% in MathTutorBench's Scaffold setting. It also achieves the highest Teaching average on LongTutor among the evaluated models, at 3.02. These results demonstrate the value of curated, capability-balanced supervision for adapting general language models to educational tasks spanning problem solving, curriculum understanding, and instructional support.

AI.tldr: OmniEdu 是一组面向 K-12 教与学的开源教育基础模型，通过按四种能力（学科胜任、课程 grounding、诊断推理、教学行动与 scaffolding）组织指令微调语料，并在 4B/9B/27B 规模上验证教育导向微调对三类教育基准的普遍提升。
AI.motivation: 教育基础模型需同时具备解题、理解课程结构、诊断学习困难并提供教学支持等能力，但现有教育语言模型多偏重解题或辅导之一，且训练数据按来源或任务组织，而非按能力组织，导致能力覆盖不均衡。
AI.method: 构建 OmniEdu 指令微调语料，整合 100+ 教育资源与通用指令来源，围绕四类能力组织；流程包含确定性清洗、语义审计与改写、任务特定质量打分、按 token 预算的多样性选择、教学指令分配。最终得到 69,999 条样本、15.96M 监督回答 token，其中教育专属样本 60,951 条。对 4B、9B、27B 模型进行微调，评测课程 grounding、K-12 解题与教学辅导，并考察通用能力。
AI.result: 教育导向微调在各模型规模上一致提升三组教育基准。OmniEdu-27B 在 K12-Bench 上达 63.12% EM、76.69% F1，MathFish 85.89%，EDUMATH 86.95%，MathTutorBench 的 Scaffold 设置 78.74%；在 LongTutor 上取得所评模型中最高 Teaching 平均分 3.02。
AI.conclusion: 经过策展、能力均衡的监督数据对将通用语言模型适配到解题、课程理解与教学支持等教育任务具有明确价值。

title: An Efficient and Effective Watermarking Scheme for the Protection of the Intellectual Property Rights of Video Generative Models
summary: The rapid development of video generative models (VGMs) has enabled the generation of highly realistic synthetic videos, raising concerns about the intellectual property rights (IPR) of these models. In particular, two closely related forensic tasks remain largely unaddressed: synthetic video verification (determining whether a video was generated by a protected VGM) and model ownership verification (determining whether a suspect VGM is an unauthorized copy of a protected VGM). In this paper, we propose a new in-generation watermarking scheme that can address the two verification tasks. First, a novel video watermarking network named VidMark is presented, which incorporates a two-scale discrete wavelet transform (DWT) decomposition and a global temporal attention block (GTAB) to enhance watermark robustness and imperceptibility. Second, we present a decoder-guided fine-tuning procedure. By leveraging the frozen VidMark decoder, this process enables VGMs to synthesize videos carrying an imperceptible, robust, and model-specific watermark. Finally, two verification frameworks are established to perform synthetic video verification and model ownership verification. Extensive experiments on representative VGMs demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves over 99% watermark extraction accuracy and 100% verification accuracy on both tasks, with negligible impact on video generation quality. Furthermore, the watermarks exhibit strong robustness against a comprehensive range of video-level and model-level attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"生成内嵌式"视频水印方案，包含VidMark水印网络与解码器引导微调流程，可同时完成合成视频验证与模型所有权验证，两项任务准确率均达100%。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型（VGMs）快速发展使合成视频高度逼真，引发其知识产权（IPR）保护问题。现有研究基本未涉及两个紧密相关的取证任务：合成视频验证（判断某视频是否由受保护的VGM生成）与模型所有权验证（判断嫌疑VGM是否为受保护VGM的未授权副本）。
AI.method: 1) 提出视频水印网络VidMark，引入两级离散小波变换（DWT）分解与全局时序注意力模块（GTAB），以提升水印鲁棒性与不可感知性；2) 提出解码器引导的微调流程，借助冻结的VidMark解码器，使VGM生成携带不可感知、鲁棒且模型专属水印的视频；3) 建立两个验证框架，分别执行合成视频验证与模型所有权验证。
AI.result: 在代表性VGM上的大量实验表明：两项任务的水印提取准确率超过99%，验证准确率达100%，且对视频生成质量影响可忽略；水印对广泛的视频级与模型级攻击均表现出强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该生成内嵌式水印方案以极低生成质量代价同时实现合成视频验证与模型所有权验证，并有较强抗攻击能力，为VGM知识产权保护提供了可行途径。

title: Construting Reverse Thinking: Developing Large Language Models' Reverse Thingking Ability
summary: When facing complex problems, humans tend to try various ideas for different issues. Human thinking patterns exhibit remarkable flexibility in adapting to diverse scenarios. GPT-o1, GPT-o3, and DeepSeek-R1 adopt long chain-of-thought models to address complex problems by increasing reasoning depth, which default to a forward reasoning mode. We conducted statistical analysis on the accuracy of different mathematical problem datasets on models of different scales, and found five reasons for errors: Insufficient solution-space coverage, Computational mistakes, Unverified assumptions, Ignoring constraint conditions, Maximum response length limitation. To address the above issues, we proposed a backward reasoning pattern construction method aimed at enhancing the model's reverse thinking ability and dynamic adaptability. First, we constructed an easy-hard two-stage Math dataset for training large models and gradually improving their inference ability at different difficulty levels. The dataset contains forward reasoning paths as well as backward reasoning paths. And a two-stage supervised fine-tuning process is applied to progressively train the model's backward reasoning capability. Furthermore, a fine-grained reward mechanism is developed, employing smoothed reward signals to strengthen the model's ability to autonomously select thinking modes during the reasoning process, thereby avoiding reward hacking. A linear-decay balanced sampling strategy is designed to maintain a balance between forward and backward reasoning path samples during training, enabling the model to converge quickly and stably. Experimental results show that our method significantly improves reasoning efficiency and accuracy in tasks such as mathematical proofs, offering a flexible and efficient reasoning paradigm for solving complex problems.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对现有长链思维模型（如GPT-o1、DeepSeek-R1）默认前向推理的局限，提出一种后向推理模式构建方法，通过易-难两阶段数据集、两阶段监督微调、细粒度奖励机制与线性衰减平衡采样策略，提升模型的逆向思维与动态适应能力，从而显著提高数学证明等复杂任务的推理效率与准确率。
AI.motivation: 人类在解决复杂问题时会针对不同问题尝试多种思路，思维模式具有高度灵活性。而当前的长链思维模型（GPT-o1、GPT-o3、DeepSeek-R1）主要依赖增加推理深度，且默认采用前向推理模式。作者通过对不同规模模型在多个数学问题数据集上的准确率进行统计分析，归纳出五类错误原因：解空间覆盖不足、计算错误、未验证假设、忽视约束条件、最大响应长度限制，因此需要提升模型的逆向思维能力与动态适应性。
AI.method: 1）构建易-难两阶段的数学数据集用于训练大模型，在不同难度层面逐步提升推理能力，数据集中同时包含前向推理路径与后向推理路径；2）采用两阶段监督微调，渐进式训练模型的后向推理能力；3）设计细粒度奖励机制，使用平滑奖励信号增强模型在推理过程中自主选择思维模式的能力，避免奖励劫持（reward hacking）；4）设计线性衰减平衡采样策略，在训练中维持前向与后向推理路径样本的平衡，使模型快速稳定收敛。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在数学证明等任务上显著提升了推理效率与准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为求解复杂问题提供了一种灵活且高效的推理范式，通过增强模型的后向推理能力与思维模式自主选择能力，弥补了前向推理模式的不足。

title: Chronologic: Measuring Language Models' Ability to Represent the Past
summary: Language models are appealing tools for research on the past. But to trust the evidence a model provides, researchers need to know whether its responses fit the period represented. Validation is challenging, because this is not a task living people ordinarily perform, and because many questions have multiple correct answers. We use historical texts to develop a benchmark for a model's representation of English-language contexts 1831-1930, relying on pairwise comparisons to multiple ground truths and strong distractors to score the hardest questions in an appropriately graduated way. We find that generative tasks are harder than discriminative ones; in fact, reasoning models can typically discern the weakness of their own generated answers. While models pretrained exclusively on historical text lead the pack when evaluated by answer likelihood, they cannot compete with commercial models in free generation. None of the models we tested represent historical contexts in a fully persuasive way yet, but progress toward that goal is evident.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个基于历史文本（1831–1930年英语语境）的基准，用于评估语言模型对历史语境的表征能力。基准采用多参考答案与强干扰项配对的对比方式，对最难的题目进行分级评分。结果显示：生成任务比判别任务更难；推理模型通常能识别自身生成答案的弱点；仅用历史文本预训练的模型在答案似然度评估中领先，但在自由生成上不及商业模型。
AI.motivation: 语言模型是研究历史的有力工具，但研究者要信任其提供的证据，就需判断模型回答是否符合所表征的历史时期。验证之所以困难，一是普通人日常并不执行此类任务，二是许多问题存在多个正确答案，缺乏合适评价手段。
AI.method: 利用历史文本构建基准，评估模型对1831–1930年英语语境历史背景的表征。采用与多个ground truth及强干扰项的成对比较，对最难的题目按适当梯度进行评分；并对比判别任务与生成任务，以及历史文本预训练模型与商业模型。
AI.result: 生成任务比判别任务更难；推理模型通常能辨别自身生成答案的弱点；仅用历史文本预训练的语言模型在答案似然度评估中表现领先，但在自由生成任务中无法与商业模型竞争。
AI.conclusion: 目前所测模型尚未能以完全令人信服的方式表征历史语境，但朝向该目标的进展已显而易见。

title: Collapse, Not Complexity: Failure-Conditioned Decomposition Repair for End-to-End Document Parsing
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: End-to-end document parsers increasingly offer an optional reasoning mode for complex pages. On a 180-page entropy-stratified discovery sample with one frozen 4B checkpoint, complexity is the wrong decision variable. Reasoning lowers mean quality by 2.21 Overall at 1.54x tokens; a preregistered input-only model cannot predict its signed benefit (held-out AUROC 0.47, indistinguishable from chance). The benefit concentrates on pages whose ordinary pass has already collapsed, and they do not look complex: shared collapses have lower layout entropy than healthy ones yet consume 19x the tokens as degenerate repetition that doubling the budget does not cure. Switching modes rarely repairs them: 83% recur under reasoning. We instead detect collapse from the ordinary-pass trace, decompose the page by projection, and re-parse each region. Repair gains 1.40 Overall (95% CI [0.68, 2.16]) at 1.13x tokens, replicates across three checkpoints, and, with all parameters frozen, gains 2.41 (CI [1.64, 3.46]) on the remaining 1,175 benchmark pages.

AI.tldr: 在端到端文档解析中，用"页面复杂度"决定是否启用推理模式是错误的决策变量；收益集中在普通解析已崩溃但外表并不复杂的页面上。作者改为从普通解析轨迹检测崩溃、按投影分解页面并分区重解析，以1.13倍token获得1.40 Overall提升，并在全部参数冻结下于1,175页基准上获得2.41提升。
AI.motivation: 端到端文档解析器普遍提供"推理模式"以应对复杂页面，但实践中缺乏可靠的启用判据。作者质疑"页面复杂度"这一直觉性决策变量，希望找到真正决定推理是否带来收益的因素，并据此设计更高效的替代方案。
AI.method: (1) 在180页熵分层发现样本上，使用一个冻结的4B检查点做对照实验，对比普通解析与推理模式的画质与token成本；(2) 预注册一个仅输入可用特征的模型，检验其能否预测推理的带符号收益（held-out AUROC校验）；(3) 分析崩溃页面的布局熵、token消耗与重复退化行为，并测试加大预算、切换模式是否可修复；(4) 提出替代流程：从普通解析轨迹检测崩溃，按投影分解页面，对每个区域分别重新解析。
AI.result: 推理模式平均降低画质2.21 Overall，token消耗为1.54倍；仅输入模型无法预测其收益（AUROC 0.47，接近随机）。收益集中在普通解析已崩溃的页面上，而这些页面并不显得复杂：共享崩溃页的布局熵低于健康页，却消耗19倍token，表现为加倍预算也无法治愈的退化重复；83%的崩溃在推理模式下复现。所提修复方法提升1.40 Overall（95% CI [0.68, 2.16]），token为1.13倍，在三个检查点上可复现；参数全部冻结时在剩余1,175页基准上提升2.41（CI [1.64, 3.46]）。
AI.conclusion: 页面复杂度不是启用推理的合适判据；推理的收益源于修复普通解析的崩溃，而非应对表面复杂性。基于普通解析轨迹的崩溃检测加区域分解重解析，是更廉价、更稳健且可复现的替代方案，并在大规模基准上验证了泛化性。

title: Convex AI Compositionality and the Governance of AI System Populations
summary: AI governance increasingly requires providers and public authorities to reason about multiple AI instantiations, alternative versions, and deployment configurations of multiple AI systems. Yet current regulation remains predominantly single-system-centric, acknowledging such multiplicity only sparsely without treating collections of related AI systems as governance objects. This creates an AI population governance problem: determining which instantiations can be meaningfully considered together and how their changing configurations can be represented and monitored. The first requirement has recently been addressed through trustworthiness-based accounts of AI identity. We address the second by introducing convex AI compositionality: a formal representation of the configurations generated by finite AI system populations that uses convex spaces. The core idea is that convex compositions of the operational states that a population of AI system instantiations may occupy over time are compatible with lifecycle reachability across the population and can preserve the formal identity relations between these systems. Well-known statistical and geometric constructions, such as weighted state distributions and convex hulls, become AI governance tools for distinguishing operational states, population weights, heterogeneity, and AI configuration change across different governance modes while remaining compatible, under stated conditions, with lifecycle reachability and AI identity. We illustrate our AI population governance framework through distributed healthcare deployments and controlled deployment of recruitment AI variants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"凸AI组合性"（convex AI compositionality）形式化框架，用凸空间表示有限AI系统总体在配置变化中可能占据的运行状态，以支持AI总体治理。
AI.motivation: 当前AI监管以单一系统为中心，仅零散地承认AI的多实例、多版本、多部署配置现象，未将相关AI系统的集合视为治理对象，由此产生"AI总体治理"问题：如何确定哪些实例可被有意义地归并考虑，以及如何表示和监测其不断变化的配置。
AI.method: 在基于可信度的AI身份理论解决"哪些实例可归并"的基础上，引入凸AI组合性：用凸空间形式化表示有限AI系统总体所生成的配置；核心是总体中各实例的运行状态随时间的凸组合，与整个总体的生命周期可达性（lifecycle reachability）相容，并能保持系统间的形式身份关系。将加权状态分布、凸包等统计与几何构造转化为治理工具。
AI.result: 加权状态分布与凸包等构造可用于区分运行状态、总体权重、异质性以及不同治理模式下的AI配置变化，并在给定条件下与生命周期可达性和AI身份相容。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为AI总体治理提供形式化基础，并通过分布式医疗部署与招聘AI变体的受控部署两个案例加以说明。

title: Low resource cross-modal alignment using HGNN to enhance speech representation
summary: Speech-text space alignment is a multimodal representation learning method consisting to map different speech and text into a shared representation space, leading to enrichment of the representation of each modality. Proposed architectures, such as SAMU-XLSR, typically follow a student/teacher framework, with the goal of fine-tuning an audio encoder to produce representations that closely match those of the text. In this way a speech representation is semantically enriched. However, such systems generally require large amounts of training data and considerable computational resource, making them difficult to apply to low resources languages under frugal constraints. The present work proposes a data-efficient space alignment method based on Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks and link prediction. The core idea is to leverage message passing to explicitly transfer information from the text modality to the speech modality, thereby reducing the need for large training datasets and intrinsically enriching the acoustic representations, all in a more interpretable manner. Although thoroughly explored for high-resource languages, word-level tasks in speech remain relevant for certain low-resource languages. Therefore, we conducted experiments on speech-text alignment at the word level using the TIMIT (English) dataset and Yemba (a Cameroonian language). Our approach yields results comparable to those of SAMU-XLSR, a state-of-the-art method, and even surpasses it for the Yemba language in the task of word retrieval, while using far fewer resources, demonstrating its power, frugality, and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于异构图神经网络与链接预测的数据高效语音-文本空间对齐方法，利用消息传递将文本信息显式迁移至语音模态，在TIMIT和Yemba词级任务上以更少资源取得与SAMU-XLSR相当甚至更优的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有语音-文本空间对齐方法（如SAMU-XLSR）多采用师生框架微调音频编码器以对齐文本表示，但通常需要大量训练数据和可观算力，难以适用于资源受限的低资源语言。因此需要一种数据高效、可解释且节俭的对齐方法。
AI.method: 提出基于异构图神经网络（Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks）与链接预测（link prediction）的数据高效空间对齐方法。核心思想是通过消息传递（message passing）将文本模态信息显式迁移到语音模态，从而减少对大训练集的依赖，并以更具可解释性的方式内在增强声学表示。
AI.result: 在词级语音-文本对齐任务上，使用TIMIT（英语）数据集和Yemba（喀麦隆语言）进行实验。所提方法结果与最先进方法SAMU-XLSR相当，并在Yemba语言的词检索任务上超越后者，同时所需资源远少于对方。
AI.conclusion: 该异构图神经网络对齐方法在低资源场景下展现出强大、节俭和高效的特点，验证了消息传递式显式跨模态信息迁移在减少数据与算力需求方面的有效性，为资源受限语言的语音-文本对齐提供了可行方案。

title: StyleAT: Defending Face Recognition Against Semantic Attacks
comment: Accepted at the 37th British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC 2026), Lancaster, UK. 14 pages main text plus 13 pages of appendices, 15 figures, 12 tables
summary: With face-recognition models now embedded in everyday authentication and surveillance, recent works have pinpointed a critical weakness: these models remain acutely vulnerable to adversarial semantic edits. I.e., adversarially produced semantic alterations to the input, such as slight aging or pose changes, can induce misclassifications. Certain existing attacks are powerful, but they can be computationally costly, rendering them inadequate for developing defenses (e.g., through adversarial training). To fill the gap, we introduce BoundStyle, a potent semantic attack operating in StyleGAN's rich latent space to maximize misclassification rates. Notably, BoundStyle achieves high attack success rates while being ${\sim}{\times}9.5$ faster than existing state-of-the-art attacks, making it suitable for adversarial training. Building on BoundStyle, we develop StyleAT, an efficient adversarial training scheme that incorporates low-budget attack variants yet defends against stronger and unseen semantic attacks. We evaluate on two datasets unseen during training and seven models, and find that StyleAT boosts robust accuracy against state-of-the-art attacks and outperforms common defenses in various settings.

AI.tldr: 提出BoundStyle语义对抗攻击，在StyleGAN潜空间中高效生成语义编辑，速度约为现有SOTA攻击的9.5倍；并基于此设计StyleAT对抗训练方案，提升对强语义攻击及未见攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 人脸识别模型已广泛用于身份认证与监控，但对其输入进行语义层面的对抗编辑（如轻微老化、姿态变化）即可导致误分类。现有语义攻击虽强，但计算开销大，难以支撑对抗训练等防御手段的开发，因此需要一种高效且强力的语义攻击方法。
AI.method: 1) BoundStyle：在StyleGAN丰富的潜空间中进行语义对抗攻击，以最大化误分类率为目标；2) 基于BoundStyle构建StyleAT：一种高效对抗训练方案，训练时仅使用低预算攻击变体，但旨在防御更强及未见过的语义攻击。
AI.result: BoundStyle在保持高攻击成功率的同时，比现有SOTA攻击快约9.5倍。在训练时未见过的两个数据集和七个模型上评估，StyleAT提升了对SOTA语义攻击的鲁棒准确率，并在多种设置下优于常见防御方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过在StyleGAN潜空间中高效生成语义对抗样本，BoundStyle兼顾攻击强度与效率，并可作为对抗训练的有效组件；StyleAT证明利用低预算攻击变体进行训练即可获得对更强、未见语义攻击的鲁棒性，为人脸识别语义鲁棒防御提供了可行路径。

title: GRUET: Quantifying Uncertainty of Agentic Reasoning-and-Acting Processes
summary: Agents have attracted considerably increasing attention due to the power of executing both Reasoning and Acting (ReAct) in open and dynamic environments. The ReAct process typically exhibits a multi-turn trajectory in which one drives Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate both reasoning chains and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner. However, agents often suffer from significant uncertainty, where identical tasks yield divergent trajectories; trajectories with higher uncertainty often produce incomprehensible behaviors, severely undermining agent credibility. This work conjectures that such trajectory-level uncertainty frequently stems from cumulative turn-level reasoning uncertainty induced by LLMs; the latter often exhibits a collection of branches of divergent reasoning chains and their resulting actions. Built upon this, we present the Graph-based Reasoning UncErtainty in Trajectories (GRUET) method for the uncertainty quantification of ReAct, comprising turn-level reasoning uncertainty quantification and trajectory-level uncertainty aggregation; the former precisely quantifies reasoning uncertainty via modeling the reasoning space spanned by potential reasoning branches as a graph and then approximating the reasoning space complexity with graph complexity, while the latter employs simple aggregation strategies for quantifying the overall trajectory credibility. Empirical evaluations across nine LLMs and five benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our proposed GRUET in terms of selective generation performance, measured by AUROC, AUPRC, and AUARC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRUET方法，用于量化ReAct智能体轨迹级不确定性：将轮级推理不确定性建模为图复杂度，并通过简单聚合策略得到轨迹级不确定性，在9个LLM和5个基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: ReAct智能体在开放动态环境中结合推理与行动，但常表现出显著不确定性：相同任务产生差异轨迹，高不确定性轨迹伴随难以理解的行为，严重损害智能体可信度。作者推测轨迹级不确定性源于LLM逐轮推理不确定性的累积，而轮级不确定性表现为发散推理链及其对应动作的分支集合。
AI.method: 提出GRUET（Graph-based Reasoning UncErtainty in Trajectories），包含两部分：(1) 轮级推理不确定性量化：将潜在推理分支张成的推理空间建模为图，用图复杂度近似推理空间复杂度；(2) 轨迹级不确定性聚合：采用简单聚合策略量化整体轨迹可信度。
AI.result: 在9个LLM和5个基准上进行实证评估，以AUROC、AUPRC和AUARC衡量的选择性生成性能验证了GRUET的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GRUET能够有效量化ReAct轨迹的不确定性，提升选择性生成表现，从而增强智能体可信度。

title: Enhancing speech representation learning with cross-modal knowledge transfer with HGNN under low resource settings: the case study of Yemba
summary: Acoustic representation learning is crucial for speech processing, yet low-resource languages (LRLs) face severe data scarcity, limiting the effectiveness of traditional and self-supervised methods. As a promising alternative, in this work, we propose to enhance acoustic representation trough a cross-modal transfer knowledge approach, based on heterogeneous graph neural networks (HGNNs), where acoustic and linguistic entities are modeled as distinct node types within a unified graph. Through message-passing mechanisms, linguistic nodes explicitly transfer knowledge to acoustic nodes, enabling structured and interpretable cross-modal information flow. To highlight this knowledge transfer and its benefits, we measured standard clustering metrics as an intrinsic evaluation of acoustic representation, and to emphasize applicability, we performed isolated-word recognition tasks using an English benchmark and a Cameroonian language dataset in low resources settings . Results demonstrate that acoustic representations consistently benefit from linguistic knowledge propagated through the graph. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of explicit cross-modal knowledge transfer for acoustic representation learning using HGNNs, highlighting a promising direction for speech representation in low-resource settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于异构图神经网络（HGNN）的跨模态知识迁移方法，将声学与语言实体建模为统一图中的不同节点类型，通过消息传递让语言节点向声学节点显式传递知识，以增强低资源语言的声学表征。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言（LRLs）面临严重的数据稀缺问题，限制了传统方法与自监督方法在声学表征学习上的效果，因此需要一种能借助其他模态知识来弥补数据不足的替代方案。
AI.method: 构建异构图神经网络，将声学实体与语言实体作为统一图中的不同节点类型；利用消息传递机制，使语言节点向声学节点显式地、可解释地、结构化地传递知识，实现跨模态迁移以增强声学表征。
AI.result: 以标准聚类指标对声学表征进行内在评价，并在低资源设置下使用英语基准与喀麦隆语言数据集进行孤立词识别任务；结果表明声学表征能持续受益于图中传播的语言知识。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首次利用 HGNN 实现面向声学表征学习的显式跨模态知识迁移，为低资源场景下的语音表征学习指出了一条有前景的方向。

title: PETR: Prompt Ensembling with Training-free Routing for Vision-Language Models
summary: Prompt learning efficiently adapts vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks, but gains on seen classes often come at the expense of generalization to unseen classes. To address this limitation, we propose prompt ensembling with training-free routing (PETR), whose key innovation is a carefully designed dual-prompt architecture: two complementary prompts are learned from different data and objectives to emphasize seen class discrimination and unseen-class generalization, respectively. During training, both prompts are fine-tuned using a shared frozen CLIP backbone, and statistical information is collected from the training set logits. At inference time, we determine the similarity of each test sample to seen data, and route the sample to the most appropriate prompt branch. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first prompt tuning framework that performs training-free adaptive routing based on statistical similarity. This design provides an interpretable routing signal and avoids common MoE-style routing pathologies, such as router training instability and load imbalance. Extensive experiments on 11 benchmark datasets demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms previous methods on both seen and unseen classes, achieving new state-of-the-art results.

AI.tldr: 提出PETR，通过双提示架构与免训练路由，兼顾已见类判别与未见类泛化。
AI.motivation: 提示学习适配视觉-语言模型时，已见类性能提升往往以未见类泛化能力下降为代价。
AI.method: 设计双提示架构：两个互补提示分别由不同数据和目标学习，强调已见类判别与未见类泛化；训练时在共享冻结CLIP骨干上微调，并从训练集logits收集统计信息；推理时计算测试样本与已见数据的相似度，路由到最合适的提示分支，实现免训练自适应路由。
AI.result: 在11个基准数据集上，框架在已见类和未见类上均持续优于先前方法，取得新的SOTA结果。
AI.conclusion: 首次提出基于统计相似度的免训练自适应路由提示微调框架，提供可解释路由信号，并避免MoE式路由的训练不稳定与负载不均衡问题。

title: MedRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Medical Agents via Clinically Aligned Self-Evolution
summary: Medical agents increasingly combine general reasoning models with specialized clinical tools, yet their capabilities remain largely fixed by what clinicians and engineers design before deployment. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a different paradigm in which agents learn from their own failures and autonomously expand their capabilities, but directly applying RSI to medicine introduces fundamental safety challenges. We introduce MedRSI, the first recursive self-improvement framework for medicine, which continuously transforms diagnostic failures into new clinical capabilities through tool composition and task-specific model training. Inspired by clinical practice, MedRSI introduces two mechanisms for clinically aligned self-evolution. Clinical-cost-aware failure prioritization directs improvement toward errors according to their potential clinical consequences rather than frequency alone. Fast discovery with slow registration separates rapid capability invention from conservative adoption, allowing new tools to enter the persistent agent only after demonstrating sustained benefit across subsequent patient cohorts. Across public glaucoma and heart disease benchmarks and two private clinical tasks, MedRSI progressively develops segmentation, measurement, prediction, multimodal reasoning, and generative capabilities, surpasses manually engineered medical agents, and autonomously discovers solutions to clinical problems not anticipated by its original designers. Our results show that medical agents need not remain constrained by capabilities specified before deployment: with clinically grounded mechanisms governing what to improve and what to retain, they can continuously construct, validate, and accumulate new capabilities from diagnostic experience. Code is available at https://github.com/ImprintLab/MedRSI.

AI.tldr: MedRSI是首个面向医学的递归自我改进框架，通过工具组合与任务专属模型训练，将诊断失败持续转化为新临床能力，并在多项基准上超越人工设计的医疗智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗智能体的能力在部署前由临床医生和工程师预先设定，部署后基本固定，难以自主扩展；而直接套用通用递归自我改进（RSI）范式又面临根本性的医疗安全挑战。
AI.method: 提出MedRSI框架，含两项受临床实践启发的机制：（1）临床成本感知的失败优先级排序，按潜在临床后果而非出现频率决定改进方向；（2）快发现—慢注册，将能力的快速发明与保守采纳分离，新工具需在后续患者队列中展现持续收益后才纳入常驻智能体。能力通过工具组合与任务专属模型训练获得。
AI.result: 在青光眼与心脏病公开基准及两项私有临床任务上，MedRSI逐步发展出分割、测量、预测、多模态推理与生成能力，性能超过人工工程化的医疗智能体，并能自主发现原设计者未预见的临床问题解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 医疗智能体不必受限于部署前设定的能力边界；在"改进什么、保留什么"由临床依据驱动的机制约束下，它们可从诊断经验中持续构建、验证并积累新能力。

title: Euston: Training Away Mathematical Sycophancy Without Losing the Mathematics
summary: Reasoning language models are trained to produce solutions, not to refuse them, and this bias persists when the problem they are handed is false. Asked to prove a corrupted theorem, a strong model will typically comply and produce a confident derivation of something untrue. We present Euston, an 8B mathematical claim-verification model trained to resist exactly this. Training data were generated with GraphSynth, a probabilistic factor-graph generator that couples attribute-level diversity to decode-time structural masking and span-synchronized verification, yielding 3{,}026 matched true/corrupted statement pairs (6,052 statements) drawn from arXiv papers spanning 2010--2025. We fine-tuned DeepSeek-R1-8B with GRPO under a rule-based, zero-API reward for 189 steps on four H100 GPUs. On a balanced 200-true/200-false held-out split, balanced accuracy rises from 29.50% to 63.75% and the discrimination gap---the difference between the rate of calling false statements false and the rate of calling true statements false moves from -0.5% (z=-0.1) to +27.5% (z=+6.0). Critically, the gain is not purchased with general mathematical ability: AIME 2026 accuracy under official semantics is 65.00% against a 69.17% base, a difference of -4.17% that is not statistically significant, whereas an earlier run of the same recipe on a smaller GraphSynth corpus collapsed to 40.00%. Median response length also falls from 19,217 to 18,296 tokens and the truncation rate from 25.8% to 8.3%, so the improvement does not come from thinking longer. We report the result together with the confounds that bound its interpretation, principally the all-false composition of the official evaluation sets and the low precision implied at realistic error prevalence.

AI.tldr: 提出8B数学命题验证模型Euston，通过GraphSynth生成真假配对数据并以GRPO微调DeepSeek-R1-8B，使模型对伪造定理的判别能力显著提升，且不损害通用数学能力、不依赖更长推理。
AI.motivation: 推理语言模型被训练为"给出解答"而非"拒绝解答"，这一偏向在题目本身错误时依然存在：面对被篡改的定理，强模型往往会顺从地给出自信但错误的推导。作者希望构建一个能抵抗这种顺从偏差的数学命题验证模型。
AI.method: 数据端：GraphSynth——一种概率因子图生成器，将属性级多样性与解码时的结构掩码、跨度同步验证相耦合，从2010—2025年arXiv论文中生成3,026对匹配的真/伪陈述（共6,052条）。训练端：在4块H100上，用规则式、零API的奖励对DeepSeek-R1-8B进行189步GRPO微调。评测端：使用200真/200伪的平衡留出集，并在AIME 2026官方语义下检验通用数学能力，同时统计响应长度与截断率。
AI.result: 平衡准确率从29.50%提升至63.75%；判别差距（把假陈述判为假的比例减去把真陈述判为假的比例）由-0.5%（z=-0.1）升至+27.5%（z=+6.0）。通用数学能力未被牺牲：AIME 2026准确率65.00%，对照基座69.17%，差值-4.17%且不具统计显著性；而同一配方在更小GraphSynth语料上的早期运行曾坍缩至40.00%。中位数响应长度由19,217降至18,296 tokens，截断率由25.8%降至8.3%，说明提升并非来自"想得更久"。
AI.conclusion: Euston证明可以通过数据合成与规则奖励微调，使推理模型获得对伪造数学命题的判别性拒绝能力，并保持通用数学性能。但作者同时指出限制结论解释力的混淆因素，主要是官方评测集全为假陈述的构成，以及在真实错误发生率下所隐含的低精度。

title: PREM: Prefix-Steered Recurrent Memory for Long-Video Understanding
summary: Long-video understanding must capture transient visual evidence under strict token budgets, yet existing methods compress frames, append memory tokens, or alter internal key-value (KV) caches. We introduce Prefix-Steered Recurrent Memory (PREM), a memory-token-free framework for frozen vision-language models (VLMs). PREM separates video ingestion from query answering: a recurrent writer distills visual streams into a compact 256 KiB multi-slot associative state, while a question-conditioned readout adds memory-derived key/value (K/V) steering modulations to existing non-visual prompt prefixes during prefill. This enables write-once, query-many inference without extra prompt tokens or decoding recurrence. Across six long-video benchmarks in offline and streaming end-of-stream settings, PREM consistently outperforms frozen baselines at every evaluated visual budget. Under a constrained budget of 16 frames, PREM improves macro-average accuracy by 3.06% on Qwen2.5-VL-3B, with gains of 11.0% on action antonym identification and 9.9% on localized needle retrieval. These gains require tuning 0.24% of backbone parameters at 0.03 GiB of peak GPU memory overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出PREM，一种无需记忆令牌的框架，通过循环写入器将视频流压缩为紧凑关联状态，并用问题条件读出在预填充阶段对前缀施加K/V调制，实现冻结VLM的长视频理解。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解需在严格令牌预算下捕捉瞬态视觉证据，但现有方法（压缩帧、追加记忆令牌、修改内部KV缓存）存在局限。
AI.method: PREM将视频摄入与问答分离：循环写入器把视觉流蒸馏为256 KiB多槽关联状态，问题条件读出在预填充时向现有非视觉提示前缀添加记忆派生的K/V调制，支持一次写入多次查询。
AI.result: 在六个长视频基准的离线和流式端到端设置中，PREM在每个视觉预算下均优于冻结基线。16帧预算下，Qwen2.5-VL-3B宏平均准确率提升3.06%，动作反义词识别提升11.0%，局部化针检索提升9.9%。仅需调优0.24%主干参数，峰值GPU显存开销0.03 GiB。
AI.conclusion: PREM以极低的参数与显存代价，在无需额外提示令牌或解码循环的前提下，显著提升冻结VLM的长视频理解性能。

title: Extracting Arguments, Not Just Classifying Them: Instruction-Tuned LLMs for Generative Component Detection
summary: Argumentative component detection (ACD) is a core subtask of Argument(ation) Mining (AM) and one of its most challenging aspects, as it requires jointly delimiting argumentative spans and classifying them into components such as claims and premises. While research on this subtask remains relatively limited compared to other AM tasks, most existing approaches formulate it as a simplified sequence labeling problem, component classification, or a pipeline of component segmentation followed by classification. In this paper, we propose ITFACD, a novel approach based on instruction-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) using compact instruction-based prompts, and reframe ACD as a language generation task, enabling arguments to be identified directly from plain text without relying on pre-segmented components. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that our approach achieves higher performance compared to state-of-the-art systems. To the best of our knowledge, this is one of the first attempts to fully model ACD as a generative task, highlighting the potential of instruction tuning for complex AM problems. Our code and the datasets used are openly available in the following GitHub repository.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ITFACD，将论证成分检测（ACD）重构为语言生成任务，基于指令微调的大语言模型（LLM）与紧凑指令提示，无需预分割成分即可直接从纯文本识别论证，在标准基准上超越当前最优系统。
AI.motivation: ACD是论证挖掘（AM）的核心且最具挑战性的子任务，需同时界定论证文本跨度并将其分类为claim、premise等成分。相比其他AM任务，ACD研究相对有限，现有方法多将其简化为序列标注、成分分类，或"先分割后分类"的流水线，存在简化建模与误差传播问题。
AI.method: 提出ITFACD方法：采用指令微调的大语言模型（instruction-tuned LLM），设计紧凑的基于指令的提示（compact instruction-based prompts），将ACD重构为语言生成任务，使论证能够直接从纯文本中被识别，不依赖预先分割的成分。
AI.result: 在标准基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比当前最优系统（state-of-the-art systems）取得了更高的性能。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首批将ACD完全建模为生成式任务的尝试之一，凸显了指令微调在复杂论证挖掘问题上的潜力。代码与所用数据集已在GitHub仓库公开。

title: ChemCLIR-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval in Multilingual Chemical Patents
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Industry Track. 22 pages including references and appendices; 7 pages of main text
summary:
Cross-lingual information retrieval (CLIR) is increasingly important in multi-national industries, where critical technical evidence may exist in a different language than the query. However, existing benchmarks do not adequately capture domain-specific cross-lingual retrieval or the retrieval-depth and recoverability failures that aggregate recall hides.
  In this work, we benchmark CLIR in the chemical domain, with a focus on patent data. We construct a multilingual dataset from Google Patents and the European Patent Office (EPO) data, spanning five languages (covering major Eastern and Western languages) and reflecting the diversity and complexity of real-world industrial documentation.
  Using this dataset, we systematically evaluate eight state-of-the-art embedding models for cross-lingual retrieval. Our results show a substantial performance gap between monolingual and cross-lingual settings: for the best-performing model, Recall@10 drops from 0.72 to 0.53 in cross-lingual setting. Retrieval depth also degrades significantly, with relevant documents ranked lower across languages in cross-lingual scenarios. Furthermore, some multilingual embedding models that perform strongly in monolingual settings exhibit sharp declines when queries and documents are in different languages, providing practical insights for model selection in cross-lingual use cases.
  These findings highlight critical limitations of current approaches and emphasize the need for more robust cross-lingual retrieval methods in domain-specific settings. Our benchmark provides actionable insights for model selection and establishes a controlled diagnostic evaluation framework for CLIR over industrial technical text. Data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/MohammadKhodadad/Multi-Lingual-QAC.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了化学/专利领域的多语言跨语言检索数据集，系统评测八个嵌入模型，发现跨语言相比单语言性能显著下降。
AI.motivation: 多国产业中关键技术证据可能与查询语言不同，跨语言信息检索（CLIR）日益重要。然而现有基准未能充分体现领域特定的跨语言检索需求，且聚合召回率掩盖了检索深度与可恢复性方面的失败。
AI.method: 基于Google Patents与欧洲专利局（EPO）数据构建多语言数据集，涵盖五种语言（含主要东西方语言），反映真实工业文档的多样性与复杂性。在此数据集上系统评测八种最先进的嵌入模型在跨语言检索中的表现，并引入检索深度等受控诊断评估。
AI.result: 单语言与跨语言设置间存在显著性能差距：最佳模型Recall@10从0.72降至0.53。检索深度也明显退化，相关文档在跨语言场景中排名更靠后。部分在单语言中表现强劲的多语言嵌入模型在查询与文档语言不同时性能急剧下降。
AI.conclusion: 当前方法在领域特定跨语言检索中存在关键局限，亟需更鲁棒的方法。该基准为模型选择提供可行洞见，并建立了面向工业技术文本CLIR的受控诊断评估框架，数据与代码已公开。

title: Beyond UV Mapping: Mesh Texture Compression via Surface-Aligned Texture Fields
summary: Mesh texture compression typically relies on 2D UV atlases, whose chart discontinuities and mapping overhead can limit coding efficiency. To tackle this challenge, we introduce TexF, a surface-aligned texture field that organizes texture attributes in sparse voxels derived from the mesh surface. This representation supports high-resolution textures while preserving local 3D correlations for compression and enabling direct surface queries. For bitstream compression, TexF reuses established 3D attribute codecs, with voxel locations reconstructed from the decoded mesh without separate transmission. For GPU-resident compression, we develop 3DNTC, which combines quantized hash features with a lightweight decoder for random-access reconstruction at surface positions. Differentiable rendering enables image-space refinement of both voxel attributes and compressed neural fields. Experiments on the MPEG and AOM mesh compression benchmarks demonstrate improved average rate-distortion performance over representative UV-based methods for both bitstream and GPU-resident compression. 3DNTC also supports real-time rendering.

AI.tldr: 提出表面对齐纹理工件TexF，用稀疏体素组织纹理属性，改善网格纹理压缩效率，并开发GPU友好的3DNTC实现实时渲染。
AI.motivation: 传统网格纹理压缩依赖2D UV图集，其图表不连续和映射开销限制了编码效率。
AI.method: TexF将纹理属性组织在由网格表面导出的稀疏体素中，保持局部3D相关性并支持表面直接查询；比特流压缩复用现有3D属性编解码器，体素位置由解码网格重建而无需单独传输；GPU端提出3DNTC，结合量化哈希特征与轻量解码器实现表面位置的随机访问重建；利用可微渲染进行图像空间精化。
AI.result: 在MPEG和AOM网格压缩基准上，比特流和GPU常驻压缩的平均率失真性能均优于代表性UV方法；3DNTC支持实时渲染。
AI.conclusion: 表面对齐纹理场表示可有效规避UV图集缺陷，在两类压缩场景中提升率失真性能，并兼顾实时渲染能力。

title: Partner-Specific Affective Precision in Social Active Inference
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures. Accepted as a full paper at the 7th International Workshop on Active Inference (IWAI 2026). Code: https://github.com/har5h1l/affect_aif
summary: In multi-agent social settings, model reliability varies across relationships. Beyond inferring what others will do, an agent must calibrate how confidently those inferences should guide policy selection for each relationship. An agent may maintain a well-validated model of one partner, a fragile model of another, and a model under revision for a third; collapsing these into a single confidence estimate loses information relevant to policy selection. We therefore formalize affective precision as a relationship-specific metacognitive estimate of confidence in the current partner model. Each partner's behavioral evidence updates a local confidence estimate that modulates policy precision during selection, regulating how strongly current beliefs are expressed in policy rather than changing the content of those beliefs. Simulations in a multi-partner graded trust game show that partner-local affective precision influences behavior primarily through policy commitment rather than direct improvement of partner-state inference. Because the mechanism tracks partner-response predictability rather than realized payoff, greater confidence produces sharper policy commitment without necessarily producing higher rewards. Under abrupt shifts in social behavior, confidence accumulated from previously reliable predictions can remain behaviorally active after the relationship changes, showing that confidence revision can lag behind social change. Finally, varying precision gain and priors produce distinct trust-calibration dynamics, showing how confidence accumulation and revision depend on model parameters. Together, these results show how relationship-specific affective precision can distinguish social prediction from social policy commitment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"情感精度"(affective precision)概念，即针对特定关系的元认知置信度估计，用于调节策略选择时对当前伴侣模型的依赖程度，而非改变信念内容。
AI.motivation: 多智能体社会环境中，模型可靠性随关系而异。智能体可能对某伴侣拥有验证良好的模型、对另一伴侣只有脆弱模型、对第三个伴侣模型仍在修正中。若将这些情况压缩为单一置信度估计，会丢失与策略选择相关的信息。因此需要形式化关系特异性的元认知置信度。
AI.method: 将情感精度形式化为对当前伴侣模型置信度的关系特异性元认知估计。每个伴侣的行为证据更新局部置信度估计，该估计在策略选择时调节策略精度，调控当前信念在策略中表达的强度。通过多伴侣分级信任博弈(graded trust game)进行仿真，并考察精度增益与先验参数变化的影响。
AI.result: 伴侣局部情感精度主要通过策略承诺(policy commitment)而非直接改善伴侣状态推断来影响行为。由于机制追踪的是伴侣反应可预测性而非实际收益，更高置信度会带来更锐利的策略承诺，但不必然带来更高回报。在社会行为突变时，基于先前可靠预测累积的置信度在关系改变后仍保持行为活跃，表明置信度修正可能滞后于社会变化。精度增益与先验的变化产生不同的信任校准动态。
AI.conclusion: 关系特异性情感精度能够区分社会预测(social prediction)与社会策略承诺(social policy commitment)，为社会认知中的元认知机制提供了关系层面的解释框架。

title: SoK: Formal Methods for Fact-Checking and Information Integrity
summary: An automated fact-checking system returns a label: the claim is true, or it is false. In many such systems the verdict remains the primary output. What is generally missing is a record of which document settled the question, of what would have had to be different for the verdict to change, or of whether the same claim, reworded, would have been judged the same way. We call the missing piece a warrant: a separate statement of what was guaranteed and on what grounds. Formal methods produce evidence of this kind, and regulation is beginning to ask for it, since the Digital Services Act and the AI Act both call for auditable evidence about how systems behave. Surveys of automated fact-checking are usually organised by pipeline stage, and treat logic as one technique among many. We organise the field by what is being formalised instead, which gives five levels: the claim, the reasoning, the system doing the checking, the ecosystem the claim spreads through, and the regulatory obligation. Sorting 121 works into those levels, two patterns stand out. Most of the relevant formal machinery already exists, but it was built for other domains and has rarely been applied here, and the gap is widest for verifying the checking system itself. Several stages of the routine professional fact-checkers follow also have no stated correctness criterion, and two of them, writing a claim in checkable form and correcting a verdict already published, are not formally specified in any work we coded. We close with open problems, each with a suggested first step.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以"warrant（依据）"为核心梳理自动化事实核查领域：现有系统多只输出真/假标签，缺少可审计的判定依据（用何文档定案、何种条件下结论会改变、改写后判定是否稳定）。作者以"被形式化的对象"而非流水线阶段为分类标准，将121篇工作分为五个层级（claim、reasoning、checking system、ecosystem、regulatory obligation），指出形式化工具多借自其他领域、验证核查系统本身的缺口最大，并给出开放问题及起步建议。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化事实核查系统以判定标签为唯一主要输出，缺少支撑结论的证据记录：未记录是哪份文档决定了判定、在什么条件下结论会翻转、同一主张改写后是否得到一致判定。与此同时，形式化方法本可提供这类证据，且DSA与AI Act等监管要求对系统行为提供可审计证据。既有综述多按流水线阶段组织并视逻辑为众多技术之一，因此需要一个以"被形式化对象"为轴的新组织方式，以识别真实缺口。
AI.method: 作者提出"warrant（依据）"这一概念，即关于"保证什么、依据什么"的独立陈述；据此以"被形式化的对象"为标准重构领域分类，划分五个层级：主张本身（claim）、推理过程（reasoning）、执行核查的系统（checking system）、主张传播的生态（ecosystem）、监管义务（regulatory obligation）。作者按此框架对121篇文献进行编码归类并统计缺口分布。
AI.result: 两个显著模式：其一，多数相关形式化机制已经存在，但原本为其他领域构建，很少被应用于事实核查；其中"验证核查系统自身"的缺口最大。其二，职业事实核查员常规流程的若干阶段缺乏明确的正确性判据，特别是"将主张改写为可核查形式"与"对已发布判定进行更正"这两步，在所编码的工作中没有任何一篇给出形式化规范。
AI.conclusion: 自动化事实核查应以可审计的"依据（warrant）"作为补充输出，以满足监管与可信性需求。领域应按被形式化对象组织，五层级框架揭示了工具迁移不足与系统自验证缺口。作者最后给出开放问题清单，并为每个问题提出可行的第一步建议。

title: Compact Low-Cost Hyperspectral Imaging via Angular-to-Spectral Diversity Conversion
summary: Snapshot hyperspectral imaging avoids sequential scanning, but systems that jointly achieve stable reconstruction, low cost, and compact optics remain limited. We present a snapshot hyperspectral imaging system based on angular-to-spectral diversity conversion. A tapered kaleidoscope creates replicated views with distinct incidence directions, and a directly attached birefringent filter converts them into view-channel-dependent spectral transmittances, yielding complementary measurements that better condition the inverse problem for more stable single-shot spectral reconstruction. The system preserves a simple pixel-wise linear model for fast non-learning-based reconstruction and uses only off-the-shelf components without relay optics or cascaded modules. We select the birefringent filter configuration using a condition-number-based criterion and validate the system on both synthetic and real data.

AI.tldr: 提出基于角度-光谱多样性转换的快照高光谱成像系统，利用锥形万花筒与双折射滤光片实现稳定单帧光谱重建。
AI.motivation: 快照高光谱成像可避免逐点扫描，但现有系统难以同时满足重建稳定、低成本与光学紧凑三项要求。
AI.method: 采用角度-光谱多样性转换机制：锥形万花筒产生具有不同入射方向的复制视图，紧贴的双折射滤光片将其转换为随视图通道变化的光谱透过率，从而获得互补测量以改善逆问题条件；保持简单的逐像素线性模型以支持快速非学习类重建，仅使用现成元件，无需中继光学或级联模块；并依据条件数准则选择双折射滤光片配置。
AI.result: 在合成数据与真实数据上均完成验证，系统可稳定实现单帧光谱重建。
AI.conclusion: 该方案以低成本、紧凑结构实现了稳定重建，为快照高光谱成像提供了一种简洁有效的实现路径。

title: Pinocchio: Fast Uncertainty Estimates for Black-Box Language Models
summary: In high-stakes decision-making applications of large language models (LLMs), practitioners require not only accurate LLMs but also uncertainty estimates for their predictions. Existing approaches to uncertainty estimation for LLMs require access to log-probabilities output by the model or require fine-tuning access. However, many industrial LLM products use closed-source API models, and many such API models like GPT do not return log-probabilities and may not allow fine-tuning. We introduce Pinocchio, an external calibrator that estimates the correctness of responses from black-box API models. Trained jointly on responses from seven LLMs, it achieves 0.862 AUROC predicting the correctness of held-out responses from those same models, and shows zero-shot transfer to thirteen unseen models across eight organizations. Our model needs only a single forward pass to generate an uncertainty estimate and requires no access to the target model's logits, weights, or internal states. A lightweight text only 0.8B checkpoint matches our largest model's AUROC. We release code for adding uncertainty estimation to existing repos in only two additional lines of code.

AI.tldr: 提出Pinocchio，一种仅需黑盒API文本输出即可估计LLM回答正确性的外部校准器，单次前向即可给出不确定性，训练于七个LLM的回答并零样本迁移到十三个未见模型。
AI.motivation: 高风险决策场景下使用LLM不仅需要准确预测，还需要不确定性估计，但现有方法依赖log-probabilities或微调权限；许多工业级闭源API（如GPT）不返回log-probabilities且不允许微调，导致这些方法无法适用。
AI.method: Pinocchio是一个外部校准器，仅基于黑盒API模型输出的文本回答估计其正确性。它在七个LLM的回答上联合训练，不访问目标模型的logits、权重或内部状态，仅需单次前向即可产生不确定性估计；同时提供一个轻量级0.8B纯文本checkpoint作为可选实现。
AI.result: 在相同七个模型的留出回答上预测正确性达到0.862 AUROC，并零样本迁移到八个机构的十三个未见模型；0.8B轻量checkpoint的AUROC与最大模型持平；仅需额外两行代码即可将不确定性估计集成到已有代码库。
AI.conclusion: Pinocchio为闭源黑盒API模型提供了一种无需log-probabilities和微调的通用不确定性估计方案，具备跨模型零样本迁移能力与低部署成本，便于实际工业场景快速集成。

title: Judging a Review by its Cover: A Reliability Analysis of LLM-based Peer Review Evaluation Metrics
summary: Peer-review evaluation is increasingly being automated with LLM-as-a-judge metrics, but this creates a measurement risk. A review may receive a high score because it is fluent, organized, and polished, rather than because it provides a strong evaluation of the paper. This risk is especially important in AI-assisted reviewing, where reviewers may use LLMs to improve clarity or presentation while preserving the underlying judgments. We propose a statistical framework for testing whether peer-review evaluation metrics capture substantive review quality beyond surface-level linguistic form. The framework compares original human reviews with faithful LLM rewrites that preserve the same evaluative content while changing wording and presentation. Using a dataset comprising 4,044 meaning-preserving rewrites derived from 674 human reviews from ICLR and NeurIPS, we evaluate 29 content-oriented peer-review evaluation metrics drawn from four prior works through complementary tests of surface sensitivity and robustness. Although these metrics are intended to capture review properties beyond surface-level, writing-dependent characteristics, we find that sensitivity to rewriting is widespread. Under our primary analysis, 23 metrics assign significantly different scores to reviews whose evaluative content is preserved, while only six satisfy our robustness criterion. The patterns are largely consistent across two LLM judge models, suggesting that the issue is not specific to a single judge. These findings show that many peer-review evaluation metrics partially conflate review quality with linguistic presentation, and indicate that robustness to meaning-preserving rewriting should be validated before such metrics are used to compare human-written, AI-assisted, and AI-generated reviews.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出统计框架，用"意义保持的LLM改写"检验同行评审评价指标是否真正衡量实质评审质量。基于674篇ICLR/NeurIPS审稿的4,044条改写，测试29个指标，发现23个对改写敏感，仅6个满足稳健性标准。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-judge式自动评审评价存在测量风险：审稿可能因语言流畅、结构清晰而获高分，而非因为评价实质上更优。在AI辅助评审场景下，审稿人可借助LLM改善表达而保留原有判断，这一风险尤为突出，因此需检验现有指标是否超越了表层语言形式。
AI.method: 构建统计检验框架，将原始人类审稿与"忠实LLM改写"对比——改写保持相同评价内容，仅改变措辞与呈现方式。使用ICLR与NeurIPS的674篇人类审稿生成的4,044条意义保持改写，对来自4项先前工作的29个内容导向评审评价指标，进行表层敏感性与稳健性的互补检验。
AI.result: 尽管这些指标旨在捕捉超越表层、依赖写作的特征，但对改写的敏感性普遍存在。主分析下，23个指标对评价内容相同的审稿给出显著不同的分数，仅6个满足稳健性标准。该模式在两种LLM评判模型下大体一致，说明问题并非源于单一评判者。
AI.conclusion: 许多同行评审评价指标将评审质量与语言呈现部分混淆。在用于比较人类撰写、AI辅助与AI生成审稿之前，应对指标进行意义保持改写下的稳健性验证。

title: Reassessing Global Gradient-Norm Imbalance in BLIP Fine-Tuning Across Physical Domains
comment: 10 pages, 14 figures. Supplementary material included as ancillary file
summary: Imbalanced gradient magnitudes between the visual and language pathways of a vision-language model are often treated as a defect to be corrected. We test that premise for one family of correction, deliberately excluding adaptive, signal-driven schemes (e.g. BalGrad, OGM, PMR, CGGM), which are a mechanistically distinct class outside this study's scope. Measuring the language-to-visual gradient-norm ratio, reported in parameter-normalised form, across nine fine-tuning conditions, three seeds, and three captioning datasets spanning distinct physical domain shifts -- underwater, aerial, radiological -- we find imbalance magnitude varies markedly across domains with no predictable ordering. A plain learning-rate reduction cuts imbalance substantially and lands within a few BLEU points of the best method on every dataset. Staged freezing reduces the ratio on every domain yet never ranks first; a schedule-only control isolates freezing as the cause on one dataset but not the other two. Forcing the two gradient groups to equal magnitude drives per-parameter imbalance close to zero on every domain, yet is both the best result in the study and the worst placement among full fine-tuning methods, on different datasets, with identical settings. Reductions in gradient-norm ratio do not consistently predict captioning performance across domains, and how a given level of balance is reached matters as much as the level itself. As a secondary finding, a commonly reused LoRA configuration applied to BLIP silently adapts zero visual parameters; correcting it improves BLEU-4 on all three datasets.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验了"视觉-语言模型两条通路梯度幅度不平衡是缺陷、需要纠正"这一前提。作者在9种微调条件、3个随机种子、3个跨物理域偏移（水下、航空、放射）的图像描述数据集上测量语言/视觉梯度范数比，发现不平衡幅度随域显著变化且无稳定排序；降低学习率可大幅减小不平衡且性能接近最优方法；强制两组梯度等幅虽几乎消除不平衡，却在不同数据集上分别表现为最优和最差；梯度范数比与描述性能之间无一致预测关系，达致平衡的方式与平衡程度同样重要。附带发现：常用的LoRA配置在BLIP上实际未适配任何视觉参数。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型中视觉与语言通路的梯度幅度不平衡通常被视为需纠正的缺陷，各类梯度平衡/修正方法据此被提出。作者意在检验这一前提是否成立，并明确界定研究范围：只考察非自适应的修正手段，排除BalGrad、OGM、PMR、CGGM等自适应、信号驱动类方案，因为它们在机制上属于本研究范围之外的独立类别。核心疑问是：减小梯度不平衡能否稳定带来下游描述性能的提升。
AI.method: 测量参数归一化形式的语言-视觉梯度范数比（language-to-visual gradient-norm ratio），覆盖9种微调条件、3个随机种子、3个跨物理域偏移的图像描述数据集（水下、航空、放射）。对比的修正手段包括：朴素学习率降低、分阶段冻结（staged freezing）、仅调节schedule的对照组、以及强制两组梯度等幅（per-parameter imbalance趋零）。同时对一种被广泛复用的LoRA配置在BLIP上的行为进行核查。
AI.result: 梯度不平衡幅度跨域差异显著且无可预测排序。朴素学习率降低大幅削减不平衡，并在每个数据集上距最佳方法仅差几个BLEU点。分阶段冻结在每个域都降低了比率，但从未排名第一；schedule-only对照仅在三个数据集中的一个上确认冻结是原因，另外两个则不然。强制两组梯度等幅使逐参数不平衡在各域都接近零，但在相同设置下，该方法在不同数据集上分别是最佳结果和全量微调方法中最差的名次。梯度范数比下降不能一致地预测描述性能。次要发现：一个常被复用的LoRA配置在BLIP上静默地适配了零个视觉参数，修正后三个数据集的BLEU-4均提升。
AI.conclusion: 梯度幅度不平衡并非普遍意义上的缺陷，其大小随域变化且无可预测规律；降低不平衡水平与提升描述性能之间无稳定因果关系，'多平衡'并不等于'更好'。不同数据集/域下，实现平衡的具体路径（学习率、冻结、强制等幅）带来的效果差异巨大，甚至相反。因此，'达致平衡的方式'与'平衡的程度'同等重要。此外，常规LoRA配置可能存在静默失效（未适配视觉参数）的隐患，值得核查与修正。

title: A Global Comparison of Schemas, Transparency, and Interoperability in Public-Sector AI Registers and Inventories
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) registers and inventories aim to make governmental AI visible, but their institutional scope, schemas, and reporting practices construct different representations of public-sector AI. We compare 8,368 records from country-specific and transnational inventories covering 72 countries. Across 23 harmonized fields, registers shared a descriptive core but rarely requested information about appeals, risks, legal bases, or external evaluation. We found that broad schemas often contained substantial missingness, schema similarity showed no significant patterned convergence, and multiple sources covering the same jurisdictions overlapped only selectively. Based on these findings, we synthesize a layered visibility framework that shows how register records reflect disclosure arrangements and why interoperability requires shared concepts, clear definitions, and preserved provenance.

AI.tldr: 该文比较了覆盖72个国家的8,368条公共部门AI登记/清单记录，发现各类登记在23个统一字段上仅有描述性核心共识，普遍缺失申诉、风险、法律依据与外部评估信息；宽泛的字段设计伴随大量缺失值，字段相似性无显著趋同模式，同一辖区多来源记录仅选择性重叠。作者据此提出分层可见性框架。
AI.motivation: AI登记与清单旨在使政府AI变得"可见"，但其制度范围、字段模式与报告实践会构造出不同的公共部门AI表征。现有研究缺乏跨国家、跨类型登记册的系统比较，因而无法判断这些可见性工具究竟在多大程度上可比、可互操作，以及它们实际披露了什么、隐藏了什么。
AI.method: 跨国、跨类型的登记册比较研究。收集并整合来自国别与跨国AI清单的8,368条记录，覆盖72个国家；将其映射到23个统一（harmonized）字段上进行编码与比较分析，考察字段内容、缺失程度、字段模式相似性以及同一辖区内多来源记录的重叠情况。
AI.result: 各登记册共享一个描述性核心字段集，但很少要求填报申诉机制、风险、法律依据或外部评估等信息；宽泛的字段模式往往伴随显著缺失值；字段相似性分析未显示显著的趋同模式；覆盖同一辖区的多个来源之间仅存在选择性重叠，而非一致性重复。
AI.conclusion: AI登记册的记录并非中性镜像，而是反映特定披露安排与制度选择的产物。实现登记册之间的互操作性需要共享概念、清晰定义和保留来源（provenance）。作者据此综合出分层的"可见性框架"，用以解释登记记录如何生成以及为何难以直接比较。

title: Knowing When to Trust Images: Reliability-Aware Multi-modal Entity Alignment
summary: The visual modality, i.e., images, plays a key role in multi-modal entity alignment (MMEA). Existing approaches often directly fuse the image with other modalities to align different entities. Although simple, such strategies overlook the potential noise in the images and their semantic misalignment with corresponding entities, resulting in suboptimal fusion and degraded performance. Addressing this, we propose a novel Reliability-Aware framework for MMEA (RA-MMEA), which assesses visual reliability and adaptively improves unreliable visual representations for robust entity alignment. The core lies in two modules, including dependency-aware visual reliability prediction (DA-VRP) and stability-regularized visual embedding generation (SR-VEG). The former aims to estimate the reliability of an image by leveraging multi-modal dependency within the entity, while the latter focuses on producing alternative visual representation conditioned on semantics encoded in textual modalities for multi-modal fusion. Compared to current methods, RA-MMEA enables more reliable visual representations for modality fusion, thereby improving performance. In extensive experiments, RA-MMEA achieves state-of-the-art results, verifying the importance of reliable visual modality for entity alignment and the effectiveness of RA-MMEA. The code and results will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可靠性感知的多模态实体对齐框架RA-MMEA，通过评估并修复不可靠的视觉表示来提升对齐性能，实验达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态实体对齐方法通常直接融合图像与其他模态，忽略了图像中潜在的噪声以及图像与对应实体之间的语义错位问题，导致融合效果不佳、性能下降。
AI.method: RA-MMEA包含两个核心模块：依赖感知的视觉可靠性预测（DA-VRP），利用实体内部的多模态依赖关系估计图像可靠性；以及稳定性正则化的视觉嵌入生成（SR-VEG），基于文本模态编码的语义生成替代视觉表示以用于多模态融合。
AI.result: 在大量实验中，RA-MMEA取得了最先进（SOTA）的结果，验证了可靠视觉模态对实体对齐的重要性以及该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: RA-MMEA通过提供更可靠的视觉表示用于模态融合，显著提升了多模态实体对齐性能，代码与结果将公开。

title: Why Do Video Diffusion Models Violate Physics? Unveiling the Flaws in Attention Mechanisms
summary: Despite impressive visual quality, state-of-the-art video diffusion models often generate content that violates real-world physical laws. While existing solutions rely on external priors or specialized data, we investigate the root cause by exploring the internal mechanisms of these models. Specifically, we present the first interpretability study on the ''motion planning'' process of text-to-video diffusion models, revealing how motion trajectories form during early denoising stages. Building upon the ''first shape, then details'' finding, we combine cross-attention trajectory patterns with causal head contributions to identify a specific subset of attention heads driving motion planning. Further, our self-attention analysis shows that Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) induces excessive spatial attention decay. This causes early candidate regions to prematurely lock into physically implausible positions, suppressing reasonable trajectories in adjacent frames and triggering generation failure modes. To address this fundamental flaw, we propose a lightweight architectural modification that scales the frequency of RoPE across different denoising steps. This strategy reduces excessive attention decay, helping the model explore better candidate regions to establish coherent physical motion. Finally, training-free and training-based experiments confirm the effectiveness of our approach in enhancing the physical commonsense of generated videos.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对文生视频扩散模型的"运动规划"过程进行可解释性研究，发现RoPE导致的过度空间注意力衰减是物理不合理运动生成的根因，并提出一种跨去噪步缩放RoPE频率的轻量架构修改来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 当前先进的视频扩散模型视觉质量出色，但常生成违反物理规律的内容。已有解决方案依赖外部先验或专用数据，本文转而探究模型内部机制，寻找物理不合理生成的根因。
AI.method: 1) 对文生视频扩散模型的运动规划过程开展首个可解释性研究，揭示运动轨迹在早期去噪阶段形成；2) 基于"先形状、后细节"的发现，结合交叉注意力轨迹模式与因果注意力头贡献，定位负责运动规划的特定注意力头子集；3) 通过自注意力分析发现RoPE引起过度的空间注意力衰减，导致候选区域过早锁定在物理不合理位置；4) 提出轻量架构修改，在不同去噪步上缩放RoPE频率以减轻注意力衰减。
