We assemble these distinctions into a reporting protocol whose outcomes, refusal included, state what an adjusted score may be claimed to show: an audit-time diagnostic reported beside the construct-alignment cost it incurs, never a replacement for the raw score.

AI.tldr: 论文指出对LLM评测分数（奖励模型、重排序器、LLM评判者）做表面特征“残差化”校正并不能得到更有效的测量：它同时削掉构念相关信号，可能使分数去相关却损害构念对齐，因此只能作为审计期诊断，附带构念对齐代价报告，而非原始分数的替代品。
AI.motivation: LLM系统中广泛使用的评测分数（奖励模型、重排序器、LLM评判者）常追踪表面形式（如注释、格式）而非其声称衡量的质量。例如面对同一MBPP问题的简洁正确解与带注释的错误解，公开偏好奖励模型选出正确解的准确率仅0.507，接近抛硬币。为消除这种表面成分，研究者常从分数中减去可预测的表面分量，但作者认为仅靠移除无法获得更有效的测量：被移除的成分可能携带与构念相关的信号，而残差化本身无法区分二者的性质。
AI.method: 1）设计干预实验：使用仅修改注释的单元测试标签，比较残差化前后奖励模型的格式效应与正确/错误代码的差值；2）观察性实验：在NLI和QA设置中，先冻结一个留出复现集再评分，并用来自不相交标注者的标签重新评估；3）构造受控模型，检验在构念对齐上同样有害的配置是否能通过所有预调整检查；4）综合以上区分，提出一套报告协议。
AI.result: 干预实验中，残差化使奖励模型的格式效应在正确与错误代码上均衰减约0.12，而正确与错误代码之间的差值变动不足0.01。观察性NLI与QA设置中，仅在预先声明的、表面特征预测器会出错的切片上支持与构念标签更好的一致性，而非“修复后的分数”：所有报告正向切片增益的观察性设置中，全总体一致性均下降，且此类QA设置中问题内排序能力均下降。受控模型显示，对构念对齐同样有害的配置能通过所有预调整检查，说明任何预设门控都不是保证。
AI.conclusion: 当构念特征与表面特征纠缠时，残差化可使分数去相关，同时损害构念对齐；不应将调整后的分数视为原始分数的替代或“修复后的测量”。作者提出一套报告协议：其结果（包括拒绝报告）应说明调整后分数可主张什么，即作为审计期诊断，与它带来的构念对齐代价一同报告，而绝不能取代原始分数。

title: STAR: Scene- and Task-Aware 4D Radar Preprocessing Towards End-to-End Cognitive Radar
summary: Four-dimensional (4D) Radar has emerged as a key sensor for environmental perception, providing range, azimuth, elevation, and Doppler measurements while remaining robust to illumination changes and adverse weather conditions. However, conventional Radar preprocessing methods, such as constant false alarm rate (CFAR) detection, select measurements primarily based on signal-level criteria and may therefore discard information valuable for downstream perception during point cloud generation. In addition, existing 4D Radar perception pipelines typically optimize Radar data processing and downstream perception independently, preventing task objectives from directly guiding the preprocessing stage. To address these limitations, we propose a Scene- and Task-Aware Radar (STAR) Preprocessor together with an end-to-end training framework. The STAR Preprocessor incorporates scene context and downstream task objectives to generate task-relevant Radar points, enabling the Radar representation to be optimized directly for perception. On the K-Radar benchmark, the proposed method achieves 74.3 AP, outperforming the previous state of the art by 5.6 AP points. Furthermore, applying the task-relevant points generated by STAR to various existing 3D detectors improves detection performance in most evaluation settings and yields an overall positive average gain over point clouds produced by conventional preprocessing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出场景与任务感知的雷达预处理器STAR及端到端训练框架，在K-Radar基准上取得74.3 AP，较此前最佳提升5.6 AP。
AI.motivation: 四维雷达是环境感知的重要传感器，但传统预处理（如CFAR）仅依据信号级准则筛选测量，在生成点云时会丢弃对下游感知有价值的信息；且现有4D雷达感知流程将数据处理与下游感知独立优化，任务目标无法指导预处理阶段。
AI.method: 提出STAR（Scene- and Task-Aware Radar）预处理器及端到端训练框架。STAR结合场景上下文与下游任务目标生成任务相关雷达点，使雷达表征可直接面向感知任务进行优化。
AI.result: 在K-Radar基准上达到74.3 AP，超出此前最优方法5.6 AP；将STAR生成的任务相关点应用于多种现有3D检测器，在多数评测设置下提升检测性能，相较传统预处理点云取得总体正向平均增益。
AI.conclusion: 将场景与任务信息引入雷达预处理并与下游感知端到端联合优化，可有效提升4D雷达点云质量与目标检测性能，且对现有3D检测器具有良好通用性。

title: LoopCD: Loop-wise Contrastive Decoding for Improving Reasoning in Looped Language Models
summary: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) perform "latent reasoning" by recursively refining internal latent representations with shared weights, offering a more effective alternative to explicit verbal reasoning. Despite their effectiveness, we find that LoopLMs remain prone to loop instability: unstable refinement across iterations can produce localized uncertain "hard" tokens associated with reasoning errors. To address this, we propose LoopCD, loop-wise contrastive decoding that enhances the reasoning performance of LoopLMs by intervening on these tokens at inference time. Specifically, we exploit the internal dynamics of LoopLMs and contrast the logits from earlier iterations with logits from the last refined iteration to form the final sampling distribution. We find that this strategy is highly efficient, introducing only negligible inference overhead and requiring no additional training, while effectively improving reasoning performance by naturally refining reasoning-critical hard tokens. Extensive experiments show that our method improves the performance of recent representative LoopLMs across various reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出LoopCD，一种无需训练的循环式对比解码方法，通过对比早期迭代与最终迭代的logits来修正循环语言模型中的"困难"token，提升推理性能。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型（LoopLMs）通过共享权重递归精炼潜在表示进行"潜在推理"，比显式语言推理更有效，但存在循环不稳定问题：迭代间不稳定的精炼会产生与推理错误相关的局部不确定"困难"token，影响推理性能。
AI.method: 提出LoopCD（loop-wise contrastive decoding），在推理阶段对这些困难token进行干预。具体利用LoopLMs的内部动态，将早期迭代的logits与最后一次精炼迭代的logits进行对比，构造最终采样分布。
AI.result: 该方法高效，仅引入可忽略的推理开销，无需额外训练，通过自然精炼推理关键困难token有效提升推理性能；在多种推理任务上提升了近期代表性LoopLMs的性能。
AI.conclusion: LoopCD是一种即插即用、高效且免训练的推理时干预方法，可有效缓解LoopLMs的循环不稳定问题并提升其推理表现。

title: Relightable 3D Avatar Reconstruction with Semantic-Adaptive Motion-Illumination Responses
summary: Reconstructing expressive and relightable 3D head avatars from monocular videos remains challenging in computer vision, as it requires accurate modeling of both non-rigid facial motion and illumination-dependent appearance. Existing Gaussian avatar methods commonly rely on globally coupled representations, in which Gaussian primitives share a unified motion or illumination response model. Such uniform modeling neglects the distinct motion patterns and material/reflectance properties of different facial semantic regions, thereby limiting fine-grained animation accuracy and reducing relighting plausibility. To address this limitation, we propose SAMIRA, a 3D Gaussian avatar framework for semantic-adaptive motion-illumination response modeling. For motion response modeling, the Semantic-Adaptive Motion Response module rasterizes current-to-reference mesh displacements into a topology-consistent UV space and leverages facial semantics to route displacement features through semantic-specific modulators, predicting localized Gaussian geometric residuals beyond coarse mesh binding. For illumination response modeling, the Semantic-Adaptive Illumination Response module learns compact diffuse and specular response factors for each facial region, allowing Gaussians in different regions to adapt their illumination responses to novel environment lighting. These response factors are incorporated into deferred physically based shading, providing a lightweight approximation of semantic-dependent illumination effects. Extensive experiments on self-reenactment, cross-reenactment, and relighting demonstrate that SAMIRA improves both fine-grained expression reconstruction and relighting realism over existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出SAMIRA框架，通过语义自适应的运动与光照响应建模，从单目视频重建可表达、可重打光的三维高斯头部虚拟人。
AI.motivation: 现有高斯虚拟人方法采用全局耦合表示，高斯基元共享统一的运动或光照响应模型，忽视了不同面部语义区域在运动模式与材质/反射特性上的差异，限制了细粒度动画精度与重打光真实性。
AI.method: 包含两个模块：语义自适应运动响应模块将当前到参考网格的位移光栅化到拓扑一致的UV空间，利用面部语义将位移特征路由至语义专属调制器，预测局部高斯几何残差；语义自适应光照响应模块为每个面部区域学习紧凑的漫反射与镜面反射响应因子，不同区域的高斯可适应新环境光照，并将因子融入延迟物理着色。
AI.result: 在自重建、跨重建与重打光等任务的大量实验表明，SAMIRA在细粒度表情重建与重打光真实性上均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 语义自适应的运动与光照响应建模能有效解耦不同面部区域的运动与反射特性，提升高斯头部虚拟人的动画精度与重打光效果。

title: Vimarsha: Faithful ASR Evaluation for Indian Languages with Demographic Diversity, In-the-Wild Audio and Spelling Variations
summary: Evaluation benchmarks for Indian language automatic speech recognition (ASR) suffer from two systematic biases: optimistic scores from clean, controlled audio conditions, and pessimistic scores from overly rigid transcription standards that penalize valid linguistic variations. We introduce Vimarsha, a 100-hour benchmark spanning all 22 scheduled Indian languages, designed to address both distortions. Vimarsha combines demographically diverse on-field recordings with carefully mined in-the-wild audio selected for acoustic difficulty, alongside a lattice of variations framework that encodes multiple valid transcriptions per utterance. Evaluations of 10 state-of-the-art ASR models reveal substantial shifts in model rankings under realistic conditions, geographic and demographic performance disparities, and systematic failure modes across speaking rates and acoustic environments.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Vimarsha，一个覆盖 22 种印度官方语言、100 小时的 ASR 评测基准，用于纠正现有基准在音频条件与转写标准上的两类系统性偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有印度语言 ASR 评测基准存在两种系统性偏差：一是使用干净受控音频导致分数过于乐观，二是转写标准过于刚硬，惩罚合理的语言变体，导致分数过于悲观。
AI.method: Vimarsha 融合人口统计多样化的实地录制音频与为声学难度筛选的真实场景（in-the-wild）音频，并提出"变体格"（lattice of variations）框架，为每句话编码多种有效转写。基准规模为 100 小时，覆盖全部 22 种印度官方语言。
AI.result: 对 10 个最先进 ASR 模型的评测显示：在真实条件下模型排名出现显著变化，存在地理与人口统计维度的性能差异，并在语速和声学环境上表现出系统性失效模式。
AI.conclusion: Vimarsha 通过同时缓解乐观与悲观两类偏差，提供更贴近真实场景的印度语言 ASR 评测，揭示现有模型在真实条件下的排名不稳定与公平性问题。

title: An Unexpected Robot Policy: Early Evaluations of GPT-6 Astra on RoboDojo and Beyond
summary: Embodied AI systems are often organized into System 1 and System 2. System 1 is typically a pretrained policy that generates actions at high frequency, whereas System 2 is often instantiated as a vision-enabled language model for high-level planning. We ask whether a large language model (LLM) can act as the policy for robot manipulation without task-specific finetuning. We call this setting LLM as policy. We evaluate three LLMs on all 42 RoboDojo tasks and compare their scores with 40 public policies. Astra and GPT-5.5 use the official 50-episode-per-task protocol; DeepSeek-Flash uses 10 episodes per task. GPT-6 Astra achieves 22.48% average success rate and 28.97 Score over 2,100 trials, ranking above every public entry. Yet GPT-5.5 and DeepSeek-Flash reach only 0.88% and 1.92% average success rate with the same post-processing. We find that Astra exhibits a sharply polarized capability profile. It generalizes well to tasks that require semantic understanding but not high-precision control. In contrast, it performs poorly on tasks that require precision, dynamic control, or complex bimanual coordination. In-context experiments show no aggregate benefit from one-shot demonstrations, while selected interaction traces show within-episode corrections under perturbations. Overall, the evaluated LLMs vary substantially in manipulation performance. Astra stands out and provides initial evidence for the potential of a general-purpose manipulation model, although reliable precision and dynamic control remain limitations in the evaluated setting.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"LLM as policy"设定：不进行任务特定微调，直接用LLM作为机器人操作策略，在RoboDojo全部42项任务上评测三个LLM并与40个公开策略对比，发现模型间差异巨大，仅Astra表现突出。
AI.motivation: 具身智能常分为System 1（高频预训练策略）与System 2（视觉语言模型做高层规划）。作者追问：LLM能否跳过任务特定微调，直接充当操作策略，从而验证通用操作模型的可行性。
AI.method: 在RoboDojo全部42项任务上评测三个LLM，并与40个公开策略比较分数。Astra与GPT-5.5采用官方每任务50回合协议，DeepSeek-Flash采用每任务10回合；三者使用相同的后处理。另开展单样本演示的上下文实验与扰动下的交互轨迹分析。
AI.result: Astra在2100次试验中取得22.48%平均成功率与28.97 Score，高于所有公开条目；GPT-5.5与DeepSeek-Flash平均成功率仅为0.88%与1.92%。Astra能力呈明显极化：在需要语义理解但无需高精度控制的任务上泛化良好，在需要精度、动态控制或复杂双臂协调的任务上表现差。单样本演示无总体收益，部分交互轨迹显示回合内扰动纠正。
AI.conclusion: 所评测LLM在操作性能上差异显著，Astra表现突出，为通用操作模型的潜力提供了初步证据；但在该评测设定下，可靠的精度与动态控制仍是主要瓶颈。

title: From Articles to Publishers: Aggregating Language Model Predictions for News Source Reliability Inference
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Computational Social Systems (TCSS)
summary: Traditionally, the reliability of news publishers is assessed by expert organisations that evaluate editorial practices, transparency and factual standards at source. When this process is translated into a computational approach, the problem is often formulated at the level of individual articles, with models being trained on a set of pre-labelled articles and their performance being evaluated in a test phase. In this work, we investigate news source reliability inference as a source-level prediction problem. We propose a two-stage framework in which transformer-based language models first estimate the reliability of individual articles and subsequently aggregate article-level predictions to infer the reliability of previously unseen publishers. To approximate realistic deployment conditions, we enforce a strict publisher-disjoint evaluation protocol, ensuring that no publisher appears in both training and test sets. Experiments on 19,476 political news articles from 439 English-language publishers labeled with NewsGuard reliability ratings show that aggregation substantially improves robustness and performance, increasing accuracy from approximately 0.60 at the article level to 0.69 at the publisher level. Finally, we analyze how prediction errors vary across political orientations, revealing statistically significant associations between political leaning and misclassification patterns. Overall, our findings show that publisher reliability can be inferred from aggregated textual signals alone, supporting scalable and content-based approaches to automated news source assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段框架：先用Transformer模型估计单篇文章可靠性，再聚合文章级预测以推断未见过出版商的可靠性，在严格执行出版商不交叉的评测协议下将准确率从约0.60提升至0.69。
AI.motivation: 传统新闻出版商可靠性由专家机构在信源层面评估，但计算化方法通常将问题简化为文章级分类，无法直接刻画"信源可靠性"这一本质为信源级的属性；同时常规评测存在出版商泄漏，难以反映真实部署条件。
AI.method: 将新闻信源可靠性推断建模为信源级预测问题，提出两阶段框架：第一阶段用基于Transformer的语言模型估计单篇文章的可靠性；第二阶段将文章级预测聚合，推断训练中未出现过的出版商的可靠性。采用严格的出版商不交叉（publisher-disjoint）评测协议，确保同一出版商不同时出现在训练集与测试集。
AI.result: 在19,476篇政治新闻、439家英语出版商、以NewsGuard可靠性评级为标签的数据上，聚合显著提升稳健性与性能，准确率由文章级约0.60提升至出版商级0.69；误差分析显示预测错误在不同政治倾向间存在统计显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 仅依靠聚合的文本信号即可推断出版商可靠性，说明基于内容的自动化新闻信源评估具备可扩展性与可行性；同时提示需关注政治倾向相关的偏差。

title: LegendBench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Legend Understanding with Counterfactual Interventions
summary: Legends are fundamental to chart understanding, as reliable interpretation requires correctly binding legend entries to corresponding visual marks. While vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly applied to chart understanding, their legend understanding is poorly diagnosed by aggregate accuracy, which can be satisfied by superficial shortcuts and confound legend-specific errors with other reasoning failures. To enable fine-grained diagnosis and controlled testing, we introduce LegendBench, a parametric benchmark and generation pipeline that produces targeted legend-centric test cases. LegendBench contributes (1) a capability-task taxonomy spanning legend parsing, legend grounding, legend-conditioned reasoning, and legend-aware abstention to localize failures, and (2) counterfactual group generation, where each base chart yields multiple variants under controlled legend interventions to probe model invariance and sensitivity. Using LegendBench, we evaluate both general-purpose VLMs and specialized chart models and generate their capability profiles, revealing persistent bottlenecks in reliable legend-to-mark binding and counterfactual consistency. We then use these capability profiles to guide targeted fine-tuning, demonstrating that bottleneck-specific interventions can effectively close the localized capability gaps and generalize to unseen data. We further leverage our counterfactual design to conduct fine-grained diagnostic experiments, analyzing encoding-channel effects, legend-order shortcuts, and abstention under varying visibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LegendBench，一个面向图例理解的参数化基准与生成流水线，通过能力-任务分类体系和反事实分组生成实现细粒度诊断与可控测试，揭示VLM在图例-标记绑定与反事实一致性上的瓶颈，并证明针对性微调可有效弥补局部能力缺口。
AI.motivation: 聚合准确率无法有效诊断VLM的图例理解能力：模型可能依赖表层捷径取得高分，且图例相关错误会与其他推理失败混淆，缺乏细粒度、可控的测试手段来定位失败原因。
AI.method: 构建LegendBench参数化基准与生成流水线，产出以图例为中心的定向测试用例：一是涵盖图例解析、图例定位绑定、图例条件推理、图例感知弃答的能力-任务分类体系以定位失败；二是反事实分组生成，即每个基础图表在受控图例干预下生成多个变体，以探测模型的不变性与敏感性。基于该基准评测通用VLM与专用图表模型并生成能力画像，据此指导针对性微调。
AI.result: 通用VLM与专用图表模型在可靠的图例到标记绑定及反事实一致性上均存在持续瓶颈；基于能力画像的针对性微调能够有效弥补局部能力缺口并泛化到未见数据；借助反事实设计进一步完成编码通道效应、图例顺序捷径及不同可见度下弃答行为的细粒度诊断实验。
AI.conclusion: LegendBench实现了图例理解的细粒度诊断与可控测试，能力画像可指导瓶颈特异性干预，为提升图表理解模型的图例绑定可靠性与反事实鲁棒性提供了有效路径。

title: Memory vs. Context? Influential Factors of Factual Recall in Language Models
comment: Accepted to the BlackboxNLP 2026 Reproducibility Challenge (Special Track), EMNLP 2026
summary: We reproduce and stress-test the work of Yu et al. (2023), who characterize how language models (LMs) arbitrate between memorized knowledge and contradictory in-context statements. We replicate their world-capitals experiments on 31 models spanning Pythia, GPT-2, Qwen3, and Ministral families, including base and post-trained variants, and extend evaluations to five additional knowledge relation types from the ParaConflict dataset. We empirically confirm most of their original findings: larger models and higher-frequency entities tend to favor memorized answers, with substantial family-level variance. However, several conclusions do not generalize cleanly: entity-frequency effects disappear on Qwen3-14B and 32B; post-training shifts the memory-context trade-off inconsistently across families; question phrasing alone can change a model's reliance on memorized knowledge by up to 80 percentage points; and semantically unrelated prose can mimic coherent supporting context. Our results clarify where Yu et al.'s claims hold and to what extent they generalize to other prompts.

AI.tldr: 复现并压力测试Yu et al. (2023)关于语言模型在记忆知识与矛盾上下文间权衡的研究，跨31个模型与5类新知识关系验证其结论的泛化性。
AI.motivation: 检验Yu et al. (2023)关于语言模型如何仲裁记忆知识与矛盾上下文陈述的结论是否稳健、是否可泛化到更多模型家族与知识关系类型。
AI.method: 在31个模型（Pythia、GPT-2、Qwen3、Ministral家族，含基座与后训练变体）上复现世界首都实验，并扩展至来自ParaConflict数据集的5类额外知识关系；通过改变提问措辞、实体频率与上下文类型进行压力测试。
AI.result: 多数原结论得到证实：更大模型与更高频实体倾向偏好记忆答案，且存在显著家族层面差异；但部分结论不能干净泛化——实体频率效应在Qwen3-14B/32B上消失，后训练对记忆-上下文权衡的影响跨家族不一致，提问措辞可使依赖记忆知识的程度变化高达80个百分点，语义无关的文本也能模仿连贯的支持性上下文。
AI.conclusion: 明确了Yu et al.主张成立的范围及其在其他提示下的泛化边界，表明相关结论对模型家族、后训练与提示措辞高度敏感。

title: Benchmarking Off-the-Shelf Multimodal AI Models Against Dermatologists on Patient-Captured Skin Images
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) has advanced at a rapid pace in recent years. Initially, breakthroughs in large language models caught widespread attention. However, recent generations of frontier AI models have adopted multimodal capabilities as a first class citizen, with vision capabilities being central to that. In this paper, we evaluate three recently released models on the task of diagnosing dermatological conditions from patient-submitted images. The models chosen are at the low to mid tier in terms of pricing and thus represent a floor on current AI capabilities, not a ceiling. We evaluate AI performance relative to a panel of three certified dermatologists, who grade each image, and we present four interesting findings. Firstly, depending on the metric, the tested AI models are either on par or slightly trail humans in terms of inter-clinician agreement. Secondly, we find that asking AI models for a confidence rating produces poorly calibrated answers, meaning use of confidence thresholds should not be relied upon in a clinical setting. Thirdly, the effect of providing additional patient metadata is strongly model-specific, with one of the three models degrading on every metric considered. Finally, model cost is not predictive of performance. The best-performing model we tested costs on average $0.0045 per case.

AI.tldr: 本文评估三款低中价位多模态AI模型在皮肤病诊断任务上的表现，并与三位认证皮肤科医生对比，得出四项发现：AI在一致性上接近人类；置信度校准差；元数据增益因模型而异；成本不能预测性能。
AI.motivation: 近年前沿AI模型将多模态（尤其是视觉）能力作为核心，患者提交的皮肤图像诊断具备实际临床价值；作者希望用低中价位模型评估当前AI能力下限，而非上限，从而了解其真实可用性与风险。
AI.method: 选取三款近期发布的低至中价位模型，对患者提交的皮肤科图像进行诊断；以三位认证皮肤科医生组成评审小组对每张图像进行评分，并据此比较AI与人类在临床医生间一致性等指标上的表现，同时考察置信度校准、额外患者元数据影响及模型成本与性能关系。
AI.result: 四项发现：1）按不同指标，AI模型在临床医生间一致性方面与人类持平或略低；2）要求AI给出置信度会产生校准很差的答案，因此不应在临床场景依赖置信度阈值；3）提供额外患者元数据的影响高度依赖模型，其中一款模型在所有指标上均下降；4）模型成本不能预测性能，表现最佳的模型平均每例成本仅0.0045美元。
AI.conclusion: 低中价位多模态AI在皮肤科图像诊断上已接近人类评审一致性水平，但置信度不可靠、元数据增益不稳定且高成本不等于高性能；临床应用中需谨慎，不应依赖置信度阈值，并应针对具体模型进行验证。

title: Taramandal-GPT: Enhancing Astrodynamics Problem-Solving with Knowledge Retrieval and Structured Thinking
comment: Proceedings of All India Hindi Technical Conference, 05-06 February 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable progress in natural language understanding, yet their effectiveness in specialized fields like astronomy and astrodynamics remains limited due to challenges in multi-step reasoning, symbolic manipulation, and domain-specific terminology. To address this, we present Taramandal-GPT (Constellation-GPT), a domain-adapted framework built on the Qwen3-8b backbone, enhanced with a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline and a fallback mechanism for improved contextual precision. We evaluate it on the Astrodynamics Problems Benchmark (APBench), a dataset of 299 questions covering foundational to advanced levels of space science. Using a dual evaluation method - numeric margin-based scoring and semantic similarity assessment - Taramandal-GPT achieves competitive performance against state-of-the-art open- and closed-source models, with notable strength in thinking-intensive tasks. These results highlight the value of specialized LLMs for domains demanding accuracy and interpretability, positioning Taramandal-GPT as a step toward reliable Artificial Intelligence (AI) assistants for astrophysics, spacecraft engineering, and space exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出Taramandal-GPT，基于Qwen3-8b并结合RAG与回退机制的天体动力学领域适配框架，在299题的APBench上以数值与语义双重评估，取得与前沿模型相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在自然语言理解上进展显著，但在天文学和天体动力学等专业领域受限于多步推理、符号运算和领域术语，效果有限。因此需要领域适配的专用LLM来提升准确性与可解释性。
AI.method: 以Qwen3-8b为骨干构建领域适配框架Taramandal-GPT，引入检索增强生成（RAG）流水线及回退机制以提升上下文精度；在自建APBench（299道覆盖基础到高级空间科学问题的数据集）上评估；采用数值裕度评分与语义相似度评估的双重评价方法。
AI.result: Taramandal-GPT在与开源及闭源最先进模型的对比中表现具有竞争力，尤其在思考密集型任务上优势明显。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了专用LLM在需要准确性与可解释性领域中的价值，将Taramandal-GPT定位为面向天体物理、航天器工程与空间探索的可靠AI助手的一步。

title: Lightweight Pedestrian Head-Orientation Recognition Network for Safe Pedestrian-Vehicle Interaction
summary: Pedestrian head orientation recognition plays an important role in autonomous driving by providing valuable cues for understanding pedestrian attention and anticipating potential crossing behavior. However, reliable recognition in real-world traffic scenes remains challenging because pedestrian head regions are often captured at low resolution. To address this challenge, we propose a lightweight Low-Resolution Head Orientation Convolutional Neural Network (LRHO-CNN) for pedestrian head orientation recognition. We construct a new dataset by extracting pedestrian head images from multiple public datasets and manually annotating them into eight orientation categories. The collected images are systematically preprocessed and augmented to increase data diversity and better represent variations in illumination and image quality. The experimental analysis compares LRHO-CNN with three fine-tuned baseline models, namely ResNet-18, ResNet-34, and VGG-16. The results demonstrate that LRHO-CNN achieves the highest classification accuracy among the evaluated models. LRHO-CNN is further evaluated on the JAAD and PIE datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness in recognizing pedestrian head orientation in real-world traffic scenes and providing informative head-orientation cues that can support downstream pedestrian behavior and intention prediction.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对真实交通场景中行人头部区域分辨率低导致朝向识别困难的问题，提出轻量级低分辨率头部朝向卷积神经网络LRHO-CNN，并构建了八类朝向标注的新数据集。
AI.motivation: 行人头部朝向识别可为自动驾驶理解行人注意力、预判过街行为提供重要线索，但真实交通场景中行人头部区域常以低分辨率被捕获，可靠识别仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 从多个公开数据集中提取行人头部图像，人工标注为八种朝向类别，并进行系统的预处理与数据增强以提升数据多样性、更好地体现光照与图像质量变化；提出轻量级LRHO-CNN，并与微调后的ResNet-18、ResNet-34、VGG-16三个基线模型进行对比实验。
AI.result: LRHO-CNN在所评估模型中取得最高分类准确率；并进一步在JAAD和PIE数据集上验证，证明其在真实交通场景中识别行人头部朝向的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LRHO-CNN能够在真实交通场景中有效识别行人头部朝向，提供有价值的头部朝向线索，可支撑下游的行人行为与意图预测任务。

title: Canonical Procedural Actions: An Auditable Annotation Protocol for Tool-Use Agent Traces
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Includes ancillary files for reproducing the reported analyses
summary: Tool-use agent traces identify messages and API calls, but procedural analyses also need explicit units of action and inspectable links to their evidence. We present Canonical Procedural Actions (CPAs), an annotation protocol that records a procedural function, its first agent-event anchor, the agent events that realize it, and separate contextual evidence. Multiple actions may share a message anchor without an inferred within-message order. A retail case study produces a versioned 24-entry codebook through open induction, recorded consolidation, and successive application audits. Two isolated LLM contexts annotate 32 trajectories disjoint from development at the trajectory level, producing 499 and 491 occurrences with anchor-label overlap A=0.982. Requiring identical context-event references reduces overlap to 0.798. These are structural repeatability measures, not semantic accuracy: 16 of 26 task IDs also occur in development, and historical tool payloads were truncated to 110 characters. Retrospective controls show that collapsing all labels raises overlap to 0.986, while simple endpoint rules reproduce the tool-anchored portion with 0.997 overlap. Assistant-message actions have 0.971 overlap, with a per-label minimum of 0.816. Applying the frozen codebook to 244 further trajectories yields 4,058 records, including eight diagnostic outcomes. The contribution is an explicit, auditable annotation instrument and a case study of its construction and measurement limits; human-reference validity and downstream utility remain to be established.

AI.tldr: 提出"规范过程行为"(CPAs)标注协议，将工具使用智能体的轨迹标注为可审计的"过程功能+事件锚点+实现事件+上下文证据"，并通过零售案例构建24条目的版本化码本，报告其结构可重复性及局限。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体轨迹虽能识别消息与API调用，但缺乏显式的行为单元，也缺少可检视的证据链接，难以支撑过程性分析。因此需要一个明确的、可审计的标注工具来界定行为单元并给出证据关联。
AI.method: CPAs协议记录：过程功能、首个智能体事件锚点、实现该功能的智能体事件、以及分离的上下文证据；允许多个行为共享同一消息锚点而不推断消息内顺序。零售案例通过开放归纳、记录式整合与逐轮应用审计，产出24条目的版本化码本。两个隔离的LLM上下文对32条与开发集在轨迹层面不相交的轨迹进行标注；另设消融/回顾性控制（标签全部折叠、简单端点规则），并将冻结码本应用于244条新轨迹。
AI.result: 两次标注分别得到499与491次出现，锚点-标签重叠A=0.982；要求上下文事件引用完全一致时降至0.798。折叠所有标签后重叠升至0.986；简单端点规则复现工具锚定部分达0.997；助手消息行为重叠0.971（单标签最低0.816）。冻结码本应用于244条轨迹得4,058条记录，含8项诊断性结果。26个任务ID中有16个也出现在开发集，历史工具载荷被截断至110字符。
AI.conclusion: 贡献是一个显式、可审计的标注工具及其构建与测量局限的案例研究，所报告的是结构可重复性而非语义准确性；人类参照效度与下游效用仍待验证。

title: SAFe: Segment-guided Aggregation of Feature Densities for Anomaly-aware Segmentation
summary: Visual segmentation systems encounter objects outside their training distribution during real-world deployment, hindering reliable autonomous systems that depend on scene parsing in the perception stage. Many recent methods address this by using self-supervised foundation models to train density estimators that yield low likelihood in anomalous image regions. Although promising, these methods suffer from poor feature semantics or they lack spatial consistency, both of which undermine critical downstream decisions. We address this problem with~\method, a generative method based on class-conditional density estimation over self-supervised representations. SAFe trains lightweight normalizing flows that produce class-conditional normalized likelihood estimates over frozen DINOv3 features. We combine density estimates from transformer features with density scores over multi-scale convolutional features to capture both global semantics and local detail. We introduce a method-agnostic post-processing step based on SAM3 that connects per-location likelihoods into spatially coherent segments while suppressing false positives, and enables instance-level anomaly detection without retraining. The post processing further distinguishes novel categories among anomalous objects by a similarity-based agglomerative clustering scheme. SAFe sets a new state of the art on the PANIC, OoDIS, SMIYC ObstacleTrack with strong performance on the ISSU benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SAFe，一种基于自监督表示的条件类别密度估计的生成式方法，用于视觉分割中的分布外/异常检测，结合 DINOv3 特征上的轻量归一化流、多尺度卷积特征密度以及基于 SAM3 的后处理，在多个基准上取得新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 视觉分割系统在真实部署中会遭遇训练分布之外的对象，威胁依赖场景解析的自主系统可靠性。现有基于自监督基础模型的密度估计方法虽具前景，但特征语义性差或缺乏空间一致性，损害下游决策。
AI.method: SAFe 在冻结的 DINOv3 特征上训练轻量归一化流，产生条件类别的归一化似然估计；将 Transformer 特征的密度估计与多尺度卷积特征的密度分数结合，以同时捕捉全局语义与局部细节；引入基于 SAM3 的方法无关后处理，把逐位置似然连接为空间连贯的分割，抑制假阳性，并支持无需重训练的实例级异常检测；后处理还通过基于相似度的凝聚聚类区分异常对象中的新类别。
AI.result: 在 PANIC、OoDIS、SMIYC ObstacleTrack 上取得新的 state of the art，并在 ISSU 基准上表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: SAFe 通过类别条件密度估计、多尺度特征融合与 SAM3 后处理，有效提升了异常分割的语义性与空间一致性，实现实例级异常检测与新类别区分，性能优于现有方法。

title: Structure Before Sampling: Community-Aware Core-Set Selection for Data-Efficient Text-to-Speech
summary: Text-to-speech (TTS) corpora are costly to record, yet many utterances add little new phonetic information. Core-set selection reduces this cost by choosing a small training subset under a fixed audio-duration budget. We represent a corpus as a phonotactic graph that links each utterance to its most phonemically similar ones, and we first test whether this graph has structure. In Bangla and English corpora, its clustering is 199 and 56 times that of a size-matched random graph, and its modularity is more than twice that of a degree-preserving random graph. We then propose Community Representative, a selector that samples across graph communities and spreads its choices within each one, starting from utterances rich in rare phonemes. At every budget and in both languages, it covers more rare phoneme bigrams than random and entropy-based selection, and this lead holds on held-out utterances. TTS models trained on its 20% core-sets have a significantly lower character error rate (CER) than models trained on equal-duration random or entropy-based subsets in both languages. When all models train for the same number of epochs, the Bangla core-set model also outperforms full-corpus training (3.93% vs. 4.47% CER) with 4.5x less training time.

AI.tldr: 该论文将语音语料组织为音位组合图，提出基于社区代表的子集选择方法，在固定音频时长预算下以20%数据量显著提升TTS训练效率与CER表现。
AI.motivation: TTS语料录制成本高昂，但许多语句带来的音素信息增益有限。核心集选择可在固定音频时长预算下压缩训练数据，然而如何在保证音素覆盖（尤其稀有音素）的前提下进行有效选取，仍缺乏针对性方法。
AI.method: 将语料表示为音位组合图（phonotactic graph），把每条语句连接到与其音素最相似的语句，并先检验该图是否存在结构（对比同规模随机图与度保持随机图的聚类系数与模块度）。随后提出Community Representative选择器：跨图社区采样，并在每个社区内部扩散选择，从富含稀有音素的语句出发。
AI.result: 在孟加拉语与英语语料中，该图的聚类系数分别为同规模随机图的199倍与56倍，模块度超过度保持随机图的两倍。在所有预算与两种语言下，该方法覆盖的稀有音素二元组多于随机选择与基于熵的选择，且该优势在留出语句上保持。用其20%核心集训练的TTS模型，CER显著低于等时长随机或熵基子集训练的模型；在相同训练轮数下，孟加拉语核心集模型还优于全语料训练（CER 3.93% vs. 4.47%），训练时间减少4.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 音位组合图具有显著的非随机社区结构，基于社区代表的选择能在固定时长预算下提升稀有音素覆盖，进而以更少数据与训练时间获得更低CER，为降低TTS语料成本提供了有效途径。

title: CoaG: Cylinders on a Grid: Coarse 3D Layout Control for Video Generation
summary: We ask how little geometry a person has to draw to control both where people stand and where the camera moves in a generated video. Our answer is a ground plane and one cylinder per person. A user draws a grid on the ground, places one cylinder where each person should stand, moves the cylinders and the camera over 81 frames, and the model renders a photoreal video in which the people occupy the cylinders' positions, move as the cylinders move, and are seen from the drawn camera. Appearance comes from a text prompt and a background reference image; layout and motion come from the geometry. Because no dataset pairs such a signal with video, we build the pairs ourselves: an automatic engine writes 2000 captions from a combinatorial seed, generates a clip for each with a text-to-video model, and lifts every clip back to its geometry with person tracking, background inpainting, an agentic ground-mask loop, feed-forward multi-view reconstruction and a plane fit, with no real footage and no manual labels. A LoRA on Wan2.2-Fun-Control trained on 1935 such tuples follows drawn layouts and camera paths on hold-out clips: the generated people match the cylinders' count, order, position and height, the text changes who they are, the reference image changes where they are, and dolly-in, orbit, pan and crane paths are followed, dolly-out only weakly.

AI.tldr: 仅用地面网格与每人一个圆柱体作为几何控制信号，配合文本与背景参考图，即可生成人物位置、运动与相机路径均受控的写实视频；作者自建2000条数据管线并训练LoRA验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成难以用极简、易绘制的几何输入同时控制人物站位与相机运动，且缺少"几何信号-视频"配对数据集。
AI.method: 以地面平面网格加每人物一个圆柱为控制表示，用户绘制后移动圆柱与相机共81帧；自动引擎由组合种子生成2000条caption，用文生视频模型生成片段，再经人物跟踪、背景修复、智能体地面掩码循环、前馈多视图重建与平面拟合反推几何，构成无真实素材、无人工标注的数据对；在Wan2.2-Fun-Control上以1935个元组训练LoRA。
AI.result: 留出片段上生成人物在数量、顺序、位置、高度上与圆柱一致；文本决定人物身份，参考图决定其位置；dolly-in、orbit、pan、crane路径跟随良好，dolly-out较弱。
AI.conclusion: 极简几何（地面＋圆柱）足以解耦外观、布局与相机运动，实现可控写实视频生成；自动数据构建管线可替代人工标注。

title: Mitigating Entity Type Confusion in Cross-Domain NER via Multidimensional Quantification and Reasoning Enhancement
summary: Cross-domain Named Entity Recognition (CD-NER) aims to transfer the rich knowledge in the source domain to the target domain. Recent studies adopting decomposition or generation paradigms have achieved significant performance improvements, demonstrating high accuracy in entity span detection. However, during entity type classification, models severely suffer from entity type confusion, the erroneous tendency that models classify entities of one type in the text as another similar but incorrect type. To address this issue, we first propose a Multidimensional Confusion Quantification Model (MCQM) that quantifies a model's confusion extent between entity types from three dimensions: source-target hierarchy analysis, semantic similarity analysis, and explicit data evaluation. Moreover, we propose the Progressive Bidirectional Reasoning Chain (PBRC). PBRC leverages the source-target hierarchy and confusion analysis from the MCQM to prompt the LLM to generate two-stage reasoning information. The two-stage reasoning information is utilized to augment the knowledge of the model, significantly mitigating entity type confusion and improving the model's generalization performance. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves new state-of-the-art results on all domains of the CrossNER dataset.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对跨领域命名实体识别中的实体类型混淆问题，提出混淆量化模型MCQM与渐进式双向推理链PBRC，在CrossNER全部领域达到新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 跨领域NER虽在实体跨度检测上准确率高，但在实体类型分类阶段存在严重的"实体类型混淆"问题，即模型倾向于把某一类型的实体误判为相似但错误的类型，影响泛化性能。
AI.method: 1) 提出多维混淆量化模型MCQM，从源-目标层次分析、语义相似度分析和显式数据评估三个维度量化模型在实体类型间的混淆程度；2) 提出渐进式双向推理链PBRC，利用MCQM得到的源-目标层次与混淆分析结果，提示大语言模型生成两阶段推理信息，用以增强模型知识。
AI.result: 在CrossNER数据集的全部领域上取得新的state-of-the-art结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过量化实体类型混淆并借助两阶段推理信息增强模型知识，可显著缓解实体类型混淆，提升跨领域NER的泛化能力。

title: ChartJudgeBench: Evaluating LMM Judges for Chart-to-Code Generation
summary: Building strong chart-to-code systems increasingly relies on reinforcement learning, whose effectiveness depends critically on the quality of the reward signal. Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) play a natural critical role in jointly assessing chart visual appearance and task requirements. They are therefore increasingly used as visual critics and reward models, yet their reliability as judges remains largely unexplored. To this end, we introduce ChartJudgeBench, a diagnostic vision-language benchmark for assessing LMM judges in chart-to-code workflows. It includes 1,003 Chart Perception Alignment (CPA) instances for pairwise chart comparison and 650 Chart Reasoning Judgment (CRJ) instances for binary Accept/Reject verification in Chart Reproduction and Chart Editing. Together, these tasks emulate the core judging decisions required in agentic refinement and RL-based chart optimization. Our evaluation of strong LMMs reveals four systematic limitations: (i) positional bias in pairwise comparison, (ii) a strong tendency to overpredict Accept, (iii) difficulty in matching visual styles and aesthetics, and (iv) an unexpected leniency bias in RL-trained models. These findings show that current LMM judges require explicit reliability validation before being used as critics or reward models in chart-to-code optimization. The code and data are available on ChartJudgeBench.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ChartJudgeBench，一个诊断型视觉-语言基准，用于评估图表转代码（chart-to-code）工作流中作为评判者的 LMM，并揭示其四类系统性缺陷。
AI.motivation: 图表转代码系统日益依赖强化学习，其效果高度依赖奖励信号质量。LMM 能同时评估图表视觉外观与任务需求，因而被广泛用作视觉批评器与奖励模型，但其作为评判者的可靠性尚未被充分探究。
AI.method: 构建 ChartJudgeBench 基准，包含 1,003 个 Chart Perception Alignment (CPA) 实例用于成对图表比较，以及 650 个 Chart Reasoning Judgment (CRJ) 实例用于 Chart Reproduction 与 Chart Editing 场景下的二元 Accept/Reject 验证；两类任务模拟智能体式细化与基于 RL 的图表优化中的核心评判决策，并对强 LMM 进行评测。
AI.result: 评测揭示四类系统性局限：(i) 成对比较中的位置偏差；(ii) 强烈倾向过度预测 Accept；(iii) 难以匹配视觉风格与美学；(iv) RL 训练模型中出现意外的宽松偏差。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LMM 评判者在被用作 chart-to-code 优化中的批评器或奖励模型前，需要经过显式的可靠性验证；代码与数据已在 ChartJudgeBench 公开。

title: URA-NER: A Unified Retrieval-Augmented Framework with Retrieval Alignment and Uncertainty Reduction for Low-Resource NER
comment: 8 pages,3 figures, accepted at IJCNN 2026, conference WCCI 2026
summary: In-context learning (ICL) based on large language models (LLMs) has shown promising potential in alleviating performance bottlenecks caused by the limited availability of annotated data in Named Entity Recognition (NER). However, existing methods still face issues of retrieval misalignment and generation uncertainty, making their performance heavily dependent on the LLM's capabilities. As the parameter scale of LLMs decreases, their performance in few-shot settings deteriorates significantly. In this paper, we propose a novel unified retrieval-augmented framework, URA-NER, including three key components: Progressive Granularity Retrieval (PGR), Model-aware Representation Enhancement (MaRE), and Reason-aware Knowledge Verification. PGR is a two-stage retrieval mechanism that achieves stage alignment. It first retrieves demonstrations for span detection based on the query's global semantics, and then for type classification based on the specific entity context, providing fine-grained local information. Moreover, MaRE employs entity pre-recognition to guide the construction of representations, ensuring the query and demonstrations are aligned within the LLM's semantic space and attention pattern. In addition, to mitigate generation uncertainty, we propose RaKV, a closed-loop "generation-retrieval-verification" process. It explicates the LLM's reasoning paths, leverages them for the retrieval of external knowledge, and reorganizes the knowledge into verification evidence aligned with the original reasoning paths. We conduct extensive experiments on multiple low-resource NER datasets. Results demonstrate that URA-NER significantly enhances the performance of LLMs under low-resource settings, with particularly pronounced gains for smaller LLMs, achieving new state-of-the-art results on several benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 URA-NER，一个面向低资源命名实体识别的统一检索增强框架，通过渐进粒度检索、模型感知表示增强与推理感知知识验证三个组件，缓解检索错位与生成不确定性问题，显著提升大模型尤其小模型在少样本 NER 上的性能并刷新多个基准。
AI.motivation: 基于大模型的上下文学习在缓解标注数据稀缺带来的 NER 性能瓶颈方面有潜力，但现有方法存在检索错位与生成不确定性，导致性能过度依赖大模型能力；当模型参数规模下降时，少样本场景性能显著退化。
AI.method: 提出统一检索增强框架 URA-NER，含三个关键组件：(1) 渐进粒度检索 PGR，两阶段检索实现阶段对齐，先基于查询全局语义检索用于片段检测的示范，再基于具体实体上下文检索用于类型分类的示范，提供细粒度局部信息；(2) 模型感知表示增强 MaRE，利用实体预识别引导表示构建，使查询与示范在大模型语义空间和注意力模式中对齐；(3) 推理感知知识验证 RaKV，构建“生成-检索-验证”闭环，显化大模型推理路径，据此检索外部知识并重组为与原始推理路径对齐的验证证据，以缓解生成不确定性。
AI.result: 在多个低资源 NER 数据集上开展大量实验，结果表明 URA-NER 显著提升大模型在低资源场景下的性能，对小规模大模型的增益尤为明显，并在多个基准上取得新的最优结果。
AI.conclusion: URA-NER 通过检索对齐与知识验证的闭环设计，有效缓解检索错位与生成不确定性，降低对模型规模的依赖，为低资源 NER 提供统一且高效的检索增强解决方案。

title: Beyond Emotion Prompts: Fine-Grained Text-to-Image Generation Driven by Valence-Arousal-Dominance
summary: Although text-to-image models can accurately depict subjects and scenes, creators still struggle to specify the fine-grained emotions an image should convey without rewriting its content description. Natural language can suggest emotions, but it offers no control scale with stable meanings and ordered intensities. We propose EMOTRANS, which transforms psychologically grounded valence-arousal-dominance (VAD) coordinates into generation conditions that are independent of the content text and modulated across denoising stages, making emotional style a finely adjustable creative variable. To support this goal, we construct EMOVAD, an art-painting dataset that pairs objective content descriptions with separately collected emotional ratings from multiple annotators. We also coordinate emotional expression and content preservation through dual-branch training with a shared model. Objective and human evaluations show that the framework improves the accuracy of three-dimensional emotion control and produces perceptible, orderable continuous changes while maintaining competitive text alignment and image quality. This work provides a practical emotion-driven approach to image generation that extends objective content depiction to fine-grained emotional adjustment.

AI.tldr: 提出 EMOTRANS，将心理学 VAD（效价-唤醒-支配）坐标转化为与内容文本解耦、跨去噪阶段调制的生成条件，实现图像情感的连续可调控制；并构建 EMOVAD 艺术绘画数据集，通过共享模型的双分支训练协调情感表达与内容保持。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像模型虽能准确描绘主体与场景，但创作者难以在不改写内容描述的前提下指定图像应传达的细粒度情感。自然语言虽可暗示情感，却缺乏具有稳定含义与有序强度的控制尺度，情感风格难以作为可精细调节的创作变量。
AI.method: 1) 提出 EMOTRANS，将基于心理学的 VAD 三维坐标转化为生成条件，该条件独立于内容文本，并在不同去噪阶段进行调制；2) 构建 EMOVAD 艺术绘画数据集，为客观内容描述配以多位标注者单独采集的情感评分；3) 采用共享模型的双分支训练，协调情感表达与内容保持。
AI.result: 客观评估与人工评估表明，该框架提升了三维情感控制的准确性，产生可感知、可排序的连续变化，同时保持具有竞争力的文本对齐度与图像质量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种实用的情感驱动图像生成方法，将目标从客观内容描绘扩展至细粒度情感调节，使情感风格成为可精细调控的创作变量。

title: End-to-end Jordanian dialect speech-to-text self-supervised learning framework
summary: Speech-to-text engines are extremely needed nowadays for different applications, representing an essential enabler in human-robot interaction. Still, some languages suffer from the lack of labeled speech data, especially in the Arabic dialects or any low-resource languages. The need for a self-supervised training process and self-training using noisy training is proven to be one of the up-and-coming feasible solutions. This article proposes an end-to-end, transformers-based model with a framework for low-resource languages. In addition, the framework incorporates customized audio-to-text processing algorithms to achieve a highly efficient Jordanian Arabic dialect speech-to-text system. The proposed framework enables ingesting data from many sources, making the ground truth from external sources possible by speeding up the manual annotation process. The framework allows the training process using noisy student training and self-supervised learning to utilize the unlabeled data in both pre- and post-training stages and incorporate multiple types of data augmentation. The proposed self-training approach outperforms the fine-tuned Wav2Vec model by 5% in terms of word error rate reduction. The outcome of this work provides the research community with a Jordanian-spoken data set along with an end-to-end approach to deal with low-resource languages. This is done by utilizing the power of the pretraining, post-training, and injecting noisy labeled and augmented data with minimal human intervention. It enables the development of new applications in the field of Arabic language speech-to-text area like the question-answering systems and intelligent control systems, and it will add human-like perception and hearing sensors to intelligent robots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端、基于Transformer的低资源语言语音转文本框架，针对约旦阿拉伯语方言，结合自监督预训练与噪声学生自训练，并集成定制音频处理与多种数据增强，词错误率较微调Wav2Vec降低5%，并公开约旦口语数据集。
AI.motivation: 语音转文本在人机交互中至关重要，但阿拉伯方言等低资源语言缺乏标注语音数据；自监督训练与基于噪声数据的自训练被视为可行解决方案，因此需要面向低资源语言的端到端框架。
AI.method: 提出端到端、基于Transformer的模型及低资源语言框架；集成定制音频到文本处理算法；框架支持多源数据摄取，通过加速人工标注从外部数据生成真值；采用噪声学生训练与自监督学习，在预训练和后训练阶段利用未标注数据，并融合多种数据增强；整体以最少人工干预注入噪声标注与增强数据。
AI.result: 所提自训练方法在词错误率上较微调后的Wav2Vec模型降低5%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为研究社区提供了约旦口语数据集及应对低资源语言的端到端方法，充分利用预训练、后训练及注入噪声标注与增强数据且人工干预最小；可推动阿拉伯语语音转文本领域的问答系统与智能控制系统等新应用，并为智能机器人增加类人感知与听觉传感器。

title: Document Retrieval-Aware Chunking (D-RAC): Universal Retrieval-Aware Ingestion of Enterprise Documents via PDF Normalization and Multimodal Markdown Conversion
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems over enterprise knowledge bases must ingest heterogeneous document formats -- PDFs, Word documents, presentations, and scans -- whose content is locked inside complex visual layouts, multi-column pages, and dense tables. Rule-based extraction and OCR destroy reading order, flatten tables, and lose heading hierarchy, while fully agentic chunking over extracted text incurs high token costs and hallucination risk. We present Document Retrieval-Aware Chunking (D-RAC), an extension of our Web Retrieval-Aware Chunking (W-RAC) framework to arbitrary document formats. D-RAC first normalizes any input document into PDF, exploiting the fact that virtually every format has a faithful, deterministic PDF rendering. A single multimodal LLM pass then converts rendered pages into retrieval-optimized Markdown -- rewriting tables as self-contained prose statements and preserving heading hierarchy -- after which chunking proceeds exactly as in W-RAC: deterministic parsing into ID-addressable units followed by lightweight LLM-based chunk planning over identifiers rather than text. Source text is never regenerated during chunking, preserving W-RAC's cost, determinism, and observability benefits while unlocking every renderable format as a first-class input. On the 236-document, 795-page PDF subset of the RAG-Multi-Corpus benchmark spanning five enterprise domains, D-RAC converts and chunks the entire corpus in 72 minutes with zero errors, producing 1,748 retrieval-ready chunks. Compared to agentic chunking with frontier LLMs, D-RAC reduces chunking-stage output tokens by 95.7%, cutting chunking cost by 77.8% (GPT-4.1 pricing) to 85.6% (Gemini 2.5 Pro pricing) and chunking time by 75%. D-RAC scales linearly to documents of 500+ pages.

AI.tldr: 提出 D-RAC 文档检索感知分块框架，将任意格式文档归一化为 PDF，通过多模态 LLM 转 Markdown 后进行确定性分块，在企业级基准上实现零错误、低成本、线性可扩展。
AI.motivation: 企业知识库 RAG 需处理 PDF、Word、演示文稿、扫描件等异构文档，其内容嵌入复杂视觉布局、多栏页面和密集表格中。规则抽取与 OCR 会破坏阅读顺序、压平表格、丢失标题层级；而基于抽取文本的全智能体分块 token 成本高且存在幻觉风险。
AI.method: D-RAC 是 W-RAC 框架向任意文档格式的扩展。首先将任意输入文档归一化为 PDF（利用几乎所有格式都有忠实、确定性 PDF 渲染的特性）；随后用单次多模态 LLM 处理将渲染页转为检索优化的 Markdown，把表格改写为自包含的散文陈述并保留标题层级；分块沿用 W-RAC：确定性解析为可 ID 寻址单元，再基于标识符而非文本进行轻量 LLM 分块规划。分块过程中从不重新生成源文本。
AI.result: 在 RAG-Multi-Corpus 基准的 236 篇文档、795 页 PDF 子集（覆盖五个企业领域）上，D-RAC 用 72 分钟零错误完成全语料转换与分块，生成 1,748 个可直接检索的块。相比前沿 LLM 的智能体分块，分块阶段输出 token 减少 95.7%，成本降低 77.8%（GPT-4.1 定价）至 85.6%（Gemini 2.5 Pro 定价），分块时间减少 75%，并可线性扩展至 500 页以上文档。
AI.conclusion: D-RAC 通过格式归一化与确定性分块，在保持 W-RAC 成本、确定性与可观测性优势的同时，使所有可渲染格式成为一等输入，为异构企业文档的 RAG 分块提供了高效、可扩展的解决方案。

title: LLJ Cards: Best practices for the Use of LLMs as Judges
summary: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a popular alternative for evaluation. Often referred to as LLMs as judges (LLJs), these systems have been widely adopted by researchers and practitioners across a broad range of measurement tasks, driven by their strong performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness relative to human judgment. However, a growing body of work has shown that the use of LLJs raise concerns about their validity and reliability as evaluators. Existing efforts to address these challenges have largely focused on developing bias-mitigation techniques and refining prompting strategies. While these approaches represent an important step forward, they primarily offer technical fixes and leave a more fundamental challenge unaddressed: the lack of standardized, transparent, and reproducible evaluation practices. In this paper, we introduce LLJ Cards, a framework that synthesizes best practices from measurement theory, natural language generation, and machine learning literature into practical guidelines for LLJ-based evaluations. While LLJs offer a promising path toward scalable evaluation, their effective use requires grounding in rigorous evaluation principles to ensure validity, reliability, and reproducibility. LLJ Cards addresses this need by providing a structured framework for applying these principles in the design and reporting of automated evaluations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 LLJ Cards 框架，将测量理论、自然语言生成与机器学习的最佳实践整合为实用指南，用以规范基于大语言模型评审（LLJ）的评估设计与报告。
AI.motivation: LLM 作为评审（LLJ）因性能强、可扩展、成本低而被广泛用于评估任务，但已有研究揭示其效度与信度存疑。现有应对多集中于偏差缓解技术和提示策略优化，属于技术性修补，未解决更根本的问题：缺乏标准化、透明且可复现的评估实践。
AI.method: 作者提出 LLJ Cards 框架，综合测量理论、自然语言生成和机器学习文献中的最佳实践，将其转化为面向 LLJ 评估的实用指南，为自动化评估的设计与报告提供结构化框架，以落实效度、信度与可复现性原则。
AI.result: 论文以框架性、方法论性质的贡献为主，提出 LLJ Cards 作为落实严谨评估原则的结构化工具，未报告具体实验数据或量化结果。
AI.conclusion: LLJ 虽为实现可扩展评估提供了有前景的路径，但其有效使用必须根植于严谨的评估原则，以确保效度、信度与可复现性；LLJ Cards 正是为满足这一需求而提出的结构化框架。

title: DiaSeg: Diagonal Segment Extraction from DTW Paths for Interpretable Gait Analysis
comment: Accepted for publication in Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery (Springer), September 2026. 28 pages, 4 figures
summary: Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is the dominant approach for measuring similarity between time series, yet standard practice discards the optimal warping path after computing a single distance value, losing local alignment information most relevant to clinical diagnosis. We introduce DiaSeg, a framework that extracts diagonal segments from DTW paths with controlled breaks, characterizing each segment by five geometric features (effective length, interruption count, cost variation, temporal position, and path context), and enabling unsupervised pattern discovery without domain-specific feature engineering. Validated on 91 subjects across six clinical conditions (healthy aging, Parkinson's, Huntington's, ALS, brain tumor, and stroke), three findings emerge. First, diagonal segments form consistent unsupervised patterns (silhouette 0.33) aligned with biomechanical phase annotations, with label-based validation confirming near-perfect separation of healthy and pathological gait (ARI up to 0.986). Second, segments discriminate pathology at 69% (supervised) and 75% (patient-level clustering), with pathology manifesting through distributional shifts in segment length; combining segment and cycle-level features further improves classification to 91.7%. Third, while cycle-based methods achieve higher accuracy (91%), diagonal segments provide phase-specific interpretability unavailable in global representations, localizing where coordination breaks down within the gait cycle. DiaSeg thus transforms DTW from a black-box distance into a source of interpretable temporal features for neurodegenerative disease assessment.

AI.tldr: DiaSeg从DTW最优弯曲路径中提取带受控断点的对角线段，以五个几何特征刻画并用于无监督模式发现与疾病分类，在六种临床状态的91名受试者上验证了可解释性。
AI.motivation: 标准DTW在计算完距离后丢弃最优弯曲路径，损失了与临床诊断最相关的局部对齐信息。作者希望把DTW从黑箱距离转化为可解释的时间特征来源。
AI.method: DiaSeg从DTW路径中提取受控断点的对角线段，用五个几何特征（有效长度、中断次数、代价变化、时间位置、路径上下文）描述每段，实现无需领域特征的工程化无监督模式发现。
AI.result: 在91名受试者、六种临床状态上验证：对角线段形成与生物力学相位标注一致的无监督模式（silhouette 0.33），健康与病理步态近完美分离（ARI最高0.986）；疾病判别达69%（有监督）和75%（患者级聚类），病理表现为线段长度的分布漂移；结合线段与周期级特征分类提升至91.7%；周期方法精度更高（91%），但线段提供全局表示所不具备的相位特异性可解释性。
AI.conclusion: DiaSeg将DTW由黑箱距离转化为可解释的时间特征来源，能够定位步态周期内协调性崩溃的位置，为神经退行性疾病评估提供支持。

title: QLoRA Fine-Tuning of Ministral LLM for Sequence-to-Function Protein Annotation
summary: Functional annotation of newly sequenced proteins remains a bottleneck in molecular biology: the number of sequences in public repositories grows far faster than the capacity for manual curation. Most computational approaches consider annotation as multi-label classification over a fixed ontology, which constrains predictions to a predefined label set. In this work we study the the protein annotation as a sequence-to-text generation problem. We fine-tune the 3B-parameter Ministral 3 base model with QLoRA (4-bit NF4 quantization with low-rank adapters) on sequence annotation pairs. We assess predictions with an LLM-as-expert protocol: a GPT model prompted as a senior molecular-biology curator scores organism identification as binary and function annotation quality. We conclude that QLoRA-fine-tuned compact LLMs can generate curator-style annotations with genuine biological value for a substantial subset of proteins. We also discuss future directions in data quality, model scaling, and evidence grounding that are needed to make the approach sufficiently reliable for practical use.

AI.tldr: 该工作将蛋白质功能注释重构为序列到文本的生成任务，用QLoRA微调3B参数的Ministral 3模型，并以LLM-as-expert协议评估，认为紧凑LLM可为相当一部分蛋白质生成具有生物学价值的注释。
AI.motivation: 公共序列库中序列数量的增长速度远超人工注释能力，功能注释成为分子生物学的瓶颈；现有计算方法多将注释视为固定本体上的多标签分类，预测被限制在预定义标签集内，难以生成灵活、描述性的注释。
AI.method: 将蛋白质注释建模为序列到文本的生成问题；在序列-注释配对数据上用QLoRA（4-bit NF4量化结合低秩适配器）微调3B参数的Ministral 3基础模型；采用LLM-as-expert评估协议，由被提示为资深分子生物学注释专家的GPT模型对生物体识别作二分类打分，并评估功能注释质量。
AI.result: QLoRA微调的紧凑型LLM能够为相当一部分蛋白质生成注释专家风格的注释，且具备真实的生物学价值；同时在数据质量、模型规模扩展与证据支撑方面仍需改进才能达到实用可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 序列到文本生成范式为蛋白质功能注释提供了超越固定标签集分类的可行路径，紧凑LLM经高效微调即可产出有生物学意义的注释，但要使该方法足够可靠以投入实际应用，仍需在数据质量、模型扩展与证据依据等方向继续研究。

title: SRPR-Net: Semantic and Relational Prompt Refinement for Automated SAM-based Instance Segmentation
summary: Instance segmentation is a fundamental computer vision task with diverse real-world applications. Recently, prompt-driven foundation models have shown promising generalization. However, automated prompting remains limited by insufficient semantic guidance and inter-instance modeling. To address this challenge, we propose a novel architecture, named Semantic Relational Prompt Refinement Network (SRPR-Net), for automated SAM-based instance segmentation. A sequential prompt refinement mechanism is introduced to enrich detector geometry with visual-language semantics and then incorporate same-image instance dependencies, enabling context-aware box adjustment before SAM segmentation. Experiments on multiple standard benchmarks demonstrate that SRPR-Net achieves consistent improvements in segmentation performance over existing state-of-the-art approaches. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/JeremyXSC/SRPR-Net.

AI.tldr: 提出SRPR-Net，通过语义关系提示精炼实现自动化SAM实例分割。
AI.motivation: 提示驱动的基础模型泛化性较好，但自动提示受限于语义引导不足与实例间关系建模缺失。
AI.method: 设计顺序提示精炼机制：先为检测器几何注入视觉-语言语义，再引入同图实例依赖，在SAM分割前进行上下文感知的框调整。
AI.result: 在多个标准基准上相较现有SOTA方法取得一致的分割性能提升。
AI.conclusion: SRPR-Net是面向自动化SAM实例分割的有效架构，代码已开源。

title: Toward a Unified Mathematics of Concepts
summary: Concepts are commonly defined as abstract, compact representations of knowledge and treated as basic units of intelligent behavior. Yet, cognition, psychology, and AI lack a shared mathematical language for them. Modern systems represent concepts as vectors, distributions, symbols, graphs, and other structures, but these formalisms are typically treated as competing rather than as solutions to a common problem. We propose an operation-based view that evaluates mathematical frameworks by the conceptual operations they support, identifying thirteen operations (including similarity, composition, generalization, and grounding) that recur across cognition, psychology, and AI. We show that ten frameworks embody distinct commitments to concepts as self-contained content, relational structure, or evolving process, and that these commitments determine which operations each supports naturally. For example, vector-based models facilitate graded similarity and generalization but struggle with explicit composition, whereas symbolic models support composition but offer but generalize poorly. No single framework we examined naturally supports all operations without extension. We test this account empirically using categorization as a case study, operationalizing nine theories on the same items against human judgments. Despite addressing the same conceptual question, the theories produce different procedures and results, demonstrating that mathematical commitment shapes what a theory can explain. We call for hybrid formalisms that treat content, relation, and process as jointly primary.

AI.tldr: 该文提出“基于操作的视角”，主张以数学框架所支持的概念操作来评价理论，并识别出跨认知、心理学与AI反复出现的十三种操作；通过分析十个框架与一个以“分类”为案例的实证检验，揭示数学承诺如何决定理论能解释什么，并呼吁发展融合内容、关系与过程的混合形式化。
AI.motivation: 概念被视为智能行为的基本单位，但认知科学、心理学与AI缺乏共享的数学语言；现有系统将概念表示为向量、分布、符号、图等，却常被当作相互竞争的方案，而非对同一共同问题的不同解答。
AI.method: 提出基于操作的视角，用框架所支持的概念操作来评价数学框架；识别十三种重复出现的操作（如相似性、组合、泛化、奠基）；分析十个框架，将其归纳为对概念的三种承诺——自足内容、关系结构或演化过程；并以“分类”为案例进行实证检验，将九种理论在同一批项目上操作化，与人类判断比较。
AI.result: 不同数学承诺决定各框架天然支持的操作用。向量模型利于渐进相似性与泛化，但难以进行显式组合；符号模型支持组合，却泛化较差。所考察的框架中没有单一框架能天然支持全部操作而无需扩展。九种理论即便针对同一概念问题，也会产生不同程序与结果。
AI.conclusion: 数学承诺塑造了理论能够解释的内容。应发展混合形式化，将内容、关系与过程视为同等基本的三要素。

title: IMPLICIT-Bench: Measuring Implicit Bias in Text-to-Image Models under Neutral Prompts
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models are typically evaluated for bias using slot-based templates such as ``a photo of a [profession]''. Such templates probe only \emph{explicit} demographic attributes (e.g., gender, skin tone) in isolation. They overlook a broader \emph{implicit} bias that arises in natural prompts: when stereotype-relevant attributes are left unspecified, models still default to stereotypical outputs. We introduce IMPLICIT-Bench, a benchmark for measuring implicit bias in T2I models under such prompts. The key design is a structured-knowledge-graph (KG) construction of controlled prompt triplets: neutral, stereotype, and anti-stereotype variants that differ only along a single bias dimension while preserving scene semantics. This enables precise attribution of bias effects that template benchmarks cannot achieve. IMPLICIT-Bench comprises 5,493 prompts across 11 bias categories, validated through multi-model agreement, CLIP-based verification, and human evaluation. Using this benchmark, we show that state-of-the-art T2I models exhibit systematic bias under neutral prompts, a failure mode largely invisible to existing evaluations. We then use IMPLICIT-Bench to evaluate debiasing methods, uncovering a fundamental trade-off between bias reduction and semantic fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出 IMPLICIT-Bench，基于知识图谱构建中性/刻板/反刻板三元组提示，衡量 T2I 模型在自然提示下的隐性偏见，并揭示去偏方法与语义保真度间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有 T2I 偏见评测多采用槽位模板（如"一张[职业]的照片"），只能孤立探测显式人口属性，忽略了自然提示中属性未指定时模型默认输出刻板内容这一更广泛的隐性偏见。
AI.method: 以结构化知识图谱构建受控提示三元组：中性、刻板、反刻板变体，仅在单一偏见维度上不同而保持场景语义一致，从而实现偏见效应的精确归因；基准含 11 类偏见、5,493 条提示，并通过多模型一致性、CLIP 验证和人工评估进行校验。
AI.result: 利用该基准发现，当前最优 T2I 模型在中性提示下表现出系统性偏见，这一失效模式在既有评测中基本不可见；同时用其评测去偏方法，发现偏见降低与语义保真之间存在根本性权衡。
AI.conclusion: IMPLICIT-Bench 提供了更贴近自然使用场景的 T2I 隐性偏见评测手段，揭示了模板式评测遗漏的系统性偏见，并指出去偏研究需在偏见缓解与语义保真间寻求平衡。

title: Evaluating Decision Models for Text Annotation in Computational Social Science
summary: Computational social science increasingly relies on large language models for text annotation, and the validity of published findings now rests on the labels generated by such models. Decision models, a new model class built for categorical question answering, answer typed questions with a choice, a probability distribution over the label set, and a confidence score rather than free text, at a small fraction of frontier inference prices. Whether their answers are accurate, and whether that stated confidence can be trusted on social science constructs, are unknown. Here, we mirror the evaluation of Ziems et al. (2024) on 18 computational social science classification tasks (7,977 items), comparing the first commercial decision model and two open-weight counterparts against 19 frontier and open-weight language models under the same zero-shot protocol. The decision model trails the per-task best LLM on 14 of 15 evaluation tasks, with a median deficit of 11.6 macro-F1 points, at a median 44 times lower measured cost. Its confidence is better calibrated than the verbalized confidence of 16 of the 19 LLMs, yet three frontier models show lower median calibration error (0.157 against 0.066). While items above 0.9 confidence are typically labeled accurately (median accuracy 0.815), on one task, empathy in peer-support dialogues, the model reports high confidence while performing near chance. Nonetheless, our results suggest that decision models are useful as a first step in the annotation pipeline: routing low-confidence items to an LLM matches or exceeds the LLM alone at a quarter to half of its cost.

AI.tldr: 本文在18项计算社会科学分类任务上，将首个商用决策模型及其两个开源版本与19个前沿/开源语言模型在零样本协议下对比。决策模型准确率低于各任务最佳LLM（中位差11.6个macro-F1），但成本低约44倍，置信度校准优于19个LLM中的16个，可作为标注流水线的低成本前置环节。
AI.motivation: 计算社会科学日益依赖大语言模型进行文本标注，已发表结论的有效性取决于这些模型生成的标签。决策模型（decision models）是为分类问答设计的新模型类别，输出选择、标签集上的概率分布和置信度分数而非自由文本，且推理价格远低于前沿模型，但其在社会科学构念上的答案准确性与置信度可信度尚不明确。
AI.method: 复现Ziems等人（2024）的评测框架，在18项计算社会科学分类任务（7,977个条目）上，采用相同的零样本协议，将首个商用决策模型及两个开源权重同类模型与19个前沿和开源权重语言模型进行对比，考察准确率（macro-F1）与置信度校准误差，并检验基于置信度阈值的路由策略。
AI.result: 决策模型在15项评估任务中的14项落后于各任务最佳LLM，macro-F1中位差距为11.6分，但实测成本中位数低约44倍。其置信度校准优于19个LLM中16个的言语化置信度，但有3个前沿模型的中位校准误差更低（0.157对0.066）。置信度高于0.9的条目通常标注准确（中位准确率0.815），但在"同伴支持对话中的共情"这一任务上，模型报告高置信度却表现接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型适合作为标注流水线的第一步：将低置信度条目路由给LLM，可在仅为LLM单独使用成本的四分之一到一半的情况下，达到或超过后者单独使用的效果。

title: Look Where It Counts: A Free, Label-Free Visual Evidence Signal for Fine-Grained Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) fail at fine-grained visual questions less because they cannot reason than because they never see the evidence: high-resolution images are downsampled before encoding, so the model answers from linguistic priors. The standard remedies are expensive: annotated answers (SFT), hand-engineered verifiers (RLVR), or a large external teacher (on-policy distillation). We ask whether the visual evidence itself can supply the signal for free. We formalize the contrastive evidence gap, the per-token log-likelihood ratio that a model assigns to its own output when conditioned on a question-relevant region versus an irrelevant one, and study it across Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-8B, and Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B on V*Bench. Our main positive result is training-free: selecting the candidate crop under which the model's answer distribution is most peaked, using a single-view, label-free criterion, discovers the answer-bearing region with no bounding boxes, training, or labels. It localizes the target 4.4 to 5.1 times better than chance and raises fine-grained accuracy from 70 percent to 85 percent at inference. We further show that the gap is complementary to the model's own confidence. Combining them predicts correctness better than either alone, with AUC up to 0.99, and flags confidently wrong answers, with AUC ranging from 0.97 to 1.00 within the high-confidence subset. All effects concentrate on perception-bottleneck questions and vanish on a global-context control. Finally, we report an honest negative result: converting the same signal into a training method, gated self-distillation (SEG-Distill), does not outperform the base model at pilot scale across three gate designs, while more aggressive gating degrades accuracy. The signal is real, but converting it into training gains remains an open problem.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"对比证据差距"（contrastive evidence gap）这一无需训练、无需标注的信号，用单视图峰值准则在推理阶段定位关键视觉区域，可将细粒度准确率从70%提升到85%；该信号还能与模型置信度互补预测正确性（AUC最高0.99），但将其转化为训练方法（SEG-Distill）在试点规模下未超越基线。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在细粒度视觉问题上失败，主要不是因为推理能力不足，而是因为高分辨率图像在编码前被下采样，导致模型"看不到证据"，只能依赖语言先验作答。现有补救方案（SFT标注、RLVR手工验证器、外部教师在线蒸馏）成本高昂，作者希望探究视觉证据本身能否免费提供监督信号。
AI.method: 形式化"对比证据差距"：模型在给定问题相关区域与无关区域条件下，对其自身输出所赋予的逐token对数似然比。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B、Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B三个模型及V*Bench上展开研究。推理阶段采用无标签、单视图准则：选择使模型答案分布最尖锐（most peaked）的候选裁剪区域，无需边界框、训练或标签。
AI.result: 无需训练的推理方法定位目标的准确率是随机的4.4~5.1倍，使细粒度准确率从70%提升至85%。该证据差距与模型自身置信度互补：二者结合预测正确性的AUC最高达0.99，在高置信子集内识别"自信但错误"答案的AUC为0.97~1.00。所有效应集中于感知瓶颈类问题，在全局上下文对照上消失。负面结果：将同一信号转为训练方法（门控自蒸馏SEG-Distill）在三种门控设计下试点规模均未优于基座模型，更激进的门控反而降低准确率。
AI.conclusion: 对比证据差距是一个真实且有效的信号，在推理阶段可显著提升细粒度视觉定位与准确率，并与置信度形成互补。但将其转化为训练收益仍是未解决的开放问题。

title: Written as a Record, Read as an Address: What a Forward Pass Leaves in an Operation's KV Cache
summary: When a language model reads an operation such as "Swap the contents of Box F and Box B", its forward pass writes keys and values for those tokens into the KV cache. Prior work on entity tracking establishes what models use: bindings are resolved at query time rather than stored as explicit latent state. We ask what they write at the operation span and how it is accessed. We split a forward pass into a frozen writer and a reader: the writer's cache is recomputed without gradients, while the reader sees only the instruction and operation tokens, with all state descriptions hidden, and is trained in isolation. Anything the reader recovers was therefore already present in the unmodified cache. On a synthetic boxes task, a base reader recovers $\leq 0.06$ of queried bindings against $0.75$--$1.00$ after training, and recoverability tracks the operation's read/write footprint. We find two modes of access. Across Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B, operation-span transplants causally redirect which visible state is read even when the two worlds hold identical values, revealing a routing record. Isolation training preserves routing and adds direct access to the payload, the value the operation read, from the single operand-name token in a narrow mid-depth band (layers 12--15 of 32 in Llama-3.1-8B, 14--17 in Mistral-7B) --- the same site that holds the routing record. The same recipe extends to further operations, ToMi and GSM8K, but is bounded by training coverage and costs open-book accuracy. Operation tokens thus leave localized, causally recoverable records that support both routing and direct payload access, though the model that writes them reads mainly the address they carry and not the value.

AI.tldr: 该论文将前向传播拆分为冻结的"写入器"与独立训练的"读取器"，发现操作型token会在KV缓存中留下局部、可因果恢复的记录，这些记录既支持路由也支持对载荷的直接访问，但写它们的模型主要读取的是地址而非值。
AI.motivation: 既有实体追踪研究只确立了模型在查询时解析绑定而非显式存储潜状态，但未回答模型在操作跨度处究竟写入了什么、这些信息如何被访问。作者希望厘清KV缓存在操作token上的内容与访问机制。
AI.method: 把前向传播拆为"写入器"和"读取器"：写入器的KV缓存无梯度重算，读取器仅见指令与操作token（隐藏所有状态描述）并独立训练，因此读取器恢复的任何信息必然原本就存在于未修改的缓存中。在合成盒子任务上验证，并通过操作跨度移植做因果干预，测试Llama-3.1-8B与Mistral-7B，并扩展到ToMi与GSM8K。
AI.result: 基线读取器仅恢复≤0.06的查询绑定，训练后达0.75–1.00，可恢复性随操作的读/写足迹变化。发现两种访问模式：操作跨度移植可因果地重定向读取哪个可见状态（即使两个世界值相同），揭示"路由记录"；隔离训练保留路由并新增对载荷的直接访问，来源是单个操作数名称token，位于中深度窄带（Llama-3.1-8B第12–15层/32层，Mistral-7B第14–17层），与路由记录同址。
AI.conclusion: 操作token在缓存中留下局部、可因果恢复的记录，同时支持路由与直接载荷访问。同一配方可扩展到更多操作、ToMi与GSM8K，但受训练覆盖限制并会牺牲开卷准确率；写这些记录的模型主要读取其携带的地址而非值本身。

title: Hierarchical Prompt Learning for Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
summary: Hyperbolic vision-language models (VLMs) represent image and text features in a geometry naturally suited to hierarchy, but their adaptation to downstream tasks has largely relied on fixed prompts. Existing prompt learning methods, meanwhile, treat class labels as a flat set and do not exploit available taxonomic structure. We address this gap with a hierarchical prompt learning plug-in for frozen hyperbolic VLMs. Given a fixed offline parent-class hierarchy, it augments a class prompt learner with a separate parent prompt learner, parent-level supervision, hyperbolic entailment regularization, and parent-feedback logit fusion. We instantiate the method with CoOp, CoCoOp and MaPLe, yielding HyPLO, CoHyPLO and MaHyPLO. Across the standard 11-dataset benchmark, all variants improve base-to-new generalization and cross-dataset transfer, and remain comparable to their prompt learning baselines under domain shift. Six hierarchical metrics and embedding analyses show that the method produces more taxonomically consistent predictions and induces a hierarchy-consistent organization of parent, class, and image embeddings in hyperbolic space. Its gains are largest when novel classes must be placed within a fixed taxonomy, and smallest for fine-grained confusions among sibling classes or shifts affecting only the image distribution.

AI.tldr: 该工作为冻结的双曲视觉-语言模型提出层次化提示学习插件，通过引入父类提示学习器、父级监督、双曲蕴含正则与父反馈logit融合，在标准11数据集基准上提升了基类-新类泛化与跨数据集迁移。
AI.motivation: 双曲VLM的几何结构天然适配层次关系，但其下游适配多依赖固定提示；而现有提示学习方法把类别标签视为扁平集合，未利用可得的分类学结构。作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在给定固定离线父类层次的前提下，为类别提示学习器增加一个独立的父类提示学习器，并引入父级监督、双曲蕴含正则化以及父反馈logit融合。将该方法实例化于CoOp、CoCoOp和MaPLe，分别得到HyPLO、CoHyPLO与MaHyPLO。
AI.result: 在标准11数据集基准上，所有变体均改善了基类到新类的泛化与跨数据集迁移，在域偏移下与各自的提示学习基线相当。六项层次化指标与嵌入分析表明，该方法产生更符合分类学的预测，并在双曲空间中诱导出父类、类别与图像嵌入的层次一致组织。增益在新类必须置于固定分类体系时最大，在同级类别细粒度混淆或仅影响图像分布的偏移时最小。
AI.conclusion: 该层次化提示学习插件可即插即用地适配多种提示学习方法，在不破坏原有鲁棒性的同时有效利用分类学结构，提升双曲VLM下游任务的层次一致性与泛化能力。

title: Assessing Readability with LLMs: The Role of Reasoning and Few-Shot Prompting
summary: Readability assessment is essential for tailoring texts to intended audiences across educational, healthcare, and information retrieval domains. However, traditional readability formulas struggle to generalize across genres and languages, while supervised machine learning models rely on scarce, domain-specific annotated corpora, limiting their applicability--particularly for less-resourced languages. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a highly scalable, multilingual alternative that requires no task-specific training, yet the impact of advanced prompting strategies on their performance remains underexplored. In this paper, we conduct a systematic benchmark of diverse open-source LLMs for multilingual readability assessment, focusing on the prediction of discrete readability levels required by educational frameworks. In addition to English, we evaluate our approach on a less-resourced language, Slovenian, to establish whether LLMs remain effective in low-resource settings. Specifically, we investigate the influence of explicit reasoning, demonstrating that Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting and reasoning-oriented models yield significant improvements over direct answering. Furthermore, our exploration of few-shot in-context learning reveals that providing just one labelled example per category (1-shot) substantially enhances prediction quality compared to zero-shot settings, with additional examples offering diminishing returns. By comprehensively comparing these approaches against traditional unsupervised metrics and state-of-the-art supervised baselines, we establish the viability of out-of-the-box LLMs as robust, cross-lingual readability assessors.

AI.tldr: 本文对多种开源大语言模型进行多语言可读性评估的系统基准测试，涵盖英语与低资源语言斯洛文尼亚语。研究表明，CoT提示与推理导向模型显著优于直接回答，1-shot 上下文学习相比零样本大幅提升而更多示例收益递减，验证了开箱即用LLM作为稳健跨语言可读性评估器的可行性。
AI.motivation: 可读性评估对教育、医疗与信息检索等领域的文本适配至关重要，但传统可读性公式跨体裁与跨语言泛化能力差，有监督机器学习模型依赖稀缺的领域标注语料，在低资源语言场景下尤为受限。LLM虽提供了可扩展、多语言且无需任务特定训练的方案，但高级提示策略对其性能的影响尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 对多种开源LLM开展多语言可读性评估的系统基准测试，任务为预测教育框架所需的离散可读性等级。除英语外，还评估低资源语言斯洛文尼亚语。重点考察显式推理的影响，对比CoT提示与推理导向模型同直接回答的表现；并探索少样本上下文学习，比较零样本、每类1个标注样本（1-shot）及更多示例的效果。同时与传统无监督指标和当前最优有监督基线进行对比。
AI.result: CoT提示与推理导向模型相比直接回答取得显著提升；每类仅提供1个标注样本的1-shot设置相较零样本大幅改善预测质量，而增加更多示例收益递减；与无监督指标及有监督基线对比后，验证了开箱即用LLM作为稳健跨语言可读性评估器的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 开箱即用的大语言模型可作为稳健的跨语言可读性评估器，在英语及低资源语言场景下均具可行性；显式推理与少量上下文示例是提升性能的关键因素，而无需任务特定训练或大量标注数据。

title: Classifier-Free Guidance in Flow Matching: Non-Autonomous Potentials, Overshoot, and Posterior-Mean Control
summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) improves conditional generation in Flow Matching, but strong guidance can distort the generated distribution and reduce diversity. We provide a geometric account of this behavior by viewing Flow Matching as a time-varying gradient flow and characterizing how CFG reshapes its underlying potential. This view explains how stronger alignment can be accompanied by mean displacement and trajectory concentration, and motivates controlling guidance through the model-implied terminal posterior mean. We therefore propose Posterior-Mean-Capped CFG (PMC-CFG), a training-free, per-sample method that adaptively retains the strongest feasible guidance without additional network evaluations. Experiments on synthetic and large-scale image-generation benchmarks show that PMC-CFG limits guidance-induced distortion and concentration while improving the alignment--diversity trade-off, with particularly strong benefits when nominal guidance is large.

AI.tldr: 本文将Flow Matching视为时变梯度流，从几何角度解释CFG导致分布失真与多样性下降的机理，并提出免训练、逐样本的PMC-CFG方法，在保持最强可行引导的同时改善对齐-多样性权衡。
AI.motivation: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) 能提升Flow Matching的条件生成质量，但强引导会扭曲生成分布并降低多样性。论文希望从几何角度理解该现象的成因，并找到一种能在不牺牲对齐强度的前提下控制失真的引导调节方式。
AI.method: 将Flow Matching建模为时变梯度流，分析CFG如何重塑其潜在势函数，揭示更强对齐伴随均值位移与轨迹集中的机制；据此提出通过模型隐含的终端后验均值来控制引导，设计Posterior-Mean-Capped CFG (PMC-CFG)：一种免训练、逐样本、无需额外网络评估即可自适应保留最强可行引导的方法。
AI.result: 在合成数据与大规模图像生成基准上的实验表明，PMC-CFG能抑制引导引起的分布失真与轨迹集中，改善对齐-多样性权衡，且在名义引导强度较大时收益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 通过梯度流几何视角可统一解释CFG的失真与集中效应，基于终端后验均值上限的PMC-CFG提供了一种无需重训练、计算开销低的引导控制方案，有效缓解强引导带来的多样性损失。

title: Adapting Tree-Structured Speculative Decoding to DeepSeek-V4 for Efficient Inference
summary: Repeated execution of the target model during autoregressive decoding is a major source of LLM inference latency. Unlike linear speculation, which follows a single candidate chain, tree-structured speculation retains multiple branches from shared prefixes; under the same budget, this broader coverage can improve acceptance and efficiency. Adapting it to DeepSeek-V4 is nontrivial: its CSA/HCA online compressed attention concentrates the difficulty on the target-verify side, where branches diverging from a shared prefix compress into different states, breaking cross-branch state consistency. We integrate tree-structured speculative decoding into the DeepSeek-V4-Flash pipeline via branch-aware causal verification, temporary state isolation, and accepted-path state refresh, keeping verification and compressed-state updates consistent across branches. Across budgets D=5 to D=8, batch sizes 1 to 64, and three datasets (GSM8K, MBPP, ShareGPT), tree speculation achieves a higher accepted length than the matched linear configurations in all settings (e.g., at D=8 about 2.83--3.41 versus 2.39--2.84) and improves throughput in nearly all configurations---marginal only at the smallest budget---by up to about 18.5%. More importantly, the gains follow stable, transferable regularities: the relative gain grows with the budget and is most pronounced for less predictable workloads at small-to-medium batch sizes, while beyond a certain budget throughput plateaus and decouples from the still-rising accepted length. These results show that retaining multiple candidate paths under the same budget can effectively improve DeepSeek-V4 decoding efficiency, and offer experience for adapting speculative decoding to future models with compressed, sparse, or structured context representations.

AI.tldr: 本文将树结构投机解码集成到 DeepSeek-V4-Flash，通过分支感知因果校验、临时状态隔离与接受路径状态刷新解决压缩注意力下的跨分支状态一致性问题，在不同预算与批量下取得更高接受长度和最高约18.5%的吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: 自回归解码中反复执行目标模型是 LLM 推理延迟的主要来源。相比线性投机仅沿单条候选链，树结构投机可从共享前缀保留多条分支，在同等预算下覆盖更广，有望提高接受率与效率。但将其适配到 DeepSeek-V4 存在难点：其 CSA/HCA 在线压缩注意力使难点集中在目标验证端，共享前缀分出的不同分支会压缩为不同状态，破坏跨分支状态一致性。
AI.method: 将树结构投机解码集成到 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 流水线，采用三项关键机制：分支感知因果校验、临时状态隔离、接受路径状态刷新，以保证跨分支的校验与压缩状态更新保持一致。
AI.result: 在预算 D=5 至 D=8、批量 1 至 64、以及 GSM8K、MBPP、ShareGPT 三个数据集上，树投机在所有设置下均取得比匹配线性配置更高的接受长度（如 D=8 时约 2.83–3.41 对 2.39–2.84），并在几乎所有配置下提升吞吐（仅在最小预算时增益边际），最高约 18.5%。增益呈稳定可迁移规律：相对增益随预算增大而增加，对可预测性较低的工作负载、小到中等批量最显著；超过一定预算后吞吐趋于平台，与仍上升的接受长度解耦。
AI.conclusion: 在相同预算下保留多条候选路径可有效提升 DeepSeek-V4 的解码效率，并为将投机解码适配到具有压缩、稀疏或结构化上下文表示的未来模型提供了经验。

title: HappyWorld-Bench
summary: Evaluating world models requires assessing both the quality of the worlds they generate and their consistency and responsiveness under exploration, interaction, and modification. We introduce HappyWorld-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark that evaluates whether generated worlds remain reliable as agents interact with them. Our design is built on a hierarchical capability framework of six world capabilities (W1-W6), from generative construction to unified world modeling, instantiated across three independent evaluation tracks: video world models, spatial world models, and embodied world models. HappyWorld-Bench comprises 1,138 video prompts, 300 spatial scenes, and 254 embodied test cases. Across all three tracks, we build and operate HappyWorld-Arena to organize human A/B comparisons and derive model-level Elo ratings, which complement newly designed automated metrics that capture behavioral correctness. We evaluate 14 video world models, 9 spatial systems, and 8 embodied candidates under this unified framework. Results reveal remaining reliability gaps across all three tracks: video models exhibit reduced consistency during extended rollouts and revisits, spatial models achieve at best 70.14% placement accuracy and 73.33% edit execution, and embodied models struggle to preserve state across multi-step actions and respond precisely to altered action conditions and physical rules. These findings highlight the need to evaluate world models not only by visual quality, but also by state consistency and the correctness of their responses to actions and interventions.

AI.tldr: 提出 HappyWorld-Bench，从六个世界能力维度（W1–W6）出发，在视频、空间、具身三条评测轨道上评估世界模型在交互、探索与修改下的可靠性与一致性。
AI.motivation: 评估世界模型不能只看生成世界的视觉质量，还需考察其在探索、交互与修改下是否保持一致性和响应正确性；现有评测缺乏统一的可靠性与行为正确性衡量标准。
AI.method: 构建分层能力框架（六项世界能力 W1–W6，从生成式构建到统一世界建模），实例化为三条独立评测轨道：视频世界模型、空间世界模型、具身世界模型。数据集包含 1,138 条视频提示、300 个空间场景、254 个具身测试用例；通过 HappyWorld-Arena 组织人工 A/B 对比并得出模型级 Elo 评分，同时设计自动化指标刻画行为正确性。共评测 14 个视频世界模型、9 个空间系统和 8 个具身候选模型。
AI.result: 三条轨道均存在可靠性缺口：视频模型在长程 rollout 与重访时一致性下降；空间模型最佳达 70.14% 放置准确率和 73.33% 编辑执行率；具身模型难以在多步动作中保持状态，且对动作条件与物理规则变化的精确响应能力不足。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型评测应超越视觉质量，将状态一致性与对动作、干预响应的正确性纳入核心指标。

title: When Quantization Preserves Accuracy but Not Evidence: Explanation-Aware Post-Training Quantization for Medical LLMs
summary:
Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of large language models, and PTQ methods are usually optimized and evaluated with generic reconstruction, perplexity, or answer accuracy. But in explanation-critical domains, preserving only the final answer may be insufficient, since users may also inspect generated rationales to judge whether a prediction is trustworthy. We study this issue in medical multiple-choice question answering, where rationales should provide evidence that supports the selected answer.
  We propose an explanation-aware objective for transformation-based PTQ. Our method builds an offline faithfulness cache from full-precision teacher rationales and uses it during optimization to preserve answer-supporting evidence tokens and evidence-conditioned answer behavior. We instantiate it on OSTQuant under W4A4KV4 quantization and evaluate four 7B--8B medical and instruction-tuned LLMs on MedExQA, MedExpQA, and ChallengeClinicalQA. While a same-calibration OSTQuant baseline preserves task accuracy, it can substantially weaken answer-supporting rationales. Our objective is to preserve the full-precision model's answer-supporting behavior rather than improve gold-label accuracy, and our method better preserves the full-precision model's answer behavior and rationale-to-answer support. These results suggest that PTQ for explanation-critical settings should evaluate preservation of answer-supporting evidence, not only answer accuracy. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/dut0817/EAQuant.

AI.tldr: 提出解释感知的训练后量化目标EAQuant，在医学多选题场景下保留支撑答案的推理证据。
AI.motivation: 解释敏感领域（如医学问答）中用户会检查生成的理由来判断预测可信度，而现有PTQ方法多以通用重建、困惑度或答案准确率为优化与评估目标，仅保留最终答案不足以保证理由的支撑性。
AI.method: 提出面向变换式PTQ的解释感知目标。基于全精度教师模型生成的理由构建离线忠实度缓存，在优化中用于保留支撑答案的证据token以及以证据为条件的答案行为；在OSTQuant上实例化，采用W4A4KV4量化。
AI.result: 在MedExQA、MedExpQA、ChallengeClinicalQA上评测4个7B–8B医学与指令微调LLM。相同校准集的OSTQuant基线虽能保持任务准确率，但会显著削弱支撑答案的理由；所提方法更好地保留了全精度模型的答案行为与理由到答案的支撑关系。
AI.conclusion: 在解释敏感场景下，PTQ应以保留支撑答案的证据（而非仅答案准确率）作为优化与评估标准。代码与评测脚本见https://github.com/dut0817/EAQuant。

title: AnalogDepth: Multi-view Geometry from FPV drones under Analog Video Transmission
summary:
Analog video transmission (VTX) remains widespread in FPV drones due to low latency, weight and low cost. However analog VTX suffers from complex spatially structured image degradation which differ fundamentally from digital image corruption (e.g. AWGN) used in standard training augmentation. This work shows that this type of noise severely degrades the accuracy of Depth Anything 3 (DA3), a state-of-the-art feed forward visual geometry foundation model.
  To address this gap, we present AnalogDepth, a parameter-efficient training pipeline that adapts DA3 to analog FPV imagery using student-teacher knowledge distillation with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) injected into the DINOv2 backbone. Rather than synthesizing noise analytically, we build a noise bank from static FPV recordings under diverse conditions and compare real-noise injection against PSD-matched Gaussian synthesis and AWGN as baselines. Experiments on six real FPV flight sequences across three indoor scenes show that training with our noise bank consistently reduces per-frame depth RMSE and 3D reconstruction Chamfer distance compared to the pretrained DA3 baseline and both Gaussian noise variants. These results demonstrate that replicating the spatial structure of real analog transmission noise is critical for effective adaptation.
