AI.tldr: 本文提出 AnalogDepth，一种参数高效训练流水线，通过学生-教师知识蒸馏与注入 DINOv2 主干网络的 LoRA，将 Depth Anything 3 (DA3) 适配到模拟 FPV 图像，并构建真实噪声库替代解析合成噪声进行训练。
AI.motivation: 模拟视频传输（VTX）因低延迟、轻量与低成本在 FPV 无人机中广泛使用，但其图像退化具有复杂的空间结构特性，与标准训练增强使用的数字损坏（如 AWGN）本质不同。这种噪声严重降低先进前馈视觉几何基础模型 DA3 的深度估计精度，而现有方法未针对该缺口进行适配。
AI.method: 提出 AnalogDepth：采用学生-教师知识蒸馏，并将 Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) 注入 DINOv2 主干网络进行参数高效微调；不采用解析合成噪声，而是基于多种条件下的静态 FPV 录像构建噪声库，并将真实噪声注入与 PSD 匹配高斯合成、AWGN 两种基线进行对比。
AI.result: 在三个室内场景的六段真实 FPV 飞行序列上，使用噪声库训练相比预训练 DA3 基线及两种高斯噪声变体，持续降低了逐帧深度 RMSE 与 3D 重建 Chamfer 距离。
AI.conclusion: 复现真实模拟传输噪声的空间结构对于有效适配至关重要；利用真实噪声库进行参数高效蒸馏训练可显著提升模拟 FPV 图像下的深度估计与重建性能。

title: MSI-Bench: Evaluating Multi-Speaker Voice Interaction for Collaborative AI Agents
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/M2cha4l1124/MSI-Bench ; Code: https://github.com/boson-ai/MSI-Bench
summary: Voice provides a natural and immediate interface for AI agents. Many settings in which voice agents could be useful, including meetings, households, and collaborative work, are inherently multi-speaker. Supporting these settings introduces challenges that are largely absent from one-on-one interaction. We introduce the Multi-Speaker Interaction Benchmark (MSI-Bench) for evaluating multi-speaker voice interaction. Each test case is a short multi-party multi-turn audio scene with participant context, expected tool calls, and atomic rubrics. The benchmark targets three capability families: multi-speaker memory, multi-speaker instruction following, and multi-speaker reasoning. It comprises 1,152 test cases, evenly split between Mandarin Chinese and English (576 each). The strongest configuration on each split passes all rubrics on only 66.8% of English and 54.5% of Mandarin cases, and the strongest open-weight configuration on 34.0% and 19.3%. Failure analysis separates perception from reasoning: open-weight models are bottlenecked by the multi-speaker audio front-end, while frontier systems still fail speaker-scoped decision making on clean transcripts---and models across the board often respond when no one has addressed them. These results identify speaker-grounded perception, speaker-scoped decision making, and conversational restraint as concrete targets for future voice agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多说话人交互基准 MSI-Bench，用于评测多说话人语音交互中的记忆、指令跟随与推理能力，含 1152 个中英双语测试用例。
AI.motivation: 语音是 AI 智能体的自然交互接口，但会议、家庭、协作等真实场景本质上是多说话人的，这带来了单对单交互中不存在的挑战，而现有评测缺乏针对多说话人语音交互的系统性基准。
AI.method: 构建 MSI-Bench：每个测试用例为带参与者上下文的多方多轮短音频场景，配有期望的工具调用与原子化评分细则（rubrics），覆盖多说话人记忆、多说话人指令跟随、多说话人推理三类能力；共 1152 例，中英文各 576 例。
AI.result: 最强配置仅通过英文 66.8%、中文 54.5% 的全部评分细则；最强开源配置仅为 34.0% 和 19.3%。失败分析显示：开源模型瓶颈在多说话人音频前端（感知），前沿系统即便在干净转写上仍失败于说话人范围决策，且各模型普遍存在无人呼叫却应答的问题。
AI.conclusion: 多说话人语音智能体未来需重点攻克三个方向：基于说话人的感知、说话人范围的决策、以及对话克制（无被呼叫时不应答）。

title: NeuIDO: Neural Intrinsic Dynamics Operator for Physics-Informed 4D World Models
comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026; Project Page: https://github.com/JiajingLin/NeuIDO
summary: World models aim to capture environmental dynamics and predict future trajectories, showing growing potential for embodied intelligence. Physics-informed 4D generation integrates physical simulation to predict 3D object interactions, offering a promising pathway toward world models. However, this paradigm relies on manually imposed dynamical assumptions rather than internalizing world dynamics, and thus still leaves a gap toward a true world model. To bridge this gap, we propose NeuIDO, a novel world dynamics modeling framework that learns a unified intrinsic dynamics representation from visual observations, advancing physics-informed 4D generation toward a world model. Specifically, we formulate world modeling as a neural operator learning problem and introduce a two-stage training strategy to learn a generalizable mapping from the visual observation distribution to the intrinsic dynamics distribution. Building on this observation-dynamics mapping, NeuIDO enables zero-shot dynamics inference directly from videos and can be further aligned with complex real-world dynamics via few-shot adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeuIDO effectively unifies the intrinsic dynamics underlying diverse visual observations into a shared representation and rapidly infers dynamics in novel scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NeuIDO，一个从视觉观测中学习统一内在动力学表征的世界动力学建模框架，将物理信息驱动的 4D 生成推向世界模型，实现零样本动力学推理与少样本适配。
AI.motivation: 世界模型旨在捕捉环境动力学并预测未来轨迹，在具身智能中潜力巨大。物理信息驱动的 4D 生成虽能预测 3D 物体交互，但依赖人工设定的动力学假设，而非内化世界动力学，因此与真正的世界模型仍有差距。
AI.method: 将世界建模形式化为神经算子学习问题，提出两阶段训练策略，学习从视觉观测分布到内在动力学分布的泛化映射，构建统一的内在动力学表征。
AI.result: 实验表明，NeuIDO 能将多样视觉观测背后的内在动力学统一到共享表征中，并可在新场景中快速推理动力学；支持从视频直接进行零样本动力学推理，并可通过少样本适配对齐复杂真实世界动力学。
AI.conclusion: NeuIDO 弥合了物理信息驱动 4D 生成与世界模型之间的差距，为从视觉观测中内化世界动力学提供了可行路径。

title: The Answer-Basin Representation Hypothesis: We Are Not Probing or Steering Concepts
summary: The Linear Representation Hypothesis associates high-level concepts with directions in language models, but it remains unclear how these concept-related linear structures are organized within the model. We propose the Answer-Basin Representation Hypothesis: the probability measure induced over answers by the model's continuation distribution organizes these linear structures, with its statistics represented along linear directions shared across questions. All continuations yielding the same answer form an answer basin, whose mass is their total probability. These basin masses define the pushforward probability measure over answers. We posit that concept-related linear structure emerges from differences in the answer measure rather than being determined by changes in concept labels. Experiments across models and tasks link concept-consistent effects and their reversals in probing and steering to the alignment between concept labels and the answer measure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"答案盆地表示假说"(Answer-Basin Representation Hypothesis)，认为语言模型中概念相关的线性结构是由模型对答案的续写概率分布所组织的，盆地质（同一答案全部续写的总概率）定义的答案测度塑造了这些线性方向，而非概念标签本身。
AI.motivation: 线性表示假说将高层概念与语言模型中的方向关联，但这些概念相关线性结构在模型内部如何被组织仍不清楚。本文试图解释这些线性结构的来源与组织机制。
AI.method: 提出答案盆地表示假说：将所有产生同一答案的续写视为一个"答案盆地"，其总概率为盆地质量；这些盆地质量定义答案上的推前概率测度。假说认为概念相关线性结构源于答案测度的差异，而非概念标签的变化。在多个模型与任务上进行探测(probing)与引导(steering)实验进行验证。
AI.result: 实验将探测与引导中概念一致效应及其反转，与概念标签和答案测度之间的一致性联系起来，验证了假说。
AI.conclusion: 概念相关的线性结构由答案测度组织，其统计量沿跨问题共享的线性方向表示；概念标签本身并不决定该结构，而是通过与答案测度的一致性发挥作用。

title: AlignMorph: Tuning-Free Diffusion Image Morphing via Explicit Semantic Transport
summary: Image morphing aims to produce a smooth and semantically consistent transition between two input images. Existing diffusion-based morphing methods either require expensive per-pair optimization or rely on implicit spatial alignment, which easily fails under large layout discrepancies. To address these limitations, we propose AlignMorph, a novel tuning-free diffusion framework guided by the principle of transport-then-denoise. We explicitly decouple geometric alignment from generative denoising to avoid structural entanglement. Our framework consists of two core components. (1) Global Semantic Transport, which achieves diffusion-compatible semantic alignment via entropic optimal transport and reliability-aware latent warping; and (2) Coordinate-Aligned Generation, which uses a symmetric bi-phase attention handoff to maintain consistent spatial coordinates throughout denoising. Without any tuning, AlignMorph effectively eliminates ghosting and achieves superior structural coherence and temporal smoothness on morphing benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/51xOne/Alignmorph.

AI.tldr: AlignMorph：一种免调优的扩散框架，遵循"先传输后去噪"原则，通过显式解耦几何对齐与生成去噪，解决图像变形中大布局差异下的错位问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的图像变形方法存在两大缺陷：一是需要针对每一对图像进行昂贵的逐对优化；二是依赖隐式空间对齐，在大布局差异场景下容易失败。因此需要一个既无需调优又能稳健处理大布局差异的对齐方案。
AI.method: 提出 AlignMorph 免调优扩散框架，核心思想为"先传输后去噪"，将几何对齐与生成去噪显式解耦。包含两个组件：(1) 全局语义传输：通过熵正则化最优传输与可靠性感知的隐空间变形，实现与扩散过程兼容的语义对齐；(2) 坐标对齐生成：采用对称双阶段注意力交接，在去噪全程维持一致的空间坐标。
AI.result: 在无需任何调优的情况下，AlignMorph 有效消除了鬼影现象，在变形基准上取得了更优的结构连贯性与时序平滑性。
AI.conclusion: 通过"传输-去噪"解耦范式与双组件协作，AlignMorph 为图像变形提供了一种免调优、结构连贯且能应对大布局差异的新方案，代码已开源。

title: Decomposing Error and Style in Automated Clinical Coding
summary: In automated clinical coding, where the label space spans tens of thousands of diagnosis and procedure codes, models are currently evaluated against a single gold annotation, treating any deviation as error. But we find when two teams code the same 110 ACI-Bench encounters, they agree on only 73% of codes (Jaccard similarity) for the same note; even after an independent clinical audit removes erroneous codes, agreement rises only to 77%. Is that gap error or something systematic? We model the systematic component as coding style $ψ$, a coder- or site-specific policy over what to code and how much to document, and recast coding as $p(\mathrm{code}\mid\mathrm{note},ψ)$, estimating $ψ$ with a 10-dimension rubric. If style were noise, conditioning on it would do nothing. Instead, across five datasets a model conditioned with a data-matching style raises ICD F1 by up to 26 points and an extreme mismatched one lowers it by up to 21. Four prompt based coding methods spanning 39-49 F1 converge to 52-56 once style is supplied (All p<0.05). Much of what single-gold evaluation charges to model error is recoverable, unmodeled style.

AI.tldr: 自动临床编码中不同编码团队对同一病历的标注仅约73%一致，该差异很大程度源于可建模的"编码风格ψ"而非纯误差；以10维评分卡估计风格并条件化后，模型ICD F1最高提升26分，四种提示方法F1从39-49收敛至52-56。
AI.motivation: 当前自动临床编码（标签空间达数万诊断与操作码）均以单一金标准标注评估，任何偏离都计为错误。但两个团队对同一110份ACI-Bench病历编码，Jaccard一致率仅73%；即便经独立临床审核剔除错误码后也仅升至77%。作者据此追问：这部分差距究竟是模型误差，还是某种系统性因素。
AI.method: 将系统性成分建模为"编码风格ψ"——即编码者或机构在"编什么、记录多少"上的策略；把编码任务重构为条件概率 p(code|note, ψ)，并用一个10维评分卡来估计ψ，从而在评估与训练中显式条件化于风格。
AI.result: 若风格只是噪声，条件化应无效果；但在五个数据集上，条件化于与数据匹配的风格可使ICD F1最高提升26分，而极端不匹配风格则最多降低21分。四种基于提示的编码方法（F1在39-49之间）在提供风格后收敛至52-56（所有p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 单金标准评估所归咎于模型的"错误"中，有很大一部分是可恢复但未被建模的编码风格，而非真正的模型能力缺陷；应将编码风格纳入建模与评估体系。

title: LiAuto-MindViT: A Hybrid Vision Backbone with Adaptive Bidirectional Mamba
summary: While Mamba-based models have shown strong potential for long sequence modeling, adapting them to vision is challenging due to the requirement of local neighborhood correlations and multi-directional spatial contexts for visual understanding. In this paper, we present LiAuto-MindViT, a novel hybrid vision backbone that synergizes the strengths of CNNs, Mamba, and Transformers. The core of our design is the Adaptive Bidirectional Mamba (ABM), which eliminates the directional bias of unidirectional SSMs through bidirectional selective scanning with learnable alpha blending, enabling content-adaptive directional fusion without the overhead of exhaustive multi-path routing. To further accelerate inference, we propose a deployment-friendly Reparameterized ConvSE (RepConvSE) module that leverages structural reparameterization to reduce latency and memory access overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiAuto-MindViT achieves state-of-the-art performance on image classification, object detection, and semantic segmentation while enabling efficient inference through reparameterization.

AI.tldr: 提出LiAuto-MindViT混合视觉骨干网络，融合CNN、Mamba与Transformer优势，通过自适应双向Mamba（ABM）与重参数化RepConvSE实现高效推理，在分类、检测、分割任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: Mamba类模型在长序列建模上潜力突出，但直接迁移到视觉领域存在困难：视觉理解既需要局部邻域相关性，又需要多方向的空间上下文，而单向状态空间模型（SSM）存在方向偏差，多路径路由方案又带来额外开销。
AI.method: 设计混合视觉骨干LiAuto-MindViT，核心为自适应双向Mamba（ABM）：通过带可学习alpha混合的双向选择性扫描消除单向SSM的方向偏好，实现内容自适应的方向融合，避免穷举多路径路由开销；同时提出面向部署的Reparameterized ConvSE（RepConvSE）模块，利用结构重参数化降低延迟与访存开销。
AI.result: 在图像分类、目标检测与语义分割任务上均达到state-of-the-art性能，并通过重参数化实现高效推理。
AI.conclusion: 将CNN、Mamba与Transformer协同设计，配合双向自适应扫描与结构重参数化，可在保持视觉建模能力的同时兼顾推理效率，为高效视觉骨干提供了可行方案。

title: The Copy Ceiling: An Input-Exposure Control for Ontology-Grounded Generation over Curated Corpora
summary: When a language model answers from a curated corpus via graph-based retrieval, a large grounding uplift does not establish reasoning over the retrieved structure: the context may already expose the gold answers. We propose exposure accounting, which classifies each gold item by whether the shown context exposes it and whether the answer recovers it. Its scalar reference is the copy ceiling, the recall a verbatim copy of the context achieves; signed gain over copy measures the model's recall relative to this deterministic, judge-free baseline. Across ten models, unaided recall averages 0.26 and grounded recall 0.92, yet gain over copy is uniformly negative (-0.067 to -0.022). Of 11,360 gold-item observations, representing 1,136 target instances evaluated under ten models, only three unexposed items receive lexical credit. A stratified model-judged audit of 423 observations, with a symmetric quotation-verification policy, estimates that 97.1% of credited items assert the requested relation; all three unexposed credits fail relational adjudication. On targets the scaffold does not expose, lexical recovery falls from 0.121 unaided to 0.004 grounded; adjudication validates 71 of the 92 unaided credits and none of the three grounded credits, without establishing full-frame relational recovery rates. Rephrasing questions outside the graph's title vocabulary reduces exposure from 0.964 to 0.328, while an absence-triggered fallback activates on only 2 of 506 questions. A paired production study improves judged quality by +0.27 pooled, but negative controls do not establish content specificity beyond a well-formed on-corpus block. These results support exposure accounting as a standing control for corpus-derived evaluations. The accounting distinguishes exposed-item omissions from beyond-exposure recoveries; it does not determine whether reasoning occurred.

AI.tldr: 提出"暴露核算"方法，以复制上限为标尺衡量图检索问答中模型相对逐字复制的召回增益，发现十模型增益一致为负，多数被记分项实为上下文已暴露，方法作为语料评测的常备对照而非推理判定。
AI.motivation: 基于图检索的语料问答中，大幅的"落地增益"并不能证明模型对检索结构进行了推理，因为所展示的上下文本身可能已直接暴露金标答案，缺少一个免评判器、确定性的基线来区分"暴露项遗漏"与"超出暴露的恢复"。
AI.method: 提出暴露核算：对每个金标项按"上下文是否暴露"与"答案是否恢复"进行分类；以复制上限（对上下文逐字复制所达召回）作为标量参照，用相对复制的带符号增益衡量模型表现。另设分层模型评判审计（423 条观测，对称引文核验策略）、改写问题避开图标题词汇的暴露度实验，以及缺位触发的兜底机制检验。
AI.result: 十模型无辅助召回均值 0.26、有上下文召回 0.92，但相对复制的增益全为负（-0.067 至 -0.022）。11,360 条金标项观测（1,136 个目标实例×十模型）中仅 3 个未暴露项获得词汇记分。审计估计 97.1% 被记分项确实断言了所请求关系，而 3 个未暴露记分项全部未通过关系裁定。未暴露目标上，词汇恢复由无辅助 0.121 降至有上下文 0.004；裁定确认 92 个无辅助记分中的 71 个、3 个有上下文记分中的 0 个。改写问题使暴露度由 0.964 降至 0.328，兜底机制仅在 506 个问题中的 2 个被触发。配对生产研究判定质量提升 +0.27（合并），但负对照未能确立超出格式良好语料块的内容特异性。
AI.conclusion: 暴露核算可作为语料派生评测的常备对照，用于区分"暴露项遗漏"与"超出暴露的恢复"；但它并不判定推理是否真正发生。

title: Dissecting Agentic Forensics: The Role of Triage, Prompting, and Evidence Arbitration in Open-World Fake Image Detection
comment: Accepted at the 2026 Workshop on AI for Multimedia Forensics and Disinformation Detection (AI4MFDD), ECCV 2026. 34 pages (17 main paper incl. references, 17 appendix), 7 figures, 5 tables
summary: Image forensics is increasingly an open-world problem: manipulations range from fully synthetic images to localized edits, splicing and swapping, while most forensic detectors remain specialized to a single manipulation family. Agentic AI has recently emerged as a promising solution. In principle, such systems can assess the reliability of individual detectors, identify out-of-scope evidence, and arbitrate conflicting reports. However, it remains unclear which components actually drive performance and whether their benefits persist under distribution shift. To answer these questions, we study a training-free agentic framework built around specialist detectors, per-detector triage, and conflict-aware evidence arbitration. Using six configurations and three multimodal large language model backbones, we dissect the role of triage, prompting, and reasoning quality on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data. Our results show that naive detector fusion suffers from severe false-positive rates on authentic images. Triage and prompting consistently improve performance by filtering unreliable evidence and exposing detector limitations. However, the dominant factor is represented by reasoning itself: A stronger judge substantially outperforms a weaker one, particularly under distribution shift. Most notably, manipulation recall is nearly saturated across all configurations, indicating that the main challenge of open-world image forensics is not detecting manipulations, but calibrating trust in specialized forensic tools and arbitrating conflicting evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究免训练智能体框架在开放世界图像取证中的作用：通过6种配置、3种多模态大模型骨干，拆解分流、提示与推理质量对分布内/分布外性能的贡献。结果表明朴素检测器融合在真实图像上误报严重，分流与提示可稳定提升性能，但推理质量（更强裁判）才是主导因素；操纵召回率近乎饱和，开放世界取证的核心挑战在于校准对专用取证工具的信任并仲裁冲突证据。
AI.motivation: 图像取证日益成为开放世界问题：操纵手段涵盖全合成图像与局部编辑、拼接、替换等，而多数取证检测器仅专精于单一操纵类型。智能体AI被视为潜在解法，因为其理论上可评估单个检测器可靠性、识别超范围证据并仲裁冲突报告。但尚不清楚哪些组件真正驱动性能，也不清楚其收益在分布偏移下是否依然成立，因此需要系统拆解。
AI.method: 构建一个免训练的智能体框架，围绕三类组件：专用检测器（specialist detectors）、逐检测器分流（per-detector triage）以及冲突感知的证据仲裁（conflict-aware evidence arbitration）。实验设计包含6种配置与3种多模态大语言模型骨干，在分布内与分布外数据上分别考察分流、提示（prompting）与推理质量的作用。
AI.result: 朴素检测器融合在真实图像上误报率严重。分流与提示通过过滤不可靠证据、暴露检测器局限而持续提升性能。但主导因素是推理本身：更强的裁判模型显著优于较弱者，且在分布偏移下优势更明显。最突出的是，操纵召回率在所有配置下近乎饱和，说明检测操纵并非开放世界图像取证的主要难题。
AI.conclusion: 开放世界图像取证的核心挑战不在操纵检测本身，而在于校准对专用取证工具的信任，并对相互冲突的证据进行仲裁；推理质量（裁判模型能力）是决定系统性能的关键因素，尤其在分布偏移场景下。

title: OSWorld-Pro: Process-based Evaluation for Computer Use Agents
summary: Evaluation of Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) is often limited to the final deliverables they create (at the end of hundreds of steps) and assessed with functional verifiers, as seen in OSWorld. However, such evaluation of end-state performance lacks transparency into how and why agents fail in various tasks, obfuscating critical insight for subsequent improvement. For instance, agents that err during keyboard inputs would require a different mitigation strategy from those that fail to precisely provide click-based inputs on the graphical UI. We introduce OSWorld-Pro: a set of over 300 tasks containing over 2800 subgoals to enable the procedural evaluation of CUAs grounded in over 67,000 human annotations. We use robust human-aligned LLM-Judges to evaluate the fulfillment of OSWorld-Pro subgoals and thereby reveal the progress that models make throughout a series of sequentially dependent subgoals. Our findings reveal that OSWorld-Pro is challenging even for state-of-the-art LLMs, with top performers like Claude Opus 5 achieving only 75.7% vs. 83.4% on OSWorld. Furthermore, we identify critical process-focused failure modes of various models (e.g. subgoal-irrelevant actions and click-based mistakes) to provide insights to improve performance and efficiency of CUAs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 OSWorld-Pro，一个包含超过 300 个任务、2800 多个子目标、基于 67,000 余条人工标注的过程性评测基准，用人类对齐的 LLM-Judge 评估计算机使用代理（CUA）的子目标完成情况，从而揭示模型的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有 CUA 评测（如 OSWorld）仅关注数百步后产出的最终结果，并用功能性验证器评估终态性能，缺乏对代理“如何失败、为何失败”的过程透明度。例如键盘输入错误与图形界面点击不精确需要不同的改进策略，但终态评测无法区分，阻碍了针对性优化。
AI.method: 构建 OSWorld-Pro 基准：300+ 任务、2800+ 子目标，基于 67,000+ 人工标注；采用稳健的、与人类对齐的 LLM-Judge 评估子目标达成情况，追踪模型在一系列顺序依赖子目标中的进展。
AI.result: 即使对最先进 LLM 而言 OSWorld-Pro 也具挑战性：顶级模型如 Claude Opus 5 仅达 75.7%，低于其在 OSWorld 上的 83.4%；同时识别出以过程为中心的失败模式，如与子目标无关的操作和点击类错误。
AI.conclusion: OSWorld-Pro 通过过程性、细粒度的子目标评测，弥补了终态评估的不足，揭示 CUA 的过程失败模式，为提升代理性能与效率提供可操作洞见。

title: TReViS: Temporal Repetition Structure Aware Video Synthesis for Self-supervised Repetitive Action Counting
comment: Accepted for publication in Image and Vision Computing (Elsevier). This is the author-accepted manuscript and not the final published version of record. The DOI and link to the published version will be added when available
summary: Fully supervised repetitive action counting (RAC) has achieved strong performance, but requires dense temporal annotations that are costly and difficult to scale. We propose TReViS, a self-supervised video synthesis framework that enables training RAC models without any repetition labels. TReViS estimates the underlying temporal repetition structure of an unlabeled video via a Temporal Self-Similarity Matrix, infers its cycle statistics, and synthesizes new training sequences that preserve realistic repetition patterns while introducing controlled temporal variability. These synthesized videos are paired with pseudo-labels and used to train existing RAC architectures from scratch. Across multiple datasets and backbones, TReViS consistently outperforms prior self-supervised methods and achieves performance competitive with several supervised baselines, while remaining fully label-free, demonstrating the effectiveness of structure-aware video synthesis for label-free RAC. The source code is available at https://github.com/yfqi/TReViS.

AI.tldr: TReViS：一种无需重复标签的自监督视频合成框架，通过时间自相似矩阵推断重复结构并合成带伪标签的训练视频，训练RAC模型，性能优于现有自监督方法并接近部分有监督基线。
AI.motivation: 现有全监督重复动作计数（RAC）性能虽强，但依赖成本高、难以扩展的密集时间标注；本文旨在无需任何重复标签的情况下训练RAC模型。
AI.method: TReViS通过时间自相似矩阵（Temporal Self-Similarity Matrix）估计无标签视频的潜在时间重复结构，推断其周期统计量，并据此合成保留真实重复模式且引入可控时间变化的新训练序列；合成视频配以伪标签，从头训练现有RAC架构。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种骨干网络上，TReViS持续优于先前自监督方法，并与若干有监督基线性能相当，同时保持完全无标签。
AI.conclusion: 结构感知的视频合成对无标签RAC有效，为无需重复标注的重复动作计数提供了可行方案；代码已开源。

title: Human-LLM Deliberation as Interactive Proof: Conditions for Verifiability Without Transparency
summary: When an LLM supplies an argument that a user could not readily construct, how can the user decide whether to accept its claim? Inspired by interactive proofs, we model human-LLM deliberation as an interaction between a prover with unrestricted internal search and a resource-bounded human verifier. The verifier requests and checks supporting details without access to the LLM's internal state. Passed checks accumulate evidence toward an acceptance threshold. We prove anytime-valid soundness against adaptive provers: the probability of ever accepting a false claim is at most a chosen error level, provided the task supplies bounds on false passes and human checking errors that remain valid after every relevant history. A finite-horizon completeness bound additionally requires bounds on the adequacy of honest responses and sufficient diagnostic progress. Further checks can strengthen the evidence for acceptance, but each requires another adequate response and reliable human effort. Whether this tradeoff permits certification depends on the verifier's effort budget, cognitive load, expertise, and fatigue. We identify conditions under which the supplied bounds certify a specified sequence of local checks but not a specified global check under the same resource budgets.

AI.tldr: 该文将人-LLM审议建模为不受限证明者与资源受限人类验证者之间的交互证明，证明在任务提供有效的假通过率与人类检查错误率下界时，对自适应证明者具有任意时刻有效的可靠性；有限时域完备性还需诚实响应充分性与诊断进展下界。进一步检查可增强接受证据，但需更多充分响应与可靠人类投入，能否认证取决于验证者的努力预算、认知负荷、专业知识与疲劳。
AI.motivation: 当LLM给出用户难以独立构造的论证时，用户缺乏明确依据判断是否接受其主张；需要一种理论框架来界定在资源受限、无法访问模型内部状态的条件下，何时以及如何可靠地接受LLM的论证。
AI.method: 借鉴交互证明，将人-LLM审议形式化为无限制内部搜索的证明者与资源受限人类验证者之间的交互：验证者请求并检查支持细节，不访问LLM内部状态，通过的检查累积证据直至接受阈值；并给出对自适应证明者的任意时刻有效可靠性证明与有限时域完备性界。
AI.result: 在任务提供假通过与人类检查错误的有效下界时，证明接受虚假主张的概率不超过选定错误水平（任意时刻有效可靠性）；有限时域完备性要求诚实响应充分性与充分诊断进展的下界；额外检查可增强接受证据，但每次需另一充分响应与可靠人类投入。识别出在相同资源预算下，所提供的下界能认证特定序列的局部检查、却不能认证特定全局检查的条件。
AI.conclusion: 人-LLM审议的可靠性认证受制于人类验证者的资源与认知约束：局部检查可由给定下界认证，而全局检查在同等资源预算下未必可认证；认证可行性取决于努力预算、认知负荷、专业知识与疲劳等因素。

title: Topographic Training Concentrates Causal Circuits Without Improving Neuron Monosemanticity
comment: Accepted at the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: Mechanistic interpretability of vision transformers seeks to decompose model computation into human-readable units, but learned representations entangle many concepts in each neuron. Feature superposition is widely treated as the central obstacle to this decomposition, yet most mitigations (sparse autoencoders, dictionary learning) are post-hoc and leave the underlying network unchanged. We ask whether a spatial-locality training loss (TopoLoss) can act as a lightweight, training-time prior that improves interpretability of standard mech-interp tools. Training ViT on ImageNet-100 across multiple TopoLoss weights $α$, we measure causal sufficiency of topographic clusters via activation patching and feature geometry via sparse autoencoders fit to the same residual stream. At $α=1.0$, topographic clusters are 2.79$\times$ more causally sufficient than random unit sets of the same size, with the effect increasing monotonically in $α$. SAE L0 sparsity decreases by 11% and dead-feature fraction rises 19-fold, yet standard neuron-level monosemanticity scores are unchanged, indicating that topographic pressure acts at circuit level, concentrating causal mass into spatially local structures without disentangling individual neurons. This dissociation suggests current neuron-level monosemanticity metrics are insensitive to a class of real interpretability gains, and positions cheap architectural priors as a viable training-time complement to post-hoc tooling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用空间局部性训练损失(TopoLoss)作为训练期先验来提升ViT的可解释性，发现其效果作用于"回路层面"而非单个神经元层面。
AI.motivation: 机制可解释性希望将模型计算分解为人类可读单元，但神经元表示存在特征叠加(feature superposition)。现有缓解手段（稀疏自编码器、字典学习）多为事后(post-hoc)处理，不改变底层网络，因此探索是否可用轻量训练期先验改善标准工具的可解释性。
AI.method: 在ImageNet-100上以不同TopoLoss权重α训练ViT；通过激活修补(activation patching)测量拓扑聚类的因果充分性，并对同一残差流拟合稀疏自编码器以分析特征几何。
AI.result: α=1.0时，拓扑聚类的因果充分性为同尺寸随机单元集的2.79倍，且效应随α单调增强；SAE的L0稀疏度下降11%，死特征比例上升19倍，但标准神经元级单义性分数不变。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑压力在回路层面起作用，将因果质量集中于空间局部结构，却不拆解单个神经元。该解离表明当前神经元级单义性指标对一类真实的可解释性增益不敏感，说明廉价架构先验可作为事后工具的训练期补充。

title: ToneCL: Contrastive Learning for Few-Shot Syllable-Level Tone Classification
summary: Tone languages constitute over 50-70% of the world's languages, but the vast majority are low-resource, lacking the large transcribed corpora needed for automatic tone classification. Existing datasets are typically collected at the sentence level, whereas field linguists require fine-grained syllable-level annotations. We propose ToneCL, a lightweight contrastive learning framework for few-shot syllable-level tone classification. We simulate low-resource conditions on Mandarin and Vietnamese, limiting labeled data to tens of examples per tone class. ToneCL is pretrained on unlabeled speech with augmentations that preserve tonal identity, then fine-tuned on few-shot examples. Experiments show our method consistently outperforms baselines, achieving 91.6% on six-speaker Mandarin at 10 shots. Cross-lingual transfer is also effective: pretraining on Vietnamese and fine-tuning on Mandarin reaches 91.0\% accuracy at 10 shots. Ablation confirms that frequency band rejection is the most critical augmentation.

AI.tldr: ToneCL：面向小样本音节级声调分类的轻量对比学习框架，在低资源条件下通过保持声调特性的增强进行预训练并微调。
AI.motivation: 声调语言占全球语言50-70%，但多为低资源语言，缺乏大规模转写语料；现有数据集多为句子级，而田野语言学家需要细粒度音节级标注。
AI.method: ToneCL采用轻量对比学习框架，先在无标注语音上使用保持声调身份的增强进行预训练，再在小样本（每类声调数十例）标注数据上微调；在普通话与越南语上模拟低资源条件。
AI.result: 方法持续优于基线，六说话人普通话10 shots达91.6%；跨语言迁移有效，越南语预训练后普通话微调10 shots达91.0%；消融实验表明频带抑制是最关键的增强手段。
AI.conclusion: ToneCL验证了对比预训练结合声调保持增强在小样本音节级声调分类及跨语言迁移中的有效性。

title: A Lightweight Convolutional Neural Network for Real-Time Recognition of Hand-Drawn Geometric Shapes
summary: Recognizing hand-drawn geometric shapes is a foundational sub-problem of sketch recognition, with applications in education, human-computer interaction, and diagram digitization. This paper presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of a desktop application that recognizes four basic hand-drawn geometric shapes, circle, square, rectangle, and triangle using a compact Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). A dataset of 2,000 labeled 28x28-pixel shape images was collected independently and released publicly. The classifier consists of three convolutional blocks (16, 32, and 64 filters) with max-pooling, an in-model data-augmentation stage (random horizontal flip, rotation, and zoom), a dropout-regularized dense layer of 128 units, and a 4-way linear output layer, totaling 97{,}956 trainable parameters. The network is trained with the Adam optimizer on a sparse categorical cross-entropy objective computed directly on logits. On an 80/20 train-validation split, the model achieves 94.80% training accuracy and 96.01% validation accuracy with a validation loss of 0.1437. A Tkinter-based graphical interface allows a user to draw a shape with the mouse and receive an immediate class prediction with a confidence score. We situate this system within the broader sketch and shape-recognition literature, compare its accuracy against related hand-drawn shape classification studies, and discuss the limitations inherent to a small, single-contributor dataset. The complete source code, trained model, and per-class datasets are released publicly to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文设计并实现了一个基于轻量级CNN（97,956参数）的桌面手绘几何图形识别应用，可识别圆、正方形、矩形和三角形四类图形，并公开了数据集、模型与源码。
AI.motivation: 手绘几何图形识别是草图识别的基础子问题，在教育、人机交互和图形数字化等领域有应用价值，但相关研究受限于小规模数据集等问题。本文旨在构建一个紧凑、可复现且交互友好的识别系统，并对其性能与局限进行实证评估。
AI.method: 独立采集并公开2,000张28×28像素的标注图形数据集；构建三组卷积块（16、32、64个滤波器）配合最大池化的CNN，内含模型内数据增强（随机水平翻转、旋转、缩放）、dropout正则化的128单元全连接层及4路线性输出层；采用Adam优化器，直接在logits上计算稀疏类别交叉熵损失；通过Tkinter实现鼠标绘制与实时预测的图形界面。
AI.result: 在80/20的训练-验证划分下，模型取得94.80%的训练准确率和96.01%的验证准确率，验证损失为0.1437。
AI.conclusion: 该系统在四类手绘图形识别任务上达到较高准确率，并被置于更广泛的草图与图形识别文献中与相关研究进行比较；同时讨论了小规模、单一采集者数据集带来的固有局限，并公开完整源码、训练模型及各类数据集以支持可复现性。

title: SocioVerse2: A Longitudinal Dynamic Social Simulation Framework under a Human-AI Co-evolutionary Paradigm
summary: Social simulation offers the social sciences an experimental instrument that the real world cannot supply, and generative agents have transformed it by acting as silicon samples that unite agent-based modeling with real behavioral data. Existing platforms verify collective behavior, align simulated populations with real societies in cross-sections, and employ autonomous agents for the research process. However, two social science requirements remain without systematic support: intervention in the content of a simulation and the researcher's control over the process that produces it. We present SocioVerse2, which extends SocioVerse 1.0 into a human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm built from two loops and one infrastructure. The longitudinal simulation loop simulates the target population with evolving environments and forks counterfactual branches via interventions. The controllable research loop takes the study itself as an editable state and updates state versions via controllable editing. The social science agentic infrastructure carries both loops through composable skills with researcher checkpoints, a population service over five persona pools, and an environment service over 21 real-world signal sources with point-in-time guarantees. We validate SocioVerse2 across three case families and seven case studies, from reproducing canonical agent-based models to modeling policy processes on real records and nowcasting macro-economic indices beyond the response model's knowledge cutoff. With the human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm, these cases go beyond system demonstrations to become substantive studies that investigate frontier questions in their respective disciplines. Code, data services, and a workbench are released as open-source resources.

AI.tldr: 提出 SocioVerse2，将社会仿真平台从被动验证工具升级为“人-AI 协同演化”范式，通过双循环与一套社会科学生成式基础设施，实现对仿真内容的干预与研究者对生成过程的控制，并在七项案例中完成验证。
AI.motivation: 现有社会仿真平台能验证集体行为、在横截面上对齐真实社会、并用自主智能体辅助研究流程，但社会科学的两项需求尚缺乏系统支持：一是对仿真内容的干预，二是研究者对仿真生成过程的控制。缺乏干预则无法开展反事实比较，缺乏过程控制则难以满足研究可复现与可审计的要求。
AI.method: SocioVerse2 在 SocioVerse 1.0 基础上构建“两循环+一基础设施”的人-AI 协同演化范式。纵向仿真循环以演化环境模拟目标人群，并通过干预分叉出反事实分支；可控研究循环将研究本身视为可编辑状态，通过受控编辑更新状态版本。社会科学生成式基础设施支撑两个循环，包含带研究者检查点的可组合技能、覆盖五个角色池的 population service，以及接入 21 个真实世界信号源并具备时点保证（point-in-time）的 environment service。
AI.result: 在三大案例族、七项案例研究中完成验证，涵盖复现经典智能体建模、基于真实记录建模政策过程，以及在响应模型知识截止时间之外对宏观经济指标进行临近预测（nowcasting）。
AI.conclusion: 借助人-AI 协同演化范式，这些案例超越了单纯的系统演示，成为探讨各自学科前沿问题的实质性研究。代码、数据服务与工作台以开源资源形式发布。

title: Can Spiking Neural Networks play pinball? A neuromorphic motion detector for target tracking
summary:
Biological visual systems achieve continuous, low-latency motion perception by processing sparse, asynchronous spiking signals, enabling real-time tracking under strict energy constraints. Event-based cameras, inspired by the mammalian retina, replicate this efficiency by capturing only local brightness changes as asynchronous events, offering a natural substrate for spiking neural networks (SNNs) to parallelise computation and adapt to fast-changing scenes. Pinball provides a controlled yet dynamic testbed, requiring precise motion estimation and fast reaction to a small, rapidly moving target.
  This work presents a fully spiking, real-time perception-to-action pipeline for closed-loop pinball gameplay. A dynamic vision sensor observes a small, fast-moving ball, and a network of spiking Time-Difference Encoders on the SpiNNaker neuromorphic platform jointly estimates its position, speed, and direction. The system is characterised across receptive field size, accumulation window, and angular tuning width for real-time operation, and benchmarked in closed loop against human players across two flipper regimes of increasing physical realism. It achieves a hit rate of 56.1%, nearly double the human average, reacting within 21.7 ms (5 ms network latency) and consuming an estimated 148 μW using fewer than 25k neurons, among the fastest and most energy-efficient event-based closed-loop demonstrators benchmarked. Under more realistic flipper dynamics, tuning a single interpretable policy parameter reproduces the full spectrum of human play styles, from cautious to aggressive, with no change to the perception pipeline. A physical demonstrator, tracking a real ball and actuating real flippers in closed loop, confirms the principle operates beyond simulation. Its fully spiking, learning-free design offers a compact, energy-efficient example of real-time neuromorphic perception-to-action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个全脉冲、实时的"感知—动作"闭环系统，用于控制弹球机。系统用动态视觉传感器观测快速小球，在SpiNNaker神经形态平台上用脉冲时间差编码器网络联合估计位置、速度与方向，闭环击败人类玩家，并具备极高能效与实时性。
AI.motivation: 生物视觉系统能以稀疏、异步的脉冲信号实现连续、低延迟的运动感知，在严格能耗约束下完成实时跟踪。事件相机模仿视网膜、仅捕获局部亮度变化，为脉冲神经网络提供并行计算与快速适应场景的天然载体。弹球机是一个可控且动态的测试平台，要求精确运动估计和对小而快速移动目标的快速反应，适合验证神经形态感知—动作闭环。
AI.method: 构建全脉冲、实时的闭环感知—动作流水线：用动态视觉传感器（事件相机）观测小而快速移动的球；在SpiNNaker神经形态平台上部署脉冲时间差编码器（Time-Difference Encoders）网络，联合估计球的位置、速度和方向；针对感受野大小、累积窗口和角度调谐宽度进行系统表征以优化实时运行；在两种物理真实性递增的挡板模式下与人类玩家进行闭环对比基准测试。
AI.result: 系统命中率达56.1%，接近人类平均水平的两倍；反应时间21.7 ms（其中网络延迟5 ms）；估计功耗约148 μW；使用少于25k神经元，是已基准测试的事件驱动闭环演示中速度最快、能效最高的之一。在更真实的挡板动力学下，仅调节一个可解释的策略参数即可复现从谨慎到激进的完整人类玩法谱系，且无需改变感知流水线。物理演示器通过跟踪真实球并驱动真实挡板形成闭环，验证该原理不仅限于仿真。
AI.conclusion: 该全脉冲、免学习（learning-free）设计提供了一个紧凑、高能效的实时神经形态感知—动作范例，证明基于事件相机与神经形态硬件的闭环系统可在严格能耗与延迟约束下实现超越人类的动态控制，并具备从仿真迁移到物理实机的可行性。

title: Linguistic Features for Interpretable Textual Entailment
summary: Despite the success of neural models in natural language processing, their black-box nature limits interpretability and conceals the linguistic phenomena underlying their predictions. We present SLITE, an explainable hybrid model for Recognizing Textual Entailment that integrates two complementary layers of semantic analysis: a structural-relational layer, based on semantic compatibility and incompatibility between compositional entities, and a distributional-informational layer, based on structured patterns of information change between embedding-based representations of the premise and the hypothesis. We propose 17 features that combine entity-level semantic relations, polarity-sensitive lexical matching, and alignment measures over semantic sub-representations of the similarity matrix, including measures based on entropy and transfer entropy. A logistic regression trained on these features achieves an accuracy of 83% on three-class SICK and 96% on SICK-CE, outperforming IsoLex by 4 percentage points and falling within 2 percentage points of RoBERTa with a fraction of its computational complexity. Ablation studies and SHAP analysis confirm that structural-relational features are the primary drivers of classification, while distributional-informational features provide essential complementary contributions, particularly for detecting neutrality and contradiction. Our results demonstrate that further exploration of hybrid approaches is a viable and scientifically productive alternative to massive neural architectures, and we hope they will strengthen the dialogue between linguistic theory and computational modeling of inference

AI.tldr: SLITE是一种可解释的混合RTE模型，融合结构-关系层与分布-信息层共17个特征，用逻辑回归在SICK上达83%、SICK-CE上达96%的准确率，接近RoBERTa但计算量极小，消融与SHAP分析证实两类特征互补。
AI.motivation: 神经模型在NLP中虽表现优异，但其黑箱特性限制了可解释性，并掩盖了预测背后的语言现象。作者希望以混合方法替代庞大神经架构，加强语言理论与计算推理建模之间的对话。
AI.method: 提出SLITE可解释混合模型，包含两层语义分析：（1）结构-关系层，基于组合实体间的语义兼容与不兼容；（2）分布-信息层，基于前提与假设嵌入表示之间信息变化的结构化模式。共设计17个特征，涵盖实体级语义关系、极性敏感的词法匹配，以及相似度矩阵语义子表示上的对齐度量（含基于熵和转移熵的度量），并用逻辑回归训练。
AI.result: 在三分类SICK上准确率83%，在SICK-CE上96%，比IsoLex高4个百分点，与RoBERTa相差2个百分点以内但其计算复杂度仅为后者一小部分。消融研究与SHAP分析表明，结构-关系特征是分类的主要驱动因素，分布-信息特征提供重要互补贡献，尤其在检测中立和矛盾关系时。
AI.conclusion: 进一步探索混合方法是替代大规模神经架构的可行且具科学产出的方案，有望促进语言理论与推理计算建模之间的对话。

title: DeCo: Efficient Decouple-to-Couple Learning for Multi-Task Visual Grounding
summary: Multi-task visual grounding requires models to jointly understand linguistic semantics and perform accurate visual localization and segmentation. Despite the success of multimodal large language models, effectively adapting them to multiple grounding objectives remains challenging. Existing methods commonly enforce task cooperation through shared representations, while overlooking the intrinsic conflict between task-oriented feature interests. In this paper, we introduce $\textbf{DeCo}$, an efficient $\textbf{De}$couple-to-$\textbf{Co}$uple learning framework that resolves this dilemma through a two-stage paradigm: task-specific representation decoupling followed by complementary prior coupling. Specifically, we first propose Task-aware Semantic Decoupling (TSD) to route shared visual cues into individual features under salient word-level guidance, alleviating representation interference between localization and segmentation. Furthermore, we observe that segmentation naturally provides informative localization priors due to dense supervision. Based on this insight, we introduce Hybrid Prior Coupling (HPC), which integrates sentence-level semantic prior with mask-derived spatial prior for enhanced grounding. Built upon a frozen multimodal encoder, DeCo requires lightweight trainable parameters while achieving strong generalization across multiple grounding objectives. Extensive experiments on RefCOCO/+, G-Ref, ReferIt, Flickr, DIOR-RSVG, SARVG1.0, RRSIS-D, RIS-LAD, and RefDIOR demonstrate that DeCo achieves state-of-the-art performance on both natural and remote sensing benchmarks. The code and models are available at https://github.com/xiaoqiang-lu/DeCo.

AI.tldr: 提出DeCo解耦-耦合学习框架，通过任务特定表征解耦与互补先验耦合两阶段范式，解决多任务视觉定位中的任务冲突，在多个自然与遥感基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 多任务视觉定位需同时理解语言语义并进行精确定位与分割。尽管多模态大模型取得进展，但其适配多定位目标仍具挑战。现有方法普遍通过共享表征强制任务协作，却忽略了任务导向特征兴趣之间的内在冲突。
AI.method: 提出DeCo框架，采用"解耦到耦合"两阶段范式：1) 任务感知语义解耦（TSD），在显著性词级引导下将共享视觉线索路由至各自特征，缓解定位与分割间的表征干扰；2) 混合先验耦合（HPC），基于"分割因密集监督天然提供定位先验"的观察，融合句子级语义先验与掩码导出的空间先验以增强定位。框架构建于冻结的多模态编码器之上，仅需轻量可训练参数。
AI.result: 在RefCOCO/+, G-Ref, ReferIt, Flickr, DIOR-RSVG, SARVG1.0, RRSIS-D, RIS-LAD, RefDIOR等基准上实验表明，DeCo在自然与遥感基准上均达到SOTA性能，并具备强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: DeCo通过解耦-耦合范式有效解决多任务视觉定位中任务表征的内在冲突，在保持轻量可训练参数的同时实现跨多定位目标的强泛化与SOTA表现，代码与模型已开源。

title: Jev for Scientific Decisions: Evaluating Semantic Choices and Their Consequences
comment: 11 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Includes references and appendices
summary: Scientific workflows often require choosing among known relations before a deterministic calculation can proceed. Whether observations share a culture, treatment or reference standard can change the scientific meaning of the resulting count or comparison. We evaluate Jev as a semantic decision component using a harness that follows its documented guidance and assigns arithmetic to code. The study compares twelve model configurations on twenty source-grounded Choices across ten scientific cases, each repeated five times. We measure semantic selections, downstream outputs and final claim labels separately. Jev matched five other configurations at complete semantic correctness and achieved the lowest observed median latency among successful responses. Across three comparison models, seven wrong selections on one culture-history question changed downstream counts while preserving the correct final label. These results identify a useful role for Jev in prepared scientific decision tasks and show why evaluating that role requires checking the relations and quantities that a workflow will reuse.

AI.tldr: 本文评估 Jev 作为科学工作流中的语义决策组件，在 10 个科学案例、20 个来源锚定的选择题上比较 12 种模型配置，发现 Jev 达到与其他五个配置相同的完全语义正确率，且在成功响应中取得最低中位延迟；同时发现语义选择错误可改变下游计数却仍保留正确最终标签。
AI.motivation: 科学工作流在执行确定性计算前，常需在已知关系之间做出选择，而观测是否共享文化、处理或参考标准会改变计数或比较的科学含义，因此需要一个可被审查的语义决策组件，并需要检验其在整个工作流复用关系与数量时的表现，而非仅看最终标签。
AI.method: 采用遵循 Jev 文档化指导的评测框架，将算术运算交由代码执行。在 10 个科学案例上构建 20 个来源锚定（source-grounded）的选择题，比较 12 种模型配置，每个配置重复 5 次；分别测量语义选择、下游输出与最终主张标签三项指标。
AI.result: Jev 与其他五个配置在完全语义正确性上持平，并在成功响应中取得最低的观测中位延迟。在三个对比模型上，一个文化史问题中的七次错误选择改变了下游计数，但最终标签仍保持正确。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 Jev 在预先准备的科学决策任务中具有实用价值；同时说明评估该角色时必须检查工作流将要复用的关系与数量，而不能仅依赖最终标签，因为语义错误可能被下游计算掩盖。

title: Estimating Accurate Hand Pose in Camera Space with Vision Transformer
summary: Monocular RGB-based hand pose estimation has emerged as a critical research frontier in computer vision. The local hand pose estimation methods predict hand poses relative to the wrist, while global hand pose estimation also requires estimating the wrist's position in the camera coordinate system. However, this camera-space estimation confronts two fundamental challenges: (1) depth ambiguity in monocular settings, and (2) the coupling effect of hand local poses and global wrist positions in the perspective projections. In particular, this coupling reflects that the projections are jointly determined by local hand poses, wrist positions, and camera intrinsics. To overcome these challenges, our framework proposes two key innovations: Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision for hand-depth information extraction and Perspective Information Embedding for resolving above coupling effect of local pose and wrist position, both integrated within the mainstream encoder-decoder architecture. Besides, we propose a novel framerate-aware multi-dataset training strategy for sequential pose refinement. Our fully integrated approach achieves at most 37.1\% superiority in CS-MJE over SOTA on HO3D. Project page: https://github.com/Mine268/CS-ViT.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对单目RGB手部全局姿态估计中的深度模糊与局部姿态-腕部位置耦合问题，提出Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision、Perspective Information Embedding及帧率感知多数据集训练策略，在HO3D上CS-MJE最高超越SOTA 37.1%。
AI.motivation: 单目RGB全局手姿态估计需在相机坐标系中估计腕部位置，但面临两个根本挑战：(1)单目设置的深度模糊；(2)透视投影中手部局部姿态与全局腕部位置的耦合效应——投影由局部姿态、腕部位置和相机内参共同决定。局部姿态方法仅预测相对腕部的姿态，无法解决上述问题。
AI.method: 在主流编码器-解码器架构中集成两项关键创新：Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision用于手部深度信息提取；Perspective Information Embedding用于解耦局部姿态与腕部位置的耦合效应。此外提出新颖的帧率感知多数据集训练策略用于序列姿态细化。
AI.result: 在HO3D数据集上，完整集成方法在CS-MJE指标上最高超越SOTA达37.1%。
AI.conclusion: 通过深度信息提取监督、透视信息嵌入与帧率感知多数据集训练的结合，有效缓解单目全局手姿态估计的深度模糊与投影耦合问题，显著优于现有方法。

title: DolphinBench: Mapping the Pareto Frontier of Agent Memory
summary:
Agents today often take real-world actions that depend on long-term memory and context recall over time. However, most current memory benchmarks are built for a conversational question-answer format, where the question itself signals that some fact must be retrieved, and often which one. Moreover, benchmarks rarely require anything beyond accuracy from submissions, allowing memory systems to make unreasonable cost/time tradeoffs to achieve higher scores.
  We present DolphinBench, a benchmark that evaluates memory directly through an agent's task completion. DolphinBench includes three knowledge-work personas with roughly 500k tokens of user messages per persona and evaluates agents on tasks that depend on information from that history. We verify all 200 tasks per persona by running an agent with and without the relevant history, requiring success with it and failure without it.
  Finally, we require all evaluations to report total cost and latency alongside accuracy, which enables us to evaluate agent memory systems holistically. No existing memory benchmark combines all three. The dataset and evaluation code are available at https://dolphinbench.ai.

AI.tldr: 提出 DolphinBench，一个通过智能体任务完成度直接评估长期记忆的基准，含三个知识工作角色（每角色约 50 万 token 历史），每角色 200 个经"有历史成功、无历史失败"双重验证的任务，并要求同时报告准确率、总成本与延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆基准多采用对话式问答形式，问题本身已暗示需要检索某事实（甚至指明是哪一条），无法真实反映智能体在无提示情况下对长期记忆的依赖；同时基准通常只考核准确率，导致记忆系统为刷高分而采用不合理的成本/时间折衷，缺乏对成本与延迟的约束。
AI.method: 构建 DolphinBench：(1) 设计三个知识工作角色，每个角色约 500k token 的用户消息历史；(2) 任务设计为依赖该历史信息才能完成的实际工作型任务，每角色 200 个；(3) 采用对照验证协议——智能体在可访问相关历史时须成功、在无该历史时须失败，确保任务确实考察记忆；(4) 评估协议强制同时报告总成本与延迟以及准确率。
AI.result: 每角色 200 个任务全部通过"有/无历史"的对照验证；基准同时提供准确率、总成本与延迟三类指标，据作者所述，尚无现有记忆基准能同时结合这三项（任务完成式评估、对照验证、成本与延迟报告）。数据与评估代码公开于 https://dolphinbench.ai。
AI.conclusion: DolphinBench 将记忆评估从"对话问答+仅看准确率"转向"以智能体任务完成度为核心、并强制纳入成本与延迟"的整体性评估范式，为更贴近真实部署场景的智能体记忆系统提供了可复现的评测基准。

title: Do LiDAR Language Models Really Understand Spatio-temporal Relationships?
summary: Recent 4D LiDAR language models aim to reason about objects and their evolving spatial relationships. Yet, in our evaluation, always selecting the same option nearly matches the multiple-choice accuracy of two B4DL-derived configurations. We introduce LiDAR-Hallu, a geometry-referenced benchmark and diagnostic protocol with 10,000 questions across 150 nuScenes scenes. It covers object existence, ego-relative position, distance ordering, relative motion, and temporal localization, with explicit rules for selecting objects, comparing times, and determining reference answers. Our protocol combines fixed-answer and candidate-content controls, cross-scene pairs with identical prompts but opposite reference answers, and relation-specific recall. Analysis of 100,000 recorded responses reveals failures hidden by aggregate accuracy. Candidate duration alone makes temporal answers predictable without observing LiDAR. On paired questions, the models frequently give the same answer to scenes requiring opposite answers. Relation-specific analysis further shows that both configurations miss every positive lateral-motion case across all tested conditions. Temporal-shuffle contrastive decoding provides little net improvement, as repairs are largely offset by new errors and the main failures persist. These results show that evaluating spatio-temporal reasoning requires testing whether models distinguish the queried physical relationships, rather than relying on individual-answer accuracy alone. The source code, checkpoints, and data are released at https://github.com/Awesome4D/4DMLLM_Hallucination_Bench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LiDAR-Hallu基准与诊断协议，揭示4D LiDAR语言模型的时空推理准确率存在虚假性，模型的失败被聚合准确率掩盖。
AI.motivation: 作者评估发现，在B4DL衍生的配置上，始终选择同一选项几乎可以达到多项选择的准确率，说明现有评测无法反映模型是否真正理解所查询的物理关系，因此需要一个能暴露此类失败的诊断性基准。
AI.method: 构建LiDAR-Hallu，包含150个nuScenes场景、10,000个问题，涵盖物体存在性、自车相对位置、距离排序、相对运动和时间定位，并给出对象选择、时间比较与参考答案的明确规则；采用固定答案与候选内容对照、相同提示但相反参考答案的跨场景配对、以及关系特定召回率的诊断协议。
AI.result: 分析100,000条模型响应发现：仅凭候选时长即可在未观测LiDAR的情况下预测时间答案；配对问题上模型对需要相反答案的场景常给出同一答案；两种配置在所有条件下均完全漏掉正向横向运动案例；时间打乱对比解码净收益甚微，修正被新增错误抵消，主要失败依旧存在。
AI.conclusion: 评价时空推理应检验模型是否区分所查询的物理关系，而非依赖单个答案的准确率；代码、检查点和数据已开源。

title: onPanda: Efficient Annotation of On-Policy Alignment Data for LLMs and Agents via Token-Level Correction
summary: We present onPanda, an interactive tool for efficiently annotating LLM alignment data and agent trajectories. onPanda adopts token-level correction as its core interaction: while reading a model response, the annotator locates the first inappropriate token and either picks a substitute from the model's candidate tokens or types the correct text via free-form editing. The system then truncates everything after that position and continues generation from the corrected prefix, repeating this locate-correct-continue loop until a satisfactory response is obtained. This mechanism lets annotators precisely steer model outputs at low cost: a small controlled study suggests that onPanda reduces median annotation time by 52% over manual post-editing. Since the vast majority of tokens in the final response are generated by the model itself, the resulting data largely preserves the model's sampling distribution and is well suited for constructing on-policy SFT and preference data. Furthermore, the token-level corrections recorded during annotation provide fine-grained supervision with precise positions and naturally paired positive--negative samples. onPanda also connects to external tools and harnesses, enabling interactive trajectory annotation in realistic environments. In addition, we release Panda-CVL, a dataset annotated with onPanda, together with a benchmark for token-level correction.

AI.tldr: onPanda 是一种交互式标注工具，采用 token 级纠正作为核心交互，高效标注 LLM 对齐数据与 agent 轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 对齐数据与 agent 轨迹标注成本高，人工后编辑效率低，且难以在保持模型采样分布的同时获得细粒度监督信号。
AI.method: 以 token 级纠正为核心：标注者定位首个不当 token，从模型候选 token 中选择替代项或自由编辑输入正确文本；系统截断该位置之后内容并从纠正后的前缀继续生成，循环执行"定位—纠正—续写"。同时连接外部工具与执行环境以支持真实场景下的轨迹标注。
AI.result: 小规模对照研究显示，onPanda 相比人工后编辑将标注时间中位数降低 52%；由于最终响应中绝大多数 token 由模型自身生成，数据较好保留模型采样分布，适用于构造 on-policy SFT 与偏好数据；token 级纠正记录提供带精确位置与天然配对正负样本的细粒度监督。此外发布了 Panda-CVL 数据集及 token 级纠正基准。
AI.conclusion: onPanda 通过 token 级纠正机制显著提升标注效率并保持数据分布特性，兼具细粒度监督与轨迹标注能力，同时开源数据集与基准以推动相关研究。

title: MECAIL: Communication-Aware Incremental Learning for Object Detection with 14.6 KB Spatiotemporal Experts
summary: Intelligent transportation systems require Incremental Learning (IL) to continually improve their overall performance in dynamic environments. However, most edge devices lack the computational resources to support on-device IL, requiring updates to be transmitted from centralized servers. We propose using this setup to obtain dense, specialized module coverage that adapts a fixed base model to specific spatiotemporal contexts, such as parking lots, gas stations, ferries, or construction sites. However, in order to reliably transmit these modules to the edge device, using TCP, UDP, and BTP over V2X, Wi-Fi, and 2G-5G hardware, we establish a strict limit of 14.6 KB per module to fit within the first TCP window and to minimize UDP/BTP fragmentation. We further introduce Mixture-of-Experts for Communication-Aware Incremental Learning (MECAIL), the first method that meets this strict requirement, in which each new domain or environment is served by a small expert network that adapts the base model. We validate MECAIL on D-RICO and ODinW-13, where it largely matches the performance of parameter-heavy approaches while enabling practical, bandwidth-efficient large-scale deployment. This allows comprehensive coverage by experts for highly specific, focused, and temporary situations.

AI.tldr: 提出MECAIL方法，用极小型专家网络（每模块≤14.6 KB）实现通信感知的增量学习，在D-RICO和ODinW-13上匹配大参数量方法性能，支持边缘端大规模部署。
AI.motivation: 智能交通系统需要在动态环境中持续进行增量学习以提升整体性能，但多数边缘设备缺乏支持端侧增量学习的算力，需由中心服务器下发更新。为可靠地通过V2X、Wi-Fi和2G-5G上的TCP、UDP、BTP传输模块，需满足严格的体积限制。
AI.method: 利用服务器-边缘的这种配置获得密集、专用的模块覆盖，使固定基座模型适配特定时空场景（停车场、加油站、渡口、施工现场）。将每个模块体积限制在14.6 KB以内，以适配首个TCP窗口并最小化UDP/BTP分片；据此提出Communication-Aware Incremental Learning的专家混合方法MECAIL，每个新领域/环境由一个小型专家网络适配基座模型。
AI.result: 在D-RICO和ODinW-13上验证，MECAIL基本达到参数量庞大方法的性能水平，同时实现实用、带宽高效的大规模部署，使专家可对人体高度特定、聚焦且临时的场景提供全面覆盖。
AI.conclusion: MECAIL是首个满足14.6 KB严格模块限制的通信感知增量学习方法，通过小型专家网络实现带宽高效的边缘增量学习与大规模部署。

title: MIGA:Shared-Geometry Gaussian Representation with Implicit Amplitude Modeling for Accelerated 3D Multi-Echo MRI
summary: Three-dimensional multi-echo MRI provides rich anatomical and quantitative information, but repeated volumetric encoding prolongs acquisition and motivates k-space undersampling. Reconstructing undersampled multi-echo data requires exploiting shared anatomy while preserving echo-dependent signal variation; full-volume modeling also introduces substantial computational and memory demands. We propose MIGA, a scan-specific framework comprising shared anisotropic Gaussian geometry, a coordinate-conditioned multi-output amplitude network, and explicit echo-specific phase variables. The Gaussian geometry provides common spatial support across echoes, the implicit network models spatially structured amplitude variations, and the phase variables retain echo-specific complex signal information. All components are jointly optimized using only the acquired multi-coil k-space, requiring no fully sampled training data. Experiments showed that MIGA consistently outperformed the comparison methods across imaging tasks and acceleration factors, with larger improvements under stronger undersampling. MIGA also achieved a favorable quality-cost balance among the evaluated full-volume multi-echo methods. These results support the effectiveness of combining shared Gaussian geometry with implicit echo-dependent amplitude modeling for accelerated 3D multi-echo MRI reconstruction.

AI.tldr: MIGA是一种扫描特定的3D多回波MRI重建框架，通过共享各向异性高斯几何、坐标条件多输出振幅网络与显式回波相位变量，仅用采样的多线圈k空间联合优化，在欠采样重建中优于对比方法且质量-成本更优。
AI.motivation: 3D多回波MRI虽提供丰富解剖与定量信息，但重复体编码导致采集时间过长，需进行k空间欠采样。重建欠采样多回波数据需在利用共享解剖结构的同时保留回波相关信号变化，而全容积建模又带来显著的计算与内存负担。
AI.method: 提出MIGA扫描特定框架，包含三部分：共享各向异性高斯几何（为各回波提供共同空间支撑）、坐标条件多输出振幅网络（隐式建模空间结构化振幅变化）、显式回波相位变量（保留回波特定复信号信息）。所有组件仅使用获取的多线圈k空间进行联合优化，无需全采样训练数据。
AI.result: 实验表明，MIGA在各成像任务与加速倍数下均一致优于对比方法，欠采样更强时提升更明显；在评估的全容积多回波方法中实现了良好的质量-成本平衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将共享高斯几何与隐式回波相关振幅建模相结合，可有效用于加速3D多回波MRI重建。

title: Spatial Action Review: A Visual Analytics Dashboard for Auditing Language-to-Action Hand-offs in Electron Microscopy
comment: Accepted at the IEEE VIS 2026 Workshop on Visual Analytics in the Age of Autonomous Science (VAxAutoSci)
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly explored as interfaces for scientific image analysis, where a visual question-answering (VQA) response may be paired with a spatial output that guides a downstream stage. A supervisor reads the language answer, while a downstream workflow such as segmentation or region review consumes the point-set output. We call this transition from inspecting the answer to relying on its point action the language-to-action hand-off. A silent failure occurs when the answer is correct while the paired action misses annotated objects needed downstream, so answer-based oversight clears a region whose action is unreliable. We introduce Spatial Action Review, a visual analytics dashboard for auditing this failure mode in electron microscopy (EM) mitochondria analysis. It links paired answer-action records through an answer-action ledger, a task-by-dataset risk map, and an image-region audit view, connecting aggregate patterns to image evidence while an adjustable action-reliability gate supports re-audit. The review ends in a human-AI hand-off, where a supervisor records whether the action is accepted, escalated, held under a stricter gate, or flagged for model revision. Across 541 image regions from an EM-adapted Qwen3-VL case-study run, point actions fail the gate in 54.4% of records with a correct VQA response, and 27.4% of all records are silent failures. A correct answer is associated with only a 5.8-percentage-point higher probability of a reliable action, with a bootstrap interval spanning zero; the point-biserial correlation between answer correctness and object coverage is 0.061. This weak coupling persists across five model conditions on 753 matched image regions. Spatial Action Review makes answer-action mismatches visible and ties them to image evidence and a recorded decision before MLLM outputs enter autonomous scientific workflows.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"语言到行动交接"（language-to-action hand-off）这一概念，指多模态大模型回答正确但配对的空间点集输出（如分割提示点）却遗漏目标物体的"静默失败"。作者开发了 Spatial Action Review 可视化分析仪表盘来审计该失败模式，并在电镜线粒体分析任务中发现：正确回答对应可靠行动的概率仅高出5.8个百分点，静默失败占比高达27.4%。
AI.motivation: 在多模态大模型作为科学图像分析接口的场景中，监督者通常只审阅语言答案，而下游工作流（如分割、区域复核）却消费模型输出的点集行动。当语言答案正确、但配对的空间行动漏掉下游所需的标注物体时，基于答案的监督会放行一个行动不可靠的区域，形成"静默失败"。现有监督机制无法揭示这种答案与行动之间的错配。
AI.method: 提出 Spatial Action Review 可视化分析仪表盘，用于审计电镜线粒体分析中的答案-行动错配。该仪表盘包含：答案-行动账本（answer-action ledger）、任务×数据集风险图（task-by-dataset risk map）、图像区域审计视图（image-region audit view），并通过可调节的行动可靠性门控（action-reliability gate）支持复审。审阅最终以人机交接结束，监督者记录行动是否被接受、升级、在更严格门控下暂缓或标记为需要模型修正。
AI.result: 在 EM 适配版 Qwen3-VL 案例研究的 541 个图像区域中：54.4% 的记录在 VQA 回答正确的情况下点行动未通过门控；27.4% 的全部记录为静默失败。正确答案与可靠行动之间的关联仅使概率提高 5.8 个百分点，且 bootstrap 区间跨越零；答案正确性与物体覆盖率之间的点二列相关系数为 0.061。这种弱耦合在 753 个匹配图像区域的五种模型条件下持续存在。
AI.conclusion: Spatial Action Review 使答案-行动错配变得可见，并将其与图像证据及记录决策相绑定，从而在 MLLM 输出进入自主科学工作流之前提供审计保障。实验表明语言答案的正确性并不能可靠预示空间行动的可靠性，二者耦合极弱。

title: STA-TFM: Spatio-Temporal Aggregation Across Views TransForMer for Pose Estimation
summary: Monocular 3D human pose estimation (HPE) remains challenging due to depth ambiguity, occlu- sions, and the need for temporal consistency. While multi-view methods provide superior accuracy over monocular approaches, they often require complex setups. We introduce STA-TFM, a transformer-based architecture that combines spatial and temporal information for multi-view pose estimation. The approach leverages DSTformer, a monocular feature extractor, to capture long-range pose dependencies within each view. A fusion transformer then aggregates information across views to produce coherent 3D estimates. To address training data scarcity, we use a data generation pipeline that transforms any existing 3D pose dataset into multi-view setups with controllable parameters. Experiments on various datasets demonstrate that STA-TFM outperforms existing camera-parameter-free multi-view methods. STA-TFM achieves 50.9% and 49.5% reductions in mean per joint position error (MPJPE) and mean per joint velocity error (MPJVE) on the DHP19 dataset. Furthermore, it achieves 6.7% and 7.7% respective reductions on HAA4D, and a 15.2% MPJPE reduction on TotalCapture. STA-TFM handles noisy and missing 2D inputs, supporting potential deployment in healthcare monitoring, athletic assessment, and immersive technologies. Code, training checkpoints, and data are available at https://zenodo.org/records/22832620.

AI.tldr: STA-TFM：一种基于Transformer的多视角3D人体姿态估计架构，融合空间与时间信息，配合可控的多视角数据生成流程，在多个数据集上显著优于现有免相机参数方法。
AI.motivation: 单目3D人体姿态估计受深度歧义、遮挡与时间一致性等问题困扰；多视角方法精度更高但通常需要复杂的相机标定与采集设置，且多视角训练数据稀缺。
AI.method: 提出STA-TFM，一种融合空间与时间信息的Transformer架构：使用DSTformer作为单目特征提取器捕捉每个视角内的长程姿态依赖，再通过融合Transformer跨视角聚合信息以生成连贯的3D估计；同时设计数据生成流程，可将任意现有3D姿态数据集转换为参数可控的多视角设置以缓解训练数据不足。
AI.result: 在DHP19上MPJPE与MPJVE分别降低50.9%和49.5%；在HAA4D上分别降低6.7%和7.7%；在TotalCapture上MPJPE降低15.2%。此外可处理含噪声与缺失的2D输入。
AI.conclusion: STA-TFM在无需相机参数的多视角方法中取得领先精度，具备对不完美2D输入的鲁棒性，可潜在应用于健康监测、运动评估与沉浸式技术；代码、检查点与数据已公开。

title: VPRune: Efficient Training-free Pre-LLM Visual Token Pruning
summary: Visual token pruning is a promising approach to reducing the inference cost of large vision-language models (LVLMs), yet aggressive token reduction often causes substantial performance degradation. We identify three key factors behind this degradation: text-guided selection bias, information loss from discarded tokens, and positional distortion caused by sequence compaction. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{VPRune}, a training-free pre-LLM pruning framework consisting of visual-only diversity selection, similarity-guided token recycling, and position-preserving restoration. Experiments on FastVLM-1.5B across multiple vision-language benchmarks demonstrate that VPRune achieves a favorable accuracy--compression trade-off, with particularly pronounced advantages under aggressive compression. Furthermore, evaluations on edge-device show that VPRune effectively reduces end-to-end inference latency while maintaining superior task performance, demonstrating its practicality for resource-constrained LVLM deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练的前置LLM视觉token剪枝框架VPRune，通过纯视觉多样性选择、相似度引导的token回收与位置保持恢复，缓解激进压缩下的性能退化问题。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型推理成本高，视觉token剪枝是降低成本的有效手段，但激进的token削减往往导致显著性能下降。作者识别出导致退化的三个关键因素：文本引导的选择偏差、被丢弃token造成的信息损失，以及序列压缩引发的位置失真。
AI.method: 提出VPRune，一种免训练的前置LLM剪枝框架，包含三个组件：纯视觉的多样性选择（避免文本引导偏差）、相似度引导的token回收（补偿被丢弃token的信息）、以及位置保持恢复（缓解序列压缩导致的位置失真）。
AI.result: 在FastVLM-1.5B及多个视觉语言基准上的实验表明，VPRune取得了良好的精度—压缩权衡，在激进压缩场景下优势尤为明显；在边缘设备上的评估显示其能有效降低端到端推理延迟，同时保持优越的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: VPRune作为免训练框架，兼顾精度与压缩效率，并在边缘设备上验证了实用性，适用于资源受限的LVLM部署场景。

title: AgentSTAR: Agentic Shape Tracking and Reconstruction from Monocular Videos
summary: In this work, we present a method for shape reconstruction and tracking from video via agentic analysis-by-synthesis. Unlike prior methods which first estimate dense pixel correspondences and then recover object motion from them, our method infers a structured 3D object model, including its geometry and kinematic structure, and uses this model to optimise object track estimates over time. In our optimisation loop, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) agent iteratively refines shape or generalised pose through a render-and-compare loop, combining coarse visual reasoning with numerical pose optimisation for precise state estimation. This structured formulation enables our method to track through large motion, articulation, and severe occlusion without relying on pixel-matching objectives. Quantitatively, on ARCTIC, our method substantially outperforms state-of-the-art 3D point-tracking baselines for articulated objects, and on HOT3D it outperforms all evaluated rigid-object tracking baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于智能体"分析-合成"的视频形状重建与跟踪方法，先推断结构化3D物体模型（几何与运动学结构），再用该模型优化随时间变化的跟踪估计，在ARCTIC和HOT3D数据集上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有方法先估计稠密像素对应关系，再从中恢复物体运动，这种依赖像素匹配的方式在大运动、关节活动和严重遮挡情况下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 采用智能体式分析-合成框架：由VLM智能体在渲染-比较循环中迭代优化形状或广义位姿，将粗略视觉推理与数值位姿优化相结合以实现精确状态估计，直接推断结构化3D物体模型（几何+运动学结构），并据此优化跟踪估计。
AI.result: 在ARCTIC上显著优于针对关节物体的最先进3D点跟踪基线；在HOT3D上优于所有评估的刚性物体跟踪基线。
AI.conclusion: 结构化建模与智能体渲染-比较优化相结合，可在大运动、关节活动和严重遮挡下实现稳健跟踪，且无需依赖像素匹配目标，验证了该范式的有效性。

title: Identity-Consistent Analysis of Long-Shot Windsurfing Video: A Domain-Specific Offline Tracking System
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Project code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/BertilBraun/Windsurf-Analysis/tree/windsurf-report-v1.5
summary: Long-shot windsurfing video combines small targets, large camera pans, prolonged overlaps, and rapidly changing backgrounds. The desired output is not a generic MOT trace but a separate, stable rider-relative video for each surfer; one false identity merge can invalidate an otherwise useful result. We present an offline analysis system that detects surfers, forms conservative local tracklets, links them globally with camera-compensated motion and a foreground-masked sail-color descriptor, and uses two pose keypoints on the rig to drive a rider-relative virtual camera. The tracking stage is evaluated on 21 manually reconstructed development videos containing 41,004 retained observations. On this fixed-observation protocol, the production system achieves 0.957 pairwise precision, 0.918 recall, and 0.937 F1, compared with 0.792 F1 for OC-SORT and 0.828 for BoT-SORT. Compared with OC-SORT, it reduces fragmentation excess from 845 to 42, but nine of its 95 output tracks mix rider identities and these errors affect seven of the 21 videos.

AI.tldr: 提出离线长镜头风帆冲浪视频分析系统，通过保守局部轨迹片、全局关联和姿态驱动虚拟相机实现逐选手稳定视频输出，F1达0.937，但95条轨迹中9条存在身份混淆。
AI.motivation: 长镜头风帆冲浪视频具有小目标、大范围相机平移、长时间遮挡重叠与背景快速变化等特点；应用需求不是通用多目标跟踪轨迹，而是每位冲浪者独立的、以选手为参照的稳定视频，且一次身份合并错误即可使结果失效。
AI.method: 离线分析系统：检测冲浪者并构建保守的局部轨迹片；利用相机补偿运动和前景掩膜的帆色描述子进行全局轨迹关联；使用帆具上两个姿态关键点驱动以选手为参照的虚拟相机。
AI.result: 在21段人工重建的开发视频（41,004个保留观测）上，固定观测协议下系统达到成对精度0.957、召回0.918、F1 0.937，OC-SORT为0.792、BoT-SORT为0.828；相比OC-SORT将碎片化超额从845降至42；但95条输出轨迹中9条混合了选手身份，影响21段视频中的7段。
AI.conclusion: 该系统在长镜头风帆冲浪场景下显著优于通用MOT基线并大幅降低碎片化，但身份混淆仍是主要残余误差，需进一步约束全局关联以消除跨选手合并。

title: CMAMBADEPTH: Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation with Channel Mamba and Hybrid Attention
summary: Accurate monocular depth estimation serves as a core enabler for single camera scene understanding. However, existing self-supervised monocular depth estimation methods generally suffer from the bottleneck of inefficient cross-scale information interaction and difficulty in balancing local and global spatial modeling. In this paper, we propose CMambaDepth, a self-supervised framework that achieves efficient multi-scale feature fusion and fine-grained contextual modeling via channel-wise selective state propagation. Specifically, Bidirectional Channel Mamba (Bi-CMamba) aligns encoder features across scales and enables bidirectional information exchange among ordered scale groups. Unidirectional Channel Mamba (Uni-CMamba) progressively aggregates decoder features and retains fine-grained scale groups through a group selection mechanism for subsequent fusion. Furthermore, a Hybrid Attention Module (HAM) is introduced to combine large-kernel local context and Manhattan self-attention for complementary spatial modeling. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves highly competitive performance. Specifically, our model achieves an AbsRel of 0.094 and an RMSE of 4.156 on KITTI, and an AbsRel of 0.140 on DDAD. In the zero-shot cross-dataset generalization test on NYUv2, it attains an AbsRel of 0.232, outperforming the baseline RA-Depth by 7.2%.

AI.tldr: 提出自监督单目深度估计框架 CMambaDepth，通过通道维选择性状态传播实现高效多尺度特征融合与细粒度上下文建模，在 KITTI、DDAD 及跨数据集泛化上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督单目深度估计方法存在两个瓶颈：跨尺度信息交互效率低，以及难以平衡局部与全局空间建模。论文旨在通过通道维选择性状态传播来解决多尺度融合与上下文建模问题。
AI.method: 核心由三个模块构成：1）双向通道 Mamba（Bi-CMamba），对跨尺度编码器特征进行对齐，并在有序尺度组间实现双向信息交换；2）单向通道 Mamba（Uni-CMamba），渐进聚合解码器特征，并通过组选择机制保留细粒度尺度组以供后续融合；3）混合注意力模块（HAM），将大核局部上下文与 Manhattan 自注意力结合，实现互补的空间建模。
AI.result: 在 KITTI 上取得 AbsRel 0.094、RMSE 4.156；在 DDAD 上 AbsRel 为 0.140；在 NYUv2 的零样本跨数据集泛化测试中 AbsRel 为 0.232，较基线 RA-Depth 提升 7.2%。
AI.conclusion: CMambaDepth 验证了基于通道选择性状态空间建模在自监督单目深度估计中的有效性，兼顾多尺度融合效率与局部—全局建模平衡，并展现出良好的跨数据集泛化能力。

title: 0.5\%>100\%: Bidirectional Reciprocal Learning for Referring Image Segmentation
summary: Recent advances in vision foundation models (VFMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across diverse unimodal visual tasks. However, adapting VFMs to referring image segmentation (RIS) typically necessitates precise vision-language alignment via full fine-tuning, incurring substantial computational overhead and risking catastrophic forgetting. While existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods enable safe knowledge transfer with minimal training costs, they predominantly operate independently within individual modalities or focus exclusively on unidirectional guidance from language to vision, overlooking progressive cross-modal interaction and visual feedback for textual refinement. To address these limitations, we propose Bidirectional Reciprocal Learning (BRL), a novel adapter-based PEFT framework that facilitates hierarchical, bidirectional information flow within both token-mixing and channel-mixing layers of frozen foundation models. Specifically, BRL introduces two complementary lightweight modules. The Reciprocal Attention Adapter (RAA) performs cross-modal query-key exchanges at the token level, enabling visual and linguistic tokens to mutually attend to each other for fine-grained spatial grounding. The Reciprocal Gate Adapter (RGA) generates cross-modal gating signals at the channel level, allowing global semantic context from one modality to adaptively recalibrate channel activations of the other. Extensive experiments on RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of BRL over prior RIS methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance while requiring less than 0.5% backbone parameter updates. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/xiaoqiang-lu/BRL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双向互惠学习（BRL），一种基于适配器的参数高效微调框架，在冻结的视觉基础模型中通过token级与通道级的双向跨模态交互提升指代图像分割性能，仅需更新不到0.5%的骨干参数即可达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 将视觉基础模型适配到指代图像分割（RIS）通常需全量微调以实现精确的视觉-语言对齐，但计算开销大且易导致灾难性遗忘。现有PEFT方法虽可低代价迁移，但多在各模态内独立操作，或仅从语言到视觉单向引导，忽视了渐进式跨模态交互与视觉反馈对文本的修正作用。
AI.method: 提出BRL（双向互惠学习）适配器式PEFT框架，在冻结基础模型的token-mixing和channel-mixing层中实现分层的双向信息流。包含两个轻量模块：互惠注意力适配器（RAA）在token级进行跨模态query-key交换，使视觉与语言token互相注意以实现细粒度空间定位；互惠门控适配器（RGA）在通道级生成跨模态门控信号，用一模态的全局语义上下文自适应重校准另一模态的通道激活。
AI.result: 在RefCOCO、RefCOCO+和RefCOCOg基准上，BRL优于现有RIS方法，取得SOTA性能，且骨干参数更新量小于0.5%。
AI.conclusion: BRL通过token级与通道级的双向跨模态交互，有效弥补了现有PEFT在跨模态交互与视觉反馈方面的不足，在极低训练成本下实现了RIS的SOTA表现，代码与模型将开源。

title: Preoperative Prediction of Microvascular Invasion in Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Integrating Multimodal Ultrasound and Clinical Data: A Multicenter Study
comment: Main manuscript: 37 pages, 5 figures, and 4 tables; supplemental material: 18 pages, 6 figure, and 9 tables
summary: Background: Microvascular invasion (MVI) predicts recurrence and survival in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) but requires postoperative histopathology for diagnosis. We developed and validated a model integrating multimodal ultrasound and clinical data for preoperative MVI prediction. Methods: This multicenter study included 489 patients with HCC from eight centers. All patients had B-mode ultrasound (BUS), color Doppler flow imaging (CDFI), dynamic contrast-enhanced ultrasound (DCE-US), and clinical information. Data from seven centers (n = 421) were used for model development with five-fold cross-validation; data from the remaining center (n = 68) formed an independent external validation cohort. The proposed multimodal information fusion network used modality-specific encoders, a hemodynamic temporal change module for bidirectional DCE-US perfusion changes, and a representation consistency learning module to align heterogeneous ultrasound representations before Transformer-based fusion. Results: In external validation, DCE-US achieved the highest single-modality area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC; 0.8545+/-0.0198), versus clinical information (0.6715+/-0.0156), CDFI (0.6435+/-0.0344), and BUS (0.6087+/-0.0417). Pixel-difference sampling and the proposed temporal module outperformed alternative sampling and video representation methods. The full model achieved the best performance, with an AUC of 0.8953+/-0.0180, accuracy of 81.18%+/-2.83%, sensitivity of 86.40%+/-6.69%, and specificity of 78.14%+/-6.28. Conclusions: Integrating multimodal ultrasound and clinical information enabled promising preoperative MVI prediction in HCC. DCE-US was the main source of predictive information, while BUS, CDFI, and clinical information provided complementary value. The proposed framework may support preoperative risk stratification and individualized clinical decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并验证了一种融合多模态超声与临床数据的术前微血管侵犯（MVI）预测模型，外部验证AUC达0.8953。
AI.motivation: MVI可预测肝细胞癌（HCC）的复发与生存，但诊断依赖术后组织病理学，缺乏术前无创预测手段。
AI.method: 多中心研究纳入8个中心共489例HCC患者，均具备B型超声（BUS）、彩色多普勒血流成像（CDFI）、动态对比增强超声（DCE-US）及临床信息。7个中心（n=421）数据经五折交叉验证用于建模，剩余中心（n=68）作为独立外部验证队列。所提多模态信息融合网络包含模态特异性编码器、用于双向DCE-US灌注变化的血流动力学时序变化模块，以及在Transformer融合前对齐异质超声表征的表征一致性学习模块。
AI.conclusion: 整合多模态超声与临床信息可实现有前景的HCC术前MVI预测；DCE-US是预测信息的主要来源，BUS、CDFI与临床信息提供互补价值，该框架有望支持术前风险分层与个体化临床决策。

title: ME-VLM:A Unified VLM for Embodied Cognition and Agent Coordination
summary:
Physical AI requires models to ground visual and linguistic understanding in real-world environments while accounting for environmental constraints and execution feedback. We introduce MachEmbodied-VLM (ME-VLM), a unified vision-language model with two variants, 4B and 35B-A3B, that brings together embodied cognition and multimodal agent capabilities. Our work emphasizes physical perception and spatiotemporal reasoning, together with planning, interaction, and outcome assessment in both digital and physical environments. We construct training data spanning embodied and multimodal agent tasks, including execution observations and feedback to support outcome assessment and decision refinement. The training pipeline comprises embodied capability injection, separate reinforcement learning of embodied and multimodal-agent experts, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation that consolidates their complementary capabilities into a single model. Experiments show competitive performance on both embodied and agent benchmarks, as well as on autonomous-driving and embodied-navigation tasks. For edge deployment, visual token compression, W4A8 quantization, and hardware--software co-optimization enable on-device inference of the 4B variant on the M100, reducing prefill latency from 400 ms to 188 ms.
  Project Page: https://machembodied.com/ME-Brain/ME-VLM.html Code Repository: https://github.com/MachEmbodied/ME-VLM

AI.tldr: 提出统一视觉语言模型 ME-VLM（4B 与 35B-A3B 两个版本），融合具身认知与多模态智能体能力，通过具身能力注入、专家分别强化学习与多教师在线策略蒸馏的流水线训练，在具身、智能体及自动驾驶/导航基准上表现有竞争力，并通过视觉 token 压缩、W4A8 量化与软硬件协同优化实现 4B 版本端侧部署。
AI.motivation: 物理 AI 要求模型将视觉与语言理解落地到真实环境，同时需考虑环境约束与执行反馈，现有模型在物理感知、时空推理及结果评估方面仍存在不足。
AI.method: 构建覆盖具身与多模态智能体任务、含执行观测与反馈的训练数据；训练流水线包含三阶段：具身能力注入、具身专家与多模态智能体专家的分别强化学习、多教师在线策略蒸馏以整合互补能力。部署侧采用视觉 token 压缩、W4A8 量化与软硬件协同优化。模型提供 4B 与 35B-A3B 两种规格。
AI.result: 在具身与智能体基准以及自动驾驶、具身导航任务上取得有竞争力的性能；4B 版本在 M100 上实现端侧推理，预填充延迟由 400 ms 降至 188 ms。
AI.conclusion: ME-VLM 通过统一架构与多教师蒸馏有效整合具身认知与智能体能力，并结合压缩与量化技术实现可行的端侧部署，为物理 AI 提供了一体化方案。

title: Dynamic Thermal Gaussians: Multimodal 4D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Thermography plays a vital role in military and broader thermal analysis applications. Recent progress in 3D thermal reconstruction has extended temperature analysis from 2D to 3D space, yet most existing works assume static temperature distributions, neglecting the temporal dynamics of heat transfer in real-world environments. To address this limitation, we propose the first dynamic RGB-Thermal reconstruction framework for complex scenes. Our method jointly models RGB appearance, thermal observations, and scene geometry as they change over time. Specifically, we introduce a multimodal dynamic scene representation that anchors both the color and thermal modalities to a shared geometric substrate, ensuring their consistency under spatiotemporal deformations. We further design multimodal embeddings to enhance the motion expressiveness for each modality, and propose a multimodal routing mechanism that retains a unified set of shared multimodal Gaussians as the geometric backbone while adaptively spawning modality-specific Gaussians to strengthen the representational capacity in detail-rich regions of each individual modality. In addition, we contribute a novel benchmark dataset featuring high-frequency temperature variations to facilitate the evaluation of 4D reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves high-fidelity spatiotemporal reconstruction of both appearance and temperature. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/LinLif1869/DTG.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向复杂场景的动态RGB-热成像重建框架，联合建模随时间变化的表观、热观测与几何，并贡献高频温度变化数据集，实现高保真4D重建。
AI.motivation: 热成像在军事及热分析领域应用重要，3D热重建虽将温度分析从2D扩展到3D，但现有工作多假设温度分布静态，忽略了真实环境中的传热时间动态性。
AI.method: 1) 多模态动态场景表示：将颜色与热模态锚定到共享几何基底，保证时空变形下的一致性；2) 多模态嵌入：增强各模态的运动表达能力；3) 多模态路由机制：保留统一的共享多模态高斯作为几何骨干，并自适应生成模态特有高斯以增强各模态细节丰富区域；4) 构建含高频温度变化的新基准数据集用于4D重建评测。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，方法在表观与温度两方面均实现高保真的时空（4D）重建。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次实现复杂场景的动态RGB-热重建，验证了多模态动态表示与路由机制的有效性，并公开代码与数据集以推动4D热重建研究。

title: SLICEChat: Progressive In-Encoder Token Pruning for Whole-Slide Pathology Language Models
summary: Whole-slide pathology images (WSIs) contain gigapixel-scale visual content, creating a major scalability challenge for slide-level multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Existing approaches process thousands of patch tokens and typically apply compression only after slide encoding, leaving multimodal attention computationally expensive. We introduce SLICEChat, a slide-level MLLM that integrates progressive token pruning within a hybrid Mamba--Transformer slide encoder. Mamba layers enable efficient long-range propagation, while Transformer layers preserve global interactions as the sequence is progressively shortened. Between stages, language-supervised, region-aware pruning removes spatially coherent low-utility regions under a controlled keep-rate schedule, producing compact slide representations before multimodal fusion. On SlideBench VQA, SLICEChat achieves 79.84% accuracy on TCGA and 59.09% on BCNB cohorts, outperforming prior slide-level pathology MLLMs, and achieves the highest overall WSI-Bench metrics. It also provides competitive memory usage and the inference latency among the evaluated models. These results demonstrate accurate and computationally efficient multimodal reasoning over gigapixel WSIs.

AI.tldr: SLICEChat 是一种整合渐进式 token 剪枝与 Mamba-Transformer 混合编码器的全切片病理图像 MLLM，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 全切片病理图像（WSI）包含数十亿像素级视觉内容，对切片级多模态大语言模型（MLLM）构成严重的可扩展性挑战。现有方法处理数千个 patch token，且仅在切片编码之后才进行压缩，导致多模态注意力计算代价高昂。
AI.method: 提出 SLICEChat，将渐进式 token 剪枝集成到 Mamba-Transformer 混合切片编码器中。Mamba 层实现高效的长程信息传播，Transformer 层在序列逐步缩短时保留全局交互。各阶段之间采用语言监督、区域感知的剪枝策略，在受控保留率调度下移除空间连贯的低效用区域，从而在多模态融合前生成紧凑的切片表示。
AI.result: 在 SlideBench VQA 上，SLICEChat 在 TCGA 队列达到 79.84% 准确率，在 BCNB 队列达到 59.09%，优于此前的切片级病理 MLLM，并在 WSI-Bench 上取得最高整体指标；同时内存占用具竞争力，推理延迟在评估模型中表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，该方法能够对数十亿像素级 WSI 实现准确且计算高效的多模态推理。

title: MIRAGE: Full-Body Bystander Privacy for Smart Glasses with Consent-Based Restoration
summary:
Video recording on smart glasses exposes more than faces. Continuous capture reveals full-body biometric signatures, including gait, posture, and silhouette, that enable person re-identification (ReID) even after conventional face sanitization.
  We present MIRAGE, a three-tier architecture for privacy-preserving smart glasses that enforces full-body privacy, supports synthetic full-body replacement, and retains encrypted recovery material for consent-based restoration. We implement MIRAGE on a Raspberry Pi~5 (a CPU-only proxy for smart-glasses compute), companion phones, and a cloud generative backend. Compared to prior systems, MIRAGE achieves 0.948 AP and 0.976 AR while accurately detecting the complete visible body. Its bounding box masking reduces learned silhouette-based ReID to essentially random guessing, with 10.86% Rank-1 accuracy compared with an 11.12% measured chance level. Even against an adaptive adversary retrained on MIRAGE's sanitized pose signals, Rank-1 gait identification drops from 90.25% to 26.20%, removing 72.5% of the adversary's identification advantage.

AI.tldr: MIRAGE：面向智能眼镜的三层全身体隐私架构，可在保护全身体生物特征的同时支持合成替换与授权恢复。
AI.motivation: 智能眼镜的持续录像不仅暴露人脸，还泄露步态、体态、轮廓等全身体生物特征，使现有仅针对人脸脱敏的方案无法阻止重识别（ReID）。
AI.method: 提出 MIRAGE 三层架构：实施全身体隐私保护、支持合成全身体替换、并保留加密恢复材料以供基于同意的还原。系统部署于 Raspberry Pi 5（仅 CPU 的智能眼镜算力代理）、配套手机与云端生成后端。
AI.result: 实现 0.948 AP 与 0.976 AR，并准确检测完整可见身体；边界框掩蔽使基于轮廓的学习式 ReID 降至接近随机（Rank-1 为 10.86%，实测随机水平 11.12%）；针对在 MIRAGE 脱敏姿态信号上重训练的适应性对手，步态识别 Rank-1 从 90.25% 降至 26.20%，消除 72.5% 的识别优势。
AI.conclusion: 全身体脱敏与合成替换可有效抑制智能眼镜场景下的 ReID，同时保留授权恢复能力，兼顾隐私与可用性。

title: Incentive Noise and Structural Prior Infusion for Multi-modal Object Re-Identification
comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026. The version of record may differ slightly
summary: Multi-modal object Re-Identification (ReID) benefits from complementary information across heterogeneous imaging modalities. To further enrich semantic representation, text descriptions have recently been incorporated as an additional modality. However, recent vision-language approaches often treat text descriptions as clean, deterministic signals and overlook their inherent noise, including modality-mismatched phrases and semantically ambiguous expressions. Moreover, prevailing methods lack explicit mechanisms to reconcile fine-grained structural discrepancies between modalities, even after high-level semantic alignment. To address these challenges, we propose a novel framework centered on Positive-Incentive Noise (π-noise) and structured prompt modulation. First, the Semantic Cross-Modal Modulator harnesses task-aware π-noise, sampled from a distribution conditioned on both visual and text inputs, to perturb global tokens and enable semantics-guided cross-modal compensation. Second, the Structure-Aware Prompt Adapter injects learnable geometric priors via prompts to enhance spatial consistency. Third, the Context-Aware Sparse Fusion module distills structural context to guide adaptive fusion while shielding identity features from noisy local details.
