Experiments on three multi-modal ReID benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our approach. The code is available at https://github.com/zw-absin/INSPI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以正激励噪声（π-noise）与结构化提示调制为核心的框架，用于多模态目标重识别，缓解文本描述固有噪声并调和模态间细粒度结构差异。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态重识别引入文本描述以丰富语义表示，但多数视觉-语言方法将文本视为干净、确定性的信号，忽视其固有噪声（如模态不匹配短语、语义歧义表达）；同时，现有方法即使完成高层语义对齐，也缺乏显式机制来调和模态间细粒度的结构差异。
AI.method: 框架包含三个模块：(1) 语义跨模态调制器（Semantic Cross-Modal Modulator）：利用任务感知的π-noise，其采样分布以视觉与文本输入为条件，扰动全局token，实现语义引导的跨模态补偿；(2) 结构感知提示适配器（Structure-Aware Prompt Adapter）：通过提示注入可学习的几何先验，增强空间一致性；(3) 上下文感知稀疏融合（Context-Aware Sparse Fusion）：提炼结构上下文以指导自适应融合，同时保护身份特征免受局部噪声细节干扰。
AI.result: 在三个多模态重识别基准上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性与鲁棒性。代码开源于 https://github.com/zw-absin/INSPI。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入π-noise建模文本噪声并对齐结构先验，配合稀疏融合抑制局部噪声，该框架能有效提升多模态重识别的语义表示质量与跨模态结构一致性。

title: Evaluating Transformation Models for pCLE Mosaic Registration
summary: Confocal Laser Endomicroscopy (CLE) provides real-time, cellular-resolution optical biopsy but has a narrow field of view, which image mosaicing can extend to provide anatomical context. Because of line-by-line acquisition, probe motion, and probe-tissue interaction, frame alignment generally requires a non-linear transformation whose accuracy is difficult to quantify: flexible transformation models can fit intensity features and noise, so appearance-based metrics such as Normalized Cross-Correlation (NCC) can improve without a genuine gain in geometric accuracy. We therefore establish a dataset of 132 frame pairs across fourteen pCLE sequences from 4 patients with manually annotated landmark correspondences, so that Target Registration Error (TRE) can serve as a geometrically grounded complement to NCC. We assess the effect of progressively increasing the transformation model's degrees of freedom, from translation to Thin Plate Spline (TPS), and of six feature-matching backends spanning classical (Shi-Tomasi, Lucas-Kanade) and learned (SuperPoint, SuperGlue, LightGlue, LoFTR, RoMa) approaches. Translation and rigid models prove insufficient under tissue deformation, while TPS with random sampling achieves the strongest landmark-derived alignment of the evaluated configurations; among the learned matchers, used without fine-tuning, only RoMa offers a robust, if modest, advantage over other methods. At the sequence level, pairwise registration quality proved an unreliable predictor of final mosaic quality, so mosaic quality must be evaluated directly rather than inferred from pairwise metrics.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了带手动标注地标对应的pCLE帧对数据集，以TRE为几何基准指标，系统评估了从平移到TPS的变换模型复杂度及六种特征匹配后端对帧配准精度的影响。
AI.motivation: CLE可提供实时细胞级"光学活检"，但视野狭窄，需通过图像拼接扩展解剖背景。由于逐行采集、探头运动及探头-组织交互，帧间配准需非线性变换，而灵活变换模型易拟合强度特征与噪声，导致NCC等基于外观的指标提升但几何精度未必真正改善，缺乏可靠的几何评估手段。
AI.method: 建立包含4名患者14个pCLE序列、132对帧、带手动标注地标对应的数据集，以TRE作为几何可信度指标补充NCC。评估变换模型自由度递增（平移→刚性→TPS）的影响，并比较六种特征匹配后端，涵盖经典方法（Shi-Tomasi、Lucas-Kanade）与学习方法（SuperPoint、SuperGlue、LightGlue、LoFTR、RoMa）。
AI.result: 平移与刚性模型在组织形变下精度不足；TPS配合随机采样在所评估配置中取得最优的地标对齐效果。在未经微调的学习型匹配器中，仅RoMa相比其他方法具有稳健但有限的优势。序列层面，成对配准质量无法可靠预测最终拼接质量。
AI.conclusion: 非线性TPS变换更适合CLE帧配准，学习型匹配器在零微调下未必优于经典方法。拼接质量需直接评估，不能由成对配准指标推断。

title: HyperCLIP++: Fine-tuning CLIP forOpen-vocabulary Semantic Segmentation in Hyperbolic Space
summary: CLIP, a foundational vision-language model, has emerged as a powerful tool for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation. While freezing CLIP's text encoder is known to preserve its generalization capability, recent studies show that fine-tuning both CLIP's text and image encoders jointly significantly enhances segmentation performance, especially for classes from open sets. In this work, we explain this phenomenon from the perspective of hierarchy alignment, since during fine-tuning, the hierarchical level of image embeddings shifts from image-level to pixel-level. We achieve this by leveraging hyperbolic space, which naturally encodes hierarchical structures. Our key observation is that, during fine-tuning, the hyperbolic radius of CLIP's text embeddings decreases, facilitating better alignment with the pixel-level granularity of visual data. Building on this, we propose HyperCLIP++, a novel and parameter-efficient adaptation strategy. HyperCLIP++ directly adjusts the hyperbolic radius of CLIP's embeddings via scaling transformations to achieve a hierarchy alignment to the target task, i.e., segmentation. To ensure this hierarchy alignment is effected consistently across both modalities and preserves their cross-modal alignment during training, HyperCLIP++ integrates a Dual Cross-Relation Communication (DCRC) module that synchronizes these adjustments between the vision and text pathways. Our experiments show that HyperCLIP++ achieves state-of-the-art performance across three benchmarks while fine-tuning only approximately 5% of CLIP's total parameters. More importantly, we observe that after adjustment, CLIP's text embeddings exhibit a relatively fixed hyperbolic radius across datasets, suggesting that the hierarchical level required for this segmentation task might be quantified using the hyperbolic radius.

AI.tldr: 本文从层级对齐视角解释CLIP联合微调提升开放词汇分割性能的原因，并提出基于双曲半径调节的高效适配策略HyperCLIP++，仅调约5%参数即达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 冻结CLIP文本编码器可保持泛化性，但近期研究表明联合微调文本与图像编码器能显著提升分割性能（尤其开放集类别）。作者希望从层级对齐角度解释该现象：微调过程中图像嵌入的层级从图像级迁移到像素级。
AI.method: 借助自然编码层级结构的双曲空间进行分析：观察到微调时CLIP文本嵌入的双曲半径减小，从而更好对齐像素级视觉粒度。据此提出HyperCLIP++，通过缩放变换直接调节CLIP嵌入的双曲半径以实现面向分割任务的层级对齐；并设计双跨模态关系通信（DCRC）模块，在视觉与文本通路间同步该调节，保证两模态层级对齐一致并维持跨模态对齐。方法参数高效。
AI.result: 在三个基准上取得SOTA性能，仅微调CLIP约5%的总参数。调节后CLIP文本嵌入在不同数据集上呈现相对固定的双曲半径，暗示该分割任务所需层级可用双曲半径量化。
AI.conclusion: 联合微调提升分割性能可归因于层级对齐，双曲半径是刻画该层级的关键量；HyperCLIP++以极少参数实现高效适配，并为层级量化提供了新视角。

title: Active Visual Sampling with a Connectome-Constrained Fly Model for One-Shot Hatch Recognition in Architectural Drawings
summary: Architectural drawings encode material classes through repeated hatch patterns. We test whether a connectome-constrained fly visual network, pretrained for motion, can be repurposed without task-specific weight updates as a descriptor for one-shot hatch matching. Each 64 x 64 patch is translated over eight scan trajectories and summarized across 57 cell types; query descriptors are then matched to one legend strip per class. On 400 development sheets from a synthetic benchmark built on CubiCasa5K geometry, the frozen fly pipeline reaches 0.857 area-weighted accuracy and 0.910 with an extended legend. On an equal-brightness orientation condition it reaches 0.840 versus 0.299 for eleven pixel statistics, while a Gabor bank reaches 0.900. Replacing drift with a repeated still frame lowers the combined equal-condition score by 0.089 [0.066, 0.112]. However, a receptors-only descriptor reaches 0.891 and a task-trained 5,888-parameter CNN averages 0.959, so the current evidence supports transfer and the usefulness of active sampling, but not an advantage of the biological wiring. We separate project-recorded results from recomputed checks and report a small real-drawing audit. The supported claim is therefore narrow: motion-oriented biological vision can be repurposed as a useful texture representation for architectural hatch matching, while the topology contribution and end-to-end BIM utility remain open questions.

AI.tldr: 冻结的果蝇视觉运动网络可作为建筑填充图案的单样本纹理描述子，但生物拓扑结构本身未显示优势。
AI.motivation: 建筑图纸用重复填充图案编码材料类别，论文检验一个为运动任务预训练的、受连接组约束的果蝇视觉网络能否在不更新权重的情况下被复用为单样本填充图案匹配的描述子。
AI.method: 将每个64×64图像块沿八条扫描轨迹平移，在57种细胞类型上汇总为描述子；查询描述子与每类一条图例条带进行匹配。在基于CubiCasa5K几何构建的合成基准的400张开发图纸上评估，并与十一种像素统计特征、Gabor滤波器组、仅受体描述子以及一个5,888参数的任务训练CNN对比；同时进行等亮度朝向条件测试、以重复静止帧替换漂移的消融，并报告小规模真实图纸审计。项目记录结果与重算校验被分开呈现。
AI.result: 冻结果蝇流程达到0.857面积加权准确率，扩展图例后为0.910；等亮度朝向条件下为0.840，而十一种像素统计为0.299，Gabor滤波器组为0.900；将漂移替换为重复静止帧使等条件综合得分下降0.089 [0.066, 0.112]；仅受体描述子达0.891，任务训练CNN平均0.959。
AI.conclusion: 当前证据支持迁移学习和主动采样的有用性，但不支持生物布线结构带来优势；可支持的结论较窄：面向运动的生物视觉可被复用为建筑填充图案匹配的有用纹理表示，而拓扑贡献与端到端BIM效用仍待解决。

title: Applications of Neural Cellular Automata: State of the Art, Challenges and Opportunities
summary: Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs) are a new type of neural network architecture which enable accurate and robust inference at extremely small model sizes. Recently, NCAs have advanced to become interesting low-resource alternatives to convolution- and attention-based architectures for various tasks such as image analysis, synthetic image generation, and simulation. The rapid development and increased research interest necessitate a comprehensive review of the emerging technology. This review provides an overview of the fundamentals of NCAs, applications to medical imaging, as well as insights into the state of the art. We analyze recent modifications to the originally proposed NCA architecture with respect to their efficiency and accuracy. Furthermore, we review practical applications in real-world scenarios with a focus on medical image analysis, segmentation, classification, registration, depth estimation, and image synthesis. Finally, we identify several advantages of NCAs, research gaps, and conclude with an analysis of future opportunities for NCAs in medical applications in confined settings or areas that have particular demands for robustness or efficient data processing.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了神经细胞自动机（NCA）的基本原理、医学影像应用及最新进展，分析了架构改进与效率，并指出研究空白与未来机遇。
AI.motivation: NCA作为可在极小模型规模下实现准确鲁棒推理的新型网络架构，正快速发展为图像分析等任务的低资源替代方案，研究热度上升，亟需一篇系统性综述来梳理这一新兴技术。
AI.method: 综述性研究：梳理NCA基础理论，比较原始NCA架构的近期改进在效率与精度方面的表现，并系统回顾其在真实场景中的应用，重点关注医学图像分析（分割、分类、配准、深度估计与图像合成）。
AI.result: 归纳了NCA相对于卷积与注意力架构的优势，总结了其在医学影像任务中的实际应用现状，并识别出当前研究的空白点。
AI.conclusion: NCA在资源受限、对鲁棒性或高效数据处理有特殊需求的医学应用场景中具有广阔前景，是未来值得深入探索的方向。

title: Beyond Uniform Subspaces: Spectrum-Aware and Depth-Adaptive Fusion for Multi-Task Model Merging
summary: Model merging aims to consolidate multiple task-specific models without access to extra training process. However, existing subspace-based methods largely rely on a uniform treatment of task updates, overlooking their intrinsic spectral and depth-wise heterogeneity. We identify two key deviations from this assumption: different tasks require different subspace capacity and exhibit different tolerance to spectral transformation, while subspace projection introduces depth-dependent distortion. Based on these observations, we propose SADA-Merging, a spectrum-aware and depth-adaptive framework for data-free model merging. SADA-Merging allocates task-specific subspace capacity according to spectral complexity, adapts spectral preservation according to task-wise plasticity, and applies depth-dependent anchoring to compensate for projection-induced distortion. This enables the fusion process to adapt to both the intrinsic geometry of each task and its sensitivity across network depth. SADA-Merging operates directly on task updates and is applicable to both full fine-tuning and LoRA settings. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over existing data-free merging methods across different task scales and adaptation settings.

AI.tldr: SADA-Merging：一种频谱感知与深度自适应的无数据模型合并框架，按任务频谱复杂度分配子空间容量、按任务可塑性调整频谱保留，并用深度相关锚定补偿投影失真。
AI.motivation: 现有基于子空间的模型合并方法对任务更新一视同仁，忽视了任务间内在的频谱异质性与深度维度的异质性。作者指出两个关键偏差：不同任务需要不同子空间容量、对频谱变换容忍度不同；且子空间投影会引入与深度相关的失真。
AI.method: 提出 SADA-Merging，包含三个机制：(1) 依据频谱复杂度为每个任务分配特定子空间容量；(2) 依据任务可塑性自适应调整频谱保留程度；(3) 施加深度相关锚定以补偿投影导致的失真。该方法直接作用于任务更新，兼容全参微调与 LoRA 两种设定。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在不同任务规模与适配设定下，SADA-Merging 相较现有无数据合并方法均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将任务更新的频谱与深度异质性显式建模，SADA-Merging 突破了均匀处理假设，提升了无数据模型合并的通用性与有效性。

title: Video-based Surgical Skill Assessment Using Dynamics-and-Uncertainty-Aware Tree-based Gaussian Process Classifier
comment: 4 figures, 17 tables, 31 pages. It is Under Review in scientific reports Journal
summary: The proposed pipeline integrates a representation-flow convolutional neural network with a dynamics- and uncertainty-aware tree-based Gaussian Process classifier. In this framework, latent motion dynamics are exploited both as discriminative representations and as a source of input uncertainty, enhancing robustness against temporal variations and abnormal motion transitions. Compared with conventional deep learning approaches, the proposed strategy requires less training data and offers improved computational efficiency. To further improve classification performance, we introduce novel semantic-aware compound kernels that effectively capture semantic, flow, and dynamic information embedded in surgical video features. In addition, uncertainty-aware kernels are developed to strengthen the robustness and practical applicability of the compound kernel framework. The proposed method is evaluated on two benchmark datasets, namely the JIGSAWS and the Cataract-LMM (Capsulorhexis) datasets. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance across both datasets, including the LOSO and LOUO evaluation protocols on JIGSAWS, including the subject-independent LOUO protocol on JIGSAWS, on which the framework attains a mean accuracy of \ph{96.9}\%; results under the within-subject LOSO protocol are reported for comparability with prior work, achieving competitive accuracy while substantially reducing computational cost. Overall, the proposed pipeline provides an efficient and accurate framework for video-based surgical skill assessment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种将表征流卷积神经网络与动力学及不确定性感知的树状高斯过程分类器相结合的手术技能评估框架，利用潜在运动动力学作为判别表征和输入不确定性来源，并设计语义感知复合核与不确定性感知核，在JIGSAWS和Cataract-LMM数据集上取得高效且高精度的结果。
AI.motivation: 传统深度学习方法在视频手术技能评估中通常需要大量训练数据且计算成本高，同时对时间变化和异常运动转换的鲁棒性不足。因此需要一种训练数据需求更少、计算效率更高且能应对运动动态变化的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出将表征流卷积神经网络（representation-flow CNN）与动力学及不确定性感知的树状高斯过程分类器（tree-based Gaussian Process classifier）集成的流水线。将潜在运动动力学同时用作判别性表征和输入不确定性来源；引入语义感知复合核（semantic-aware compound kernels）以捕捉手术视频特征中的语义、光流和动态信息；并开发不确定性感知核（uncertainty-aware kernels）增强复合核框架的鲁棒性与实用性。
AI.result: 在JIGSAWS和Cataract-LMM（Capsulorhexis）两个基准数据集上进行评估。在JIGSAWS上采用LOSO和LOUO评估协议（包括与受试者无关的LOUO协议），框架取得平均准确率96.9%；在与受试者内LOSO协议下报告了结果以便与先前工作比较，在显著降低计算成本的同时达到有竞争力的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线为基于视频的手术技能评估提供了一种高效且准确的框架。

title: Relationally Grounded Latent World Models for Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted at the NeuRo-SymBolic World Models (RoBoWoMo) Workshop at IROS 2026
summary: Latent world models learn predictive representations for autonomous driving, but the relational semantics these states preserve often remain implicit. We investigate whether traffic scene graphs can serve as privileged semantic supervision for latent world representations. Building on LAW, we construct actor-centric scene graphs from nuScenes 3D annotations, encode their serialized relational structure using a frozen text embedding model, and align the visual latent representations with this semantic target during training. We remove the supervision branch at inference, so it requires neither scene graphs nor 3D annotations and adds no test-time computation. On nuScenes, our method reduces average trajectory L2 error from 0.661 to 0.622 (5.9%) and collision rate from 0.456 to 0.217 (52.4%) relative to our retrained LAW baseline. It also outperforms an unstructured caption-style semantic target, supporting the benefit of explicit relational structure for latent world-model representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究交通场景图能否作为特权语义监督来增强潜在世界模型的表示。基于LAW，从nuScenes 3D标注构建以行为主体为中心的场景图，用冻结文本编码模型编码其序列化关系结构，训练时对齐视觉潜在表示。推理时移除监督分支，无需场景图、3D标注及额外测试计算。相比重训的LAW基线，轨迹L2误差由0.661降至0.622（5.9%），碰撞率由0.456降至0.217（52.4%），并优于非结构化描述式语义目标。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型虽能学习自动驾驶的预测性表示，但其状态所保留的关系语义往往是隐式的。作者希望探索交通场景图能否作为特权语义监督，显式地为潜在世界表示注入关系结构信息。
AI.method: 基于LAW，从nuScenes 3D标注构建以行为主体为中心的场景图，将序列化的关系结构用冻结文本嵌入模型编码为语义目标，在训练阶段将视觉潜在表示与该语义目标对齐；推理时移除监督分支，因此不依赖场景图或3D标注，也不增加测试时计算。
AI.result: 在nuScenes上，相比重训的LAW基线，平均轨迹L2误差从0.661降至0.622（降低5.9%），碰撞率从0.456降至0.217（降低52.4%）；同时优于非结构化的描述式语义目标，表明显式关系结构对潜在世界模型表示学习更有效。
AI.conclusion: 交通场景图可作为有效的特权语义监督，为潜在世界模型引入显式关系结构，在不增加推理开销的前提下显著提升轨迹预测精度并大幅降低碰撞率，且显式关系结构优于非结构化语义目标。

title: FedMust: Semi-supervised Multi-task Student-Teacher Federated Learning for Multi-organ CT Segmentation
comment: This manuscript has been accepted for publication at the 7th International Conference on Medical Imaging and Computer-Aided Diagnosis (MICAD 2026)
summary: Multi-organ segmentation using deep learning requires large amounts of annotated patient data; however, institutions often lack sufficiently large and diverse annotated datasets. Privacy constraints further prevent institutions from sharing patient data to overcome this limitation. Moreover, due to the labor-intensive nature of annotation and the scarcity of diverse expertise, institutions typically have labels for only a small portion of their local data, leaving the larger unlabeled portion unused. In this work, we propose a flexible semi-supervised federated multi-task student-teacher framework that leverages federated learning (FL) to improve multi-organ segmentation using both labeled and unlabeled data across participating sites. At each communication round, the proposed framework initiates local training, where clients with labels for the same task form a federation to produce an aggregated teacher model. The resulting teachers generate task-specific features for all data at each client. Subsequently, all clients form a second federation to train a multi-task student model with a shared encoder and task-specific decoders that replicate the teacher-generated features across all segmentation tasks. The aggregated student model is then used to update the local teachers and initiate the next training round. Extensive experiments demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed method compared with local and federated single-organ models, yielding an average performance gain of 13 percent across clients. The experiments also demonstrated the impact of multi-task learning and unlabeled data and the applicability of the framework in relaxing labeled-data requirements for client participation. The code is available at https://github.com/AshknMrd/FedMust.

AI.tldr: 提出一种灵活的半监督联邦多任务师生框架（FedMust），利用联邦学习在多个站点联合有标注和无标注数据进行多器官分割，平均性能提升约13%。
AI.motivation: 多器官分割的深度学习依赖大量标注数据，但机构普遍缺乏足够大规模且多样的标注数据；隐私约束又使得机构之间无法共享患者数据。同时，由于标注工作量大且具备多样专业能力的人员稀缺，机构通常只对本地数据中的一小部分进行了标注，大量未标注数据被闲置。
AI.method: 提出半监督联邦多任务师生框架。每轮通信中先进行本地训练：对同一任务拥有标注的客户端组成一个联邦，聚合成教师模型；教师为各客户端的全部数据生成任务特定特征。随后所有客户端组成第二个联邦，训练带共享编码器和任务特定解码器的多任务学生模型，以在全部分割任务上复现教师生成的特征。聚合后的学生模型再用于更新本地教师，进入下一轮训练。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法相较本地单器官模型和联邦单器官模型更为有效，在客户端上平均性能提升约13%。实验还验证了多任务学习与无标注数据的作用，以及该框架在放宽客户端参与所需标注数据要求方面的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可在标注数据有限的条件下，借助联邦学习同时利用有标注与无标注数据提升多器官分割性能，并降低对客户端标注数据量的要求；代码已开源。

title: High-resolution Nitrogen Dioxide Maps Reveal Exposure Limit Breaches across Europe
summary: Nitrogen dioxide (NO2) is a common air pollutant, released into the atmosphere through the incomplete burning of fossil fuels, and associated with respiratory and cardiovascular diseases in humans. Ambient NO2 concentrations are regulated through air-quality limits assessed with a sparse network of fixed monitors. The revised EU Ambient Air Quality Directive (2024/2881) introduces a daily NO2 limit to be met from 2030. At present, neither the regulatory monitoring network nor existing coarse, annual-mean models can resolve NO2 concentrations at the spatio-temporal resolutions necessary to assess compliance. Here we map NO2 across Europe at hourly and 10m resolution with a machine-learning model that combines ground monitors with satellite, reanalysis, land-use, traffic and emission data and returns a calibrated predictive distribution at every location. Validated against held-out regulatory monitors and independent citizen-science campaigns, the maps resolve high-resolution spatiotemporal NO2 gradients for 110 metropolitan areas in Europe. We reconstruct the daily compliance statistic across those regions and find limit breaches in 91 EU air quality zones deemed compliant by the regulatory monitoring network, covering a population of approximately 135M. Beyond air quality zones and monitor locations, an estimated 9-9.4% (20M) of the population in mapped regions lives in areas where the daily NO2 limit is breached. The high-resolution maps offer a route to population-scale assessment of compliance with the 2030 limits.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了结合地面监测站与卫星、再分析、土地利用、交通和排放数据的机器学习模型，生成了欧洲小时级、10米分辨率的NO₂浓度地图，并重建了2030年EU日均限值的合规情况，揭示了大量未被监管网络识别的超标区域。
AI.motivation: NO₂是常见空气污染物，与呼吸和心血管疾病相关；修订后的EU空气质量指令（2024/2881）引入2030年起的日均NO₂限值，但现有稀疏固定监测网络与粗分辨率的年均模型均无法在所需时空分辨率上评估合规性，因此需要高分辨率制图方法。
AI.method: 采用机器学习模型，融合地面监测站数据与卫星、再分析、土地利用、交通及排放数据，在每个位置返回经过校准的预测分布，从而生成欧洲范围小时级、10米分辨率的NO₂地图。
AI.result: 模型经留出监管监测站和独立公民科学活动验证，可解析欧洲110个都市区的高分辨率时空NO₂梯度；在这些区域重建日均合规统计量，发现91个被监管网络判定为合规的EU空气质量区内实际存在限值超标，涉及约1.35亿人口；除空气质量管理区和监测点外，制图区域内约9-9.4%（2000万）人口居住在日均NO₂限值超标区域。
AI.conclusion: 高分辨率NO₂地图可用于人口尺度的2030年限值合规评估，弥补稀疏监测网络与粗分辨率模型在识别超标区域上的不足。

title: Ev-YOLO: Uncertainty-Aware Object Detection via a Unified Evidential Formulation
comment: Preprint / submitted manuscript. This version has not undergone peer review. To appear in the proceedings of the 9th International Conference on Belief Functions (BFAS 2026), Springer, LNAI
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimation is essential for deploying object detectors in autonomous systems operating in uncertain environments. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) provides a principled framework for uncertainty-aware classification by representing network outputs as evidence and interpreting predictions through subjective logic. However, existing evidential object detectors typically combine evidential classification with regression uncertainty models that do not share the same theoretical foundation. In this work, we propose an evidential version of YOLOv8 in which both classification and bounding-box regression are formulated within a common evidential framework. Our approach exploits YOLOv8's distribution-based bounding-box representation, allowing the evidential formulation to be applied not only to classification but also to localisation. As a result, both tasks produce belief, uncertainty, and probability estimates that can be interpreted within the Dempster--Shafer framework. Experiments on KITTI, MUSES, and nuScenes show that the resulting detector remains broadly competitive with standard YOLOv8 in terms of detection accuracy while providing a localisation uncertainty that effectively discriminates between correct and erroneous detections. Moreover, this uncertainty becomes increasingly discriminative under domain shift.

AI.tldr: 提出证据版YOLOv8，将分类与边界框回归统一到同一证据框架，在保持检测精度的同时提供有效定位不确定性。
AI.motivation: 在不确定环境中部署目标检测器需要可靠的 uncertainty estimation。EDL 提供了基于主观逻辑的不确定性感知分类框架，但现有证据目标检测器通常将证据分类与理论基础不一致的回归不确定性模型相结合，导致分类与回归的不确定性缺乏统一解释。
AI.method: 提出 evidential YOLOv8。利用 YOLOv8 基于分布的 bounding-box representation，将证据公式化同时应用于分类与定位（边界框回归）。分类和回归输出均产生 belief、uncertainty 与 probability 估计，并可在 Dempster--Shafer 框架下解释。
AI.result: 在 KITTI、MUSES、nuScenes 上的实验表明：检测精度总体上与标准 YOLOv8 具有竞争力；同时提供能够有效区分正确与错误检测的定位不确定性，且在 domain shift 下该不确定性更具判别性。
AI.conclusion: 通过在统一证据框架下建模分类与定位，edevidential YOLOv8 在不牺牲检测精度的前提下提供了可解释、可用于错误检测与域迁移场景的定位不确定性。

title: What Makes a Good Medical Image Tokenizer? Rethinking Reconstruction and Generation in Medical Image Tokenization
summary: Latent diffusion models now dominate medical image generation, and every such pipeline rests on a \emph{tokenizer} that compresses images into the latent codes for image generation to operate on. Thereby, the tokenizer choice bounds every downstream task from reconstruction fidelity and generation quality to the representations available for downstream analysis. Yet, medical imaging pipelines routinely utilize tokenizers from natural imaging on the hypothesis that their behavior carries over. However, this is an assumption never tested in the medical imaging regime, where datasets are orders of magnitude smaller and images exhibit far lower inter-sample variance. We present a systematic evaluation of medical image tokenizers evaluating thirty configurations across ten model families on twelve datasets at three compression factors, spanning reconstruction, generation, latent geometry, downstream classification, and memorization. We find that (1) performance on image reconstruction and generation strongly correlate, unlike prior reports on natural images; (2) modern tokenizers use nearly all of their codebook entries, but still leave most of the latent space unused; (3) training-set memorization is mild and is further suppressed by stronger latent space compression; and (4) discrete quantization can largely preserve downstream classification, with lookup-free schemes being the main exception.

AI.tldr: 本文对医学图像分词器进行了迄今最系统的评测：覆盖10个模型家族、30种配置、12个数据集、3种压缩率，横跨重建、生成、潜空间几何、下游分类与记忆化五个维度，并得出四点与自然图像领域不同的结论。
AI.motivation: 潜扩散模型已成为医学图像生成的主流范式，而其全部流程都依赖分词器将图像压缩为潜编码。分词器的选择会从重建保真度、生成质量到可供下游分析的表征，全面限制后续任务的上限。然而医学影像流程通常直接沿用自然图像的分词器，默认其行为可以迁移——这一假设从未在医学影像场景下被验证，而该场景的数据集规模小几个数量级、样本间方差也远低于自然图像。
AI.method: 作者开展了一项系统性的医学图像分词器评测：在12个数据集上，对10个模型家族共30种分词器配置、3种压缩因子进行统一比较，评测维度涵盖图像重建、生成质量、潜空间几何结构、下游分类性能以及训练集记忆化程度。
AI.result: 主要发现四点：(1) 图像重建性能与生成性能高度相关，这与自然图像上的既有报道不同；(2) 现代分词器几乎用满了全部码本条目，但潜空间仍大部分未被使用；(3) 训练集记忆化程度较轻，且更强的潜空间压缩可进一步抑制记忆化；(4) 离散量化基本能保留下游分类性能，主要例外是无查找表（lookup-free）方案。
AI.conclusion: 在医学影像场景下，自然图像分词器的行为假设并不完全成立，需要重新审视。分词器选型应同时权衡重建—生成相关性、码本与潜空间利用率、压缩对记忆化的抑制效应，以及量化方式对下游分类的影响（尤其是无查找表方案的局限）。作者呼吁在医学影像流程中谨慎评估并针对性选择分词器，而非默认沿用自然图像分词器。

title: ReSTI: A Source-Grounded Audit and Repair of STI-Bench
summary: Spatial--temporal benchmarks are valid only when their questions, source annotations, and answer options identify the same physical quantity. We audit STI-Bench against the official ScanNet, Waymo, and Omni6DPose sources and find systematic coordinate-system and timestamp errors, under-specified targets and times, and disagreements between keyed options and answer details. We introduce ReSTI, a source-backed revision that reconstructs every recoverable answer under an explicit target, time, coordinate system, physical quantity, and unit. Source reconstruction reveals task-level geometric failures: ScanNet Grounding omits the required alignment between annotation and raw camera coordinate systems, while Orientation measures camera rotation on the wrong plane. ReSTI replaces these labels with explicit, source-consistent geometric definitions and corrects other source-verifiable defects, including Waymo poses evaluated at the wrong timestamp. Across 2,064 legacy questions, ReSTI retains 1,782 questions and records 282 evidence-backed exclusions. ReSTI therefore provides a conservative and source-traceable basis for evaluating precise video spatial--temporal reasoning. Project page: https://github.com/pengzhansun/ReSTI.

AI.tldr: 该文审计了时空基准 STI-Bench，发现其存在坐标系、时间戳、目标/时间描述不清及选项与答案不一致等系统性错误，提出源可溯的修订版 ReSTI，重建可恢复答案并剔除不可恢复问题。
AI.motivation: 时空基准只有在问题、源标注与答案选项指向同一物理量时才有效。STI-Bench 存在与官方源（ScanNet、Waymo、Omni6DPose）不一致的系统性缺陷，导致评测基础不可靠。
AI.method: 对照官方 ScanNet、Waymo、Omni6DPose 源审计 STI-Bench；提出 ReSTI，在明确的目标、时间、坐标系、物理量与单位下重建每个可恢复答案；修正源可验证缺陷（如 ScanNet Grounding 缺失标注与原始相机坐标系对齐、Orientation 在错误平面上测量相机旋转、Waymo 位姿在错误时间戳上评估），并记录证据支持的排除项。
AI.result: 在 2,064 道遗留问题中，ReSTI 保留 1,782 道，记录 282 个有证据支持的排除项；源重建揭示任务级几何失败。
AI.conclusion: ReSTI 为精确的视频时空推理评测提供了保守且源可溯的基础。项目页面：https://github.com/pengzhansun/ReSTI。

title: GraphSVR: q-Space--Aware Graph-Based Slice-to-Volume Registration for Diffusion MRI
summary: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) remains highly vulnerable to subject motion, particularly in time-efficient protocols and in motion-prone populations. While slice-to-volume registration (SVR) can mitigate inter-slice and inter-stack misalignment, diffusion MRI introduces additional complexity due to diffusion-direction-dependent contrast and the requirement to align dozens of measurements within a common reference frame, effectively yielding a 4D registration problem. Existing approaches rely primarily on sequential modeling or pairwise similarity and often degrade under sparse gradient sampling or severe motion. We introduce GraphSVR, a q-space-aware graph-based framework for 4D SVR registration in DWI. GraphSVR represents slice groups as nodes in an acquisition-structured graph, with edges encoding temporal proximity, spatial slice geometry and diffusion encoding relationships. A graph neural network predicts globally consistent stack-wise rigid motion, optimized in a self-supervised, zero-shot manner using only an anatomical reference image, without requiring paired ground-truth motion. We evaluate GraphSVR using both fully synthetic diffusion simulations and realistic recombination-based simulations from real acquisitions with controllable motion severity and gradient sparsity. Performance is quantified using grid error (mm) and rotation error relative to known ground-truth transforms. Under severe motion, GraphSVR reduces grid error and rotation error by 73% compared to FSL eddy, the standard DWI motion-correction method, with the largest gains observed in sparse-direction regimes. These results demonstrate that explicitly modeling acquisition structure through graph-based reasoning improves robustness and global consistency in 4D DWI motion estimation. Code is available at https://github.com/nogakertes/GraphSVR.git.

AI.tldr: 提出GraphSVR，一种基于q空间感知图网络的4D扩散MRI切片到体积配准框架，自监督预测全局一致的层堆刚体运动，严重运动下误差较FSL eddy降低73%。
AI.motivation: DWI对受试者运动高度敏感，尤其在高效协议和易动人群中。切片到体积配准（SVR）虽可缓解层间与堆间错位，但扩散MRI因对比度依赖扩散方向、需将数十次测量对齐到统一参考系，构成4D配准难题。现有方法多依赖序列建模或成对相似性，在梯度稀疏采样或严重运动下性能下降。
AI.method: GraphSVR将切片组表示为采集结构图中的节点，边编码时间邻近性、空间切片几何与扩散编码关系；用图神经网络预测全局一致的层堆刚体运动；以仅含解剖参考图像的自监督、零样本方式优化，无需成对运动真值。评估采用全合成扩散仿真与基于真实采集的可控运动严重度、梯度稀疏度的重组仿真，以网格误差（mm）和旋转误差度量。
AI.result: 在严重运动下，GraphSVR相对标准DWI运动校正方法FSL eddy将网格误差和旋转误差降低73%，在稀疏方向情形下增益最大。结果表明显式建模采集结构的图推理可提升4D DWI运动估计的鲁棒性与全局一致性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过q空间感知的图结构建模采集关系，GraphSVR在无需配对真值的情况下实现鲁棒、全局一致的4D DWI运动估计，显著优于FSL eddy，尤其适用于稀疏梯度采样与严重运动场景。

title: MiTHras: Task-specific Hierarchical Semi-supervised Contrastive Masked Autoencoder for Mitotic Figure Analysis
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Mitotic figure (MF) analysis supports tumor grading and prognostic assessment, but automated models remain sensitive to differences in tissue type and image acquisition. We present MiTHras, a task-specific pretraining framework that combines pseudo-label-guided image- and token-level contrastive learning with masked reconstruction. We construct TCGA-MF-Pseudo, a corpus of 1.8 million cell-centered images from 14 TCGA cohorts spanning 11 organ sites. Comprehensive evaluation on MF classification, detection, count-based survival prediction, and subtype classification demonstrates the efficacy of MiTHras. It achieves the highest mean F1 on all three MF classification benchmarks and both subtype benchmarks. MiTHras also outperforms general-purpose and pathology foundation encoders by a larger margin under frozen-encoder linear probing than under full fine-tuning. Although detection gains are modest due to a shared candidate-detection stage, ablations confirm that token-level supervision improves typical-versus-atypical classification and linear probing. These findings establish that MiTHras yields robust, transferable representations for automated mitotic activity assessment.

AI.tldr: MiTHras是一个任务特异的预训练框架，结合伪标签引导的图像级与token级对比学习及掩码重建，在1.8M细胞图像的TCGA-MF-Pseudo语料上训练，在MF分类、检测、生存预测与亚型分类任务上取得最优表现，验证其表征的鲁棒性与迁移性。
AI.motivation: 自动化的核分裂象（MF）分析虽有助于肿瘤分级与预后评估，但现有模型对组织类型和图像采集差异高度敏感，缺乏稳健且可迁移的表征。
AI.method: 提出MiTHras任务特异预训练框架，融合伪标签引导的图像级与token级对比学习以及掩码重建；构建TCGA-MF-Pseudo语料，包含来自14个TCGA队列、11个器官部位的180万张细胞中心图像。
AI.result: 在MF分类、检测、基于计数的生存预测和亚型分类上全面评估：在三项MF分类基准和两项亚型基准上均取得最高平均F1；在冻结编码器线性探测下优于通用与病理基础编码器的幅度大于全量微调；检测增益有限（因共享候选检测阶段），但消融证实token级监督提升了典型与非典型分类及线性探测性能。
AI.conclusion: MiTHras能够产生稳健、可迁移的表征，适用于自动化核分裂活性评估。

title: Ananke: Contractive Torus Attractor Networks
summary: We introduce Ananke, a representation-learning framework that scaffolds latent representations onto a structured product-torus prior, and its flagship visual backbone realization, Contractive Torus Attractor Networks (CTAN). By factorizing high-dimensional latent spaces into an orthogonal direct sum of two-dimensional phase planes ($\bigoplus_{k=1}^K \R^2$), Ananke coordinates feature updates via a decoupled dual-phase continuous flow: skew-symmetric Hamiltonian transport moves features tangentially along energy level sets to preserve semantic phase invariants, while signed gradient dissipation contracts transverse perturbations normally toward target invariant manifolds. For circular potential families with frozen parameters, logarithmic radial feedback yields the Exact Log-Symplectic Flow (ELSF), an analytical closed-form mapping with exact exponential decay of log-radius error that evaluates in a single forward pass without numerical integration. We establish local input-to-state bounds for level-set deviations and log-radius errors, and characterize the normal hyperbolicity and persistence of the ideal product torus under bounded perturbations. We further formulate the architecture through Lie--Trotter operator splitting, unifying spatial depthwise diffusion with local manifold contraction, and analyze both exact trigonometric flows and hardware-friendly symplectic dual-shear variants. Across natural image benchmarks (CIFAR-100) and clinically challenging endoscopy datasets (Kvasir-v2), CTAN demonstrates exceptional parameter efficiency: an ultra-compact hierarchical model with merely 0.27M parameters achieves 90.52\% accuracy on Kvasir-v2, outperforming 25M+ baselines (ResNet-50, DenseNet-161) by nearly two orders of magnitude in capacity, while scaled variants attain 80.32\% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-100.

AI.tldr: 本文提出表示学习框架Ananke及其视觉骨干CTAN，通过将隐空间分解为二维相平面的正交直和，构建环面先验结构，实现高效且可解析的几何深度学习模型。
AI.motivation: 现有高维隐空间表示缺乏结构化几何先验，参数效率与语义不变性难以兼顾。作者希望借助辛几何与流形动力学，将隐表示约束到product-torus结构化先验上，以在保持语义相位不变量的同时获得高参数效率。
AI.method: 将隐空间分解为K个二维相平面的正交直和；用解耦双相连续流协调特征更新：斜对称Hamiltonian输运沿能量等值面切向移动以保持语义相位不变量，符号梯度耗散沿法向收缩横向扰动至目标不变流形。对冻结参数的圆势族，由对数径向反馈导出精确对数辛流ELSF，具有闭式映射与log半径误差的精确指数衰减，单次前向即可求值，无需数值积分。通过Lie–Trotter算子分裂统一空间深度可分离扩散与局部流形收缩，并分析精确三角流与硬件友好的辛双剪切变体。
AI.result: 建立等值面偏差与log半径误差的局部输入-状态界；刻画理想product torus在有限扰动下的法向双曲性与持久性。在CIFAR-100与Kvasir-v2上，CTAN参数效率突出：仅0.27M参数的超紧凑分层模型在Kvasir-v2达90.52%准确率，容量比ResNet-50、DenseNet-161等25M+基线少近两个数量级；放大变体在CIFAR-100达80.32% top-1准确率。
AI.conclusion: Ananke/CTAN通过product-torus结构化先验与辛流动力学的闭式实现，在极低参数量下取得具有竞争力的性能，验证了几何结构化表示学习在参数效率与稳定性上的潜力。

title: PrismGPT: Proxy-Guided Learning for Region-Aware Photo Editing with Self-Synthesized Reasoning
summary: Professional photo finishing relies on both global adjustments and region-specific local edits guided by semantic masks, yet current automated methods handle this workflow only partially. We present PrismGPT, a Vision-Language Model (VLM) framework that produces structured, region-aware editing plans from a single input image without relying on commercial black-box tools. Training a VLM to simultaneously diagnose aesthetic deficiencies at both global and local levels while predicting precise editing parameters is challenging due to the vast combinatorial decision space. We address this through proxy-guided learning: two simpler proxy tasks -- operation decomposition and region-aware aesthetic ranking -- teach the foundational skills the model needs, while a competence-based dynamic scheduler automatically rebalances the multi-task training ratio, progressively shifting emphasis from the proxy tasks to the primary editing task as each skill is mastered. Crucially, all reasoning traces used for supervised fine-tuning are self-synthesized by the same base model, eliminating the need for a stronger external teacher. Experiments on MIT-Adobe FiveK and SPIRE, a new professionally retouched benchmark we introduce, show that PrismGPT achieves state-of-the-art results while using only ~6% of the training data compared to the previous best method.

AI.tldr: 提出PrismGPT，一种VLM框架，可从单张图像生成结构化、区域感知的编辑方案，通过代理引导学习与动态调度器，仅用约6%训练数据即达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 专业照片修图依赖全局调整与基于语义掩膜的区域局部编辑，但现有自动化方法仅部分覆盖该流程。训练VLM同时诊断全局与局部美学缺陷并预测精确编辑参数，面临组合决策空间巨大的挑战。
AI.method: PrismGPT基于视觉语言模型，不依赖商业黑盒工具。采用代理引导学习：两个更简单的代理任务（操作分解、区域感知美学排序）教授基础技能；并以能力驱动的动态调度器自动重平衡多任务训练比例，随技能掌握逐步从代理任务转向主编辑任务。用于监督微调的推理轨迹均由同一基座模型自合成，无需更强外部教师。
AI.result: 在MIT-Adobe FiveK及新引入的专业修图基准SPIRE上，PrismGPT取得SOTA，且训练数据量仅为先前最佳方法的约6%。
AI.conclusion: 代理引导学习配合能力动态调度，可有效缓解组合决策空间带来的训练难题，实现高效且区域感知的自动化专业修图，并减少对外部教师模型与大规模数据的依赖。

title: Brain Metastases Segmentation for BraTS 2026 Task 1: A Multi-Architecture Comparison
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a poster at the BraTS 2026 Challenge, MICCAI 2026. Code: https://github.com/mahdiislam79/BraTS_METS_2026
summary: Brain metastases are the most common intracranial malignancy, occurring in roughly 30% of patients with primary solid tumors and carrying a median survival near 5.9 months. Automated segmentation is critical for treatment planning and volumetric monitoring, but metastases are frequently small, numerous, and heterogeneous in size within a single patient. We compare a plain nnU-Net baseline, a Residual Encoder Large (ResEncL) variant, region-based training, and a Primus transformer model for BraTS-METS 2026 Task 1, using patient-grouped cross-validation to prevent leakage from the longitudinal UCSD subset. Primus (label-based) is our strongest individual model by aggregate DSC/NSD, achieving 0.710/0.761 (ET), 0.742/0.785 (TC), 0.683/0.689 (WT), and 0.531/0.436 (RC). ResEncL trails Primus on aggregate DSC/NSD but achieves substantially higher lesion-wise F1 (e.g. ET: 0.452 vs. 0.052); a probability-averaging ensemble of the two only partially preserves ResEncL's F1 advantage (ET lesion-wise F1: 0.064). We further report three postprocessing and label-reconstruction pitfalls we believe generalize beyond this challenge. Code is available at https://github.com/mahdiislam79/BraTS_METS_2026.

AI.tldr: 该文对比了nnU-Net基线、ResEncL、区域训练与Primus Transformer在BraTS-METS 2026 Task 1脑转移瘤分割任务上的表现，Primus综合指标最佳，ResEncL病灶级F1显著更高，集成仅部分保留该优势，并指出三类后处理与标签重建陷阱。
AI.motivation: 脑转移瘤是最常见的颅内恶性肿瘤，约发生于30%的原发实体瘤患者，中位生存期约5.9个月。自动分割对治疗计划与体积监测至关重要，但转移灶通常体积小、数量多、大小异质性强，分割难度大。
AI.method: 针对BraTS-METS 2026 Task 1，采用患者分组交叉验证以避免UCSD纵向子集带来的数据泄漏，对比四类模型：普通nnU-Net基线、Residual Encoder Large (ResEncL) 变体、基于区域的训练以及Primus Transformer模型。
AI.result: Primus（label-based）在综合DSC/NSD上为最强单模型：ET 0.710/0.761，TC 0.742/0.785，WT 0.683/0.689，RC 0.531/0.436。ResEncL综合DSC/NSD略低，但病灶级F1显著更高（如ET：0.452 vs. 0.052）；两者概率平均集成仅部分保留ResEncL的F1优势（ET病灶级F1：0.064）。
AI.conclusion: 综合指标与病灶级检测性能存在明显权衡：Primus在DSC/NSD上领先，ResEncL在病灶级F1上占优，简单概率平均集成难以兼顾两者。作者还总结了三种可推广至该挑战之外的后处理与标签重建陷阱。代码已开源。

title: Virtual neural networks: hundreds of souls in a body
summary: A new concept, termed virtual neural networks, is introduced, where the count of trainable parameters is kept constant, and scalability is attained purely through computational resources. This concept is an abstract framework that can be realized using any standard convolutional neural network. It merges siamese neural networks with a deep ensemble technique by generating numerous virtual models that share weights derived from a small set of physical models. The ensemble comprises up to hundreds of trained models simultaneously. All virtual networks take the same input, and their interconnected structure induces an internal distortion that boosts the entire ensemble robustness. The accuracy of the ensemble improves as the number of virtual networks increases, without changing the capacity. Virtual neural networks outperform larger capacity models, typical deep ensembles, and contemporary approaches like SWA and Masksembles. Additionally, the highest-performing individual model from the ensemble surpasses other models trained individually, even those with a greater number of parameters. Code: gitlab.com/EnginCZ/virtual-models-public

AI.tldr: 提出"虚拟神经网络"概念：可训练参数量恒定，仅通过增加计算资源实现可扩展性，该框架可基于任意标准CNN实现。
AI.motivation: 传统模型提升性能通常依赖增加参数量与容量，作者希望在不增加可训练参数的前提下，通过计算资源获得可扩展性与更强的鲁棒性和精度。
AI.method: 融合孪生神经网络与深度集成技术，由少量物理模型共享权重生成大量虚拟模型，集成规模可达数百个模型；所有虚拟网络共享同一输入，其互连结构引入内部扰动以增强整体集成的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 集成精度随虚拟网络数量增加而提升且容量不变；虚拟神经网络优于更大容量模型、典型深度集成以及SWA、Masksembles等现有方法；集成中表现最佳的单个模型也超过单独训练的其他模型，即使后者参数量更多。
AI.conclusion: 虚拟神经网络以恒定参数量结合计算扩展实现了性能与鲁棒性提升，可作为通用框架应用于标准CNN，并公开了代码。

title: Toward a foundation model for forest point clouds
summary: Forest inventories increasingly rely on artificial intelligence (AI) models to derive forest attributes from large-scale 3D point clouds. Current models are typically specialized to a single task, sensor, and forest type, making adaptation expensive in terms of annotations, computation, and expertise. We ask whether a single pretrained model can instead learn transferable representations across diverse forest inventory settings. Inspired by recent developments in language modelling and computer vision, we take a step toward a foundation model (FM) for 3D forestry. Using LitePT as backbone, we first establish a strong supervised baseline that sets a new state of the art on forest semantic and instance segmentation, tree species classification, and age regression benchmarks. We then curate a large-scale unlabelled corpus spanning airborne, UAV, and mobile laser scanning across diverse forest ecosystems, and pretrain the same backbone using self-supervised learning. We systematically evaluate representation learning strategies by comparing training from scratch, supervised pretraining, and self-supervised pretraining across four representative forestry tasks, under varying annotation budgets. Compared with training from scratch, self-supervised pretraining accelerates model convergence and consistently improves performance when annotations are scarce. Compared with task-specific supervised pretraining, self-supervised pretraining yields more transferable representations across downstream forestry tasks. These findings identify the practical regime in which pretrained representations are most valuable and suggest that instance discrimination, rather than forest semantics, is the main remaining obstacle to a general-purpose 3D forest foundation model. Code and models are available at: https://github.com/prs-eth/ForPT.

AI.tldr: 以LitePT为骨干，构建跨传感器森林点云大规模无标签语料并做自监督预训练，验证其在标注稀缺时加速收敛并提升跨任务迁移性，指向3D林业基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有森林资源调查AI模型通常针对单一任务、单一传感器和单一林型专门化，适应新场景时在标注、算力和专业知识上代价高昂，因此作者追问能否用单一预训练模型学习跨多种森林调查场景的可迁移表征。
AI.method: 以LitePT为骨干：先建立强监督基线；随后整理覆盖机载、无人机与移动激光扫描、跨多种森林生态系统的大规模无标签语料，用自监督学习预训练同一骨干；在四个代表性林业任务、不同标注预算下系统对比从零训练、监督预训练与自监督预训练三种表征学习策略。
AI.result: 监督基线在森林语义与实例分割、树种分类、树龄回归基准上取得新的最优结果；相比从零训练，自监督预训练加速收敛，并在标注稀缺时持续提升性能；相比任务特定的监督预训练，自监督预训练产生跨下游林业任务更可迁移的表征。
AI.conclusion: 研究界定了预训练表征最有价值的实际适用范围（标注预算受限、需跨任务迁移）；并指出实例判别（instance discrimination）而非森林语义，是通向通用3D森林基础模型的主要剩余障碍。代码与模型已开源。

title: Streaming Video Editing with Easy Adaptation
summary: In this paper, we propose SVEET, a framework that requires merely training on a pretrained bidirectional video diffusion model but supports high-quality streaming video editing in an auto-regressive fashion. To tackle this problem, we first systematically revisit existing video-to-video diffusion approaches and identify two key principles for such streaming adaptation: backbone feature disentanglement and conditional frame independence. Building on these insights, we develop a novel paradigm for controllable video generation. At its core, an auxiliary model branch encodes source video inputs with temporally independent self-attention, and the intermediate features are injected into the corresponding backbone blocks for streaming-compatible control. Moreover, to bridge the discrepancy between the feature spaces of bidirectional and streaming models, we propose a decoupled training scheme that explicitly enforces the orthogonality between the optimization directions of video controllability and model causality. Such disentanglement ensures compatibility between the two objectives at inference and facilitates smooth zero-shot knowledge transfer across heterogeneous backbone architectures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SVEET achieves superior editing quality while maintaining real-time performance, attaining 15 FPS on a single H100 GPU 17 without any auxiliary acceleration techniques. Codes are available at https://github.com/YujiaHu1109/SVEET.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SVEET框架，仅需在预训练双向视频扩散模型上训练即可实现高质量自回归流式视频编辑，在单张H100上达到15 FPS。
AI.motivation: 现有视频到视频扩散方法多基于双向模型，难以直接用于流式（自回归）视频编辑，且双向与流式模型特征空间存在差异，阻碍知识迁移与实时性能。
AI.method: 系统回顾现有video-to-video扩散方法，归纳出流式适配的两大原则：骨干特征解耦与条件帧独立性。在此基础上构建新范式：辅助模型分支以时间独立自注意力编码源视频输入，并将中间特征注入对应骨干块实现流式可控生成；同时提出解耦训练方案，显式约束视频可控性与模型因果性的优化方向正交，以弥合双向与流式模型特征空间差异。
AI.result: 大量实验表明SVEET在保持实时性能的同时取得更优编辑质量，在单张H100 GPU上无需任何辅助加速技术即达到15 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 通过特征解耦与条件帧独立性设计及解耦训练，SVEET实现了从双向扩散模型到流式视频编辑的平滑零样本知识迁移与实时高质量编辑。

title: INTCORT: Training-Free Spatial Reasoning Enhancement for Vision-Language Models via Input Transformations and Confidence Routing
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in multimodal tasks, yet they still exhibit poor ability in spatial reasoning. Existing training-dependent and training-free enhancement methods suffer from high computational costs with catastrophic forgetting and internal mechanism interference that compromises general capabilities, respectively. In this work, we first verify two key hypotheses: appropriate geometric image transformation and query-reversal transformation can recover incorrect spatial predictions, and correct predictions exhibit higher relation-token confidence than incorrect ones. Based on these findings, we propose INTCORT, a training-free spatial reasoning enhancement framework that constructs multiple inference views through input transformations and aggregates their predictions via relation-token confidence routing, without modifying the VLM's internal mechanisms. Experimental results on several commonly-used benchmarks demonstrate that INTCORT substantially improves spatial reasoning accuracy across diverse VLMs, achieving an average improvement of 10.01% over all models and benchmarks. Compared with prior works, INTCORT achieves superior performance with improvements of up to 25.01%.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架INTCORT，通过输入变换构造多推理视图并借助关系token置信度路由聚合预测，显著提升VLM空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在多模态任务上表现优异，但空间推理能力仍较弱。现有增强方法存在缺陷：依赖训练的方法计算开销大且易发生灾难性遗忘；免训练方法则干扰模型内部机制，损害通用能力。因此需要一种既能提升空间推理又不损害通用性能的低成本方案。
AI.method: 首先验证两个关键假设：（1）恰当的几何图像变换与query-reversal变换可纠正错误的空间预测；（2）正确预测的关系token置信度高于错误预测。基于此提出INTCORT——一种免训练的空间推理增强框架：通过输入变换构造多个推理视图，并利用关系token置信度路由聚合各视图预测，且不修改VLM内部机制。
AI.result: 在多个常用基准上的实验表明，INTCORT在多种VLM上均显著提升空间推理精度，在所有模型和基准上平均提升10.01%，相较已有方法最高提升达25.01%。
AI.conclusion: INTCORT通过免训练的多视图变换与置信度路由，在不损害通用能力的前提下有效增强VLM空间推理，性能优于现有方法，验证了所提两个假设的有效性与方法的通用性。

title: Mobile Imaging Solutions for Medical Diagnosis: Trends and Applications
summary: Advances in processing power, camera technologies, and mobile image analysis have made smartphones and other mobile devices, such as laptops, increasingly suitable for medical diagnosis and healthcare applications. Researchers have developed low-cost solutions for the early detection and monitoring of various health conditions, including eye and ENT diseases, malnutrition, heart rate variability, skin and oral conditions, and injuries, using images captured by non-medical devices such as smartphones and webcams. This survey examines existing research on mobile image-based medical diagnosis, with an emphasis on its potential to enable low-cost and accessible healthcare. We comparatively analyze state-of-the-art solutions across different healthcare application categories, examining their advantages and limitations. Based on this analysis, we identify desirable characteristics of mobile image-based diagnostic tools and highlight areas where existing approaches have made progress as well as areas requiring further research. We also discuss application-specific and common challenges and outline directions for future research. Overall, this study provides a comprehensive overview of mobile image-based healthcare solutions and their potential to support low-cost disease diagnosis and monitoring, particularly for underserved populations in remote and resource-constrained settings.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了基于移动设备图像的医学诊断研究，比较各类方案，总结优势与局限，并指出未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 处理能力、摄像技术和移动图像分析的进步，使智能手机、笔记本电脑等移动设备日益适合医学诊断与健康应用；研究者已开发出低成本方案用于多种疾病的早期检测与监测，有望为偏远及资源受限地区人群提供可及的低成本医疗。
AI.method: 综述方法：梳理基于移动图像的医学诊断现有研究，按不同医疗应用类别对前沿方案进行对比分析，考察其优势与局限，并据此归纳理想诊断工具应具备的特性。
AI.result: 通过对比分析，识别出移动图像诊断工具的理想特性，明确了现有方法已取得进展的领域以及仍需进一步研究的方向，并总结了应用特定性与共性挑战。
AI.conclusion: 本研究全面概述了基于移动图像的医疗方案及其在低成本疾病诊断与监测方面的潜力，特别适用于偏远和资源受限环境中的医疗服务不足人群。

title: ZVeC: A Zero-Shot Framework for Instance-Level Vehicle Extraction and Generative Point Cloud Completion
summary: LiDAR point clouds acquired in underground environments exhibit severe geometric incompleteness due to occlusions and limited sensor viewpoints, making reliable point cloud completion challenging without large supervised datasets. We propose ZVeC, a zero-shot, instance-driven framework that reformulates scene-level completion as compositional object-level reconstruction. By decomposing a scene into semantic object instances, ZVeC reduces reconstruction ambiguity in cluttered environments while eliminating the need for scenario-specific training. Each segmented vehicle is completed independently using a depth- and 3D Gaussian-conditioned diffusion model that exploits generalized geometric priors before the reconstructed instances are recomposed into the original scene. To evaluate our approach, we construct a real-world dense LiDAR benchmark of underground parking environments. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements over representative scene-level baselines in both quantitative metrics and visual quality. The completed point cloud differs substantially from the measured input (average KL divergence ~ 2.1), yet reducing the input to only 1% of the original LiDAR measurements changes the completed reconstruction only marginally (KL divergence < 0.50). This demonstrates that ZVeC produces geometrically consistent completions even under extreme input sparsity.

AI.tldr: ZVeC：零样本、实例驱动的场景级点云补全框架，将场景补全重构为对象级组合重建，在无场景特定训练下于地下停车场LiDAR数据上取得优于场景级基线的效果。
AI.motivation: 地下环境中的LiDAR点云因遮挡与视角受限导致严重几何不完整，且缺乏大规模监督数据集，使可靠的点云补全十分困难。
AI.method: 将场景分解为语义对象实例，降低杂乱环境中的重建歧义并免去场景特定训练；对每个分割出的车辆实例，使用深度与3D高斯条件化的扩散模型独立补全，以利用泛化几何先验，再将补全实例重组成原始场景。
AI.result: 构建了真实地下停车场密集LiDAR基准，在定量指标与视觉质量上均稳定优于代表性场景级基线；补全点云与实测输入差异显著（平均KL散度约2.1），而将输入降至原始LiDAR测量的1%时，补全结果仅有微小变化（KL散度<0.50）。
AI.conclusion: ZVeC在极端输入稀疏条件下仍能生成几何一致的补全结果，验证了实例驱动、零样本范式在地下场景点云补全中的有效性。

title: When Wider Views Fail: Stress-Testing Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models enable efficient geometry estimation from sparse images, but their pretrained nature can make them vulnerable to distribution shifts beyond their training data. Identifying these failure modes is important for understanding when such models can be reliably deployed in unconstrained imaging settings. We investigate viewpoint variation as a controlled distribution shift by varying the angular span of sparse image inputs while keeping the input budget fixed. Across multiple feed-forward reconstruction models, we observe substantial degradation as viewpoint span increases, with wide spans producing both incomplete surface coverage and geometry unsupported by the observed imagery. These results reveal that viewpoint variation can induce failure modes beyond conventional reconstruction incompleteness, highlighting the need to evaluate pretrained feed-forward models under distribution shifts that challenge their learned geometric priors.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过固定输入视角数量、改变视角跨度来构造受控分布偏移，发现前馈3D重建模型在大视角跨度下会出现表面覆盖不全及无观测支撑的几何，揭示其失败模式超出传统重建不完整范畴。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D重建模型虽能高效地从稀疏图像估计几何，但其预训练特性使其在训练分布之外易受分布偏移影响。识别这些失败模式对于判断模型能否在无约束成像场景中可靠部署至关重要，而视角变化是一种可被精确控制的分布偏移来源。
AI.method: 在保持输入图像数量（输入预算）固定的前提下，系统地改变稀疏输入图像的角跨度（angular span），以此构造受控的视角分布偏移，并在多个前馈重建模型上进行评测，观察几何输出随视角跨度的变化。
AI.result: 随着视角跨度增大，多个前馈重建模型性能显著退化；大跨度同时导致两类问题：表面覆盖不完整，以及生成缺乏观测图像支撑的几何结构。
AI.conclusion: 视角变化会诱发超越传统重建不完整性的失败模式，说明需在挑战模型习得几何先验的分布偏移条件下评估预训练前馈模型，以保证其在无约束成像环境中的可靠部署。

title: Revisiting Multi-View Stereo: A Sequence-to-Sequence Formulation
summary: Computing accurate geometry from multi-view images is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Recent feed-forward (FF) models jointly estimate 3D geometry and camera parameters, but they typically suffer from geometry distortion caused by reconstruction ambiguity, even when ground-truth camera parameters are supplied. In this paper, we study the multi-view stereo (MVS) problem with known camera parameters and propose a novel approach that bridges conventional MVS and FF methods. Rather than casting MVS as a sequence-to-one mapping that predicts depth only for a single reference view, we reformulate it as a sequence-to-sequence task, akin to FF models, that jointly predicts geometry for all input views. We introduce a global transformer-based architecture with two components that explicitly exploit camera-induced priors: ray-map embeddings that inject camera parameters into image patch tokens, making the transformer camera-aware, and a unified global cost volume that replaces conventional per-view cost volumes to jointly capture 3D structure across all views. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks show our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing both MVS and FF reconstruction baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文将已知相机参数的多视图立体（MVS）问题从"序列到单点"重构为"序列到序列"任务，提出基于全局Transformer、显式利用相机先验（射线图嵌入与统一全局代价体）的方法，在多个公开基准上取得超越MVS与FF基线的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 多视图图像恢复精确几何是计算机视觉的基础问题。近期前馈（FF）模型虽能联合估计三维几何与相机参数，但即使给定真值相机参数，仍因重建歧义导致几何畸变。论文旨在已知相机参数条件下研究MVS问题，弥补传统MVS与前馈方法之间的差距。
AI.method: 不再将MVS视为仅对单一参考视图预测深度的"序列到单点"映射，而是重构为类似FF模型的"序列到序列"任务，为所有输入视图联合预测几何。提出全局Transformer架构，含两个显式利用相机先验的组件：（1）射线图嵌入，将相机参数注入图像块token，使Transformer具备相机感知能力；（2）统一全局代价体，替代传统的逐视图代价体，联合捕获所有视图的三维结构。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准上的大量实验表明，该方法达到最先进性能，超越MVS与前馈重建两类基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过将MVS重构为序列到序列任务并引入相机感知的全局Transformer与统一全局代价体，可在已知相机参数下有效缓解重建歧义导致的几何畸变，实现优于传统MVS和前馈方法的几何重建效果。

title: DTKDP: A Dual Teacher Knowledge Distillation and Pruning Framework for Lightweight Oriented SAR Ship Detection
comment: Published in Remote Sensing. The version of record is available at https://doi.org/10.3390/rs18183172
summary: Two-stage oriented detectors achieve high localization accuracy in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) ship detection, but their large backbones, feature pyramids, proposal modules, and heavy region of interest (RoI) heads hinder deployment. Existing lightweight SAR ship detectors typically use one-stage frameworks that lack proposal-level refinement for precise rotated localization. This paper presents a dual-teacher knowledge distillation and pruning (DTKDP) framework for lightweight oriented SAR ship detection. DTKDP introduces learnable gates into convolutional, normalization, and linear layers to prune convolutional channels and RoI-head neurons. Rotated proposal alignment (RPA) distills teacher and student predictions in a shared teacher-generated rotated proposal space, while a dual-teacher scheme combines classification and regression guidance from a homogeneous main teacher with complementary classification cues from a heterogeneous auxiliary teacher. Experiments on the SAR Ship Detection Dataset (SSDD) and Rotated Ship Detection Dataset in SAR Images (RSDD-SAR) show that DTKDP reduces the parameters of Oriented Region-based Convolutional Neural Network (Oriented R-CNN) and RoI Transformer equipped with ResNet-50 backbones by 87.5-91.8% and their floating-point operations (FLOPs) by 75.6-79.9%. In terms of average precision (AP) and mean average precision (mAP), the resulting Oriented R-CNN-slim and RoI Transformer-slim retain accuracy close to their full-scale counterparts. Relative changes across $\mathrm{AP}_{50}$, $\mathrm{AP}_{75}$, $\mathrm{mAP}_{50:75}$, and $\mathrm{mAP}_{50:95}$ range from a 2.38% decrease to a 0.65% improvement. Compared with RTMDet-tiny, they improve all four metrics on both datasets by 0.52-27.55% and consistently surpass representative distillation methods, demonstrating a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DTKDP框架，通过双教师知识蒸馏与结构化剪枝，实现轻量级旋转SAR船舶检测，在参数量和计算量大幅下降的同时保持高精度。
AI.motivation: 两阶段旋转检测器在SAR船舶检测中定位精度高，但其庞大骨干网络、特征金字塔、候选框模块及沉重的RoI头难以部署；现有轻量级SAR船舶检测器多为一阶段框架，缺乏候选框级精化，难以实现精确的旋转定位。
AI.method: DTKDP在卷积层、归一化层和线性层中引入可学习门控，以剪枝卷积通道与RoI头神经元；提出旋转候选框对齐（RPA），在教师生成的共享旋转候选框空间中蒸馏师生预测；采用双教师方案，由同构主教师提供分类与回归指导，异构辅助教师提供互补分类线索。
AI.result: 在SSDD和RSDD-SAR数据集上，DTKDP将ResNet-50骨干的Oriented R-CNN与RoI Transformer参数量减少87.5-91.8%，FLOPs减少75.6-79.9%；AP与mAP接近原始模型，AP50、AP75、mAP50:75、mAP50:95相对变化为下降2.38%至提升0.65%；相比RTMDet-tiny，四项指标提升0.52-27.55%，并持续优于代表性蒸馏方法。
AI.conclusion: DTKDP在轻量级旋转SAR船舶检测中实现了良好的精度-效率权衡，验证了双教师蒸馏与剪枝结合的有效性。

title: SPHQuant: Efficient extreme low bit weight quantization for Vision-Language Models
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, including appendix. Code will be released at https://github.com/Pushazf/SPHQuant
summary: Recent foundation models are moving toward native multimodal Vision-Language Models (VLMs), making VLMs a central form of next-generation foundation models. However, their large language backbones make edge deployment difficult due to high memory footprint and memory-bound autoregressive decoding. Weight-only post-training quantization is a practical solution, but pushing VLMs to extreme low bit-widths remains challenging: existing rotation-free methods suffer from outliers at 2-3 bits, while rotation-based methods improve accuracy at the cost of additional runtime overhead. We propose SPHQuant, a rotation-free spherical weight-only quantization framework for VLMs. Instead of quantizing weights directly in Cartesian coordinates, SPHQuant decomposes each 8D weight vector into coordinate signs, radius, and a positive unit direction. This representation isolates outlier magnitude into the radius while keeping directions bounded and statistically regular. Based on this insight, SPHQuant allocates extra precision to the radius to mitigate accuracy degradation induced by outliers. It further uses a compact positive-direction codebook and fine-tunes codebook entries through angular parameterization to preserve the unit-sphere constraint. We also design a hardware-friendly GEMV kernel that keeps the direction codebook small enough for shared-memory lookup and packs radial bits efficiently. Experiments show that SPHQuant matches the performance of state-of-the-art extreme low-bit quantization methods while improving decode throughput over QTIP by 30.3% on RTX A6000. Code will be released in https://github.com/Pushazf/SPHQuant.

AI.tldr: 提出SPHQuant，一种无旋转的球面坐标权重量化框架，将8D权重分解为符号、半径与正向单位方向，并对半径分配额外精度，以在极低比特下缓解离群值影响，同时提升解码吞吐。
AI.motivation: 原生多模态VLM成为下一代基础模型的核心，但其大语言主干带来高显存占用与内存受限的自回归解码，边缘部署困难。仅权重量化是实用方案，但推向极低比特仍有挑战：无旋转方法在2-3比特下受离群值影响，旋转方法虽提升精度却引入额外运行时开销。
AI.method: SPHQuant采用无旋转的球面权重量化：将每个8D权重向量分解为坐标符号、半径和正的单位方向，从而将离群值幅度隔离到半径中，使方向保持有界且统计规律。基于此对半径分配额外精度；使用紧凑的正方向码本，并通过角度参数化微调码本条目以保持单位球约束；设计硬件友好的GEMV内核，使方向码本小到可放入共享内存查找，并高效打包径向比特。
AI.result: 实验表明，SPHQuant在性能上匹配当前最先进的极低比特量化方法，同时在RTX A6000上相比QTIP将解码吞吐提升30.3%。
AI.conclusion: SPHQuant为VLM提供了一种无旋转、硬件友好的极低比特仅权重量化方案，在保持精度竞争力的同时显著改善解码效率，代码将开源。

title: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
summary: Video world models enable interactive exploration of dynamic environments, yet struggle to respect prior observations over long horizons and across viewpoints. We present WorldCrafter, a video world model that learns a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory for this purpose. The key insight is to let the requested viewpoint shape how multi-view evidence is compressed into the video generator's limited token budget. Trained jointly with the video generator, a memory encoder and pose-conditioned readout module integrate historical observations into a fixed set of target view-specific tokens before denoising, without explicit depth-based correspondences. By combining this memory with recent temporal context and few-step distillation, WorldCrafter enables streaming scene exploration from a single input image or text prompt. Experiments across static and dynamic scenes show substantial gains in long-horizon consistency and camera-control accuracy while preserving visual quality during minute-scale exploration.

AI.tldr: WorldCrafter 提出一种可查询相机的隐式三维感知记忆机制，通过让目标视角决定多视角证据如何压缩进视频生成器的 token 预算，实现长时程一致的视频世界模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型在长时程与跨视角下难以保持对历史观测的一致性，限制了交互式动态环境探索。核心挑战在于：如何在视频生成器有限的 token 预算内，有效整合多视角历史信息并尊重先验观测。
AI.method: 提出 WorldCrafter：训练与视频生成器联合进行，包含记忆编码器（memory encoder）与位姿条件读出模块（pose-conditioned readout），在去噪前将历史观测整合为固定的目标视角专属 token，无需显式深度对应；结合近期时序上下文与少步蒸馏（few-step distillation），支持从单张图像或文本提示进行流式场景探索。
AI.result: 在静态与动态场景实验中，长时程一致性显著提升，相机控制精度明显改善，同时在分钟级探索中保持视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: WorldCrafter 通过相机可查询的隐式三维感知记忆，将视角作为压缩多视角证据的引导，有效解决了长时程与跨视角一致性问题，为交互式视频世界模型提供了可行方案。

title: Generating Chest X-Ray Counterfactuals by Specialising Foundation Image Models
summary: Counterfactual image generation answers questions about how a subject would have looked under retrospective, hypothetical scenarios. Recent methods have improved perceptual quality, identity preservation and faithfulness to an underlying causal model, but their adoption in healthcare is limited by scarce annotated data, distribution shift between datasets, and mismatches between pretrained generative models and those required for counterfactual inference. We propose specialisation, a data and parameter-efficient framework for adapting pretrained, non-causal generative models into causal mechanisms under distribution shift. Based on this framework, we train a radiology counterfactual image generation model, called RadCF, using latent flow matching. We validate our approach on three chest X-ray datasets spanning different dataset shifts, data volumes, and counterfactual questions, associated with challenging, highly-localised interventions. Our results show that RadCF and specialisation improve counterfactual soundness over existing methods while being data and parameter efficient, and that the resulting counterfactuals can detect and mitigate shortcut learning in a downstream medical classifier. Code is available at https://github.com/GSK-AI/RadCF/.

AI.tldr: 提出specialisation框架，将预训练非因果生成模型适配为分布偏移下的因果机制，并训练出放射学反事实图像生成模型RadCF，在三个胸部X光数据集上实现了数据与参数高效的反事实生成，可检测并缓解下游分类器的捷径学习。
AI.motivation: 反事实图像生成在医疗领域应用受限，主要受制于：标注数据稀缺、数据集间分布偏移，以及用于反事实推断所需的生成模型与现有预训练生成模型之间的不匹配。
AI.method: 提出specialisation框架，以数据和参数高效的方式将预训练的非因果生成模型适配为分布偏移下的因果机制；基于该框架，采用latent flow matching训练放射学反事实图像生成模型RadCF。
AI.result: 在三个胸部X光数据集上验证，覆盖不同数据集偏移、数据量和反事实问题，并关联高度局部化的干预。结果表明RadCF与specialisation在数据和参数高效的同时提升了反事实合理性，且生成的反事实可用于检测和缓解下游医疗分类器中的捷径学习。
AI.conclusion: specialisation框架与RadCF证明了在真实医疗场景中，通过适配预训练生成模型可实现高效、可靠的反事实图像生成，并为缓解捷径学习提供实用价值。

title: GameHorizon Suite: Multi-Horizon Data and Evaluation in Gameplay
comment: We will release our dataset, annotator, and benchmark to facilitate future research. Github Repo: https://github.com/TencentARC/GameHorizon & Project Page: https://gamehorizon-suite.github.io
summary: Modern video games provide a measurable testbed for AI models, combining abilities of visual understanding, instruction decomposition, goal planning, and precise action control over multiple temporal horizons. Existing datasets and benchmarks, however, either cover a narrow range of games, lack language instructions, or rely on high-variance online rollouts. To address these challenges, we introduce GameHorizon, a unified data and evaluation suite that measures gameplay capabilities at different horizons for diverse model families. GameHorizon Suite consists of three components. First, GameHorizon-Annotator is a scalable and automated annotation pipeline for multi-horizon instructions. Second, utilizing the pipeline, we construct GameHorizon-Data, the first large-scale AAA gameplay dataset with temporally aligned videos, player actions, and multi-horizon instructions. It comprises 5,000 hours of recordings from 21 games, collected by 100 human expert players. Third, we build GameHorizon-Bench with reproducible offline and stepwise online testing. The offline track enables reproducible evaluation using thousands of standardized questions organized into three primary tasks and a series of diagnostic variants, while the online track tests whether offline scores reflect actual gameplay capabilities and localizes failures to specific steps within long-horizon gameplay. Based on our GameHorizon Suite, we evaluate 47 models through more than one million model invocations, revealing a meaningful hierarchy of task difficulty and pronounced differences in model capabilities. Our work can provide a standardized yardstick for evaluating gameplay capabilities across horizons and model families. We will release our dataset, annotator, and benchmark to facilitate future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GameHorizon，一个统一的数据与评测套件，用于在不同时间跨度上衡量多样化模型家族的游戏能力，包含标注流水线、大规模AAA游戏数据集与离线/在线基准。
AI.motivation: 现代视频游戏是衡量AI模型视觉理解、指令分解、目标规划与精确动作控制能力的可测量试验台。但现有数据集与基准要么游戏覆盖面窄、要么缺少语言指令、要么依赖高方差的在线rollout，难以提供统一、可复现的评测标准。
AI.method: GameHorizon Suite由三部分组成：1) GameHorizon-Annotator，可扩展的多时间跨度指令自动标注流水线；2) GameHorizon-Data，首个大规模AAA游戏数据集，含时间对齐的视频、玩家动作与多时间跨度指令，覆盖21款游戏共5,000小时，由100名人类专家玩家采集；3) GameHorizon-Bench，提供可复现的离线评测与逐步在线测试，离线赛道含三类主任务及诊断变体的数千标准化问题，在线赛道检验离线分数是否反映真实游戏能力并将失败定位到长时程游戏中的具体步骤。
AI.result: 基于该套件对47个模型进行了超过一百万次模型调用评测，揭示了清晰的任务难度层级以及模型能力间的显著差异。
AI.conclusion: GameHorizon为跨时间跨度与模型家族的游戏能力评测提供了标准化标尺，作者将开源数据集、标注器与基准以促进后续研究。

title: PixelDiT2: Representation-Grounded Pixel Diffusion Transformers
summary: Recent advances in pixel-space diffusion models have narrowed the image quality gap with latent-space diffusion, but still converge more slowly and lag behind in final image quality. We argue that a key reason is the lack of an explicit representation prior: unlike latent diffusion, which usually denoises in a compact and structured latent space, pixel diffusion needs to learn denoising-friendly representations and pixel generation simultaneously from raw RGB space. To address this problem, we propose PixelDiT2, an end-to-end pixel-space diffusion model designed to decouple representation learning from pixel generation without introducing an autoencoder or latent reconstruction bottleneck. We propose representation grounding that uses a frozen pretrained vision foundation model to provide explicit per-patch representation guidance throughout denoising, allowing the pixel diffusion transformer to focus more on pixel generation. On ImageNet-256x256, PixelDiT2 achieves an FID of 1.46 after 600 epochs; at 512x512 resolution, PixelDiT2 achieves an FID of 1.48 after 680 epochs.

AI.tldr: PixelDiT2通过引入冻结预训练视觉基础模型的表示接地，解耦表示学习与像素生成，在ImageNet-256达FID 1.46、512达FID 1.48。
AI.motivation: 像素空间扩散模型虽已缩小与潜空间扩散的图像质量差距，但收敛更慢、最终质量仍落后。作者认为关键原因是缺乏显式表示先验：潜空间扩散在紧凑结构化的潜空间中去噪，而像素扩散需同时从原始RGB空间学习利于去噪的表示与像素生成。
AI.method: 提出PixelDiT2，一种端到端像素空间扩散模型，在不引入自编码器或潜重建瓶颈的前提下解耦表示学习与像素生成。核心为"表示接地"（representation grounding）：利用冻结的预训练视觉基础模型在去噪全过程提供逐patch的显式表示引导，使像素扩散Transformer能更专注于像素生成。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-256x256上训练600 epoch后FID为1.46；在512x512分辨率上训练680 epoch后FID为1.48。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式表示先验的接地设计，PixelDiT2在不依赖自编码器的像素空间扩散中实现了与潜空间扩散相当的图像质量，验证了表示解耦策略的有效性。

title: Anatomy-Decomposed Chest Computed Tomography (CT) Projections as Scalable Supervision for Bone Suppression in Chest Radiographs
summary: Bone overlap can obscure abnormalities in chest radiographs, while scarce paired training data limit supervised bone suppression. We address this challenge with a digitally reconstructed radiograph (DRR) framework that converts chest computed tomography (CT) into paired supervision for component suppression. A novel bone segmentation algorithm enables CT decomposition into bone, non-lung soft-tissue, and lung components, which are projected separately. Their weighted combination yields synthetic radiographs with pixel-registered component images that sum exactly to the full DRR. Models trained on these data suppress bone or lung components by predicting the target component and recovering the remainder by subtraction, transferring to real radiographs without real paired training data. As an extension, their outputs on real radiographs provide target domains for unpaired, component-wise DRR translation, reducing the appearance gap while retaining anatomical details. Across multiple public datasets, downstream detection experiments demonstrate the utility of bone suppression, with gains concentrated on abnormalities with substantial bone overlap. Compared with open-source DRR engines applied to the same CTs, our unmodified DRRs achieve comparable realism and preservation of label-relevant anatomy, while translated DRRs achieve the best Fréchet inception distance (FID), lung-field sharpness, and agreement with source-CT anatomy among the evaluated methods. Models and inference code: https://huggingface.co/qureaiorg/bone-suppression; Translated projections: https://huggingface.co/datasets/qureaiorg/ct2xr-projections.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于DRR的框架，将胸部CT转换为成对监督数据以训练骨/肺成分抑制模型，无需真实配对的胸片数据即可迁移到真实X光并提升重叠区域的异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: 胸片中骨骼重叠会遮蔽异常，而监督式骨抑制受限于稀缺的成对训练数据。
AI.method: 采用数字化重建放射影像（DRR）框架：提出新的骨分割算法将CT分解为骨、非肺软组织与肺三类成分并分别投影；加权组合生成像素配准且各成分精确求和等于全DRR的合成胸片。在其上训练的模型通过预测目标成分、再用减法恢复剩余成分实现骨或肺抑制，并可迁移到真实胸片。进一步地，将真实胸片上的输出作为目标域，用于无配对、成分级的DRR翻译，缩小外观差异并保留解剖细节。
AI.result: 在多个公开数据集上，下游检测实验证明骨抑制的有效性，增益集中在骨骼重叠显著的异常上。与作用于同一CT的开源DRR引擎相比，未修改的DRR在真实感与标签相关解剖结构保留上相当，而翻译后的DRR在FID、肺野清晰度及与源CT解剖一致性上为所评估方法中最优。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以CT生成的成分级配对监督替代真实配对数据，实现可迁移的骨/肺抑制，并通过成分级无配对翻译进一步提升合成胸片的真实感与解剖保真度，对骨骼重叠区域的异常检测具有实用价值。模型与推理代码及翻译投影已公开。

title: GAE: Learning a Geometry-Native Latent Space for 3D-Consistent World Generation
summary: We present a compact geometry-native latent space as a shared foundation for perception and generation. Visual generators can produce photorealistic frames without preserving a consistent 3D scene. We argue that this is not only a modeling problem but also a representation problem: generators typically evolve appearance-centric latents, while perception models recover geometry in a semantically rich space that encodes cross-view structure. Rather than adding geometry as another output, we reparameterize a geometry foundation model's features into a compact latent space for generation. We realize this shift with the geometry-native autoencoder (GAE), whose latent is jointly decodable to appearance, depth, cameras, and point maps. With this state, a standard conditional flow supports diverse generation tasks. In controlled comparisons that hold the generator and training protocol fixed, replacing the latent with GAE improves both visual quality and independently measured 3D coherence: FVD falls by $12.7\%$ and $23.1\%$ on RealEstate10K and DL3DV, and camera-trajectory error is halved on RealEstate10K. Together, these results show that the latent space is central to geometry-consistent generation and can serve as a shared interface between perception and generation.

AI.tldr: 提出几何原生自编码器(GAE)，将几何基础模型特征重参数化为紧凑隐空间，作为感知与生成的共享接口，显著提升视觉质量与3D一致性。
AI.motivation: 视觉生成器能生成逼真帧却难以保持一致的3D场景。作者认为这不仅是建模问题，更是表示问题：生成器多演化以外观为中心的隐表示，而感知模型在语义丰富的几何空间中恢复跨视角结构。因此需要一种几何原生的共享隐空间。
AI.method: 提出GAE，将几何基础模型的特征重参数化为紧凑隐空间，而非将几何作为额外输出。该隐表示可联合解码为外观、深度、相机和点图；以此状态配合标准条件流(conditional flow)支持多种生成任务。对比实验中固定生成器和训练协议，仅替换隐表示。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K和DL3DV上，FVD分别下降12.7%和23.1%；在RealEstate10K上相机轨迹误差减半，同时提升视觉质量与独立测量的3D一致性。
AI.conclusion: 隐空间是几何一致生成的核心，可充当感知与生成之间的共享接口。

title: VideoGen-Agent: Reinforcing Video Generation Agents
summary: Recent advances in video generative models have enabled high-fidelity, temporally coherent video generation. However, these models often struggle to satisfy prompts requiring specialized knowledge, specific identities, physical consistency, or ordered events. In this paper, we present VideoGen-Agent, a multimodal agent trained through multitask agentic reinforcement learning to use external tools for video generation. The agent coordinates augmentation, generation, and verification tools through multi-turn interactions, using the prompt and intermediate observations to guide its decisions. We train a shared policy on a category-balanced dataset spanning six tasks. Supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated trajectories establishes tool-use behavior, which is then refined through reinforcement learning. A category-aware hybrid reward evaluates tool-call validity, task-appropriate tool use, and generated video quality. We further introduce VABench, a held-out benchmark of 600 prompts covering procedural knowledge, single- and multi-entity identity preservation, physical consistency, scene composition, and multi-shot temporal structure. On VABench, VideoGen-Agent improves over its base text-to-video generator by 19.1 points, from 56.5 to 75.6. Upgrading the generation tools further raises the score to 86.1 without additional agent training. Human raters prefer the upgraded configuration over the strongest standalone baseline in 84.3% of comparisons. These results support learning tool use across video-generation tasks and show that the trained agent can benefit from subsequent advances in generation tools.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 VideoGen-Agent，一个通过多任务智能体强化学习训练的多模态智能体，协调增强、生成与验证工具完成视频生成，并发布 VABench 基准，性能显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能生成高保真、时序连贯的视频，但在需要专业知识、特定身份、物理一致性或有序事件等提示下表现不佳。作者希望借助外部工具与智能体式工具使用能力弥补这一缺陷。
AI.method: VideoGen-Agent 通过多轮交互协调增强、生成、验证三类外部工具，依据提示与中间观测进行决策。方法包含三部分：在覆盖六类任务的类别均衡数据集上训练共享策略；先用教师生成的轨迹做监督微调以建立工具使用行为；再用强化学习精调，并采用类别感知的混合奖励评估工具调用有效性、工具使用是否任务适配及生成视频质量。
AI.result: 在自建的 VABench（600 条提示，覆盖程序性知识、单/多实体身份保持、物理一致性、场景构图、多镜头时序结构）上，VideoGen-Agent 相对基础文生视频模型提升 19.1 分（56.5→75.6）；仅升级生成工具、不额外训练智能体即可提升至 86.1。人类评估中，84.3% 的对比中更偏好升级配置而非最强单模型基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在视频生成任务中学习工具使用，并表明训练后的智能体可持续受益于生成工具的后续进步，具备良好的可扩展性与兼容性。
